Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de brief van de staatssecretaris over Italiaanse Dublinzaken van 23 mei 2023

An MP from Volt asked the State Secretary why Dublin transfers to Italy are being held for the full six-month transfer period despite court findings that Italy's reception shortcomings cannot be resolved on a known timeline, and why applicants are not yet placed in the national procedure. The State Secretary answered that the full transfer period will be awaited because Italy describes the suspension as temporary, that cases will be moved to the national procedure only after the deadline expires, and that Nederland may rely on mutual trust in other member states.
I still intend to await the final transfer deadline in these cases, because information from the Italian authorities shows that the situation is temporary.
Ik ben vooralsnog van plan de uiterste overdrachtstermijn in deze zaken af te wachten, omdat uit informatie van de Italiaanse autoriteiten blijkt dat sprake is van een tijdelijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dassen over de Zuid-Afrikaanse plannen om de wet aan te passen zodat zij Poetin niet hoeven uit te leveren

MP Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about South Africa's planned law change to avoid arresting Putin, Pentagon withholding of Russia war-crimes evidence from the ICC, and US ICC membership. The government declined to speculate on South Africa's intentions, defended the ICC's independence, said it cannot judge US Defence's evidence-sharing choices, and expects no near-term change in US ratification stance.
The cabinet does not consider it appropriate to anticipate the possible future conduct of the South African authorities.
Het kabinet vindt het niet gepast om vooruit te lopen op het mogelijke toekomstige handelen van de Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee, Dassen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Germany unsure if Orbán fit to be ‘EU president’'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks, Volt and VVD asked whether Hungary's upcoming EU Council presidency in July–December 2024 is acceptable given its unresolved rule-of-law and corruption problems, its Article 7 procedure, and risks to the MFF and Ukraine solidarity, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister replied that the rotation follows the agreed Council decision, that the cabinet will stress Hungary's presidency duties and keep pressing on rule of law, that it will not seek to change the rotation, and that it has no information on Germany opposing the presidency.
In the run-up to the Hungarian EU presidency, the cabinet will, together with as many like-minded member states as possible, emphasise that it expects Hungary to meet these responsibilities.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar het Hongaarse EU-voorzitterschap, samen met zo veel mogelijk gelijkgezinde lidstaten, benadrukken te verwachten dat Hongarije deze verantwoordelijkheden nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Cora van Nieuwenhuizen heeft een lobbyverbod maar bemoeit zich met het werk van klimaatminister Jetten’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the Minister of the Interior whether former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen breached the post-ministerial lobbying ban through contacts with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, and how enforcement will be ensured. The government answers that the ban was triggered by her brief five-day interim ministerial role, that her later letters were treated as Energie-Nederland positions, and that a statutory ban and register will follow in a forthcoming bill.
The lobbying ban makes no distinction based on the nature and duration of the ministerial office.
Het lobbyverbod kent geen onderscheid naar de aard en duur van het ministerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Mutluer, Teunissen, Sylvana Simons en Ellemeet over het bericht 'politie keek heimelijk mee in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, under which legal powers, and how this relates to the right to demonstrate. The Minister declined to comment on the specific case pending a court ruling, described general police information-gathering powers, and said the proportionality assessment lies with the police and the mayor.
I cannot address this specific question because the court is still considering the case concerning the suspicion of incitement.
Op deze concrete vraag kan ik niet ingaan omdat de rechter zich nog buigt over de zaak betreffende de verdenking wegens opruiing.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van de leden Boutkan en Dassen over het bericht 'Nederland laat miljoenen liggen om de wolf te weren'

Two Volt MPs asked the Minister of Finance about a newspaper report that the Netherlands leaves EU funds unused for wolf protection, including whether LIFE funds are used, and requested a detailed overview of EU funds, their uses, Dutch claims and communication. The government replied only that the answers cannot be provided within the usual deadline due to interdepartmental coordination and will follow as soon as possible.
cannot be answered within the usual period as a result of interdepartmental coordination
kunnen als gevolg van interdepartementale afstemming niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel ‘Landbouwlobby liet maatregelen uit nieuw waterbeleid van het Rijk afzwakken’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the agricultural lobby (LTO) influenced the new national water policy after a press report, and about the nature of its contacts with ministers. The government answered that the meetings were consultations tied to a policy letter rather than formal administrative consultation, that no minutes were kept, and that some suggestions were adopted while others were not.
No meeting report was made, but an appointment was made for a follow-up meeting.
Er is geen gespreksverslag gemaakt, wel een afspraak voor een vervolggesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de position paper 'Jongeren willen daadkracht: op naar een effectieve en uitvoerbare RES'

An MP asked the minister about JongRES's position paper proposing three scenarios, a binding oversight committee and national instruments for regional energy strategies, plus how youth voice would be secured. The minister confirmed receipt, maintained the 2030 targets remain achievable, declined to set up the committee or a national coordination scheme as a first step, and pointed to a subsidy and annual meetings to secure youth participation.
I therefore see no added value in establishing such a committee in relation to implementing a RES bid.
Ik zie daarom geen meerwaarde voor het instellen van een dergelijke commissie in relatie met het tot uitvoering brengen van een RES-bod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over de Corruption Perceptions Index 2022

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the minister about the Netherlands' 2022 Corruption Perceptions Index drop to eighth place, Transparency International's criticism of political integrity rules, party financing and lobbying oversight, and planned measures. The minister acknowledged the drop as a signal to take seriously, pointed to recent integrity measures and pending legislation, and said the government will act on the lobbying study and integrity follow-up.
The cabinet considers that this insufficiently does justice to the efforts made here over the past year.
Het kabinet vindt dat dit onvoldoende recht doet aan de inspanningen die hier het afgelopen jaar op zijn gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de brief 'No export credit support for Santos FPSO' van Nederlandse en Braziliaanse NGO’s

MP Dassen (Volt) asks whether export credit insurance has been granted for the Santos Basin FPSO project, how it fits the 1.5-degree scenario given the new no-fossil-expansion policy, and why it is still processed. The state secretary answers that the insurance is not yet granted, the application was filed before 1 January 2023 and falls under a transitional period allowing a policy until end-2023, while acknowledging the project would not fit the new policy.
For this category of projects the cabinet has decided to apply a limited transitional period: applications submitted before 1 January 2023 could lead to a policy until the end of 2023.

Voor deze categorie projecten heeft het kabinet besloten een gelimiteerde overgangsperiode toe te passen: aanvragen die zijn ingediend vóór 1 januari 2023 zouden tot uiterlijk eind 2023 tot een polis kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de berichten ‘Fabrieken worden stilgelegd door energieprijzen en dat gaan we merken’ en ‘Europese metaalbedrijven vrezen permanente sluiting van fabrieken’

MP Dassen asked the minister about reports that energy-intensive factories, especially in metals and chemicals, are halting production due to high energy prices, and about which goods are critical, EU coordination, and safeguards against permanent closure. The minister answered that a study on the impact is underway with results promised before year-end, that halts are company-initiated and not yet causing shortages, and that Europe's decarbonisation of steel is the long-term route.
As promised in the Commission debate on business policy of 19 October, I will inform your House of the outcomes of this study before the end of the year.
Zoals toegezegd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfsleven beleid van 19 oktober, zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren voor het einde van het jaar.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Collegegeld hoeft misschien maar 67 euro te stijgen’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether a news report suggesting the tuition fee rise for 2023/2024 could be only 67 euro, instead of 105 euro, was accurate, and whether the fee would be reduced if so. The Minister said the 2023/2024 statutory tuition fee of 2,314 euro was already fixed in October 2022 using the CPI average method, that a possible CBS change in energy price calculation would not affect this year's fee, and that it could at earliest apply to 2024/2025.
The level of the statutory tuition fee for academic year 2023/2024 was set at 2,314 euro in October 2022.
De hoogte van het wettelijk collegegeld voor studiejaar 2023/2024 is in oktober 2022 vastgesteld op € 2.314.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Europe’s heavy industry takes action to tackle energy crisis'

An MP asked the minister to reflect on an FT article about energy-intensive industry under high energy prices, whether the gas-curtailment plan covers gas-intensive sectors, whether a European curtailment plan is needed, whether fixteams for energy saving will be set up, and whether a German-style energy-efficiency network will be started. The minister answered that impacts vary by sector, that supply chain effects are considered, that the curtailment strategy is being coordinated with Belgium and Germany, that fixteams are mainly for households with a micro-business pilot, and that a business-park decarbonisation pilot will start this year.
This year we will start a pilot for an accelerated programme for sustainability of business parks.
Nog dit jaar zullen wij van start gaan met een pilot voor een versnellingsprogramma verduurzaming bedrijventerreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de nieuwe Amerikaanse wet die de export van geavanceerde chips en machines naar China verder aan banden wil leggen

Volt MP Dassen asked the Dutch ministers whether the US had requested Dutch-style export bans on chipmaking technology to China, whether a Dutch DUV machine ban was under discussion, and about the geopolitical implications. The government answered that it regularly consults the US on export controls but would inform parliament of relevant policy changes, declined to disclose the content of a confidential meeting, acknowledged economic interests, and said export control is a national competence while Dutch policy aims for European coordination.
Due to the confidentiality of this conversation, I cannot make statements about the precise content discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit gesprek kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze besproken inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Energy union or deindustrialisation'

MP Dassen (Volt) asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Economic Affairs about articles on energy prices causing deindustrialisation in Europe, and about the merits of a European Energy Union, a pan-European supergrid, a shared gas purchase and a European shutdown plan. Minister Adriaansens acknowledged the concern over high energy prices, said the government will inform parliament before year-end on the impact on industry, rejected the shutdown-plan and full Energy Union positions in part, and called the supergrid study's 32% savings figure uncertain.
As promised in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will inform your House before the end of the year about the impact of higher energy prices on industry.
Zoals toegezegd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober jl., zal ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar informeren over de impact van de gestegen energieprijzen op de industrie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het bericht 'Brussel duldt geen inmenging in besteding coronamiljarden'

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked whether the government supports the Commission's claim that disclosing documents on informal talks about the Dutch recovery plan would undermine decision-making, and how the decision-making process is defined. Minister Kaag answered that disclosure of pre-2022 documents no longer undermines the process, that the formal decision-making only started after the final plan was submitted on 8 July 2022, and that Parliament was kept informed throughout, while deferring the Commission-related questions to the Commission.

As regards the documents on the talks between the Dutch cabinet and the European Commission for this period that are in our possession, I am of the view that disclosing these documents no longer undermines the decision-making process surrounding approval of the Dutch plan.

Voor wat betreft de documenten over de gesprekken tussen het Nederlandse kabinet en de Europese Commissie voor deze periode die in ons bezit zijn, ben ik van mening dat openbaarmaking van deze documenten het besluitvormingsproces rondom de goedkeuring van het Nederlandse plan niet langer ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that schools forced to terminate energy contracts face up to twelve times higher costs, asking about the scale of bills, financial risks, monitoring, compensation and energy-efficiency targets for school buildings. The minister replied that no national overview of energy contracts or school finances exists, that a targeted support motion is being implemented with a report due by 1 December, that schools can report acute liquidity problems to the ministry, and that monitoring relies on annual accounts plus a sample inquiry.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers or what prices they pay.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben of welke prijzen zij betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet en Dassen over het vastleggen van het recht op abortus in het Europees Handvest van grondrechten van de Europese Unie

MPs Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet and Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about the US Dobbs ruling restricting abortion, funding of anti-abortion groups, and whether abortion access should be anchored in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights. The minister expressed concern, said abortion is mainly a member-state competence, and noted that anchoring it in the Charter would require treaty change, which support among member states may lack.
The cabinet is closely following the discussion on anchoring the right to abortion in the Charter and will further examine the feasibility of this initiative.
Het kabinet volgt de discussie over het verankeren van het recht op abortus in het Handvest op de voet en zal zich verder verdiepen in de haalbaarheid van dit initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het laatste IPCC-rapport en het besparingsplan aardgas van de NVDE

An MP asked the Minister about the IPCC report on fossil infrastructure emissions, the NVDE's gas-saving plan, and whether new North Sea gas extraction fits with climate goals. The Minister replied that gas extraction from small fields is still needed for supply security and that the NVDE's measures are largely already in place or being pursued through existing policy, without committing to a specific new extraction halt.
The cabinet continues to prefer extracting gas from small Dutch fields onshore and offshore, for as long and to the extent this is needed for Dutch gas demand.
Het kabinet blijft er de voorkeur aan geven gas te winnen uit de Nederlandse kleine velden op land en op zee, zolang en voor zover dit nodig is voor de Nederlandse gasvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de gevolgen van de keuze voor Amerikaans schaliegas als alternatief voor Russisch gas voor het behalen van onze klimaatdoelen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the climate and methane consequences of importing US shale-based LNG to replace Russian gas, and whether long-term contracts or commitments had been made. The government answered that the market decides, that the Dutch state and the European Commission made no binding supply agreements with US gas companies, and that climate targets remain in force while the methane and LNG risks are judged acceptable in the short term.
The Dutch State has not made any agreement whatsoever with American gas companies.
De Nederlandse Staat heeft geen enkele afspraak met Amerikaanse gasbedrijven gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het nieuwsbericht 'Faillissement door verkoopverbod tabak? Lobby klopte cijfers op'

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about a news report that a tobacco-sales-ban impact study commissioned by the government, by SEO Economisch Onderzoek, overstated bankruptcy risk under lobby pressure, and asked how commissioned research is checked for representativeness, objectivity, lobbying influence and Framework Convention compliance. The State Secretary answers that existing codes (ARVODI, ALLEA, GIR) provide sufficient safeguards, that the research design was approved by VWS and adjusted after supermarkets refused cooperation, that the government does not deem Article 5.3 FCTC breached, and that a lobby register and a new ministers' code will be pursued.
The cabinet will ask a professor with expertise in interest representation and political decision-making for advice on a lobby register, and report on it in autumn 2022.
Het kabinet zal een hoogleraar met expertise op het gebied van belangenbehartiging en politieke besluitvorming vragen om advies over een lobbyregister, en hierover najaar 2022 nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Kabinet mist kans echt transparant te zijn bij het ultieme lobby-evenement’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked why not all ministers' agendas from the World Economic Forum were made public and requested full disclosure of meetings with persons and organisations. The government replied that the programmes of the ministers attending the 2022 annual meeting are now public and are attached to the answers.
The programmes of the ministers during the 2022 annual meeting are now public.
De programma’s van de bewindspersonen tijdens de jaarvergadering van 2022 zijn inmiddels openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Dassen over de gele kaart procedure met betrekking tot de Europese kiesakte.

MPs asked whether the eight-week yellow card deadline for the European electoral act started from the Commission's publication date (3 May 2022), which would have expired before the 5 July vote on the motion. The minister answered that the period runs from the date the proposal was transmitted to national parliaments, which was 19 May 2022, so the deadline runs until 14 July and has not expired.
This means that the period within which each of the Chambers could issue a yellow card will expire on 14 July 2022 and therefore has not already expired on 28 June.
Dit betekent dat de termijn waarbinnen elk van de Kamers een gele kaart zou kunnen trekken op 14 juli 2022 zal verlopen en dus niet reeds op 28 juni is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de excessieve winsten van energiebedrijven

An MP asked whether windfall taxes on energy companies' excess profits, as used in Italy, Spain and other countries, could be adopted in the Netherlands, and why the government says profits cannot be mapped. The minister answered that profits depend on world markets, that a sector-specific windfall tax faces investment-climate, implementation and EU-law obstacles, and that an increase of existing mining levies on Dutch oil and gas production is an option.
Introducing a specific new windfall tax for energy companies is complex and involves several bottlenecks.
Het introduceren van een specifieke nieuwe windfall tax voor energiebedrijven is complex en kent verschillende knelpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel ' Fonds van 250 miljard moet eurozone versterken'

Dassen (Volt) asked the finance minister about a proposed 250 billion euro eurozone stabilisation fund inside the ESM, and whether reforms should be tied to access. Minister Kaag answered that the cabinet is sceptical of a central stabilisation function, citing doubts about need and risk, and that the fund would reduce ESM lending capacity and ease pressure on states to reduce debt, while noting reforms are generally valued but not a condition in the ESM discussion paper.
The cabinet is reluctant about proposals for a central stabilisation function for the eurozone, due to doubts about the need and concerns about the risks.
Het kabinet is terughoudend waar het gaat om voorstellen voor een centrale stabilisatiefunctie voor de eurozone, vanwege twijfels over de noodzaak, en zorgen om de risico's.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel "Brabant investeert in kernenergie uit gesmolten zout, maar hoe veilig is het? “Geen meltdown mogelijk”” en “Varende reactor meert aan in de stad”

An MP asked the minister about the province of Brabant funding molten-salt nuclear reactor research and the safety and role of such reactors in the Dutch energy mix. The minister welcomed the provincial support, said molten-salt SMRs are one option among many, noted they likely will not be commercially available before 2040, and pointed to a scenario study and ongoing government-funded research.

As announced when the market consultation on nuclear energy was presented, I am currently having a scenario study (for the period 2030 to beyond 2050) drawn up, which will examine the relationship between different types of CO2-free capacity and how nuclear energy can fit into the Dutch energy mix.

Zoals ook aangekondigd bij het aanbieden van de marktconsultatie kernenergie laat ik op dit moment een scenario-studie (voor de periode 2030-verder dan 2050) opstellen, waarbij zal worden ingegaan op de relatie tussen diverse typen CO 2 -vrij vermogen en op welke wijze kernenergie inpasbaar kan zijn in de Nederlandse energiemix.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Lobbyist Jack de Vries heeft toegangspas tot het ministerie van Defensie’

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about lobbyist Jack de Vries holding a Defence Ministry access pass, the status of a motion for a mandatory lobbying register, and rules on lobbying while employed by a department. The government replied that lobbyists have no free access to ministries, that a code of conduct for ministers is due mid-2022 with the motion taken into account, and that no overview of department staff with lobbying side jobs exists.
Lobbyists as such do not have free access to a ministry, and therefore also not to the Ministry of Defence.
Lobbyisten hebben als zodanig geen vrije toegang tot een ministerie, en dus ook niet tot het Ministerie van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Omtzigt en Klaver over het gebruik van privé berichtenservices en privé mailboxen door bewindspersonen voor hun werk

MPs asked whether ministers' use of private email and messaging apps for government work is covered by the Wob and parliamentary inquiries, and about the Kamp Gmail and Snel phone cases. The government answered that work-related messages on private accounts fall under the Wob and parliamentary inquiry powers, that a ministry review of the VWS/BZK private accounts found no security or archiving risk, and it promised to supply usage overviews for the current and previous cabinets later.

Under Article 6(1) of the Parliamentary Inquiry Act, a parliamentary inquiry committee can demand copies of, access to, or knowledge of work-related documents, regardless of the form of communication used.

Op grond van artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Wet op de Parlementaire enquête kan er door een ingestelde parlementaire commissie een afschrift van, inzage in of kennisneming van werkgerelateerde documenten gevorderd worden, ongeacht de gehanteerde vorm van communicatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Dassen over de openbaarmaking van de brief die Cora van Nieuwenhuis tekende voor de informateur, voordat zij minister werd en waarin zij beloofde om geen afspraken te maken over

MPs Omtzigt and Dassen asked the Prime Minister to publish the letter former minister Cora van Nieuwenhuizen signed before taking office, pledging no post-office arrangements, and whether her conduct and oversight of those pledges were adequate. The Prime Minister said the standard letter's text is fully public without signature and personal data, that there is no reason to think she breached her pledges, and that the cabinet plans no separate oversight of former ministers beyond new integrity measures requiring legislation.
The cabinet has no intention of establishing any form of oversight of (former) office holders.
Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens om een vorm van toezicht op (gewezen) bewindspersonen in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het EU herstelfonds

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked the Finance Minister why the Dutch EU recovery fund (RRF) spending selection was prepared behind closed doors without parliament and local governments, and about the timeline, consultation and Commission contacts. The minister answered that spending choices were set in the coalition agreement, that consultation has occurred and will continue via two draft plans shared with parliament, and that some correspondence will be released later via a pending FOI request.
In the process leading to submission of the final plan, the House, sub-national governments and other stakeholders will be involved.
In het proces dat leidt tot indiening van het definitieve plan zullen de Kamer, medeoverheden, en andere belanghebbenden meegenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het artikel ‘Van Nieuwenhuizen wilde aanblijven als minister toen ze baan aannam in de lobbysector, Rutte was akkoord’

Two MPs asked the government about former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen taking a lobbying job for the energy sector while still in office and attending cabinet budget meetings, and about whether Prime Minister Rutte's approval and existing integrity rules were adequate. The government answered that the former minister bears primary responsibility for integrity, that she left office in August 2021 after the Prime Minister's political assessment, and that a revolving-door ban, cooling-off period and independent advisory commission are planned via future legislation.
In the letter of 29 November 2021 from the then Minister of the Interior, three new measures were announced regarding the integrity policy for former office holders.

In de brief van 29 november 2021 van de toenmalig Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zijn drie nieuwe maatregelen aangekondigd ten aanzien van het integriteitsbeleid voor gewezen bewindspersonen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de interactie tussen organisaties inzake de situatie Afghanistan en het asiel- en migratiebeleid

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked how the IND was involved in deciding who could be evacuated or relocated from Afghanistan before and after 15 August 2021, and asked for internal advice, criteria and working instructions. The government answered that the IND was involved through questionnaires, document checks, social media checks and visa approval, that the IND's internal advice will be included in the pending Wob requests without a fixed date, and that the criteria were set via the existing tolkenregeling and later adjusted under the Belhaj motion amid extreme time pressure.
In handling the Wob requests, all relevant documents will be considered, including those of IND/DSUA.
Bij de behandeling van de WOB-verzoeken zullen alle relevante stukken worden betrokken, dus ook die van IND/DSUA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Alkaya en Dassen over het bericht ‘Belasting besparen: zo doen Zuidas-partners dat’

MPs asked whether Zuidas partners' use of BV structures and DGA arrangements lets them pay less tax than employees, whether the Tax Authority's agreements on reasonable salaries are acceptable, and whether a 20-partner BV constructions should be banned. The State Secretary acknowledges a possible gap, describes the excessive-lending bill and the reasonable-salary rules, says new policy options are unnecessary, and states that ministers' business interests were disclosed under a motion.
The Tax Authority does not address individual cases because of its statutory duty of confidentiality.
De Belastingdienst gaat in verband met zijn wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het integriteitsbeleid bewindspersonen

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Interior how the secretary-general would grant exemptions from the broadened post-office lobbying ban, who sits on the independent advisory committee, how GRECO recommendations are met, and whether the government wrongly informed GRECO that the lobbying ban had lapsed. The minister replied that exemptions weigh factors like duration of office and proximity of policy field, that the advisory committee role will be assigned to an existing college via future legislation, that responsibility for compliance lies primarily with former ministers, and that no organisations were misinformed because the ban was never withdrawn.
The lobbying ban applied and still applies in full.
Het lobbyverbod gold en geldt onverkort.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Gündoğan over het artikel 'Clash Hoekstra en Wiebes over plan Europees noodfonds'

MPs Dassen and Gündoğan asked about an RTL report of a clash between the Finance and Economic Affairs ministries over the Dutch Recovery and Resilience Plan and how the plan will be prepared and approved. The minister replied that the plan will be decided by the next cabinet, that a Finance-led programme directorate will draft it with Parliament consulted before formal submission, and that the plan is not yet fixed on reforms or spending.
Your House was informed of this on 27 November 2020 by means of a letter.
Uw Kamer is hier op 27 november 2020 over geïnformeerd middels een brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Gündoğan over het artikel ‘Clash Hoekstra en Wiebes over plan Europees noodfonds’

Two MPs from Volt asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about a reported clash over how the Netherlands should prepare its Recovery and Resilience Plan, including contacts with the European Commission, the factors behind the chosen package of plans, and parliamentary and regional involvement. The acting Finance Minister answered that the matter is being coordinated by the Finance Ministry and that the timing and content of plans will be decided with the next cabinet, with limited concrete commitments on parliamentary involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het toepassen van een milieueffectrapportage voorafgaand aan het vaststellen van de besluitvorming rondom de Regionale Energie Strategieën

An MP asked whether environmental impact assessment under the SEA Directive is required before Regional Energy Strategies (RES) are finalised, and how the government squares wind-park permits and the Aarhus Convention with recent Council of State and CJEU rulings. The State Secretary answered that the SEA Directive does not require a plan-MER for norms set in permits or zoning plans, that existing permits need not be withdrawn, that an already-in-progress RES is not a SEA-type plan so a plan-MER is voluntary, and that participation meets Aarhus, while promising a working group report by year-end.
An already-in-progress RES is not a "plan or programme" within the meaning of the SEA Directive, because a RES is not a plan or programme prescribed by legislative or administrative provisions.

Een al in besluitvorming zijnde RES is geen «plan of programma» in de zin van de SMB-richtlijn, omdat een RES geen plan of programma is dat door wettelijke of bestuursrechtelijke bepalingen is voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over interactie asiel- en migratiebeleid en evacuaties Afghanistan

Volt MPs asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuations, including whether correspondence between ministries and the IND would be shared, the IND's role in evacuation lists, and how asylum policy relates to crisis situations. The state secretary answered that correspondence will be released via pending FOI requests with no firm timeline, that the IND had a limited support role without staff in Kabul, and that the asylum policy framework accommodates crisis situations.
Your House will therefore receive an overview of the information disclosed in this context at or immediately after its publication.
Uw Kamer zal dan ook een overzicht van de in dit kader geopenbaarde informatie ontvangen bij of onmiddellijk na de openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de storing bij Facebook en Instagram op 4 oktober 2021

MPs asked about the impact of the 4 October 2021 Facebook and Instagram outage on Dutch government operations, citizens, and future resilience, as well as EU regulation and internet routing standards. The minister replied that government operations were largely unaffected because these apps are restricted to informal use, that the outage was caused by a human error at Facebook, and that existing EU and national measures (Telecommunications Act duties, NIB2 negotiations, DMA) are being pursued.
There are currently no known signals of such messages directed at the cabinet.
Er zijn op dit moment geen signalen bekend over dergelijke aan het kabinet gerichte berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de Conferentie over de Toekomst van Europa

Two Volt MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Conference on the Future of Europe is organised in the Netherlands, covering citizen representativeness, the choice of external contractor, themes, youth dialogues, coordination with provinces and municipalities, and how results will be used. The minister answered in detail, describing representative survey panels, online and in-person dialogues, a communication campaign, reports to the Conference and a planned timeline, without declining to provide requested information.
The cabinet will convey the outcomes of the national citizen consultations to the Conference and ensure they are taken into account in the Conference's final report.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten van de nationale burgerconsultaties overbrengen in de Conferentie, en er zorg voor dragen dat deze worden meegenomen in het eindverslag van de Conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over Afghanistan

An MP asked the foreign minister about a proposed EU emergency plan for evacuations and refugee reception following Afghanistan, including the mandate for the informal Gymnich meeting, possible non-paper, and coordination with migration ministers on shelter capacity. The minister replied that lessons from Afghanistan will be discussed at EU level, that refugee reception falls under the migration pact talks, and that the government will coordinate with the justice ministry but has not yet decided on a non-paper.
What precise form of steering or influence over this process the cabinet chooses or deems necessary cannot yet be said at this stage.
Welke precieze vorm van sturing dan wel beïnvloeding van dit proces het kabinet kiest of nodig acht valt in dit stadium nog niet te zeggen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Kabinet maakt vertrouwelijke notulen ministerraad openbaar.’

Volt MP Dassen asked whether the ministers of Finance and Foreign Trade, who also sit in parliament, would take part in the urgent debate on publicised cabinet minutes, and how this dual role affects the separation of power and countervailing power amid the childcare benefits scandal. The government answered that the dual role is permissible under article 57(3) of the Constitution during the caretaker period, that the questions about party-group deliberations cannot be answered by the cabinet, and that the ministers will participate in the debate as cabinet members.

Parliamentary questions are addressed to members of the cabinet. Questions concerning meetings of parliamentary party groups cannot be answered by the cabinet and must be raised in the parliamentary debate.
Kamervragen worden gesteld aan leden van het kabinet. Vragen die zien op de vergaderingen van Kamerfracties, kunnen niet door het kabinet beantwoord worden en moeten gesteld worden in het Kamerdebat.

The minister answered that an independent external investigation is announced, the algorithm is suspended pending results, DUO will only do random checks, and publication and the Algorithm Register are being pursued.
As indicated in my letter to the House of 21 June, I find these signals very disturbing and I have immediately announced an independent external investigation.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 21 juni vind ik deze signalen zeer verontrustend en heb ik direct een onafhankelijk extern onderzoek aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het aantal geweldsincidenten bij politie-inzet is gestegen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported rise in police use-of-force incidents, including the link to shorter police training, staffing shortages, public discontent, de-escalation, registration quality and registration of protest-related force. The minister answered that no complete explanation can yet be given, that the police plan an analysis, found no evidence linking the training change or staffing to the rise, and that existing sanctions and registration are considered adequate, though no protest-specific registration will be introduced.
To gain insight into the background and motives of officers for using force, qualitative research would be necessary.
Om inzicht te krijgen in de achtergrond en beweegredenen van agenten om geweld toe te passen, zou een kwalitatief onderzoek noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de zorgen van honderden techprominenten over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie (AI)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about tech leaders' concerns over AI's societal risks, whether public debate is adequate, the promised values framework, whether to pause powerful AI, and which advisory bodies advise on AI ethics. The government answered that it is developing a vision on generative AI with public input, pursuing EU AI regulation, and listing existing advisory bodies, while rejecting a pause as not addressing current harms.
I will inform your House before the summer about the progress.
Ik informeer uw Kamer nog voor de zomer over de vorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het nieuws dat de Binnenlandse Veiligheidsdienst jarenlang illegaal advocaten en academici bespioneerde

Left-wing SP MPs asked the Interior Minister about reports that the BVD illegally surveilled lawyers and academics, including Bakker Schut and people around him, and whether this resembled police-state methods and was a criminalisation of a lawyer. The minister replied that the 1970s investigations took place under a much thinner legal framework, that the RAF terrorism context applied, that today's stricter safeguards for lawyers (court authorisation, CTIVD oversight) are in place, and that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss the specific operational case.
Finally, I cannot publicly discuss the intelligence investigations of the AIVD and its predecessors.
Ik kan, ten slotte, in het openbaar niet ingaan op de inlichtingenonderzoeken van de AIVD en diens voorgangers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bouw van het datacentrum van Microsoft

An SP MP asked how Microsoft could keep building a data centre without a permit, whether preferential treatment undermines trust, whether the project should be halted, and what role EZK and NFIA played. The minister answered that the province of Noord-Holland, as competent authority, allowed construction via two gedoogbeslissingen, that the omgevingsvergunning was granted on 19 April but is not yet final, that the data centre is within designated zoning, and that NFIA's involvement was limited to investor relations and referral to regional authorities.
The college of gedeputeerde staten of the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority for permit granting, supervision and enforcement.
Het college van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland is het bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een Wob/Woo-verzoek uit januari 2021 naar de reactie op het rapport ‘Ongekend Onrecht’

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked for a detailed timeline of how the government handled a Wob/Woo request from January 2021 for drafts and related documents on the response to the 'Ongekend Onrecht' report, including court rulings, why it was omitted from an earlier list, and disclosure of the inventory and drafts. The Minister answered most questions substantively, providing timelines, the court ruling and decisions, but refused to release draft letters, citing the need for internal confidentiality, and deferred assessment of the handling to the court.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de recente rechterlijke uitspraken aangaande het toeslagenschandaal en het verzoek niet in hoger beroep te gaan

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about court rulings finding the state liable in the childcare benefits scandal, the decision not to appeal, the Landsadvocaat's arguments, and delays in the restoration operation. The State Secretary accepts liability following the Rotterdam ruling, does not appeal the Overijssel ruling (but will contest it in future cases outside the compensated years), and says efforts to speed up compensation continue.
The State agrees with the ruling of the Rotterdam court and thereby acknowledges liability for decisions for which the UHT has provided compensation.
De Staat verenigt zich met het oordeel van de rechtbank Rotterdam en erkent daarmee de aansprakelijkheid voor besluiten waarvoor de UHT compensatie heeft geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de nieuwe opzegboete bij vaste energiecontracten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the new early-termination fee for fixed-price energy contracts, the ACM's policy rule, and why the ACM's decision cannot be reversed by the minister or parliament. The minister defends the rule as proportionate and transparent, rejects postponing it or reinstating the ACM's annulment-proof status, and says the ACM's independence is required under EU law.
I do not intend to reverse the disapplication of Article 22 of the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies, as laid down in Article 10(1) of the ACM Establishment Act.
Ik ben niet van plan om het buitenwerking zetten van artikel 22 van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, zoals neergelegd in artikel 10, eerste lid, van de Instellingswet ACM, ongedaan te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het nieuws dat kringloopwinkels zich grote zorgen maken om het moeten bijhouden van een verplicht register voor alle binnengekomen producten middels het Digitaal

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about concerns from thrift shops over a mandatory product register via the Digitaal Opkopers Register, and whether it serves to prevent handling stolen goods and money laundering. The minister answered that the registration duty already exists, that it will be narrowed to theft-sensitive goods with a limited regime for free-donated items, and that a proportionate arrangement is being negotiated with the trade association.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de gevolgen voor mensen als de Staat blijft procederen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the State should be more restrained in appealing against citizens who already won in first instance, given the financial and mental burden, and whether the framework 'Behoorlijk omgaan met schadeclaims' and the Leijten/Ellian motion on the State as litigant will be applied. The minister acknowledges the burden, says the existing framework requires restraint and weighing of individual interests and that its current relevance will be reviewed, with a government update expected around summer.
As I indicated above, there is a framework within central government to ensure proper handling of damage claims within central government.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, bestaat er binnen de rijksoverheid een kader om een behoorlijke omgang met schadeclaims binnen de rijksoverheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Vattenfall krijgt tik op de vingers van rechter voor tariefsverhoging klant'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a court ruling that found Vattenfall's price-change clause unfair and annulled it, and about related consumer protection, model contracts and billing clarity. The minister answered that the ruling concerns an individual case under appeal, that the ACM does not track such tariff changes, that the contract was not a model contract, and that no broader investigation is planned.
I do not have these figures.
Ik beschik niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de invloed van het bedrijfsleven op het onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked how the government will limit business influence on academic research and teaching, ensure independence where companies fund chairs, and address gaps in universities' information on external funding. The minister answered that academic independence is the universities' own responsibility under supervision of supervisory boards, pointed to a UNL overview of external funding and a national register of ancillary activities due by end 2023, and said the broader funding review will not be adapted.
I consider it important that universities have current, complete and publicly accessible information on external funding of chairs.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat universiteiten informatie over externe financiering van leerstoelen actueel, volledig en publiek toegankelijk hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verdwijnen van stembureaus

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about the decline in polling stations, its uneven spread across neighbourhoods, long travel distances, election posters and whether a minimum norm should be set. The minister says the causes and spread are being studied in the evaluation of the 2023 provincial and water board elections, that gemeenten are legally responsible for polling stations, and opposes a fixed norm, promising to report findings in September.
It is a statutory responsibility of municipalities to ensure sufficient polling stations.
Het is een wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te zorgen voor voldoende stemlokalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de tijdelijke verrekenfactor voor nieuwbouw vanwege de hoger uitgevallen milieubelasting van warmtepompen

Two MPs (SP) asked why a temporary calculation factor for heat pumps' environmental impact was introduced without informing parliament, whether legal advice was obtained, and what the consequences are for the climate goals. The minister replies that the factor was developed by the independent Stichting NMD, that the government did not seek legal advice because the method itself was unchanged, that parliament was not informed since the database is managed by the sector, and that heat pumps remain climate-friendly overall.
If the calculation method or requirement designated in the building regulations is changed, your House will be informed of this.
Als de in de bouwregelgeving aangewezen bepalingsmethode of eis wordt gewijzigd, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Vattenfall 76 euro vraagt voor stadswarmte terwijl de inkoopprijs ongeveer een tientje is

Leijten (SP) asked the minister why Vattenfall charges 76 euro per GJ for district heat when the purchase price is about 10 euro, and how consumers can be protected and given insight into cost build-up. The minister answered that the price applies only above the 37 GJ volume cap, that the ACM supervises heat tariffs and returns, and that cost transparency is limited by confidential business information.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het risico op een onbeheersbare brand en het niet vertrekken van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken

An SP MP asked why the Ministry of General Affairs refuses to leave the Binnenhof despite fire-brigade warnings of an uncontrollable fire risk, why the move slipped from its planned date, and who is liable in case of fire. The government answers that the move is delayed because the planned temporary location at Catshuis was dropped, that Bezuidenhoutseweg 73 is being prepared, that extra fire-safety measures are in place, and that liability depends on the circumstances.
For this reason, the Central Government Real Estate Agency has requested an extension of the permit for use of the Binnenhof complex.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf heeft om deze reden een verlenging van de vergunning voor gebruik van het Binnenhof-complex aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bereikbaarheid van stemlocaties

An MP asked whether the government is aware that a regional transport strike on election day could make some polling stations inaccessible, and whether it would discuss free public transport with unions and operators. The minister confirmed awareness, said both the strike right and access to polling stations matter, and reported having urged the unions not to strike on election day without committing to any concrete structural measure.
I understand the concerns raised by a strike on election day, but of course also respect the right to strike.
Ik begrijp de zorgen die leven bij een staking op de verkiezingsdag, maar respecteer uiteraard ook het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over aanhoudingen door de politie

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Interior ministers about police arrests of Extinction Rebellion activists before a planned A12 blockade, including Amnesty's concerns about the right to demonstrate. The minister answered that the arrests were for suspected incitement, not preventive detention, that courts upheld most area bans, and that a full response to Amnesty's report will follow before summer 2023.
There has been no question of preventive arrests.
Er is geen sprake geweest van preventieve arrestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het over het bericht 'ACM doet onderzoek bij kantoren van Eneco, Essent en Vattenfall'

An MP (SP) asked the minister about the ACM's investigation visits to Eneco, Essent and Vattenfall, the ACM's reasons, how the information is used, and KPMG's role in the price-cap margin test. The minister answered that the ACM is an independent regulator that sets its own investigative approach, that the visits followed from the three firms' large market share, and that the ACM will report more in March.
It is up to the ACM as an independent regulator to shape its supervision of the reasonableness of tariffs.
Het is aan de ACM als onafhankelijk toezichthouder om het toezicht op de redelijkheid van tarieven vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het naleven van integriteitsregels door bewindspersonen

An SP MP asked why Minister Kaag's membership of the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board was not registered as a secondary position under the code of conduct, despite advice to register it, and about enforcement of integrity rules. The government answered that the role was an official function carried out for policy purposes rather than a Blauwe Boek side position, that the Chamber had been informed, and that the code is primarily the responsibility of each minister, with annual ministerial-council agendas and integrity training planned.
There is no secondary position within the meaning of the Blauwe Boek, the handbook for ministers, because the function was carried out in the context of policy implementation.
Er is geen sprake van een nevenfunctie in de zin van het Blauwe Boek, het handboek voor bewindspersonen, omdat de functie is uitgevoerd in het kader van de beleidsuitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de overheid die burgers monitort via sociale media

MP Leijten asks on what legal basis ministries, the Tax Authority and the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority store and process public social media posts, and why this differs from the NCTV practice the cabinet found unlawful, plus questions on transparency, sharing, use in policy and oversight. The State Secretary says such monitoring needs a legal ground under the GDPR and that a DPIA will be requested to map the practice, while acknowledging the need for transparency, limits on data, and oversight by the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Because several government bodies are involved, I intend to ask my colleagues to map the use of social media monitoring through a DPIA.

Omdat het hier gaat om verschillende overheidsinstanties, ben ik voornemens om mijn collega’s te verzoeken het gebruik van sociale media monitoring in kaart te laten te brengen door middel van een DPIA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Warmteleveranciers verhogen hun tarieven volgend jaar fors'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether heat supplier tariff increases of about a doubling were justified by actual costs, how the ACM monitors this, and what consumers can do. The Minister answered that he cannot yet judge whether all increases reflect real costs, pointed to ACM oversight, the return test and future data, and said consumers are protected by the Heat Act and the price cap.
I cannot currently assess whether the increase in heat tariffs is fully based on actual costs.
Ik kan op dit moment niet beoordelen of de stijging van warmtetarieven volledig gebaseerd is op de werkelijke kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Omtzigt over de marktconsultatie voor de schaderegeling voor ex-partners

MPs Leijten, Alkaya and Omtzigt asked why the government ran a market consultation on outsourcing the ex-partner compensation scheme to a commercial party, when it was decided and whether the UHT agency's own view was tested. The State Secretary answered that UHT and CWS lack capacity, the consultation tests market interest and feasibility before a tender, the Ministry of Finance would be the client, and the government regrets the delay but considers the consultation essential.
The market consultation is used to sound out whether market parties are interested in and able to carry out the compensation scheme.
Met de marktconsultatie wordt gepolst of marktpartijen geïnteresseerd en in staat zijn om de schaderegeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het handelen van DGB Energie

MP Leijten asked the minister about DGB Energie's sales practices, its ACM fine, outsourced telephone sales and customer service, licence revocation, bankruptcy risk from its corporate structure, and prize-cap subsidy advances. The minister answered that the ACM is responsible for enforcement and licence decisions, that suppliers remain liable for outsourced services, and that existing rules already prohibit misleading sales, while promising a progress report on the prize cap and that the ACM will be asked how it supervises responsiveness.
It is the task of the ACM to act when the rules are broken.
Het is de taak van de ACM om op te treden als de regels overtreden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de brandbrief van 50 topambtenaren over de verhouding tussen politiek en ambtenarij

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether he regards it as acceptable that a letter from 50 senior civil servants about the politics-civil service relationship reached the press, and asks for examples, the training content, and the letter itself. The government answers that civil servants work under ministerial responsibility and cannot speak publicly on policy, provides the letter, notes the matter was discussed with secretaries-general, and promises continued dialogue but gives no examples.
The letter makes no mention of this training.
In de brief wordt geen melding gemaakt van deze training.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de privatisering van politietaken

Two MPs (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the privatisation of police tasks, including which partners join dialogue tables on a future police vision, which stakeholders and disciplines are involved, which tasks are inherently public, and whether Parliament will be involved. The minister answers that strategic dialogue tables and essays will shape a white paper, that Parliament will be informed later, and that the political debate on public versus shared police tasks is needed, though substantive answers on task allocation are deferred.

As stated in my letter of 5 July 2022, I want to arrive at a thorough deepening and I attach importance to carefully going through all parts of the necessary process before formulating a substantive answer to the above questions.
