Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief van 5 juli 2022 wil ik komen tot een grondige verdieping en ik hecht eraan alle onderdelen van het hiervoor noodzakelijke proces zorgvuldig te doorlopen, alvorens een inhoudelijk antwoord te formuleren op bovenstaande vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de rechtsstaat en beloofde verbeteringen na het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the government about progress on promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including the eleven 'buikpijn' cases, the implementation of softer legal discretion, the role of inspectorates and ombudsman signals, the Landsadvocaat, and the Ministerial Commission on the childcare benefits recovery. The minister answered that the cases are being pursued by the relevant departments, gave progress updates across the reaction to the 'Ongekend onrecht' report, and said the Landsadvocaat and commission data are not available as overviews, while promising ongoing reporting to parliament.
No overviews are available of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er buitensporig vaak inzage in de persoonsgegevens van slachtoffers van het toeslagenschandaal heeft plaatsgevonden

MP Leijten asked whether police and other authorities queried personal data of victims of the childcare benefits scandal excessively often via the BRP, why, and whether such access is checked or logged. The government answered that police cannot identify victims in their records, that excessiveness cannot be judged generally, that no signals of excessive queries were known beyond the FTM report, and it outlined existing AVG and Wpg accountability and access rules, with logging of police data use (art. 32a Wpg) due to take effect by May 2023.
The police do not know which persons are victims of the childcare benefits affair.
Het is voor de politie niet bekend welke personen gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese inmenging in Nederland

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen and Leijten asked about reports of Chinese 'police service stations' in the Netherlands, whether those staff can stay and be prosecuted, whether the AIVD knew, where the limits of foreign interference lie, what infrastructure Chinese state actors hold and how to prevent its use as leverage, and whether cruciale sectors should be under Dutch control. The government said the stations have been closed after diplomatic protests, that no evidence yet shows staff were sent from China, that investigation continues and prosecution is not ruled out, declined to comment on AIVD knowledge, pointed to its three-track anti-interference approach and a planned espionage bill, and described the Vifo screening law and a reinforced vital-infrastructure approach while citing partial Chinese ownership of Rotterdam container terminals.
Regarding the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the intelligence services, the AIVD, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet de AIVD, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over spionage met gebruik van Pegasus- of vergelijkbare software

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government distinguishes security risks for ministers and senior officials, whether it will raise security measures against spyware such as Pegasus, and how it oversees use of intrusion software. The ministers answered that departments are responsible for their own digital security under the BIO framework, that intrusion software use is subject to legal safeguards and judicial, prosecutorial and intelligence oversight, and that they will not publish which software is used.
To protect means and methods, it is not possible to give public insight into which software the police use when carrying out this power.
Het is voor de afscherming van middelen en methodieken niet mogelijk om openbaar inzicht te geven in welke software de politie gebruikt bij de uitvoering van deze bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Kwint en Van Nispen over de inzet van voorspellende algoritmes met betrekking tot kinderen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether the police would keep using the ProKid Plus algorithm to predict violent crime among children, and about oversight, data, safeguards and links to youth care and the Top400 approach. The minister answered that ProKid Plus was used only once in a 2016 Amsterdam trial, is no longer used, that a new police alerting system (ProKid 23-) is still under legal and ethical assessment, and described existing legal safeguards and oversight, while committing to no new structural rule changes.

The experiences with ProKid Plus underline the importance of good safeguards for the use of algorithms, to which the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, is giving extra attention.

De ervaringen met ProKid Plus onderstrepen het belang van goede waarborgen voor het gebruik van algoritmen, waar de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming extra aandacht voor heeft.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) over de voorbereiding van de Tijdelijke wet onderzoeken AIVD en MIVD naar landen met een offensief cyberprogramma op basis van de eerste Woo-besluiten van de ministeries van

An MP asked the Ministers of Interior and Defence about the preparation of the Temporary Act for AIVD and MIVD investigations into states with offensive cyber programmes, including which MPs were consulted, withheld content in disclosed Woo documents, informal contact with the Council of State, the use of 'white coats' to promote the bill, and the role of the oversight bodies TIB and CTIVD. The Minister answered that consultations were held to gauge support, that redactions reflect personal policy views and confidentiality of drafts, that the bill shifts prior authorisation to ongoing oversight by CTIVD to match cyber practice, and that the oversight bodies were consulted but not on the steering group.
The passages redacted under the Woo in these notes mainly concern the content of the draft bill.
De op basis van de Woo gelakte passages in deze nota’s, betreffen hoofdzakelijk passages over de inhoud van het conceptwetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht ‘GGD trekt stekker uit digitaal jeugddossier ondanks investering van miljoenen’

MPs Hijink and Leijten asked why three GGDs stopped developing a digital youth health dossier after millions in investment, and about alternatives, data safety and oversight. The State Secretary answered that the decision belongs to the GGD boards, that no data-safety problem exists, that alternatives will be bought from the market, and that national information standards and municipal responsibility apply.
It is not for me to respond.
Het is niet aan mij om met een reactie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitspraak van de rechter in de rechtszaken tussen RWE en Uniper en de Staat

Leijten (SP) asked the climate minister how the court rulings in the RWE and Uniper cases against the State affect climate policy, whether policy was chilled by litigation fears, the status of arbitration, and compensation and costs for coal plant closures. Minister Jetten answered that the rulings confirm consistent climate policy, that no policy was affected by litigation fears, arbitration is suspended, and the State recovers only part of its legal costs.
No, no policy has been inhibited or influenced out of fear of legal proceedings.
Nee, er is geen beleid geremd of beïnvloed uit angst voor juridische procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de beantwoording van eerder gestelde vragen over het bericht ‘Energieplafond drijft prijzen en subsidies verder op'

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy whether raising energy tariffs under the price cap increases state costs, whether the tariff rises by Vattenfall and Essent are justified, whether the cap constitutes state aid, and how the margin test and external advice were arranged. The minister answers that the state compensates the gap between the cap and contract price subject to a margin test, that the ACM is responsible for reviewing reasonableness, that the Commission's state-aid decision is pending with no payments before approval, and that the underlying documents were sent to parliament on 9 December.
It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), as an independent regulator, to check under its statutory duty whether the tariffs energy companies charge are reasonable.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) als onafhankelijke toezichthouder om conform haar wettelijke taak te controleren of de tarieven die energiebedrijven rekenen redelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over werkinstructies over de compensatie O/GS en non-response

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about new work instructions for the O/GS compensation and non-response cases, including why compensation is now calculated on the amount actually repaid and why the changes apply only to new decisions. The State Secretary replied that the calculation was adjusted to match the legislator's intent, that compensation still covers the full recovered amount, that past decisions are not reopened, and that the non-response instruction now relies more on the parent's account.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Erkens over het bericht 'Inspectie: burgers onvoldoende beschermd tegen geluidsoverlast windmolens'

MPs Leijten and Erkens asked why a 2009 HUF assessment of wind turbine noise rules was initially reported as absent, why its warnings about the annual-average noise norm were not shared with parliament, and whether the norms and existing permits will be revisited. The state secretary acknowledged the earlier search failure, explained that the assessment's personal policy views were withheld in 2009 and later released, and said the inspectorate's concerns led to tightened measurement rules and a night norm while the new plan-MER will decide any further changes.
In response to the Woo request, it was stated that all requested documents had already been involved in an earlier relatively recent decision (19-08-2021) under the Wob.

Bij het betreffende Woo-verzoek is aangegeven dat alle opgevraagde documenten al betrokken zijn geweest bij een eerder relatief recent besluit (19-08-2021) op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door vervoersbedrijven

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether anonymous international train travel is practically impossible, who is responsible for processing passenger data, and why ticket counters are closing. The state secretary answered that anonymous travel is still possible to about 200 destinations, that there is no general legal duty on carriers to prevent anonymous travel, that the GDPR governs data processing with controllers identified per ticket sale, and that the number of international ticket counters fell from 10 to 5 with personal assistance offered elsewhere.
Providing personal data when travelling is not unusual.
Het afgeven van persoonsgegevens bij vervoer is niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het artikel 'Energieplafond drijft prijzen en subsidies verder op'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about an FD op-ed arguing that the temporary energy price cap drives up prices and subsidies, including suppliers coordinating higher prices, welcome gifts used to attract customers, and whether suppliers are compensated in advance. The minister rejected collusion claims, said volume limits and independent accountant checks guard against overcompensation, and said welcome bonuses are allowed under current law while the ACM plans new rules, though he did not commit to dropping advance compensation or a cost-only model.
An independent accountant also checks the relevant costs and, where there is reason to, improperly charged costs can be reclaimed afterwards.
Er vindt ook een controle plaats op de relevante kosten door een onafhankelijke accountant en waar daartoe aanleiding is, kunnen onterecht in rekening gebrachte kosten achteraf worden teruggevorderd.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Agressieve verkoper van energiecontracten start eigen energiemaatschappij. Radar Checkt!'

An MP asks the Minister about the energy supplier HEM, its five-year variable-rate contracts, whether ZZP-ers can be sold them, how a firm can sell energy without a licence, and how ACM oversight and consumer protection can be tightened. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says ACM oversees licensing and supplier conduct, points to stricter licensing rules in force since 4 October 2022 and forthcoming Energiewet provisions, and says courts or the dispute committee handle exit fees.
Tightening supervision of suppliers and setting additional requirements is urgently needed and has my full attention.
Het aanscherpen van toezicht op leveranciers en het stellen van extra eisen is hard nodig en heeft mijn volle aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over mensen die afgesloten worden van energie en het beleid om dit te voorkomen

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how many households have been disconnected from gas or electricity despite the government's pledge of no winter disconnections, and what measures prevent it. The minister said data do not show total disconnections for wanbetaling, announced a tightened disconnection regulation with mandatory payment-arrangement offers until 1 April 2023, and said the ACM and dispute bodies supervise compliance.
Grid operators only have insight into the numbers of end-of-supply signals they receive from suppliers and the number of disconnections carried out by grid operators.
Netbeheerders hebben alleen inzicht in de aantallen «einde leveringssignalen» die zij vanuit leveranciers ontvangen en de aantallen afsluitingen (door netbeheerders).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een mislukt ICT-project dat gegund is aan een stichting van een ambtenaar

MP Leijten asked why the Ministry of BZK awarded a failed ICT project to a foundation whose board included civil servants of the same ministry, and about the decision-making, advice, information to parliament and mistakes made. The minister answered at length, acknowledging that the foundation was set up outside the Stichtingenkader procedure, that the award was insufficiently justified and documented, that the appearance of conflict of interest arose, and that parliament was not informed, while promising improvements.
Your House was not informed about the award of the assignment to and the termination of the cooperation with foundation NTF.
Uw Kamer is niet geïnformeerd over de opdrachtverlening aan en het beëindigen van de samenwerking met stichting NTF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Eneco snoeit in de vergoeding voor teruglevering van stroom

MP Leijten asked the minister whether Eneco's cut in the feed-in compensation for solar electricity is unfair to households and how to prevent other suppliers following suit. The minister replied that suppliers must pay a reasonable compensation supervised by the ACM, proposed a 80% statutory minimum and an absolute maximum from 2025, and said Eneco would reverse the cut for fixed contracts.
Currently this provision applies to a limited number of small consumers who generate electricity with solar panels.
Momenteel geldt deze bepaling voor een beperkt aantal kleinverbruikers die elektriciteit opwekken met zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Essent maakt stroom en gas flink duurder'

An SP MP asks the government whether Essent's sharp energy tariff increases from 1 October 2022 are close to the planned price cap, whether agreements were made with suppliers, who monitors supplier purchase prices, and how overcompensation and profit-taking via the cap will be prevented. The minister replies that the ACM monitors reasonableness of supplier tariffs and that the cap is designed to avoid over- and undercompensation, but gives no commitments to freeze tariffs or new interventions.
I see no need to take earlier measures that intervene in the interim in the price formation of individual suppliers.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om eerder maatregelen te nemen die tussentijds ingrijpen ten aanzien van de prijsvorming bij individuele leveranciers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de zorgen van Netbeheerder Nederland over het rampscenario van 1 miljoen huishoudens de worden afgesloten omdat ze hun energierekening niet meer kunnen betalen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether he agrees that the worst case is one million households being disconnected for unpaid energy bills, what will prevent this, and whether the climate fund can relieve energy costs. The minister answered that the cabinet is pursuing income-support measures and tightened disconnection protections, that the energy-price measures are separate from the climate fund, and that saving energy and tackling price rises are complementary.
This tightening means the supplier must make every effort to contact the customer and offer the customer an appropriate payment arrangement.
Deze verruiming houdt in dat de leverancier zich tot het uiterste moet inspannen om met de klant in contact te komen en de klant een passende betalingsregeling moet bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de komst van het energiebedrijf Gunvor naar Nederland met mogelijke betrokkenheid van Vladimir Poetin

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether President Putin has a stake in Gunvor, which plans a green hydrogen terminal in Rotterdam, and whether its establishment is acceptable given sanctions. The minister answered that no indications of Putin ownership were found, that Gunvor's ownership is held by Torbjorn Törnqvist, that existing screening and investment checks cover sanctions compliance, and that no measures against the plan are currently justified.
Based on the currently available information, there are no indications that this is the case.
Op basis van de thans beschikbare informatie zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat hiervan sprake is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het lekken van geheime kabinetsplannen

The SP's Leijten asked the Prime Minister about leaked draft budget and purchasing-power measures for Prinsjesdag, how the press obtained them, what has been done to prevent leaks, and who had access. The government declined to confirm or deny specific reported measures, citing the embargo, said it deplored leaks, and gave only general answers about coalition consultations and confidentiality rules.
I therefore cannot yet address specific measures reported in the media, as I would thereby be confirming or denying measures.
Ik kan daarom op dit moment nog niet ingaan op specifieke maatregelen die in de media worden genoemd, aangezien ik daarmee maatregelen zou bevestigen of ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht Duitsland redt energiegigant Uniper en schrapt rechtsgang Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether Uniper had withdrawn its arbitration claim against the Netherlands, about RWE's claim, contacts with the companies, nationalisation of energy suppliers, and why failed suppliers were not rescued. The minister said the arbitration is suspended pending Uniper's shareholder approval, the Dutch lawsuit continues, nationalisation does not lower consumer prices, and the existing supplier-failure system ensures continuity, with a review of financial requirements promised.
I do not see nationalising an energy supplier as a solution to high supply prices or to improve the functioning of the energy market.
Het nationaliseren van een energieleverancier zie ik niet als oplossing voor hoge leveringsprijzen en/of om de werking van de energiemarkt te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een journalist die jarenlang gevolgd wordt door de AIVD

Opposition MP Leijten asks the Interior Minister whether journalist Stella Braam, followed by the AIVD for decades, can do her work freely, whether such surveillance is standard practice, why she was not informed, and what safeguards apply. The minister answers that surveillance of journalists is exceptional, subject to heightened safeguards (Hague court authorisation, stricter proportionality test, CTIVD oversight), declines to discuss the individual case, and says the AIVD will improve its inzage procedure explanations.
Surveillance of journalists (meaning AIVD investigation using special powers) occurs only in exceptional cases.
Van «volgen» (te weten: het doen van onderzoek door de AIVD met inzet van bijzondere bevoegdheden) van journalisten is slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit die ongevraagd gegevens van honderdduizenden patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg opvraagt

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked why the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa collects mental health patients' medical data without consent, whether this is acceptable given remaining re-identification risk, and whether providers refusing on confidentiality grounds face fines. The minister replies that the NZa has a statutory basis under the Wmg and GDPR art. 9(2)(g)/(h), that data are pseudonymised and destroyed after two years, that consent is not required for legally mandated transfers, and that enforcement is for the NZa to decide.
It is correct that patients are not asked for consent to share their medical data with the NZa, and that is also not necessary, because the NZa has a statutory basis to request this data.

Het klopt dat patiënten niet om toestemming gevraagd wordt om hun medische gegevens te delen met de NZa en dat is ook niet noodzakelijk, omdat de NZa een wettelijke grondslag heeft om deze gegevens op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over het gestrande onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen door schuldenproblematiek en/of het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked why an independent study into child removals linked to debt problems and the childcare benefits scandal stalled, and whether the minister had intervened. The minister replied that he had no involvement, that the judiciary chose not to co-operate with Groningen because cases are still pending, that an Inspectorate study and a planned independent commission are under way, and that he sees no reason for another study now.
In addition, at the request of your House I am working on establishing an independent investigation committee.
Daarnaast werk ik op verzoek van uw Kamer aan de instelling van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over lekkende zorgdata

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the ministers how a commercial software firm could leak medical data of tens of thousands of patients, why warnings from a former employee were not acted on, whether patients and GPs must be informed, and whether additional protections against commercial use of medical data are planned. The government answered that providers are primarily responsible, that the AP supervises GDPR compliance, that it cannot comment on AIVD/MIVD investigations, and that existing rules are sufficient with further awareness and enforcement efforts.
No public statements are made about the working methods and investigations of the AIVD and MIVD.
Over werkwijzen en onderzoeken van de AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over ‘de rol van de premier in de Uber-files’

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Prime Minister about his and his advisers' contacts with Uber, Neelie Kroes's informal role, her appointment as StartupDelta envoy and the Uber Files revelations. The Prime Minister answered that he knew of Kroes's advisory role since 2016, described his meetings with Uber executives as functional business contacts, declined to comment on the Dutch prosecution and tax matters, and referred several questions to the European Commission, the Tax Authority and other ministries.
I have been aware of Ms Kroes's role as a member of Uber's advisory council since her appointment in May 2016.
Ik ben sinds haar aanstelling in mei 2016 op de hoogte van de rol van mevrouw Kroes als lid van de adviesraad van Uber.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over signalen dat gemeenten slecht voldoen aan de verplichtingen uit de privacywet

An MP asked the government about signals that municipalities poorly comply with privacy law (AVG) and lack resources for data protection, and what oversight exists. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to a WODC study and a 150 million euro investment, said the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and municipal data protection officers hold supervisory roles, and promised further talks with the VNG and a review of a national register for data protection officers.
The cabinet does not supervise compliance with the GDPR at municipalities.
Het kabinet houdt geen toezicht op de naleving van de AVG bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over racisme en geweld bij de politie en een incompleet dossier

SP MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about racism and police violence in Rotterdam and a court ruling that the prosecution's file was incomplete, leading to inadmissibility. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, described the internal disciplinary outcome and criminal proceedings, and promised stricter sanctioning of discrimination and a forthcoming update to parliament.
I cannot go into individual cases that are before the court.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Chroom 6 aangetroffen in grondwater bij Tata Steel’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reported chromium-6 contamination of groundwater at Tata Steel, the lack of health protection, the implementation of a motion on health gains, the smoke incident, the timeline for sustainability agreements, and subsidies. The government answered that the GGD sees no health risk because there is no exposure, that the environmental service has ordered follow-up research and tightened permits, and that binding maatwerk agreements depend on a complete business case, so no firm timeline is given.
However, I will not make concessions on a careful assessment of the business case; I will not take irresponsible risks with taxpayers' money.
Ik ga echter geen concessies doen aan een zorgvuldige beoordeling van de business case, ik ga geen onverantwoorde risico's nemen met belastinggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verhuizing van DSM naar Maastricht

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the move of DSM's head office from Heerlen to Maastricht, with public subsidies, betrays the Mijnstreek and lacks historical awareness. The minister expressed understanding for regional disappointment, said DSM made its own business decisions and dropped the subsidies, and noted DSM-Firmenich will keep one head office in the region.
However, it remains a decision of DSM itself.
Het blijft echter een besluit van DSM zelf.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de inform

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Foreign Affairs Minister what measures the ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, on hardship-causing laws, prior inventories, the handling of new proposals, the baseline measurement for digital information management, the chat-message retention policy, and the number of FOI requests. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of hardship-causing rules, outlined the methodology and timelines, described the retention rules for chat messages, and referred to attached overviews for FOI request data.
Question 2: Has this research, or have these studies, been shared with the House? If not, can you explain in detail why not and send the research to the House without delay?
Vraag 2 Is dit onderzoek of zijn deze onderzoeken met de Kamer gedeeld? Zo nee, kunt u uitgebreid motiveren waarom niet en kunt u het onderzoek onverwijld naar de Kamer sturen?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardheden en d

The SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh rules and information management, including inventories of harsh legislation, methods used, new-proposal safeguards, chat-message retention and FOI request backlogs. The minister answered that each department is conducting an inventory of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for timelines and methods, said chat messages need only be kept when the decision is not recorded elsewhere, and provided a FOI overview in an annex.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department is conducting an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked the Ministers of SZW and the Prime Minister which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and their information management. The government answered that departments are inventorying harsh laws under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that independent research and a chat-message retention policy exist, and that further letters and action plans will follow.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department carries out an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardhe

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked which measures the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality has taken following the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh consequences of laws and the handling of information. The minister responded that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that research reports and timelines were or will be shared, and described the chat-message retention policy and pending Wob/Woo request figures.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every department is carrying out an inventory of laws and regulations that have harsh effects on people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuisho

Leijten (SP) asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Economic Affairs what measures her ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, against laws and procedures that cause hardship, and about its information management, including chat message retention and FOI/WOO requests. The minister, on behalf of the cabinet, answered that departmental inventories of harsh regulations are under way, pointed to separate reports and letters, and described the chat-message retention rules for officials.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de in

MPs Leijten and Kwint asked what the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science has done after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship-causing laws, the review of such rules, its information management and handling of FOI requests. The minister answered that departmental inventories of hardship-causing regulations are underway under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, with results and timelines to be sent to parliament, and that chat-message retention follows government-wide rules.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informa

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Security Ministry what measures it has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, to find and fix harsh or disproportionate laws and procedures and to manage its information (including chat messages and FOI requests). The minister replies that the department is carrying out the government-wide inventory of harsh rules under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, is applying a shared analysis toolkit, will report on timelines in an annexed letter, and is clarifying the chat-message retention rules for ministers, with a practical proposal promised by end of August.
To this end, a practical proposal for a uniform working method that ministers can use will be made by the end of August.
Hiertoe wordt voor eind augustus een praktisch voorstel gedaan voor een uniforme werkwijze die door de bewindslieden gebruikt kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Financiën naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister what measures the Finance Ministry took after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh outcomes of rules and on information management. The minister answered that inventories of harsh rules are underway across departments, that results will be sent later, and that chat-message retention guidance for ministers will be clarified.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the Minister of Interior about measures at her ministry after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship rules and information management, including investigations into harsh regulations, a baseline measurement for information management, the EUR 780 million budget, and chat message retention. The minister answered that each department is conducting inventories of harsh rules, that the Open op Orde programme and a regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding are in place, and that the departmental action plans and baseline measurements will be sent to the House, with promises of further updates after the summer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

The MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Ministry of VWS what measures it has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and rules, and about its information management such as retention of chat messages and FOI request handling. The minister answered that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for details, and described the chat-message retention policy.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Defensie naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuisho

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Minister of Defence what measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of rules and the information management. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of harsh legislation under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that the ministries' action plans and baseline measurements will be sent separately, and that the chat-message retention policy for ministers is being clarified.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every ministry is carrying out an inventory of legislation and regulations that work harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Energieleveranciers moeten btw-verlaging direct doorberekenen'

An SP MP asked whether energy suppliers should pass the VAT cut on to households directly, arguing that customers must act themselves to benefit and many will not claim it. The State Secretary replied that suppliers will show the VAT cut in advance payments as far as possible, that a broad lowering of advance payments is undesirable, and that the government is in contact with suppliers on payment problems, without committing to a binding rule.
Broadly lowering advance payments is undesirable.
Het breed verlagen van voorschotten is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het nieuws dat de SMS-controle van DigiD wordt uitgefaseerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about plans to phase out SMS authentication for DigiD, whether this forces use of Apple and Google apps, why the app is not open source, and whether trackers and US data access are a concern. The State Secretary answered that SMS authentication remains for now, that the app is limited to iOS and Android for reach and security reasons, that the source code is being explored for publication, and that the trackers are technical and collect no personal data.
An exploration of whether it is possible to publish the DigiD source code as open source is underway, but publication must be done in a responsible and secure way.
Een verkenning of het mogelijk is om de broncode van DigiD open source te publiceren is gaande, maar het publiceren van de broncode moet wel op een verantwoordelijke en veilige manier mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over discriminatie en racisme bij politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about discrimination and racism within the police, following a documentary in which police officers said they would not return to the force. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a new police leadership statement, a national coordinator for combating racism, and a planned tiered sanctions regime, but declined to set a firm timeline and gave limited concrete figures.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the elaboration of this.
Over de uitwerking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ethisch profileren bij de IND bij 'erkend referenten'

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked why the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors (erkend referenten), which registered company board composition and reportedly profiled by origin, was stopped without public notice, whether other ministries were informed, and whether risk profiling by government should be halted. The government replied that the model had no consequences for decisions, that the board-composition indicator was never used in scoring but was wrongly registered, that it acknowledged an unheeded 2017 legal warning, and that it will inform the House before the summer recess on the results of the Motion#21 investigation into discriminatory risk models.
I regret that an internal memo from the IND's Legal Affairs department, which in 2017 advised stopping the risk model, was not acted on more quickly.
Ik betreur dat er niet sneller opvolging is gegeven aan een interne notitie van de afdeling Juridische Zaken van de IND, die in 2017 adviseerde met het risicomodel te stoppen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over terugtrekking uit het Energiehandvestverdrag

An SP MP asked the climate and energy minister whether the Energy Charter Treaty conflicts with the Paris Agreement, whether Netherlands is preparing withdrawal, how intra-EU arbitration can ignore the Komstroy ruling, and about the climate risks of EU modernisation proposals, RWE/Uniper claims and ministerial contacts with those companies. The minister answered that the treaty is not fully aligned with Paris and that legal scenarios including withdrawal are being studied, but declined to detail contacts with RWE and Uniper because the matters are pending before courts or arbitration.
Matters currently before the courts or pending before the arbitration tribunal are not discussed in mutual contact.
Zaken die op dit moment onder de rechter zijn of bij het arbitragetribunaal aanhangig zijn, worden in onderling contact niet besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Wat te doen met ons kernafval?’

An SP MP asked the government, in 13 questions, about nuclear waste storage at COVRA, the Asse II salt mine and the timing of final disposal around 2130, and whether new nuclear plants are responsible. The State Secretary answered that the surface storage is safe, that stress tests and periodic safety reviews show no need for extra flood measures, that no foreign disposal sites are planned, and that the polluter-pays principle applies, without committing to new action.
The policy for radioactive waste was recently evaluated.
Het beleid voor radioactief afval is recent geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Azarkan en Omtzigt over recente nihilstellingen in de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Leijten, Azarkan and Omtzigt asked about recent nihilstellingen (zeroing-out of childcare allowance) for 2020/2021, including how the process, notification, reasons, objection and repayment are handled after the Ongekend Onrecht report. The State Secretary answered that about 4,500 2020 cases were zeroed out, described new procedural safeguards, admitted decisions do not yet state reasons in the formal beschikking, and promised improvements without firm dates.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over het verweer van de Staat in de artikel 12-procedure omtrent de vervolging van de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked why the State's written defence in the Article 12 complaint procedure about prosecution of the Tax Authority omitted the Tax Authority's repeated breaches of law, and about the handling of the Biemond advice, the notice of complaint, and the information shared with the Public Prosecution Service. The State secretaries answered that breaches occurred for varied reasons, that the Chamber will continue to be informed of new cases, and that the Ministry deliberately withheld documents from the Public Prosecution Service to protect its independence.
Not acting in accordance with the law can have various reasons, with different underlying causes.
Het niet handelen in overeenstemming met de wet kan diverse redenen hebben, met verschillende grondoorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Tata Steel betaalt alleen 'belasting' aan Tata Steel'

MP Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Tata Steel Netherlands paying no profit tax, subsidies for greening, reliability of its figures, tax constructions, and whether subsidies should be withheld. The Minister repeatedly declined to discuss the company's tax position citing confidentiality under Article 67 AWR, stated the accounts were audited and compliant, listed meetings with the company and subsidies received, and said subsidies consider the company's financial capacity.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake Rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Klanten van failliete energiebedrijven krijgen niet de beste deal bij nieuwe leverancier'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy why customers of bankrupt energy suppliers end up with expensive contracts, how supplier prices and margins are set and made transparent, and whether the regulator ACM should get powers to intervene earlier. The minister answered that suppliers set their own tariffs subject to a reasonableness test by ACM, that margins are confidential but ACM checks them, and that a study on strengthening consumer protection and supplier requirements is underway with results expected around summer.
At present I am having a study carried out into the possibility and desirability of improving the position of the consumer in the event of a bankruptcy.
Op dit moment laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid om de positie van de consument te verbeteren ingeval van een faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het bericht “Schandalen PostNL bij ons niet minder erg dan in België”

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked ministers whether the abuses at PostNL in Belgium are a scandal, whether Dutch oversight of parcel delivery fails, what will be done to end such practices, what they think of Belgian plans to require firms to employ many couriers directly, and why Dutch postal workers still generate scandals. The minister declined to address the ongoing Belgian case, described Arbeidsinspectie and ILT enforcement and a multi-year strategy with large clients, said generic measures are preferred but sector-specific ones may be warranted, and noted the 80% employment rule applies only to letter delivery, not parcels.
I cannot go into an ongoing legal procedure such as the case in the article in your question, which moreover took place in a neighbouring country.
Op een lopende juridische procedure zoals de casus in het artikel uit uw vraag, die zich bovendien in een buurland heeft voorgedaan, kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de weigering van bedrijven op basis van geautomatiseerde kredietchecks

Two SP MPs asked whether automated credit checks by companies, which collect and retain privacy-sensitive data, are desirable, what legal basis exists, whether human intervention is required under the GDPR, who must correct erroneous data, and where citizens can turn when wrongly excluded. The minister acknowledged the impact on citizens, explained the GDPR principles and data controller responsibilities, and referred supervision to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens while describing existing rectification rights and programmes.
However, it cannot be established in general terms on which legal basis(es) the processing in the context of offering credit checks is based.
Het is echter niet in algemene zin vast te stellen op welke grondslag(en) de verwerkingen in het kader van het aanbieden van kredietchecks zijn gebaseerd
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een oud-bewindspersoon die lobbyt bij het ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked why a former minister working for a lobbying firm was given access to the Ministry of Defence, whether this creates conflict of interest, and whether a network-scan and cross-government checks on part-time lobbyists will be carried out. The government answered that access is limited to needed areas, that the secretary-general restricted his dealings with Defence for a two-year cooling-off period, that a whole-of-government integrity code and an organisation-level scan pilot are in progress, and that case-by-case assessment rules out a blanket check.
It is not the case that someone who has been politically active may under no circumstances have access to a ministry. That must be assessed on an individual case basis.
Het is niet zo dat iemand die politiek actief is geweest in geen geval toegang zou mogen hebben tot een ministerie. Dat dient per individueel geval beoordeeld te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de datahonger van de overheid

The MP Leijten asked how many bodies can access a citizen's BRP personal data, whether access should be restricted, why ministries and police can query family data, and how the SILA's access can persist despite earlier commitments. The Secretary of State answered that access is strictly authorised per user and purpose, that some queries are necessary, that the SILA access will be ended via a forthcoming general administrative order with consent through MijnOverheid, and that uncontrolled logging of purposes is not planned.
It is not possible to estimate the number of users who can query data about an arbitrary citizen, because that would require analysing logging data on search-based disclosures for all citizens.

Het is niet mogelijk een schatting te geven van het aantal gebruikers dat gegevens kan opvragen over een willekeurige burger omdat daarvoor protocolleringsgegevens over verstrekkingen op basis van zoekvragen (ad 1) van (alle) burgers moeten worden geanalyseerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Kent en Alkaya over de compensatie voor de gestegen energie- en brandstofprijzen

SP MPs asked why the 120% of social minimum income test for the one-off energy allowance counts the single-parent supplement of the child-related budget as income while excluding the child budget itself, and questioned how income is defined and applied across municipalities. The minister explained that the child budget including the single-parent supplement is excluded from income under the Participatiewet, acknowledged that the concept of income is hard for citizens to grasp, and said municipalities have discretion in specialist assistance while the wage increase was not feasible in time.
For social assistance benefits, a supplement under the child-related budget is a benefit within the meaning of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes.
Voor bijstandsuitkeringen geldt dat een toeslag in het kader van het kindgebonden budget een tegemoetkoming is in de zin van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de aanwezigheid van Gazprom in Nederland

MPs from the SP asked the government about Gazprom's presence in the Netherlands, including its asset holdings via shell companies, Dutch investment ties with Russia, tax avoidance, tax rulings for state-owned firms, and frozen Russian assets. The State Secretary answered that sanctions freezes apply, the cabinet opposes facilitating Russian-linked shells and is banning certain trust services, tax secrecy limits detailed answers on individual taxpayers, and a rulings termination clause exists for sanctioned entities.
Under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Ergernis mkb over aandeel klimaatkosten'

Leijten (SP) asks why SMEs bear about 80% of climate subsidy costs while large industry contributes little, and whether households are disproportionately burdened. Minister Jetten replies that the 2020 cost split was shifted to 33% households and 67% businesses with large energy users paying more, that the polluter-pays principle is endorsed, and that existing exemptions will be phased out.
I am of the view that with the measures the cabinet is taking a good balance is achieved in the burdens falling on small and larger enterprises.
Ik ben van mening dat met de maatregelen die het kabinet treft een goed evenwicht wordt gerealiseerd in de lasten die optreden bij kleine en grotere ondernemingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima als test voor de monarchie’ uit het Algemeen Dagblad van 31 januari 2022 en de documentaire ‘Een Porseleinen Huwelijk van BNNVARA

MPs Sneller and Leijten asked the Prime Minister and ministers about press and documentary reports on the 2001 decision not to prosecute Jorge Zorreguieta, the role of the Prosecution Service, and an intelligence check on him and Edwin de Roy van Zuydewijn without ministers being informed. The government answered in detail on the chain of communication, the BVD check, and safeguards, denying political influence over the prosecution decision and describing the current naslag arrangements.
No indication of political influence on the content of this decision has been found.
Van politieke beïnvloeding van de inhoud van deze beslissing is niet gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol en kosten van samenwerkingsverbanden

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister about the costs, opacity and democratic control of intermunicipal cooperation bodies (gemeenschappelijke regelingen) and their effect on municipal mergers. The minister answers that no national cost figures exist, that municipalities spend about 20% of budgets via such bodies, that democratic control is partly addressed by a pending Wgr amendment and better governance, and that gemeenschappelijke regelingen are extended local government rather than a shadow state.

However, as I argued above, this can to a large extent be mitigated by professional governance of and within cooperation bodies, which also invests in the relationship between participating executives and councils.

Dit kan echter, zoals ik hierboven ook heb betoogd, voor een groot deel worden ondervangen door een professionele sturing (governance) op en binnen samenwerkingsverbanden waarbij ook wordt geïnvesteerd in de relatie tussen deelnemende colleges en raden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over “de ongekende invloed van Blackrock op de Europese klimaatplannen”

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about lobbying influence by BlackRock and financial-sector groups on EU sustainable finance and taxonomy rules, including BlackRock's role as a Commission adviser. The minister answered that lobbying must follow transparency rules, that the Ombudsman found no maladministration but urged stricter conflict-of-interest checks which the Commission has accepted, and that the government has no further information on BlackRock's budget or meetings.
The European Ombudsman concluded there was no maladministration because the European Commission had complied with the procurement rules.
7 De Ombudsman concludeerde dat er geen sprake was van wanbestuur omdat de Europese Commissie aan de aanbestedingsregels had voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het gebruik van algoritmes door decentrale overheden

An MP asks the Minister of Interior how algorithms used by local authorities must comply with rules, whether the Rotterdam welfare-fraud algorithm complies, whether similar tools are used elsewhere, who supplies them, how proportionality is tested, and about filming of benefit interviews, notification of fraud investigations, and discrimination criteria. The minister answers that the government is bound by the GDPR and equality law, that assessing Rotterdam's compliance is for the municipality, the DPA and courts, that an algorithm register and a mandatory register are being explored, and that filming is acceptable only in exceptional cases.
It is not for me to judge that.
Het is echter niet aan mij om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een voor de belastingdienst beschamende uitspraak bij het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over o.a. zwarte lijsten

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling criticising the Tax Authority over blacklist (FSV) registration, dossier access, appeal conduct and trust in the tax service. The State Secretary answered most questions on substance, but declined to discuss individual cases citing tax secrecy, and committed to further investigations, an external review of CAF, and a compensation regime.
Based on the tax secrecy obligation in Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot address the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht uit artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Energy Charter Treaty: stalled reform fuels EU fears for climate”

An MP asks whether the stalled modernisation of the Energy Charter Treaty shows that the Netherlands should withdraw, why it is not in the anti-ECT alliance, and how fossil investment protection and pending ISDS cases against the Netherlands fit with climate goals. Minister Jetten answers that the Netherlands pursues modernisation via the Commission mandate, keeps withdrawal as a possible option if talks fail, and will submit any amendment to parliament for approval.
In accordance with the Constitution and the Approval and Publication of Treaties Act, a proposed amendment to the ECT will be submitted to the States General for approval.
Conform de Grondwet en de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen zal een voorgestelde verdragswijziging van het ECT aan de Staten-Generaal worden voorgelegd voor goedkeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de afwijzing van inzageverzoek in FSV

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rejection of a data access request concerning registration in the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including why citizens are denied the specific grounds for refusal. The government answered that exceptions such as investigation interests and tips apply, that numbers of requests and timeliness are reported, that the grounds for refusal are assessed case by case without disclosing details, and that a compensation scheme is being developed for early 2022.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanvankelijke goedkeuring voor het aanblijven van de demissionair minister Infrastructuur en Waterstaat terwijl zij een lobbyfunctie voor de energiesector had aanvaard

The SP's Leijten asked Prime Minister Rutte how he reached the political assessment that minister Van Nieuwenhuizen could not stay on after accepting a lobbying job in the energy sector, who was consulted, whether memos exist, and how integrity rules and future cases will be handled. Rutte answered that he judged after political weighing on 26 August 2021 that the appointment did not fit the ministerial office, that no memos were written, that no integrity issue existed, and that new post-ministerial integrity measures are being prepared in legislation.
On 26 August 2021, after further political weighing, I came to the view that the appointment does not fit well with the office of minister.
Op 26 augustus 2021 ben ik na nadere politieke weging tot het inzicht gekomen dat de benoeming niet goed samen gaat met het ambt van bewindspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Het Rijk regelde onder druk van Facebook voorrang op het stroomnet'

MP Leijten (SP) asked ministers whether the government arranged priority grid access for Facebook/Meta's Zeewolde data centre, questioned the secrecy and possible blackmail by the company, and asked for timelines of contacts and a pause on the decision. The minister denies any priority was granted, says the connection follows the legal framework, and gives a detailed contact timeline while declining to disclose tax rulings and refusing to pause the spatial process.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of individual taxpayers due to the statutory tax confidentiality obligation (Article 67 AWR).
Het kabinet kan geen mededelingen doen over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 67 AWR).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het Onderzoeksrapport inzake het faillissement van Flexenergie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the investigation report into the bankruptcy of energy supplier Flexenergie, including why the ACM did not intervene earlier, whether the supplier misused customer prepayments and tax money, whether revoking its licence would have been better, and what has changed in licensing and consumer protection. The minister defended the independent ACM, said it intervened in 2017 after completing its investigation, described the prepayment system, and pointed to planned Energiewet tightening of licence requirements and a study on consumer protection in supplier bankruptcies.
The ACM completed its investigation at the end of 2017 and decided to intervene at Flexenergie.
De ACM heeft haar onderzoek eind 2017 afgerond en besloten om in te grijpen bij Flexenergie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het controleren en koppelen van data van onschuldige mensen

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why no privacy impact assessment was carried out for police project Athene, which automatically linked data from asylum seekers' phones to criminal information, and whether similar projects exist and how the Council of State's advice on phone reading would be followed. The Minister answers that the police overlooked the need for a privacy test after the GDPR transition, the test was done in November 2021 and the project ended, no data was shared, and the government will clarify the legal basis for reading digital data carriers and has amended rules to meet the Council of State's advice.
As a result, the assessment only took place in November 2021, after which the project was ended.
Hierdoor heeft de toets pas plaatsgevonden in november 2021, waarna het project is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over digitale veiligheid

MP Leijten (SP) asked the government about the European and Dutch digital identity schemes, data storage and blockchain use, lobbying, ethics, cyber vulnerabilities and dependence on single providers. The state secretary answered at length, defending the planned EU framework and Dutch rules against data commercialisation, but gave largely general replies and deferred some matters to other bodies or future policy.
I agree with the experts that citizens' personal data are not a tradeable commodity and that providers' business models may not be based on it.
Ik ben het met de experts eens dat persoonsgegevens van burgers geen handelswaar zijn en dat verdienmodellen van aanbieders daarop ook niet gebaseerd mogen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat raadsleden gemeenschappelijke regelingen een bedreiging vinden voor de lokale democratie

An SP MP asks whether council members' concerns that joint arrangements (gemeenschappelijke regelingen) threaten local democracy are justified, and raises questions on council knowledge of arrangements, mergers, citizen control over municipal tasks, the growth of joint arrangements and the future of local government. The minister points to a Wgr amendment giving councils a stronger position, promised support products and motions, notes that joint arrangements are a form of extended local government, and declines to predict the structure of local government in 20 years, pending proposals due in 2022.
With the forthcoming amendment of the Wgr, the position of municipal councils in this assessment is strengthened through the new obligation to ask councils for an opinion on the proposed arrangement.

Met de aanstaande wijziging van de Wgr wordt de positie van gemeenteraden bij deze afweging versterkt door de nieuwe verplichting om gemeenteraden om een zienswijze te vragen over de voorgenomen regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Weer meer CO2-uitstoot veroorzaakt door biomassa'

An SP MP asks whether the 16 percent rise in CO2 emissions from biomass in 2020 is acceptable, how much subsidy biomass received, how this fits the Van Esch motion banning new biomass subsidies, and how the Van Raan/Leijten motion on measuring biomass co-firing emissions is being implemented. The minister answers that low-grade wood subsidies were closed to new applications in 2021 but existing grants continue, that about 814 million euro was paid for biomass projects in 2021, and that CBS and PBL will be asked to report and project these emissions annually.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Peter de Groot en Leijten over de invloed van de windlobby op de rapporten van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) over de gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

MPs Erkens, Peter de Groot and Leijten asked whether RIVM omitted the wind-lobby influence on its reports on health effects of wind turbines, and how independent future research can be ensured. The minister said the RIVM's authority is not in question, that funding source alone should not exclude studies, and that RIVM is exploring additional health research and a study on setback distances.
I do not think it is for me or the cabinet to respond to this discussion, which belongs in the scientific domain.
Ik vind het niet aan mij of het kabinet om te reageren op deze discussie, die in het wetenschappelijk domein thuishoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de compensatie van toeslagenschandaal soms verkeerd terecht komt

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why compensation for the childcare benefits scandal sometimes reaches people not entitled to it, how long internal warnings were known, and why the reimbursement rules and the Catshuis scheme were adopted without a statutory basis. The State Secretary answered that a deliberate trade-off between generosity, speed and legality means some undeserved payments are unavoidable, that internal signals are taken seriously but the list of internal reports will not be shared to protect staff, and that the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen is delayed after a critical Council of State advice.
They are part of the regular assessment process.
Zij lopen mee in het reguliere beoordelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over “de verplichting door gemeenten tot een alimentatieverzoek als al vaststaat dat dit geen kans van slagen heeft”

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that municipalities can require welfare recipients to file hopeless alimony claims, as criticized by a court, and asked about scope, costs, cost recovery and ending such practices. The State Secretary acknowledged the court's criticism, said such obligations must be used carefully and not where a claim has no chance, declined a broad inventory as unfeasible, and committed to alerting municipalities in Gemeentenieuws.
I consider a broad inventory as you propose too far-reaching in that light, and I also consider such an inventory unfeasible.
Ik vind een brede inventarisatie zoals u voorstelt in dat licht te vergaand en ik acht een dergelijke inventarisatie ook onuitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over dat een Amerikaanse spion Booking.com heeft gehackt en dit niet is gemeld

Leijten (SP) asked whether Booking.com customers should have been notified of a reported 2016 hack by a US spy, why the AIVD did not inform the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, how often US actors hacked Dutch firms, whether the AIVD is equipped to counter such espionage, and whether Booking.com faces stricter supervision. Minister Ollongren answered that the old Wbp breach-notification rules applied, that she cannot judge the case which falls to the regulator, that she cannot discuss AIVD conduct or current knowledge in public, that the AIVD investigates suspected state hacks of Dutch firms, and that the AP has no current steps to announce.
I cannot publicly address specific questions about the conduct of the AIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete vragen over het handelen van de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Zeer nauwe verbintenis Roland Berger en Tata

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports of close ties between consultancy Roland Berger and Tata Steel, questioning the independence of a study on green steel production. The minister answered that the past Tata/Roland Berger alliance concerned Indian advisory work, ended around 2012, was not linked to Tata Steel Netherlands, and that the scenarios studied have been published.
Both FNV and the group Zeester (former Tata Steel directors) have designated Roland Berger as a competent organisation to investigate the sustainability options for Tata Steel.
Zowel FNV, alsook de groep Zeester (oud-directeuren van Tata Steel) hebben Roland Berger aangewezen als een competente organisatie om de verduurzamingsmogelijkheden voor Tata Steel te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over faillissementen van energiebedrijven

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked about the bankruptcy of energy supplier Welkom Energie, its consumers' losses and whether consumers can be protected or compensated. The State Secretary answered that consumers are unsecured creditors, that compensation is impractical so general tax cuts were chosen, and that stricter supplier requirements and further research on protecting consumers are planned.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of data, the ACM cannot provide information on whether more energy suppliers are in acute financial trouble.
De ACM kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van gegevens geen informatie verstrekken of er meer energieleveranciers in acute financiële problemen verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over een gemeente die gesprekken over uitkeringen filmt

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether filming benefit conversations in the municipality of Dronten is acceptable, whether it undermines trust, and how the municipality complies with privacy law. The minister answered that filming privacy-sensitive talks needs a legal basis and must be necessary and proportionate, that the municipality has halted filming pending a review, and that the Dutch data protection authority and courts will judge its admissibility.
At present filming has been completely halted and the municipality is carrying out a review examining which means can be used and the advantages and disadvantages of each.
Op dit moment is het filmen geheel stil gelegd en voert de gemeente een onderzoek uit waarin gekeken wordt welke middelen kunnen worden ingezet en wat per middel de voor- en nadelen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over illegale casino’s op Curaçao

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the scale of illegal online gambling from Curaçao, the Dutch Gambling Authority's (Ksa) ability to collect fines, and the status of a motion on the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The government answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and enforcement, that it is working with the Netherlands on reform under the Curaçao package, that Ksa fines against Curaçao-based firms are hard to collect, and that the motion is considered fulfilled.
Imposing an order subject to a penalty or a fine is, however, only one of the means that can be used to stop illegal providers.
Het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom of boete is echter maar één van de middelen die kunnen worden ingezet om illegale aanbieders te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Sprong in het duister met waterstofmiljarden'

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Gasunie's warnings, Court of Audit criticism of state-backed consortia, public funding for hydrogen projects, and contacts with the NortH2 consortium of Shell, Equinor and RWE. The government says public funds are earmarked and disclosed via budget documents, that no commitments were made to NortH2, that Gasunie will be asked to limit itself to knowledge sharing, and that further market-model choices will be communicated to parliament.
I therefore always inform your House in a timely manner about concrete policy intentions, especially where this leads to the spending of public funds.
Ik informeer uw Kamer daarom altijd tijdig over concrete beleidsvoornemens, zeker waar dit leidt tot de besteding van publieke middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het gebruik van gezichtsherkenning bij toegang tot evenementen

An MP from the SP asked the government about the use of facial recognition for event access, including the risks to privacy, whether consent is truly voluntary when alternatives are slower, and oversight capacity. The minister replied that no overview of events using facial recognition exists, that the AVG strictly limits such use and requires genuinely free consent, and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and data protection officers oversee compliance.
Such an overview does not exist.
Een dergelijk overzicht is er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ‘foute investeringen die de klimaatramp verergeren’

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretaries about an IMF finding of 5.9 trillion dollars in fossil fuel subsidies in 2020, the rise in public investment in fossil fuels since the Paris Agreement, G7 phase-out plans, and the role of hedge funds buying fossil shares divested by institutional investors. The government acknowledged the IMF figure is mainly unpriced external costs, stressed carbon pricing and international coordination, and rejected a private investment ban on oil and gas and a 'Klimaatbank' as not opportune.
I do not have cumulative data on what share of this has been invested in oil and gas.
Ik beschik niet over cumulatieve data over welk aandeel hiervan is geïnvesteerd in olie en gas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Leijten over de uitvoering van de motie Erkens/Leijten (Kamerstuk 32813-731)

MPs Leijten and Erkens asked the State Secretary for Energy and Climate about the status of research into the effects of distance standards for onshore wind turbines, who is involved, whether court cases and independence of studies are considered, and whether wind-on-land is needed to reach the 35 TWh target given rooftop solar potential. The government answered that research by Arcadis is underway with results expected February 2022, that stakeholders will be involved, that studies on a 45 dB noise norm show reduced potential, and that the 35 TWh target is not assured.
The research has recently been commissioned from the external research bureau Arcadis.
Het onderzoek is recent in opdracht gegeven bij het externe onderzoeksbureau Arcadis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de compensatie van gedupeerden in het Toeslagenschandaal

An SP MP asked whether the secretaries-general of two ministries prepared a memo on the compensation of victims of the childcare benefits scandal, its status, and whether it could be sent to parliament. The government answered that no such memo could be found, but that related emails on interdepartmental capacity for the restoration agency were located, and it offered to search further if the MP specifies the expected content.
Based on the information in your questions, we have not been able to find such a memo.
Op basis van de informatie in uw vragen hebben wij een dergelijke notitie niet kunnen vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese drones die gebruikt worden door de politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether police use Chinese DJI drones, why they were chosen, whether data could reach Chinese servers, and whether a Rijksbreed policy on foreign technology is needed. The minister confirmed police use DJI drones, said procurement law gave no basis to exclude them, acknowledged the data-leak reports could not be verified, and declined to commission further investigation or a government-wide overview of such technology use.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf in het tijdelijke Kamergebouw

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about agreements with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf on responsibility for major building changes, space requirements, cost allocation and sustainability in the temporary parliament building. The State Secretary answered that the Tweede Kamer's programme of requirements and the Technisch Ontwerp 100% govern the work, that changes go through the regular client-request and budget process, and that costs are charged to users via a usage fee.

This programme of requirements was translated into the 'Technisch Ontwerp 100%' (with detailed designs of all rooms in the building), which was adopted by the presidium of the House of Representatives as representative of this user.

Dit programma van eisen is vertaald naar het «Technisch Ontwerp 100%» (met de detailontwerpen van alle ruimten van het gebouw) dat is vastgesteld door het presidium van de Tweede Kamer als vertegenwoordiger van deze gebruiker.
