Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis OZG door deal met PowerField in de armen van commercie geduwd en het unieke Oldambtster landschap wordt vermarkt: 'Onoorbaar en amoreel''

Two SP MPs asked whether a deal in which a solar park developer offers EUR 20 million to a Groningen hospital, conditional on a solar park being built, amounts to commercialising care and the landscape. The government answered that spatial development is bound by existing law and policy, that the hospital is not dependent on the donation, that no care funds are involved, and that local authorities make the public interest assessment.
Moreover, I point out that there is no legal obligation to return proceeds to the surrounding area.
Overigens wijs ik erop dat er geen sprake is van een wettelijke verplichting om opbrengsten terug te laten stromen naar de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Leijten over de investering in groen staal door ArcelorMittal en de overheden in België

MPs Bontenbal and Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about ArcelorMittal's green steel investment in Ghent with Flemish government support, and how it compares with Tata Steel IJmuiden's decarbonisation plans, including state participation, state aid rules, SSAB's withdrawn takeover interest. The minister answered that the plans are broadly similar, that the Dutch state is only examining possible support for Tata Steel without any financial commitment yet, and that a progress letter will follow before year end.
You will be informed about the state of affairs by letter to the House before the end of the year.
Over de stand van zaken wordt u voor het einde van het jaar middels een kamerbrief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over een burgemeester die een boek schreef over kritische burgerjournalisten

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked ministers about a mayor who wrote a book criticising critical citizen journalists, and about local government support for independent local journalism. The government answered that local journalism is essential, that no protocol exists for mayors, that municipalities are encouraged to develop media policy, and that the data available does not show local media budget cuts or communication spending.
No, there is no such protocol.
Nee, er is geen dergelijk protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de woede over de bouw van een kantoorpand in de tuin van het Catshuis

Rep. Leijten (SP) asked why a new office building is being built in the Catshuis garden for temporary housing of the Ministry of General Affairs, why vacant buildings are not used, and whether the project is proportionate. The State Secretary answered that the Binnenhof renovation requires temporary housing, that other locations were explored with the Catshuis site preferred on security and cost grounds, and that the proportionality weighing (including a city council motion against it) is still ongoing and will be reported in December 2021.
This weighing is still ongoing. In the next progress report of December 2021 I will of course return to this.
Deze weging is nog steeds gaande. In de volgende voortgangsrapportage van december 2021 zal ik hier uiteraard op terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de gang van zaken met de nieuwe functies van de voormalig bewindspersonen Van Veldhoven en Van Nieuwenhuizen

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why the departure of former state secretary Van Veldhoven and minister Van Nieuwenhuizen was delayed after their new jobs became known, and why integrity and lobbying rules were not applied earlier. The government answered that the timing followed the dismissal process, that the handbook is not binding, that Van Nieuwenhuizen's ministerial role was adjusted and her appointment was reconsidered before she left, and that the minister is responsible for some answers.
As I also said in the debate of 8 September 2021, I would prefer ministers to stay on until a new cabinet takes office, but it remains a personal consideration.
Zoals ik ook in het debat van 8 september 2021 heb gezegd, zie ik liever dat bewindspersonen aanblijven tot het aantreden van een nieuw kabinet, maar het blijft een persoonlijke afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van ambtenaren voor een privékwestie

MP Leijten asked whether a state secretary used civil servants for advice on a private matter, whether top officials may use ministry staff for private affairs, who handles integrity enforcement, and whether the ministry should have declined. The minister answered that private matters can affect a office-holder's functioning, that the ministry supports ministers in their ministerial role, that the landsadvocaat advice cost 4,173.68 euro paid by the ministry, that integrity rules for ministers will be codified in the Blauwe Boek, and that the internal handling is described in an earlier answer.
The ministry also has the task of advising the ministers on when a matter in the private sphere affects their functioning as minister.
Het ministerie heeft mede als taak om de bewindspersonen te adviseren over de vraag wanneer een aangelegenheid in de privésfeer van invloed is op het functioneren als bewindspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voortgang van het onderzoek naar het verdwenen memo van de vaktechnisch coördinator uit 2017 (memo-Palmen)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the progress of the inquiry into the vanished 2017 memo (memo-Palmen), including when the ministry learned of the messages, why they were shared only after media attention, and whether the memo was withheld from the parliamentary inquiry. The State Secretary answered that the PwC report shows no deliberate concealment, that the memo was not passed to the inquiry because it did not reach the required seniority level, and that the PwC report and related documents were sent to parliament together with the answers.
The memo was not provided to the POK earlier because it did not meet the criteria set for that purpose.
Het memo is niet eerder aan de POK verstrekt omdat het niet voldeed aan de daarvoor gestelde criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van ministeries tijdens politieke campagnes van bewindspersonen

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked whether ministers acting as party leaders should be separated from their ministerial role, what rules govern ministry staff support for party-political activity during campaigns, and whether ministry social media and communication resources are used for campaigning. The Minister of Interior Affairs answered that ministerial and party roles are separate but partly overlap, that staff support is allowed only for government-policy content, and that existing guidelines (Donner letter 2011, Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk) apply equally during elections.

This means that the deployment of civil servants is permitted without reservation when a contribution promotes the unity of cabinet policy and insofar as a minister addresses policy-substantive topics falling within the ministry's remit.

Dat betekent dat de inzet van ambtenaren zonder meer is toegestaan wanneer een bijdrage de eenheid van het kabinetsbeleid bevordert en voor zover een bewindspersoon ingaat op beleidsinhoudelijke onderwerpen die vallen binnen het terrein van het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de benoeming van de secretaris-generaal bij het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

An MP asked why the caretaker cabinet appointed a senior official involved in the childcare benefits scandal as secretary-general of the Ministry of VWS, and whether other candidates were considered. The minister answered that an open procedure was followed, that involvement in the scandal is no bar to other posts, that individual conduct is not discussed publicly, and that the cabinet bears political responsibility and has resigned.
Individual conduct of civil servants is not discussed in public.
Over het individuele handelen van ambtenaren wordt niet in het openbaar gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een datalek bij de Kamer van Koophandel

MP Leijten asked the minister how a former lawyer could still access personal data of foundation directors at the Chamber of Commerce, why this lasted months, and whether affected persons could be named, and called for better protection of personal data. The state secretary answered that the former lawyer was reported and that the KVK is tightening authorisation checks and consulting on a data vision, but declined to name the lawyer or the foundations or the number of MPs affected, citing privacy and security.
No, it is not possible to disclose the name of the former lawyer, for reasons of privacy and the safety of the former lawyer himself.
Nee, het is niet mogelijk om de naam van de voormalige advocaat bekend te maken. Dit vanwege privacy en de veiligheid van voormalige advocaat zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Minister een lobbyfunctie heeft aanvaard

Rep. Leijten (SP) asked whether a minister taking a lobbying post, and two ministers leaving the Infrastructure ministry early for other jobs, breach the Handbook for ministers, and whether the generous transition allowance and workload should be changed. The government answered that the lobby ban is not breached, that taking such posts is the minister's own decision within legal limits, that the allowance is not meant to deter early departure and will not be trimmed, and that the Defence secretary's appointment was agreed with the Defence minister.
Accepting a position is not in conflict with the Handbook for ministers.
Het aanvaarden van een functie is niet in het strijd met het handboek voor bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

SP MP Leijten asked ministers about reports that a GGD director had removed Tata Steel's name from a lung cancer report in Beverwijk, and whether trust in authorities has been damaged. The government answered that an independent investigation found the director acted with integrity, cited the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a ministerial working group on Tata Steel, and pointed to Tata Steel's own Roadmap Plus, while committing to a nulmeting and possible further measures.
The investigation report, carried out by researcher and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'PBL: kosten van broeikasuitstoot niet eerlijk verdeeld, huishoudens betalen te veel'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about a PBL report finding that the cost of greenhouse gas emissions is unfairly distributed, with heavy industry contributing too little to the renewable energy levy (ODE) and households and SMEs bearing too much. The government disputes the framing, noting the report uses 2018 data that excludes the Climate Agreement burden shifts, and says it will share its position on the EU energy tax directive proposal with parliament in September.
The cabinet aims to design fiscal incentives so that they support the energy and climate transition while preserving international competitiveness.
Het kabinet zet erop in om de fiscale prikkels op die manier in te richten dat zij de energie- en klimaattransitie ondersteunen, met behoud van de internationale concurrentiepositie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de handelswijze van de provincie Gelderland bij de herindeling Barneveld-Scherpenzeel

MP Leijten asks the Minister of Interior whether a merger of Barneveld and Scherpenzeel can be pushed through despite an 82% referendum majority against, whether the province approached MPs, and whether an integrity investigation is warranted. The Minister answers that a merger without broad support is permissible in exceptional cases under the Wet arhi, that the province initiated it, that the impending advice will be assessed on its merits, and that no formal integrity investigation request was received, so none is needed.
That a large majority of residents oppose the proposed solution of a merger is an important factor and must be taken into account in weighing the desirability of the merger.

Dat een ruime meerderheid van de inwoners tegen de voorgestelde oplossing van een herindeling is, is een belangrijk gegeven en dient als zodanig in de afweging over de wenselijkheid van de herindeling betrokken te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over 'RIVM houdt rapport over gezondheid rond Tata Steel nog lang onder de pet.'

MP Leijten asked why the RIVM health report on Tata Steel is not yet public, whether the timing was deliberate, whether it can be shared before the 9 September debate, and which ministries received drafts. The government replied that the provincial and IJmond municipal clients, together with RIVM, decided to publish mid-September, that the minister is not the client and cannot commit to sharing it earlier, and that only the GGD Kennemerland received a draft.
I am not the client. The province of Noord-Holland and the IJmond municipalities are the clients.
Ik ben geen opdrachtgever. De provincie Noord-Holland en de IJmondgemeenten zijn opdrachtgever.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de benoeming van nieuwe bewindslieden

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister about the caretaker cabinet's appointment of new ministers and state secretaries, including whether caretaker status is applied consistently, dual roles of MPs who are also ministers, the timing of announcement and swearing-in, and the severance entitlements of such appointees. The Prime Minister answered that caretaker restraint is applied consistently, that the Constitution's exception allows MPs to serve as ministers during caretaker periods, that MPs-ministers follow agreed limits on parliamentary activity, and that severance rules apply, with some appointees offering to waive their MP allowance.
The Constitution (Article 57, second paragraph) provides, among other things, that a member of the States General cannot also be a Minister or State Secretary.
In de Grondwet (artikel 57, tweede lid) staat onder meer dat een lid van de Staten-Generaal niet tevens Minister of Staatssecretaris kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de problemen rondom Paleis Soestdijk

An MP asked why the buyer of Paleis Soestdijk changed its plans substantially after purchase, whether the sale can be reversed, and whether public money should cover a budget gap, and asked how the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf views the sale process. The State Secretary answered that post-sale changes were approved as optimisations within the buyer's concept, the buyer bears the financial risk and the sale cannot be reversed, and the sale followed a careful, formally prescribed procedure.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf approved the proposed changes because it judged them to be elaborations/optimisations that fit within the proposed concept.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf heeft de voorgestelde wijzigingen goedgekeurd omdat het van oordeel was dat het ging om uitwerkingen/optimalisaties die binnen het voorgestelde concept pasten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de zeggenschap over veiligheidsregio’s

Two SP MPs asked how much say municipalities still have over safety regions, what happens if municipalities refuse higher contributions or cannot pay, whether funding is adequate, and about conditions and plans for merging safety regions. The minister replied that municipal mayors and councils retain governance and budget influence, that contributions are binding once adopted, that funding comes via the general municipal fund with some tension over priorities, and that no concrete merger request exists while the ministry will weigh boundary criteria and regional support if one arises.
My current policy is not to take any steps to push safety regions towards merging, but to consider any proposals from safety region boards to merge.
Mijn huidige beleid is geen activiteiten te ontplooien om veiligheidsregio’s tot fusie te bewegen, maar eventuele voorstellen van besturen van veiligheidsregio’s om te fuseren in overweging te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ceo die altijd een Minister kan bellen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior why large companies have so much contact with ministries and whether lobbying access is fair, and whether ministers should publish the number and type of meetings, citing an OECD report on lobby transparency. The Minister replied that what matters is a fair and equal access process, that ministers weigh interests themselves, that the government sees no sign Dutch lobbying is less transparent than elsewhere, and that it sees no need to publish meeting lists, though the OECD report will inform integrity policy.
The cabinet has no indications that lobbying in the Netherlands is conducted less transparently than in other countries.
Het kabinet heeft geen indicaties dat lobbyen in Nederland op minder transparante wijze verloopt dan in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Shell handelt volgens accountant niet in overeenstemming met eigen klimaatdoel'

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that Shell's climate plans are not aligned with its own 2050 net-zero goal, including its reliance on carbon intensity, vague planning, tree planting, greenwashing and subsidies for fossil fuels. The State Secretary replies that Shell must meet its own targets, that Dutch and EU carbon pricing and ETS rules apply to its emissions, and that it is not for the cabinet to set a company's global strategy.
It is not for the cabinet to determine a company's global strategy.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om de wereldwijde strategie van een bedrijf te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over falend schuldenbeleid van de Belastingdienst

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Administration offset benefit debts without applying the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and how it will fix this and inform debtors. The State Secretary admits the practice was wrong, promises talks with the Ombudsman and LOSR, outlines plans to improve information and access to payment arrangements, and refers to an attached letter for details.
Given the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Protected Minimum Act, I now conclude together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de fraudezaak bij het kantoor van Pels Rijcken

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the Pels Rijcken fraud case, covering court supervision of mass-claim settlements, notary and BFT oversight, the state's continued use of Pels Rijcken as landsadvocaat, and disclosure of ongoing investigations. The ministers answered that existing safeguards are sound in principle, that several investigations are ongoing so they cannot yet say whether the checks failed, and that Parliament will be informed when results are available, with an external advisory report due in September.
To get a complete picture of what went wrong in this case, we first want to await the outcomes of the various ongoing investigations.
Om een volledig beeld te krijgen van wat is misgegaan in de onderhavige casus, willen wij eerst de uitkomsten van de diverse lopende onderzoeken afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een geheime vertrekdeal van een VVD-wethouder de samenleving een kwart miljoen kan kosten

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a secret departure deal for a VVD alderman that could cost the public a quarter million euros, about the entitlement to post-service benefits, and about the state of municipal dualisation. The minister answered that the alderman's pension entitlement under the Appa is automatic and independent of the reason for leaving, declined to change the law based on one case, and described past steps to strengthen the council's position.
I therefore see no reason, based on this single case, to amend the law on this essential point.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op basis van dit ene geval de wet op dit wezenlijke punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een melding van een poging tot Russische beïnvloeding van het Nederlandse parlement in een la verdween

An MP asked whether a report of an attempted Russian influence on parliament went missing and how the parliamentary security office cooperates with the AIVD, plus questions on foreign political financing. The minister explained the standard reporting channel, said no comment on individual reports, and pointed to the pending Wfpp amendment banning donations from third countries and making EU/EEA donations fully transparent.
As a rule, no public statements are made about individual reports to the AIVD.
In de openbaarheid worden in de regel geen uitspraken gedaan over individuele meldingen aan de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Alphen aan den Rijn mag in enquête kiezen tussen windmolens en windmolens’

MP Leijten asked whether municipal surveys on wind turbines using leading questions and selective targeting, as in Alphen aan den Rijn, undermine representative public support and trust, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said participation is the regions' responsibility, that manipulation would be unacceptable, that the reported survey contains factual errors, and that PBL will be asked to analyse participation in the RES plans, with no separate investigation planned.
If the results of such a survey were manipulated, I would disapprove of that.
Als de resultaten van een dergelijk onderzoek gemanipuleerd zouden worden, keur ik dat af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het buitensluiten van mensen door de digitale wereld.

An MP asked the minister whether people who are not digitally skilled can participate in society, how many lack digital skills and internet access, how the motion requiring low-threshold human contact with government is being implemented, and whether banks, insurers and housing corporations will be engaged on offline contact. The state secretary answers that digital inclusion programmes, information points and a statutory duty of appropriate assistance in a pending bill are under way, cites figures on digital skills and home internet, and says private sectors bear responsibility for their own services and the DigiHulplijn is being promoted.
Therefore the bill provides for a general duty of care for the government to offer appropriate support in communication with the government.
Daarom voorziet het wetsvoorstel in een algemene zorgplicht voor de overheid om passende ondersteuning te bieden bij communicatie met de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten niet willen stoppen met oneigenlijk informatie verzamelen over hun inwoners

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether municipalities that continue collecting personal information about residents improperly, despite privacy law, will be sanctioned and how quickly this will stop. The minister replied that municipalities are responsible for complying with privacy rules themselves, that she will raise it with the VNG and municipalities, and that she has had administrative contact with the VNG with a further letter to Parliament before the summer recess.
Where compliance and internal supervision fall short, I will raise this in my discussions with the VNG and municipalities.
Wanneer naleving en intern toezicht tekort schieten, zal ik hier in mijn gesprekken met de VNG en gemeenten aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten mensen online in de gaten houden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether citizens monitored online by municipalities are informed and can object, and whether the central government sets a bad example in monitoring and profiling residents. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for GDPR compliance, that people can object to processing, that a Rijksbrede monitoring guideline is being developed, and that she will raise the issue with the VNG.
People can object to forms of processing at the relevant municipality or ask for rectification or modification.
Mensen kunnen bij de desbetreffende gemeente tegen vormen van verwerking bezwaar maken of vragen om rectificatie of wijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol van het Portugees EU Voorzitterschap tijdens de onderhandelingen over de aanpassing van de TEN-E verordening

MP Leijten asks how the Dutch government views a group of EU member states, and the Portuguese presidency, pushing to keep funding for gas infrastructure in the revised TEN-E regulation, and what steps the Netherlands took to counter this. The government answers that it opposes EU funding for fossil fuel infrastructure but supports adapting gas infrastructure for hydrogen, that it voted for a compromise with stricter hydrogen blending conditions, and that member states are free to set their own positions while the national stance rests on the Klimaatakkoord.
The cabinet is of the view that fossil fuel infrastructure should no longer receive subsidies from EU funds
Het kabinet is van mening dat infrastructuur voor fossiele brandstoffen geen subsidie meer mag ontvangen uit EU-fondsen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de nieuwe Oekaze Kok en de soepeler omgang met het contact tussen ambtenaren en Kamerleden

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked why the revised guidelines on external contacts of civil servants with MPs still cause uncertainty and fear among officials, and whether the rules are in fact looser than the former Oekaze Kok. The minister answers that the rules are meant to be more permissive, outlines awareness training and a planned debate, and defends the remaining limits on civil servants' contact with Parliament as flowing from ministerial responsibility.
The cabinet wishes to stress that the rules have certainly not become stricter, but that the revision has in fact created more room for contacts between civil servants and MPs.
Het kabinet wil vooropstellen dat de regels zeker niet strenger zijn geworden, maar dat er met de herziening juist méér ruimte is gekomen voor contacten tussen rijksambtenaren en Kamerleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Ondernemer moet weer langer wachten op coronasteun; “Ik ben met stomheid geslagen”

An MP asks why the TVL fixed-cost subsidy for Q2 2021 was delayed despite earlier promises, why RVO did not keep its promise to speed up payments after a court case, and why advance payments were not used. The state secretary explains the delay through extended Q1 applications and a reference-system decision, denies breaking any promise, says advance payments are legally barred, and states the Q2 scheme opens on 25 June.
I should have communicated this delay more clearly to your House.
Deze vertraging had ik duidelijker aan uw Kamer moeten communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over winsten die worden gemaakt met publiek geld voor verduurzaming

SP MPs asked the government about private profits from publicly subsidised wind and solar, electricity bills, overcompensation under the SDE+ scheme, and the Court of Audit's findings. The State Secretary maintained that overwinsten are limited by the tender design and PBL cost estimates, committed to a new evaluation and to monitoring participation, but refused to quantify private profits and rejected socialising renewable energy.
I have no direct insight into the amount of private profit made with SDE+ subsidies.
Ik heb geen direct inzicht in de hoeveelheid private winst die is gemaakt met SDE+-subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen door de coronapandemie

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the government how socioeconomic health inequalities have grown due to the coronavirus pandemic, and how communication about vaccination and measures reaches people who are digitally or functionally illiterate, and how many communication staff the government employs. The minister answered that research on the widening gap is ongoing with results expected by year-end, cited existing data and studies, listed communication staff numbers (811.5 fte at department communication directorates, 15 fte on the vaccination communication team), and described outreach tools for low-literacy and digitally less skilled groups.
It is expected that in the coming months it will become clearer what the consequences of the pandemic are for socioeconomic health inequalities in the Netherlands.
Naar verwachting zal de komende maanden meer duidelijk worden wat de gevolgen zijn van de pandemie voor de sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Hijink en Leijten over het afschuiven van uitbetalingen bij letselschade door verzekeraars aan gemeenten

MPs Van Nispen, Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked about insurers redirecting injury-claim victims to municipalities for costs insurers should bear, and about slow payouts and municipal recovery of costs. The minister answered that insurers may not require victims to first go to the municipality, that victims may choose, that no fixed settlement term exists, and that municipalities are responsible for recovering costs, with no direct national role beyond pointing to a convenant option.
An insurer of the liable party may not require a victim to first approach the municipality to claim support under the Social Support Act 2015.

Een verzekeraar van de aansprakelijke partij mag niet van een slachtoffer verlangen dat hij zich eerst tot de gemeente wendt voor een beroep op ondersteuning via de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de motie Alkaya, Kamerstuk 31066-827

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked how many dossiers and staff are involved in the pilots (Leeuwarden, Almere, Zaanstad) for handling childcare benefit reclamation cases in one day, given the minister's view that a nationwide rollout before September 2021 is unfeasible. The Staatssecretaris provided a table of pilot dossiers and staff numbers, stressing the pilots are small-scale and that rollout would require substantial logistical capacity.
Below you will find the requested information about the pilots.
Onderstaand treft u de gevraagde informatie over de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de tarieven bij gemeenten voor trouwceremonies stijgen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether marriage should remain accessible to low-income people, whether rising marriage fees reflect municipal budget pressure, and whether a cap on cost-recovery should be studied. The minister answered that municipalities must offer free marriage slots, that fee-setting is a local democratic choice, and that no national maximum or study by central government is planned.
A maximum tariff for marriage fees would not do justice to locally made democratic choices and local cost differences.
Een maximumtarief voor trouwleges zou geen recht doen aan lokaal gemaakte democratische keuzes en lokale kostenverschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Leijten over het bericht 'Overheid heeft nog jaren nodig om «foute persoonsgegevens» op te ruimen'

MPs Ceder and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Interior about reports that the government needs years to clean up improperly used personal data in risk models, including use of nationality, ethnicity and birthplace, privacy impact assessments, proportionality, and timelines. The State Secretary answered that a DPIA check and inventory will be carried out across departments, that such data use is only allowed when objectively justified, that the operation may run until 2025, and that a first progress report will be sent before the budget debate.
As I wrote to your House in my letter of 8 April, we are starting with an inventory of data processing and a check on lawfulness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer schreef in mijn brief van 8 april, starten we met een inventarisatie van de gegevensverwerkingen en een toetsing op rechtmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Ook aardgas dreigt straks als 'groen' te worden gezien'

An SP MP asks whether the government accepts that the EU taxonomy could label gas-fired power as green, why NGOs left the sustainable finance platform, and whether nuclear energy should count as green. The minister states the Netherlands favours a science-based, technology-neutral taxonomy, that gas is not in line with the scientific advice, and that the government will press the Commission on its scientific basis while the nuclear assessment is still pending.
The Netherlands will continue to advocate a technology-neutral taxonomy in which economic activities are assessed on the basis of scientific criteria.
Nederland zal blijven pleiten voor een technologie-neutrale taxonomie, waarin economische activiteiten aan de hand van wetenschappelijke criteria worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Miljardensubsidie voor CO2-opslag onder Noordzee is rond'

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why billions in subsidies for CO2 storage under the North Sea, benefiting polluters such as Shell, are justified and why this money is not spent on renewables, along with questions on evaluation, the CO2 levy, refineries and the Klimaatakkoord's democratic legitimacy. The state secretary replied that CCS is a cost-effective generic SDE++ subsidy technology, that subsidies cover only the unprofitable top and are capped and time-limited, and that the Klimaatakkoord was broadly supported and politically adopted.
The functioning of the SDE+ will be evaluated this year, and the functioning of the SDE++ (which also includes CO2-reducing techniques besides renewable energy production) will be evaluated in 2023.

Het functioneren van de SDE+ wordt dit jaar geëvalueerd, het functioneren van de SDE++ (waarin ook CO 2 -reducterende technieken, naast de productie van hernieuwbare energie) zal in 2023 worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over negatieve publieke uitlatingen van een hoge ambtenaar van de NCTV over Pieter Omtzigt

Two SP MPs asked why a senior NCTV official's public tweets criticising Pieter Omtzigt were permissible and whether they breach the civil service conduct norm, and whether that official was involved in threat assessments for him. The ministers answered that the freedom of expression of officials is weighed against functioning-based criteria, that two fact-finding inquiries are ongoing so no conclusions can be pre-empted, and that the official had no direct or indirect role in threat analysis for Omtzigt.
While these investigations are ongoing, we can and will not anticipate those conclusions, given the duty of care we must observe as employer.
Lopende deze onderzoeken kunnen en willen wij niet vooruitlopen op die conclusies, mede gelet op de eisen van zorgvuldigheid die als werkgever in acht zijn te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de ceo altijd een Minister kan bellen

An MP asked why large companies take up so much of ministers' agendas, how often ministries meet VNO-NCW, and whether lobbying contacts, including phone calls, should be published, citing GRECO criticism on lobby transparency. The minister replied that departments publish agendas, that meeting companies is legitimate interactive policymaking, that openness of decision-making is preferred over full contact lists, and that GRECO recommendations are being worked on with a compliance report to follow.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ongevraagd uitkeren van een te hoog kindgebonden budget

Two SP MPs asked why the Tax Administration over-pays the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) to migrant workers and why these people face large recoveries, and how many cases are known. The ministers answer that the system relies on BRN/BSN partner data which is often missing for partners abroad, describe partial fixes and planned improvements, and say they will review collection policy and make some changes but do not quantify harm or commit to individual redress.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het feit dat meerdere gedupeerde ouders een brief van Incassobureau GGN hebben ontvangen

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked why many affected parents received letters from debt collector GGN saying they were not victims, despite not yet having an integral assessment or compensation, and on what legal basis the Tax Authority shares victim status with collectors. The State Secretary apologises, explains that a faulty list of parents was shared with enforcement bodies under the statutory moratorium (art. 49i Awir), that the moratorium ends from 1 May for parents with no indication of entitlement, and that parents can verify their status via a code and register.
I therefore find it terrible that this incorrect list was shared and that these letters were subsequently sent out.
Ik vind het dan ook verschrikkelijk dat deze foute lijst gedeeld is en dat vervolgens deze brieven zijn uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie jarenlang onterecht informatie met de belastingdienst heeft gedeeld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers why police in Oost-Nederland shared suspects' data with the Tax Authority for years allegedly without proper basis, and what was done about it. The government answers that a legal basis exists under the Bpg and RIEC convention but its practical application needs attention, that police suspended sharing in Oost-Nederland, is developing a uniform working method with the Tax Authority and RIEC's, and that the Data Protection Authority would be consulted later if needed.
In addition, the police will work with the Tax Authority and the RIEC's to develop a uniform working method that guarantees careful information sharing.
Daarnaast gaat de politie samen met de Belastingdienst en de RIEC’s een uniforme werkwijze ontwikkelen waarbij een zorgvuldige informatiedeling gegarandeerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bestuurlijke situatie in Limburg

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Interior whether action was taken before the Limburg governor and deputies resigned, why a temporary commissioner (Remkes) was appointed and what his competences are, whether the scandal extends beyond the province, and whether there are other subsidy ties with ministries. The Minister answered that the ministry monitored developments, explained the appointment as necessary to restore trust and gave Remkes a mandate on administrative culture with an integrity reporting point, while stating that the province and private overseers are responsible for investigations and that she has no view of subsidy ties beyond media reports.
As you know, promoting administrative integrity and tackling administrative problems is one of the priorities of my policy.
Zoals u weet, is de bevordering van de bestuurlijke integriteit en de aanpak van bestuurlijke problemen een van de speerpunten van mijn beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de staking bij kolencentrale op de Maasvlakte

An SP MP asks the Economy and Climate minister why the owner of the Onyx coal plant requested a 238 million euro closure subsidy while allocating little for staff, and how the subsidy conditions and works council procedures protect employees. The minister replies that the subsidy is conditional on an adequate social plan and WOR procedures, that no agreement on the social plan exists yet, that the financial assessment and EU state-aid approval are pending, and that the minister is not a party to the social plan negotiations.
If the proposal submitted by Power Plant Rotterdam does not meet the stated requirements, the subsidy for the proposal will not be granted.
Als het voorstel dat door Power Plant Rotterdam is ingediend niet voldoet aan de gestelde eisen, wordt de subsidie voor het voorstel niet verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over onterecht verstuurde berekeningen Toeslagen

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked why the Tax Administration wrongly sent about 224 households demands to repay large childcare-benefit (toeslagen) amounts, including for 2014, and why the Chamber was not informed. The State Secretary apologised, explained the IND data processing error, said the Chamber was not proactively informed but will be in future, and described fixes plus a law change requiring a hearing before large repayment decisions from 2021.
However, I understand your need for information in order to properly carry out your supervisory task.
Ik heb echter begrip voor uw informatiebehoefte om uw controlerende taak goed uit te kunnen oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the statutory debt moratorium for childcare benefit scandal victims, expiring on 1 May 2021, would expose affected parents to renewed collection and whether it should be extended urgently. The State Secretary answered that the moratorium is extended by one year for parents found eligible for at least 30,000 euro in compensation, while parents not found eligible lose it on 1 May, with a nazorgteam and possible specific solutions for those harmed later.
Once it is established that victims qualify for the Catshuis scheme and thus at least 30,000 euro, the moratorium (the pause button) will be extended by one year from the moment of payment.

Zodra bij gedupeerden is vastgesteld dat ze in aanmerking komen voor de Catshuisregeling en daarmee minimaal € 30.000, wordt het moratorium (de pauzeknop) vanaf het moment van uitbetaling met 1 jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over burgers die in 2021 ongevraagd een voorlopige aanslag krijgen

An SP MP asked why many people received unsolicited provisional tax assessments in 2021, why they were assessed individually rather than with their partner, and whether this conflicts with the Tax Administration's personal approach and the Toeslagenaffaire trust damage. The Secretary of State said the number of first-time positive provisional assessments actually fell (265,000 in 2021 versus 277,000 in 2020), defended proactive assessment to avoid large year-end payments, and promised to improve communication and study simplifying adjustments.
I want to look at how communication about the provisional assessment can be further improved, because I realise that especially when taxpayers receive one for the first time, this raises questions.

Ik wil kijken hoe de communicatie rond de voorlopige aanslag verder verbeterd kan worden omdat ik me realiseer dat vooral wanneer belastingplichtigen deze voor de eerste keer ontvangen dit vragen oproept.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van Ojik en Leijten over het bericht ‘Statement of the Members of the European Council’

MPs Kuiken, Van Ojik and Leijten asked the Prime Minister whether the European Council's March 2021 statement to start work on modernising the EU-Turkey customs union squared with the minister's earlier remarks, and why it should not be paused given Turkey's withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and moves against the HDP. The government replied that the customs union has not been decided, that discussion only starts under the positive agenda conditional on de-escalation, and that human rights and the rule of law must remain part of the EU-Turkey dialogue, with the minister having raised these concerns directly with Turkey.
The cabinet will reiterate this in relevant new discussions with colleagues.
Het kabinet zal dit bij relevante nieuwe discussies met collega’s opnieuw benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de langdurige storing bij de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the prolonged outage of the Tax Administration's online filing systems during the 2021 filing campaign, including its cause, communication, and link to IT modernisation. The State Secretary attributed the outage to unclosed failed login attempts overloading the access channels, said it is fixed, denied links to the ETM system replacement, and committed to evaluating the campaign.
Each year the course of the filing campaign is evaluated in order to further improve the process.
Ieder jaar wordt het verloop van de aangiftecampagne geëvalueerd om het proces verder te kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over corruptie bij Limburgse CDA-bestuurders

Leijten (SP) asks the Interior Minister how she assesses the integrity scandal in Limburg's provincial government, whether the administration and the governor's position remain tenable, whether similar cases exist elsewhere, what external controls exist against fraud, whether complaints about subsidy handling reached the ministry, and whether she accepts that subsidy abuse harms trust in politics. The minister answers that the governor ordered an inquiry, executives resigned, a new acting commissioner (Remkes) was appointed with a restorative mandate, no signs of similar cases in other provinces were found, external controls are the responsibility of provinces, accountants and the Public Prosecution Service, and no complaints reached the ministry.
Thereupon I have nominated Mr J.W. Remkes for appointment as acting Commissioner of the King, with an explicit administrative mandate.
Daarop heb ik de heer J.W. Remkes voorgedragen voor benoeming tot waarnemend commissaris van de Koning, met een expliciete bestuurlijke opdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de vele openstaande vragen die er zijn over de compensatie van gedupeerden in de toeslagenaffaire

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the tax authority's denials about pre-CAF unlawful practices, the Catshuis compensation scheme, the lifting of the debt moratorium, delays and advocate fees in the childcare benefits scandal remain unresolved. The State Secretary answered that pre-CAF harm is being redressed, the Catshuis scheme is a deliberate fast-payment route with individual assessment still available, the moratorium lapses only for applicants without indications for the 30,000 euro payment, and that figures on other benefit groups are provided.
This is to prevent the private debts of these parents from increasing, while UHT has not yet been able to establish that they qualify for the Catshuis scheme.
Dit is om te voorkomen dat de private schulden van deze ouders oplopen, terwijl UHT nog niet heeft kunnen vaststellen dat zij in aanmerking komen voor de Catshuisregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over fraude met tegemoetkoming vaste lasten-subsidie

SP MPs asked the government about suspected fraud with the TVL fixed-cost subsidy, including suspicious bank transactions, the number of FIOD-handled reports, weak controls and the use of dormant company registrations. The State Secretary answered that the government is in close contact with FIU-Nederland, the FIOD and banks, has tightened risk controls and checks against tax data, and will revoke subsidies, file reports and seize accounts where fraud is confirmed, while withholding some figures pending ongoing investigations.
The investigation into the reports is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de meldingen loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de keuze om digitale uitzendingen van culturele evenementen als elektronische dienst te beschouwen

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 21% VAT rate on digital broadcasts of cultural events, classed as electronic services, should be revised in light of the Geelen case and a critical academic commentary, and about cultural municipal support. The State Secretary replied that Geelen does not settle whether such broadcasts are electronic services, that the EU VAT Directive bars the reduced rate, that no legislative change is planned until EU negotiations conclude, and that the existing support measures are adequate.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to provide for legislative measures for this at this time.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens hiervoor op dit moment te voorzien in wettelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het nieuws dat de laatste onafhankelijke radiozender van Hongarije door premier Orban is weggewerkt

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the loss of broadcasting licence by Hungary's last independent radio station Klubrádió was a purely political move by Orbán, and what the Netherlands and the EU would do about media freedom there. The minister replied that media pluralism in Hungary is under pressure, that the Commission asked Hungary to keep the station on air and publicly voiced concern, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally, in the EU rule-of-law dialogue and at the Article 7 procedure.
The Netherlands regularly raises the importance of press freedom and media pluralism in European and bilateral contexts.
Er wordt in Europees en bilateraal verband door Nederland regelmatig aandacht gevraagd voor het belang van persvrijheid en mediapluriformiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over miljoenenfraude bij de landsadvocaat

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about large-scale fraud by a former top figure at the state's legal advisory firm, questioning oversight capacity, the four-eyes principle, the state's reliance on the firm, and when the minister was informed. Minister Grapperhaus largely declined to address specifics pending ongoing criminal, supervisory and internal investigations, while defending the arrangement and promising to seek further information from the firm and to inform the House later.
Since various investigations are still ongoing on this matter, I cannot go into more detail on this at the present moment.
Aangezien ter zake nog diverse onderzoeken lopen, kan ik hier op dit moment nog niet inhoudelijk nader op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over gestopte grenscontroles in Noord-Ierland en het EU-only gehalte van het akkoord met het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the Foreign Minister about halted border controls in Northern Ireland and whether the EU-UK trade agreement is EU-only, including why the Netherlands handled it differently from other member states and what concrete steps will keep parliament informed. The minister answered that the Northern Ireland Protocol is binding, that the trade agreement is EU-only per the Council decision, that no procedural changes are planned beyond regular briefings, and that parliament will be kept informed through letters and Council agendas.
Your House received a letter on 15 February with an account of the experiences in the first period after the transition period ended.
Uw Kamer heeft op 15 februari jl. een brief ontvangen met daarin een uiteenzetting van de ervaringen van de eerste periode na het aflopen van de overgangsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het herleven van een studieschuld na afronding van een WSNP

SP MPs asked why people who exited a debt-restructuring (WSNP) procedure received letters demanding resumption of student loan repayments at amounts unaffordable on a modest income, and whether DUO would soften this. The minister explained repayment is frozen during the procedure, admitted the letters can be unexpected and too high before income-based assessment, and said DUO will now phone debtors first where income is unknown and clarify the letters.
After consultation with DUO, it has therefore been decided no longer to announce the resumption of collection solely by letter.
Na overleg met DUO is dan ook besloten om niet langer uitsluitend per brief aan te kondigen dat de inning wordt herstart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het SchuldenLabNL

MPs asked why the government appointed former finance minister Zalm, who is under OM investigation for money laundering, as chair of SchuldenLabNL, and whether private creditors would cooperate on debts of parents in the childcare benefits affair. The state secretary replied that SchuldenLabNL is an independent foundation the cabinet had no role in appointing its board, that the board is unpaid, and that talks with public and private creditors are ongoing to give affected parents a fresh start.
The cabinet has no involvement whatsoever in appointing Mr Zalm as chair or in appointing the other board members of SchuldenLabNL.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele bemoeienis met het benoemen van de heer Zalm als voorzitter alsmede met de benoeming van andere leden van het bestuur van SchuldenlabNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het in één keer ontvangen van 54 aanmaningen van het CJIB

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why a childcare-benefit affair victim received 54 reminder letters from the CJIB at once, and what the government will do to prevent this and stop collection of debts owed by victims. The State Secretary explains the letters were automatically generated per open case, the CJIB has taken measures to prevent bulk dispatch, and public creditors are being asked to pause collection of debts of victims while stating that fines from criminal convictions are excluded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de hoge BTW-heffing over digitale popevenementen

Two MPs asked why digital pop-event tickets are taxed at the 21% standard VAT rate rather than the 9% reduced rate and whether this should change. The State Secretary confirmed that electronic services fall outside the reduced rate under EU law, rejected a reduced rate for online cultural events, and pointed to subsidy packages and the Geefwet instead.
Under EU law it is not permitted to place online cultural events under the reduced rate.
Het is op grond van het EU-recht niet toegestaan online culturele evenementen onder het verlaagd tarief te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht 'Ontwikkelaar corona-sneltest ontwijkt op grote schaal belastingen'

SP MPs asked the health minister and finance state secretary about reports that Qiagen, a supplier of COVID-19 test kits, avoided Dutch taxes while receiving public subsidies, and about public investment via the Dutch Venture Initiative. The minister answered that the government cannot comment on individual taxpayers under article 67 AWR, that no test orders were placed with Qiagen, and that the government will pursue anti-avoidance measures and study public country-by-country reporting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een gedupeerde moeder niet uit de schuldsanering mag door de aankondiging van 30.000 euro en dat de overheid zich terugtrekt als schuldeiser

Leijten (SP) asked why a rechter-commissaris did not end a debt-restructuring (WSNP) process for a mother who was to receive a 30,000 euro compensation payment, and why there is no clean-slate plan despite payments to about 500 parents. The Secretary of State says the government has cancelled public debts of affected parents, is working on a clean-slate plan with creditors and other ministries, and that the matter of specific cases lies with the trustee and the judge, without firm timelines.
Assessing specific practical situations is reserved for the trustee and the judge.
Het beoordelen van specifieke praktijksituaties is voorbehouden aan de bewindvoerder en aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een overzicht van delen van wetten die wel door het parlement zijn aangenomen maar nooit in de werking zijn getreden

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked why many tax and benefit provisions adopted by parliament never entered into force, and requested a full overview with reasons and information given to the Chamber. The State Secretary provided an annex listing unimplemented tax and benefit provisions over ten years, with stated reasons for delay, and acknowledged the ministry kept no central overview, promising to include the topic in annual reports.
The Ministry of Finance does not keep a central overview of whether tax or benefit legislation has entered into force; of course this is known within the responsible departments.
Het Ministerie van Financiën houdt niet centraal een overzicht bij of fiscale of toeslagen wet- en regelgeving in werking is getreden; uiteraard is dat wel bij de behandelende afdelingen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de betrokkenheid van de minister-president bij de compensatieregeling voor gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asks the government about the Prime Minister's involvement in designing the compensation scheme for childcare benefit victims, including the crisis structure, the Bewindsliedenoverleg meetings, withheld Wob documents, precedent concerns, and the scope of the advisory committee. The Secretary of State answers that the Prime Minister attended three ministerial preparation meetings in February and March 2020, releases several previously withheld documents, but refuses some details and says the questions could not be answered by the deadline.
This ministerial consultation on possible compensation scenarios convened three times.
Dit BWO met als onderwerp «mogelijke scenario’s compensatieregeling» is driemaal bijeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Adviescommissie-Donner conclusies trok die in strijd waren met het eigen onderzoek

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Adviescommissie Uitvoering Toeslagen (AUT, Donner committee) drew conclusions at odds with its own research, including the concealment of documents in appeal cases and the use of an internal work plan. The State Secretary answers that the AUT set its own method, acknowledges that withholding relevant documents from courts is unacceptable and regrets past practice, outlines remedial measures and compensation rules, and largely declines to explain the timing and handling of Wob requests and press contacts beyond general procedure.
The Ministry of Finance does not provide documents to the media, insofar as these documents are not already public or will not be made public immediately.
Het Ministerie van Financiën verstrekt geen stukken aan media, voor zover deze stukken niet reeds openbaar zijn of terstond openbaar zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat Oeganda 21 miljoen misloopt door Nederland

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the Netherlands-Uganda tax treaty lets companies such as Airtel and CNOOC avoid Ugandan tax, how much Uganda loses, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that individual taxpayers cannot be discussed, that the treaty lacks anti-abuse rules that the government wants to add quickly, and that renegotiation has been pursued since 2013 with Uganda slow to respond.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de reactie van de Europese Ombudsman op de gunning van een onderzoeksopdracht aan BlackRock door de Europese Commissie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance Minister how he views the European Ombudsman's finding of serious shortcomings in controlling conflicts of interest around BlackRock's award of a sustainable finance advisory contract by the European Commission. The minister replied that the Ombudsman found no maladministration, that the Commission should strengthen its procurement framework, and that he will encourage the Commission to act and inform the House.
I will encourage the European Commission in the relevant bodies to take this up promptly and ask how it intends to take forward the Ombudsman's recommendations.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie in de relevante gremia aanmoedigen dit voortvarend op te pakken en vragen hoe zij voornemens is de aanbevelingen van de Ombudsman verder te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geringe straf op het mogelijk maken van belastingontduiking

MP Leijten asked why accounting firm Baker Tilly Berk was fined only EUR 20,000 for enabling tax evasion via a Cyprus route, and why the fine seems small relative to fees, while victims of the childcare benefits scandal were punished harder. The State Secretary answered that the transaction matched the amount the prosecutor would demand, that the firm self-reported, and that the cases differ between tax evasion and avoidance; he also said he would examine whether administrative fine tools are adequate and promised a Tax Governance Code initiative.
I am not aware of the rates Baker Tilly Berk charges.
Ik ben niet bekend met de tarieven die Baker Tilly Berk hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de verplichte dataverstrekking van kinderopvangorganisaties aan de Belastingdienst

MPs Kwint and Leijten (SP) asked why monthly personal data sharing by childcare organisations with the Tax Administration was set by ministerial regulation rather than law, whether privacy impact assessments and consent/opt-out were provided, and whether the practice conflicts with privacy rights. The state secretaries answered that monthly data delivery aims to prevent high childcare benefit recoveries, that a statutory basis exists and is being strengthened via the Awir amendment, and that parents cannot opt out, while several answers (e.g. on the AP advice and PIA) were given but the timing deadline was missed.
From 2021 the monthly delivery of this data will be mandatory.
Vanaf 2021 is het maandelijks leveren van deze gegevens verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de fraudejacht bij de inkomstenbelasting

MP Leijten asked the state secretaries of Finance about the Belastingdienst's tax fraud targeting, including project code 1043 (AKI 1043), facilitator-linked CAF investigations, whether people were targeted year after year, the use of 'black-list'-like selection lists, deletion of records and call-centre instructions. The government explained how AKI codes are set and lifted, admitted instruction errors and that 1043 targeting is paused with extra safeguards, promised a dienst-wide review and to keep data, and sent the instructions and handbook.
Until the investigation is completed, we are ensuring additional safeguards around the supervisory processes (including the four-eyes principle).
Totdat het onderzoek is afgerond, zorgen wij voor extra waarborgen rondom de toezichtprocessen (o.m. meerogenprincipes).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Nederlandse fiscaal verdragsbeleid

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Netherlands' tax treaty policy toward developing countries, including why withholding rates agreed since 2011 are lower than OECD averages, why treaties with Kenya and Malawi are not in force, and whether conditional withholding taxes on interest and royalties will curb treaty abuse. The State Secretary rejects the claim that Dutch treaties undermine developing countries' taxing rights, cites the 2011 policy of accommodating developing countries, and announces treaty submissions, monitoring of conditional withholding tax effects, and possible dividend measures.
I attach importance, in line with treaty policy, to including anti-abuse provisions in tax treaties so that the developing country is not wrongly limited in its taxing rights.

Voorts hecht ik, in lijn met verdragsbeleid, belang aan het opnemen van antimisbruikbepalingen in belastingverdragen zodat het ontwikkelingsland niet ten onrechte in zijn heffingsbevoegdheid wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de tweewekentermijn die gehanteerd wordt bij informatieverzoeken

MP Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Authority responded to media rather than Parliament, why parents received short two-week deadlines for information requests on childcare allowance, and whether short deadlines apply elsewhere, including for codes linked to suspected system fraud. The State Secretary said reminder letters now give three weeks, the timing reflected COVID-era considerations, short deadlines are longstanding practice, and a proposal on response periods will follow; the answer to the BSN-code question was not provided in the text.

I promised your House during the General Consultation on the restart of the childcare allowance recovery operation of 20 August 2020, to the member Lodders, that I would soon come with a proposal for setting response and reminder periods.

Ik heb uw Kamer tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Start hersteloperatie kinderopvangtoeslag van 20 augustus 2020 aan het lid Lodders toegezegd binnenkort te komen met een voorstel voor een invulling van reactie- en rappeltermijnen.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het kwijtraken van toeslagen door transitievergoedingen

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether transitievergoedingen (transition payments on dismissal) can push low-income people over the income thresholds and cause toeslagen (benefit supplements) to be reclaimed, and whether these payments could be excluded from the income test or averaged more easily. The state secretary acknowledged the payments can raise the income test and lead to reclaims, but rejected exempting them, said the Belastingdienst cannot count how often this happens, and said the averaging threshold will stay.
The benefit supplement system serves a different purpose. It provides targeted income support to guarantee financial access to care, childcare and a rental home.
Het toeslagenstelsel dient een ander doel. Het biedt gerichte inkomensondersteuning om de financiële toegankelijkheid van zorg, kinderopvang en een huurwoning te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over informeelkapitaalstructuren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about informal capital structures, including whether advance rulings can still indirectly cover them and how often they are used. The State Secretary answered that since 1 July 2019 no advance certainty is given where tax saving is the sole or decisive motive, that a study will follow, and that roughly 157 informal-capital cases with an international character were identified for 2016 and 126 for 2017.
That is why I also announced a study into informal capital structures.
Daarom heb ik ook een onderzoek aangekondigd naar informeel-kapitaalstructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep voor meer geld voor het Europees Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister whether he pleaded for more money for the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) at the JBZ Council, and why, given the EPPO is not yet operational. The minister denied it was on the agenda, said he only stated after the meeting that Europol, Eurojust and the EPPO should be adequately equipped, and answered the budget and MFF questions by referring to earlier letters and the European Council conclusions.
No, the EPPO was not on the agenda and was also not discussed at the JBZ Council of 7 July 2020.
Nee, het EOM stond niet geagendeerd en is ook niet besproken op de JBZ-raad van 7 juli 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de Voortgangsrapportage kinderopvangtoeslag en de verdwenen dossiers

MPs Alkaya and Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Finance (Toeslagen en Douane) about the childcare benefits scandal: who sits on the Strategic Crisis Team, whether its minutes can be shared, how the UHT handles parents' cases, the O/GS compensation, the CAF-11 group, the destroyed case files and the queries that included nationality. The State Secretary answered that the crisis team keeps only action and decision lists, that case handling and compensation are being rolled out with safeguards, that an external review of UHT is under way, and that the selection-list and nationality-query matters were disclosed or stopped after discovery.
Of these meetings, currently two per week, action and decision lists are recorded, not minutes.
Van deze bijeenkomsten, momenteel twee per week, worden actie- en besluitenlijsten vastgelegd, geen verslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de sponsoring van het tijdelijke EU-voorzitterschap

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about private sponsorship of the EU presidency, the European Ombudsman's recommendation, and transparency calls for the German presidency. The minister answered that sponsorship is not in principle undesirable, that the Council is considering guidelines in response to the Ombudsman, and that the Netherlands supports transparency efforts, without committing to a leading role.
The cabinet is of the view that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat sponsoring in beginsel niet ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MP Leijten asked the State Secretaries of Finance about the Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV), a Tax Authority fraud-signal database, including its legal basis, data retention, deletion, sharing with other agencies and privacy assessment. The government answered that FSV was taken offline, that a deletion action removed 143,574 records with a backup preserved, that the privacy impact assessment was deficient, and that FSV will not be reused.
In the meantime it has been decided not to use FSV any more and to redesign the processes for processing signals and the associated support.
Ondertussen is besloten om FSV niet meer te gaan gebruiken en de processen voor het verwerken van signalen en de bijbehorende ondersteuning opnieuw te ontwerpen.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over onterechte huurverhogingen door foutieve huishoudverklaringen door de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked how 932 household statements with a wrong AOW age led to unlawful higher rent increases, and what happens if landlords do not reverse them. The government answered that the error stemmed from an outdated parameter in software, that the Tax Authority informed landlords and tenants by letter and phone, and that reversing increases is the landlord's responsibility under civil rental law.
The Tax Authority is not leaving it to the tenants.
De Belastingdienst laat het niet over aan de huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het door de Belastingdienst toekennen van verzuimboetes terwijl uitstel van aangifte is aangevraagd

MP Leijten asked how many businesses obtained deferral of tax returns during the COVID-19 crisis, why late-payment fines were still imposed despite deferral requests, why individual rather than categorical deferral was chosen, and how businesses can easily cancel fines. The State Secretary answered that all deferral-of-payment requests were granted, that fines for VAT were automatically annulled after a request while payroll-tax fines were not imposed, that the process is automated, and that businesses need not act because the fines are cancelled.
No breakdown is available by self-employed persons and other businesses/legal forms.
Er is geen uitsplitsing beschikbaar naar zelfstandigen en andere bedrijven/rechtsvormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het recht op toeslagen in combinatie met wezenpensioen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why a foster parent lost retroactive rent allowance because a foster child's orphan's pension was counted as income, and asks about the length of response times and Tax Authority service. The State Secretary declines to discuss the individual case but explains that a special-income exemption exists and that the objection deadline for requesting it was extended to five years, while promising an external review of service delivery.
Although I cannot go into individual cases, in general a income exemption applies to living-at-home (foster) children up to age 23.
Hoewel ik niet op individuele casussen kan ingaan, geldt in zijn algemeen voor thuiswonende (pleeg)kinderen tot 23 jaar een inkomensvrijstelling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over overwerk in relatie tot toeslagen

Two SP MPs asked whether the government will protect care and other essential workers from losing childcare, rent and healthcare allowances because of overtime during the coronavirus crisis, and whether it will give certainty about having to repay allowances. The government answered that it cannot identify overtime effects on household income, that allowances must follow actual income, and that it will focus on communication and individual arrangements rather than a special scheme, apologising for the delay.

The cabinet will now primarily focus on communication to point citizens to the importance of reporting expected changes in household income for 2020 to the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances as soon as possible.

Het kabinet zal nu primair inzetten op communicatie om burgers te wijzen op het belang om verwachte wijzigingen in het huishoudinkomen van 2020 zo snel mogelijk door te geven aan de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de onafhankelijke organen betrokken bij uitvoering ‘Herstel Toeslagen’

The SP MP Leijten asks why four advisory and review commissions for the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation were formally established by decree while the parents' panel was not, and questions the panel's selection, meeting location, secretariat and influence. The State Secretary defends the informal set-up as allowing a low-threshold, flexible parents' panel, states that its advice is weighed heavily by the crisis team, and answers the factual questions about selection and location.
The parents' panel and the participating parents have a full and independent role in advising.
Het ouderpanel en de deelnemende ouders hebben een volwaardige en eigenstandige rol in de advisering.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat andere Europese landen 10 miljard dollar aan belastinginkomsten mislopen door belastingontwijking via Nederland
