An SP MP asked the Dutch Finance ministers about a Tax Justice Network report claiming the Netherlands costs other EU countries about $10bn a year in corporate tax through avoidance, and whether Dutch anti-avoidance measures, a withholding tax, and limits on loss deductions would be adopted. The State Secretary disputes the scale of the claim, notes the data's limitations, and lists measures already taken (a withholding tax from 2021, the multilateral instrument, ATAD implementation, loss-deduction limits) while rejecting an unconditional withholding tax and promising a cabinet response to the advisory committee report in summer.
The cabinet considers an unconditional withholding tax undesirable.
Het kabinet acht een onvoorwaardelijke bronbelasting ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Leijten en Van Kent over kinderopvangtoeslag in werkloosheid tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs of the SP asked whether childcare allowance is stopped after three months of unemployment during the coronavirus crisis and whether the government will extend that period to six months given weak job prospects and childcare waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that parents keep the allowance for three months and can use remaining hours until year-end under the annual system, and declined to extend the period because past extensions had limited effect and the economic outlook is uncertain.

Given the room that the existing unemployment period and the annual system already offer, and given the limited effects in the past, the uncertainty about the economic outlook and its effect on waiting lists, I do not consider it opportune to extend the unemployment period.

Gegeven de ruimte die de bestaande werkloosheidstermijn en de jaarsystematiek reeds bieden, en gegeven de beperkte effecten in het verleden, de onzekerheid over het economische beeld en het effect daarvan op wachtlijsten, vind ik het niet opportuun om de werkloosheidstermijn te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geldverspilling van de EU aan de promotie van vlees

An SP MP asked the minister why the EU spends about 60 million euros since 2017 promoting European meat, a policy at odds with Dutch consumption guidance, and whether the government would push the Commission to stop such subsidies. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposed the EU promotion regulation, will seek to steer funding toward healthy and sustainable food information, and will keep raising objections at EU level, though it could not block the regulation.
As before, I still do not support EU funding for promotion of a specific product, such as bread or meat.
Zoals destijds ben ik nog steeds geen voorstander van EU-financiering van promotie van een specifiek product, zoals brood of vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de vraag hoe mensen die kinderopvang geheel zelf betalen ook gecompenseerd zullen worden

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked how parents who pay for childcare entirely themselves, without childcare allowance, will be compensated during the COVID-19 closure, and why the compensation scheme relies on Tax Authority data that does not capture them. The State Secretary answered that only a few thousand such parents are estimated, that the scheme uses existing Tax Authority data for speed and privacy reasons, and that the government will consider a form of compensation for this group once more is known about them.
The number of people who do not qualify for childcare allowance cannot be estimated.
Het aantal mensen dat niet in aanmerking komt voor kinderopvangtoeslag is niet in te schatten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het feit dat vermogensbeheerder BlackRock de Europese Commissie gaat voorzien van advies over duurzaamheidsbeleid bij bankenbeleid op Europees niveau

SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why the European Commission chose BlackRock, a major investor in fossil fuel companies, to advise on ESG and sustainability in bank regulation, and whether this is a conflict of interest. Minister Hoekstra answered that the contract was awarded through a transparent public tender with nine bids, that expert input is customary, that the Netherlands as a Council member will co-decide EU legislation, and that he sees no reason to intervene in the procurement.
The European Commission awarded the research assignment through a public tender procedure.
De Europese Commissie heeft de onderzoeksopdracht uitgezet via een openbare aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over het verstrekken van volledige dossiers aan gedupeerde ouders in de toeslagenaffaire

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked why the Tax Administration postponed sending full case files to affected childcare-benefit parents and how they can obtain their files and the grounds for decisions. The State Secretary answered that file compilation is very labour-intensive, that staff will call parents to establish their actual information needs, that no formal decisions were issued because the file requests fall outside Article 15 GDPR, and that a date for sending files will be communicated next month.
I will inform your House about this next month.
Hierover informeer ik uw kamer volgende maand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de oppositie in Hongarije verder in de verdrukking komt

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Hungary's COVID-19 emergency measures are being used to further restrict the opposition and local governments, and what the Netherlands will do about it. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned about Hungary's authorisation law, has raised it with the Hungarian counterpart and in EU forums, supports conditionality of EU funds on rule of law, and will keep pressing via the Commission and the Article 7 procedure.
The cabinet is following developments in Hungary with concern.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Hongarije met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het verminderde recht op toeslagen als effect van de afbouw van de algemene heffingskorting

SP MPs asked why the phase-out of transferability of the general tax credit to the lower-earning partner pushes single-earner households above the minimum wage, causing loss of allowances and reduced net income, and why the Nationale ombudsman's 2016 concerns have not been resolved. The minister explains the cause of the case, sets out a range of solution directions that are rejected as too costly or disproportionate, and promises to explore options and inform parliament by end 2020.
The cabinet wants to explore options that ensure households with an income at the social minimum always receive the maximum allowance amount for the relevant allowances.
Het kabinet wil de mogelijkheden verkennen die ervoor zorgen dat huishoudens met een inkomen op het sociaal minimum altijd het maximale toeslagenbedrag aan de voor hen relevante toeslagen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Tegemoetkoming Specifieke Ziektekosten (TSZ)

An MP asked whether delays in determining 2018 tax assessments caused late Tegemoetkoming Specifieke Zorgkosten (TSZ) decisions for 2018 and whether affected people were compensated. The State Secretary denied any delay, showed rising numbers of late-year TSZ decisions as part of the regular process, and said no compensation was needed.
No, that is not correct. The determination of final assessments for 2018 proceeded at a slightly higher pace than was the case for 2017.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Het vaststellen van de definitieve aanslagen over 2018 heeft in een iets hoger tempo gelopen dan over het jaar 2017 het geval was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de dwangsom bij niet tijdig beslissen door de overheid

SP MPs asked whether the government should decide on time, whether the penalty-for-delay (dwangsom) regime still works as intended, why the Tax Administration has a different regime, and how much penalties were paid out in 2015-2019 per organisation. The minister agreed timely decisions matter, reported the regime has a preventive effect with some side effects, explained the Tax Administration's separate rules, and gave incomplete, non-uniform payment figures while noting the IND's sharp rise.
It turned out that these figures are not kept everywhere or in a uniform way.
Gebleken is dat deze cijfers niet overal en niet uniform worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de toeslagenaffaire met ouders die onder beschermingsbewind staan

MPs asked how the childcare benefits affair is handled for affected parents under protective administration, whether the administrator can be replaced as representative, and what recourse exists if parents feel poorly represented. The State Secretary answered that administrators act for parents on equal terms, that the court sets the scope of administration and can appoint another administrator, and that complaints go to the court or the administrator's sector body, with no role for Toeslagen.
The district court can then assess whether the scope of the administration should be adjusted so that someone else can act on behalf of the parents in the settlement.
De kantonrechter kan dan beoordelen of de reikwijdte van het bewind moet worden aangepast, zodat iemand anders bij de afwikkeling namens de ouders kan optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over morele corruptie bij de Belastingdienst door het stellen van een minimumbedrag voor het terugvorderen van toeslagen

The SP MP Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority applied minimum recovery amounts for childcare and other benefit (toeslag) fraud enforcement that had to be met regardless of cost, and what consequences this had for objections and appeals. The State Secretary answers that a budgeted fraud-yield target of 25-33 million per year existed from 2014, that monitoring of the yield stopped in 2019, that the target was not a management KPI, and that backlogs in objections and appeals arose from capacity shortages and have been addressed.
The budget amount thereby became a binding target for the yield of enforcement, and I find that undesirable.
Het begrotingsbedrag werd daarmee taakstellend voor de opbrengst van de uitvoering en dat vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Leijten over de berichten dat grootschalige kapitaalverschaffing aan banken een risico vormen voor de stabiliteit van de (Europese) bankensector

MPs Van Raan and Leijten asked the Finance Minister whether ECB liquidity support to banks and shadow banks, repo funding and the ban on monetary financing create risks to financial stability and fairness during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the ECB's measures are within its independent monetary mandate, that the ECB monitors risks, that monetary financing of governments is prohibited and that the EU's 500 billion euro package and Commission funds are the chosen route for support.
In addition, the ECB continuously monitors the financial system to detect potential risks and vulnerabilities early.
Daarnaast monitort de ECB voortdurend het financiële systeem om potentiele risico's en kwetsbaarheden vroegtijdig te detecteren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de in 2013 ingezette fraudemaatregelen door het kabinet naar aanleiding van de morele corruptie door targets bij de Belastingdienst en de relatie met de Ministeriele commissie

An SP MP asked the government how it responded to the Adviescommissie uitvoering toeslagen finding that fraud enforcement at the Belastingdienst had to pay for itself (morally corrupt), what 2013 agreements underpinned this, and whether the Ministeriële Commissie Aanpak Fraude discussed it. The state secretary agreed the financing link was undesirable, described the 2013 business case and €33 million cost-recovery agreement with compensation obligations, and said the ministerial commission addressed cross-departmental topics with cost-benefit analyses only mentioned in passing.
Ik ben het eens met dat oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat er een bankrun gaande is binnen de financiële sector

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the Finance Minister about a reported bank run, the ECB's bond-buying and its effects on inequality, state aid reaching banks rather than households and firms, a temporary cap on overdraft rates, the role of private banks and a public money or digital central bank currency, and inequality from the crisis response. The minister answered that the ECB sets its own monetary instruments, that aid reaches firms via guarantees and direct schemes, that overdraft rates were urged down by banks, and that the government aims for balanced income distribution.
It is up to the ECB to decide independently on the most effective and efficient approach to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is aan de ECB om onafhankelijk te beslissen over de meest doeltreffende en doelmatige benadering om haar mandaat op prijsstabiliteit te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over uitstel voor het doen van belastingaangifte voor particulieren in verband met de verlenging van coronamaatregelen tot 1 juni

An SP MP asked whether people who need assistance to file their tax return can request individual extensions, and whether the State Secretary will allow late filing without penalty given new corona measures. The State Secretary acknowledged that not everyone can request an extension independently, and agreed to an automatic extension to 1 September for the group that files with assistance (about 660,000 people), while rejecting generic extensions for everyone.
I am prepared to implement automatic extension for the above group that is not self-reliant regarding the tax return, to make it beyond doubt that people do not file late unintentionally.
ben om buiten twijfel te stellen dat mensen ongewild hun aangifte te laat indienen, bereid een automatisch uitstel te realiseren voor de bovengenoemde groep
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over EU-lidstaten die maatregelen nemen vanwege de coronacrisis die verregaande gevolgen hebben voor de democratie

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary's COVID-19 emergency law enabling rule by decree, its criticism under international law, and the criminalisation of 'panic-spreading' that could affect journalists, and how the Netherlands would address this with EU partners. Minister Blok replied that the Hungarian parliament had lifted the time limit on decrees, that the Netherlands raised concerns at EU level and bilaterally, and that the Netherlands would press for the rule-of-law implications of emergency measures to be put on the agenda of the EU General Affairs Council.

The cabinet, together with like-minded member states, has worked at European level to produce a statement calling on member states to respect the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights when taking exceptional emergency measures.

Het kabinet heeft zich er in Europees verband samen met gelijkgezinde lidstaten voor ingespannen om een verklaring tot stand te brengen waarin lidstaten wordt opgeroepen om bij het nemen van uitzonderlijke noodmaatregelen de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Leijten over uitbreiding van de Europese Unie

MPs Bisschop and Leijten asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands agreed to open EU accession talks with Albania and North Macedonia, given Copenhagen criteria, absorption capacity, rule-of-law and corruption concerns, and whether alternatives to membership were considered. The minister answered that the Netherlands agreed, that further progress by Albania is required before a formal intergovernmental conference, that the Commission found North Macedonia had achieved tangible results, and that the government is considering the EU perspective in the revised enlargement methodology.
The Netherlands agreed to the opening of accession negotiations with North Macedonia.
Nederland heeft ingestemd met de opening van de toetredingsonderhandelingen met Noord-Macedonië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de belastingen voor woningcorporaties die Vestia willen helpen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about tax and policy measures for housing corporations, including the Vestia rescue, the transfer of Vestia homes to other corporations, property transfer tax exemptions and the Tweebosbuurt case. The minister answered that a Vestia housing transfer study is pending, that abolishing the rental levy only for corporations is not an option, and declined to comment on several local or ongoing legal matters.
This concerns a local matter on which Vestia must weigh considerations in consultation with the municipality.
Het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid waarover Vestia in samenspraak met de gemeente een afweging moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de spoedbijeenkomst van de Eurogroep van 24 maart naar aanleiding van de geannoteerde agenda

An MP (Leijten, SP) asks the Finance Minister about the 24 March 2020 extraordinary Eurogroup meeting, including whether irreversible steps on EMU deepening are being taken, the use of the general escape clause and ESM conditionality, and the coordination of economic measures against COVID-19. The Minister answers that no irreversible EMU steps were taken, that the escape clause is an existing SGP provision the Netherlands supports, that no new ESM mandate is needed, and that coordination follows existing Council and Eurogroup processes.
No irreversible steps have been taken regarding the deepening of the Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
Hierbij zijn geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet aangaande de verdieping van de Economische en Monetaire Unie (EMU).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inkomensongelijkheid en de gevolgen van statistische keuzes

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about a claim that statistical choices (deducting interest, excluding capital gains) make income inequality look smaller, and whether indirect and local taxes make the tax system regressive. The State Secretary acknowledged wealth inequality, defended CBS and OECD statistical conventions, and argued that indirect taxes are not necessarily more burdensome for low incomes.
I am aware of the article. I agree that wealth is distributed more unequally than income.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel. Ik onderschrijf dat vermogens ongelijker verdeeld zijn dan inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie de Donald Duck gebruikt voor Europese indoctrinatie door te sturen op enkel een positief beeld van de EU

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the European Commission's Donald Duck special on the EU, alleging that the Commission's Dutch representation pressured publisher Sanoma-type content to present only a positive picture, funded with Dutch taxpayer money, and failed to disclose the costs and label it as government communication. The minister answered that the Commission, which controls its own communication and answers to the European Parliament, is responsible, that the Dutch government cannot judge the correspondence, that the cost of the EU special is not known to the cabinet, and that the Dutch Advertising Code complaint is for the Reclame Code Commissie to decide.

Given that communication policy falls within the Commission's prerogatives and it is accountable for this to the European Parliament, it is not for the cabinet to call the Commission to account on this.

Gezien het communicatiebeleid binnen de prerogatieven Commissie valt en zij hierover verantwoording aflegt tegenover het Europees parlement, is het niet aan het kabinet de Europese Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Zwartboek van de Stichting Afkoop Belastingschulden

Lawmaker Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about a blacklist report from the Stichting Afkoop Belastingschulden concerning the Belastingdienst Rivierenland and the ministry, including its handling, long-running disputes and whether similar cases warrant investigation. The State Secretary confirmed receipt of the report, declined substantive comment on individual cases citing tax secrecy, noted that the related proceedings had ended in final rulings, and declined to launch an investigation into comparable long-running cases.
In view of the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and article 67 of the Collection Act 1990, no substantive statements can be made about individual cases.

Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en artikel 67 van de Invorderingswet 1990 kunnen geen inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een Eurocommissaris die wordt benaderd door de energielobby waar hij zelf aandelen in bezit

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether an EU Commissioner's shareholdings in an energy company that lobbies the Commission, and similar holdings of the High Representative, are compatible with the Commission's ethics code and whether the Dutch government will act with the Ombudsman. The minister answers that the declarations were reviewed by the European Parliament's JURI committee, that the Commission President and the independent ethics committee oversee compliance, and that the government trusts they act where needed.

The government trusts that the President of the European Commission, assisted by the independent ethics committee, oversees compliance with this code of conduct for the members of the European Commission.

Het kabinet vertrouwt erop dat de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie, bijgestaan door het onafhankelijk ethisch comité, toeziet op naleving van deze gedragscode voor de leden van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsgeld van de Wereldbank deels bij belastingparadijzen belandt

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether World Bank aid to 22 highly aid-dependent countries is leaking to tax havens, how widespread this is, which countries and elites are involved, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledges concern, notes the study is preliminary and not causal, describes Dutch and World Bank anti-corruption measures, and says the findings will be used to push for stronger action, without announcing a policy change.
It does not lend itself to drawing conclusions about individual countries, specific persons or bilateral aid flows.
Het leent zich niet om conclusies te trekken over individuele landen, specifieke personen of bilaterale hulpstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Weyenberg over een overzicht van aftrekposten, grondslagversmallers en belastingregelingen in de vennootschapsbelasting

MPs Leijten and Van Weyenberg asked why the liquidation loss scheme is not listed among tax arrangements and whether the Chamber will get a full list of provisions that reduce the corporate tax base. The state secretary provided a 2017 corporate tax base overview, explaining that the Miljoenennota list covers only non-primary-structure items, and committed to consider regular updates.
The overview omits banks and the gas sector because publishing their tax base figures could lead to identifiable information.
In het overzicht zijn de banken en de gassector weggelaten omdat publicatie van de grondslagbedragen bij deze specifieke sectoren kan leiden tot herleidbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten inzake CAF onderzoeken bij de inkomstenbelasting

SP MP Leijten asked about the CAF (Commissie Afzonderlijk Fiscaal?) fraud investigations at the tax authority, including the Hoorn case of tax consultants accused of systemic fraud, the reversed burden of proof, algorithmic risk selection, and remedies for consultants. The state secretary declined to discuss individual cases citing confidentiality, explained that risk signals are only starting points and are checked by staff, noted civil and criminal remedies and the 2019 algorithm oversight report, but did not commit to new measures.
Due to the confidentiality obligation in article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot address the specific circumstances of individual cases.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de concrete omstandigheden van specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Futselaar over nieuwe berichten van belangenverstrengeling en corruptie in het falende Europese Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

MPs Leijten and Futselaar asked whether EU agricultural subsidies enabled fraud and oligarch enrichment, citing reports on Czech PM Babiš and Italian mafia fraud, and whether the CAP should be cut and capped. The minister called the allegations serious, said the Commission should investigate, declined to comment on individual cases, denied that CAP subsidies destroyed markets for small farmers, and said the Netherlands favours a smaller MFF and a cap on support per farm.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases under ongoing investigation.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen waarnaar onderzoek nog lopende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de CAF-11 gedupeerden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the settlement of compensation for CAF-11 parents wrongly cut off from childcare allowance, including how many have claimed extra compensation, how the independent expert commission operates, and why a CAF list was withheld under Wob requests. The government answered that 77 parents had submitted documents for extra compensation, that the commission's advice was followed, that the promised February 2020 settlement would slip, and that the list was not yet in existence when earlier Wob requests were filed.
This commitment will not be met. I aim for swift completion but also want to take into account the final advice of the Advisory Committee on Benefits Implementation and the ADR report.
Deze toezegging wordt niet gehaald. Ik streef naar spoedige afronding maar wil hier ook het eindadvies van de Adviescommissie uitvoering toeslagen en het rapport van de ADR bij betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de teruggekeerde belastingdienstmedewerkers die met de vertrekregeling waren vertrokken

An SP MP asked how former Tax Authority staff who left under the departure scheme were rehired, whether they repaid the premium, and how re-entry is prevented. The State Secretary answered that two former staff were rehired as regular civil servants and three were hired as temporary workers, that repayment rules did not apply because re-hiring occurred after the premium months had passed, and that monthly controls were tightened.
At a check at the end of April 2019 it was found that three employees who had used the departure scheme had been hired as temporary or agency workers.
Bij een controle eind april 2019 is vastgesteld dat drie medewerkers als inhuur- of uitzendkracht zijn ingehuurd die gebruik hadden gemaakt van de vertrekregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Nederland een belastingparadijs is voor organisaties die een «algemeen nut» dienen, omdat ze moeilijk te controleren zijn

An MP asked why many ANBI charities fail legal requirements, such as publishing annual accounts, and why the Tax Authority does not enforce this more strictly. The State Secretary answered that oversight is risk-based and resources are limited, that non-compliance does not automatically mean loss of ANBI status, and that a central portal is a possible future ICT addition.
Failing to meet the publication obligation also does not directly lead to revocation.
Het niet voldoen aan de publicatieplicht leidt ook niet direct tot een intrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het bericht dat de huidige Voorzitter van de Raad van de Europese Unie wordt gesponsord door de gaslobby

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the Croatian EU Council presidency accepting corporate sponsorship, including from oil company INA, is acceptable, and how this relates to the EU Ombudsman's call for strict rules and to the Green Deal. Minister Blok replied that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable, that the Council will respond to the Ombudsman's recommendations by 6 April 2020, and that the Dutch aim is guidelines similar to those of the Dutch 2016 presidency.
The cabinet is of the view that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat sponsoring in beginsel niet ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het nog zeker een jaar gaat duren tot de toeslagenaffaire is opgelost

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the childcare benefits (toeslagen) affair could take another year to resolve, and about compensation, verjaring, case handling and how ministry contact with affected parents was arranged. The government answered that files will be handled step by step with speed and care, promised a progress letter after the Donner and ADR reports, and said the ministry did not steer parents' contact with the media.
I undertake to send your House a progress letter to this group of parents after the final Donner Commission report, the ADR report and the cabinet's response to them.
Ik zeg uw Kamer toe aan deze groep ouders, na het uitkomen van het eindrapport van de Commissie Donner het rapport van de ADR en de kabinetsreactie daarop, een voortgangsbrief te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de aankoop van Maltese paspoorten door spionnen, fraudeurs, mensenhandelaren en belastingontduikers

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government shares concern that Maltese passports sold to investors have gone to suspected criminals and spies, and whether it will press Malta on its vetting. The government said it finds such passport sales undesirable, relies on Malta's due diligence checks, and will pursue dialogue at EU level once the Commission's expected 2020 report is published.
The government shares that concern and considers the so-called sale of passports, whereby a third-country national can also obtain EU citizenship, an undesirable form of naturalisation.
Het kabinet deelt die zorg en acht het zogenoemd verkopen van paspoorten, waardoor een derdelander ook het EU-burgerschap kan verkrijgen, een onwenselijke wijze van naturalisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over de actieve promotie van de controversiële paspoortprofessor Kochenov door de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Two SP MPs asked the Education Minister why Groningen University had not yet started its investigation into possible conflicts of interest by professor Kochenov and why it actively promoted his work. The minister answered that the external investigation had begun, that quality takes precedence over speed, that the university's publicity choices are its own responsibility, and that the government is awaiting the report and the Inspectorate's assessment before acting.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the investigation and the Inspectorate's assessment of this investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en het oordeel van de inspectie over dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen voor AOW-gerechtigden

MP Leijten asked whether the VNG's municipal tax-remission norms for AOW pensioners are adequate, given that the maximum norm can fall below the single AOW benefit, and whether the VNG and municipalities should be pressed to change them. Minister Knops answers that the norms follow national rules, municipalities have discretion and may set the maximum at 100% of AOW plus a fixed amount, and that the norms will be considered in the local tax review, with consultation if warranted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het door laten gaan van loonbeslag bij onterecht als fraudeur aangemerkte ouders en het verstrekken van opgevraagde gegevens aan deze ouders

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether debt collection and wage garnishment against parents wrongly labelled as fraudsters has really stopped, and whether affected parents can inspect their files by phone. The State Secretary answers that a pause applies to most collection measures, that parents who have requested files will receive them, that remaining garnishments should be reported to the Belastingtelefoon, and that objections are granted case by case rather than categorically.
I also responded to the Finance Committee's request to give parents access to their files in my letter of 29 November.
Ook op het verzoek van de commissie van Financiën om ouders inzage te geven in hun dossiers ben ik in mijn brief van 29 november jl. ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het zonder waarschuwing incasseren van een openstaande toeslagschuld

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether it is normal that a missed payment within two weeks under a debt arrangement for a childcare-benefit debt triggers payment of the full outstanding amount, and how this fits with incasso policy. The state secretary answered that a reminder is sent first, that the procedure has applied since 2005, that about 212,000 cases were cancelled in 2018, and that personal payment arrangements remain available, while promising to reconsider policy on intent or gross negligence.
Only if that request is not met and no other response follows the payment reminder is the payment arrangement withdrawn, after which the citizen must pay the outstanding amount in one go.

Pas als niet aan dat verzoek wordt voldaan en op de betalingsherinnering evenmin een andere reactie is gevolgd, wordt de betalingsregeling ingetrokken waarna de burger gehouden is het openstaande bedrag in één keer te betalen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Leijten over “ambtenaren die deelnemen aan belastingcommissies van lobbyclubs van buitenlandse bedrijven”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether civil servants should sit on tax committees of foreign business lobby groups such as AmCham, and whether NFIA staff participation creates conflict of interest and loss of role clarity. The minister answered that participation as a listening observer (toehoorder) is justified for signal-gathering and network building, that the NFIA has no membership except a French chamber corporate membership, and declined to publish meeting records or systematic participation data.
It is not for me to make the points raised in such consultations public.
Het is niet aan mij om ingebrachte punten uit dergelijke overleggen naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de veroordeling van Catalaanse politici en protestleiders

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the convictions of nine Catalan politicians and protest leaders, whether they comply with ECHR freedoms of expression and assembly, and whether the Netherlands will raise the matter with Spain. The minister replied that the case is an internal Spanish matter, that Spain is a strong democratic rule-of-law state bound by the ECHR, and that there is no reason for the Netherlands to intervene.
In my view there is therefore no reason for the Netherlands to get involved in this case.
Naar mijn oordeel is er daarom geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich in deze zaak te mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bisschop over het bericht dat de EU honderden miljarden Euro’s niet uitgegeven krijgt

Two MPs (Leijten, Bisschop) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that about 300 billion euro of EU commitments remains unspent, questioning the MFF's goal-driven design, decommitment, audit efficiency findings and administrative costs. The minister answered that the RAL reflects multiannual investment timing, that Nederland seeks a smaller MFF with stricter decommitment and efficiency focus, and that the surplus mechanism returns unspent funds to member states.
To prevent this in 2021–2027, the Netherlands is working for stricter decommitment rules and lower pre-financing percentages.
Om dit in 2021–2027 te voorkomen zet Nederland zich in voor strengere decommitteringsbepalingen en lagere voorfinancieringspercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de honderden miljoenen euro's aan lobbyuitgaven van olie- en gasgiganten

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the government accepts a Corporate Europe Observatory finding that oil and gas lobbying spent over 251 million euro to slow EU climate targets, and whether it will hold Shell and others to account and limit their influence on climate policy. The minister said the figures are not known to the government, that the government does not track individual firms' lobbying, that companies may pursue their interests within the rule of law, and that the Klimaatakkoord deliberately involves industry alongside other stakeholders.
All parties are always free to pursue their interests as long as this stays within the bounds of the rule of law.
Het staat alle partijen altijd vrij hun belangen te behartigen zolang dit binnen de grenzen van de rechtstaat past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het afwijzen van kinderopvangtoeslag omdat de toeslagpartner dagbesteding heeft

An SP MP asks why childcare benefit was refused to a working mother whose partner attends daytime care, and whether this matches the law's aim of supporting work and care. The state secretary declines to comment on the individual case, says daytime care is not a statutory ground for the benefit, and points to municipal social-medical indication as the route, while planning a separate entitlement only for households where a partner has a Wlz indication.
As your House knows, for reasons of privacy I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik uit het oogpunt van privacy niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over het afkondigde onderzoek naar hoogleraar Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Two SP MPs asked whether the Groningen university's investigation into professor Kochenov over EU passport-sale advisory work is justified, and why the university had not investigated conflicts of interest earlier. The minister supports the university's independent inquiry, says it will be led by an external chair and checked against the integrity code and secondary-employment rules, and says the Inspectorate will assess its findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and any conflict of interest, and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de oud-bestuurders van PrivaZorg ruim 14 miljoen zorggeld uit de zorginstelling hebben gesluisd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Health Minister and the State Secretary of Finance about reports that former PrivaZorg directors siphoned over 14 million euro of care funds through a complex corporate structure, and whether the IGJ, NZa, Tax Service and prosecutors should have acted earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ found no proven unlawful conduct within current legal frameworks, that the agencies lack sufficient powers over governance and integrity, and that new legislation on integrity, supervision and dividend conditions is being prepared.

The IGJ and NZa have previously indicated that they still have insufficient powers to investigate integrity and professional business operations, conflicts of interest, siphoning off care funds and setting up complex inefficient corporate structures.

De IGJ en de NZa hebben eerder aangegeven dat ze nog onvoldoende bevoegdheden hebben om onderzoek te doen naar integere en professionele bedrijfsvoering, belangenverstrengeling, wegsluizen van zorggelden en het optuigen van complexe ondoelmatige bedrijfsstructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Brexit-ultimatum van de Franse president Macron en de Finse minister-president Rinne

MP Leijten asked whether the Brexit deadline set by Macron and Rinne reflected an EU Council position, whether such unilateral ultimatums help an orderly Brexit, and when the government was informed. The minister answered that the government does not recognise the media's 'ultimatum' framing, that no official French or EU deadline beyond 31 October 2019 was set, and that the UK was urged to present realistic proposals quickly.
The cabinet does not recognise the media reporting of 18 September about an 'ultimatum' and the alleged breaking of EU27 unity.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in de mediaberichtgeving op 18 september over een «ultimatum» en het vermeende doorbreken van de eenheid van de EU27.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling door de overstap van de directeur van de Europese Bankenautoriteit (EBA) naar een financiële lobbyclub

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister whether the move of the EBA executive director to the lobby group AFME creates conflicts of interest, and about AFME membership, lobbying and Eurofi attendance. The minister answers that EBA staff are bound by confidentiality and a two-year cooling-off period, that the director is barred from lobbying and advising AFME for set periods, and that the ministry keeps no overview of financial-sector lobby organisations.
To counter (the appearance of) conflicts of interest, the EBA runs an active integrity policy and is transparent about its contact with stakeholders.
Om (de schijn van) belangenverstrengeling tegen te gaan voert de EBA een actief integriteitsbeleid 3 en is zij transparant over het contact met stakeholders 4 .
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Leijten over het Brexit-ultimatum van de Franse president en de Finse minister-president. D

An MP asks the government about the reported Brexit ultimatum by Macron and Rinne to the UK, whether it was agreed with the EU, and how it fits with the Dutch aim of avoiding no-deal. The minister replies that no EU deadline beyond 31 October exists, that the UK must present concrete proposals in time, and that the Netherlands still prefers an orderly withdrawal.
Neither the European Council (Article 50) nor the European Commission has adopted an EU position on a deadline other than 31 October.
Er is noch door de ER Artikel 50, noch door de Europese Commissie een EU-standpunt over een deadline ingenomen, anders dan die van 31 oktober

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verwachting dat meer ouders te maken hebben gehad met onterechte stopzetting van kinderopvangtoeslag dan eerder gedacht en het onderzoek naar andere CAF-onderzoeken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Auditdienst Rijk investigation into other CAF cases took about four months to commission, whether the child care allowance stoppages were unlawful, who ordered them, and what happens to affected parents. The State Secretary answered that preparatory work and a broader ADR investigation took time, that the ADR will examine whether similar stoppages occurred in other CAF cases, and that the matter of who gave the orders and the individual cases remain under investigation or are not discussed.
I cannot rule out that this approach was also applied in other allowance-related CAF cases to a large number of persons at the same time.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat deze handelwijze ook in andere toeslaggerelateerde CAF-zaken bij een groot aantal personen tegelijk is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de informatie die de regering gaf over de CAF-11 zaak aan de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked whether the government told the National Ombudsman that all 235 parents affected by the CAF-11 childcare benefit case were clients of the childcare agency Dadim in 2014, and whether this misled the Ombudsman into closing his inquiry. The State Secretary confirmed the 235 figure was communicated, said only about 200 were linked to Dadim, and maintained the Ombudsman said the exact number did not affect his conclusions.
Toeslagen informed me upon request that approximately 200 of these 235 parents were affiliated with the childcare agency concerned.
Toeslagen heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat circa 200 van deze 235 vraagouders waren aangesloten bij het betrokken gastouderbureau.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een ambtenaar die een stuk van het onderzoek van de EDP-auditors uit het concept-verslag van onafhankelijke onderzoekers verwijderde met het oog op het eventueel mo

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance why a civil servant removed the authorisation part of the EDP auditors' draft report on the CAF 11 childcare benefits affair, and whether this was consistent with independent investigation and prior commitments to parliament. The State Secretary answered that the authorisation investigation was dropped from the assignment in agreement with the auditors because it would add little value, that no content was removed from the draft report itself, and that the relevant Wob documents have been released.
So nothing was removed from the draft investigation.
Er is dus niets weggehaald uit het concept-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de sponsoring van EU-voorzitters door bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether it is acceptable that Finland's EU Council presidency is sponsored by BMW, given an ongoing Commission cartel investigation, and whether sponsorship by such firms is undesirable. The minister replied that each presidency decides how to handle sponsorship, that the Commission investigation is ongoing, and that the government does not consider sponsorship in principle undesirable, pointing to 2016 Dutch presidency criteria that excluded firms involved in unlawful activities.
Each member state has the responsibility and room to organise its presidency itself.
Elke lidstaat heeft de verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om het voorzitterschap zelf in te kleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het niet bijhouden van documentatie met lobbygesprekken door voormalig secretaris-generaal van de Europese Commissie de heer Martin Selmayr

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether it is problematic that former Commission Secretary-General Selmayr kept no formal records of lobby meetings, and whether the Commission and the interinstitutional mandatory lobby register should be pushed for more transparency. The minister replies that transparency rules are for the EU institutions themselves, that the Secretary-General falls outside the Commission's disclosure rules, and that the Netherlands prioritises restarting the stalled register negotiations and getting the Council to join.
It is up to the institutions to set internal agreements, and to supervise compliance with them, regarding the recording of interactions with interest representatives.
Het is aan de instellingen om interne afspraken vast te stellen, en toe te zien op de naleving ervan, ten aanzien van verslaglegging van interacties met belangenvertegenwoordigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat het witwasbeleid van ABN Amro volgens de toezichthouder faalt

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB found ABN Amro's anti-money-laundering policy deficient and ordered a re-screening of retail clients, and asked why DNB's instruments and the bank's treatment differ from ING's settlement. The minister answered that DNB cannot disclose supervisory-confidential directions or specific measures against ABN Amro, that enforcement responsibility lies with DNB and the Public Prosecution Service, and that he expects banks to comply and reports DNB's annual oversight accountability.
DNB itself cannot make public information about directions because it concerns supervisory-confidential information.
DNB kan zelf geen informatie naar buiten brengen over aanwijzingen omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de inspanningen van de Belastingdienst om bij te dragen aan het bestrijden van georganiseerde criminaliteit en het afpakken van misdaadgeld

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked about the Tax Authority's contribution to fighting organised crime and seizing criminal proceeds, including why its EUR 7 million funding request from the Ondermijningsfonds was not honoured and whether regions can set their own priorities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the request was declined due to uncertainty over a pilot, that Tax Authority priorities are set nationally within regional LIEC/RIEC structures, that extra structural funding is planned with details due on Prinsjesdag, and that asset-seizure ambitions are being pursued jointly with the Public Prosecution Service.
Given the operational nature of the spending proposals submitted by the other partners, I will not make the reinforcement plans public.
Gezien de operationele aard van de bestedingsvoorstellen die door de overige partners zijn ingediend zal ik de versterkingsplannen niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de kandidatuur van oud-minister Dijsselbloem als directeur van het IMF

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister how the cabinet chose and backed former minister Dijsselbloem as IMF managing director candidate, including the selection process, lobbying, MPs' contact and the cost of his travel. The minister answered that the decision was made in July, the process was intensive but confidential so no full overview is given, and the candidacy was not publicly discussed to protect its chances.
Given the number of conversations and their confidential nature, no overview can be provided of the conversations that took place.
Gezien het aantal gesprekken en het vertrouwelijke karakter kan geen overzicht geven worden van de gesprekken die hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Lodders over het bericht dat de Kamerbrief over letselschade foute cijfers bevat

Two MPs (Leijten, SP and Lodders, VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance why figures in a letter on personal injury compensation in the wealth tax were questioned, how injury experts were involved, whether clarity can be given quickly, and whether the debate affects the decision on counting injury compensation as own assets. The State Secretary refers to a reply letter on the motion and does not answer the questions in the text itself.

The written questions from MPs Leijten (SP) and Lodders (VVD), question number 2019Z150123, have been answered by means of the letters 'Response to the motion by MPs Leijten and Lodders on personal injury compensation'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Lodders (VVD), vraagnummer 2019Z150123 , zijn beantwoord middels de brieven «Reactie op de motie van de leden Leijten en Lodders over letselschadevergoedingen» (Kamerstuk 35 026, nrs.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitblijven van verzoeken en vragen van Kamerleden over achtergrond en aanleiding van het onderzoek naar vermeende fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag en het onterecht stopzetten

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the government withheld documents and information about the CAF 11 childcare benefit fraud investigation and the wrongful termination of childcare benefits for hundreds of parents, including who commissioned the EDP-auditors' follow-up work, the reasons for deeper investigation, and the completeness of parents' files. The State Secretary answered that the auditors' follow-up was chosen in consultation with the ministry without restriction, that internal deliberation documents are not made public by policy, that the tax authority's CAF information management was inadequate, and that he regrets the harm to families and will work to restore trust, while declining to comment on individual officials or cases.
It is standing government policy not to make documents drawn up for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld ten behoeve van intern beraad geen onderwerp van politiek debat te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep van burgemeesters meer te investeren in de handhavingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the government would respond to mayors' calls for more Tax Authority capacity to fight organised crime, and what it would concretely do to prevent a capacity shortfall. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Tax Authority commits a substantial share of capacity to the integrated approach, that the requested extra funding for its enforcement bid was not granted, but that €1 million (2019) and €0.85 million (2020 onward) go to analysis capacity and a further increase of about €29 million structurally was decided.
The Tax Authority cannot currently always make the requested contribution.
De Belastingdienst kan op dit moment niet altijd de gevraagde bijdrage leveren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Snels over ouders die met de staatssecretaris in gesprek gaan over de problemen in het kader van CAF-11 (Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators 11), waarover de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Snels asked the State Secretary of Finance, in written questions, about the childcare benefit (CAF-11) problems, the individual talks with affected parents, whether parents can bring an advisor, whether talk reports will be shared, and safeguards such as full file access, representation and time to consider offers. The State Secretary answered that parents may bring someone, that talk notes will not be shared given their personal nature but a summary will be provided, and that parents get file access and may be represented, while the advisory commission was asked to advise on time to consider offers and confidentiality clauses.
Given the personal nature of the conversations, I do not consider it appropriate to share the verbatim notes with your House.
Gezien het persoonlijke karakter van de gesprekken vind ik het niet gepast om de woordelijke notities met uw Kamer te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geheime gesprekken van de Europese Commissie met voormalig premier van het Verenigd Koninkrijk de heer Blair en de heer George Soros over een tweede Brexit-referendum

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported secret meetings of Commissioner Moscovici with Tony Blair and George Soros on a second Brexit referendum, and about the Commission's non-publication of such meetings and absence of minutes. The minister answered that the Commission decides whom its members meet, that the Brexit mandate is unaffected, that the Commission's publication decision falls within its own exceptions, and that the Commission is responsible for its own transparency, while noting the lobby register proposal was stalled but the Netherlands would push for it in the next legislature.
It is up to the European Commission itself to weigh whom Commissioners do or do not speak with.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie zelf om de afweging te maken met wie Eurocommissarissen wel of niet spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlandse bedrijven Europese partijen sponsoren

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether buying influence over parties through foreign corporate donations and Dutch shell companies is undesirable, and what the government will do to make European party financing more transparent and block corporate funding. The minister agrees buying influence is undesirable, announces a bill banning non-EU donations to Dutch parties, and says EU-level changes to Regulation 1141/2014 can only come via the scheduled 2021 review.

Given the increased risk of foreign influence, the cabinet will, in addition to the existing transparency rules in the Wfpp, prohibit donations from outside the EU (except from Dutch voters residing abroad) and require full transparency for donations from other EU countries.
Gelet op het toegenomen risico van buitenlandse beïnvloeding zal het kabinet in aanvulling op de bestaande transparantieregels in de Wfpp giften van buiten de EU verbieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de wederom gesponsorde Koningsdagborrel van de ambassade in Brussel, ook wel de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging genoemd

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how sponsors such as Sabic, ING, and Shell were selected for the Koningsdag reception at the Permanent Representation in Brussels, whether a Saudi state-linked sponsor was appropriate after the Khashoggi killing, and why sponsors are not publicly listed. The minister replied that sponsorship follows integrity rules on impartiality and conflict of interest, that sponsor amounts are modest and kept confidential, and that no central register or ban on sponsorship is planned.
Because the companies that made a sponsorship contribution did not expect their individual contribution to be made public, I prefer to treat these contributions confidentially.

Omdat de bedrijven die een sponsorbijdrage hebben gedaan er niet van uitgingen dat hun afzonderlijke bijdrage publiek zou worden gemaakt, geef ik er de voorkeur aan deze bijdragen vertrouwelijk te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het herstarten van het recht op toeslagen door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen

An SP MP asked whether the Belastingdienst's errors in restarting the kindgebonden budget also affect other allowances, how the omission of the automatic restart was discovered, and how many people lose benefits when income rises. The State Secretary answered that other allowances are not affected because they require an application, that the omission surfaced during policy and implementation analyses, and that roughly 250,000 people lose the healthcare allowance and 100,000 the rent allowance yearly due to income rises.
No, the errors made do not apply to other allowances.
Nee, de gemaakte fouten gelden niet voor andere toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over vorderingen van de Belastingdienst inzake schadevergoedingen gaswinningsschade

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority taxes part of earthquake damage compensation paid to entrepreneurs and households, and whether this is fair. The minister answered that compensation for lost business income is taxed as business profit while costs of repair can be deducted, that damage compensation for private persons is generally not taxed except via box 3 wealth, and that no separate fiscal policy is planned.
I cannot respond substantively to a situation that is not described in more detail.
Ik kan niet inhoudelijk reageren op een niet nader beschreven situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de extra tonnen voor de vertrekregeling van de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance when he learned of extra costs for the Tax Authority's departure scheme, why Parliament was not informed of pending court appeals, which claims remain open, and how the costs are covered. The State Secretary answered that court rulings in late 2018 and early 2019 were known, that the financial stake is about one million euros across roughly ten ongoing cases, that Parliament was not informed given the limited stake, and that costs are absorbed within the Tax Authority's budget.
Given the relatively limited financial stake of the procedures for the employer compared with the total financial size of the departure scheme, there was no reason for me to inform your House.

Gezien het voor de werkgever relatief beperkte financiële belang van de procedures afgezet tegen de gehele financiële omvang van de vertrekregeling, was er voor mij geen aanleiding om uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het effectieve belastingtarief op multinationals

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary of Finance to respond to a report showing Dutch effective corporate tax rates for multinationals are among the EU's lowest, and questions the fairness, the revenue loss, the planned cut in the corporate tax rate, and whether the Netherlands is a tax haven. The State Secretary disputes the effective-rate methodology, argues the statutory rate says little about effective rates, says no study of revenue loss is warranted, rejects reconsidering the rate cut, and rejects the tax-haven label while proposing a conditional withholding tax on interest and royalties.
No, I do not acknowledge that.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de staat van de rechtsstaat op Malta

Leijten (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the rule of law in Malta, including the murder investigation into journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, the Venice Commission's criticism, attempts to remove Pieter Omtzigt as PACE rapporteur, and the prime minister's concentration of power. Minister Blok answered that the rule of law and the murder case were raised with Malta, that the Venice Commission report will be followed up by Malta, and that the government does not see reason to put the conclusions on the General Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to put the conclusions on the agenda of the General Affairs Council at this time.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen reden de conclusies op dit moment op de agenda van de Raad Algemene Zaken te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het “gouden visa” een bedreiging vormen voor de interne veiligheid van de Europese Unie

An MP asked the government about reports that Spain's golden visa scheme poses money-laundering and EU internal security risks, and whether national citizenship-by-investment schemes should be restricted. The state secretary answered that member states decide on their own visa and nationality rules, that the Netherlands has no scheme selling passports for money, and that the government will await the Commission's proposals while stressing EU anti-money-laundering rules.
The Netherlands has no scheme under which passports are granted to people who bring 'sufficient money' to be admitted to Dutch nationality.
Nederland kent geen regeling waarbij paspoorten worden verstrekt aan mensen die «voldoende geld» meebrengen om toegelaten te worden tot het Nederlanderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Futselaar over het bericht dat een Oekraïense kippenmiljardair het meest profiteert van het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement lets Ukrainian poultry imports undercut Dutch producers through lower standards, state aid and EU loans to MHP, and whether the agreement should be evaluated. The ministers answered that imports must meet EU health and safety rules, that the Commission monitors implementation and is closing a tariff loophole, that the state aid cannot yet be judged compatible, and that the Netherlands opposed the EBRD loans.
Periodic evaluation of association agreements is therefore necessary to keep a finger on the pulse and to be able to intervene if needed.
Periodieke evaluatie van associatieakkoorden is daarom nodig om de vinger aan de pols te houden en in te kunnen grijpen als dit nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Nederlandse lijst van laagbelastende landen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch list of low-tax jurisdictions: the corporate tax rates of the 21 listed countries, the money flows to them, rulings, effective tax rates, treaties and CFC/withholding measures. The government answered in detail, largely explaining that country-level data is limited, that the list uses statutory rates, and committing to stop issuing rulings for listed-country entities from 1 July 2019 and to renegotiate treaties.
I do not have an exact breakdown of this flow across the different countries.
Ik beschik niet over een nauwkeurige verdeling van deze stroom over de verschillende landen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de activiteiten van lobbyplatform Eurofi en de deelname van Nederlandse toezichthouders en overheid aan die activiteiten

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister whether it is concerning that Eurofi, a platform with paying financial-sector members, lobbies, whether civil servants and officials attending its conferences is desirable, who decides on attendance, and why the ministry stopped Holland Financial Centre but continues attending Eurofi. The minister answers that Eurofi members are financial institutions, that the ministry bears its own travel costs, that attendance is weighed case by case and useful for diverse views, that no overview of attendance exists within the ministry, and that he sees no reason to refrain from attending or to urge others to do so.
There is no overview of this within the ministry.
Hier is geen overzicht van binnen het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over brievenbusfirma’s van internationale wapenbedrijven in Nederland

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether nuclear weapons-linked arms firms should be allowed to settle in the Netherlands for tax reasons, obtain tax rulings, and face extra taxation, and whether the government would act on arms sales to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that it opposes tax-motivated settlement, rejects a special tax or exclusion for arms firms, notes no commercial firm produces nuclear weapons, and stresses its strict export controls.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de koopkrachtplaatjes van middeninkomens niet kloppen

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the purchasing-power projections for middle incomes are accurate, given claims that middle-income households gain little from economic recovery, and asked about income trends, wage growth and government action. The government rejects the criticism, says the projections are the best available estimates, and attributes weak income growth mainly to taxes, premiums and slow wage growth linked to productivity, while promising further study of productivity without committing to a concrete new step.
I do not share the view of Mr Castelein.
Ik deel de mening van de heer Castelein niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Frans-Duitse voorstel over de architectuur van een eurozonebegroting

An SP MP asks Finance Minister Hoekstra why the Netherlands opposes the Franco-German eurozone budget proposal, what his 'not immediately opposed' stance means, whether he will keep Dutch opposition in talks, and whether he agrees a eurozone budget is part of a transfer union. The minister answers that the cabinet opposes a stabilisation function and any new own resource, that the mandate covers only a convergence and competitiveness instrument within the EU27 budget under strict conditions, and that Dutch opposition to stabilisation was stated clearly in bilateral meetings.
For the Netherlands it was and is important that no mandate was given to develop an instrument for stabilisation.
Voor Nederland was en is van belang dat er geen mandaat werd gegeven om een instrument uit te werken voor stabilisatie

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het witwassen van miljarden euro’s door criminelen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about estimates that some 16 billion euros is laundered yearly in the Netherlands, and whether banks can keep criminal money out, including the ING Curaçao transactions. The minister acknowledged the scale, pointed to DNB's supervision and deficiencies at banks, listed ongoing anti-money-laundering legislation and EU initiatives, and promised an integral policy response in Q1 2019.
It has already been promised to the House that an integral policy response will be sent in the first quarter of 2019.
Aan uw Kamer is reeds toegezegd dat een integrale beleidsreactie in het eerste kwartaal van 2019 zal worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ontslagen medewerkers van de Belastingdienst vanwege fraude

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the 15 Tax Administration employees dismissed for fraud were discovered, whether prosecution follows, how referrals to prosecutors work, and how recruitment and integrity screening are handled. The answer reports 16 dismissals for 2017-2018, explains that tax inspectors, not the employer, refer possible offences to Justice under the AAFD protocol, that the employer has no registry of such cases, and that 20 investigations were ongoing as of 1 November 2018.

For that reason, the Tax Administration as employer does not know how many cases involving non-compliance with tax obligations by its employees have been discussed with the Public Prosecution Service.

Er is om die reden bij de Belastingdienst als werkgever niet bekend hoeveel zaken met het OM besproken zijn, waarbij sprake is van het niet nakomen van fiscale verplichtingen door de belastingdienstmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Wet Bronbelasting 2020

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch conditional withholding tax (Wet Bronbelasting 2020), including its threshold based on statutory rather than effective tax rates, its limitation to related parties, its interaction with EU law and tax treaties, and the substance requirements. The State Secretary defended the design as a robust anti-avoidance measure constrained by EU law and enforceability, and was reluctant to tighten substance requirements further.
I am not in principle opposed to such open norms.
Ik ben niet op voorhand een tegenstander van dergelijke open normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het anonimiseren van vermogen via een commanditaire vennootschap (cv)

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority stopped giving advance agreements on commanditaire vennootschap (cv) structures used to anonymise wealth, and related questions on case law, business-activity tests, beheersverbod, stichtingen and whether such structures are still used. The State Secretary answered that the 2015 fourth anti-money-laundering directive led to ending advance certainty, that existing rulings cannot be revised, that the Tax Authority still grants mandatory share-merger rulings which may allow such structures, and that the tax treatment rules are as set out in case law.
The Tax Authority has not kept track of how often advance consultation on this subject took place in the past.
De Belastingdienst heeft niet bijgehouden hoe vaak in het verleden vooroverleg over dit onderwerp heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over witwaspraktijken van Europese banken

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about money-laundering through Danske Bank and European banks, the supervision of anti-money-laundering rules in Denmark and the Netherlands, and whether the ING settlement and fine would be enough. The minister answered that the facts of the Danske case are not yet known, that DNB and AFM supervise under the Wwft, that ING's profits were disgorged, and that DNB and AFM's independence limits his involvement in individual cases.
As Minister of Finance I do not intervene in individual cases, but I do have regular contact with DNB to assess whether the supervisory system as a whole functions properly.
Als Minister van Financiën treed ik niet in individuele zaken 9 maar heb ik wel regulier contact met DNB om te bezien of het toezichtsysteem als geheel (d.w.z.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Nijboer over het contact met en advies van de Europese Commissie aangaande de vraag of woningbouwcorporaties onder de werking van de antibelastingontwijkingsrichtlijn ATAD1 vall

MPs Leijten and Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance for an overview of all contacts with the European Commission on whether housing associations fall under ATAD1, how the government lobbied for an exemption and the budgetary consequences, and for the advice and the government's request to be sent to the House. The State Secretary referred to a letter of 12 November 2018 for the correspondence, stated that an exemption would carry real state-aid risks, and gave a budgetary loss table (EUR 102m in 2019 rising to 193m in 2021, structural 353m).
For answering these questions I refer to my letter of 12 November.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief van 12 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Leijten over het bericht dat lidstaten EU-miljarden niet op krijgen

MPs Bisschop and Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about reports that member states are not drawing down EU structural funds, with only 16% spent by end-2017 and large sums unspent, and asked about complexity, co-financing, OLAF referrals, unspent budgets, and reforms for the 2021-2027 MFF. The minister confirmed the low spending rate but argued unspent funds are committed to projects, defended national co-financing, declined to disclose OLAF referrals, and said the government favours simplification, a budget cut, and publishing Annual Control Reports.
The cabinet has no insight into the reports the European Court of Auditors made to OLAF regarding suspicious transactions.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de meldingen die de Europese Rekenkamer aan OLAF heeft gedaan met betrekking tot verdachte transacties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat farmaceuten belasting ontwijken via Nederland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms such as Abbott, Johnson & Johnson, Merck and Pfizer use the Netherlands to avoid tax and whether the government will investigate this. The State Secretary of Finance answered that he cannot discuss individual companies' tax affairs, pointed to the government's anti-avoidance measures (CFC rule, conditional withholding tax, EU directives) and said no separate investigation into pharmaceutical firms is planned, though the effects of the policy will be monitored.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over bedrijfsovernames en de stakingsgolf bij AkzoNobel

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked about strikes at AkzoNobel over wages and pensions while shareholders receive large payouts, the treatment of employees in the sale of the chemicals division (now Nouryon), tax on capital repayments, and private equity sales of Dutch firms. Minister Wiebes answered that wages and pensions are for social partners, that the Rijnlands governance model and works council rights apply, that the Corporate Governance Code does not bind Nouryon or foreign investors, and that a legislative cooling-off period for listed boards is being prepared.
The cabinet attaches great value to this Rhineland model.
Het kabinet hecht grote waarde aan dit Rijnlandse model.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de reactie vanuit de Europese Commissie, Navo en Europese leiders op de uitslag van het referendum in Macedonië

MP Leijten asks whether the Macedonian referendum on the Prespa agreement was an internal name issue or a vote on EU and NATO membership, and whether EU and NATO reactions and Tusk's pre-referendum video were premature or improper interference.
