The minister replies that the government linked the referendum to future EU and NATO accession, that the vote was consultative so parliament now decides, and that the EU and NATO were simply encouraging participation.
The referendum has thus been linked by the Macedonian government to future EU and NATO accession.
Het referendum is daarmee door de Macedonische regering gekoppeld aan toekomstige EU en NAVO-toetreding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat de Italiaanse bank UniCredito mogelijk ABN AMRO wil overnemen

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch state might sell its ABN AMRO shares, including via NLFI, given reports that UniCredit was interested in acquiring the bank, and how cross-border bank mergers and too-big-to-fail risks would be handled. The minister said he could not say in advance under what circumstances shares would be sold, that any transaction would be assessed when it arose, that he was unaware of other parties' interest, and pointed to existing EU measures on bank supervision, resolution and capital.
I cannot state in advance in which situation I would sell ABN AMRO shares via NLFI, because this could be disadvantageous to the state's position when selling a stake in ABN AMRO.
Ik kan op voorhand niet aangeven in welke situatie ik via NLFI aandelen in ABN AMRO verkoop, omdat dit nadelig kan zijn voor de positie van de staat bij de verkoop van een belang in ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie zich mengt in de opleiding Europese Studies

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the European Commission exerts undue influence over European Studies curricula through Jean Monnet funding and the Tuning project, and whether funding and teaching should be transparent and free of content steering. The minister replied that there are no signals from the accreditation body or inspectorate of threats to academic freedom, that Jean Monnet funding is open to critical perspectives, that Tuning is an autonomous higher-education initiative to which the Commission gave only financial and moral support, and that transparency will be promoted within existing privacy law.
The Netherlands favours maximum transparency and accessibility of information, within the existing (privacy) legislation of course.
Nederland is voorstander van maximale transparantie en toegankelijkheid van informatie, uiteraard binnen de bestaande (privacy)wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat vermogensbeheerders en grootaandeelhouders zich niet laten leiden door de dividendbelasting voor investeringen in Nederlandse bedrijven

MP Leijten asked the government how it reacts to foreign asset managers saying they are not influenced by Dutch dividend tax, whether the abolition is driven by lobbying, and whether anti-avoidance measures and corporate tax cuts are in contradiction. The State Secretary largely rejects the premises, argues the dividend tax does affect returns and investment, defends abolition as serving headquarters and the general interest, and states that anti-avoidance measures are not the reason for abolition.
It is questionable whether the quoted statements from certain asset managers, saying they are not guided by dividend tax, give a representative picture of current and potential investors in general.

Het is de vraag of de geciteerde uitspraken van bepaalde vermogensbeheerders die aangeven dat zij zich niet laten leiden door de dividendbelasting een representatief beeld geven van de huidige en potentiële beleggers in den brede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over vaststellingsovereenkomsten tussen de belastingdienst en multinationals

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the claim that tax settlement agreements can run for 100 years squares with earlier answers saying the longest term is 10 years, and asked about the use, duration and oversight of rulings on dividend access mechanisms with multinationals. The government answers that such agreements are theoretically possible but practically limited by termination on law changes, that APA/ATR rulings run 4 to 5 years (up to 10 in exceptional cases), that many figures are not systematically kept, and that the Commission may request information but such exchanges are confidential.

For rulings with an international character, I earlier committed in answer to your questions of 15 June that I will include a limit of in principle 4 to 5 years, in line with APAs and ATRs, in the announced revision of the ruling practice.

Voor rulings met een internationaal karakter heb ik eerder in antwoord op uw Kamervragen van 15 juni jl. toegezegd dat ik een beperking van de looptijd tot in principe 4 tot 5 jaar conform APA's en ATR's zal meenemen in de door mij aangekondigde herziening van de rulingpraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over het bericht dat visa en paspoorten te koop zijn voor superrijken

An MP asks the government why wealthy non-EU nationals can buy EU residence permits or passports through investor programmes, and whether this undermines citizenship, transparency and anti-money-laundering safeguards. The government answers that each state sets its own nationality rules, transparency and money-laundering checks are the responsibility of member states and the Commission, and it sees no conflict with international law so no further action is planned.
It is up to the member state concerned to establish whether the national legal conditions for issuing a passport have been met and to prevent criminals possibly being facilitated thereby.

Het is aan het desbetreffende land om vast te stellen of aan de nationale (wettelijke) voorwaarden voor verstrekking van een paspoort is voldaan en om te voorkomen dat daardoor mogelijkerwijs criminelen worden gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about banks' strong legal position as secured creditors in insolvency, the disadvantage to other creditors, and whether the balance is still desirable. The Minister answered that the government will discuss the balance with insolvency practitioners within the ongoing faillissementsrecht reform, while defending the current pledge rules and noting that other creditors have their own protections.

Whether the above is still sufficient to keep the positions of the various parties in a bankruptcy in balance, I will discuss with practitioners within the reorganisation pillar of the bankruptcy law revision programme.

Of het voorgaande nog steeds voldoende is om de positie van de verschillende betrokkenen in een faillissement in evenwicht te houden, zal ik in het kader van het laatste wetsvoorstel in de reorganisatiepijler van het wetgevingsprogramma herijking faillissementsrecht bespreken met vertegenwoordigers uit de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de koersval van de Turkse lira

SP MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about the consequences of the Turkish lira's collapse for Dutch and European banks, contagion risk, ING's exposure, causes of the sell-off, the risk of a Turkish bank run, and a possible EU bail-out. Minister Hoekstra answered that exposure is mainly indirect and manageable under prudential rules, attributed the crisis to Turkey's domestic macroeconomic policy, and ruled out an EU bail-out.
It is not for me to speculate on the amount of any possible losses.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over de hoogte van eventuele verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de invloed van accountantskantoren Deloitte, KPMG, EY en PwC op Europees niveau op belastingbeleid en belastingontwijking

Leijten (SP) asked the Finance Minister about the influence of the Big Four accountancy firms on EU tax policy, revolving-door movement between their advisory practice and the European Commission, and EU contracts awarded to them. State Secretary Snel answered that career moves are possible but do not by themselves show lack of integrity, that EU tenders follow transparent rules allowing exclusion of conflicted bidders, and that the government sees no reason to act in Brussels.
I rely on the expertise, independence and integrity of the Commission and on the procedures that counter conflicts of interest and promote transparency.
Ik vertrouw op de deskundigheid, onafhankelijkheid en integriteit van de Commissie en de procedures die belangenverstrengeling tegengaan en transparantie bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het ontslag van klokkenluider Roelie Post bij de Europese Commissie

The SP MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister how he judges the dismissal of whistleblower Roelie Post by the European Commission for unauthorised absence and disloyalty, the loss of unemployment benefits, the Commission's bill for unauthorised absence, and whether he will intervene with Commission President Juncker. The minister replied that Commission staff are governed by the EU Staff Regulations, that it is for the Commission to resolve the dispute, that the cabinet has no mediating role and no details of the dispute, though it would welcome a mutually acceptable solution, and that the EU General Court is competent in such disputes.
For this reason, a mediating role for the cabinet is not obvious.
Voor het kabinet ligt om deze reden geen bemiddelende rol voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het in staatsgezinde handen vallen van een kritische tv-zender in Hongarije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the takeover of Hir-TV in Hungary by pro-government owners, press freedom, the Copenhagen criteria, the Commission's infringement action over the anti-migrant aid law, NGO restrictions, and how the EU and like-minded states should respond. The minister said the government is concerned about shrinking media diversity but does not comment on individual outlets, backed the Venice Commission's criticism of the Soros package, and pointed to ongoing bilateral and EU-level pressure and work on a peer review mechanism.
The cabinet is concerned about the narrowing of media diversity in Hungary, but does not address the position of individual broadcasters.
Het kabinet maakt zich zorgen over de verschraling van de diversiteit aan media in Hongarije, maar gaat niet in op de positie van individuele zenders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de schadevergoeding van Belastingdienst in verband met inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked about the consequences of a court ruling that the Tax Authority must pay damages to a tenant for wrongly disclosing income data to a landlord for income-dependent rent increases, and whether affected rents should be reversed. The minister answered that the government disagrees with the ruling and has appealed, does not believe rents should be reduced to 2012 levels, and sees no reason to start talks with those affected and the Woonbond.

How many households actually received a higher income-dependent rent increase is not known to me, because it is up to landlords whether or not to use the option of an income-dependent (higher) rent increase.

Voor hoeveel huishoudens daadwerkelijk een inkomensafhankelijke hogere huurverhoging is toegepast is mij niet bekend, omdat het aan verhuurders is om al dan niet gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid tot inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhoging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat een bende cocaïnesmokkelaars is geïnfiltreerd bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether a Tax Authority employee was arrested for leaking confidential information to a drug smuggling gang, how such access is possible, how common official collusion with criminals is, and whether customs and tax officials are being bribed on a large scale. The State Secretary confirmed one Tax Authority employee is suspected, declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, cited 2017 statistics and a WODC study, reported no known serious cases at customs in 2017-2018, saw no indication of large-scale bribery and therefore no inquiry, and said the government is strengthening its approach to undermining crime.
As far as this case is concerned, I cannot make any statements about a concrete criminal investigation.
Voor wat deze zaak betreft geldt dat ik geen mededelingen kan doen over een concreet stafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van privéjets voor buitenlandse bezoeken

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why a chartered private jet was needed for his February 2018 Brussels-Berlin trip, whether that and a Paris trip were efficient use of public money, and which rules govern private jet use. The minister answered that scheduled flights and government aircraft were unavailable or too inflexible, that chartering was the most efficient option, that internal criteria and priority rules apply, and listed prior charter use.
For this specific trip on 13 and 14 March, the government aircraft was not available.
Voor deze specifieke reis op 13 en 14 maart jl. was het regeringsvliegtuig niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het anonimiseren van vermogen via een commanditaire vennootschap (CV)

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a Weekblad voor Fiscaalrecht article claiming limited partnerships (CVs) are used to anonymise wealth, and about tax leakage, the commercial and societas leonina requirements, and whether the Tax Authority cooperates with such structures. The State Secretary rejects the claims, says the Tax Authority no longer gives advance rulings on these structures, states no income tax is lost, and points to the forthcoming UBO register as added transparency.

I see no reason to amend the law to address the situation sketched by the article's authors, all the more so because transparency of asset components is already achieved through the introduction of the so-called UBO register.

Ik zie geen reden om de wet te wijzigen om de door de auteurs van het artikel geschetste situatie aan te pakken, temeer omdat transparantie van vermogensbestanddelen al wordt bereikt door de invoering van het zogenoemde UBO-register.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de investeringen in kolencentrales in de Westelijke Balkan

Two SP MPs asked the government about Chinese investment in coal plants in the Western Balkans, whether this shows weak EU accession commitment, how it affects Dutch coal phase-out and EU climate targets, and whether the Netherlands will raise environmental standards with EU partners. The minister answered that accession countries must align with EU law including the ETS, that the EU 40% target stays, that accession is a long process with strict, fair criteria, and that the Netherlands will continue to insist on these conditions including environmental ones.
The cabinet adheres to a strict and fair EU accession policy and consistently emphasises this in European forums.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan een strikt en fair EU-toetredingsbeleid en benadrukt dit steevast in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de lobby voor een hogere beloning voor bestuurder(s) van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether the AFM supervisory board chair lobbied for a higher pay for the AFM chair and a future board member, when pay was discussed, whether correspondence exists, and whether the pay issue affected the late reappointment of the chair. The Minister says pay was discussed in normal reappointment contact, the WNT exception for the chair was corrected to allow indexation, the correspondence is personnel-confidential and will not be shared, and the board's recruitment process was thorough.
Given the considerations above, I cannot provide these documents to your House.
Gegeven de bovenstaande overwegingen kan ik deze stukken niet aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Dutch Trade and Investment Board (DTIB)

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade whether the Dutch Trade and Investment Board (DTIB) and its successor the ISB-NL are lobby organisations, who sits on them, whether their composition and minutes are transparent, and what they cost. The minister replied that they are public-private advisory platforms rather than lobby bodies, gave the 2017 membership list, promised to publish future ISB-NL members and agendas subject to business confidentiality, and said a WOB decision was published late.
Account must be taken of business-sensitive information, and it must be ensured that discussions within the ISB-NL can be held as openly as possible.
Daarbij zal wel rekening gehouden moeten worden met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en moet worden gewaarborgd dat gesprekken binnen de ISB-NL zo open mogelijk gevoerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het kennismakingsgesprek met Shell

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance why he met Shell's Dutch CEO, who initiated the meeting, who attended, and whether minutes and preparatory memos would be released. The State Secretary answered that such meetings are routine for balancing policy impact, that the meeting agenda was published, and that internal notes are not disclosed under established government policy, though relevant information will be shared in objectified form.
It is standing cabinet policy that documents prepared for internal deliberation, such as notes, memos and meeting minutes, are not made a subject of political debate.
Het is staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad, zoals notities, memo’s en gespreksverslagen geen onderwerp te maken van het politieke debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het opkopen van staatsobligaties door de ECB

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how many government bonds the ECB has bought under the PSPP per member state, whether ECB bond buying affects creditworthiness, and whether the ECB deliberately reduced Italian bond purchases during Italian coalition talks, and whether bond buying amounts to political conduct or Europeanises risk. The minister answered that purchases are driven by monetary policy and liquidity rather than political cycles, that the ECB is independent with no evidence of political conduct, and that risk-sharing under the PSPP is limited, while rejecting the claim of a transfer union via TARGET2.
I have no indications that the ECB engages in politics through its purchasing policy.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de ECB via het aankoopbeleid politiek bedrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over het bezoek van de Eurocommissaris Cretu in het kader van het cohesiebeleid en de volgende meerjarenbegroting

MP Leijten asked why the Chamber was not informed about the April 2018 meeting between Commissioner Crețu and the Dutch ministers on cohesion policy and the next MFF, whether a meeting report exists, and whether the Chamber will be informed of such meetings in future. The ministers answered that such consultations are routine, that their outcomes flow into the regular EU information channels, and that minutes will not be provided, while stating the cabinet coordinates MFF positions closely.
The cabinet does not consider it expedient or desirable to inform the Chamber of every conversation that ministers have with members of the European Commission.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun noch wenselijk om van elk gesprek dat bewindspersonen met leden van de Europese Commissie voeren, de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht Tips & tricks bij een vaststellingsovereenkomst met fiscus'

Leijten (SP) asks the State Secretary of Finance about a tax advisers' article on settlement agreements with the tax authority, including whether they can run indefinitely, whether the waiver of appeal rights is omitted, and whether non-compliant agreements are void. The State Secretary answers that agreements must state a fixed term, that a waiver of appeal is required under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht though compliance cannot be guaranteed in every case, that such agreements are not void under civil law, and agrees to consider capping the maximum term in the ruling practice review.
I do not approve of it, but I cannot guarantee that this provision is included in 100% of settlement agreements.
Ik keur het niet goed maar ik kan niet garanderen dat deze bepaling in 100% van de vaststellingsovereenkomsten is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het witwasschandaal met EU-geld door de Hongaarse premier Orbán

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an alleged money-laundering scandal involving EU funds linked to Hungarian PM Orbán, including investigation, OLAF referral, fund suspension and stricter enforcement. The minister replied the cabinet lacks the figures, that the Commission and OLAF are responsible for investigating and recovering funds, and that the Netherlands supports stricter rule-of-law linked conditionality and the EPPO.
The cabinet is not aware of the figures behind this alleged scandal, nor of whether and how much EU money is involved.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van cijfers achter dit mogelijke schandaal en ook niet of en zo ja hoeveel EU-geld hiermee zou zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de behandeling van klokkenluider Roelie Post door de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the SP asked the ministers whether the government would intervene in the case of whistleblower Roelie Post, who alleges retaliation and threats from the European Commission after exposing adoption corruption in Romania. The minister replied that the government considers threats against officials unacceptable, points to EU whistleblower guidelines, states it lacks details of the dispute, and sees no role for itself in mediation, though it would welcome a mutually acceptable solution.
For this reason, the government sees no obvious role for mediation.
Voor het kabinet ligt er om deze reden geen bemiddelende rol voor de hand.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het feit dat de Raad van de Europese Unie geen enkel antwoord geeft op de aanbevelingen van de Europees Ombudsman over transparantie en geheimhouding e

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked why the EU Council has not responded to the European Ombudsman's February 2018 recommendations on transparency and secrecy in its working documents, which they argued breaches the EU treaty. The Minister replied that no formal treaty deadline binds the Council, that the Netherlands pressed for a timely reply, and that a substantive Council response is expected in early July 2018.
Formally, no obligation arises from Article 228 TFEU for the Council to send its position to the European Ombudsman within three months.
Antwoord 3 Formeel vloeit er geen verplichting voor de Raad voort uit artikel 228 VWEU om binnen drie maanden een antwoord om de Europese Ombudsman zijn standpunt mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat Rabobank haar zorgplicht voor bouwbedrijf Midreth schond

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether Rabobank breached its duty of care toward construction firm Midreth, whose house bank allegedly abused its position, and what the banking code and oversight of small-business lending mean for affected firms. The minister declined to judge the specific case, which is pending before the courts, pointed to the new small-business lending code and monitoring, and said the AFM's earlier review found no structural disadvantage, so no further steps were planned.
This specific case is still before the courts; an appeal in cassation is still open.
Deze specifieke zaak is nog onder de rechter; beroep in cassatie staat nog open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de financiering van een broodcampagne door de EU

The SP MP Leijten asked why the EU co-finances a bread promotion campaign, whether the sector cannot fund it itself, and what 'European bread' means. Minister Schouten answered that general promotion is the sector's responsibility, that she opposed EU co-financing and will push for abolishing the scheme in the new CAP negotiations, while noting the sector can apply directly to the Commission.
Furthermore, I will again argue, including in the negotiations on the new CAP, for abolishing the EU promotion scheme for general sales promotion.
Verder zal ik, ook in de onderhandelingen over het nieuwe GLB, opnieuw pleiten voor afschaffing van de EU-promotieregeling voor algemene afzetbevordering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over het bericht dat ouderen er de dupe van zijn dat er bij sommige gemeenten alleen gepind kan worden

MPs Van Raak and Leijten asked whether it is wrong that some municipalities accept only card payments, which can hurt elderly people and debt-restructuring clients, and whether the government will force municipalities and public bodies to accept cash. The minister agrees that card-only payment should not block access to official documents and is willing to consult municipalities and public bodies on accepting cash, but does not commit to binding measures.
I am willing to consult further with municipalities and public institutions on the acceptance of cash.
Ik ben bereid tot nader overleg met de gemeenten en publieke instellingen over de acceptatie van contant geld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and of Finance whether banks enjoy a privileged position in insolvency, whether this disadvantages other creditors, and whether enforcement practices such as collective pledge deeds and irrevocable powers of attorney should be curbed. The government answered that secured creditors' rights are a necessary condition for cheap credit, that other creditors also hold privileges, that no misuse of irrevocable powers of attorney is found, and that the insolvency law reform programme will revisit the position of pledge and mortgage holders with the advisory group.
This subject was already discussed in June 2017 with the group of representatives from the insolvency practice.
Dit onderwerp is in juni 2017 al eens besproken met de groep vertegenwoordigers uit de faillissementspraktijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de informatievoorziening van de Tweede Kamer aangaande de agenda van de informele Ecofinraad van 27 en 28 april 2018 te Sofia

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the agenda documents for the informal Ecofin in Sofia reached the Chamber only after the meeting had started, and about the information provision to parliament on EU finance council matters. The Minister answered that publication timing lies with the Bulgarian presidency, that Dutch pressure for early publication was made, that informal Ecofins are not decision-making bodies, and that the government commits to transparency through annotated agendas and reports.
For the informal Ecofin, it is ultimately up to the presidency to decide when the documents it prepares are made public.
In het geval van de informele Ecofin is het uiteindelijk aan het voorzitterschap om te bepalen wanneer de stukken die het hiervoor opstelt openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het vastzittende onderzoek naar de moord op onderzoeksjournalist Daphne Caruana Galizia op Malta

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the stalled investigation into the murder of Maltese journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, including Dutch forensic assistance, the rule of law in Malta, and EU action. The minister said the investigation is ongoing, that the Netherlands Forensic Institute assisted Maltese police cooperatively, and that the Commission and Council are monitoring Malta's rule of law without committing to specific Dutch action.
The Cabinet welcomes this involvement and also closely follows developments itself.
Het Kabinet verwelkomt deze betrokkenheid en volgt daarnaast ook zelf de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de deelname van de ECB aan de groep van 30

MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about ECB president Draghi's membership of the opaque G30 group, its membership, funding, and whether it undermines ECB independence and transparency. The minister answered that G30 engagement is acceptable at arm's length, that no direct influence on ECB supervision was found, and that the ECB is raising transparency in response to the Ombudsman's recommendations.
The European Ombudsman's investigation also did not reveal any direct influence by the G30 on the ECB's supervision.
Uit het onderzoek van de Europese Ombudsman is ook niet gebleken dat er sprake is van directe beïnvloeding door de G30 op het toezicht van de ECB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst stukken geheimhield tijdens een rechtszaak

MP Leijten asked why the Tax Administration withheld phone notes in a court case, whether this violates the law, what happens to those responsible, how large toeslagfraud is compared with tax evasion, and whether algorithms cause wrongful blocking of citizens. The State Secretary answered that the case is still pending before the court so he cannot comment on the notes, acknowledged the balance in the childcare benefit case tipped too far against citizens, and gave figures on fraud and staffing.
Under article 8:42 of the General Administrative Law Act, an administrative body must send all documents relating to the case to the administrative judge.
Conform artikel 8:42 Algemene wet bestuursrecht dient een bestuursorgaan alle op de zaak betrekking hebbende stukken aan de bestuursrechter te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het feit dat een markt voor topbestuurders fictie is

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether he was surprised by a PhD study showing performance pay does not deliver its promise, whether benchmarking top executive pay against peers is flawed, and whether he would act on the Ronnes motion. The minister said the bonus cap evaluation is ongoing with results due before summer, agreed that benchmarking and performance pay are not ideal, and committed to talks with the sector on pay policy and to informing the House on the motion.
I will inform the House in writing about the implementation of the motion.
Ik zal de Kamer schriftelijk informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over sponsoring van de Koningsdagborrel op de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about corporate sponsorship (ING, Shell, G4S) of the King's Day reception at the Dutch Permanent Representation in Brussels, including whether such sponsorship is usual, whether it risks conflicts of interest, and whether it should end. Minister Blok answered that posts have long used third-party sponsorship under integrity codes, were re-instructed in March 2018, that no central sponsor register exists, and that he sees no reason to change the practice.
No central register of sponsors is kept.
Er wordt geen centraal bestand van sponsoren bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de woekerrente op rood staan bij banken

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether high overdraft interest rates charged by banks amount to usury, whether a maximum rate should be lowered, and how overdrafts relate to debt problems and state collection measures. The minister replies that the interest cap is tied to the statutory rate, defends the cost structure and the ACM's view that lowering the cap would backfire, and promises a forthcoming AFM-based review but does not commit to lowering the cap.
How much banks earn from the interest charged on overdrafts is not known to me, as this concerns commercially confidential information.
Hoeveel banken verdienen met de rente die wordt gerekend op roodstanden is mij niet bekend, aangezien het hier gaat om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de gevolgen van Kaderprogramma 9 voor het Meerjarig Financieel Kader

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate whether Council conclusions on industrial policy amount to a call to raise the EU budget (MFK), and why the minister said the MFK was not on the agenda. The State Secretary answered that the conclusions are not a call for a higher MFK, that the MFK was not discussed at the Competitiveness Council, and that the government will improve referencing of agenda documents in future.
As discussed in the General Committee on Information Provision of 12 April, the cabinet will give extra attention to proper referencing in the annotated agenda and cabinet letters.
Zoals besproken in het Algemeen Overleg Informatievoorziening van 12 april jl. zal er vanuit het kabinet extra aandacht zijn voor goede verwijzing in de geannoteerde agenda en kabinetsbrieven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de forse aanblijfbonussen van bankiers bij beursgang NIBC

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether NIBC's large retention bonuses for bankers at its stock-market listing are acceptable, given its past state guarantee, whether DNB approved them, and whether NIBC falsely claims it survived the crisis without state aid. The minister answers that the bonuses are legally permitted under the Wbfo with DNB consent, that the board must justify them, that the law is under evaluation, and that the state guarantee was in fact used until December 2014.
Because of supervisory confidentiality, DNB cannot share further information about this specific case.
Omwille van de toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan DNB geen nadere informatie over deze specifieke casus delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Europees Parlement trakteert zichzelf op miljoenen voor verkiezingen'

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister about a rise in the European Parliament's budget above two billion euros, extra campaign funding, and communication staff and information offices. The minister answers that the EP sets its own budget within EU financial frameworks, that campaign subsidies are permitted under EU and Dutch rules, and that the EP is primarily responsible for its own spending and controls.

The cabinet leaves it to the members of the European Parliament themselves to assess to what extent they consider it desirable for their tasks to have a communications department and information offices in the member states.

Tegen deze achtergrond acht het kabinet het dan ook aan de leden van het Europees parlement zelf om te beoordelen in hoeverre zij het voor de uitoefening van hun taken wenselijk achten dat er een communicatieafdeling is en dat er informatiekantoren zijn in de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het tobben van de Europese bankensector

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the struggles of the European banking sector, including profitability, low interest rates, non-performing loans, too-big-to-fail risk and a possible next banking downturn. The minister answered that European banks are overall profitable, that ECB policy effects are monitored, that NPL write-downs are mainly the banks' responsibility with supervisory pressure, and that the Netherlands opposes a eurozone stabilisation mechanism.
The cabinet shares the IMF's view that member states should prepare for a next economic downturn.
Het kabinet deelt de mening van het IMF dat lidstaten zich moeten voorbereiden op een volgende economische neergang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof inzake transparantie van de triloogonderhandelingen

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the General Court ruling in De Capitani v Parliament (T-540/15) requiring public disclosure of trilogue four-column documents, and how it will promote transparency. The minister welcomed the ruling, said the Limité marking should be applied as restrictively as possible and that Nederland will press the Council secretariat on this and on proactive publication, but declined to commit to standard publication of the documents.
The Netherlands is working to ensure that this assessment is carried out carefully.
Nederland zet er op in dat deze afweging zorgvuldig gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ernstige gevolgen van de notificatierichtlijn

The SP MP Leijten asked whether the proposed revision of the EU services notification directive, with its standstill period, threatens democratic processes, burdens municipalities and the Commission, and whether the Netherlands should withdraw from it. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands opposes an extra three-month standstill (which was dropped from the general approach), that the notification duty already exists and only moderately expands, and that municipalities can still adopt ordinances without prior Commission approval.
During the trilogue negotiations as well, I will continue to work hard on this.
Ook tijdens de onderhandelingen in de trilogen zal ik mij hiervoor in blijven spannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de herziening van het beloningsstelsel bij de verzekeraar ASR

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about a large pay rise for the ASR executive board, arguing it clashes with a 2% staff increase and that the state had bailed out ASR. The minister answered that since the state sold its last ASR shares, pay is a matter for the supervisory board and new shareholders, though he finds the rise remarkable and expects the board to weigh ASR's social role, and he described the Dutch corporate governance framework on shareholder interests.
Because the state is no longer a shareholder, I do not decide on the level of the pay of the executive board of a.s.r.
Omdat de staat geen aandeelhouder meer is, ga ik niet over de hoogte van de beloning van de raad van bestuur van a.s.r.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Rabobank, National Association bereikt schikking over tekortkomingen compliance programma'

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the 298 million euro US settlement by Rabobank National Association over failed anti-money-laundering compliance, including directors' knowledge, the dismissal of a whistleblowing employee, and whether Dutch prosecutors settle such cases. The minister answered that the facts are serious and that Dutch AML rules are being tightened, but declined to comment on the details of the case or on Dutch prosecutorial settlement policy, which was referred to the Justice Minister.
In principle I cannot go into the details of individual cases.
In beginsel kan ik niet ingaan op details van individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de dalende belastingdruk op multinationals

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the effective tax burden on multinationals keeps falling while burdens on citizens rise, and whether the tax race and related measures would be reconsidered. The State Secretary answered that ATAD 2 and public country-by-country reporting will address avoidance, that data on effective tax rates are not available and a separate study would be needed, and that the government will not reverse the dividend tax abolition or corporate rate cuts, while promising a study on the arm's-length principle.
This data is not in the possession of the Tax Authority.
Deze gegevens zijn niet in het bezit van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over nepnieuwsbestrijders van de EU die Nederlands nieuws beoordelen maar geen Nederlands spreken

SP MPs asked why the EU's EUvsdisinfo fake-news unit, which has no Dutch-speaking staff, rates Dutch news, how its volunteer numbers and €1 million budget add up, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answers that the unit's Dutch-language articles were wrongly published and rectified, that the government opposes its method and has raised it with the EEAS, and that the EU Commission is not responsible for it.
No, the cabinet will therefore carry out the motion submitted by MPs Kwint and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Parliamentary paper 21 501-34, no. 290).
Nee, het kabinet zal daarom de motie van de leden Kwint en Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Kamerstuk 21 501–34, nr. 290 ) uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de werkwijze van de Belastingdienst bij belastingafspraken met multinationals

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Netherlands does not disclose the number of advance pricing agreements with multinationals, how concern financing rulings were handled and continued after the CFA regime ended, and whether the Tax Authority's practice is adequately transparent. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands publishes APA figures annually, that the concern financing rulings expired at the end of 2016 with no further extensions, and that a review of ruling practice and external audits are underway.
The Ministry of Finance does not disclose personal policy views contained in documents prepared for internal deliberation in Wob decisions.
Het Ministerie van Financiën maakt in Wob-besluiten geen persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen ten behoeve van intern beraad openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'EU-geld vloeide naar familie Orban'

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about reports that EU funds flowed to Orban's family via the firm Elios, including OLAF findings of irregular tenders and fraud, and whether Hungary's response and EU sanctions are adequate. The minister said the OLAF report is not public, that Hungarian criminal investigation is ongoing so the government will not comment on the firms or persons, and pointed to Commission enforcement tools and Dutch proposals for publishing annual control reports and tougher MFF conditions.

The content of the relevant report of the European Anti-Fraud Office (OLAF) and the recommendations it contains are not public and not accessible to anyone other than the relevant Hungarian authorities.

De inhoud van het betreffende rapport van het Europees Bureau voor Fraudebestrijding (OLAF) en de daarin opgenomen aanbevelingen zijn niet openbaar en niet voor anderen dan de relevante Hongaarse autoriteiten inzichtelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het transparantie initiatief, ondertekend door 26 delegaties van commissies voor Europese aangelegenheden uit de parlementen van de lidstaten van de Eu

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked whether the Dutch representative handed the COSAC transparency report to the Bulgarian presidency, whether all member states received it, what comments exist, when it will be on the agenda, and whether the government has actively pushed for its proposals. The minister confirmed the handover, said the initiators were responsible for distribution, stated no comments had been made and the Council's reaction will come later, and said the government has raised the topic and will seek a suitable moment to put it on the General Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet will endeavour to put the subject of transparency on the General Affairs Council agenda at a suitable moment, in consultation with the presidency.
Het kabinet zal zich inspannen om het onderwerp van transparantie, in samenspraak met het voorzitterschap, op een geëigend moment te agenderen voor de Raad Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verdwijnen van hulp bij de belastingaangifte

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the declining availability of in-person help with tax returns, the closure of the Gouda help point, and how people without helpers or paid advisers can file. The State Secretary answered that help is available at 30 locations and via library and intermediary networks, and that the Tax Administration will keep help at its 20 planned offices, while stating it provides no fiscal advice.
It is not the case that citizens from Gouda can no longer receive help with their tax return.
Het is niet zo dat burgers uit Gouda geen hulp bij aangifte meer kunnen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat hoogleraren en fiscalisten pleiten voor openheid belastingafspraken met multinationals

Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether publishing tax rulings with multinationals is needed to remove secrecy, whether rulings can comply with law only if published or stopped, whether they comply with EU Code of Conduct guidelines, and related questions on the 2016 pre-consultation decision, NFIA, the cv/bv structure, transfer pricing and the EU MFF. Snel answered that rulings are exchanged internationally and general frameworks and exemplary APAs/ATRs are published, that individual rulings cannot be published under the AWR, that EU guidelines are soft law with procedural alignment planned by 1 January 2019, and that individual publication adds limited value.
In connection with Article 67 of the General Tax Act, individual rulings cannot be made public.
In verband met artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen kunnen individuele rulings niet publiek gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over partnerschap

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why a child moving in with a parent can make the parent and child legal partners, cutting off childcare and health-related allowances, while inheritance tax treats children differently, and whether partner criteria across laws should be harmonised. The State Secretary defends the objective partner criteria in the AWR and tax/allowance laws, including the household rule for blood relatives in the first degree aged 27 or over, and says there is no need to harmonise partner definitions across social-security schemes.
As I indicated earlier, the basic partner concept also applies to gift and inheritance tax, and because of its specific nature a number of additional requirements apply.
Zoals ik hiervoor al heb aangegeven geldt het basispartnerbegrip ook in de schenk- en erfbelasting en is vanwege het specifieke karakter ervan een aantal aanvullende eisen gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het rapport 'mining taxes' van de Stichting Onderzoek Multinationale Ondernemingen (SOMO)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about an SOMO report on tax avoidance by mining companies via the Netherlands and Mongolia's tax treaty with the Netherlands, including the IMF's view, other countries' treaty changes, and four SOMO recommendations. The State Secretary said the IMF only described the Dutch treaty and favoured renegotiation over termination, that the Netherlands is pursuing anti-abuse clauses and substance requirements, and that individual firms receive no tax advantages contrary to law, while not ruling out lower withholding rates in a future treaty.
I cannot comment on the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen kan ik geen uitlatingen doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'EU welcomes Silvio Berlusconi as the man to save Italy from populism'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether it is appropriate for Commission President Juncker, EP President Tajani and others to publicly back Berlusconi, who is barred from office by the European Court of Human Rights, before the Italian elections, and whether this oversteps the EU's mandate and affects Brexit talks. The minister replies that the Commission President and other EU officials decide whom they meet and what they say, that the government has confidence in Barnier, and that Berlusconi is not currently a candidate.
It is up to Commission President Juncker and other EU high-level officials to decide whom they meet, and the statements they make are for their own account.

Het is aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie Juncker en andere EU-hoogwaardigheidsbekleders om te bepalen met wie zij een ontmoeting hebben en de uitspraken die zij doen zijn voor hun eigen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het bericht 'EU rift over rule of law deepens’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the ministers about the European Commission's warnings to Romania over judicial reforms that could weaken the rule of law and shield corruption suspects, and about rule-of-law decline in several member states, EU justice cooperation, EU funds and Western Balkans accession. The minister confirmed awareness of the Commission's concerns, said the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism mainly signals problems without enforcement power, and stated that justice cooperation is based on mutual recognition with limited refusal grounds.
The Cooperation and Verification Mechanism (CVM) was designed after the accession of Bulgaria and Romania to monitor progress in judicial reform and the fight against corruption.

Het Coöperatie- en Verificatiemechanisme mechanisme (CVM) werd ontworpen na de toetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenië om voortgang te monitoren bij de hervorming van het rechtsstelsel, de bestrijding van corruptie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de politie-inval bij de Eurogroep-voorzitter

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about a police raid on Eurogroup president Centeno, how integrity was assessed in his selection, and whether he should remain in office during an investigation. The government replied that integrity is essential, that the Portuguese investigation has concluded with no finding of integrity violations, and that Centeno was never formally a suspect.
A statement from the Portuguese public prosecutors says the investigation found that Centeno did not commit any integrity violations.
In een verklaring van de Portugese openbaar aanklagers wordt gesteld dat uit het onderzoek is gebleken dat Centeno zich niet schuldig heeft gemaakt aan integriteitsschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het aandeel van banken in de financiering van de zorg

MPs Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about banks' large lending to care institutions, whether premium funds pay bank interest, and whether banks pressure hospitals toward profitable specialisation. The minister answered that bank debt is normal for investment, the sector's solvency meets the norm, banks' scrutiny is legitimate, no evidence shows banks forcing specialisation, and the government will keep the current system.
It is not known what part of this amount was specifically spent on paying interest to banks on outstanding loans.
Het is niet bekend welk deel van dit bedrag specifiek is besteed aan het betalen van rentes aan banken over uitstaande leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het aanstellen van “ambassadeurs” en toezichthouders

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked about how special envoys (StartupDelta and FinTech) and an AFM supervisory board member were appointed, their time commitment, pay, the plagiarism admitted by the FinTech envoy, and whether appointment procedures produce suitable people. The Minister answered that the envoys' roles and pay were set by agreements (partly via a foundation), the FinTech envoy's post had expired and was unpaid, and the AFM appointment followed a profile-based search and vetting, with pay caps under the WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ‘’Waakhond accountants VS in diskrediet’’

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister whether Dutch regulators are at risk from revolving-door fraud like the US PCAOB/KPMG case, whether the AFM cooperates with US regulators, whether it will examine KPMG's international activities, and what KPMG settlements with prosecutors have been since 2000. The minister answers that the US cases are for US authorities, the AFM has no known Dutch cases and has confidentiality and cooling-off rules, cooperation with the PCAOB exists but no request arose, oversight of the AFM is its own responsibility, and two large KPMG settlements (7 and 8 million euro) are listed.
As Minister of Finance in the Netherlands, I am not involved in this case.
Als Minister van Financiën in Nederland ben ik niet bij deze zaak betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over belasting op een Duitse tegemoetkoming voor betaalde premies voor de zorg

An MP asks why a German Zulage reimbursing Dutch Wlz and Zvw premiums is taxed as income and why this differs from how UWV treats it. The Secretary of State explains that the Zulage is a periodic benefit taxed in box 1, while UWV does not count it for WAO offsetting because the tax and social security income concepts differ in purpose.
The fiscal income concept is broader than the income concept for employee insurance schemes, including the WAO in this case, which is based on wages.
Het fiscale inkomensbegrip is ruimer dan het inkomensbegrip voor de werknemersverzekeringen, waaronder i.c. de WAO dat gebaseerd is op het loon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitspraak dat Nederland een ‘fiscaal zwart gat’ is

The SP MP Leijten asks the government whether it is proud of being called a 'fiscal black hole' by Commissioner Moscovici, how often the Netherlands has been challenged in EU forums on narrowing its tax base, and why Panama and others were removed from the EU tax haven list. State Secretary Snel rejects the characterisation as inappropriate, points to Dutch anti-avoidance measures and EU Code of Conduct reviews, and refers to the Ecofin report on the list, while acknowledging concerns about transparency of the list and promising a separate letter.
I have therefore repeatedly pressed for more transparency from the Code of Conduct Group and specifically regarding the process of the EU list.
Ik heb daarom ook herhaaldelijk aangedrongen op meer transparantie van de Gedragscodegroep en meer specifiek rondom het proces van de EU-lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de mogelijke overname van C&A door Chinese investeerders

MP Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a possible takeover of C&A by Chinese investors, the motives of its owners, worker involvement and job protection, the implications of the Organon case for foreign acquisitions, reciprocity with China, and how other EU states handle this. The minister said C&A denied or did not confirm a sale, workers' interests are protected via works council rights and SER merger rules, foreign investment is welcome in an open economy, and the EU is pursuing a common approach and an investment screening framework.
As indicated earlier in answer to question 2, it is currently unknown whether the owners of C&A intend to sell (part of) the company.
Zoals eerder bij vraag 2 aangegeven is momenteel onbekend of de eigenaren van C&A voornemens zijn om (een deel van) het bedrijf te verkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Roemeense leider van de sociaaldemocraten verdacht wordt van EU-fraude

The MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister whether Romanian Social Democrat leader Dragnea, suspected of EU and national fund fraud, had received subsidies, whether EU funds were recovered, what measures were taken, whether the case affects Romania's Schengen accession, what lessons apply to candidate states, and whether the EU budget should be increased. The government answered that an investigation is ongoing in Romania, that it will not comment further on the pending case, that EU funds are subject to standard controls and recovery is required for unlawful payments, that Schengen accession requires unanimity and is not on the agenda, and that it opposes increasing the EU budget and favours reform and stronger control.
The cabinet makes no further statements pending the investigation taking place in another member state.
Het kabinet doet geen verdere uitspraken hangende het onderzoek dat in een andere lidstaat plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voorwaarden die worden gesteld bij het afgeven van belastingrulings

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether tax rulings (APAs and ATRs) carry conditions such as substance requirements, how breaches are handled, whether staffing suffices to monitor compliance, whether rulings survive takeovers or mergers, whether companies must repay tax benefits, and how many rulings were revoked. The state secretary answered that standard substance requirements are set in public policy decisions, that non-compliance or changed facts can cause a ruling to lapse, that rulings survive a takeover only under conditions, and that 2016 monitoring led to three ATRs ceasing to apply, with fuller figures promised in a future half-year report.
In the first half-year report of 2018 it will be included how many requests were rejected in 2017, how many were declared inadmissible, how many were withdrawn and on what grounds.

Bij de eerste Halfjaarsrapportage in 2018 zal worden opgenomen hoeveel verzoeken in 2017 zijn afgewezen, hoeveel er buiten behandeling zijn gesteld, hoeveel er zijn ingetrokken en op welke grond dat is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over 16 miljard belastingontwijking van Google via Nederland

The SP MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance whether it is acceptable that Google routes 16 billion euros in royalties through a Dutch subsidiary to Bermuda without tax, whether that subsidiary lacks substance, how many multinationals use similar shells, and whether Ireland and Singapore are harmed. The State Secretary declined to confirm anything about an individual taxpayer or a ruling under the General Tax Act, stated that the government considers such shell companies undesirable and plans a withholding tax on royalties, and rejected the claim that other countries are harmed.
Regarding tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make any statements in view of article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het aansturen op het telefonisch intrekken van bezwaren door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance how the Tax Administration came to phone taxpayers to withdraw objections, whether informal withdrawals were recorded, and whether the Chamber was given full information on searches and compensation. The State Secretary replies that since October 2016 withdrawals must be confirmed in writing, that 23 affected people responded and no objections remain open, and that data searches were only theoretically possible, but declines to give the full search information and declines to answer some questions.
It therefore cannot be said that the Chamber has been denied insight or (relevant) information about search queries.
Er kan dan ook niet gesteld worden dat de Kamer inzicht of (relevante) informatie over zoekopdrachten is onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de snelgroeiende handel in Exchange Traded Funds (ETF’s) door de herziene richtlijn markten in financiële instrumenten (MIFID II)

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about rapid growth in ETF investment, systemic risk, whether MiFID II will spur unbalanced growth, governance of ETF issuers, regulation of high-frequency trading, and conflicts of interest for banks. The minister answered that ETFs are not currently large enough to disrupt the economy, that MiFID II adds cost transparency, that supervisors monitor the market, and that the government will not commit to new measures.
Supervisors monitor the development of the growth of ETFs.
Toezichthouders monitoren de ontwikkeling van de groei van ETF's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rulingpraktijk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax rulings with multinationals are not exchanged with other countries as agreed, how many rulings were issued, and how the review of about 4,000 existing rulings is organised, including the Nike ruling and the EU Code of Conduct Group's assessment. The State Secretary answered that about 4,000 existing international rulings will be exchanged by 1 January 2018, that a review will check compliance with the two-signature principle, that the Nike ruling cannot be discussed due to tax secrecy, and that he will report on the review and on EU monitoring in early 2018.
Regarding tax matters of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make public statements given the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act.

Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de gaslobby

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked ministers about gas-industry lobbying, Shell's role at Rotterdam School of Management, government access for Shell, gas infrastructure overcapacity, EU lobbying transparency, and methane emissions. The ministers answered that universities set curricula, Shell has the same access as other firms, network investments follow public consultation and regulator review, existing lobbying rules need no change, and a methane letter will follow by Q2 2018.
There is no reason to amend the existing rules and regulations on lobbying.
Er is geen aanleiding om de bestaande regels en voorschriften met betrekking tot lobbyen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geheime stemming over Europese Agentschappen

Leijten (SP) asked the Foreign Minister why the Council decided the relocation of the EMA and EBA by secret ballot, whether this fits Council transparency rules, and how the Council will become more transparent. Minister Zijlstra answered that the decision was intergovernmental and followed a published, transparent procedure, that the Netherlands sees no reason to think it damaged public trust, and that Council votes are generally public though some parts, including this relocation procedure, are not, while the government supports greater openness in EU legislation.
Since this is not an EU decision, the usual rules and practices on decision-making in the Council do not strictly speaking apply.
Aangezien het niet gaat om een EU besluit, zijn de gebruikelijke regels en praktijken rondom besluitvorming in de Raad strikt gezien ook niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verdwijnen van pinautomaten en de verminderende toegankelijkheid tot contant geld

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether access to cash is a public utility, whether the decline of ATMs and bank branches harms local economies, and how cash access is safeguarded. The Minister answered that cash access must stay in balance with demand, that banks and GSN voluntarily keep the five-kilometre norm, and that he sees no reason to impose a formal access norm.
I therefore see no reason to move towards setting a norm for access to cash.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om over te gaan tot het normeren van de toegang tot contant geld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de belastingaanslag van Unilever steeds kleiner wordt

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Unilever's Australian tax bill was shrinking, including intercompany loans shifting profits to the Netherlands, the effectiveness of BEPS measures, country-by-country reporting, a KPMG accounting remark, and KPMG's role in tax planning. The State Secretary largely refused to discuss the individual taxpayer citing confidentiality, stated the arm's length principle and OECD/EU measures are sufficient, and pointed to planned anti-avoidance legislation.
Regarding the tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make further statements given the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over hoe de voorgenomen maatregelen in het regeerakkoord van Rutte III de ‘brievenbus-bv’s’ het leven zuur gaan maken

MPs Leijten asked the Finance Minister how the Rutte III coalition plans to make 'brievenbus-bv's' (letterbox companies) difficult, including which firms would be taxed, how many exist, their employment, and rulings granted. The state secretary replied that the plans include a withholding tax on interest and royalties to low-tax jurisdictions and abolishing the dividend tax, that the number of affected firms cannot yet be known, and gave ruling and employment figures.
It is currently not possible to indicate how many companies established in the Netherlands would have to apply the proposed withholding taxes if they continue their activities unchanged.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel vennootschappen die nu in Nederland zijn gevestigd de voorgestelde bronheffingen zouden moeten inhouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een bankenlobby een EU-voorstel om de schade van een bank-run te beperken bestrijdt

MP Leijten asks the Finance Minister about a report that US bank lobbies oppose an EU proposal allowing temporary freezing of deposits in vulnerable banks, and about the lobby's influence on regulation. The minister says the Netherlands supports a moratorium instrument with restraint, that member states disagree on its scope and duration, that bail-in rules and MREL buffers matter more, and that EU consultation and a lobby-contact code apply.
The Ministry of Finance aims for openness and transparency about its contacts with external parties.
Het Ministerie van Financiën streeft naar openheid en transparantie over haar contacten met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de mislukte Griekse steunprogramma’s

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors report on the failed Greek bailout programmes, including the role of the Commission, the ECB, bank recapitalisation losses, evaluations and parliamentary oversight. The minister largely welcomed the report, defended the programmes' necessity, stated that HFSF losses do not burden the Dutch state, and explained the ECB's limited audit scope under the SSM regulation.
I am willing to ask the Commission to also address the follow-up to the ECA's recommendations in the planned ex-post evaluation of the Greek programme.
Ik ben bereid om de Commissie te vragen om in de voorziene ex-post evaluatie van het Griekse programma ook in te gaan op de opvolging van de aanbevelingen door de ERK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat honderden rijken uit Rusland en Oekraïne een Cypriotisch paspoort hebben kunnen kopen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether Cyprus sold EU citizenship via its golden passport scheme to wealthy Russians and Ukrainians, including revenue, vetting, sanctions checks, money laundering and whether national parliaments can see recipients. The minister answered that Cyprus's individual naturalisation files are not visible, that the Netherlands does not act unless national law conflicts with international law, and that disclosure is a matter for member states.
No insight can be given into the individual naturalisation procedures actually followed.
Over de daadwerkelijk gevolgde individuele naturalisatieprocedures kan geen inzicht worden verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘IMF waarschuwt voor gevolgen van jacht op rendement’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about IMF warnings on a 'search for yield', global debt, the ECB's bond-buying effects and a European deposit guarantee scheme. The minister answered that the IMF's concerns are noted, that risks exist, and that further study of QE effects is not needed because the ECB and other bodies already examine them.
I see no reason to carry out additional research into the effects of quantitative easing on financial stability and inequality.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het uitvoeren van een extra onderzoek naar de gevolgen van kwantitatieve verruiming voor de financiële stabiliteit en ongelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ABN AMRO en haar handel in hefboomleningen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO, the state-owned bank, should provide leveraged loans to already highly indebted firms, why it stopped and why it restarts, and how this squares with IMF warnings on yield-chasing. The minister replied that such loans are provided only on a limited scale within a moderate risk profile, that ABN AMRO sets its own commercial strategy without a formal state role, and that ECB and DNB measures are sufficient to manage risks.
From the shareholder's perspective, I want to emphasise that ABN AMRO itself determines its commercial strategy. The state has no formal role in this.
Vanuit het perspectief van de aandeelhouder wil ik benadrukken dat ABN AMRO zelf haar commerciële strategie bepaalt. De staat heeft hier geen formele rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de 'Leaders Agenda' van de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about the European Council President's 'Leaders Agenda', extra summits and whether agendas and decision notes will be made public and sent to parliament in time. The minister replies that the Netherlands supports the agenda, that the government cannot guarantee the timing of documents circulated by the European Council President, but that parliament will receive annotated agendas and confidential access to preparatory documents.
The cabinet therefore cannot give guarantees about the content and the timing of when documents are distributed.
Het kabinet kan dus geen garanties geven over de inhoud en het moment waarop stukken worden verspreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bedrog van Intertrust

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Intertrust's alleged lying in court over the origin of assets, whether its licence should be affected, and whether offshore structures with trust offices are a warning sign. The minister says the three entities in the Curaçao case are not licensed under the Dutch Wtt, so licence withdrawal is not at issue, and that the Belastingdienst treats trust-office offshore structures as a high-risk signal while listing legitimate reasons for offshore placement.
When a court irrevocably finds an "unfair procedural attitude" by a Dutch licensed entity, that is in principle sufficient reason for DNB to start an investigation into that entity.

Wanneer een rechtbank een «oneerlijke proceshouding» van een Nederlandse vergunninghoudende entiteit onherroepelijk vaststelt, is dat voor DNB in principe voldoende aanleiding om een onderzoek naar deze entiteit te starten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst trustgroep TMF beschuldigt van hulp bij belastingontduiking

MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Tax Authority accuses trust group TMF of helping with tax evasion, including its acquisition of a trust office under investigation since 2004, its acceptance of a high-risk client with a criminal record, the role of cash shell companies, the Tax Authority's capacity, a settlement, DNB licence sanctions, and TMF's IPO plans. The Minister declined to comment on ongoing investigations and individual taxpayers citing confidentiality, described planned stricter trust-office rules, explained cash shell company rules, said the Tax Authority has sufficient capacity, noted DNB's licence withdrawal criteria, and reported TMF's takeover by CVC instead of an IPO.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases under investigation by the Tax Authority.
Over lopende zaken die in onderzoek zijn bij de Belastingdienst kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de dividendbelasting

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why abolishing dividend tax yields a net relief of 1.4 billion when gross dividend tax revenue in the annual reports was 2.2 to 3.5 billion per year, and asked about the offsetting, the calculation, the transparency of net revenue, the effect on foreign investors and UK investors. The State Secretary explained that the annual report shows gross revenue, that offsets against income and corporate tax reduce net revenue (about 1.0 to 1.2 billion net in 2010-2014), that the 2018 net estimate of 1.4 billion rests on 48% and 9% offset assumptions, and that he refers to a separate letter on foreign investors and does not know whether UK investors lobbied.
I refer you to my letter of today on this subject.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn brief van heden over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken zijn binnengevallen vanwege mogelijke kartelvorming

Dutch MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about reports that the European Commission raided Dutch banks over suspected cartel conduct, and whether the government knew of the raids and which firms were visited. The minister confirmed the unannounced visits were a preliminary investigation into possible competition breaches, said he would not pre-empt its outcome, and that no signals of refused data sharing had reached regulators.
Since this is a preliminary investigation being carried out by the European Commission, it is not for me to anticipate the outcome of this investigation.
Aangezien het een vooronderzoek betreft dat wordt uitgevoerd door de Europese Commissie, past het mij niet om vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Raan en Van der Lee over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten, Van Raan and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance how the critical assumption in informal capital rulings (that a complete and accurate picture is given to foreign tax authorities) can be met without proactive disclosure, how compliance is checked, and about exchange of information, the Belgian state aid case, the 1986-1995 suspension, hybrid entities and the value involved. The State Secretary answered that non-compliance (failure to provide information on request) ends the APA/ATR, that 19 ATRs and 40 APAs were checked in 2016 leading to three ATR terminations, and that the government does not track the total value of informal capital rulings.
Since the introduction of the APA/ATR practice, the number of rulings with an informal capital element has not been systematically recorded when registering requested and granted APAs.
Sinds de invoering van de APA-/ATR-praktijk is bij het registeren van aangevraagde en toegewezen APA’s het aantal rulings met een informeel kapitaalelement niet systematisch bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de nieuwe Europese pseudowetgeving voor belastingrulingpraktijken van EU-lidstaten en de gevolgen voor de huidige Nederlandse praktijk

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the EU Code of Conduct Group's new guidance on tax rulings and its consequences for Dutch ruling practice, including transparency, publication of rulings, staffing, and the Netherlands' compliance. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the Netherlands largely complies, some Tax Authority practices may need adjustment with findings due in 2018, and that publication of all rulings is limited by confidentiality rules and burden, while offering alternative transparency measures.
I attach great importance to taxpayers, large and small, who seek advance certainty about their tax position being able to rely on confidential treatment of their data.
Ik hecht er sterk aan dat belastingplichtigen – groot en klein – die zekerheid vooraf wensen over hun fiscale situatie kunnen rekenen op vertrouwelijke omgang met hun gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de vermoedelijk actieve rol van KPMG Zuid Afrika in het faciliteren van fraude

An MP asks the Finance Minister about KPMG South Africa's alleged role in facilitating fraud, including resignations, investigations, rating effects, international oversight and penalties. The minister declines to comment on the South African matter, says Dutch accountancy oversight is the AFM's responsibility, and promises no concrete action beyond noting the responses.
I am not involved in this as Minister of Finance in the Netherlands, and it is therefore not for me to express a view on this matter.
Ik ben daar als Minister van Financiën in Nederland niet bij betrokken en het is dan ook niet aan mij om mij over deze kwestie uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitkleden van de buffereis voor banken zoals in voorlopige EU-wetgeving is geformuleerd

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister to release a report prepared with Germany on how the bank bail-in buffer (MREL) was worded, and whether the Netherlands is pushing to liberalise it. The minister declined to share the technical expert documents, saying they serve negotiating positions rather than political debate, and stated that the Dutch position is fully in line with the cabinet's earlier response.
To enable our civil servant representatives to make maximum efforts in Brussels to bring proposals in line with the Dutch position, I do not consider it wise to share such documents with the House.

Om onze ambtelijke vertegenwoordigers in staat te stellen zich in Brussel maximaal in te spannen om voorstellen in lijn te krijgen met de Nederlandse inzet, vind ik het niet verstandig om dergelijke stukken met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de berichtgeving van de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie en de Belastingdienst om criminelen in hun portemonnee te raken
