Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reported weak cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service and the Tax Authority in recovering criminal proceeds, including why confiscation often yields less than claimed, whether tax recovery works after failed criminal recovery, how often offshore concealment occurs, and whether multidisciplinary asset-recovery teams and more investigative capacity are warranted. The minister answered that cooperation already exists and is periodically evaluated, that figures on tax recovery and concealment are not kept, that RIEC structures are preferred over new teams, and that extra funding (5 to 20 million euro a year from 2018, plus 30 million reserved for 2018) has been provided.

The number of cases in which the Tax Authority still recovers money from criminals via tax reassessment after the criminal asset-recovery route has (partly) failed is not tracked and no figures are available.

Het aantal gevallen waarin de Belastingdienst als nog via fiscale navordering en naheffing geld terug haalt bij criminelen als het strafrechtelijke afpaktraject (deels) mislukt, wordt niet bijgehouden en cijfers zijn dan ook niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat beleggingsfraudeurs steeds weer toeslaan

An MP asked the Finance Minister how many investment fraud cases occur yearly, what actions have been taken to protect investors, why fraud persists, whether AFM and prosecutors are adequately resourced, and how cases are allocated between administrative and criminal enforcement. The minister answered that exact figures are not recorded, outlined existing prospectus, licensing and AFM consumer-information powers, acknowledged limited AFM powers over exempt offerings, and described the tripartite cooperation framework without committing to new measures.
The exact damage caused by investment fraud is not recorded separately.
De exacte schade die veroorzaakt wordt door beleggingsfraude wordt niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het Leijten over het bericht “Angstcultuur bij DNB belemmert innovatie van het geldsysteem”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that a fear culture at DNB hampers innovation in the money system, and about the Depositobank initiative and TARGET2 access. The minister rejected the claim of a fear culture, pointed to a WRR study due in early 2018, and explained the legal limits on Depositobank and TARGET2 access, with DNB and ECB rules binding its options.
That is why I also contributed to a two-day conference on money creation held at DNB and the Ministry of Finance last November.
Daarom heb ik ook bijgedragen aan een tweedaags congres over geldschepping dat november vorig jaar plaatsvond bij DNB en op het Ministerie van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht dat De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) het beheer van vertrouwelijke data wil uitbesteden

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance Minister about DNB's plan to outsource management of its confidential data, including accountability, scope, oversight and expertise. The minister answered that DNB remains ultimately responsible, state-secret data stays in-house, the outsourcing is subject to exit clauses and active steering, and the government is building ICT expertise.
DNB remains ultimately responsible for the data it has obtained in the performance of its duties.
DNB blijft uiteindelijk zelf verantwoordelijk voor de data die zij uit hoofde van haar taak heeft verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanstaande overname van de Nederlandse tak van het Italiaanse Generali door Verzekeraar ASR Nederland

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the state, as major shareholder of ASR, knew of and assessed the risks of ASR's acquisition of Generali Nederland, and about the price gap and job losses. The minister answered that the state was informed only on the day of announcement, was under no obligation to be consulted, did no risk analysis, and that job losses cannot be excluded while ASR considers it too early to quantify them.
I was informed of the proposed acquisition on Wednesday 13 September 2017, at the same time as ASR's press release on it.
Ik ben geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen overname op woensdag 13 september 2017 gelijktijdig met het persbericht van a.s.r. hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de arbeidsinkomensquote

The MPs Leijten and Van Dijk (SP) asked why the labour income share has not risen despite falling unemployment, why unused labour supply remains large, whether flexible work suppresses wages, whether profits drive investment, and why purchasing power lags growth. Minister Asscher answers that wage growth is expected to pick up in a tightening labour market, that wage policy is largely a matter for social partners, and that the links between profits, investment and the labour share are not clear-cut.
Wage formation takes place at three levels: at the level of the legislator, at the level of the social partners and at the level of individual employers and employees.
Loonvorming vindt plaats op drie niveaus: op het niveau van de wetgever, op het niveau van de sociale partners en op het niveau van de individuele werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de winstgroei in hypotheken van ABN AMRO

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about Basel IV bank capital rules, ABN AMRO's loosened internal risk models for mortgages and SME loans, securitisation and capital markets union rules, and whether ABN AMRO's mortgage growth reflects a change in risk valuation. The minister answered that DNB will push for proportionate treatment of Dutch mortgages, that the state's shareholding does not make it involved in ABN AMRO's model choices, that mortgage growth reflects a stronger economy, and that the new securitisation rules add transparency.
As a shareholder, I am not involved in the considerations ABN AMRO makes in such activities.
Als aandeelhouder ben ik niet betrokken bij de afwegingen die ABN AMRO maakt bij dergelijke activiteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht «Rijken mijden fiscus langs nieuwe route» naar aanleiding van de aanstaande UBO-registratie ter bestrijding van witwassen, terrorismefinanciering en belastingontwij

An MP asked the Finance Minister about wealthy individuals using open funds for joint account (fondsen voor gemene rekening) to avoid fiscal transparency, especially ahead of the UBO register, and whether this undermines anti-money-laundering rules and affects benefit eligibility. The State Secretary answered that applications rose to about 550 by mid-August 2017, that the Tax Authority checks eligibility, that the UBO register is delayed due to implementation timing, and that no legislative measures are planned for now.
The Tax Authority will continue to closely monitor this development, and your House will be informed about it in line with the Bashir/Grashoff motion.
De Belastingdienst zal deze ontwikkeling goed blijven volgen, en uw Kamer zal – in lijn met de Motie Bashir/Grashoff 2 – daarover geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'BNG Bank: Europese investeringsbank verstoort de markt'

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the EIB and EFSI crowd out the market, as BNG Bank claimed, and whether this is desirable and will be raised with EIB management. The minister acknowledged the concern, stressed additionality of public investment, and said the Netherlands will keep raising additionality on the EIB board of governors.

The Netherlands sits on the EIB Board of Governors. Here the Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the importance of the additionality of EIB investments relative to the market when assessing specific projects.

Nederland heeft zitting in de Raad van Bewindvoerders van de EIB. Hier zal Nederland aandacht blijven vragen voor het belang van de «additionaliteit» van EIB investeringen ten opzichte van de markt bij de beoordeling van specifieke projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het artikel 'Helaas, geen nieuw huis dankzij BKR'

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether small debts or payment arrears leading to a negative BKR credit registration, and the BKR's handling of proportionality requests, deletion, retention periods, fees and transparency, are fair and whether the state should intervene. The Minister answered that the BKR is a private foundation, that a negative registration does not itself bar credit, that deletions are possible under proportionality rules, and that he expects a more pragmatic BKR approach by year-end while promising free access to personal data from May 2018 and publication of dispute rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over het bericht 'Elke maand honderden euro’s minder pensioen door Belastingdienst'

SP MPs asked why about 61,000 pensioners living in the Netherlands would lose hundreds of euros net per month under the new Dutch-German tax treaty, whether earlier assurances that seniors would not be affected were correct, and whether those affected were adequately informed. The state secretary answered that the 2013 income calculations, based on 2012 figures, may no longer reflect the situation given later tax changes, that the €15,000 threshold is intentional to reduce administrative burdens, that no change to the treaty is planned, and that affected residents were informed through the 2016 tax return and online channels.
It is therefore quite possible that the situation of these pensioners differs from what could be inferred from the income calculations made at the time.
Het is daarom goed mogelijk dat de situatie van deze gepensioneerden anders is dan uit de destijds gemaakte inkomensberekeningen kon worden opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bezoek aan het congres van de International Fiscal Association

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Ministry and Tax Authority officials attending the International Fiscal Association congress in Rio de Janeiro, including costs, programme, past participation and contacts with the tax world. The State Secretary answered that officials have attended for a long time, four people went (paid per Dutch rules), and the IFA is a non-lobby professional association whose contacts serve knowledge-building.
The International Fiscal Association is not a lobby club but an association that brings together tax advisers, corporate tax specialists, academics, governments and judges from around the world.
De International Fiscal Association is geen lobby club maar een vereniging die belastingadviseurs, bedrijfsfiscalisten, wetenschappers, overheden en rechters uit de hele wereld bij elkaar brengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘World Bank must stop encouraging harmful tax competition’

An SP MP asked the Finance and Development Cooperation ministers about the World Bank's Doing Business report, which she says encourages tax competition and a Washington-consensus market ideology, and about ignoring OECD/IMF evidence on tax incentives and FDI. The government rejects the ideology critique, defends the report's tax indicator as having a threshold against tax races, notes Dutch anti-avoidance efforts, and says it will discuss the concerns with the Dutch World Bank executive director.

The cabinet is of the view that the way the World Bank measures the tax burden on small and medium enterprises in the Doing Business report does not encourage entrepreneurs to engage in tax avoidance.

Het kabinet is van mening dat de wijze waarop de Wereldbank in het Doing Business -rapport de belastingdruk voor het midden- en kleinbedrijf in kaart brengt ondernemers niet aanmoedigt tot belastingontwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht “AFM waarschuwt voor cryptocurrencies als bitcoins en ethers”

Two Socialist Party MPs asked the Finance Minister about AFM warnings on cryptocurrencies, including bubble risks, investor information, regulation, money laundering and a possible DNB or virtual euro. The minister answered that the risks are largely borne by holders, that supervisors have warned consumers, that crypto assets fall outside financial supervision apart from anti-money-laundering rules, and that research is ongoing.
I will ask DNB to keep me informed about the development of a virtual euro and to inform the House when there are relevant developments.
Ik zal DNB vragen om mij op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkeling van een virtuele euro en de Kamer informeren wanneer er relevante ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raan over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten and Van Raan ask the State Secretary of Finance about the APA/ATR practice, including informal capital rulings, hybrid entities, financing and royalty activities, and re-invoicing. The State Secretary answers that the EU anti-tax-avoidance directives leave the informal capital doctrine intact but reduce risk through information exchange, and that the Tax Authority now tracks informal capital rulings and exchanges information on them.
From 1 July 2017 it will be explicitly recorded how many informal capital rulings are concluded.
Vanaf 1 juli 2017 wordt expliciet bijgehouden hoeveel informeel kapitaalrulings er worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de handel in probleemleningen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the trade in non-performing loans, including investor interest, supervision of buyers and risks for ECB and Italian public finances. The minister replied that the secondary market is small and mainly for professional investors, that banks and supervisors remain responsible for pricing and provisioning, and that the EU action plan includes insolvency and transparency measures.
Given the high risk profile and the expertise required, it seems to me that only professional investors should enter into such transactions with risk-bearing capital.
Gezien het hoge risicoprofiel en de benodigde kennis, ligt het wat mij betreft ook voor de hand dat alleen professionele investeerders dit soort transacties aangaan met risicodragend vermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het opdrijven van prijzen van hotelkamers door boekingswebsites

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the minister whether hotel-booking platforms' 'lowest price' clauses restrict hotels and whether they should be banned, along with commission rises, room vacancy effects and Booking.com's promotion of student room rentals. The minister rejected a ban, stating that platform contracts are private matters, that ACM has already loosened the clauses, and that rental of student rooms is restricted by contract and law rather than by Booking.com's campaign.
I am not aware of the content of such agreements, which are concluded between two private parties.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van dergelijke overeenkomsten die tussen twee private partijen worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat werkenden een steeds kleiner deel van de koek krijgen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that workers receive a shrinking share of market-sector income, including what it could do to raise the labour income share and whether public-sector pay could influence private wages. The minister replied that the labour income share is a wage-room indicator, that wage-setting is left to social partners and decentralised bargaining, and that the government gave no concrete new measures, leaving flex-contract and other choices to the next cabinet.
The main conclusion, however, was that wage policy requires tailoring and is therefore a matter for decentralised (collective agreement) parties.
Belangrijkste conclusie was echter dat loonbeleid maatwerk vereist en (dus) aan decentrale (cao-)partijen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Nederland wereldwijd het belangrijkste knooppunt voor belastingconstructies is

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he was surprised by research showing the Netherlands as a major conduit in offshore corporate ownership chains, whether this serves tax avoidance, and what he will do about harm to other countries and the link with treaties. Wiebes answered that the findings do not surprise him, that international efforts against tax avoidance are underway, that he sees no role for a new study, and that the Netherlands has no full tax treaty with 19 of the 24 sink jurisdictions.
I am not aware of any figures that answer the question posed.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend die antwoord geven op de gestelde vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over Oekraïne als drugsroute

Two SP MPs asked about a BBC/RTL documentary alleging drug smuggling through Ukraine and corruption among border guards, and what the EU has done about it. The minister answered that anti-corruption efforts have intensified since the Euromaidan, that the EU supports Ukrainian border reform with several million euros, and that the scale of drug flows cannot be reliably estimated.
This is difficult to estimate: Ukrainian data on intercepted drug shipments mainly concern quantities of drugs entering Ukraine.
Dit is moeilijk in te schatten: Oekraïense data over onderschepte drugszendingen zien immers vooral op hoeveelheden drugs die Oekraïne binnenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over voortvluchtige criminelen die geen belasting hoeven te betalen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether fugitive criminals can avoid paying tax in the Netherlands because of the durable-ties residence test, and whether this makes the Netherlands a tax haven for criminals. State Secretary Wiebes replied that residence is assessed on the circumstances, that the court ruling was specific to its facts, that Dutch rules do not differ from other countries, and that he sees no reason to depart from the residence principle for fugitives.
As stated, to my knowledge Dutch tax legislation does not differ in this respect from tax legislation in other countries.
Zoals gezegd wijkt de belastingwetgeving in Nederland in dit opzicht naar mijn weten niet af van de belastingwetgeving in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Deutsche bank verliest vertrouwen in Europese bankensector”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how he views Deutsche Bank's downgrade of European banks to 'underweight' and its implications for growth, bank buffers, ECB policy and eurozone integration. The minister replied that growth forecasts are stable, banks have strengthened capital, further prudential tightening is pursued at EU level, the eurozone is better placed than before the crisis, and no treaty change is currently on the agenda.
It is not for me to judge the valuation of (individual) shares.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de waardering van (individuele) aandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over wapenexport naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de oorlog in Jemen

Two SP MPs asked the government about arms exports to Yemen coalition states (Egypt, UAE navies), Airbus's tax ruling, investments by pension funds and banks in Airbus, and tax facilitation of Airbus. The government said it refuses export licences for coalition states where goods may be used in combat in Yemen, declined to disclose sales volumes and tax ruling details citing confidentiality, and said banks and pension funds are addressed through due-diligence and OECD guideline frameworks.
However, under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information about individual taxpayers can be provided.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan echter geen informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Europarlementariërs schimmig over miljoenen aan onkostenvergoedingen”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that MEPs are opaque about spending of their general expense allowance, and whether it will push for transparency. The minister answered that transparency over allowances is primarily for MEPs and the European Parliament to decide, that a flat-rate system applies under the MEP statute, and that the government will not itself take action toward Dutch MEPs.
The cabinet considers it up to the members of the European Parliament themselves to decide how and to what extent they wish to be transparent about expense allowances.
Het kabinet acht het aan de leden van het Europees Parlement zelf te bezien op welke wijze en in hoeverre zij transparantie wensen te betrachten over onkostenvergoedingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Landen zetten belastingconcurrentie voort met nieuwe middelen'

SP MP Leijten asked whether international anti-avoidance measures encourage countries to create new tax breaks, whether capital is taxed less and labour more, and whether the government will act against tax competition in the EU and OECD. State Secretary Wiebes answered that agreed international measures are the most effective tool, that corporate tax revenue has risen since 2014, and that he sees no need for new initiatives yet, while promising no concrete new step.
At this moment I see no reason to take new initiatives in this regard.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding daarbij nieuwe initiatieven te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat op Malta 70.000 bedrijven staan geregistreerd met als doel om belasting te ontlopen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about reports that Malta hosts 70,000 companies registered for tax avoidance, and about Dutch monitoring of Malta-linked structures, information from North Rhine-Westphalia, and Malta's tax regime. The State Secretary said the Tax Authority treats Malta like other countries, has tightened a rule on separate private assets, is awaiting information from Germany, and declined to judge Malta's tax regime or comment on the German minister's claims.
I have no specific information at my disposal with which I can test whether tax is being evaded via so-called shell companies in Malta.
Ik heb geen specifieke informatie tot mijn beschikking waarmee ik kan toetsen of belasting wordt ontweken via zogenoemde «shell companies» op Malta.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht “TiSA and the threat to public banks”

Two SP MPs asked the trade and finance ministers about a report claiming the TiSA services agreement threatens public banks and government regulatory room. The minister rejects this, arguing TiSA contains prudential and public-service carve-outs and leaves governments free to regulate.
The cabinet does not share the thrust of the publication.
Het kabinet deelt de strekking van de publicatie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie verdachte transacties bij een trustkantoor onderzoekt

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about reports that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating suspicious transactions at trust office BK Group, and about sanctions compliance, integrity, supervision capacity and related leaks. The Minister replied that trust offices must freeze assets of sanctioned persons and report to DNB, that a tightened trust-office supervision bill is planned, and that ongoing investigations cannot be commented on.
With the draft bill for a Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018, the aim is to make the regulatory framework for trust offices stricter.
Met het concept wetvoorstel voor een Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018 wordt beoogd het regelgevend kader voor trustkantoren strenger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de hoge belasting die letselschadeslachtoffers moeten betalen omdat de vergoeding vanwege letselschade als vermogen wordt gezien

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why compensation for personal injury counts as wealth, reducing entitlement to rent and health-care allowances and raising box 3 wealth tax, and whether victims could be exempted. The State Secretary answered that such compensation is wealth like any other, that exceptions would complicate the tax system, and that he does not intend to create an exemption, though a transitional arrangement exists for certain earlier awards.
In light of the above arguments, I do not intend to provide for an exception for personal injury compensation in the savings and investments base.
Gelet op bovenstaande argumenten, ben ik niet voornemens in een uitzondering voor letselschadevergoeding voor de grondslag sparen en beleggen te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Veel minder Oekraïense miljoenen bevroren dan gedacht”

An SP MP asked the government about reports that far fewer Ukrainian funds were frozen than previously claimed, and about sanctions, the Cyprus route, IMF and EU loans, and a Rostec-linked joint venture. The government answered that about EUR 380 million was reported frozen under the EU Ukraine/Russia sanctions, that the EU list is adequately identifying, that Ukraine must proceed with corruption cases, and that it cannot disclose individual tax positions.
This amount can be broken down into funds and assets.
Dit bedrag is onder te verdelen in middelen en tegoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Telegraaf artikel "ING-topman sluit spaarrente van nul niet uit"

Leijten (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether ING's CEO was right that negative savings rates cannot be ruled out, and about related effects on savers, banks and ECB policy. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that banks set their own rates, a negative rate on retail savings is not currently on the agenda, and that the causes and welfare effects of low rates and ECB policy are hard to quantify.
ECB monetary policy is not a direct input variable in the forecast of purchasing power of European and Dutch households.
Het monetaire beleid van de ECB is geen directe inputvariabele in de raming van de koopkracht van Europese en Nederlandse huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over ‘de ongekend hoge winstuitkeringen van bedrijven’

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister about record corporate dividend payouts, takeover fears, whether the strategic-takeover screening law should be widened, employee involvement in takeovers, ECB bond purchases and investment. The government answered that dividend decisions rest with companies, outlined existing takeover and works-council rules, proposed a telecom-focused control bill under consultation, and deferred tax and public-investment choices to a future cabinet.
The Minister of Finance meant by extending the law the bill on preventing undesirable control in telecommunications that the Minister of Economic Affairs put into consultation in February 2017.

De Minister van Financiën doelde met uitbreiding van de wet op het wetsvoorstel voorkoming ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie dat de Minister van Economische Zaken in februari 2017 in consultatie heeft gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Harde woorden over hoogleraren accountancy”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether accountancy professors are independent and critical enough, following criticism that they stay silent on the sector, and what commitments universities and the sector have made to guarantee their independence. The minister replied that codes of conduct and the VGBA safeguard independence, that outside roles are desirable for practical knowledge, that conflicts of interest cannot be fully excluded, and that accountants have acknowledged shortcomings in their public task.
From the conversations I have had with universities it appears that a large number of codes of conduct have been drawn up that must both safeguard independence and prevent conflicts of interest.

Uit de gesprekken die ik heb gevoerd met universiteiten blijkt dat er een groot aantal gedragscodes is opgesteld die zowel de onafhankelijkheid moeten waarborgen als belangenverstrengeling dienen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het achterblijven van het bestrijden van witwassen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers why the Netherlands lags internationally on combating money-laundering risks, including ING and trust office cases, Panama Papers follow-up, capital controls, UBO and shareholder registers, and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister responded at length, largely describing existing supervision, risk-based rules, DNB/AFM enforcement and planned monitors, while disputing the claim that financial institutions take due diligence insufficiently seriously and declining to comment on individual institutions due to confidentiality.
Due to the statutory duty of confidentiality, DNB cannot make further statements about individual institutions under its supervision.
In verband met de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kan DNB geen verdere uitspraken doen over individuele instellingen onder haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over stijgende winsten en haperende investeringen

Opposition MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why profits are rising while business investment lags, and whether corporate tax cuts would spur investment. The government answered that lower interest rates and cyclical factors explain tax revenue, that investment levels are not structurally low, and that investment decisions are primarily for firms, leaving further measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to decide on any measures to further promote business investment.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te besluiten over eventuele maatregelen om investeringen door het bedrijfsleven verder te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Salarissen topbankiers gaan door strengere EU-regels juist hard omhoog”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how to respond to reports that top European bankers' fixed salaries rose after stricter EU bonus rules, and whether bonus caps and fixed pay should be restricted. The minister acknowledged the signal is negative, stated the Netherlands applies a stricter 20% bonus cap than the EU's 100%, noted fixed pay is not capped under EU rules, and promised an evaluation of the Wbfo by 1 December.
An evaluation of the effects of the Wbfo is currently being carried out.
Momenteel wordt er een evaluatie uitgevoerd over de effecten van de Wbfo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Menzis keurmerken voor wijkverpleging verplicht heeft gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary about insurer Menzis requiring Kiwa quality marks for home-care staff, the threat of withheld payments, and whether such requirements are acceptable. The government answered that insurers may set quality conditions, that the Kiwa mark is a practical tool for self-employed carers, and that Menzis has improved its communication and contacted the affected carers.
An health insurer is free to set (quality) requirements for care providers as long as the content and scope of the entitlement are not restricted and the insurer fulfils its duty of care.
Een zorgverzekeraar is vrij om (kwaliteits)eisen te stellen aan zorgaanbieders zolang de inhoud en de omvang van de aanspraak hiermee niet wordt beperkt en de zorgverzekeraar zijn zorgplicht nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verantwoordingsstructuur van het ESM en de ECB

Ten MPs' written questions (Leijten, SP) ask the Finance Minister about the accountability of the ESM and the ECB, including a Transparency International report, austerity assumptions, treaty integration, the veto system, and ECB secret letters. The Minister answers that existing evaluations and parliamentary consultation suffice, that treaty integration is not urgent, that no further ECB inquiry is needed, and that several recommendations fall to the member states or the ECB itself.
The cabinet nevertheless sees it as a positive development that the ECB, where possible, gives openness about its decisions, recommendations and views.
Het kabinet ziet het evenwel als een goede ontwikkeling dat de ECB, waar mogelijk, openheid geeft over haar beslissingen, aanbevelingen en zienswijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat spaarders geen rente meer krijgen op hun spaargeld

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about banks cutting savings rates, including Triodos to zero, whether negative rates should be banned, whether savers could be pushed to hold cash, and whether lower rates on loans offset the loss. The minister answered that low rates stem from structural and cyclical factors beyond ECB policy, that he sees no need to ban negative rates, that the tax system now tracks actual returns, and that customers should pay for services.
For these reasons, I do not intend to take measures now to prohibit negative savings rates.
Om deze redenen ben ik niet van plan om nu maatregelen te nemen om negatieve spaarrentes te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het CBS meer ongelijkheid meet maar het als minder verkoopt

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that CBS measures higher inequality than previously assumed while presenting it as lower, including revisions, top-income censoring, dividend-tax effects and the Quote 500 comparison. Minister Dijsselbloem answered at length, explaining that revised methods and full population data raised measured inequality, that the Netherlands remains relatively low-inequality internationally, and committing only to possibly publishing supplementary figures on retained business profits.
The CBS is however examining the possibilities of making retained profits visible at household level as a supplement to the income concept used.
Het CBS onderzoekt evenwel de mogelijkheden om de niet uitgekeerde winsten wel op huishoudenniveau inzichtelijk te maken in aanvulling op het gehanteerde inkomensbegrip.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat onethische verdienmodellen van de farmaceutische industrie de prijzen voor geneesmiddelen opdrijven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether the price increases of four medicines bought by Essential Pharmaceuticals, which push patients into co-payments, are unethical and what can be done. The state secretary answered that price increases are legal, that the company refused to lower prices or disclose cost structures, that a maximum price has been set only for Camcolit, and that no means exist to recover costs from the manufacturer.
I cannot enforce this transparency, but it is very regrettable that Essential Pharmaceuticals has so far given no justification for the price increase
Ik kan deze transparantie niet afdwingen, maar het is zeer te betreuren dat Essential Pharmaceuticals tot op heden geen onderbouwing geeft van de prijsverhoging

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat veertig Nederlanders de Amerikaanse fabrikant van Bekkenbodem- en liesbreukmatjes Johnson en Johnson voor de rechter dagen wegens blijvende schad

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the reported lawsuit by about forty patients against Johnson & Johnson over pelvic floor mesh harm, and about related issues such as compensation, implant removal, information provision and market approval. The state secretary answered that the problem is regrettable, pointed to new EU medical device rules and the Wkkgz complaints regime, rejected a dedicated compensation fund, and said existing care and reporting rules already apply.
I cannot assess whether there is a case of inadequate measures here.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of er in dit geval sprake is van inadequate maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het kwaliteitskader “Verpleeghuiszorg, samen leren en verbeteren”

Member Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary about the nursing home quality framework, including whether it is deliberately vague, staffing minimums for intensive care, night and weekend cover, the role of the Inspectorate, and consultation and evidence behind it. The State Secretary defended the framework as setting clear minimum norms, said the Inspectorate adapted its framework, and explained staffing is context-dependent with the sector to develop local norms.
The Care Institute has included the nursing home care quality framework as a quality standard in its register.
Het Zorginstituut heeft het kwaliteitskader verpleeghuiszorg opgenomen als kwaliteitsstandaard in haar register.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten in Zuid-Holland korten op het pgb

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities in South Holland cut personal budgets (pgb) for parents of seriously ill children. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Youth Act, that the ministry has checked their approach, that the region has committed to better motivation of decisions, and that a further study of pgb trends will follow.
Municipalities are responsible for the implementation of the Youth Act.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Jeugdwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de waarschuwing van 120 huisartsen voor de dreigende fusie tussen het Havenziekenhuis in Rotterdam met het IJssellandziekenhuis in Capelle aan den IJssel

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether converting Havenziekenhuis Rotterdam into a polyclinic after a merger with IJsselland Ziekenhuis would reduce access to care for elderly patients, and whether the state should intervene. The minister replied that the polyclinic care continues, nearby hospitals remain accessible, the NZa and ACM will assess any merger, and the state sees no reason to intervene since care organisation is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers.
The organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of the care providers and health insurers involved.
De organisatie van de zorg in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de betrokken zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het conflict tussen de directie en radiologen in het Zuyderlandziekenhuis in Heerlen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the conflict between the board and radiologists at Zuyderland hospital, its impact on care quality, and conflicts of interest from radiologists owning shares in a private clinic. The state secretary answered that the IGZ has no signals of compromised care quality, that the hospital is not the employer of the radiologists, and that the governance code addresses conflicts of interest, while rejecting the premise that market forces prioritise competition over care.
If the IGZ receives signals that the quality and safety of care are at stake, it will act on them directly.
Indien de IGZ signalen bereiken dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid van zorg in het geding zijn zal zij hier direct naar handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de harde kritiek op de overgehevelde jeugdzorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about harsh criticism of the decentralised youth care, including deteriorating care, rising crisis placements, regional procurement withdrawals and whether decentralisation has failed. The State Secretary rejected claims of deteriorating care, pointed to regional cooperation efforts, a pending Hospers report on crisis placements, a planned bill to enforce standard arrangements, and said a first evaluation would come in early 2018.
The bill amending the Youth Act and the Social Support Act 2015 to reduce implementation burdens, which makes this possible, goes into consultation in May 2017.

Het wetsvoorstel «wijziging van de Jeugdwet en de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 in verband met het verminderen van de uitvoeringslasten» dat dit mogelijk maakt, gaat in mei 2017 in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de pilot wijkverpleging nu al verliesgevend is

An MP asks whether the Utrecht home-nursing pilot, reported as already loss-making, is leading to more hours from non-contracted providers and risks to patients, and whether the pilot should be halted. The State Secretary says there are no signals that care quality is at risk, that Zilveren Kruis (the insurer) is compensating preferred providers and considering checks on non-contracted providers, and that the pilot is a contractual matter for the insurer and providers, monitored by Zilveren Kruis and the NZa.
The pilots concern contractual arrangements between Zilveren Kruis and the providers.
De pilots betreffen contractafspraken tussen Zilveren Kruis en de aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de sluiting van de verzorgingshuizen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the closure of St. Clara nursing home in Gorinchem, its residents' relocation, the building's sale proceeds, and cuts to nursing-home places under the shift from institutional to home care. The State Secretary answered that the building was outdated, residents are being offered alternatives in consultation with the care office and client council, and that closures are not tracked centrally, with the government stating care offices must buy enough places.
No national list is kept of nursing homes that are closing or plan to close in 2017.
Er wordt landelijk geen lijst bijgehouden van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten of in 2017 voornemens zijn te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorginstelling Charim versnaperingen aan haar bewoners schrapt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that care provider Charim cut residents' small extras such as coffee and biscuits, and about whether directors who left received severance pay and whether intimidation persists. The State Secretary replied that the coffee and biscuit were not abolished but adjusted in consultation with the client council, that IGZ sees no need for direct intervention, and that severance details must be disclosed under WNT transparency rules in the annual report.
The cup of coffee and the biscuit with the coffee for residents at the Mirtehof and Amandelhof locations have not been abolished.
Het kopje koffie en het koekje bij de koffie aan de bewoners van de locaties Mirtehof en Amandelhof zijn niet afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de protesten tegen het verplicht in moeten vullen en aan moeten leveren van routine outcome measure (Rom) gegevens in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about protests against mandatory Routine Outcome Measurement (ROM) data collection and submission in mental health care, raising concerns about privacy, informed consent, reliability of data, and SBG's independence and financing. The Minister defends ROM as a standard set by sector parties, argues SBG's data is pseudonymised and privacy-protected, acknowledges that consent is the legal basis after the Dutch Data Protection Authority's ruling, and says a legislative review may be needed.

Obtaining explicit patient consent is one of the grounds. Since the consent requirement became the only legal basis for ROM after the AP ruling, I am consulting with parties and the AP, and I want to see whether further legislation is needed.

Het verkrijgen van expliciete toestemming van de patiënt is een van de grondslagen. Omdat het toestemmingsvereiste sinds de genoemde uitspraak van de AP de enige wettelijke grondslag is voor ROM, ben ik in overleg met partijen en de AP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de financiële relatie tussen de gemeenten en het rijk verstoord is

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about advice from the Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen on simplifying the state-municipality finance system, multi-year certainty for municipal funding, earmarking social-domain budgets, and a CBS report on municipal reserves; the government answered that the review is ongoing, that the normering system is independent of social-domain cuts, that earmarking is rejected in favour of spending freedom with monitoring via Iv3 and the overall social-domain report, and that the CBS figures were not wrong. The answers are largely defensive, deferring to later decisions and reports, while committing to forward the review and reports.
The cabinet is of the view that spending conditions do not fit the principle of the decentralisations, namely policy and spending freedom at municipal level, within the legal framework.

Het kabinet is van mening dat bestedingsvoorwaarden niet passen bij het uitgangspunt van de decentralisaties, namelijk beleidsvrijheid en bestedingsvrijheid op gemeentelijk niveau, binnen de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Leijten over overname van huishoudelijke verzorging door Tzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the planned transfer of home-care services from Amstelring to Tzorg, including worker consultation, wage and terms-of-employment protection, and municipal oversight. The government answered that the Autoriteit Consument & Markt is reviewing the takeover, that works councils approved it after conditions were agreed, that transfer rules protect workers' rights, and that municipalities are monitoring compliance.
It is not for me to assess these plans.
Het is niet aan mij om deze plannen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een bestuurder 65.000 euro kreeg zonder een dag te werken

An MP asked the minister about a care executive who received a 65,000 euro severance payment without working for the organisation, whether this complies with the WNT pay-cap law, how often such arrangements occur, and about appointment favouritism and oversight failures at Vivantes. The government answered that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary (max 75,000 euro) and sees no need to change it, that the supervisor found no such cases in 2014–2015, that the supervisory board failed and is resigning, and that the inspectorate will monitor the situation.
The supervisory board clearly did not function properly.
De raad van toezicht heeft duidelijk niet goed gefunctioneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw patiëntenstops zijn in de wijkverpleging

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports of renewed patient-intake stops in community nursing, the 20% budget cut, staff shortages, families being relied upon, and workforce issues. The State Secretary replies that the budget is sufficient, that insurers bear the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that a sector-wide process to improve procurement for 2018 is underway, while committing to a monitor report and continued monitoring.
I expect the NZa monitor on the 2017 community nursing contracting process at the end of March, which will give a clearer picture of the agreements made between insurers and providers.
Ik verwacht eind maart de monitor van de NZa over het contracteerproces wijkverpleging 2017 waaruit een duidelijker beeld komt van de gemaakte afspraken tussen zorgverzekeraars en aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over zorgverzekeraars die nog altijd de restitutietarieven voor niet-gecontracteerde geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) niet bekend hebben gemaakt

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why insurers Menzis, VGZ and De Friesland had not yet published restitution tariffs for non-contracted mental health care, and whether this discouraged care and warranted enforcement. Minister Schippers attributed the delay to late NZa tariff decisions after an insurers' appeal, said the tariffs were now published, that continuity of care was not at risk, and that current rules were adequate.
The health insurers have informed me that, due to the late publication of the NZa tariffs, they were able to publish their list of maximum reimbursements for non-contracted care later than planned.

De zorgverzekeraars hebben mij laten weten dat zij door de late bekendmaking van de NZa-tarieven hun lijst met maximale vergoedingen voor niet-gecontracteerde zorg later dan gepland hebben kunnen publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de arbeidsvoorwaarden in wijkteams hard achteruit gaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that employment conditions of social neighbourhood team staff are deteriorating, including loss of permanent contracts and pay cuts after reorganisations. The State Secretary answered that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that existing employment protections and employer obligations apply, and that the ministry has no data and sees no reason for further investigation or intervention.
I do not have figures on how many people working in social neighbourhood teams have seen their employment conditions worsen due to organisational changes.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over hoeveel mensen die werkzaam zijn in sociale wijkteams er bij organisatieveranderingen in arbeidsvoorwaarden op achteruit zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de veiligheid in operatiekamers onder druk staat door een tekort aan operatieassistenten en verpleegkundigen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that operating-theatre safety is under pressure from shortages of surgical assistants and nurses, including whether non-qualified nurses perform theatre tasks, nurse sick leave, training capacity cuts and the rise of agency work. The Minister answered that staffing and safety are primarily the employers' responsibility, that the Capacity Body sees national supply as just sufficient and advises expanding training, and that she will monitor employers' efforts and act if needed.
Ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of care provided in a hospital are the board members and internal supervisory directors.
Eindverantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geboden zorg in een ziekenhuis zijn de bestuurders en interne toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat huisartsen arme patiënten gratis overgebleven medicijnen geven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that GPs give leftover medicines free to patients who cannot afford care, and about conflicting evidence on care avoidance caused by the deductible. The Minister says the GP survey does not establish frequency, opposes handing out medicines outside the pharmacy, and argues non-financial reasons also explain care avoidance while listing existing compensation measures.
I consider it undesirable that people avoid necessary care for financial reasons.
Ik vind het ongewenst als mensen vanwege financiële redenen noodzakelijke zorg mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de forse toename van wachttijden in ziekenhuizen en poliklinieken

An MP asks the Minister of Health why waiting times in hospitals and outpatient clinics rose from 2014 to 2016 according to Mediquest, whether this shows a structural problem, and whether the budget and revenue-cap system causes waiting lists. The Minister replies that average waits remain within the Treeknorm, that the NZa is investigating whether long waits breach insurers' duty of care, and that transparency rules and insurer wait-list mediation already apply.
The NZa is additionally examining to what extent longer waiting times are problematic for citizens and actually lead to insurers failing to meet their duty of care.
De NZa onderzoekt daarnaast in hoeverre lange(re) wachttijden problematisch zijn voor burgers en daadwerkelijk leiden tot het niet naleven van de zorgplicht door zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een zorgbestuurder de verpleeghuisnorm van Hugo Borst niet realistisch vindt

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health whether a care executive's claim that the 2-staff-to-8-residents nursing home norm is unrealistic is correct, along with questions on staffing costs, labour market shortages, managers in care, governance conflicts at Fundis/Alliade, and whether the minister distances herself from the manifesto. The State Secretary disputes or declines to verify the executive's figures, defends the Zorginstituut's decision not to adopt a generic numeric staffing norm, promises an analysis of financial effects by end February 2017, and says he sees no problem with the governance issues beyond the boards' own responsibility.
I have no insight into how exactly the calculation in question was arrived at.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de wijze waarop de betreffende berekening precies tot stand is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de door een farmaceutisch bedrijf opgezette website ‘Dokter Jaap’ dat huisartsen benadert om erectiepillen voor te schrijven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether the website 'Dokter Jaap', set up with Eli Lilly, which approaches GPs to prescribe erectile dysfunction pills to men who left their data, is lawful and acceptable, including its unsecured email handling of health data. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ is investigating the website and its parties, that GDPR-style consent rules and medical confidentiality apply and the AP may investigate, and that she has no information on GP approaches or other similar websites.
The IGZ has informed me that it is investigating the website and the working methods of the parties involved.
De IGZ heeft mij laten weten dat zij de website en de werkwijze van de betrokken partijen onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de financiering van zorg voor kwetsbare ggz-patiënten bij Arkin

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about Zilveren Kruis Achmea's refusal to pay Arkin over €10 million for mental health care to vulnerable patients, and whether this endangers care and breaches contracts. The Minister answered that the dispute is a private contract matter for the independent dispute body and courts, that insurers have a care duty, and that she sees no need to change wait-list oversight or the Zvw/Wlz boundary now, though an uitvoeringstoets on Wlz access is pending.
This concerns a contract between a care provider and a health insurer. I am not a party to it.
Het betreft hier een contract tussen een zorgaanbieder en een zorgverzekeraar. Ik ben daarin geen partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat 1 op de 3 mensen ontevreden is over de zorg en ondersteuning

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the government accepts responsibility for the roughly one million people reporting unmet care needs after the 2015 reforms, citing a SCP report. The State Secretary answered that the SCP data do not show care being withheld, that the number receiving help stayed stable, that unmet need does not equal requested help, and that existing legal safeguards suffice, committing to no new action.
This does not appear from the SCP research 'Care and support in the Netherlands: key figures 2015'.
Dit blijkt niet uit het onderzoek «Zorg en ondersteuning in Nederland: kerncijfers 2015» van het SCP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars steeds vaker op de stoel van de arts gaan zitten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister whether insurers overriding specialists' referrals for rehabilitation care, and demanding medical data, breaches the insurers' duty of care and amounts to risk selection. The minister answered that insurers may check entitlement and refuse prior approval on care grounds, that complaints can go to the NZa, and that she would not intervene directly, while the NZa is responsible for enforcing the duty of care.
If a patient believes they are unjustly kept waiting, or a procedure lasts 'months' without the insurer intervening, they can report this to the NZa.
Mocht een patiënt van mening zijn dat hij onterecht moet wachten, of een procedure duurt «maandenlang» zonder dat de zorgverzekeraar ingrijpt, dan kan hij dat melden bij de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Leijten over het bericht dat kinder IC’s in Nederland vol zouden zitten

MPs Bruins Slot and Leijten asked whether all Dutch paediatric intensive care units were full in December 2016, forcing cancelled elective surgery and transfers abroad, and about capacity, staffing, oversight and discharge problems. The minister confirmed that all eight PICUs were full, that some elective operations were postponed for at least three weeks and ten children were transferred to Belgian and German hospitals, while noting the IGZ was informed and that the NVK and hospital heads will analyse causes and propose improvements.
I expect the PICUs to implement these quickly.
Ik verwacht van de PICU’s dat ze één en ander snel doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het rapport ‘Een tragische gebeurtenis in Tergooi’ van de onderzoekscommissie Meurs

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the Meurs commission report on the death of a 21-year-old patient at Tergooi hospital, including whether the settlement agreement amounted to an unacceptable gag clause, whether the hospital board and IGZ bear responsibility, and whether calamity definitions and the ban on restrictive settlements should change. The minister acknowledged the agreement contained undesirable confidentiality terms, said the board is responsible for it, reported fines and a disciplinary complaint, defended the current calamity-reporting policy, and promised a letter on settlements in Q1 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat tienduizenden spiraaltjes worden teruggeroepen

SP MPs asked the Health Minister about the recall of tens of thousands of Mirena contraceptive coils, covering when and how the defect was found, prevention, which women are affected, and where to report problems. The minister answered that the recall was agreed with the IGZ and CBG, that at most 200 coils from the batch may be faulty, that the fabricator issued professional notices and advised echo checks for unchecked insertions, and that reporting points are available.
It cannot be said how many of the 200 possibly incorrectly assembled coils were dispensed in the Netherlands.
Het is niet te zeggen hoeveel van de 200 mogelijk verkeerd geassembleerde spiralen er in Nederland uitgegeven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het inzichtelijk maken van de bij zorgverzekeraars gedeclareerde zorg in relatie tot de zorguitgaven

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how the Council of State ruling that the NZa rightly refused to disclose per-provider DIS claims data affects transparency, whether prices count as confidential business information, and whether the law should change. The Minister answered that the ruling does not stop the goal of price transparency, that the NZa is preparing a traject for public access to hospital tariffs in 2017, and that no legislative change is needed.
The ruling on DIS data on declared care products per provider does nothing to diminish the importance of increasing insight for patients and insured persons into hospital tariffs.
De uitspraak over DIS-gegevens over gedeclareerde zorgproducten per zorgaanbieder doet niets af aan het belang om voor patiënten en verzekerden inzicht in de ziekenhuistarieven te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de uitzending van Zembla waaruit blijkt dat cliënten onvoldoende gewezen worden op de risico’s bij Lasik-oogchirurgie

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister, after a Zembla broadcast, whether patients receive inadequate warnings about Lasik risks and whether clinics misleadingly market the surgery, and whether the inspectorate should intervene. The minister answered that providers must inform patients under the WGBO, that she sees no reason yet for re-evaluation or closures, and that the inspectorate will act only on signals of acute danger.
Based on this broadcast, it is insufficiently clear to me whether patients have been adequately informed.
Het is voor mij op basis van deze uitzending onvoldoende duidelijk of patiënten voldoende zijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat artsen vaker kiezen voor pillen van farmaceuten waarvan zij sponsorgeld ontvangen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reports that doctors prescribe more expensive drugs from pharma companies that sponsor them, and whether sponsorship, visits and the Transparency Register explain this and should be restricted. The minister answered that the data cannot show extra spending or causation, leaves follow-up research to insurers, and rejects an immediate ban on sponsorship and doctor visits.
The research does not indicate how much extra money has been spent as a result.
Het onderzoek geeft niet aan hoeveel extra geld hierdoor is uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de wonderlijke herindicatie van Maartje

An SP MP asks the State Secretary why a client with an intellectual disability was refused Wlz care at reassessment, why the CIZ relied on a 1999 school test, and what support she will receive. The State Secretary declines to discuss the individual case because an objection is pending, explains the general rules and transition arrangements, and provides figures on negative Wlz decisions after temporary LVG/SGLVG profiles.
While this objection is pending, I cannot go into this individual case in more detail.
Hangende dit bezwaar kan ik niet nader in gaan op deze individuele zaak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat bij het UMC Utrecht ruim anderhalf jaar lang procedurefouten zijn gemaakt bij het IVF-laboratorium

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports of over a year and a half of procedural errors at the UMC Utrecht IVF laboratory, possibly leading to 26 women being inseminated with another man's sperm, and about the inspectorate's role, support for affected couples and oversight. The minister answered that a SIRE investigation is underway, the IGZ will assess the report, affected couples have been informed and offered support, and inspection frequency and IVF laboratory checks were described.

The inspectorate's research report, which will among other things address the actions taken by both the UMC Utrecht and the IGZ to safeguard quality and patient safety requirements, is expected to be completed in March and I will then send it to your House.

Het onderzoeksrapport van de inspectie, dat onder meer in zal gaan op de acties die door zowel het UMC Utrecht als de IGZ zijn genomen om de kwaliteit en eisen voor patiëntveiligheid te borgen, wordt naar verwachting in maart afgerond en zal ik vervolgens aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat duizenden gehandicapten niet naar de dagbesteding kunnen omdat zorginstellingen onvoldoende geld krijgen

MP Leijten (SP) asks why thousands of disabled people cannot attend day care because institutions lack funds for transport, and whether cuts since 2013 halved the transport budget and led to lost day care, charging for transport, and reduced quality. The State Secretary answers that the NZa found no threat to care duty or minimum quality, that institutions can reallocate within their budgets, that no further research is needed, and that the broader Wlz tariff review will only conclude by 2019.
It is up to institutions to make funds available for this within the total available budget.
Het is aan instellingen om binnen het totale beschikbare budget daarvoor middelen vrij te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen dit jaar al 304 keer melding hebben gedaan van het verlies van privacygevoelige informatie

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister how she views reports that hospitals filed 304 data-leak notifications this year and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) has been sufficiently strict in supervising them, including questions on sanctions, naming hospitals and the role of the Inspectorate. The minister answered that the AP is an independent supervisor responsible for enforcement and publication decisions, that she has no reason to think the AP neglects its role, and that the Inspectorate intervenes when patient safety is at stake, while promising a patient-data security action plan.
This is a matter for the AP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onzichtbare samenwerking van het ministerie van VWS met The Commonwealth Fund, Celsus en IQ healthcare

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the origins, costs and reporting of VWS cooperation with The Commonwealth Fund, Celsus and IQ Healthcare, including congress visits, fellowships and an ambtenaar holding a professorship. The Minister described how the Commonwealth Fund ties began in 2006, gave yearly cost tables, argued that congress visits comply with conduct rules, and declined to answer some questions on loyalty and staffing or to meet the one-week deadline.
Data on other costs associated with the cooperation with the Commonwealth Fund are not tracked separately and therefore cannot be provided.
Gegevens over overige kosten die gemoeid zijn met de samenwerking met het Commonwealth Fund worden niet apart bijgehouden en kunnen dus niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het inzichtelijk maken van de bij zorgverzekeraars gedeclareerde zorg in relatie tot de zorguitgaven

Two MPs from the SP asked the health minister whether transparency on declared care should extend beyond the deductible, whether it serves parliament's oversight role, whether DIS data can be published in anonymised form, and how this relates to NZa pricing transparency. The minister answered that price transparency serves patients and parliament's oversight, that declared care does not equal insurers' administrative costs, that anonymised aggregated DIS data is not contrary to the Wob, and that the NZa is working towards stepwise publication of price data.
Insight into declared care has significant added value at an aggregate level for tracking developments in care expenditure, among other things for the oversight role of your House.

Inzicht in gedeclareerde zorg heeft op geaggregeerd niveau een belangrijke meerwaarde om ontwikkelingen in de zorguitgaven te kunnen volgen, onder meer met het oog op de controlerende taak van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over lip filler behandeling bij meisjes onder de 18 door ‘cosmetisch’ artsen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Minister of Health about cosmetic lip filler treatment of girls under 18 and related oversight of cosmetic clinics and doctors, including complaints from plastic surgeons and the training standards dispute. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ has no reports of fillers given to under-18s, is examining the broadcast cases and calling clinics to account, and is working on quality norms and a cosmetic-doctor training curriculum with the professional bodies.
The use of mystery guests must not be deployed lightly when minors are involved, also called 'lure youngsters' in this context.
Antwoord 5 De inzet van mystery guests moet niet lichtvaardig ingezet worden, als het om een minderjarigen gaat, in dit verband ook wel «lokjongeren» genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe zorgverzekering voor ouderen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about a new VGZ insurance product for older people developed with the Nationaal Ouderenfonds and ANBO, including subsidies, commissions, advisers' fees, solidarity concerns and transparency of intermediary payments. The minister answered that it is a collective arrangement on existing policies rather than a new insurer, that the organisations receive no commission from VGZ, and that transparency of intermediary remuneration should improve.
I have no insight into the subsidies these older-persons organisations receive from other governments.
Ik heb geen zicht op de subsidies die deze ouderenorganisaties van andere overheden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over nieuwe schandalen bij Philadelphia

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a young woman with an intellectual disability who was reportedly subjected to coercive care and confinement at Philadelphia without a court authorisation, along with indication upcoding, a visitation restriction on her stepfather, and calls for independent investigations. The State Secretary said the IGZ had handled a 2014 complaint and closed it in 2015, that Philadelphia has commissioned an external investigation which the IGZ will assess, and that he cannot comment on the specific case until then.
Only once the facts are on the table and the IGZ has assessed Philadelphia's investigation report can I give a substantive response to what happened.
Pas als de feiten boven tafel zijn en de IGZ het onderzoeksrapport van Philadelphia heeft beoordeeld, kan ik een inhoudelijke reactie geven op het gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over misstanden met mentorschap in de zorg

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about a case in which care provider Philadelphia requested a mentorship for a resident without her family's knowledge, and about how often such requests occur and whether they are monitored. The government answered that an independent external investigation is underway, that the court must hear the person and relatives before appointing a mentor, and that complaints about mentorship have not been referred to the inspectorate, while promising an evaluation of the 2014 law.
Only once all the facts are known and the IGZ has assessed the investigation report can I give a substantive response to Philadelphia's conduct.
Pas als alle feiten boven tafel zijn en de IGZ het onderzoeksrapport heeft beoordeeld, kan ik een inhoudelijke reactie geven op het handelen van Philadelphia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over reclame van zorgverzekeraars die zich via direct mailings richt op mensen met een hoog inkomen of opleidingsniveau

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer Promovendum (part of VGZ) targets higher-educated and higher-income people through direct mailings, which they argued amounts to risk selection, and what criteria and costs apply. The minister answered that the mailings are legal, that Promovendum now omits the 'higher educated' target label, that the NZa will be asked to examine the practice, and that the requested client data is commercially confidential.
This is commercially confidential information that I do not have in my possession.
Dit is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die ik niet in bezit heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het commerciële tv-programma "een nieuw begin"?

SP MPs asked the Health and Culture ministers about the commercial TV programme 'een nieuw begin', which allegedly pressed participants into unnecessary cosmetic and dental treatments, and whether clinics and the Inspectorate had acted. The minister called it a worrying signal, said patient consent and information duties apply, noted the Inspectorate had no complaints about the programme and was investigating CDC Tandzorg on unrelated complaints, and said RTL and producers bear responsibility and will be reviewed.
The Inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of the ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van het lopende onderzoek kan de Inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de uitzending van Rambam met als onderwerp dokteronline.nl

SP MPs asked the health minister about a broadcast on dokteronline.com, a Curaçao-based site selling prescription medicines without a doctor visit, and whether her 2010 warning about online sales still stands and what concrete measures she has taken. The minister confirmed the warning, listed the 2011 law changes, notice-and-takedown agreements, the EU logo scheme and campaigns, and said the Inspectorate can act only against Dutch-based practitioners, so it is contacting Curaçao and foreign authorities.
As far as the IGZ is aware, Dokteronline.com no longer has any BIG-registered doctors or pharmacists working from the Netherlands.
Zover bekend bij de IGZ, zijn er bij Dokteronline.com geen artsen of apothekers meer werkzaam die BIG-geregistreerd zijn en vanuit Nederland werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar CZ prostaatkankerzorg wil concentreren in Rotterdam en Nijmegen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether health insurer CZ's plan to concentrate prostate cancer care in Rotterdam and Nijmegen was desirable, and about the wider concentration of care and quality norms. The minister answered that concentration can improve quality, that insurers make their own purchasing policy, that the Zorginstituut has no coordinating role, and that she sees no reason to address CZ.
The Zorginstituut currently has no task, and therefore no powers, to coordinate such a concentration.
Het Zorginstituut heeft op dit moment geen taak, en dus ook geen bevoegdheden, om een dergelijke concentratie te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zorgorganisaties die steeds meer betalen aan accountants

Two SP MPs asked why healthcare organisations spent rising sums on accountants, with the big four firms taking most of it, and whether the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet caused extra bureaucracy. The state secretary answered that accountancy control is necessary, that costs fell on average, that the rise is due to more contracting parties under the new laws, and that standardisation tools and possible further regulation are being pursued.
I do not have the figures on the accountancy costs of these mental health providers and therefore cannot confirm whether this expectation is correct.
Ik beschik niet over de cijfers van de accountantskosten van deze ggz-aanbieders en kan dus niet staven of deze verwachting wel of niet terecht is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de schier eindeloze nasleep van de calamiteit in mei 2007 in het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMC Groningen), waarbij Jelmer Mulder buitengewoon ernstige en onherste

MP Leijten and Van Gerven ask the ministers about the long-running legal dispute after the 2007 UMC Groningen calamity that left baby Jelmer Mulder with severe brain damage, questioning the IGZ's handling, the hospital's conduct in court, and whether the minister can direct the hospital to settle. The minister replies that the IGZ report cannot be published, that the IGZ has apologised and offered compensation, that civil liability is for the civil court, and that the IGZ cannot use its Wkkgz instruction power to force settlement of a civil claim.
The IGZ report of 14 July 2011, as well as the IGZ report of 6 December 2010 withdrawn by the IGZ, is not public.
Het rapport van de IGZ van 14 juli 2011, evenals het door de IGZ ingetrokken rapport d.d. 6 december 2010, is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Indicaties voor zware verpleeghuiszorg halveren’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the CIZ's sharp drop in severe nursing-home care indications, and misleading information on its website, mean care recipients get too-low indications and care providers lose funding. The State Secretary replied that the indication process is careful, that the number of unique entitled clients has stayed stable at about 17,000 to 20,000, that no CIZ quota was set, and that objections remain possible.
I have taken note of this and have consulted with the CIZ.
Ik heb hiervan kennis genomen en ik ben met het CIZ in overleg getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het te vaak urgent uitrukken van ambulances door een nieuw triagesysteem

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about a survey claiming a new triage system leads to too many urgent ambulance dispatches, with possible harm and accident risks, and about insurers' duty of care. The minister acknowledged signals of unnecessary urgent rides but reported no evidence of patient harm, said accident data are not registered nationally and that a limited study and evaluations are pending, and promised to decide on changes after those evaluations.
Accidents involving ambulances are currently not registered nationally.
Ongevallen met ambulances worden op dit moment niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de relatie tussen The Commonwealth Fund, The Harkness Fellowship, onderzoeksprogramma Celsus, IQ healthcare, Radboud umc en haar ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the links between the Commonwealth Fund, the Harkness Fellowship, the Celsus programme, IQ healthcare, Radboud umc and the ministry, including whether the ministry's funding and staff involvement compromise independence. The minister replied that the ministry's participation is a shared-cost survey and fellowship arrangement, that selection is run by an independent committee, and that there is no risk of influence on outcomes.
I have no insight into the financing and bookkeeping of IQ Healthcare.
Ik heb geen zicht op financiering en boekhouding van IQ Healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het melden en onafhankelijk onderzoeken van calamiteiten bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister why a maternal death at the Diakonessenhuis was not reported as a calamity and whether the external investigator's conduct and the IGZ's handling were sound. The minister acknowledged the failure, said the IGZ found the first investigation not carefully conducted and ordered a new one, but refused to publish the final IGZ report, declined to re-examine other cases, and promised a circular on calamity reporting.
Until then, the IGZ does not make individual calamity reports and reports public for the time being.
Totdat hiervan sprake is maakt de IGZ afzonderlijke calamiteitenmeldingen en -rapportages vooralsnog niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de patiëntenstop van het Nij Smellinghe

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the patient admission stop at Nij Smellinghe hospital, its effect on waiting times and travel costs, insurer responsibility, and patient choice under restitution policies. The minister answered that the hospital has not stopped all work, that insurers bear duty of care enforced by the NZa, and that restitution rules are being tightened from 2017.
