The NZa supervises that insurers, for insured persons unwilling to wait longer than these standard times, mediate in finding other care providers who can deliver care within the set standard times.

De NZa ziet er op toe dat zorgverzekeraars, voor die verzekerden die niet langer willen wachten dan deze normtijden, bemiddelen bij het vinden van andere zorgaanbieders die wel binnen de gestelde normtijden zorg kunnen verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de belasting van huisartsen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about GP workload, administrative burden, burnout, practice size norms and training capacity after a Leiden GP quit filling in insurer checklists. The Minister replied that bureaucracy has been reduced through the 'Het Roer Gaat Om' process, that she has no data on GPs leaving practice, and that she sees no need for further measures, while promising a monitor and a capacity forecast.
I do not know how many GPs leave their work early, or for what reason.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel huisartsen vroegtijdig stoppen met hun werk en met welke reden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zorg voor oudere patiënt onder druk’ in De Medisch Specialist

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that elderly patients cannot safely return home after hospital care, and about proposals to extend out-of-hours admissions and alleged fraud pressure. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the eerstelijns verblijf and the Praktijkteam, said he rejects fraud, and said a regional best-practice list is being developed without committing to a new binding step.
The Praktijkteam "zorg op de juiste plek" has been active for some time to support parties in tackling bottlenecks at local level.
Het Praktijkteam «zorg op de juiste plek» is al geruime tijd op pad om partijen te ondersteunen om knelpunten op lokaal niveau aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZBC’s ontduiken verbod winstuitkering’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether standalone treatment centres evade the ban on profit distribution and good-governance rules through BV structures and direct contracting, and whether investigations or new rules would follow. The minister replied that outsourcing is permitted, that the IGZ and NZa supervise compliance and can intervene case by case, and that she sees no need for her own investigation or for banning outsourcing to subsidiaries.
Supervision of compliance with the profit-making ban rests with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
Het toezicht op de naleving van het verbod op winstoogmerk is neergelegd bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onterechte suggestie dat fysiotherapie van mensen in de aanvullende verzekering vergoed is

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether insurers forcing physiotherapists to treat patients less than covered, via the behandelindex, is acceptable and whether it breaches the insurer's duty of care. Minister Schippers answered that treatment numbers are for the professional to judge, that the behandelindex is a benchmark used as mirror information (with some insurers linking it to contracts in exceptional cases), and promised to raise its use with stakeholders.
It cannot be the case that a care provider stops a necessary treatment for financial motives.
Het kan niet zo zijn dat een zorgverlener uit financiële motieven een noodzakelijke behandeling stopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Gideonsbende voor de verpleeghuiszorg

MP Leijten asked how the 'Gideonsbende' advisory group of care practitioners was formed, who its members are, whether they are linked to Inspectorate measures, whether its discussions are secret and whether members are paid. The State Secretary answered that members were selected through contacts in the field, listed 21 members, noted one member's organisation had an Inspectorate instruction, stated discussions are not secret but no minutes are kept, and that members receive no compensation.
No minutes are made of the meetings, because none of the members indicated they wanted them.
Van de bijeenkomsten worden geen verslagen gemaakt, omdat geen van de leden heeft aangegeven daarop prijs te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van vaccinaties bij kinderen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister why a nine-year-old disabled boy's vaccination was not reimbursed when it had to take place away from the planned location, and whether exceptions exist. The minister acknowledged poor communication in that case, said vaccination is always free with alternative locations or home visits, and estimated such exceptions occur only a few dozen times a year.
I have taken note of the report and regrettably must note that communication in this situation did not go well.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de melding en moet helaas constateren dat de communicatie in deze situatie niet goed is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de noodkreet over de nieuwe contracteerronde fysiotherapie

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a physiotherapists' distress call on the 2017 contracting round, including opaque use of the treatment index, quality-measurement conditions, benchmarks, below-cost tariffs, and third-party access to patient records. Minister Schippers answered at length, largely deferring to private insurer-provider negotiations, noting NZa oversight, transparency rules, and ongoing working-group and monitoring initiatives, while committing to follow-up but not to new binding action.
The contract terms form part of a contract between two private parties, to which the NZa does not automatically have access.
De contractvoorwaarden maken onderdeel uit van een contract tussen twee private partijen, hier heeft de NZa niet zonder meer inzage in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Leijten over het bericht dat er meer mensen onder de brug slapen

MPs Bashir and Leijten asked the government about reports of more people sleeping under a bridge in Rotterdam, rising homelessness, and the causes and policy response. The state secretary answered that causes of homelessness are diverse, that responsibility for shelter capacity lies mainly with municipalities, and listed measures such as housing reforms, a Platform31 experiment and a quality framework, without giving a full account of why earlier policy failed.
Responsibility for shelter capacity and for the flow from shelters into housing therefore lies at these levels (municipal and regional).
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de capaciteit in opvangcentra en de doorstroom vanuit de centra naar huisvesting ligt dan ook op deze niveaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bureaucratie waar mantelzorgers mee te maken hebben

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the administrative burden on informal carers, including the estimated 900 million euro cost, a mother's 65-page PGB accountability demands, and whether the government had foreseen the burden. The state secretary acknowledges the burden, points to a regulatory-reduction programme, a commissioned study on reform-related administrative costs, and a planned web portal, but denies a link to cost-cutting and defers details on the individual case.
Once this study is completed, your House will receive the study including a policy response.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, ontvangt uw Kamer dit onderzoek inclusief een beleidsreactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de noodopvang voor ouderen een gat in de markt is

Leijten (SP) asked whether emergency short-stay care for elderly people, introduced by Amsta, reflects closing nursing homes and lighter care being pushed out of institutions, and what the government will do so elderly people get care when needed. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the short-stay first-line care is a welcome addition, will fall under the Zvw from 2017, that no extra capacity is created, and that the budget was raised by 29.5 million euros.
The moving out of institutions of the lighter care packages mainly concerns people who previously lived permanently in an institution with a relatively light care need.
Het extramuraliseren van de lichtere zorgzwaartepakketten heeft vooral betrekking op mensen die voorheen permanent in een instelling verbleven met een relatief lichte zorgvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat een ruzie tussen verschillende trombosediensten de patiënten zou duperen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that a dispute between thrombosis services endangers patients, and about the safety, evidence and prescribing of newer anticoagulants (NOACs) versus traditional ones. The Minister denied any signals of patient harm or calamities, reported that the Medicines Evaluation Board judges the NOACs' benefit-risk balance positive, and said further research and monitoring are under way.
I currently have no signals that patient safety or the quality of care is at stake.
Ik heb nu geen signalen dat de patiëntveiligheid of de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Je laat je kind niet in de steek”

MP Leijten asked ministers about a newspaper report on a psychotic, addicted unemployed man left without support, asking for analysis, cost data, housing figures, and coordination between agencies. Minister Schippers acknowledged fragmented, cross-domain service delivery, stated she lacks overviews on costs and discharges without housing, and said she will urge regional parties to act but cannot resolve the individual case.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ruim driekwart van gemeenten dat de fout in is gegaan met de huishoudelijke verzorging

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views research showing that 77% of municipalities may be violating the Wmo 2015 after CRvB rulings on domestic care, and what supervisory steps it has taken. The State Secretary answered that he contacted three municipalities party to the case and ten others, has formally written to four, that a national network of social-domain directors will support municipalities, and that municipalities themselves are responsible for aligning their policy with the law.
I do not have a national overview of the state of affairs at municipalities.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijk overzicht van de stand van zaken bij gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Verpleeghuizen boycotten IGZ-uitvraag’

An SP MP asked whether nursing homes boycotting the Inspectorate's (IGZ) request for basic safety indicators was acceptable, whether a sector can withdraw from IGZ oversight, and what the IGZ will do. The State Secretary replied that not supplying the indicators is unacceptable, that the IGZ will demand the information from individual providers, and that the sector's withdrawal from oversight cannot be a real option.
The IGZ will demand the information from individual care providers that do not supply the indicators and take all steps that go with that.
De IGZ zal bij individuele zorgaanbieders die de indicatoren niet aanleveren de informatie vorderen en alle stappen nemen die daar bij horen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een bewoner van zorginstelling Cordaan

MP Leijten asked the state secretary about the IGZ report on the 2014 death of a 19-year-old resident of Cordaan from choking, including why the report is not public, why it took two years, and whether the executive board should face consequences. The state secretary said the report found care shortcomings but is withheld pending consideration of interests, the criminal investigation blocks judgement on avoidability, the IGZ sees no grounds for stronger enforcement, and Cordaan has committed to improvements.
This report is not public. Before I can send information from the report to the House, the IGZ is obliged to weigh the interests of those involved in the matter.
Dit rapport is niet openbaar. Voordat ik informatie uit het rapport naar Uw Kamer kan sturen is de IGZ gehouden de belangen van de bij de aangelegenheid betrokkenen te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Het kabinet verrekent zich met toestroom Wlz’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether the government would respond to a report by Bureau HHM showing possible shifts into the Wlz long-term care scheme, with 5% more older clients and 13% more disabled clients, and whether this implies extra budget. The state secretary answered that the figures are theoretical maximum shifts, that actual uptake is being monitored by CBS, that the NZa advises on budget adequacy, and that no extra budget is needed based on this report.
Within that perspective the research mapped what the maximum shifts are in theory.
Het onderzoek heeft binnen dat perspectief in kaart gebracht wat theoretisch gezien de maximale verschuivingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de onderzoeken naar belangenverstrengelingen bij zorginstelling Alliade

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about inspection findings on conflicts of interest at care provider Alliade, where directors also owned subcontracting companies, and about the appearance of conflict, the market conformity of payments, and whether rules should change. The State Secretary says the appearance of conflict is unacceptable, notes the directors have resigned, says the regulators will examine the matter further and address conflicts of interest in governance oversight, but states that no data exist on other providers and declines to give the subcontractor financial figures.
I have therefore asked the IGZ to explicitly put the theme of conflicts of interest on the agenda in its oversight of good governance.
Ik heb de IGZ daarom gevraagd om het thema belangenverstrengeling expliciet te agenderen in hun toezicht op goed bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het twittergedrag van het ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why the ministry tweeted five corrective 'facts' after a Buitenhof broadcast on health costs, questioning the sourcing, selected years and the claim that patients get more care for their premium. The minister defended the tweets as correcting incorrect information, gave the requested figures and sources, and said the ministry aims for adequate and correct information.
The ministry considers itself called upon to communicate facts when incorrect information is circulating, and not to enter into discussion for reasons of purity.
Het ministerie acht zich geroepen om als er niet-correcte informatie rondgaat feiten te communiceren, en om uit oogpunt van zuiverheid niet in discussie te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het schildkliergeneesmiddel Thyrax niet per september weer beschikbaar is, maar pas in het tweede kwartaal van 2017

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether the government would act against manufacturer Aspen after the thyroid drug Thyrax was delayed until Q2 2017, including whether to compensate patients and tighten the supply obligation. The minister said the government will neither recover nor compensate patient costs, pointed to existing enforcement and her pharmaceutical vision, and declined to introduce a supply obligation, arguing the IGZ investigation covered only the earlier shortage.
The recent Aspen announcement about being unable to supply Thyrax for longer has no influence on the conclusions of that investigation.
Het recente bericht van Aspen over het nog langer niet kunnen leveren van Thyrax heeft op de conclusies van dat onderzoek geen invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het door apothekers zelf bereiden en doorleveren van geneesmiddelen indien die niet in Nederland worden geproduceerd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the new IGZ circular allowing pharmacists to supply their own preparations to other pharmacies when manufacturers stop production, and about shortages, price increases and industry influence. The minister defended the circular as a narrow, case-by-case non-enforcement framework, noted alternatives exist for Thyrax, said the circular does not address prices, and explained the IGZ consulted stakeholders.
For that reason the IGZ does not enforce when the restrictive conditions described in the circular are met.
Om die reden treedt de IGZ niet-handhavend op wanneer aan de in de circulaire beschreven restrictieve voorwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de brandbrief van de gemeente Den Helder over het verdwijnen van cardiologie uit het Gemini Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a letter from Den Helder municipality opposing the concentration of complex cardiology care in Alkmaar, which they feared would dismantle Gemini Hospital, and asked about insurer VGZ's role, the risk of hospital mergers and whether a merger ban should be imposed. The minister replied that only complex multi-day cardiology is concentrated, that location decisions are for providers and insurers supervised by the IGZ and NZa, that VGZ will evaluate the profile, and that a general merger ban is not desirable, pointing instead to existing merger and competition tests.
A general merger ban is therefore not desirable.
Een algeheel fusieverbod is daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een van corruptie en valsheid in geschrifte verdachte ziekenhuisdirecteur

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about reports that a hospital director responsible for building the Prinses Máxima Centrum was arrested on suspicion of corruption and forgery at his previous hospital, and whether the Centre's supervisory board checked his background. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and gave no details, that the Centre's own review found no irregularities in the tender, and that the Centre did check with his former employer and saw no reason to revise the appointment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat geen Valysvervoer wordt toegekend

An MP asks why a woman referred by Valys to a municipality for Wmo transport was sent back to Valys without an indication, how often this happens, and whether the municipality will intervene. The state secretary says the referral back is not logical, notes Valys access can be obtained without a Wmo indication, promises a fifth eligibility condition by 1 October 2016 and a broader study of Valys access.
On the specific case, the municipality of Hollands Kroon could not go into it from a privacy point of view.
Op de specifieke casus kon de gemeente Hollands Kroon vanuit het oogpunt van privacy niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Curator: ‘Wmo klopt gewoon niet’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about a curator's claim that the Wmo does not work, the bankruptcies of Thuiszorg Noord-Holland and Stichting ZorgBedrijf, care-worker pay, and tariffs. The state secretary answered that the curator explained his views, that continuity of care and working conditions were secured through takeovers, that causes await the bankruptcy report, and that he has no overview of other home-care bankruptcies; he referred to a draft decree on a realistic price and to earlier agreements with unions and VNG.
For the answer to your question about the precise reasons for the bankruptcy, the bankruptcy report must be awaited.
Voor het antwoord op uw vraag naar de precieze redenen van het faillissement moet het faillissementsverslag worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Sionsberg in Dokkum wankelt door ruzie met zorgverzekeraar De Friesland-Achmea

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that hospital De Sionsberg in Dokkum is at risk after insurer De Friesland-Achmea terminated its contract, and whether the insurer is meeting its duty of care amid rising waiting lists. The minister said she has urged the parties to find a solution, asked the NZa and IGZ to examine the insurer's duty of care and care quality, and stated that good accessible care in Dokkum must be guaranteed, though she declined to judge whether a breach of contract occurred.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ruim een half miljoen hartpatiënten problemen hebben omdat ze goedkopere medicijnen slikken

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she responds to reports that over half a million heart patients have problems from switching to cheaper medicines, whether the ministry knew of NIVEL research on this, and what the hidden costs and health risks of preferential drug policy are. The minister argues the survey shows mainly information gaps, says no research on costs or health risks of preferential policy exists and sees no need for it, and states switching generics is desirable for affordability while pointing to prescribers and pharmacists for patient guidance.
I see no reason at this moment to conduct research specifically into preferential policy.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om onderzoek specifiek naar preferentiebeleid te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat tientallen ouderen die in een huis van Florence wonen verplicht moeten verhuizen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that dozens of elderly residents of a Florence care home must move, including sixteen forced to relocate, and about related job losses and care-allocation choices. The state secretary replied that the move reflects a shift towards care at home and that the relocations are a matter for the care provider and the zorgkantoor, with the IGZ monitoring quality and safety rather than placement decisions.
It is up to the care provider to make decisions in this regard and up to the IGZ to supervise them.
Het is aan de zorgaanbieder om daarin beslissingen te nemen en aan de IGZ om daarop toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat ouderen of instanties kinderen opzadelen met enorme pgb-schulden

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that children are left with large personal budget (pgb) debts incurred by parents or institutions while they were minors, and whether this breaches children's rights and whether the system should change. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem as undesirable, said he is discussing a solution with care offices and the NZa, and said that since 2015 pgb applications are examined more strictly, though he saw no reason to change application rules and could not yet give numbers of affected children.
That is why I am in discussion with the care offices and the NZa to find a solution for this AWBZ case.
Daarom ben ik met zorgkantoren en de NZa in gesprek om te komen tot een oplossing voor deze AWBZ-casuistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het mogelijke faillissement van thuiszorgorganisatie Solace ATC Thuiszorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Solace ATC, its debts, municipal cuts to care hours, transfer of clients and staff, and possible director liability. The State Secretary answered that the bankruptcy curator is responsible for investigating causes, has selected Tzorg as successor provider, and that such questions fall to the curator and courts, so he will not start his own investigation.
It is for the judge to assess whether the board members and supervisors involved are held personally liable for the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de betrokken bestuurders en toezichthouders persoonlijk aansprakelijk gesteld worden voor het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de budgetten van wijkverpleging nu al uitgeput zijn

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports that home-nursing (wijkverpleging) budgets were already exhausted, including claims that insurers were deliberately limiting contracting and clawing back funds. The state secretary said there were no indications the national budget was insufficient, pointed to extra funding and insurers' duty of care, and referred contracting disputes to negotiation and the new dispute body.
I have no insight into data at the level of individual care providers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in gegevens op het niveau van zorgaanbieders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet kunnen krijgen van een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) via de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) bij een persoonlijk faillissement van één van de ouders

Two SP MPs asked why a 14-year-old's personal budget (pgb) was refused and whether the SVB-managed scheme and the care office meet their duty of care when a parent is bankrupt, and whether the rule is still needed and how many similar cases exist. The State Secretary says a suitable solution was found with the mother, that the rule on bankruptcy stays as a safeguard, that the NZa supervises the care office, and that no broader investigation is needed.
The care office, given the specific circumstances and from the standpoint of its duty of care, has now reached a solution that, as I understand it, is suitable for all parties.
Het zorgkantoor is, gelet op de specifieke omstandigheden en vanuit het oogpunt van de zorgplicht, inmiddels met een, naar ik heb vernomen, voor alle partijen passende oplossing gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de negatieve gevolgen van het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the ministers whether TTIP's tariff cuts on sugar, alcohol and tobacco would harm public health, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that tariff cuts may lower consumer prices, that public health policy space remains under TTIP, and that a full response will follow once Ecorys' final report is published.
Once the final report is published, the cabinet will give a comprehensive response.
Zodra het definitieve rapport is gepubliceerd, zal het kabinet een uitgebreide reactie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Leijten over de VNG-pilot blurring

MPs Voordewind and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Health about the VNG pilot on alcohol blurring, which they say breaches the Drank- en Horecawet, including in supermarkets and in light of a poll showing 75% opposition. The State Secretary answered that a court found Nieuwegein acted unlawfully, that municipalities must enforce rather than tolerate violations, that he raised the issue with the VNG, and that he will weigh the poll and supermarket participation in the ongoing evaluation of the law.
Municipalities must enforce violations of the Drink and Catering Act rather than tolerate them.
Gemeenten dienen overtredingen van de Drank- en Horecawet te handhaven en niet te gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over fraude bij zorgorganisatie Boriz

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about suspected fraud at care organisation Boriz, its profits, whether it continues as subcontractor of Pluryn, and whether former owners can set up new care organisations. The state secretary said he awaits Menzis's fraud investigation, which he will not publish, declined to give a timeline, said excessive profits do not belong in care and that enforcement bodies are acting, and noted insurers must screen providers' integrity.
Health insurers and care offices never make fraud investigation reports public, both out of privacy interests and to prevent sensitive information about fraudsters' methods from becoming public.

Zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoren maken de rapporten van fraudeonderzoeken nooit openbaar, zowel vanuit het belang van privacy als om te voorkomen dat gevoelige informatie over de werkwijze van fraudeurs naar buiten komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuisbestuurders een calamiteitenrapport herschrijven voordat het naar de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) gaat

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about reports that hospital boards rewrite incident reports before they go to the Health Inspectorate (IGZ), and how the inspectorate's risk-based oversight and incident handling work. The Minister replied that boards are responsible for investigating calamities, that the IGZ intervenes when reports conceal causes, and that it does not keep a list of rewritten reports, while rejecting a culture of concealment and offering no new 24-hour investigation team.
When the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) finds that board members conceal the main causes of a calamity in an incident report to prevent reputational damage, it intervenes.

Wanneer de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) erachter komt dat bestuurders hoofdoorzaken van een calamiteit in een calamiteitenrapport verhullen om reputatieschade te voorkomen, dan grijpt zij in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht Selectiecriteria geven duidelijkheid over deelname aan ketenzorg

SP MPs asked the Health Minister about criteria for chronic-care programme participation, the VGZ insurer's handling of primary care contracting, and whether insurers abuse market power. The minister answered that inclusion/exclusion criteria were agreed jointly to improve clarity, add no administrative burden, and that disputes can go to an independent dispute body while the NZa and ACM handle complaints.
It is for the ACM to handle individual complaints reported to them.
Het is aan de ACM om individuele klachten die bij hen gemeld worden, te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar het mijden van zorg vanwege eigen bijdragen Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) flink vertraagd is

Two SP MPs asked why the CBS study on whether people avoid Wmo care because of co-payments was delayed and whether the research will answer that question. The Staatssecretaris explained the delay (data not yet ready for tables, final results expected November 2016), said supplementary qualitative research on avoidance has been commissioned, and declined to suspend co-payments before the results are in.
Additional research has been commissioned into undesired avoidance of care and co-payments.
Er is aanvullend onderzoek uitgezet naar ongewenste zorgmijding en eigen bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht Meander MC laat verzekerden VGZ langer wachten

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about hospital Meander MC making insured patients of insurer VGZ wait longer after exceeding a contracted budget ceiling. The minister says the hospital and insurer disagree, that acute care remains available to all, and that the parties should resolve the dispute, with the independent dispute body available if needed.
I regret that these citizens are being harmed by a dispute between a hospital and an insurer.
Ik betreur het dat deze burgers gedupeerd worden door een geschil tussen een ziekenhuis en een verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat miljoenen euro's zorggeld verdwijnen in de zakken van directeuren

The SP MP Leijten asks the State Secretary how small care providers can make very high profits, why a third of recognised care businesses do not file full annual accounts, how profit-taking in care can be stopped, and whether a licensing requirement or a ban on care-sector BV structures should be introduced. The State Secretary responds that profit distribution is restricted for intramural care under the WTZi, that the IGZ is investigating specific cases, that supervisory boards and purchasers bear primary responsibility, that partial reporting for a substantial share of providers is allowed under the rules, and that existing licensing already applies, while declining to ban the BV structure.
The IGZ investigations into these matters are currently ongoing and I cannot anticipate their content or outcomes.
De onderzoeken van de IGZ hiernaar lopen op dit moment en ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de inhoud en de uitkomsten ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de fusie tussen Achterhoekse ziekenhuizen accordeert.

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how she views the NZa's approval of the merger of two Achterhoek hospitals, including effects on care, staff, patients, the reasons for merging, the future of the Winterswijk hospital, choice for patients, and the number of merger approvals and rejections. The minister answered that the competition authority ACM must assess the merger under competition law, that the NZa found continuity of crucial care safeguarded, that the Winterswijk hospital remains sensitive for emergency and acute obstetric care, and that she leaves merger decisions to the independent regulators.
Should the merger go ahead definitively, it is up to the board to provide clarity on how they intend to give substance to the merger and what the consequences are.
Mocht de fusie definitief doorgaan, dan is het aan het bestuur om duidelijkheid te geven over hoe zij invulling willen geven aan de fusie en wat de gevolgen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat drie kankerpatiënten onder verdachte omstandigheden zijn overleden na behandeling in een alternatieve kankerkliniek

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that three cancer patients died after treatment at a German alternative cancer clinic, including whether Dutch patients were affected, whether the clinic should be closed, how oversight of alternative healers works, and whether insurers reimburse such treatment. The minister answered that the German authorities are investigating with Dutch support, that the Dutch inspectorate has contacted patients, that the clinic has halted operations, and that foreign oversight and insurance coverage fall outside her direct responsibility.
While this German investigation is ongoing, I cannot inform you further about the content of the case.
Lopende dit Duitse onderzoek kan ik u niet nader over de inhoud van de zaak informeren.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgkosten juist zullen stijgen door het openbaar maken van tarieven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether publishing hospital tariffs would raise care costs, whether published prices reflect real costs and quality, and whether patients can meaningfully choose providers. Minister Schippers replied that she supports transparency on costs and quality, argues price transparency is unlikely to raise prices, promises to report on an October expert meeting, and defends the current performance-based payment system.
The Ministry of Health is organising a meeting with experts on this subject in October.
Het Ministerie van VWS organiseert in oktober een bijeenkomst met experts op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat veel palliatieve zorg in ziekenhuizen niet wordt vergoed door fouten in de bekostigingssystematiek

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister whether hospitals are not reimbursed for palliative care due to flaws in the DBC funding system, and why some hospitals have stopped providing it. The minister replied that palliative care can be reimbursed through a palliative care team with a different specialist opening the palliative DBC, that the NZa is running an inventory with results due in January 2017 and changes for 2018, and that the current DBC system functions with problems addressed where they exist.
The NZa has concluded that there are currently bottlenecks in the funding of palliative care throughout the entire chain.
De NZa heeft geconcludeerd dat er momenteel in de bekostiging van palliatieve zorg in de gehele keten knelpunten zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de ophanden zijnde sluiting van het Psycho Trauma Centrum (PTC) van Rivierduinen in Leiden

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the planned closure of the Psycho Trauma Centre at Rivierduinen in Leiden, its reasons, alternatives for patients, waiting lists, job losses and worker participation. The minister answered that psychotrauma treatment remains available but shifts to outpatient care for patients, that the provider decides organisation and content, and that individual arrangements are made for current patients.
How this is given organisational or care-content shape is not up to me.
Hoe daar organisatorisch of zorginhoudelijk invulling aan wordt gegeven, is niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht “Twee miljoen voor in opspraak geraakte oud-Achmea-bestuurder”

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about severance and salary payments to former Achmea board members, one linked to a fraud case, and whether public money is involved. The minister replied that the pay complied with WNT rules, that the members were not responsible for care activities, that a court has ordered the conditional severance paid, and that individual pay judgements are left to the institutions.
The Cabinet wants socially acceptable incomes for care executives and for executives of health insurers.
Het Kabinet wil maatschappelijk acceptabele inkomens voor zorgbestuurders en bestuurders van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Philadelphia 30.000 euro per maand betaalt voor de beveiliging van kasteel Beverweert

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that care provider Philadelphia pays 30,000 euro per month for security at Kasteel Beverweert, and whether this is paid from care funds, what the full cost history is, and why the estate has not been sold. The State Secretary answered that Philadelphia itself is responsible for its spending, that security costs about 50,000 euro per month, that the castle still carries 4.5 million euro on the books, and that no realistic buyer has been found, while providing only partial cost data.
For how that care and support is organised, Philadelphia – like every other care provider – is itself responsible.
Voor de wijze waarop die zorg en ondersteuning wordt georganiseerd, is Philadelphia – net als iedere andere zorgaanbieder – zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de contracten van bestuurders

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether board members of Amstelring, a care provider under intensified inspection, with a 111% employment factor comply with the WNT pay cap and whether this is acceptable. The state secretary answered that no WNT breach occurred since actual pay stays under the maximum, that the accountant checks the hours arrangement, and that CIBG monitors compliance and will enforce where needed.
In this case there is no violation of the WNT.
Er is in dit geval geen sprake van overtreding van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht "Top slechte verpleeghuizen verdient meer dan de norm"

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why directors of poorly rated nursing homes earn above the Balkenende norm, and how this fits with claims that high pay attracts the best managers. The State Secretary replied that supervisory boards must set appropriate pay within the WNT limits, that transitional rules apply, and that he supports self-reflection and accreditation for care governors.
Within the limits set by the WNT, it is up to the internal supervisors to determine what an appropriate remuneration is for the director(s) concerned.
Binnen de grenzen die de WNT stelt, is het aan de interne toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning voor de betrokken bestuurder(s) is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bv-boom van zorgnetwerkorganisatie Fundis Holding

An MP asks the state secretary about healthcare network Fundis Holding's structure of 22 BVs, including its restructuring into BVs, financial oversight, WTZi licensing, profit distribution, dual board roles, and governance. The state secretary answers that the structure is the organisation's own choice, financial reporting is published, one BV has licensing, dividends stay within the foundation, and dual roles are said not to exist, while calling dual roles incompatible with the governance code.
Fundis has informed me that every legal entity within its organisation publishes its own annual report and financial statements.
Fundis heeft mij laten weten dat elke rechtspersoon binnen haar organisatie een eigen jaarverslag en jaarrekening uitbrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Pantein 170 banen schrapt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about Pantein's plan to cut 170 jobs to save 10 million euros, asking about its finances, care quality, and salary guarantees for remaining staff. The State Secretary answered that Pantein is responsible for its own management and personnel policy in consultation with the works council, that the IGJ is already examining care quality, and that no ministerial investigation is warranted.
Pantein is itself responsible for its business operations and, in consultation with the works council, for its personnel policy.
Pantein is zelf verantwoordelijk voor haar bedrijfsvoering en – in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad – voor haar personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de mantelzorgers financiële problemen heeft

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the government how it views reports that over half of informal carers face financial problems, why carers were not informed about changes in care, and what concrete measures will be taken. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for supporting carers under the Wmo 2015, that the cited Nibud study should be qualified, and that no concrete measures were announced beyond pointing to municipal responsibility.
It is up to municipalities to translate this responsibility into policy and implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om deze verantwoordelijkheid door te vertalen in beleid en uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hoge ziekteverzuim in de zorg

An SP MP asks the government why sickness absence in health and welfare care is higher than the national average, why it is high in care homes and social services, whether burnout follows from understaffing, and what measures will reduce it, including the staffing norm for long-term care demanded by the Leijten motion. The state secretary answers that absence has long been higher in this sector and reflects demanding work, that the 2016 Q1 figures are not clearly higher than 2015, that a staffing guideline is being developed and due by 1 October, and that existing programmes and sector campaigns address sustainable employability.
I see this as a good opportunity to raise the prevention of work stress and sickness absence in care on the agenda.
Ik zie dat als een goede gelegenheid om het tegengaan van werkstress en ziekteverzuim in de zorg aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de burger niet zo zelfredzaam is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that citizens are not as self-reliant as the policy assumes, and whether care recipients can rely on their networks and on government support. The State Secretary answered that most people are self-reliant, that the Wmo is for those who cannot manage alone, that the policy will not be changed, and that the research underlying the reports is still ongoing.
I therefore see no reason to adjust my policy.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding om mijn beleid aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Leijten over de handelswijze van bestuurders bij Alliade Zorggroep

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the state secretary about conflict of interest at Alliade Zorggroep, where two directors earned money through subcontracting companies, and whether the supervisory board, accountants, IGZ and NZa failed in their oversight. The state secretary answered that IGZ and NZa investigated, found no unlawful use of care funds, and that Alliade has committed to measures such as tighter internal rules and disclosure, with the IGZ to monitor compliance.
I share with IGZ and NZa that any appearance of conflict of interest must be avoided and I agree with their judgment that Alliade must remedy this.
Ik deel met IGZ en NZa dat iedere schijn van belangenverstrengeling moet worden vermeden en deel hun oordeel dat Alliade dit moet herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kerstens over het verkrijgen van raadsinformatie via een Wob- verzoek (Wet openbaarheid van bestuur)

Members Leijten and Kerstens asked why two parties in Oude IJsselstreek must file a Wob request to obtain information on contracts for home-visit (keukentafel) assessments, and whether bonus-malus arrangements tied to outcomes are acceptable and used elsewhere. The state secretary said council information rights under the Gemeentewet are broader than Wob, rejected bonus-malus arrangements as inconsistent with the Wmo 2015, and reported that no other municipalities are known to use them.
That accountability and information duty is broader than the disclosure duty arising from the Wob, because the Wob regulates citizens' right to government information.

Die verantwoordings- en informatieplicht is breder dan de openbaarmakingsplicht die uit de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob) voortvloeit, omdat de Wob het recht van burgers op overheidsinformatie regelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de huishoudelijke verzorging steeds meer plaatsvindt in het zwarte circuit

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the Wmo 2015 causes fewer care indications, pushing more care into the black market, and about PGGM survey findings on undeclared work and job prospects of home-care workers. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must assess support needs, that the Regeling dienstverlening aan huis offers a legal alternative, that undeclared work is not the government's preferred solution, and that no signals of municipalities forcing undeclared care were known.
There is no insight into the number of alfa-helpers without a contract. No figures are available on this.
Op het aantal alfahulpen dat geen contract meer heeft bestaat geen zicht. Hierover zijn geen cijfers voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de farmaceutische industrie artsen betaalt via een sluiproute

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms pay doctors via commercial education bureaus outside the Transparantieregister Zorg, and what should be done. Minister Schippers answered that such payments should be reported where the company knows of or influences the doctor's engagement, that self-regulation through the CGR code is relied upon, and that she sees no reason yet to make participation legally mandatory.
I do not have the data to make such an estimate.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens om een dergelijke inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over toezichthouders in de zorg die hun vergoeding verhogen

An SP MP asked whether it is morally objectionable that care-sector supervisors raised their own pay sharply, and whether the government foresaw this after loosening the pay norm. The minister explained that the WNT norm was raised to match the actual time spent on supervision and defended the increases as part of expanded responsibilities, while declining to track total public spending on these pay packages.
Remuneration exceeding the pay maxima will, subject to transitional law, have to be brought back down to the norm.
Bezoldigingen die de bezoldigingsmaxima te boven gaan zullen, met inachtneming van het overgangsrecht, teruggebracht moeten worden naar de norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een groot ziekenhuis over een paar jaar achterhaald is

MP Leijten asked the minister on what research she based her claim that large hospitals will be obsolete within a few years, and how this fits with ongoing hospital mergers and emergency-room closures. The minister answered that hospital care must reorganise toward networks and home-based treatment, that she does not consider hospitals unnecessary, and that the Nza and ACM review mergers while market oversight is being strengthened.
I informed your House about this in more detail by letter on 6 June.
Ik heb uw Kamer daar op 6 juni per brief nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat ggz-patiënten (patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg) vaker in een tbs-kliniek zitten

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the ministers how BOPZ psychiatric patients can be transferred to a TBS clinic without a judge's involvement, why suitable GGZ places are lacking, and whether the bed reduction is to blame. The government answered that transfers are based on BOPZ article 55 with a copy to the judge, are rare (about 0.24% of BOPZ patients, 38 people), are made by the medical director on psychiatric indication, and that a broader study and IGZ talks will follow.
These are BOPZ patients whose judicial measure is converted into a BOPZ authorisation.
Het gaat hierbij om BOPZ-patiënten van wie de justitiële maatregel wordt omgezet in een BOPZ-machtiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de schandalen bij Carint Reggelandgroep

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about severance-like payments and 'adviseur' constructions at Carint Reggeland Groep, including a former board chair paid for eight months after leaving and large exit premiums. The State Secretary called such circumvention of the WNT pay rules objectionable, left the assessment to the CIBG supervisor, and pointed to a forthcoming Evaluatiewet WNT to tighten the rules.
Circumventing those rules I consider objectionable. Whether circumvention occurred in this case will be determined by the WNT supervisor for care, the CIBG, after investigation.
Het omzeilen van die regels acht ik laakbaar. Of in deze casus sprake is van omzeiling zal de toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorg, het CIBG, na onderzoek bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het oordeel van de IGZ inzake het mensgebonden onderzoek bij psychiatrische patiënten bij GGZ NHN

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the Health Inspectorate's (IGZ) handling of a human-subject drug study with psychiatric patients at GGZ NHN, including whether the report and whistleblower treatment would be made public and whether violations were reported to the prosecutor. The minister declined to release the report because affected parties must first be consulted, said the case was passed to the Public Prosecution Service, and stated that the IGZ found no direct patient harm while acknowledging shortcomings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over opsporingscapaciteit voor pgb-fraude

An MP asked the State Secretary whether enough investigative capacity exists against personal budget (pgb) fraud, and for an overview of the bodies involved, their FTE and cooperation. The government describes a chain approach from indication to enforcement, outlines the roles of the Inspectie SZW, OM, police, NZa and others, reports added capacity of 18 and 3 FTE, and states it has no information on capacity deployed by other parties and will report fraud-signal statistics later.
There is no information available about the capacity other parties deploy in the context of tackling pgb fraud.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over de capaciteit die andere partijen in het kader van de aanpak van pgb-fraude inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het faillissement van zorgorganisatie Diafaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of care organisation Diafaan, including its causes, the transfer of staff and clients, the treatment of workers' pay, planned rules against wage dumping, and whether bankruptcy and bestuurder conduct should be investigated. The State Secretary answered that the curator is handling the process, care continuity was preserved, some staff saw worse terms, a general administrative measure on wage competition is being prepared, and the curator will decide on further steps after investigating the bestuurders' conduct.
On both matters I keep myself informed through the curator of Diafaan.
Over beide zaken laat ik mij op de hoogte houden door de curator van Diafaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Griffierecht hoort in het medisch tuchtrecht niet thuis’

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked whether the government still plans a 50-euro court fee for health-care disciplinary cases and whether that fee serves the public interest. Minister Schippers confirmed the plan, citing parallel fees for legal professions, argued it filters out unsuitable complaints while refunding founded ones, and said she will submit a bill to the Wet BIG.
I intend to submit a bill to parliament to include the court fee in the Wet BIG.
Ik ben voornemens om een wetsvoorstel voor te leggen aan het parlement om het griffierecht op te nemen in de Wet BIG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Kwart zorgbestuurders boven Balkenendenorm’

An MP asked the state secretary for health why a quarter of elderly-care executives earn above the Balkenende norm, why one former director received a severance payment far above the WNT maximum despite supervision by the Inspectorate, and whether a faster reduction should be enforced. The state secretary replied that the higher pay falls under transitional law based on the ECHR, that the CIBG enforces the WNT where violations occur, that institutions should weigh the specific circumstances within the limits, and declined to introduce emergency legislation, referring to the answer on question 5.
However, as soon as there is a violation of the WNT, the supervisory body in care, the CIBG, enforces it.
Zodra er echter sprake is van een overtreding van de WNT treedt de toezichthouder in de zorg, het CIBG, handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitgave over E-health

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the cost and purpose of a government publication on e-health, including its reach, a quote calling privacy a hurdle, the phrase 'privacy mafia', and possible sponsorship by Philips and Focus Cura. Minister Schippers answered that the publication cost 97,500 euro, that it was a legitimate government communication, that privacy rules remain binding, and that the company contributions were limited to photos and not sponsorship.
The publication was produced without financial contributions from third parties. There is no form of sponsorship.
De uitgave is zonder financiële bijdragen van derden tot stand gekomen. Er is geen sprake van enige vorm van sponsoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Ik wil naar huis, naar mijn gezin’

MP Leijten asks the state secretary for health how the government views a ventilator-dependent patient and an ALS patient who want to live at home with their families rather than in institutional care, and whether the 'doelmatig' cost criterion and the motion on not forcing people to live where they do not want to are respected. The state secretary says home care is possible with conditions and extra care options, that the care office found a solution and the ALS patient is now at home, and that the government cannot force people to live where they do not want to, while leaving legal aid to the patient's family.
That the woman feels she is being held against her will is not a desirable situation.
Dat mevrouw het gevoel heeft dat ze tegen haar wil wordt vastgehouden, is geen wenselijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen enorm moeten bijbetalen voor zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that couples caring for a family member under the Wmo 2015 are left with very little after personal contributions, and whether the rules and tax on partner-provided PGB care are fair. The State Secretary defended the contribution rules as income-based, said the municipalities and households have been in talks, explained that partner-caregivers may be worse off only in certain cases, and promised additional qualitative research on care avoidance and PGB cases with partner-caregivers.

I do not have this insight. However, during the committee debate of 10 March on the Wmo 2015 personal contributions, I committed to commissioning additional qualitative research into care avoidance, personal contributions and tailored support under the Wmo 2015.

Ik beschik niet over dit inzicht. Tijdens het AO van 10 maart jl. over de eigen bijdragen Wmo 2015, heb ik echter toegezegd om aanvullend kwalitatief onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar zorgmijding, eigen bijdragen en maatwerk op grond van de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Oude IJsselstreek alfahulpen blijft inzetten, terwijl dit ontraden is door de staatssecretaris

An SP MP asked the state secretary how Oude IJsselstreek can deploy alfahulpen (domestic helpers) despite his advice against it, why the arrangement is banned in general provisions but allowed under individual care, and whether the rules create room for abuse. The state secretary answered that municipalities must follow current rules and can only be advised, that the proposal limits the scheme to personal budgets, and that a general administrative order will be sent soon.
Until the bill banning the use of alfahulpen in general provisions takes effect, municipalities cannot be forced to end the use of alfahulpen in the general provision.

Totdat het wetsvoorstel waarin het inzetten van alfahulpen in de algemene voorzieningen verboden wordt van kracht is, kunnen gemeenten niet gedwongen worden het inzetten van alfahulpen in de algemene voorziening te beëindigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het in opdracht van de Amerikaanse farmaceutische industrie uitgevoerde onderzoek naar de machtsverhoudingen binnen het Nederlandse zorgstelsel

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about an Erasmus University study commissioned by AmCham's pharmaceutical arm on power relations in the Dutch healthcare system, including who paid, whether it was appropriate given industry influence, and the conduct of officials and the NPCF at an AmCham forum. The minister answered that parties may freely contract such research within legal limits, that the payment is a matter between the parties, that the study's conclusions are not endorsed as a formal policy position, and that regulators (NZa, ACM) must assess individual cases.
I am not aware of what was paid for the research. That is part of the agreement between the parties themselves.
Het is mij niet bekend wat is betaald voor het onderzoek. Dat is onderdeel van de overeenkomst tussen partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat behandelaars in de ggz volgens onderzoek “heel flexibel” om zouden gaan met declaratieregels

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a study reporting that mental health practitioners handle declaration rules very flexibly, and about the role of care consultants. The minister answered that the NZa-commissioned study does not accuse the sector, that the NZa will discuss the findings with insurers and practitioners, and that the role of care consultants was not part of the study's scope.
The study was carried out on the initiative and commission of the NZa.
Het onderzoek is uitgevoerd op initiatief en in opdracht van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het faillissement van het centrum voor verslavingszorg Victas en de overname ervan door ggz-instelling Arkin

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the bankruptcy of addiction care centre Victas, its building costs, the responsibility of its boards, and its takeover by Arkin. The minister answered that the curator is investigating the causes and any mismanagement, that the competition and regulatory authorities cleared the takeover, and that she cannot judge the board's conduct before the investigation concludes.
It is for the curator to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy. The final bankruptcy report will therefore have to be awaited.
Het is aan de curator om de oorzaken van het faillissement te onderzoeken. Het definitieve faillissementsverslag zal dus moeten worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima Medisch Centrum verzwijgt calamiteit voor inspectie’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a hospital (MMC) that did not report a surgical calamity to the inspectorate, whether the patient will be compensated, whether the surgeon still operates, and how many disciplinary cases followed patient or family reports. The minister called the non-reporting regrettable, said the hospital remains legally responsible and has apologised, noted the disciplinary college issued the surgeon a warning, and reported 28 disciplinary cases since 2011, only two initiated by patients.

Regardless of whether the hospital works with employees or contracted staff, the hospital remains, as a care provider under the Healthcare Quality, Complaints and Disputes Act, ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of care and legally obliged to report a calamity to the IGZ.

Ongeacht of het ziekenhuis werkt met medewerkers in loondienst of medewerkers die in opdracht werken, het ziekenhuis blijft, als zorgaanbieder in de zin van de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz), eindverantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geboden zorg en in geval van een calamiteit wettelijk verplicht om dit bij de IGZ te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol van de aanjager die de zorg binnen gemeenten op peil moet houden

MP Leijten asks what the directeur-generaal Langdurige Zorg, appointed as 'aanjager' for care continuity in municipalities, actually does after the TSN Thuiszorg bankruptcy, including contact channels, dealings with workers and clients, action on wage dumping, and prevention of further bankruptcies. The state secretary answers that the ministry coordinated stakeholders, a handreiking with VNG was produced, a call-round was held, and most care continuity was maintained, while declining to act on wage dumping as a matter of local competence and referring to measures for workers losing jobs.
The solutions chosen by municipal executives and councils and agreed with providers fall within local decision-making authority as laid down in law.
De oplossingen die colleges en gemeenteraden hebben gekozen en zijn overeengekomen met aanbieders behoren tot de lokale beslissingsbevoegdheid zoals die in de wet is neergelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Koninklijke Nederlandse Organisatie van Verloskundigen (KNOV) haar vertrouwen opzegt in het bestuur van het College Perinatale Zorg (CPZ)

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister about the KNOV withdrawing confidence in the CPZ board, the CPZ chair's critical remarks on midwives' risk selection, the rejected care standard, and whether the Zorginstituut's takeover of the process will take the KNOV's input seriously. The minister regretted the situation, said the chair apologised, defended the CPZ and the Zorginstituut's procedures, and described the planned commission to revise the standard.
The result will be sent for consultation to all involved organisations, after which the ACK will offer the final version to the Zorginstituut's board for adoption.
Het resultaat zal ter consultatie naar alle betrokken organisaties gestuurd worden, waarna de ACK de definitieve versie ter vaststelling aan de raad van bestuur van het Zorginstituut zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over Het bericht 'Steekproef Consumentenbond: zorgdossiers zijn rommeltje'

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how she would respond to a Consumentenbond mystery-shopper survey finding that many hospital medical records were incomplete, inaccurate or misdirected, and what oversight bodies would do. The minister said she takes the findings seriously, will raise record-keeping quality with hospital associations, and that the IGZ and AP oversee the issue, though the IGZ could not draw firm conclusions from the small sample.
I consider the findings of the sample an important signal for the sector.
Ik vind de bevindingen van de steekproef een belangrijk signaal voor het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat de GGD Hart voor Brabant de screening van spraak- en taalontwikkeling van 5-jarigen stop zet

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked whether the GGD Hart voor Brabant stopping logopedic screening of 5-year-olds weakens early detection of speech and language disorders, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that the GGD has reorganised rather than abandoned the task, that youth health care (JGZ) is responsible under municipal law, and that no intervention or new investigation is planned.
I see no reason to call the GGD Hart voor Brabant and the associated municipalities to order.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de GGD Hart voor Brabant en de bijbehorende gemeenten tot de orde te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Jan Slagter over zijn verpleeghuis ‘Ben Oude Nijhuis’

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary for Health about a proposed small-scale nursing home for dementia patients with low incomes, whether the government supports it, why housing corporations show no interest in investing, and what the government did in advisory-team consultations on small-scale housing. The State Secretary says he supports such initiatives, which already exist and are funded, declines to judge the specific initiative's plans, points to local responsibility of corporations and municipalities, and reports the consultations covered the advisory team's findings.
Whether in Mr. Slagter's case there were sound plans I cannot and will not assess. That is for the care office, the financier or a housing corporation with which cooperation is sought.

Of in het geval van dhr. Slagter ook sprake was van degelijke plannen kan en wil ik niet beoordelen. Dit is aan het zorgkantoor, de financier of een woningcorporatie waarmee samenwerking wordt gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw angst en intimidatie heersen bij Zorggroep Charim

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports of renewed fear and intimidation at care group Charim, the 2014 reorganisation, departing managers, and possible silence contracts. The government answered that an independent report found social insecurity at many Charim locations, that the IGZ is monitoring the organisation and will act if care quality is at risk, and that it has no reports of silence contracts.
The IGZ has in recent years maintained almost continuous supervision of Charim, partly because of reported incidents and calamities.
De IGZ houdt de laatste jaren vrijwel continu toezicht op Charim, onder andere vanwege gemelde incidenten en calamiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het megalomane project van Daelzicht

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about Daelzicht's abandoned theme-park project, its spending of over 1 million euros on planning, possible liability of board members, the myOwn care robot, staff complaints and the supervisory role of the Raad van Toezicht and the IGZ. The state secretary answered that the decisions rest with the institution and its supervisory board, that the IGZ monitors care quality without signs of risk so far, that board liability requires judicial findings, and that an independent investigation is not considered necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voortdurende crisis bij Daelzicht

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the ongoing crisis at care organisation Daelzicht, including the management team's loss of confidence in the Board, alleged intimidation by the Board, and whether oversight should be tightened. The State Secretary answered that the dispute is primarily between the Supervisory Board, the Board and the works council, that the Board will step down on 1 June 2016 with an interim board member appointed, and that the Inspectorate for Healthcare sees no current grounds for enforcement but is monitoring developments closely.
The Healthcare Inspectorate oversees that the quality and safety of the care provided by Daelzicht is in order.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg ziet erop toe dat de kwaliteit en de veiligheid van de zorg die door Dealzicht wordt geleverd op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgverlening in bijna alle gemeenten onvoldoende is

MP Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary how to respond to reports that clients rate most municipalities poorly for providing necessary care and aids, and that many clients feel limited and cannot get the best-fitting help due to unavailability or cost. The state secretary replies that client experience is important, that municipalities must improve, that a qualitative study on care avoidance, co-payments and tailored support under the Wmo 2015 is underway, and that the Wmo transition was managed in a controlled way.
In the debate of 10 March with your House, I committed, in addition to the quantitative CBS research, to a qualitative study into care avoidance, co-payments and tailored support under the Wmo 2015.

In het debat van 10 maart jl. met uw Kamer heb ik- in aanvulling op het kwantitatieve onderzoek van CBS – een kwalitatief onderzoek toegezegd naar zorgmijding, eigen bijdragen en maatwerk op grond van de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Vriendin die Fokus woning uit moet’

Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary for health how a Fokus client who must leave her home after years is affected by a 2015 court ruling, and whether Fokus should be barred from unilaterally terminating care or housing. The secretary replies that the court ruled Fokus was right given serious health risks, advises the client to seek a new care and housing solution with Fokus and the housing corporation, and maintains opposition to the motion as the link between housing and care is central to the Fokus concept.
I maintain my position that the motion mentioned in question 4 should be advised against, because the link between housing and care is an important part of the Fokus concept.
Ik blijf bij mijn standpunt dat de in vraag 4 genoemde motie moet worden ontraden, omdat de koppeling tussen wonen en zorg een belangrijk onderdeel is van het Fokus-concept.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe zorgondernemer Loek Winter een imperium opbouwde en 21,6 miljoen staatssteun lospeuterde’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a report on hospital entrepreneur Loek Winter and EUR 21.6 million in state aid for the IJsselmeer hospitals taken over by MC Groep. The minister answered that the WNT compliance case is under investigation by CIBG, defended private participation and the 2009 rescue package, and declined to detail contract terms between hospitals and insurers.
It is the task of the supervisor to check whether the WNT has been complied with in an individual case.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om te toetsen of in een individueel geval de WNT is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Menzis trekt na jaar boetekleed aan. Cliënt met klacht over pgb-fraude niet serieus genomen’

An MP asks the State Secretary why health insurer Menzis allegedly failed to take a PGB fraud complaint seriously, and whether it considers itself responsible for fraud prevention. The State Secretary replies that Menzis did act on fraud signals (accelerated home visits and material checks at Boriz BV), that the complaint was handled through the complaints procedure and declared unfounded, and that the wider investigation is still ongoing.
There is no question of Menzis refusing to investigate possible PGB fraud.
Er is geen sprake van een weigering van Menzis om mogelijke pgb-fraude te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten inzake ouders die zich door scholen onder druk gezet voelen om hun kind te medicaliseren tegen ADHD

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries whether schools pressure parents to medicate children for ADHD without diagnosis, and whether funding cuts, class sizes, waiting lists and costs drive medicalisation. The government answers that schools cannot prescribe medication, that a plan of action against medicalisation is underway with expert meetings planned for autumn 2016, that prescriptions fell in 2015, and that several questions are for further research or the next progress report.
Schools cannot prescribe medication; this is reserved for care professionals.
Scholen kunnen geen medicatie voorschrijven, dit is voorbehouden aan zorgprofessionals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Oude IJsselstreek alfahulpen wil inzetten voor huishoudelijke verzorging

The MP Leijten asks whether the Oude IJsselstreek municipality's use of alfahulpen (informal low-paid helpers) for home care conflicts with the government's announced ban and with Wmo 2015 principles of individual tailoring and free choice. The State Secretary calls the municipality's policy undesirable, says he has advised it to stop, confirms a bill banning alfahulpen in general provisions from 1 January 2017 will be sent to parliament, but declines to produce national data on how many municipalities use such constructions.
I therefore consider the municipality's policy undesirable. I have advised the municipality not to continue the policy.
Ik vind het beleid van de gemeente dan ook onwenselijk. De gemeente is door mij ontraden het beleid voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Voordewind, Leijten en Van der Staaij over het supermarktkartel tegen leeftijdsverificatiesystemen voor de verkoop van alcohol en tabak

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a court ruling against the CBL's campaign and code on age verification for alcohol and tobacco sales, and whether the sector is living up to its duty to keep sales from minors. The State Secretary declined to comment on the ruling pending appeal, said the government expects the law to be followed, and will report to parliament on the tobacco display-ban convenant by 1 July 2016 if no agreement is reached.
Since this is a court ruling against which the parties will appeal, I cannot go into the content of this ruling or the conduct of any of the parties in this lawsuit.
Aangezien het een uitspraak van een rechtbank betreft waartegen partijen in hoger beroep zullen gaan, kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze uitspraak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de Taskforce Naleving Leeftijdsgrens Tabak

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the Taskforce Naleving Leeftijdsgrens Tabak, an industry-funded tobacco age-compliance taskforce, including VWS's role, information sharing, FCTC Article 5.3 concerns, and the NIX18 campaign's stakeholders. The State Secretary answered that VWS is not involved in the taskforce's activities, that contacts fall under FCTC Article 5.3 for technical implementation reasons with documents published, and that an independent Bureau Nuchter study will report by summer.
The Ministry of VWS is in no way involved in the activities of this Taskforce.
Het Ministerie van VWS is op geen enkele wijze betrokken bij de activiteiten van deze Taskforce.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Nieuwe software NZa zet care op achterstand’

An SP MP asked the minister about delays caused by a new NZa software system in the long-term care sector, including the effects on budgets, accounts, continuity of care and whether the deadline for cost settlements was too tight. The government answered that technical and organisational problems caused delays, that the NZa offered a temporary solution, that no financial problems were known, and that the NZa would treat late submissions leniently.
The NZa has indicated that when the system was put into use there were technical and organisational problems that caused delay.
De NZa heeft aangegeven dat bij de ingebruikname van het systeem er sprake is geweest van technische en organisatorische problemen waardoor vertraging is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht Martha Flora start in Haarlem met Zorgbalans

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about the opening of Martha Flora's luxury care homes in Haarlem, the relocation of former residents of Parkzicht, and the role of insurer CZ's investment arm. The secretary said residents keep their legal right to care, that the high private costs are a matter of personal choice and that CZ's participation is acceptable as long as it is transparent, but did not provide investor return figures.
Private parties investing in (clustered) housing are not obliged to make their returns public.
Private partijen die investeren in (geclusterde) woningen zijn niet gehouden om hun rendementen publiek te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Gerven en Leijten over het feitelijk niet verkrijgbaar zijn van het generieke dimethylfumaraat voor de behandeling van MS en andere zaken omtrent dure geneesmiddelen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about unavailability of generic dimethylfumarate for MS, seeding trials, Fampyra and Amfexa pricing, and ADHD medication. The minister answered that compounded supply is not available, opposed seeding trials, described the Fampyra and Amfexa positions, and rejected the view that ADHD diagnosis is questionable.
I am not in favour of seeding trials.
Ik ben geen voorstander van seeding trials.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over de rectificatie van Kamervragen betreffende de werkwijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

Opposition MP Leijten asked why it took so long to discover that the IGZ had wrongly answered two earlier sets of parliamentary questions about a deceased care-dependent woman, and how families are treated by the inspectorate.
