State Secretary Van Rijn acknowledged the error, said it did not change the final IGZ verdict, and defended IGZ's family involvement while refusing to make medical files available to relatives beyond patient consent and Wob rules.
It was not previously known to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) that the answer was incorrect.
Het was bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) niet eerder bekend dat de beantwoording onjuist was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de overlast van verwarde personen de pan uit rijst

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about reports that nuisance from confused persons is rising sharply, the police figures behind it, and whether mental health care budget cuts, bed reductions, the FACT-team rollout and police capacity cuts are to blame. The minister answered that police registrations rose about 65% between 2011 and 2015 but are incident counts rather than unique persons, that no causal link to ggz cuts has been shown, and that the aanjaagteam, a regional study and a handle for insurers and municipalities are underway.
I make growth room available for curative mental health care every year and therefore do not cut.
Ik stel elk jaar groeiruimte beschikbaar voor de curatieve GGZ en bezuinig dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het faillissement van Freecare

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of Freecare, a care-services foundation, including unpaid staff wages, the continuity of care for clients, and whether a proposed civil bans on board members could prevent repeat directors from setting up care organisations. The State Secretary answered that the municipality of Heerhugowaard had terminated the contract but guaranteed continuity for six clients, that he lacked sufficient facts to judge the directors, and that the proposed civil bestuursverbod applies only under strict criteria for the court to assess.
I have too little factual information to be able to pass judgement on that.
Ik beschik over te weinig feitelijke informatie om een oordeel daarover te kunnen uitspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het tekort aan crisisbedden bij GGZ-instelling Reinier van Arkel vanwege de bezuinigingen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a reported shortage of crisis beds at GGZ provider Reinier van Arkel caused by budget cuts, the chair's departure, executive pay, bed reduction and street confusion. Minister Schippers denied a structural shortage, pointed to NZa findings and yearly growth room, said she has no view on the chair's motives, and deferred the bed-reduction and ambulatory questions to a separate monitor letter.
I have no insight into the reasons why executives of care institutions decide to step down.
Ik heb geen zicht op de motieven waarom bestuurders van zorginstellingen besluiten op te stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het niet melden van een calamiteit en het mogelijk betalen van zwijggeld aan nabestaande(n) door Tergooi Ziekenhuis

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the IGZ's assessment of a settlement agreement between Tergooi Hospital and the relatives of a deceased patient could be sent to Parliament before a scheduled committee meeting. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ found it a voluntary civil settlement that does not breach the duty to report calamities, but considers gag clauses and waivers of further legal recourse undesirable, and she will examine whether the Wkkgz can be amended to address them.
I will therefore examine whether it is possible to regulate this through a provision in the Wkkgz so that care providers can be held to account by the inspectorate in such cases.
Ik zal dan ook bezien of het mogelijk is dit via een bepaling in de Wkkgz te regelen opdat zorgaanbieders daar in een voorkomend geval door de inspectie op aangesproken kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht de omstreden KNO-arts weer laat opereren

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the UMC Utrecht was right to let a suspended ENT surgeon, linked to two fatal incidents, resume patient care and surgery while the Inspectorate's investigation was ongoing, and why the Inspectorate's results were not awaited. Minister Schippers answered that re-integration is the hospital board's responsibility, that the IGZ will assess the conditions and the investigation remains open, and that she cannot comment substantively on the ongoing inquiry.
Although I understand that questions are repeatedly asked about this case, I cannot respond substantively while the inspectorate's investigation is ongoing.
Hoewel ik begrijp dat over deze casus telkens vragen worden gesteld, kan ik lopende het onderzoek van de inspectie daar inhoudelijk niet op reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg, Leijten en Dik-Faber over de tariefverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en de gevolgen hiervan voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs from CDA, SP and ChristenUnie asked the government to explain the 38% fee increase for the Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and its impact on volunteer organisations, and to reconcile it with earlier statements. The state secretary attributed the increase mainly to cost-recovery of Justis integrity products, said 7.5% covers the free VOG scheme, declined to commission an impact study on volunteer organisations, and said no consultation with VWS took place.
I am not willing to conduct research into the consequences of the fee increase for volunteers and their organisations.
Ik ben niet bereid onderzoek te verrichten naar de gevolgen van de tariefverhoging op het effect voor vrijwilligers en hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de bezetting van de gemeentehuizen van Hollands Kroon en Bronckhorst door actievoerende thuiszorgmedewerkers die strijden voor hun baan

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the occupation of municipal offices by care workers protesting the TSN bankruptcy was a good action, and why the Bronckhorst and Hollands Kroon mayors evicted them, and what the government thought of municipalities leaving workers uncertain. The state secretary answered that demonstration is a right, that mayors decide on order and consequences, that he will not judge the mayors' decisions, and that continuity of care and decent employment conditions were secured.
It is up to the mayor to set rules and restrictions to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de burgemeester om ter handhaving van de openbare orde en veiligheid voorschriften en beperkingen te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Toename aantal alcoholintoxicaties in 2015’

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about a reported 27% rise in alcohol poisonings among minors in 2015, whether the trend is expected to fall, the causes, and whether municipal enforcement of the age limit is failing. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, said the cause remains uncertain, pointed to a positive overall trend, and said the Drank- en Horecawet is under evaluation with the enforcement findings due in autumn and a government response in early 2017.
Incidentally, I am currently evaluating the Alcohol and Catering Act (DHW).
Overigens evalueer ik op dit moment de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Patiëntgegevens op straat deel II’

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reports that prisoners in Belgium processed hospital patient records under a contract with Iguana, including whether consent of confidentiality was signed and what action will be taken. The Minister says the matter needs further investigation, the Dutch Data Protection Authority is looking into it, she finds the practice undesirable, will review rules, and will commission research into hospitals' handling of patient data.
As I announced in my letter of 16 March, this needs to be investigated further.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 16 maart jl. heb aangekondigd, moet dit nader onderzocht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet melden van een calamiteit en het mogelijk betalen van zwijggeld aan nabestaande(n) door het Tergooi Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a hospital's failure to report a calamity to the Inspectorate, reports of hush money paid to relatives, and the Inspectorate's reluctance to give aggregate figures on unreported calamities. The Minister said the Inspectorate has started enforcement against the hospital, will publish more reliable aggregate data after reviewing its disclosure policy, and is assessing whether the settlement agreement is permissible.
After the broadcast, the Inspectorate asked the hospital's board to provide this agreement to it.
De IGZ heeft na de uitzending de raad van bestuur gevraagd deze overeenkomst aan haar te overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over hoe de kosten van het huidige zorgstelsel ongezien naar de burger verschoven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how health care costs have shifted to citizens, including the split of BKZ costs between citizens and businesses, the treatment of self-employed workers, the Zvw transition and tax credits. The minister said costs paid from general funds cannot be split between citizens and businesses, defended treating self-employed as households in some statistics, promised further calculations for some questions later and listed the tax credits.
These figures can be provided, but more time is needed. If desired, I can deliver them before the summer.
Deze cijfers zijn wel te geven, maar daarvoor is meer tijd nodig. Desgewenst kan ik die voor de zomer leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over de opbouw van schulden naar aanleiding van gedwongen opname in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why people compulsorily admitted to psychiatric facilities may lose benefits and face debts, and whether this gap was known and remains unfixed. The state secretary answered that such persons are eligible for special assistance (bijzondere bijstand) under the Participatiewet, which was amended in 2008 with retroactive effect, leaving municipalities to decide case by case; she did not provide figures on affected people.
I do not have figures on this matter.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zorgen om lang wachten op pgb’ (persoonsgebonden budget)

An SP MP asked the state secretary about long waiting times for a personal budget (pgb) for a foster parent's child, and about the timing of mandatory consent conversations and waiting times generally. The state secretary acknowledged the delay was too long, said the pgb has now been granted, promised to discuss shortening processing times with care offices, and declined to provide some requested overviews because the information is held by the NZa or not yet available.
The care office concerned acknowledges that it took too long.
Het betreffende zorgkantoor erkent dat het te lang heeft geduurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nieuwe calamiteiten binnen het Universitair Medisch Centrum Utrecht

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about Zembla reports of new calamities at UMC Utrecht, including craniosynostosis operations against guidelines, threatening letters to sources, and failure to report incidents. The Minister answered that an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing with an external commission, expected to conclude in summer 2016, and declined to pre-judge findings or order enforcement.
The IGZ investigation will be completed mid-year, after which I will inform you of the outcomes.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ zal halverwege dit jaar gereed zijn, waarna ik u informeer over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over stijging van kapitaallasten van ziekenhuizen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the rise in capital costs of hospitals, requesting a breakdown into depreciation, rent and financing costs, and questioned the Plexus/BKB findings on the abolition of the building regime. The minister provided CBS figures, defended the Plexus/BKB estimate as a reasonable but uncertain assessment, and explained that the Waarborgfonds guarantee lowers interest costs by about 1 to 2 percent, while no comparison with ordinary businesses is available.
A comparison with the business sector is not possible due to the lack of insight into the average interest rates that ordinary businesses pay for their financing.
Vergelijking met het bedrijfsleven is niet mogelijk wegens het ontbreken van inzicht in de gemiddelde rentetarieven die «reguliere bedrijven» betalen voor hun financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het ‘Rapport van het inspectiebezoek aan Martha Flora in Gouda op 28 september 2015’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about the IGZ inspection report on Martha Flora Gouda, which found care risks and unmet norms, and about the cost and oversight of the care homes. The state secretary said the provider must submit an improvement plan by 7 April 2016, the IGZ sees no reason for intensified supervision yet, the IGZ will be asked to attach the plan to its final judgment, and pricing and business model questions are for the provider or clients.
I will ask the IGZ to attach the results report (anonymised where necessary given privacy requirements) as an annex to its final judgment.
Ik zal de IGZ verzoeken om het resultaatverslag (waar nodig gelet op privacy-eisen geanonimiseerd) als bijlage bij haar eindoordeel te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over een nieuw megalomaan project in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Health about a proposed large recreation-style park by care organisation Daelzicht, questioning its use of care funds, governance, and the parallels with Philadelphia and Meavita. The State Secretary answered that Daelzicht has decided to abandon the plan, and largely declined to assess the governance and investment questions, referring to that decision.
Daelzicht has decided to stop the plan for Belevingspark Heel and has stated that it considers peace within the organisation and its surroundings important.
Daelzicht heeft besloten te stoppen met het plan voor Belevingspark Heel en heeft meegedeeld de rust binnen de organisatie en in de omgeving belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over dat er veel mis is met de zorg in woonzorgcentrum Titus Brandsmahof

The SP MP Leijten asked the minister, after press reports of serious care failures at the Titus Brandsmahof care home, why the IGZ inspectorate did not impose intensified supervision given prior complaints and a damning inspection report, and about the role of the supervisory board. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ sees no direct risks at present, is monitoring closely with unannounced inspections, will ensure continuity after a board change, and will enforce if improvements stall, while many follow-up questions were answered by pointing to the inspectorate or the provider.
However, the IGZ is currently closely monitoring the situation at Titus Brandsmahof and Carint Reggeland, including through unannounced inspections.
Wel houdt de IGZ op dit moment de situatie bij Titus Brandsmahof en Carint Reggeland nauwlettend in de gaten, onder andere met onaangekondigde inspecties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voor zorgbestuurders perverse prikkel tot fuseren vanwege salarissen hoger dan de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the WNT salary cap creates an incentive for hospital boards to merge, and whether the cap should be tightened for executives running several hospitals. The minister answered that gelieerde instellingen' pay is aggregated under the cap, that existing merger safeguards (governance code, zorgspecifieke fusietoets) are sufficient, and that the cumulation question is under review as part of the WNT evaluation.
The cabinet is currently considering, following the WNT law evaluation, whether tightening of the WNT is necessary based on the evaluation.
Het kabinet bekijkt thans in vervolg op de wetsevaluatie WNT of aanscherping van de WNT nodig is op basis van de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht van de FBI ‘Health care systems and medical devices at risk for increased cyber intrusions for financial gain’

An SP MP asked ministers about an FBI warning that medical records have value for criminals, and about data security in Dutch healthcare after reports on Belgian prisoners handling patient files. Minister Schippers answered that information security is the responsibility of healthcare providers under data protection law and NEN 7510, supervised by the Dutch Data Protection Authority and the Health Inspectorate, but declined to provide figures on past data breaches.
I have no insight into the number of healthcare organisations and hospitals that have experienced problems with the security of their electronic data systems and devices over the past five years.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal zorgorganisaties en ziekenhuizen dat de afgelopen vijf jaar te maken heeft gekregen met problemen in de beveiliging van hun elektronische datasystemen en apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over experimenten op psychiatrische patiënten van GGZ Noord-Holland-Noord (GGZ NHN)

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about experiments on psychiatric patients at GGZ NHN, a whistleblower's treatment, the governance code breach, and whether the IGZ and CCMO are examining the research under the WMO. The Minister answered that the governance code was breached but the institution has since complied, that the IGZ investigation is near completion with a report expected in Q1 2016, and that the follow-up study was judged non-WMO by the CCMO.
The IGZ expects to be able to finalise the report at the end of the first quarter of 2016.
De IGZ verwacht het rapport eind eerste kwartaal 2016 te kunnen vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de berichtgeving over de echtgenoot van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The SP MP Leijten asked the Prime Minister whether the health minister's husband, a consultant in the care sector, posed a conflict of interest, and why the minister's press spokesperson had contacted a journalist about the story. The Prime Minister answered that partners' business interests are not normally relevant to appointments, that the spokesperson acted with the minister's consent to correct a story that did not reflect the facts, and that he sees no reason for further steps.
In light of the answers given, I see no reason to do so.
Ik zie daartoe in het licht van de gegeven antwoorden geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van een morfinepomp

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a health insurer's refusal to reimburse a morphine pump and about the general reimbursement of prescribed aids. The minister said the insurer admitted miscommunication, tightened procedures, and that insurers must provide adequate aids under their duty of care, with the NZa supervising, while deferring a broader medical-necessity review to a letter in June.
In the insurer's view, two things went wrong.
Naar oordeel van de zorgverzekeraar zijn er twee zaken niet goed gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen kiezen voor een verhoogd eigen risico

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that more people choose a higher voluntary deductible and about NZa findings that such polices and budget policies may enable risk selection and undermine solidarity. Minister Schippers answered that the 2016 uptake figures are not yet known, that voluntary deductibles are a legitimate consumer choice, and that she awaits the NZa follow-up study before deciding whether to act.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the NZa's supplementary study.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het aanvullende onderzoek van de NZa af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het verdwijnen van 300 banen bij het Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) mede vanwege 239 miljoen kostende nieuwbouw

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about 300 job losses at Medisch Spectrum Twente linked to a 239 million euro new building, including whether the financing used swaps and why capital costs in healthcare rose after the building regime was abolished. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own building decisions, declined detailed knowledge of the plans, said data on capital costs were not available, and said no public rate norm applies to bank lending to care institutions.
It is up to hospitals themselves to make decisions about any necessary new buildings and the trade-offs made in that process, such as the organisation of the institution.
Het is aan ziekenhuizen zelf om beslissingen te nemen over eventueel noodzakelijke nieuwbouw en de afwegingen die daarbij worden gemaakt over bijvoorbeeld de inrichting van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over grote prijsverschillen voor zorg tussen gemeenten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that people cannot pay Wmo co-payments and forgo care, and about large price differences between municipalities. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said co-payments must not exceed municipal cost prices, pointed to municipalities' duty to provide individual case-based tailoring, and said data on people ending care is not collected but a CBS study is underway.
Neither I nor the municipalities register whether clients drop out of or forgo support.
Door mij noch gemeenten wordt geregistreerd of cliënten afhaken of afzien van ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Inzet ID-scanners bij leeftijdscontrole tabak in strijd met Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens’

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether using ID scanners for tobacco age checks breaches the Dutch data protection act, and what the government will do about it and about poor compliance with the age limit. The State Secretary replied that the Data Protection Authority says such scanners are not automatically unlawful, depending on the data scanned and how they are used, that retailers must follow the law but the government will not prescribe a system, and that the DPA alone decides enforcement priorities, while the NVWA has intensified supervision and he will report on compliance mid-year.
Under the EU privacy directive and the Dutch Data Protection Act (Wbp), the Data Protection Authority is the independent supervisor of the Wbp.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is krachtens de EU-privacyrichtlijn en de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) de onafhankelijke toezichthouder op de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over hoe de kosten van het huidige zorgstelsel ongezien naar de burger verschoven

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether a Follow the Money report showed that healthcare costs had shifted unseen onto citizens since 2004 and whether the minister's claims about premiums were misleading. The minister replied that the increase largely reflects omitting the healthcare allowance, that the 50/50 burden-sharing rule keeps employer shares roughly constant, and that a CBS misclassification will be corrected while the minister's earlier claims stand.
The CBS, among other things, counts self-employed persons as businesses in the cited flow charts.
Het CBS rekent onder andere in de genoemde stroomschema's zelfstandigen tot bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanhoudende ellende met de keukentafelgesprekken

The SP MP Leijten asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether municipalities are misusing the Wmo 2015 in home-care assessments (keukentafelgesprekken), including fraud, conflicts of interest and withheld independent client support, and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary rejects the picture of systematic deception, says improvements are needed, points to training, independent client support rights and letters to aldermen, and sees no need for generic measures or further investigation now.
If I receive signals that a municipality is not carrying out the prescribed assessment in accordance with the requirements, other than in isolated cases, I will address that municipality.

Indien ik signalen ontvang dat een gemeente het voorgeschreven onderzoek, anders dan in incidentele gevallen, niet overeenkomstig de daaraan gestelde eisen uitvoert, spreek ik deze gemeente daarop aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jeugd-GGZ instellingen wellicht miljoenen euro’s terug moeten betalen

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports that youth mental health institutions may have to repay millions of euros over disputed billing rules, and whether the situation could threaten providers and clients. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said the NZa would be asked to clarify and retroactively adjust the rules so insurers and providers can reach fair agreements, and stated that the ministry has not assessed bankruptcy risks.
She has therefore decided to ask the NZa to adjust the relevant rules (on direct time of the main practitioner and residential performances) with retroactive effect and in consultation with parties.

Zij heeft daarom besloten de NZa te vragen om de betreffende regels (rond de directe tijd van de hoofdbehandelaar en verblijfsprestaties) met terugwerkende kracht en in afstemming met partijen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de grote onzekerheid voor thuiszorgmedewerkers en cliënten na thuiszorgwissel in Amstelveen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about job and care insecurity for home-care workers and clients after Amstelveen's home-care tender, including transfer conditions, a 20% bonus for reduced care hours, and whether intervention is planned. The state secretary answered that the municipality set conditions requiring client-carer continuity and the cao VVT, that the bonus compensates providers for lost hours, and declined to intervene, deferring to the municipal council.
No. The municipal council is actively involved in the subject of domestic help.
Nee. De gemeenteraad is actief betrokken bij het onderwerp hulp bij het huishouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het al dan niet vergoeden van dimethylfumaraat bij de behandeling van MS

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether insurer Zilveren Kruis Achmea stopped reimbursing the cheap compounded dimethylfumarate for MS, leaving only the expensive branded Tecfidera covered, and whether this breaches earlier agreements. The minister answered that the insurer stopped reimbursing only supplied compounded preparations, not in-pharmacy preparations, that registered Tecfidera remains reimbursed, and that she is examining European rules on pricing and new active substances.
Zilveren Kruis Achmea has stated that it no longer reimburses the supplied preparations of dimethylfumarate.
Zilveren Kruis Achmea heeft aangegeven dat zij de doorgeleverde bereidingen van dimethylfumuraat niet meer vergoedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de voorwaardelijke toelating van fampridine (Fampyra) in het basispakket

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why fampridine (Fampyra) was placed under conditional reimbursement despite a negative Zorginstituut advice, why the cheaper pharmacy preparation was not chosen, and how this relates to Tecfidera and earlier motions on high-priced medicines. The minister answered that Fampyra was selected through the new top-down conditional admission route, that a lower negotiated price (about EUR 151 per 4 weeks) was agreed, and that the case is not adaptive licensing, while acknowledging undesirably high prices are a concern.
The medicine Fampyra was selected in consultation with the Zorginstituut on the basis of the top-down procedure.
Het geneesmiddel Fampyra is in overleg met het Zorginstituut geselecteerd op basis van de top-down procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de toekomst van de ambulancezorg en het definitieve rapport “Ordening ambulancezorg” van Zorgconsultancybureau SiRM

The MPs Leijten and Van Gerven (SP) asked why the SiRM report on ambulance care was dated 29 September 2015 but only sent to parliament in December, why it was not sent separately, who commissioned and guided it, whether earlier drafts and meeting minutes exist, and why the government opposes a public variant and did not examine labour market effects. Minister Schippers answered that the report was sent in December to avoid delay, that the commissioning and drafts were handled internally with no written minutes, and that the government sees no need for a public variant because quality is already regulated, while the options studied do not change the basic structure of ambulance care.
No written minutes were drawn up of that meeting.
Van dat overleg is geen schriftelijk verslag opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het interview met de directeur van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank

An MP asked the state secretaries about SVB director Nicoly Vermeulen's remarks on 'framing' and problems with paying pgb carers, the delayed compensation scheme, monthly mutations and the SVB's organisational culture. The government answered that the problems span the whole chain, that the damage was estimated at 6 to 9 percent of payments, that a chain-wide improvement plan is being developed, and that the director's appointment was ended.
In accordance with the motion, the House will be informed in the first quarter of 2016 about the concretely elaborated plan.
Conform de motie zal de Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2016 over het concreet uitgewerkte plan worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het verzwijgen van een medische calamiteit door het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) in Amsterdam

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a reported unsafe training climate and a concealed medical incident at the AMC's ENT department, including what was done after the RGS critical visitation report, whether patient safety is at risk, why the inspectorate was not alerted, and whether the investigation covers the working climate. The minister answered that a safe climate is an important condition but does not by itself mean acute patient risk, that measures have been taken, that the inspectorate found no reason to close the department, that the hospital board was not obliged to report but the inspectorate will discuss it, and that the inspectorate's investigation covers only the incident, with the outcome to follow.
The investigation into the report to the inspectorate is ongoing and I will inform your House of the outcome soon.
Het onderzoek naar de melding bij de inspectie loopt en ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het kwaliteitsonderzoek telefonische informatieverstrekking zorgverzekeraars

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers Zilveren Kruis/Achmea, VGZ and CZ went to court against the NZa's critical study of phone information provision, and about the NZa's outsourcing of the research to TNS NIPO. The minister answered that insurers will discuss the method with the NZa, that the NZa is reviewing how to conduct such studies after the court ruling, and that the NZa outsourced 24 studies in 2014 and 46 in 2015, spending about 1.6% and 2.8% of its budget on third-party research.
The NZa is currently considering how best to shape similar studies to the one in this case.
Momenteel beziet de NZa hoe zij het beste vorm kan geven aan soortgelijke onderzoeken als in deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het pgb-systeem van de SVB failliet is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the SVB's personal budget (pgb) payment system is bankrupt, whether it is too complex and costly, and how the cost overruns and administrative burden of the trekkingsrecht system will be handled. The State Secretary denies the system is bankrupt, says most payments are now made within 10 working days, promises an improvement plan and talks with municipalities, but declines to commit to moving pgb administration to municipalities and gives no breakdown of the cost of the system.

I would like to use the experiences of the aldermen concerned in the further development and improvement of the pgb chain, but I do not consider it in the interest of the budget holder to implement a far-reaching change to the pgb chain now and for a number of specific municipalities.

Ik wil de ervaringen van de betreffende wethouders graag benutten bij de doorontwikkeling en verbeteren van de pgb-keten, maar ik acht het niet in het belang van de budgethouder om nu en voor een aantal specifieke gemeenten een omvangrijke wijziging van de pgb-keten door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verzwijgen van een medische calamiteit door het AMC

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why AMC did not report a medical incident to the Health Inspectorate, whether it was a calamity or a complication, and how the hospital handled complaints and the parents. The Minister answered that the IGZ is investigating whether AMC met its reporting duty and cannot comment during the inquiry, and refused to release the full file because of privacy and Wob balancing.

No. Regarding the full file and the still to be drawn up (final) report on the event, the IGZ is legally required under the Wob to weigh the public interest in disclosure against the interest in protecting patients' privacy and preventing disproportionate harm to all involved.

Nee. Ten aanzien van het volledige dossier en nog op te stellen (eind)rapportage van de gebeurtenis is de IGZ op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob), wettelijk gehouden een afweging te maken tussen het publieke belang bij openbaarmaking enerzijds, en het belang van eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van patiënten/cliënten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over over 175.000 Nederlanders die hun schildkliermedicijn Thyrax Duotab tijdelijk niet kunnen ontvangen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about a shortage of the thyroid drug Thyrax Duotab affecting 175,000 patients, including side effects of switching drugs, the manufacturer's conduct, and whether pharmaceutical supply policy should change. The minister said the IGZ is investigating the manufacturer, that alternatives are available and Euthyrox may be imported, and that no change to drug policy is planned, though the minister will talk to the industry association and intensify the drug-shortage working group.
To answer whether the manufacturer can be blamed for socially irresponsible conduct, I want to await the IGZ investigation and not anticipate its results.

Voor de beantwoording van de vraag of de fabrikant maatschappelijk onverantwoord gedrag kan worden verweten wil ik het onderzoek van de IGZ afwachten en niet nu al vooruitlopen op de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Transitie doet administratieve lasten met 30 procent groeien’

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about reports that the social domain transition raised administrative burdens by 30 percent, and whether municipal policy freedom and fragmented approaches cause this. The state secretary acknowledged the burden problems and pointed to joint action with municipalities and providers, including an action agenda and a joint implementation organisation, while declining to provide data on external hiring costs and saying there is no representative research on the burden increase.
I do not have representative research on the administrative burden resulting from the transition.
Ik beschik niet over een representatief onderzoek over de administratieve lasten als gevolg van de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat toezichthouders van Patyna het eigen salaris fors verhogen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether it is acceptable that supervisory board members of Patyna raised their own pay while home-care staff are asked to give up salary, and asked for an overview of similar cases and for the quality criteria for supervisors. The state secretary answered that pay limits are set by the WNT and that setting a fitting fee is for the supervisors themselves, that Patyna has since reversed the increase and will review pay with its works and client councils, that data for 2015 are not yet available, and that an accreditation track for supervisors is being discussed with the NVTZ.
Within the limits set by the law, in particular the WNT, it is up to the supervisors to determine what constitutes an appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Inspectie verzwijgt misstanden. Rapport over grove fouten Helders verzorgingshuis geheimgehouden’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the health inspectorate IGZ concealed serious failures at care home De Golfstroom, why its calamity report was not published, and whether it would send the report to parliament. The State Secretary denied concealment, pointed to published inspection reports, said the calamity report is withheld to protect individual privacy under the open government act, and gave no commitment to send it.
On 17 February 2015 and 7 November 2015 the inspectorate actively published the reports it drew up following its inspection of the quality of care.

De inspectie heeft op 17 februari 2015 en op 7 november 2015 de door haar opgestelde rapporten naar aanleiding van het inspectieonderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening actief openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de chaos voor consumenten die zorgpolis zoeken

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers disagree on the savings from restricting free choice of doctors, how selective contracting on 'top care' quality labels affects consumers, and whether budget policies are cross-subsidised. The Minister replied that the measure was one part of the framework agreements, replaced by the 'Kwaliteit loont' package, and that selective contracting can lower premiums without endangering the duty of care.
With the lapse of this measure the framework agreements came under pressure, and with them the €1 billion in returns.
Met het vervallen van deze maatregel stonden de hoofdlijnenakkoorden onder druk en daarmee de opbrengsten van € 1 mld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over upcoding in de ggz-sector en de rol van adviesbureaus

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how to distinguish 'smart' declaring from upcoding in mental health care, and about the role of consultants such as P5COM, including whether the NZa checks their role. Minister Schippers answered that correct declaring is required, that she does not comment on consultants or ongoing NZa investigations, and that she sees no direct link between consultants and upcoding oversight.
The NZa does not make announcements about ongoing investigations.
De NZa doet geen mededelingen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Gapend gat tussen ziekenhuis en thuis’

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports of a gap between hospital and home care, including whether elderly patients stay in hospital too long and whether the funding ceiling for first-line stays is too low. The state secretary said he added EUR 20 million to the 2015 subsidy ceiling, denied a structural flaw in the system, described a new practical support team, and said the funding timing was coincidental.
No, no data on this is kept nationally.
Nee, hier worden landelijk geen gegevens over bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over upcoding in de ggz-sector en de rol van adviesbureaus

SP MPs asked the health minister about consultancy firm P5COM advising mental health providers, whether this involves upcoding, and whether advice spending and NZa oversight of advisory firms are appropriate. The minister answered that upcoding is illegal and that there is no indication of it in the press report, that engaging advisers is a matter for providers themselves, and that the NZa has not investigated advisory firms since its remit covers insurers and providers only.
When asked, the NZa states it has not conducted any investigation into this.
Desgevraagd geeft de NZa aan hier geen onderzoek naar te hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het boek De Kraak van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the book on the Slotervaart hospital, covering the consultant's role, the heroin production contract with Di-AcetylM BV, dividends, board members' side activities, and oversight by regulators. The minister answered most questions, denying conflicts of interest and mostly deferring on the involvement of other bodies, while declining to give details of some hospital decisions for reasons of possible criminal risk and a confidentiality clause.
It is not for me to give an explanation of their functioning in the history of the Slotervaart hospital.
Het is niet aan mij om een toelichting te geven op hun functioneren in de geschiedenis van het Slotervaartziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar CZ de bonuscultuur introduceert in de operatiekamer

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer CZ's plan to reward Catharina Hospital cardiology quality (a bonus culture) is a stunt, whether the contract can be shared, and whether such pay-for-quality contracts should be banned. The minister answered that the bonus goes to hospital budget tied to measured outcomes, declined to share the private contract citing commercial confidentiality, and rejected a ban while supporting quality-based contracting.
These are agreements between private parties and they contain commercially sensitive information.
Dit zijn afspraken tussen private partijen en deze bevatten bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag Wmo-indicaties stelt via een digitaal rekenprogramma

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether Den Haag's use of a digital calculation program to assess Wmo care needs, instead of personal interviews, complies with the law, covering privacy, access, costs, staffing and whether the minister will intervene. The State Secretary answered that the digital procedure for simple requests does not fully meet Wmo 2015 requirements, that Den Haag is adjusting it by early 2016, and that he sees no reason to intervene since use of a supporting program is not in itself unlawful.
It is up to municipalities to make these choices.
Het is aan gemeenten om hier keuzes in te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen zich voorbereiden op het uitkeren van winst

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about hospitals converting to BVs ahead of allowing profit distribution, and about risks to premium money, public bailout funds, and investor returns. The minister replied that hospitals may choose their legal form, profit distribution stays banned until the bill passes, and the bill contains safeguards such as Inspectorate and NZa pre-checks.
I have now received the advice of the Council of State. I am currently examining what consequences this advice has for the bill and will then inform your House and the Senate.

Ik heb het advies van de Raad van State inmiddels ontvangen. Momenteel ben ik aan het bekijken welke gevolgen dit advies heeft voor het wetsvoorstel en zal vervolgens uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de reactie op de verzwegen misstanden bij Universitair Medisch Centrum Utrecht (UMCU) en de handelswijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether an ENT surgeon remains active during the Inspectorate's investigation, whether the department should be closed, and whether the Inspectorate can independently investigate its own conduct and the review period from 2009. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ investigates without closing the department, the hospital has relieved the doctors of patient care, the hospital will review deaths from 2011, and the IGZ will set the terms of an external commission.
The broader investigation is carried out by the IGZ, which is assisted by a commission.
Het bredere onderzoek wordt door de IGZ uitgevoerd, daarbij laat de IGZ zich bijstaan door een commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) die geen onderzoek doet bij een onnatuurlijke dood in zorginstellingen

Two SP MPs asked the minister why the Inspectorate for Healthcare (IGZ) does not investigate unnatural deaths in care institutions, and whether external chairs and external expertise are appointed for calamity investigations, including why only elderly and disability care sectors got stricter rules and whether the Bartiméus family was pressured into signing a communication line. The state secretary answered that stricter rules apply to those two sectors from 1 October 2015, that IGZ reviews all calamity investigations and does not count follow-up investigations, and that pressure on the Bartiméus family would be regrettable though the family did not sign.
However, the IGZ currently does not register how often, within its calamity investigations, it does or does not instruct institutions to conduct their own follow-up investigations.
De IGZ registreert op dit moment echter niet hoe vaak zij binnen haar onderzoek naar calamiteiten, instellingen (g)een opdracht geeft om eigen (vervolg)onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financieringsproblemen bij specialistische psychische hulp voor mensen met kanker

The MPs asked whether psycho-oncology centres such as the Helen Dowling Institute, as specialist mental health providers, should be funded as part of the somatic DBC/DOT system, what happens to psychological care after a somatic treatment ends, whether partners and children are covered, and whether the centres' continued existence falls under insurers' duty of care. The minister answered that a national working group report sets out actions for psychosocial care, that care stays within medical specialist care while the somatic trajectory continues and the GP is responsible afterwards, that family support falls under the insured entitlement, and that insurers must buy sufficient care but choose providers themselves.
Soon I will consult with the parties involved about who will take which action and when it should be completed.
Binnenkort overleg ik met betrokken partijen wie welke actie gaat oppakken en wanneer dat gereed moet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het opnieuw sluiten van verzorgingshuizen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why an 88-year-old resident and other elderly people must move because the Olde Heem care home is closing, whether this is acceptable, and whether the government will intervene to keep four homes open. State Secretary Van Rijn replied that closures through renovation and new building are normal, stressed intensive consultation with residents and relatives, declined to intervene because responsibility lies with the care group, corporations and municipalities, and said no national register of closures exists, citing care trends toward staying at home.
No national list is kept of care homes that close.
Er wordt landelijk geen lijst bijgehouden van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over over selectieve zorginkoop en de gevolgen daarvan voor zorgaanbieders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about selective health-care procurement by Zilveren Kruis Achmea, including its termination of a shoemaker's contract and the fairness of the power balance with providers. The minister defended selective procurement as an important instrument, referred the contested contract dispute to the courts and to a planned complaints committee, and said the NZa and ACM oversee market power.
For the next contracting period a complaints committee will be established where care providers can go with complaints about the procurement procedure.
Voor de volgende contracteerperiode wordt een geschillencommissie in het leven geroepen waar zorgaanbieders met klachten over de inkoopprocedure terecht kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over patiëntenstops in de thuiszorg

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about patient intake stops in home care (wijkverpleging) where providers lack funding, asking why the government's promise that no one should be deprived of care is being broken and how the stops will be lifted. The state secretary answered that the insurers' duty of care is decisive, that insurers will contract additional care where needed, and that no additional budget is automatically provided, while stating the aim that no one is deprived of care.
Health insurers, however, have a duty of care for their insured persons.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben echter zorgplicht voor hun verzekerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Vijfsterren verpleeghuis in Bavel’

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether a five-star nursing home in Bavel, where a place costs about EUR 8,000 per month and mainly pgb holders will live, amounts to two-tier care that undermines regular care and access for those without money. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the Wlz guarantees equal rights to care, that clients may pay for extra services themselves, that providers need no Wtzi licence for Wlz care to pgb holders, and that the zorgkantoor is responsible for matching clients; he saw no tiering or capacity shortage and deferred housing shortages to corporations and municipalities.
The Wlz establishes an equal right to responsible and good-quality care for everyone who is entitled to Wlz care.
In de Wlz is een gelijk recht op verantwoorde en kwalitatief goede zorg vastgelegd voor iedereen die op de Wlz is aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over zorginstellingen die weigeren inzage te geven in het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why care institutions refuse to disclose board members' expense claims and whether the minister will oblige them by law to make declarations transparent. The minister regrets the lack of transparency, says governance is the sector's own responsibility, and points to the upcoming revision of the sector-wide governance code and a survey of expense rules at university medical centres.
Good governance and the associated integrity policy are the responsibility of care providers themselves.
Goed bestuur en het daarbij behorende integriteitsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een nieuw systeem voor een veiliger patiëntendossier

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how she views Amsterdam GPs' alternative to the national LSP patient-data exchange, whether a pilot giving three care institutions LSP access falls within existing patient consent, and whether the privacy regulator was involved. The minister answered that oversight of systems rests with the CBP, that she cannot guarantee GPs' contracting freedom, and that the pilot relies on existing consent and no separate CBP review is required.
It is for the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens to supervise this and take enforcement action.
Het is aan het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens daar toezicht op te houden en handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat te veel uitgaven aan pgb-gelden (persoonsgebonden budget) ten koste gaat van intramurale zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether a reported overrun on personal budget (pgb) funding is causing cuts to institutional care, and why Achmea Zorgkantoren reported a shortfall while the government expected no pgb shortages. The State Secretary answered that regional shortfalls are expected to be resolved by reallocating funds among care offices, that the NZa will issue an updated advice in October, and that the national budget is sufficient, while answering several figure-based questions only partly.
I have therefore asked the care offices to actively consult with each other on reallocating the available funds.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren daarom gevraagd om actief met elkaar in overleg te gaan over de herverdeling van de beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van Boriz BV onder druk worden gezet om hun klachten in te trekken

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked about reports that Boriz BV pressured former clients to withdraw complaints, whether housing tied to care is acceptable, what happens to clients' rights, and whether the board structure complies with the WNT pay law. The State Secretary condemned such pressure, pointed to a Menzis investigation, said clients can switch care providers, and asked the CIBG to investigate the missing WNT reporting in Boriz's 2014 accounts.
I have asked the CIBG, as the responsible supervisory body, to carry out further investigation.
Ik heb het CIBG, als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder, verzocht nader onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw sprake is van ondermaatse zorg in De Kleine Johannes

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of substandard care at De Kleine Johannes, questioning whether the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) monitored critically enough, why it did not follow up an Amerpoort investigation, and whether staff intimidation and budget cuts were involved. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ monitored closely, found the quality of care sufficient in 2014 and good in 2015, is following the organisation's improvement plan, and sees no reason for further measures.
The IGZ continues to actively monitor the implementation of the necessary improvement measures, both through risk-based supervision and through its supervision of reports.
De IGZ blijft actief toezien op de realisatie van de noodzakelijke verbetermaatregelen, zowel vanuit het risicogestuurde toezicht als vanuit haar toezicht op meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Leijten over bemiddelingsbureaus in de zorg

An SP MP asked the health ministers about intermediary agencies in care that charge high fees to self-employed care workers, including non-compete clauses and fines. The state secretary answered that fees are a matter for agreements between parties, that he will commission research into agency fees and services in care, and that agencies without added value should be reduced.
I therefore intend to have research carried out into the fees that intermediary agencies charge self-employed workers in care and the services the agencies provide.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de fees die bemiddelingsbureaus voor zzp'ers in de zorg hanteren en de diensten die de bemiddelingsbureaus leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de opnamestop in de thuiszorgtak van Stichting Zorgcentra Rivierenland

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about an intake stop at Stichting Zorgcentra Rivierenland's home-care branch, the adequacy of contracted district nursing, and whether a macro-budget ceiling and possible use of the MBI instrument undermine care provision. The state secretary said he regrets intake stops, put responsibility on insurers under their duty of care, pointed to available extra budget, and promised to share the care-cost monitor once data are stable.
In the letter of 29 June I indicated that I do not have data indicating waiting lists or intake stops.
In de brief van 29 juni jl. heb ik aangegeven niet over gegevens te beschikken die duiden op wachtlijsten of opnamestops.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Geen tijd meer voor gewone darmpatiënt’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports of longer waiting lists for bowel surgery at academic centres, possibly caused by bowel cancer screening, and a delayed operation for a patient. The minister said the causes are unclear, stressed that providers must refer patients and insurers must meet their care duty, and pointed to new specialist training places and existing waiting-time norms.
It is the duty of the care provider to deliver responsible care.
Het is de plicht van de zorgverlener om verantwoorde zorg te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Gesthuizen over de omgang met sociale media in (geestelijke gezondheids) zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Gesthuizen asked the health minister how mental health institutions handle patients' social media use and whether family can be involved in treatment after a mother complained in Metro. The minister answered that no similar signals are known, that self-determination limits restrictions unless a patient is involuntarily admitted under the Bopz, and that family policy and a new family support module are being developed.
It is important that providers are alert to translating the policy into day-to-day practice.
Het is wel van belang dat aanbieders alert zijn op het doorvertalen van het beleid naar de werkvloer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat er een opnamestop is voor dagbesteding en jeugd-ggz

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about reports of an admission stop for day care and youth mental health care, including at farm-based care providers in Leeuwarden. The secretary answered that no admission stop applies to Leeuwarden's municipalities, that a single provider (Bezinn) imposed one unilaterally, that municipalities are responsible for securing youth care and handling waiting lists, and that the wait-list figures are not separately monitored.
Waiting-time information is not a separate part of the national monitoring of youth care use.
Wachttijdinformatie maakt niet apart deel uit van de landelijke monitoring van het jeugdhulpgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over dehumanisering in zorginstellingen

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary about the use of camera surveillance and remote monitoring centres replacing care staff in nursing homes, and whether this dehumanises residents, plus questions on financial trade-offs, staffing and sticker-based care practices. The State Secretary replies that technology such as camera supervision can improve care and autonomy if introduced in consultation with residents and staff, that no national overview of experiments exists, that costs depend on local circumstances, and that the choice belongs to individual organisations and their supervisory boards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Leijten over gegijzelde patiënten in Kenia

MPs Smaling and Leijten asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of patient hostage-taking, moonlighting staff and resale of equipment in Kenyan hospitals, and about the scope of Dutch aid and corruption risks. The minister acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, described existing zero-tolerance rules and risk assessments (including for the ORIO hospital project), and promised to check the adequacy of risk analysis and to press partner embassies to stay alert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over de opslag van DNA-data bij onder andere Google en Amazon

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the lack of oversight of DNA data storage and sale by companies such as Google, Amazon and Illumina, including consent, legal basis, and the role of the Cbp. The minister answered that DNA is a free market regulated by privacy law, that the Cbp decides independently whether to investigate, and that a planned bill on control over body material and EU data-protection rules are in progress.
Given the independent position of the Cbp, it is up to the Cbp itself to determine whether it proceeds to do so.
Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van het Cbp, is het aan het Cbp zelf om te bepalen of het daartoe overgaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het verzoek aan gemeenten om de pgb-herindicaties (persoonsgebonden budgetten) voor 1 oktober a.s. af te ronden, en aan te leveren bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked why municipalities were asked to deliver revised PGB re-assessment decisions to the SVB by 1 October 2015, whether this deadline was brought forward and whether it risks careless or erroneous re-assessments. The State Secretary answers that no deadline was advanced, that the request aimed at planning for the budget holder and SVB steps, that municipalities can extend budgets to 1 May 2016 if they need more time, and that the chain director will actively monitor progress.
There is no question of deadlines being brought forward.
Er is geen sprake van het vervroegen van deadlines.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat daklozen overleven in bossen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views reports that homeless people, after losing housing due to debt or benefit cuts, are living in forests outside regular shelter, and what the scale of the problem is. The State Secretary said the problem is recognised in some cities, that municipalities are responsible for prevention and tailored support, and that the Trimbos Institute has been asked to study the scale, while stating that homelessness should not be accepted.
Nationwide data on underlying problems when people register for a shelter are not available because this is not (always) recorded.
Landelijke gegevens over achterliggende problematiek bij aanmelding voor een opvangvoorziening zijn niet beschikbaar omdat dit niet (altijd) wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten de eigen bijdrage als melkkoe gebruiken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that municipalities have raised co-payments for social care so sharply that people are giving up support, and whether charges above municipal cost prices are unlawful. The State Secretary says the loss of the 33% discount and the absence of national tariffs explain the rises, admits charges above cost price breach the Wmo 2015, and promises to alert municipalities, VNG and CAK, but declines to publish per-municipality co-payment data or to annul municipal ordinances.
This is not in line with the law and the municipalities concerned must adjust this.
Dit is niet in overeenstemming met de wet en de gemeenten die het hier betreft, dienen dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het kunnen meenemen van pgb naar het buitenland

An SP MP asks the state secretary about unclear rules on how long a pgb (personal budget) can be used abroad, and about a health insurer that reportedly stopped a budget holder's pgb after a stay abroad and reinstated it only if the objection was withdrawn. The secretary explains the 13-week limit, says the budget holder could appeal on grounds of misled trust, denies any coercion by the insurer, and declines to comment on the pending court case because the insurer has appealed.
As long as the case is before the court, I cannot go into substance on this question.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is kan ik niet inhoudelijk op deze vraag ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karalabut over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg vanwege geldgebrek

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the ministers of health and social affairs about reports that elderly people forgo care due to money problems, including questions on rising out-of-pocket costs, dental care, municipal co-payments, and income losses for pensioners. The minister answered that no evidence shows growing numbers forgoing Wmo or Wlz care because of co-payments, that a study on care avoidance will be sent to parliament before the budget debate, and that income measures will be weighed in the August decision-making.
Research into the nature and extent of care avoidance is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzoek verricht naar de aard en omvang van zorgmijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) die geen onderzoek doet bij een niet-natuurlijk overlijden in zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the health inspectorate IGZ does not investigate non-natural deaths in care institutions, how often such deaths go uninvestigated, and whether the IGZ can rely on institutions' own inquiries, which may be shaped by reputational concerns. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ will widen family involvement and use an external chair for inquiries in elderly and disability care, that the IGZ does not register many of the figures asked for, and that the IGZ assesses institutions' calamity reports while the public prosecutor handles possible crimes.
The IGZ does not register this, so I cannot answer this question.
De IGZ registreert dit niet, dus ik kan deze vraag niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over bestuurders van academische ziekenhuizen die massaal de declaratieregels aan hun laars lappen

Two SP MPs asked the minister about academic hospital board members who allegedly ignore expense rules, with luxury and private spending charged to care funds. The minister regrets the reports, asked the hospital federations to remind members of frugality, says individual cases and enforcement fall to the supervisory boards, and points to a planned NFU inventory of expense rules.
I cannot go into the individual cases. The information for that is lacking. It is also not my task; it is a task of the Supervisory Board.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de individuele casuïstiek. Daarvoor ontbreekt informatie. Het is ook niet mijn taak, het is een taak van de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ronselpraktijken in de wijkverpleging

An MP asked the minister whether a home-care provider's letter urging clients to refer relatives for a 25-euro voucher, and the practice of 'poaching' clients, is acceptable. The minister called the initiative undesirable, said clients decide their provider and the nurse decides eligibility, and promised to discuss it with the sector's umbrella body.
I will enter into discussion with home-care organisations to exchange views on this.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met thuiszorgorganisaties om hierover van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgbehoevende kinderen van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd worden

SP MPs asked the state secretary about reports that disabled children were being shunted from the CIZ to municipalities and denied Wlz care and day treatment. The secretary answered that five of eight Wlz applications were rejected on the access criteria, one was transferred to a municipality under the Jeugdwet, two remain under review, and he will work with VNG and the CIZ on clearer boundaries.
Only the CIZ is authorised to assess access to the Wlz, which guarantees an objective, expert and uniform indication process.
Uitsluitend het CIZ is bevoegd om de toegang tot de Wlz te beoordelen, waardoor een objectieve, deskundige en uniforme indicatiestelling is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over shirtsponsoring van een betaald voetbalorganisatie door ggz-instelling Inter-Psy

An MP asked the Health Minister whether a mental health provider (Inter-Psy) using a partner platform to sponsor FC Groningen shirts is appropriate, whether this is advertising funded by care money, and how its executive fees are treated under the law. The minister replied that private parties' arrangements are not her responsibility, that advertising is governed by the Advertising Code and the private firms' own decisions, and that management fees are permissible remuneration under the WNT rather than profit distribution, while leaving insurer and fee questions to others.
It is not for me to pass judgement on a cooperation between two private parties.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over een samenwerking tussen twee private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ellende in de Wmo

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about municipal failures in applying the Wmo 2015 home-care rules, including Delfzijl, Tiel, the objection-committee advice being ignored, and provider changes in Bergen, Uitgeest, Castricum and Heiloo. The State Secretary said municipal councils are primarily responsible, that courts' rulings are being followed, that he monitors municipalities and will intervene only in structural non-compliance, and saw no reason for a nationwide study.

Only when facts show a municipality deviates from the law more than incidentally and the municipal council fails to take its responsibility, do I have the option, under conditions, to use the powers under Article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015 and the Revitalisation of Generic Supervision Act.

Pas als uit de feiten blijkt dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wet en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid daarin niet neemt, heb ik onder voorwaarden de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 en de Wet revitalisering generiek toezicht gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over onmenselijk beleid door de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015(Wmo 2015)

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about municipalities cutting or refusing home help under the Wmo 2015, including a terminally ill man in Waalwijk, and asked whether the government would intervene and why rulings keep being needed. The state secretary answered that municipal councils are primarily responsible for overseeing municipal implementation, that the government will only intervene in cases of systematic non-compliance, that individual assessments are required, and that he has already written to aldermen and will keep monitoring.

Only when facts show a municipality deviates from the law more than incidentally and the municipal council fails to take its responsibility, do I have the option, under conditions, to use the powers under Article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015 and the generic supervision revitalisation act.

Pas als uit de feiten blijkt dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wet en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid daarin niet neemt, heb ik onder voorwaarden de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 en de Wet revitalisering generiek toezicht gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de problemen met de Wmo in Berkelland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about Berkelland municipality cutting home help for a 96-year-old man, the large number of objections filed, and who pays for handling them. The state secretary replied that municipalities must provide tailored support under the Wmo 2015, that Berkelland is contacting affected residents and reviewing cases, and that handling objections is a municipal cost, not a national review matter.
Berkelland municipality held a conversation with all residents who previously received level 1 home help in the first half of 2015.
De gemeente Berkelland heeft met alle inwoners die in het verleden de voorziening huishoudelijke hulp niveau 1 kregen in de eerste helft van 2015 een gesprek gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de politieke controle op grote hervormingen in de zorg faalt

Leijten (SP) asks how the government views reports that municipal councillors are too poorly informed to control the three major decentralisations in care, and what will be done about it. Minister Plasterk replies that colleges of mayor and aldermen are responsible for informing councils, points to the Wgr and guidance for councillors, and says the Rob advice on democratic legitimacy is pending, with more measures possibly to follow.
It is the responsibility of each college of mayor and aldermen to inform its own municipal council in such a way that it can properly carry out its control task.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ieder college van burgemeesters en wethouders om de eigen gemeenteraad zodanig te informeren dat zij hun controletaak goed kunnen uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over dat gehandicapten en mensen met een uitkering ingezet worden voor thuiszorg

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether the municipality of Kaag en Braassem replacing thuiszorg staff with disabled people and benefit recipients, and whether this displaces regular work and breaches Participatiewet rules. The state secretary answered that the programme pairs experienced home helps with trainees for activation purposes, denies that dismissals or displacement occur, and sees no reason for further inquiry or intervention.
From the available information it can be concluded that there is no question of job displacement.
Uit de beschikbare informatie kan worden geconcludeerd dat er geen sprake is van werkverdringing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het niet volledig vergoeden van palliatieve zorg

SP MPs asked whether insurer Achmea/Zilveren Kruis may refuse to reimburse professional presence during rest or sleep in the dying phase and whether guidance and aftercare for relatives falls under home-nursing coverage. The State Secretary says the insurer has clarified that all palliative terminal care, including rest-time presence and aftercare for relatives, is covered and declarable, and that the insurer has a duty of care without a cap on hours.
Enquiries with Zilveren Kruis show that the above statement is a misinterpretation of the home-nursing purchasing policy.
Navraag bij Zilveren Kruis leert dat bovengenoemde uitspraak een verkeerde interpretatie van het inkoopbeleid wijkverpleging is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tabakslobby toch weer bij Van Rijn aan tafel’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about a reported June 2015 meeting with tobacco retailers shortly before a debate on tobacco policy, including whether minutes were kept, the scope of contacts with the tobacco lobby, and whether such contacts should be minimised and recorded. The State Secretary answered that a meeting on 17 June 2015 with alcohol and tobacco sellers addressed youth age-check compliance and that no minutes were made, but the outcome was reported to Parliament; he stated that the ministry had no official meetings with the tobacco industry in the past year and that contacts are kept restrained and transparent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zwerven door de zorg’

An MP asks the Health Minister to respond to a column on uninsured homeless people, whether residence-address rules exclude vulnerable people from health insurance, and why no national registration of uninsured people or of care refusals exists. The minister answers that insurance depends on residence criteria with an address as a key indicator, that the BSN is unsuitable as proof of insurance right, that no registration or investigation of care refusals is planned for cost reasons, and that practical solutions with municipalities are being explored.
Furthermore, I do not have information about care providers that do not treat uninsured persons.
Ik beschik voorts niet over informatie ten aanzien van zorgaanbieders die onverzekerde personen niet behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Regio Gooi en Vechtstreek de huishoudelijke hulp toelage verkeerd inzet

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the Gooi en Vechtstreek region may keep home-help grant money outside home care so that the work falls under the cleaning sector cao, and whether this breaches the conditions for the grant. The state secretary answered that the regional plan is still being worked out with stakeholders, that the ministry approved the application, that cao compliance is primarily a matter for social partners, and that it sees no reason to think municipalities are not respecting the grant conditions.
Compliance with and enforcement of collective labour agreements is a civil-law matter and the primary responsibility of the social partners.
Naleving en handhaving van cao’s is een civielrechtelijke aangelegenheid en de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Pia Dijkstra over de hoge bedragen pgb-geld die verhaald worden op kwetsbare cliënten omdat hun zorgverleners hun zaken niet op orde hadden

MPs Leijten and Dijkstra asked why clients of the care provider Fundament, dragers in zorg must repay large PGB sums misspent by their providers, whether repayment can be dropped, whether a criminal complaint was filed, and about inspection and conflict-of-interest rules for court-appointed administrators.
