The Secretary of State says repayment claims are suspended, a joint framework with insurers is being drafted, legal conflict rules apply to administrators, and a law change will be discussed with the NZa in autumn.
The repayment claims in this case have been suspended.
De terugvorderingen in onderhavige casus zijn opgeschort.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de 10-jarige Sem niet bij de gemeente Stadskanaal en niet bij het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ) in aanmerking komt voor een indicatie voor zorg en onders

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked why 10-year-old Sem, who has epilepsy and autism, could not obtain care indication from either his municipality or the CIZ, and how many people fall into such gaps. The State Secretary admits the municipality should have taken over responsibility earlier, says it will now do so retroactively, and promises information sessions, but refuses to confirm any general figures or a systemic link between the Wmo and Wlz and offers only partial data.
It took too long before it became clear that the municipality is responsible under the Youth Act for Sem's care.
Het heeft te lang geduurd voordat duidelijk is geworden dat de gemeente op grond van de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk is voor de zorg voor Sem
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de toegenomen problemen met zorgverzekeraars die weigeren bereide of merkmedicijnen te vergoeden

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurers refusing to reimburse compounded and brand-name medicines, including inconsistent coverage, the Competition Act's effect on coordinated benefit decisions, and forced switching to biosimilars. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for applying the basic package, that talks with ZN, Zorginstituut and ACM are ongoing with a solution promised before the end of summer, and that prescribing decisions rest with the treating physician, while largely declining to address the specific cases and motions raised.
I am in discussion with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN), Zorginstituut Nederland and the ACM about a possible solution to this.
Ik ben met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN), Zorginstituut Nederland en de ACM in overleg over een mogelijke oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘dat de drie BAR-gemeenten af willen van verzekeraar CZ’

MPs Leijten asked whether the government would act on reports that three municipalities want to drop insurer CZ as partner for long-term care and whether gemeenten can choose another insurer. The State Secretary answered that the reported wish is not recognised from recent talks, that a regional secretary programme and ongoing talks are in place, and that the preferred insurer is designated by market share, so municipalities cannot choose; the prestatie wijkgericht werken is kept in 2016 to encourage agreements.
In that sense municipalities have no option to choose a particular health insurer; they will have to cooperate with it.
Gemeenten hebben in die zin geen mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een bepaalde zorgverzekeraar, zij zullen daarmee moeten samenwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Duitsers willen ons luxe dementiehuis’

The SP MP Leijten asked the state secretary for health whether a luxury German-run dementia home (Martha Flora), charging residents an extra EUR 3,750 per month on top of public funding, is acceptable and whether it creates a two-tier system of dementia care. The state secretary answered that quality dementia care must be accessible regardless of wealth and that the extra fee is not affordable for many, but largely referred back to earlier answers and gave no concrete new action.
Regardless of how many people want or can pay extra for extras, my starting point remains that high-quality dementia care must be accessible to everyone, regardless of the size of their wallet.

Ongeacht de vraag hoeveel mensen extra willen of kunnen betalen voor extra’s is en blijft voor mij het uitgangspunt dat kwalitatief goede dementiezorg voor een ieder toegankelijk moet zijn, ongeacht de grootte van de portemonnee.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Leijten over het bericht dat veel gemeenten geen woningaanpassingen verstrekken

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipalities refusing or limiting home adaptations under the Wmo 2015, including the Alphen aan den Rijn stairlift case and the advice to move house. The state secretary said the Alphen regulation conflicted with the Wmo, the municipality committed to amend it, and that he has no national overview and will intervene only if a municipality persists.
If I receive signals that a municipality's policy on home adaptations does not comply with the principles of the law, I will also ask the municipality for an explanation.
Mochten mij signalen bereiken dat het beleid van een gemeente ten aanzien van woningaanpassingen zich niet verhoudt met de uitgangspunten van de wet, dan zal ook ik de gemeente om uitleg vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen miljoenen tegoed hebben

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why hospitals owe nurses tens of millions in irregularity allowances, what the court ruling means financially, and whether employers will be urged to compensate. The minister declined to take a position, calling it a matter between employers and employees, and said she could not assess the financial consequences.
It is not for me to make a statement on this. This is a matter between employees and employers.
Het is niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen. Dit is iets tussen werknemers en werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het per direct opstappen van de bestuursvoorzitter van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the sudden resignation of the chair of the Admiraal De Ruyter hospital board, insurer CZ's role, and whether the supervisory board and regulators failed. The minister answered that the supervisory board is responsible for board appointments and dismissals, that insurers may voice quality concerns, that the IGZ had acted, and that she sees no need to change the system.
I currently have no insight into the conditions under which this board member's employment contract was terminated.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in de voorwaarden waaronder de arbeidsovereenkomst van deze bestuurder is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de introductie van de thuis-pretecho’s

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether home 'pret echo' devices (Babywatcher) should be used only under medical supervision, whether they risk harming pregnancy care and the unborn child, and who approves such products. The Minister answers that the product is not professional care, that it is unclear what safety limits apply, that existing product safety and medical device rules govern it, and that a quality model for obstetric ultrasound is under development.
I am not responsible for pret echos.
Ik ga niet over pret echo's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zorgverlener start kort geding tegen Svb vanwege pgb-problematiek’

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a care provider's kort geding against the SVB over PGB payment problems, including personal liability of budget holders for lost wages, cost orders, refusal to commit to 30-day payment, and repeated overpayments with weekend follow-up calls. The state secretary declined substantive comment because the case is before the court and the SVB is appealing, but noted a compensation scheme is being developed and explained the duplicate payments as an error with spoedbetalingen and apologised.
Because this case is still before the court, it is not appropriate for me to give a substantive response at this time.
Omdat deze zaak nog onder de rechter is past het mij niet om daar op dit moment een inhoudelijke reactie op te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Zilveren Kruis Achmea het eigen risico van mensen verrekent met het PGB-wijkverpleging (Persoonsgebonden Budget)

An MP asked the minister whether Zilveren Kruis Achmea may offset PGB (personal budget) payments for district nursing against outstanding eigen risico debts, and whether this should stop. The minister answered that insurers may offset payments against due claims under the Civil Code, that no misuse or fraud occurs because the eigen risico is not paid from PGB funds, and that four insurers apply such offsetting.
No, there is no misuse (or even fraud), since the eigen risico is not paid from PGB funds.
Neen, er is geen sprake van verkeerd besteden (of zelfs fraude), aangezien het eigen risico niet wordt betaald uit pgb-gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het mogelijk onbewust aangaan van een budgetpolis en de niet te voorziene gevolgen daarvan

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether budget health insurance policies, which restrict hospital choice, are really cheaper, since insured people paid more in co-payments on average. Minister Schippers answered that most budget-policy holders had no co-payments, that insurers must inform policyholders about contracted care, and that Achmea informed budget-policy holders and offered switching, with 97% choosing not to switch.
Health insurers are obliged to properly inform their insured about which care is contracted for a policy.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn verplicht om hun verzekerden goed te informeren over welke zorgaanbod gecontracteerd is voor een polis
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financieringsproblemen bij specialistische psychische hulp voor mensen met kanker

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why specialised psychological care for cancer patients depends on fundraising, and whether patients with adjustment disorders are excluded from insured care. The Minister said she is not against private funding but will not intervene in provider operations or insurer tariffs, has asked insurers to promote peer centres and will report before the budget debate, and maintains that adjustment disorders stay outside the insured package.
As Minister, I do not concern myself with the business operations of individual care providers.
Ik ga als Minister niet over de bedrijfsvoering van individuele zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een bewoner van zorglocatie Het Hietveld en het onderzoek van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) daarnaar

An MP asks the state secretary why the inspectorate delegated the investigation into a resident's death at Het Hietveld to the provider, whether the family or the provider reported the incident first, and how the provider treated staff after a court case. The secretary answers that the inspectorate follows its standard delegation practice, that the investigation is ongoing so details and reports are withheld, and that the inspectorate found the provider's first analysis insufficient and ordered a deeper one.
Since the investigation has not been completed, I cannot provide further information on this at this time.
Aangezien het onderzoek niet is afgerond, kan ik hierover op dit moment geen nadere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de drastische wijziging van het zorginkoopbeleid in de Wet langdurige zorg

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the reported drastic change in care purchasing rules under the Long-term Care Act (Wlz), including quality-based purchasing, regional tariffs, contracts with providers under intensified supervision, and risks of overlap with the Health Care Inspectorate. The State Secretary replies that the shift is toward dialogue-based, quality-focused purchasing, that the inspectorate and insurers have distinct responsibilities, and that no measures will be taken against purchasing below NZa maximum tariffs.
I will inform you in the progress reports on Dignity and Pride about the state of affairs.
Ik zal u in de voortgangsrapportages over Waardigheid en Trots informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de onvolledigheid van het Transparantieregister Zorg

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether the Transparantieregister Zorg, a largely voluntary register of payments from pharmaceutical firms to doctors and hospitals, gives a complete picture, and whether it should be enforced by the inspectorate. Minister Schippers answered that the register is adequate within its chosen framework, that self-regulation works, that the IGZ already has enforcement powers, and that no new law is needed.
I am of the view that, within the framework chosen for the register, the Transparantieregister gives a good picture of the financial relationships doctors have with pharmaceutical companies.
Ik ben van mening dat, binnen de kaders die voor het register gekozen zijn, het Transparantieregister een goed beeld geeft van de financiële relaties die artsen hebben met farmaceutische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over het bericht dat in Frankrijk wetgeving van kracht wordt die het aanmoedigen van anorexia strafbaar stelt

SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands could ban and prosecute pro-anorexia websites, as France was doing, and what the effects of the current pop-up warning approach are. The state secretary answered that encouraging self-starvation is not a crime under current law, that a ban would not be effective, that he will talk with providers and clinicians about updating the pop-up system, and that a treatment standard for eating disorders is in preparation.
The French initiative prompted me to examine whether a ban on pro-ana content would be desirable and legally possible in the Netherlands.
Het Franse initiatief is voor mij aanleiding geweest om te bezien of een verbod van pro-ana uitingen ook in Nederland wenselijk en juridisch mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Tonnen wachtgeld voor oud-zorgtopman’

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports of large severance and early-retirement payments to care executives, including a €370,419 payout to a former care boss who resigned, and whether this is acceptable. The minister responds that the government considers normalising executive pay and severance in care desirable, points to the WNT pay cap (€178,000 from 2015), says the CIBG will examine the specific cases, and promises an annual report on executive pay in December 2015 without disaggregating the figures further.
The CIBG will investigate whether the WNT has been complied with.
Het CIBG zal onderzoeken of conform de WNT is gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Audiciens naar rechter om eisen zorgverzekeraar’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about audiologists going to court over insurer contracting demands, whether selection on price undermines hearing-care quality, whether patients may lose devices they are satisfied with, whether child coverage should rise to 100%, and whether hearing care for the elderly was proposed for removal from the basic package. The minister says she cannot judge from a press report, expects price selection to lower premiums, points to a dispute protocol and calls on parties to improve it, decides on child co-payments in spring 2016, and says current policy will not change after the evaluation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Toename overgewicht in achterstandswijken’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about a WHO projection of rising overweight in Europe, the influence of marketing and self-regulation by the food industry, and widening socio-economic gaps in obesity. The state secretary answered that overweight is a complex shared problem, pointed to the Akkoord with industry, the Vinkje logo and the Gezond in de stad and JOGG programmes, and said existing policy is already intensified and locally focused.
The WHO estimates for 2030 for the Netherlands were however based on only three data points.
De schattingen die de WHO voor 2030 heeft gedaan zijn voor Nederland echter gedaan op basis van slechts drie datapunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een 100-jarige mevrouw die gemangeld wordt door het zorgstelsel

An SP MP asks the state secretary how a terminally ill 100-year-old woman's palliative care indication could be cut from 24-hour care to 2 hours a day, and whether the transition to the new care system left people without clear responsibility. The state secretary replies that re-indication by the nurse was appropriate given her improved condition, that people needing 24-hour care remain under the Wlz, that the professional is responsible for coordinating care, and that no exact data on re-indication outcomes is available.
I have no insight into how many people with a PTZ indication have been re-indicated and which re-indication these people have received.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel mensen met een PTZ indicatie zijn geherindiceerd en welke herindicatie deze mensen hebben gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de signalen dat de verplichting van DigiD met SMS notificatie tot problemen leidt

SP MPs asked the ministers whether mandatory DigiD with SMS notification harms access to services, notably for low-literate people and for trustees (bewindvoerders) unable to act for clients. The minister answered that DigiD is personal, that health insurers use various declaration options, and that the ministry is studying electronic support for trustees, without any concrete new commitment.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is studying, together with various ministries and implementing organisations, which forms of electronic support in situations of authorisation and (statutory) representation are desirable and possible.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties onderzoekt in dit kader – in samenwerking met diverse ministeries en uitvoeringsorganisaties – welke vormen van elektronische ondersteuning in situaties van machtiging en (wettelijke) vertegenwoordiging wenselijk en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de pgb-betaling door de Sociale-Verzekeringsbank (SVB)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a 75-year-old PGB budget holder who was reportedly turned away at an SVB office, backlogs in unopened mail and email, kort geding cases against the SVB, and payment disruptions when carers are ill or budgets are transferred. The State Secretary denied anyone is turned away, acknowledged an email backlog being cleared, cited one lost kort geding for the SVB, and said structural fixes for sick-carer registration are being developed.
According to the SVB, no one who presents themselves in person is turned away.
Er wordt volgens de SVB niemand die zich fysiek meldt, weggestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie steeds vaker te maken krijgt met verwarde en overspannen mensen

Two MPs asked whether rising police contact with confused persons reflects cuts to psychiatric beds, and about notifications from ministries and municipalities. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that no notifications from other ministries or municipalities were received, and that the bed reduction was not meant as savings and a misunderstanding about GGZ cuts exists.

As already announced, consultation will be held with the chain partners involved, focusing on relieving the police and identifying bottlenecks and improvements regarding confused persons on the street.

Zoals reeds aangekondigd zal overleg gevoerd worden met de bij het onderwerp betrokken ketenpartners, waarin zowel aandacht zal zijn voor het ontlasten van de politie als voor het inventariseren van knelpunten en het aandragen van verbeteringen met betrekking tot de verwarde personen op straat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Reumazorg verdwijnt uit Bravis-ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about the Bravis hospital's reumatologists leaving to set up their own treatment centre, including consequences for patients, staff and the hospital, and whether the hospital's governance played a role. The Minister responds that the hospital intends to keep rheumatology care and recruit new specialists, that patients can choose and insurers have contracted the new centre, and that the decision is the specialists' own, noting such splits can weaken regional hospitals.
It is the choice of the specialists concerned to take this step.
Het is de keuze van de betreffende specialisten om deze stap te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het onder druk zetten van de cliëntenraad voor het programma ‘Anita wordt opgenomen’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the management of GGZ-Centraal pressured the client council into allowing the filming of the TV programme 'Anita wordt opgenomen', and about patient consent, possible damage claims, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister said pressure on the client council would be regrettable if proven, that the matter is for the supervisory board and the Landelijke Commissie van Vertrouwenslieden, that the IGZ would handle a new signal, and that medezeggenschap rules will be tightened.
It is not for me to assess whether the care provider exerted pressure on the client council to end the advisory process and whether (high) damage claims were discussed.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de zorgaanbieder daarbij druk heeft uitgeoefend op de cliëntenraad om het adviestraject te beëindigen en of er daarbij gesproken is over (hoge) schadeclaims.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de indicatiestelling door professionals

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipalities cutting home-care hours via indication renewals without proper investigation, the use of care professionals and provision-based consultants, and wijkverpleging indication targets. The secretary said the Bergen op Zoom/Steenbergen/Woensdrecht municipalities now issue appealable decisions, that no national investigation is planned into mandating or provision-based consultants, and that professionals' conduct is governed by existing law and standards.

As a result, the municipalities of Bergen op Zoom, Steenbergen and Woensdrecht decided to send clients, following the provider's assessment with the client of what is needed, a decision open to objection and appeal.

Naar aanleiding hiervan hebben de gemeenten Bergen op Zoom, Steenbergen en Woensdrecht besloten om aan cliënten, in aansluiting op de beoordeling die de aanbieder samen met de cliënt maakt van wat er in de betreffende situatie nodig is om het resultaat een «schoon huis» te bereiken, een beschikking te sturen die open staat voor bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kleine ziekenhuizen: Grote Financiële nood’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a BDO report showing financial strain at small hospitals, including the 'stress test' results, the role of the macro-control instrument and the availability allowance. The Minister answered that hospitals must manage their finances themselves, that small hospitals are less resilient but can remain viable, that the availability allowance criteria will be revised and that the macro-control instrument is a last resort, with a letter to follow.
I have informed your House about the macro-control instrument in my letter of 31 March 2015.
Over het macrobeheersinstrument heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd met brief van 31 maart 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Pgb-scanner heeft probleem met blauwe pen’

An MP asked whether the SVB cannot process personal budget (pgb) care contracts written in blue ink, how many cases were affected, and why parliament learned of it through the media. The state secretary replied that the SVB reports no processing problems from blue ink, that scans are occasionally hard to read, and that unreadable documents are checked against originals or returned to the budget holder.
The SVB informs me that there are no problems in processing documents from budget holders.
De SVB meldt mij dat er geen problemen zijn bij het verwerken van documenten van budgethouders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voorgenomen sluiting van de enige nachtapotheek in de regio De Langstraat

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the planned closure of the only night pharmacy in De Langstraat, its effect on 45-minute access norms, the HAP/SEH merger and regional plans. The minister replied that insurers are responsible for contracting out-of-hours pharmaceutical care, that emergency medication remains available via Tilburg and Den Bosch pharmacies and GPs, that no statutory distance norm exists, and that the regional plans were abandoned by insurers in 2014.
Whether insurers comply with their duty of care is for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over materiële controles door zorgverzekeraars bij huisartsen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether Achmea's statistically triggered material audits of GP practices, including detailed checks that may breach medical confidentiality, are justified, and raised related issues such as terminal-care limits and a contractual gag clause. The Minister replied that audits follow a statutory stepwise procedure with privacy safeguards, that the insurer had communicated poorly in one case, and that she will ask the NZa to review insurers' contracting models and will look into the gag clause.
Health insurers themselves determine how they carry out material audits within the applicable laws and regulations.
Zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf hoe zij binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving de materiële controles uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat basiszorg voor daklozen een urgent probleem is

Ms Leijten (SP) asked the minister how to respond to a study of street doctors showing poor healthcare access for homeless people, including questions on registration, identification barriers, and coordination. Minister Schippers replied that existing rights and municipal responsibilities suffice, gave no new counts or uniform registration, and promised only a talk with the Dutch street doctors group.
In the short term, talks will be held with the Dutch street doctors group to further exchange views on the bottlenecks they encounter in practice.
Op korte termijn zal met de Nederlandse straatdoktersgroep in gesprek worden gegaan om nader van gedachten te wisselen over de knelpunten die zij in de praktijk tegen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over rechterlijke uitspraken met betrekking tot de Wmo 2015

An MP asks the State Secretary how court rulings on Wmo 2015 home-help cuts (Montferland, Utrecht, Franekeradeel, Harlingen) should be interpreted, including whether co-payments and individual assessment are adequate and whether municipalities will be held to account. The State Secretary replies that courts stress individual, careful investigation and affordability, that municipalities remain responsible for their own policy, that no central register exists, and that intervention is possible only if municipalities persistently deviate from the law.
I therefore do not keep a list of municipalities that have reduced or ended home help.
Ik houd dan ook geen lijst bij van gemeenten die de huishoudelijke verzorging hebben versoberd of hebben beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over het bericht dat ex-daklozen hun huis verliezen door te hoge huren

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked about reports that ex-homeless people lose their homes due to high rents, including numbers, waiting times and rent subsidy gaps. Minister Blok answered that data on these cases is largely unavailable, pointed to reinstated fit-for-purpose rent rules and corporation and municipal measures against evictions, and did not commit to new concrete steps beyond existing motions.
No data is known about this.
Hier zijn geen gegevens over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het uitblijven van het openbaar maken van het calamiteitenrapport van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) over de casus Tuitjenhorn

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the IGZ calamity report on the Tuitjenhorn case, which concerns euthanasia practice, was not yet made public and whether it could clarify matters before the evaluation commission reports. Minister Schippers answered that the report will be sent to parliament together with the commission's report on 31 March 2015, with some passages redacted for privacy, and that publication was delayed to avoid obstructing the independent investigation.
In line with the previously announced intention, the Minister of Security and Justice and I will send the IGZ calamity report to your House together with the commission's report.

Conform het eerder aan uw Kamer gemelde voornemen, zullen de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik het calamiteitenrapport van de IGZ, gezamenlijk met het rapport van de commissie, aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het vervreemden van zorgvastgoed als een gemeenschap een ouderenzorgvoorziening wil voortzetten

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a Vinkeveen residents' group wishing to keep the Vinkenoord care home running as an elderly care facility, the legal obstacles to community takeover, the owner Careyn's preference for leasing to a mental health provider, claimed absence of demand and of needs research, and whether the College sanering zorginstellingen oversight can protect local interests. The secretary replied that there are in principle no legal barriers, that any party including residents may bid under College sanering supervision for a market price, that the College has not yet been approached, and that the ministry lacks data on property values and procurement volumes.
The College sanering publishes the decisions it has taken on its website.
Het College sanering publiceert de besluiten die het heeft genomen op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verhoging van de eigen bijdrage Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) en Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that co-payments under the Wmo and Wlz rise by up to 50% in 2015 because the 33% discount is abolished, and about affected numbers, municipal use of general facilities, CAK billing errors and whether people retain pocket money. The State Secretary answered that the discount abolition was a known coalition measure, that effects vary by person, that he sees no evidence people cannot pay for general facilities, and that he will monitor implementation and report via the budget cycle.
There is no insight into the current actual situation, as regarding Wmo clients this depends on how municipalities currently organise support.
Er is geen inzicht in de huidige feitelijke situatie gezien dit wat betreft Wmo-cliënten afhangt van de wijze waarop gemeenten nu de ondersteuning inrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Persoonlijke Gezondheidscheck gelanceerd’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the launch of the Persoonlijke Gezondheidscheck, a preventive health check, raising concerns about false reassurance, legality under the population screening law, commercial interests, unequal access and unnecessary care. The minister answered that the check is lawful in its current form, that its effects on health gains are not yet known and will be monitored, and that the Health Council is advising on health check criteria.
Whether large-scale application of such an instrument actually yields health gains, we do not yet know.
Of grootschalig toepassen van een dergelijk instrument ook daadwerkelijk gezondheidswinst oplevert, weten we nog niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het uitblijven van onderzoek naar effectiviteit en veiligheid van nieuwe antistollingsmiddelen

Two SP MPs asked why, more than two years after the introduction of NOACs (new anticoagulants), no independent safety, effectiveness and cost-effectiveness research has been completed, and raised conflict-of-interest concerns about the lead researcher. The minister replied that a pilot was run, a more demanding methodology is being developed by ZonMw and the researchers, Lareb monitors side effects, and that current evidence gives no reason to change the conclusion that the drugs are appropriately used.
It is not the case that research into the effectiveness and safety has failed to materialise.
Het is niet zo dat het onderzoek naar de effectiviteit en veiligheid uitgebleven is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het menselijk leed door de bezuinigingen op de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo)

Parliamentary member Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about cases of neglect and delayed home care after municipal cuts under the Wmo 2015, and whether the government would monitor and intervene. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have procedures for urgent cases, that some cases were resolved or taken to court, that no national data on waiting times is collected, and that he sees no reason to doubt municipalities are performing their duties.
I do not have the information requested by the House on the number of people who would wait for home care or receive no home care in an acute situation, because it is not collected at national level.

Ik beschik niet over de door de Kamer gevraagde gevraagde informatie met betrekking tot het aantal mensen dat op thuiszorg zou wachten of geen thuiszorg zou krijgen in een acute situatie, omdat deze niet op landelijk niveau wordt verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorginstelling Thebe een eigen televisiekanaal opricht

Parliamentary questions from MP Leijten (SP) asked whether the care provider Thebe's plan for its own television channel was a sensible use of care funds amid job losses and cuts, and whether its board and supervisors set the right priorities. The State Secretary replied that no television channel is being set up, only a trial video bulletin to inform residents, families and staff about care and the transition, with residents asked for feedback on it.
There is no question of setting up a television channel.
Er is geen sprake van het oprichten van een televisiekanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het succes van Buurtzorg

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about Buurtzorg's quality and cost success, whether self-managing teams should become the norm, monitoring of nurses, management cuts, and why some insurers bypass Buurtzorg. The State Secretary largely defers to dialogue with the sector, declines to keep or publish provider-level data beyond what is already public, and points to existing programmes rather than new binding measures.
The Ministry of Health does not have the names of the care providers or their scores in the comparison.
VWS beschikt niet over de namen van de zorgaanbieders of hun scores in de vergelijking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Drankje tegen Alzheimer Souvenaid te snel op de markt’

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether Souvenaid was marketed too early, whether industry influence (Nutricia, Deltaplan Dementie) compromises research independence, and about dementia prevalence figures. Minister Schippers answered that the NVWA concluded Souvenaid does not meet the medical dietary food definition and enforcement has started, that ZonMw's conflict-of-interest codes and transparency register provide sufficient safeguards, and that prevalence estimates broadly align with international studies.
The NVWA investigation has been completed. The NVWA concluded that Souvenaid does not meet the definition of food for special medical purposes.
Het onderzoek van de NVWA is afgerond. De NVWA heeft geconcludeerd dat Souvenaid niet voldoet aan de definitie van dieetvoeding voor medisch gebruik.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over “patiënten met een armenpolis die steeds vaker bij moeten betalen na een behandeling in het ziekenhuis”

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about patients with budget health insurance policies who are increasingly billed by hospitals after treatment, asking about scale, costs, insurer information duties and contracting obligations. The minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders, that data is being requested from insurers and an NVZ survey found affected patients at 73% of hospitals, that a hospital portal is being developed, and that reintroducing a contracting obligation is undesirable.
I have no data on the number of people who use the option of installment payments linked to bills not reimbursed by the health insurer because the care was not contracted.

Ik heb geen gegevens over het aantal mensen dat gebruik maakt van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen, dat samenhangt met rekeningen die niet vergoed worden door de zorgverzekeraar omdat er geen sprake is van gecontracteerde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat thuiszorgmedewerkers moeten bloeden voor falend ICT-beleid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health how he judges thuiszorg organisation Laurens failing to determine staff wages because its 'Planapp' system malfunctioned, and about its ICT investments and minute-registration systems. The State Secretary said the problem stems from ICT integration within the organisation, that the board has taken responsibility and advanced wages, has no insight into the investments (referring to the annual report), and that providers choose whether to use minute registration.
I have no insight into that.
Daar heb ik geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over collectieve zorgverzekeringen waarbij chronisch zieken geen baat hebben (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden bijlage)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about chronically ill people not benefiting from municipal collective health insurance, the loss of compensation schemes, and the removal of long-term physiotherapy for rheumatism from the basic package. The minister rejected the premise, said municipalities have been expanding collective schemes and bear responsibility for support, and maintained that evidence for long-term physiotherapy is insufficient while remaining open to a study.
Due to the multitude of factors, it is not feasible to give a clear picture of the costs and their development.
Door de veelheid van factoren is het niet doenlijk om een duidelijk beeld van de kosten en de ontwikkeling daarin te schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de behandeling van mensen die zichzelf beschadigen op de spoedeisende hulp (SEH)

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Health Minister, after a documentary on self-harming patients' treatment at emergency departments, how the government views unsedated stitching, refusals, dismissive remarks by staff, unreported complaints, and training. Minister Schippers condemned the reported conduct, said the IGZ is examining signals received via the national complaints office, and offered to encourage patients to report, while noting the NVSHA does not recognise the picture.
The IGZ takes these signals seriously. Within a few weeks the IGZ will consider what it can do with the picture from the signals.
De IGZ neemt deze signalen serieus. Binnen een aantal weken beziet de IGZ wat ze met het beeld uit de signalen kan en gaat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet vergoed krijgen van medisch noodzakelijke plastische chirurgie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about medically necessary plastic surgery no longer covered in basic insurance, citing cases such as a teenager with Poland syndrome and an older woman with drooping eyelids. The minister replied that the 2005 restrictions aim to prevent cosmetic procedures being billed as necessary, that she has no plans to widen coverage now, and that specialists must first show they use care appropriately.
I currently have no plans to expand coverage of plastic surgery in health insurance or to loosen the existing limited coverage.
Ik heb momenteel geen plannen om de vergoeding van plastische chirurgie in de zorgverzekering uit te breiden of de bestaande beperkte vergoeding te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het feit dat de griepprik dit jaar amper bescherming biedt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that this year's flu vaccine offers little protection, whether the mismatch was foreseeable, and whether the vaccination should be evaluated or cancelled. The minister answered that the strain selection is made months in advance and a mismatch could not be ruled out, declined to quantify extra cases or deaths and the extra costs, and rejected a new evaluation and cancellation as unwarranted, while noting planned effectiveness research.
Direct, reliable information on the number of deaths from flu is not available.
Directe, betrouwbare informatie over het aantal sterfgevallen door griep is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het feit dat de griepprik dit jaar amper bescherming biedt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a possible conflict of interest of committee member Wilschut, who has paid ties to Sanofi Pasteur, and about the membership of a new Gezondheidsraad committee on antivirals. The minister answered that disclosed interests do not automatically constitute a conflict, that the Gezondheidsraad's conflict-of-interest procedures were followed, that the new committee is not yet installed and its composition will be published, and that no new antiviral stock will be bought before the Kamer can form a view unless circumstances require otherwise.
I do think it is important that full transparency is practised in this regard.
Ik vind het wel belangrijk dat hierover volledige transparantie betracht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een op non-actief gestelde topambtenaar die toch bij de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) aan de slag ging

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked how a senior civil servant placed off duty at Defence could later work at the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa, whether this was a favour, and what the usual practice is. The minister replied that the official was never suspended or placed on non-active status but offered his post himself after IT restructuring, that the Defence Minister's investigation is awaited, and denied any favour or cover-up, while declining to give a full overview of reassignments.
I want to emphasise that in this case there is no question of an official who is or has been placed on non-active status.
Ik wil benadrukken dat er in dit geval geen sprake is van een ambtenaar die op non-actief is of wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het intrekken van een indicatie voor wijkverpleging twee dagen voor ingang nieuwe zorgverdeling tussen gemeenten, Rijk en zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether a family was wrongly told, two days before the new long-term care law took effect, that their son's intensive child care falls under the municipality, and how many others received similar notices. The State Secretary answered that insurers initially used too narrow a benefit scope, corrected it in December, that the family's case was handled in line with agreements, and that data transfers to municipalities and the SVB have been corrected.

Health insurers received an update in December on the scope of entitlement of the affected insured persons and on that basis re-informed them about the care they receive under the Health Insurance Act and the budget amount.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben in december een update ontvangen van de omvang van de aanspraak van de betreffende verzekerden en hebben op basis daarvan hun verzekerden opnieuw geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Leijten over de uitbetaling van zorgverleners van pgb-houders door de Sociale Verzekeringsbank

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked about SVB payments to care workers of personal budget (pgb) holders, including leaked contracts with citizen service numbers, the number of monthly versus declaration-based workers, and the Rapid Response Team. The State Secretary acknowledged the incidents, gave partial figures (68,000 monthly-paid workers, about 130,000 declaration-based), refused a breakdown by pgb type for now, and promised to share the steering group documents in the evaluation.
Within the short timeframe for answering these questions, it is not possible to provide a breakdown into Wlz-pgb, Wmo-pgb and Jeugdwet-pgb.
Binnen de korte termijn voor beantwoording van voorliggende vragen is het niet mogelijk om een uitsplitsing te geven in Wlz-pgb, Wmo-pgb en Jeugdwet-pgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over veertig keer zo duur worden van een geneesmiddel na nieuwe registratie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the re-registration of MabCampath (leukaemia drug) as Lemtrada for multiple sclerosis, raising the price from about 15 to 618 euro per milligram, and whether such price increases should be curbed and the drug excluded. The minister called the price difference discutable and said pricing reform, EU and competition aspects are being examined, with the Zorginstituut's assessment awaited before deciding on reimbursement and any financial arrangement.
I disapprove if manufacturers were to choose to pursue disproportionately high profit margins over taking their social responsibility to contribute to patient care at acceptable prices.
Ik keur het af indien fabrikanten zouden kiezen voor het nastreven van onevenredig hoge winstmarges boven het nemen van hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het explosief stijgend aantal mensen dat het eigen risico niet meer kan betalen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the sharp rise in people unable to pay their mandatory deductible (eigen risico), including payment arrangements with insurers, reactions to reported avoidance of necessary care, and whether the deductible should be phased out. The minister said she lacks data on the total rise in payment arrangements, pointed to planned research on care avoidance and a Vektis analysis, and ruled out abolishing or reducing the deductible for now.
I have no insight into the increase in the number of people using the option to pay the deductible in instalments.
Ik heb geen inzage in de stijging van het aantal mensen dat gebruik maakt van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen van het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de klantenwerving van zorgverzekeraars

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurer Promovendum approaching people unsolicited, about inducements such as free months, gifts and referral payments used to attract customers to health insurers, and whether these target profitable groups (risk selection). The Minister answered that insurers may set their own marketing strategy within legal limits, that she asked the NZa to examine indirect risk selection, and that she would act if the NZa finds problems, while leaving cost data and some questions to the insurers and the NZa.
If the research shows that there is risk selection with certain policies, I will take the necessary measures.
Als uit het onderzoek naar voren komt dat er sprake is van risicoselectie bij bepaalde polissen, dan zal ik de nodige maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inkoop van huisartsenzorg

MP Leijten (SP) asks the minister why GPs are criticising insurers' contracting for primary care, why VGZ wrote to a GP who spoke out in the media, and whether the insurer's threat of damages and demand for direct contact is fair, including effects on palliative care and mental health support for patients without contracts. Minister Schippers replies that contracting is a private matter between insurers and providers, that she prefers disputes not be aired in the media, that she has no view on VGZ's communication, and that she will discuss lessons for 2016 with the parties.
The contracting process is a private-law matter between the health insurer and the care provider.
Het contracteringsproces is een privaatrechtelijke aangelegenheid tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over de crowdfundingsite www.geefgezondheid.nu

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that people with health needs must compete for donations on the crowdfunding site geefgezondheid.nu, whether the government will make the site unnecessary by ensuring insurers and municipalities cover needs, and whether it will analyse crowdfunding requests for wrongly denied care. The minister answered that eligibility decisions rest with insurers and municipalities, that crowdfunded items fall outside or only partly within the basic package and that the government has no duty there, and declined to analyse the requests.
These concern forms of care or provisions that are not part of the basic Zvw package or only partly fall under the Wmo
Het gaat hier om zorgvormen of voorzieningen die geen onderdeel zijn van het basispakket van de Zvw of slechts ten dele vallen onder de Wmo
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van zorginstelling Pyxis zelf hun persoonsgebonden budget aan Agis Zorgkantoor moeten terugbetalen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether former clients of care provider Pyxis should be forced to repay their personal budgets to Agis Zorgkantoor, and what the government will do about the fraud-related situation and the SVB's readiness to detect pgb fraud. The state secretary said an investigation is ongoing, repayment claims are suspended, talks on support for good-faith budget holders are underway, and the new trekkingsrecht system improves monitoring, while declining to comment on the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigation, I cannot respond substantively to the situation.
Vanwege het lopende onderzoek kan ik niet inhoudelijk op de situatie reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het afschalen van de Intensive Care (IC) van ziekenhuis Bethesda in Hoogeveen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that the intensive care unit at Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen would be scaled down, including internal intensivist emails, possible links to a concept plan, insurer Achmea's role, staff consequences and consistency with the Minister's stance on small regional hospitals. The Minister answered that the IC is not being closed, that the internal note is only a discussion document, that patients are transferred to Emmen only when medically necessary or after 72 hours of ventilation, and that the board, insurers and supervisory bodies bear the responsibility.
The inspectorate supervises the quality of care delivered and checks whether the preconditions for care are present.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit van geleverde zorg en toetst of de randvoorwaarden voor geleverde zorg aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de dreigende sluiting van de intensive care (IC) in Ziekenhuis Bethesda te Hoogeveen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the planned closure of intensive care units at Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal hospitals was known in advance, whether the board chair's assurances were credible, and whether limited special care with remote intensivist consultation is responsible. The minister answered that the document is an internal discussion note without decision status, no closure is decided, the board remains responsible, the supervisory board should be involved in any decision, and quality oversight lies with the IGZ and NZa.

Once the new guideline is established, organisation-wide policy on IC care will be set so that it meets all requirements for responsible care as well as the Treant Zorggroep multi-year policy framework.

Zodra de nieuwe richtlijn is vastgesteld zal het organisatiebreed beleid ten aanzien van de IC-zorg vastgesteld worden, zodanig dat het zowel voldoet aan alle eisen die er aan verantwoorde zorg gesteld worden als aan het meerjarenbeleidskader van de Treant Zorggroep
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Gemeente weigert brandonveilige instelling te sluiten”

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that a municipality refused to close a fire-unsafe care institution, and about how fire safety in care homes is supervised and enforced. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies primarily with care providers and municipalities, that the government lacks data on inspection frequency and enforcement, and that a fire-safety action programme and a TNO dashboard are under way.
At national level there is no data on how often municipalities have addressed care institutions regarding fire safety.
Op rijksniveau zijn geen gegevens over het aantal keren dat gemeenten zorginstellingen in het kader van brandveiligheid hebben aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Thieme over de positie van identiteitsgebonden zorgcentra met een landelijke functie

MPs Leijten and Thieme asked whether the vegetarian care home Felixoord, which has a national identity-based function, should be protected from closure caused by decentralisation and the shift to home care. The State Secretary replied that care providers must prepare for fewer light-care residents, that no national status exists for care homes since 2001, that contracting must offer a varied supply, and that he knows of no other identity-based homes threatened.
I have no signals that specifically identity-based care centres are threatened in their continued existence.
Ik heb geen signalen dat specifiek identiteitsgebonden zorgcentra in hun voortbestaan worden bedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het onderzoek van de Inspectie van de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) naar de zelfdoding van een bewoner in De Golfstroom

An MP asked the State Secretary why the health inspectorate's investigation into a resident's suicide at De Golfstroom was reported inconsistently, whether whistleblowers at De Vrijwaard were ignored, and how families and contacts were handled. The State Secretary answered that a case mix-up occurred, that the investigation decision dated from 18 November 2014, that the inspectorate asks providers to investigate first, and that families were involved.
The decision dates from 18 November 2014, following receipt and study of the report.
Het besluit dateert van 18 november 2014, volgend op de ontvangst en bestudering van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de doorstart van Ascensio onder een andere naam

An SP MP asked whether care provider Ascensio, ordered closed by the inspectorate, was continuing care through a new company, Infinitus Zorg, and how the inspectorate supervised the transfer of clients. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate's order covered both companies, Infinitus Zorg was stopped from providing care until verified, and the inspectorate confirmed on 18 December 2014 that both had stopped providing (PGB-funded) care.
I was therefore of the view that my order to cease care provision and transfer clients, as it was directed at Ascensio Zorg B.V., was also directed at Infinitus Zorg B.V.
Ik was dan ook van mening dat mijn aanwijzing tot staken van de zorgverlening en overdracht van de cliënten zoals die zich richtte op Ascensio Zorg B.V. zich (ook) richtte op Infinitus Zorg B.V.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Leijten over ID-scanners

MPs Voordewind and Leijten asked the State Secretary for Health about ID-scanners for age checks in alcohol and tobacco sales, including the independence of the Bureau Nuchter mystery-shop research, the Trimbos findings on their effectiveness, and the State Lottery co-funding of scanners. The State Secretary answered that scanners are only a supporting tool within a broader approach, that the ministry will commission the national mystery-shop study from Bureau Nuchter with a scientific committee checking its objectivity, and that the state is not formally a shareholder of the State Lottery.

In response to the questions about conflicts of interest, Bureau Nuchter itself proposed setting up a scientific committee to test the objectivity of this research, and I have responded positively to this.

Naar aanleiding van de gestelde vragen over belangenverstrengeling heeft Bureau Nuchter zelf voorgesteld om een wetenschappelijke commissie in te stellen die de objectiviteit van dit onderzoek zal toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een gehandicapte bewoner bij Cordaan

MP Leijten asked the state secretary about the death of a 19-year-old resident at a Cordaan care home, including the IGZ and police investigations, family involvement, staffing with temporary workers, and parents' concerns. The state secretary answered that the IGZ has asked Cordaan to investigate and report, that no criminal investigation is underway, and that the inspectorate will assess the report and speak with the family, but declined to give details while the assessment is pending.
Pending this assessment by the inspectorate, I cannot go into this further.
Hangende deze beoordeling door de inspectie kan ik hier niet nader op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over geestelijke gezondheidszorg en verslavingszorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about access to mental health and addiction care, including insurers restricting care, waiting lists not being published centrally, bed reductions, and denial of joint admission for addicted mothers and infants. The Minister replied that insurers must follow professional judgment and their duty of care, that waiting times are publicly listed though not centrally registered, that she sees no signal of rising waiting lists, and that she will send a bed-reduction report in early 2015.
I have no reason to assume that the duty of care is at stake and that patients do not have timely access to care.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat de zorgplicht in het geding is en dat patiënten onvoldoende snel toegang tot zorg hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de berichtgeving over foute buitenlandse tandartsen die hun praktijken in Nederland voortzetten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports that foreign dentists barred from practising in their home countries continued working in the Netherlands, and about registration checks, language requirements and the BIG register. Minister Schippers answered that the CIBG now checks for foreign restrictions via information exchange and a pilot, that language testing is being studied within the EU directive implementation, and that the CIBG does not itself check deregistered persons' practice, while rejecting a dentist shortage argument.
The CIBG does not check whether persons who have been struck off the BIG register actually stop practising in the Netherlands or abroad.
Het CIBG controleert niet of personen die zijn doorgehaald in het BIG-register ook daadwerkelijk hun beroep in Nederland of daarbuiten niet meer uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het feit dat vele kinderen met lichte verstandelijke beperking en ernstige gedragsproblemen niet in aanmerking komen voor de Wet langdurige zorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary why children with mild intellectual disability and severe behavioural problems, such as the boy Youp, fall outside the Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) and whether this reflects a selection error and a problem with the transition to the Jeugdwet/Wmo. The state secretary answered that Youp will receive Wlz care next year under the Regeling Wlz-indiceerbaren, that similar cases registered with client organisations may get a one-year decision, and that a decision on the broader group will be considered in 2015.
Given the situation of Youp and his family, it is desirable to treat him nonetheless as belonging to the group of clients covered by the Wlz-indiceerbaren regulation.
Gezien de situatie van Youp en zijn familie is het wenselijk hem alsnog te behandelen als behorende tot de groep cliënten die onder de regeling Wlz-indiceerbaren vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over “de zelfdoding van een bewoner van De Golfstroom naar aanleiding van een gedwongen verhuizing"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that staff warnings of suicide risk were ignored at care institution De Golfstroom after a forced relocation, whether it is desirable that an institution's policy leads to a wish to die and that a director said suicide 'can be a choice', and why the institution lacks a works council. The State Secretary said the Inspectorate will examine whether signals were adequately addressed, declined to interpret the director's remark, and explained the statutory works council rules and the exemption route used at De Golfstroom.
The inspectorate will take into account in its investigation whether this was sufficiently done.
De inspectie zal in haar onderzoek meenemen of dat hier voldoende gebeurd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de reactie van de minister op de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie met betrekking tot het afschaffen van de vrije artsenkeuze

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister whether her claim that abolishing free choice of doctor complies with the EU Court of Justice ruling and the patient rights directive was accurate, and about the legal basis and savings of the measure. The minister rejects accusations of misrepresentation, argues the amended Article 13 Zvw fits the directive and Council of State advice, and provides the savings justification of about 1 billion euro.
There is no question of distorting facts regarding rulings of the European Court of Justice.
Er is geen sprake van het verdraaien van feiten inzake uitspraken van het Europees Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Voortbestaan Gemini Ziekenhuis in Gevaar’

An SP MP asks the health minister about the rejection of Gemini Hospital's request for an availability contribution and whether the ministry will help keep the hospital open. The minister declines to comment on the individual request, says insurers have a duty of care under NZa supervision, and promises no direct funding intervention.
I do not comment on individual applications for an availability contribution. That is an exclusive statutory competence of the NZa.
Ik ga niet in op individuele aanvragen voor een beschikbaarheidsbijdrage. Dat is een exclusieve wettelijke bevoegdheid van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het verband tussen de toename van het aantal spoedritten en inzet van de traumahelikopter en het gebruikte uitvraagsysteem

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the rising number of emergency ambulance and trauma helicopter dispatches is linked to the AMPDS/ProQA or NTS dispatch systems, and about related data and staff effects. The minister answered that the systems were introduced only gradually since 2011-2014, so no link can yet be analysed, that data on dispatches and MMT deployments are provided, and that the cause of the growth is still being investigated.
I do not yet have a good understanding of the causes of the growth in the number of emergency rides. I am having research carried out into this.
Ik heb op dit moment nog geen goed inzicht in de oorzaken van de groei van het aantal spoedritten. Ik laat hier onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van rapid responders en brambulances

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the rising use of rapid responders in ambulance dispatch and about a 'brambulance' pilot in Rotterdam-Rijnmond, including liability and effectiveness. The Minister defends rapid responders as speeding patient care, rejects further research and the claim that they are used merely to meet response times, and promises an evaluation of the pilot by early 2015.
Once the evaluation is ready, the safety region will make it public so that interested parties can take note of it.
Zodra de evaluatie gereed is, zal deze door de veiligheidsregio openbaar worden gemaakt zodat geïnteresseerden hier kennis van kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de op 1 oktober 2014 geopende CareToGo op het centraal station van Den Haag

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about CareToGo, a privately run walk-in clinic at The Hague central station, raising concerns about paid care, prescribing, data sharing, the doctor-patient relationship and costs. Minister Schippers answered that the clinic is a permitted new entrant outside the basic insurance package, that it does not affect costs or gatekeeping, and that it is privately financed, with no insurers or pharma firms involved.
CareToGo has informed me that no health insurers or pharmaceutical companies are behind CareToGo.
CareToGo heeft mij bericht dat er geen zorgverzekeraars of farmaceutische bedrijven achter CareToGo te zitten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over twee urgente patiënten in een huisartsenpraktijk die de afgelopen week niet opgenomen konden worden in een verzorgings/verpleeghuis terwijl kamers leeg staan

Two SP MPs asked why two urgent patients could not be admitted to a care or nursing home while beds were reportedly empty, and whether doorzettingsmacht for GPs was possible. The State Secretary replied that providers hold crisis capacity and a 24-hour solution is required, that one patient chose to wait and the other died, and that a check on the number of wait-listed urgent cases would be reported in November.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over leeftijdscontrole bij alcoholgebruik

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about ministry contacts with the food and alcohol industry on age checks for alcohol sales, why a pilot report was only finalised in October 2014, when the ministry learned the pilot's outcome, and industry advertising spending. The state secretary listed Directeuren Overleg Alcohol and regular alcohol policy meetings, said the report was ready in May and will be sent to parliament, noted the pilot's disappointing outcome surfaced in February, and said he has no data on industry marketing spend.
By separate letter you will receive this version ahead of the budget debate.
Middels een separate brief ontvangt u deze versie voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie van het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis in Woerden met het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis in Nieuwegein

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the planned merger of the Zuwe Hofpoort hospital in Woerden with St. Antonius in Nieuwegein, including petition signatures, staffing, emergency care, and the basis for claims that bigger hospitals are more efficient. The Minister said the merger was pre-approved by the competition authority, that the NZa would check consultation with works councils and medical staff, and that she could not predict the future, offering largely non-committal answers without releasing requested studies.
This merger was already approved earlier by the ACM under the Competition Act. However, since the merger has not yet taken place in practice, the parties must still notify it to the NZa.

Deze fusie is al eerder op grond van de Mededingingswet door de ACM goedgekeurd. Echter, omdat de fusie in de praktijk nog niet heeft plaatsgevonden moet deze alsnog door partijen worden gemeld bij de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over over huisartsenorganisaties die tegen het verplicht stellen van een screeningsinstrument voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether insurers making a GGZ screening instrument mandatory in 2015 contracts, opposed by GP organisations, undermines professional autonomy and the GP's gatekeeper role. The minister answered that the instrument only advises, professional autonomy is preserved, the tool was developed by the field, and she sees the insurers' conduct as desirable, declining to take action against insurers.
I am of the opinion that this is desirable conduct.
Ik ben van mening dat hier sprake is van gewenst gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat Philadelphia afziet van het bieden van gehandicaptenzorg aan mensen met een verstandelijke beperking vanwege de nieuwe wetgeving

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked whether the withdrawal of care provider Philadelphia from many municipalities, leaving 450 to 600 people with intellectual disabilities without day care and support, and the need for a uniform basic tariff were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that continuity is guaranteed by transitional rules to 1 January 2016, that municipalities are responsible for procuring the care, that a basic tariff is not appropriate, and that he has no overview of other providers stopping.
I do not have an overview of the number of care providers that stop providing care and support.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal zorgaanbieders wat stopt met het verlenen van zorg en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de benoeming van een partijgenoot als ambassadeur lokale aanpak gezondheidsachterstand

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health why PvdA member Den Besten was appointed ambassador for the local approach to health inequalities, whether the post was filled through an open procedure, its profile, time commitment, fees and her side positions, and whether three PvdA-linked appointments in health-related posts look odd. The State Secretary answers that she was chosen on a profile without an open application procedure, cites her local governance and education-sector experience, states the role takes about 12 days a year with a 12,000 euro compensation to the PO-raad, lists three supervisory side positions, and denies any link between the separate appointments.
On the basis of a profile, a number of persons were considered and the choice fell on Ms Den Besten.
Op basis van een profielschets is een aantal personen de revue gepasseerd en is de keuze gevallen op mevrouw Den Besten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over diens reactie op de zelfdoding van een bewoner van woonzorgcentrum De Golfstroom in Den Helder

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether a 10-week IGZ inspection into a resident's suicide at care home De Golfstroom is acceptable, whether forced relocations should be halted, and whether rules are needed to protect frail residents from unilateral eviction by care institutions. The State Secretary defended the 10-week timeframe, said the decision to halt relocations lies with the provider while the inspection runs, and saw no need for separate rules, while the inspection will examine the institution's handling of the case.
Pending the investigation, I cannot make any statements about this.
Hangende het onderzoek kan ik hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de nieuwe zorgverzekeraar Anno12

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether the new insurer Anno12, which requires members to buy a 850 euro certificate for a premium discount, risks risk selection against low-income and sick insured persons. The minister answered that the discount is permitted under the Zvw, that acceptance duty and the ban on premium differentiation are respected, and that the NZa monitors the insurer.
I therefore consider it important that the NZa monitors compliance with the Zvw and closely follows developments regarding the constructions offered.
Ik vind het daarom van belang dat de NZa toeziet op naleving van de Zvw en ontwikkelingen rondom aangeboden constructies nauwlettend volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over de informatie aan mensen die nu nog AWBZ-zorg krijgen en die te maken krijgen met wijzigingen per 2015

The SP MPs asked why the health insurance offices (zorgkantoren) dropped planned letters informing about 2015 AWBZ/care changes for about 800,000 clients, and whether the advertising campaign reaches them. The Staatssecretaris answered that the letters were dropped because they were general, could not be personalised, and risked confusing clients; he says the campaign and follow-up communication by municipalities, insurers and offices will inform people, and attached the draft letters.
As attachments to these answers I am sending you the latest versions of the draft letters.
Als bijlagen bij deze antwoorden stuur ik u de laatste versies van de conceptbrieven mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitblijven van onafhankelijk onderzoek naar een overlijden in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why no independent investigation has been opened into the death of a patient at a Lelystad mental health facility after a judo throw and delayed resuscitation, and whether the IGZ is waiting for the prosecutor's criminal inquiry. The minister replies that the criminal investigation is running independently, that the IGZ has ordered a calamity inquiry led by an independent chair to be delivered in October, and that it will also conduct its own follow-up investigation; the action programme on involuntary care does not cover this case.
Given the seriousness of the incident, the IGZ has judged that a joint inquiry by Triade and GGZ-Flevoland under an independent chair is warranted.
Gelet op de ernst van het voorval heeft de IGZ geoordeeld dat een gezamenlijk onderzoek door Triade en de GGZ-Flevoland onder leiding van een onafhankelijke voorzitter is aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financiële steun van Reinier Haga Groep aan het LangeLand Ziekenhuis en de mogelijke overname

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the ACM exemption allowing Reinier Haga Groep to financially support LangeLand Hospital, its possible takeover, job losses, service impacts, and an adviser's reported fee. Minister Schippers answered that the exemption was granted due to payment problems, that no integration steps may be taken until final ACM approval, and that details of the takeover and its consequences are the board's responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen overname van ggz-instelling Antes door de Parnassia Groep

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the planned takeover of Antes by Parnassia Groep, creating a very large mental health provider, and its effects on patients, staff, continuity of care, competition and bed reduction. The minister largely deferred to the NZa and ACM, said continuity and stakeholder involvement are covered by the mandatory merger assessment, and stated that the merger must not harm addiction care in Rijnmond.
It is not for me to judge this. That is reserved for the Dutch Healthcare Authority and the Authority for Consumers and Markets.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover te oordelen. Dat is voorbehouden aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit en de Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Siderius over de verschraling van de cliëntenondersteuning in de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) en de AWBZ

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked the State Secretary about reported budget cuts, mass dismissals and gaps in client support (cliëntondersteuning) under the Wmo and AWBZ, with 63% of municipalities lacking agreements with MEE. The State Secretary replied that most municipalities had agreed with MEE on paper, that contracts were still being finalised, that monitoring continues, and that no budget guarantee for MEE would be given.
At this moment I have no reason to assume that municipalities will not or insufficiently take their responsibility for client support.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat gemeenten hun verantwoordelijkheid voor cliëntondersteuning niet of onvoldoende zullen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het afkopen van het eigen risico bij het Iza Cura Rotterdampakket

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether buying back the statutory deductible under the Iza Cura Rotterdam package for low-income people is acceptable, and how premiums relate to expected costs. The minister answered that such supplementary insurance falls outside the Health Insurance Act and is the insurer's responsibility, that buyback is legal and a consumer choice, and that the NZa monitors the market while no change to the deductible is planned.
Profit figures for collective arrangements are not known.
Winstcijfers van collectiviteiten zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het verzwijgen van details over de medicijndeal en risico’s inzake gebruik NOAC’s

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about secrecy over the financial arrangement with NOAC manufacturers, a civil servant's conduct, and safety data on dabigatran and other NOACs. The minister denied the newspaper's account, explained that confidentiality of prices was a manufacturer condition accepted to secure savings, and said the EMA and CBG are reviewing the safety findings without committing to a new blood-level monitoring requirement.
I ultimately agreed to this, while repeatedly indicating in contacts with both parties that I wanted to maintain as much transparency as possible beyond the financial details.

Hiermee heb ik uiteindelijk ingestemd, waarbij ik herhaaldelijk in de contacten met beide partijen heb aangegeven buiten de financiële gegevens een zo groot mogelijke transparantie te willen betrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb), Thomashuizen en vastgoed

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about use of personal budgets (pgb) for housing costs in Thomashuizen and Herbergiers, the franchise model, rent levels, and ownership ties to Vestia and MC-groep. The government answers that pgb funds may not be used for housing costs, that accountability by care offices is too general to rule out such use, and that it will consult parties on clearer accountability, while declining to give a figure on how often pgb money covers housing and arguing that ownership changes fall to competition regulators.
How often individual Thomashuizen and Herbergiers spend pgb money on housing costs is not known to me.
Hoe vaak door individuele Thomashuizen en Herbergiers pgb-geld aan woonlasten uit wordt gegeven is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de korting van CZ voor verzorgingshuizen
