An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's 50% cut to nursing-home budgets in Zuid-Limburg, whether it fits the contracting space, and whether residents risk forced relocation. The State Secretary replied that the cut matches the expected national fall in low-care-package volumes for 2015, that existing residents keep their right to an intramural place, and that relocations will be prepared carefully with the care offices bound by a duty of care.
The care offices will respect the rights of existing clients.
De zorgkantoren zullen daarbij de rechten van bestaande cliënten respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de wijkverpleging splitsen

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asks the State Secretary whether health insurers splitting the district nursing (wijkverpleging) purchasing into two segments undermines the integrated role of the district nurse and creates extra bureaucracy. The State Secretary rejects the premise of splitting the district nurse's work, says the new 'wijkgericht werken' segment is separate from individual care, and agrees with insurers on shared guidelines, while declining to ban the contracting approach and not answering the request to postpone the transfer to the Zvw.
Unfortunately, the answer could not be provided before the Wlz bill was debated.
Helaas is de beantwoording niet voor de behandeling van de Wlz gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Grote fouten bij de hulpverlening bij het dodelijk rallyongeluk op 1 september 2013 in Amsterdam'

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reported serious failures in emergency care after a fatal rally accident, including an unqualified private ambulance driver moving an injured child, and about oversight of private ambulance services and profit motives. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing IGZ investigation, said no growth in regulated private ambulance services is occurring, and promised to consult parties involved in event medical care before deciding whether action is needed.
This case is part of an investigation by the IGZ. While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot comment on it.
Deze casus is onderdeel van een onderzoek van de IGZ. Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik daarover geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Kwaliteitsvisie Spoedeisende Zorg van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (concentratie van spoedzorg)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the Zorgverzekeraars Nederland quality vision on concentrating emergency care, its possible conflict with competition law flagged by the ACM, and the secrecy of the plans. The Minister replied that the ACM acted on its own supervisory initiative, that the plans are transparent and that insurers decide when to share them, and that she sees no need to assess the plans herself, refusing a national hospital network debate.
My approval is not required for this.
Mijn goedkeuring is hiervoor niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de beloning van interim-adviseur van het Kennemer Gasthuis

An SP MP asks ministers whether a hospital's interim adviser paid above the WNT pay cap, and whether consultancy firms are evading the WNT, is acceptable and should be investigated. The minister replies that the WNT applies, that oversight tools exist, that her ministry does not audit hospital management or consultancies, and that she will review the audit protocol for annual reports.
It is not my task to audit the business operations of healthcare institutions.
Het is niet mijn taak om de bedrijfsvoering van zorginstellingen door te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Reddingsbrigade een ongekend drukke tijd heeft

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about declining swimming ability among children, whether compulsory swimming lessons were abolished as a cause, whether the Zwem-ABC should be required, the decline of school swimming, and whether a new safety-net scheme should be reinstated. The minister answered that 94% of children still obtain at least one swimming diploma, that swimming skill is mainly parents' responsibility, that no evidence links the abolition to declining skills, and that no new safety-net scheme is planned.
I see no reason to do so.
Ik zie hier geen aanleiding toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de aanstelling van de heer Plukker als interim-voorzitter van de raad van bestuur van het Radboudumc

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the appointment of F. Plukker as interim chair of the Radboudumc board, his remuneration, caps on hours and pay, and transparency of interim executives' pay. The minister answered that the WNT sets the legal framework, that supervisory boards decide pay independently, and that enforcement under the WNT is ex post, so she has no intention to intervene in the details.
It is not for the Minister of VWS to negotiate the employment contract of executives together with a supervisory board.
Het is niet aan de Minister van VWS om samen met een Raad van Toezicht het arbeidscontract van bestuurders uit te onderhandelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afhandeling van overtredingen van de Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg door de NZa totdat het nieuwe samenwerkingsprotocol met het OM in werking is getreden

MPs Leijten (SP) asked how the NZa will handle Wmg violations involving possible overlap with criminal conduct until the new cooperation protocol with the Public Prosecution Service takes effect, including whether the 'grown practice' of referring only deliberate cases to the OM is appropriate, and how the VUmc children's ward fraud case will be handled. The ministers answered that the NZa applies its enforcement policy, that the CSO Zorg practice is a non-binding agreement among partners, that an updated protocol is expected before 1 October 2014, and declined to comment on the individual ongoing VUmc case.
The protocol is an agreement between the participating partners among themselves; it is up to the partners themselves to hold each other to the working arrangements.
Het protocol is een afspraak van de deelnemende partners onderling, het is aan de partners zelf om elkaar op werkafspraken aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het besluit van de NZa om het onderzoeksrapport inzake de boeteoplegging aan het Sint Antonius Ziekenhuis  niet openbaar te maken

An MP asked why the NZa refused to publish its investigation report on the fine imposed on the Sint Antonius hospital, questioning the Wob basis, whether secrecy still applies after the case closed, and whether an anonymised version could be released so parliament can exercise oversight. The minister replied that the report is a separate document from the fining decision, that the report of findings has now been attached to a letter to parliament, and that the fining decision itself was already published.

The report of findings of the supervisory authority has now been attached as an annex to the letter 'Submission of the Borstlap committee report, evaluation of the Wmg and other assessment of NZa administrative costs'.
Het rapport van bevindingen van de toezichthouder is inmiddels als bijlage bij de brief «Aanbieding rapport commissie Borstlap, evaluatie Wmg en andere beoordeling bestuurskosten NZa» bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat tijdelijke bestuurders de zorg overspoelen

The SP's Leijten asks the health minister about reports that temporary and externally hired executives are increasingly running care organisations, and whether this harms governance, continuity and accountability. The minister answers that such contracts are not inherently problematic, that supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and governance, and declines to compile lists of failed or temporary executives or to pursue a collective agreement or structural change to board models.
It is not my task to examine the business operations of care institutions, nor to supervise the suitability of individual executives of care institutions.
Het is niet mijn taak om de bedrijfsvoering van zorginstellingen door te lichten, noch om toe te zien op de geschiktheid van individuele bestuurders van zorginstellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het afsluiten van lopende behandelingen in de eerstelijns geestelijke gezondheidszorg vanwege het bereiken van het inkoopplafond van zorgverzekeraars Menzis en Achmea

An MP asked the Minister whether insurers Menzis and Achmea ending ongoing mental health treatments after reaching spending caps was acceptable, and about switching therapists and self-payment consequences. The Minister replied that reaching a spending cap is not a reason to stop treatment, that providers must finish treatment or refer patients, and that insurers have a duty of care to contract sufficient care, while saying she would not herself act beyond these points.
Reaching the revenue cap is not a reason to stop a treatment.
Het bereiken van het omzetplafond is geen reden om een behandeling te staken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de winststijging van Achmea Zorg tot 159 miljoen euro in het eerste halfjaar van 2014

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether it is acceptable that health insurer Achmea's profits and reserves keep rising, and whether reserves should be capped or skimmed to lower premiums. Minister Schippers answered that the reserves are needed for solvency under Solvency II and the transfers from the AWBZ, that she will not claw back reserves or set maximum solvency limits, and that insurers themselves decide how to use surplus reserves.
I am not willing to do so. Firstly, it is not for me to determine which part of the reserves can be labelled as superfluous, and secondly I also have no legal powers to claw back reserves.

Ik ben daartoe niet bereid. In de eerste plaats is het niet aan mij om te bepalen welk deel van de reserves als overbodig kunnen worden betiteld en in de tweede plaats heb ik ook geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om reserves af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de GGZ-instellingen uitstel vragen voor de jaarrekening

MP Leijten asked the Health Minister about GGZ mental health providers failing to produce their 2013 annual accounts, including when the government knew of the problem, the grant of deadline extensions without informing parliament, and whether the DBC payment system works. The minister answered that she has been working with the sector on a plan of action, granted a final generic extension to 1 October 2014, and attributed the problems to norm unclarity and transition issues while declining to provide figures on banks or bankruptcy risk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de brandbrief van de gemeente Zaanstad (ingezonden 23 juli 2014)

MP Leijten asked the state secretaries about a fire letter from Zaanstad and other Amsterdam-region municipalities warning that youth care providers' offers exceed the budgets in the May circular, and about possible shortfalls in The Hague and Haaglanden. The government answered that it expects regional investigations to reduce the gap, that municipalities are responsible for tariffs and contracting, and that it monitors the procurement process and will support municipalities where needed.
It is up to municipalities, in consultation with youth care providers, to make procurement agreements.
Het is verder aan gemeenten in overleg met jeugdhulpaanbieders om inkoopafspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van de uitbraak van het ebolavirus in West-Afrika

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the spread of the Ebola outbreak in West Africa, Dutch involvement, risks to Dutch public health, screening of travellers, and the differing travel advice of the US and the Netherlands. The government answered that the risk in the Netherlands is low, that it follows WHO, RIVM and LCR advice, that entry screening is not recommended, and that it has provided funding and tightened travel advice for some affected countries.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs therefore has no view of the exact number of Dutch nationals in these countries.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft daarom geen zicht op het exacte aantal Nederlanders in deze landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer en Leijten over de ebola-uitbraak in West-Afrika

SP MPs asked the government to explain the WHO's declaration of the West African Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency, which requests for help Dutch authorities had received, whether Nederland would provide solidarity and logistical support, and why. The minister answered that Nederland contributes about 822,600 euro via Artsen Zonder Grenzen and the Red Cross plus indirect funding through the EU, CERF and WHO, and that a further WHO request for medical experts and field hospitals was still being studied.
At this moment the recent WHO request, which in addition to financial support also asks for medical experts, field hospitals, etc., is still being studied.
Op dit moment wordt het recente verzoek van de WHO, waarin naast financiële steun ook wordt verzocht om medische experts veldziekenhuizen, etc nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onrust die is ontstaan in Zeeland rondom de plannen van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about planned cuts to ADRZ hospital services on Walcheren, including access to the CEAN report, the CZ regional vision, staffing, referral practices and links to private clinics. The minister answered that she has not seen the CEAN report or CZ's vision, that capacity decisions on Walcheren are not yet final, that acute care is considered guaranteed, and that hospital organisation is a matter for the parties involved.
I do not have CZ's Regiovisie and it is not for me to make it public.
Ik heb de Regiovisie van CZ niet en het is ook niet aan mij om die openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de berichtgeving over de verminderde psychologische hulp aan partners van kankerpatiënten

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that psychological help for partners of cancer patients is no longer reimbursed under the basic insurance since 2013, and whether this leads to a shift toward specialist mental health care. The minister replies that such care is not covered by basic insurance absent a disorder, points to supplementary insurance, GP practice-assistant GGZ, internet therapy and inloophuizen, and promises to raise these options with the Dutch GP association.
No, there is no insight into the number of partners of cancer patients who forgo psychological help.
Nee, er is geen inzicht in het aantal partners van kankerpatiënten dat afziet van psychologische hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de anti-Israëldemonstratie in Den Haag op 24 juli 2014

Mrs Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about anti-Jewish chants at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, the speed of the no-crime finding, police risk assessment, press arrangements and press safety. Minister Opstelten mostly referred to answers given to earlier parliamentary questions on the same demonstration, and stated that neither the Public Prosecution Service nor the mayor had signalled a threat to journalists in advance.
Antwoord op vragen van het Leijten over problemen met het Valysvervoer

MP Leijten (SP) asked why Transvision, the Valys transport operator, no longer guarantees solo rides and how this affects travel times and comfort for users. The State Secretary answered that combined transport is the agreed basis to keep Valys affordable, that former special indications had no legal basis, and that passengers' personal preferences will still be accommodated where possible.
After consultation with the carrier, it was therefore decided to inform the relevant pass holders in early April that there is no right to this kind of privilege within Valys transport.
Na overleg met de vervoerder is daarom besloten om de betreffende pashouders begin april te informeren dat er binnen het Valysvervoer geen recht op dit soort privileges is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgsector een goede markt is voor interim-managers

An MP asked the health minister for a reaction to a report that hourly rates for interim managers in healthcare rose from €112 to €145, and how this squares with layoffs and the WNT pay norms. The minister declined to answer substantively, arguing the study's small healthcare sample (11% of 484 respondents) and mixed methodology make the findings unreliable.
Therefore it is impossible for me to give a good answer to your questions.
Derhalve is het voor mij onmogelijk op uw vragen een goed antwoord op te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over brandwonden van een 86-jarige man na een douchebeurt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an 86-year-old man who suffered burns after a shower, possibly given by a trainee, and whether the Inspectorate would investigate and whether the frequency of trainee-involved incidents would be examined. The State Secretary said the Inspectorate had started its own investigation with results expected in autumn, and that the Inspectorate had recorded 29 incident reports involving trainees since 2006, so no additional study was needed.
The inspectorate decided to start its own investigation into this incident immediately.
De inspectie heeft besloten direct zelf een onderzoek naar deze calamiteit te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de hoge advieskosten van zorgorganisatie Fundis

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about a proposed tariff cut of about 243,000 euro imposed on care provider Fundis by zorgkantoor Achmea, the high external advisory costs and the failed Langeland hospital takeover, and whether oversight bodies had judged the financial risks adequately. The State Secretary answered that no fine was imposed, the tariff cut is not yet final, other zorgkantoren found no reason for cuts, and that financial risk assessment and governance of private Fundis lie with its board, supervisory board, ACM, NZa and ultimately the courts.
The judgement on possible shortcomings of a care provider lies primarily with the relevant zorgkantoor, the NZa and, for shortcomings in quality of care, the IGZ.
Het oordeel over eventuele tekortkomingen van een zorgaanbieder is primair aan het betreffende zorgkantoor, de NZa en bij tekortkomingen in de kwaliteit van de zorg aan de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Bruins Slot en Voortman over het gesloten zorgakkoord met de vijf-partijencoalitie

MPs Leijten, Bruins Slot and Voortman asked the health minister for the text and financial basis of the June 2014 care agreement with the five-party coalition, whether the Finance Ministry and CPB were involved, which care organisations took part, and her view on amendments to the Health Insurance Act. The minister answered that no written agreement exists beyond the amendments, that Finance and CPB were involved in the costing, that the sector bodies signed the sector-level agreements, and that she supports most amendments while opposing those that would reverse the change to article 13.
Apart from this, there is no agreement committed to writing.
Er is hiernaast geen sprake van een op schrift gesteld akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat opleidingen verpleging razend populair zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked the government about the popularity of nursing degrees amid job losses in healthcare, the shortage of internship places, and whether numerus fixus admission limits are acceptable. The minister says intake is still growing, temporary solutions have been found for internships, a meeting with nursing schools is planned, and that restricted intake is acceptable as regional planning.

VWS and OCW are planning a meeting with the representatives of the HBO nursing programmes, in which among other things the situation regarding internship places for the coming academic year will be discussed.
VWS en OCW plannen een afspraak met de vertegenwoordiging van de hbo-verpleegkunde opleidingen, waarin onder meer de situatie rond de stageplaatsen voor het komende studiejaar aan de orde komt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars risicoselectie toepassen op buitenlandse werknemers die in Nederland actief zijn door ze een polis zonder eigen risico aan te bi

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether insurers' supplementary policies that cover the own risk for foreign seasonal workers amount to risk selection and should be closed off by law. Minister Schippers answers that the constructions are lawful, limited in size (under 2% of insured), grounded in collection risk, and that she sees no need to ban them, though she has asked the NZa to pay extra attention in its market scan.
At the time I agreed with the NZa that they would monitor developments regarding the reinsurance.
Ik heb destijds met de NZa afgesproken dat zij de ontwikkelingen rondom het herverzekeren zouden volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar De Friesland studenten probeert te lokken door ze een gratis schoonmaakster aan te bieden

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister to respond to reports that insurer De Friesland offered students a free cleaning service to attract them, and questioned whether such marketing costs were properly booked and whether care money was being used appropriately. The minister replied that insurers decide their own marketing strategy and budgets, that the matter falls outside her responsibility, that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care and cost declarations, and that 2013 profit figures will only be available later.
This falls outside my responsibility as minister.
Dit valt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid als minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bejegenen van nabestaanden na overlijden in de instelling Bartimeus

MP Leijten asks whether relatives of a woman who died after a bathing incident at Bartimeus received no apologies, were pressured to sign a document blaming a viral infection, and whether the IGZ report and institutional response were adequate. The State Secretary says he was not involved in aftercare, finds the lack of apologies regrettable if true, notes the IGZ found no pressure reported and that Bartimeus's and the hospital's assessments do not diverge, and points to an integral improvement plan and a planned IGZ follow-up visit.
Reports of investigations into calamities are in principle not made public by the IGZ.
Rapporten van onderzoek naar calamiteiten worden door de IGZ in principe niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de gevolgen van de sluiting van verzorgingshuizen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the closure of nursing homes, the shift of light-care clients to home care, cuts to AWBZ budgets, and whether elderly people will lose access to care. The State Secretary rejects the premise, says home care will absorb those clients, and gives a breakdown of the 2014 AWBZ cuts while stating that beds for heavier groups remain available.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bezuinigingen op bewoners en personeel in de zorg

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about Careyn's plans to declare around 1,000 staff redundant, pay cuts on reassignment, closing care homes, and budget cuts to care, asking whether the government accepts the resulting wage dumping and job losses. The state secretary replied that Careyn's redundancies are closer to 200-300 staff, that the employer bears primary responsibility for personnel policy within the law, and that the government will not give exact cost or closure figures, though it commits to informing parliament via a later labour-market report.
Institutions are and remain primarily responsible for their own business operations and personnel policy.
Instellingen zijn en blijven zelf primair verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering en personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat onverzekerde Oost-Europeanen ziekenhuizen miljoenen kosten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how the government responds to reports that uninsured Eastern Europeans leave hospitals with millions in unpaid bills, asked for figures by year and nationality, and asked what is being done to reduce uninsurance. Minister Schippers said uninsured residents must insure or pay, that the CVZ does not record nationality so figures are unavailable, that hospitals (NVZ, NFU) were asked to map the losses, and that enforcement and information efforts exist but detection of short-stay EU nationals without a citizen service number is not feasible.
I will also ask them whether and to what extent it is possible to break these down further by nationality.
Tevens zal ik aan hen vragen of en in welke mate het mogelijk is deze verder uit te splitsen naar nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over het bericht dat Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) ouderen uit serviceflats jaagt

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked the government to respond to reports that Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) pressures elderly residents of service flats, including through alleged financial exploitation, intimidation and forced sales, and asked whether an independent investigation would follow. Minister Blok replied that complaints about a service-flat management organisation are a matter for the courts, that private management contracts fall outside government supervision, and pointed to industry certification initiatives, without committing to an investigation.
Ultimately it is for the judiciary to pass judgment and not for me to go into the substance of this.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechterlijke macht om een oordeel te vellen en niet aan mij om hier inhoudelijk op in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten asked whether the €5 per-medicine charge for uninsured foreigners would deter needed care, how pharmacies could assess ability to pay, the CVZ's collection costs and savings, and whether it breaches the European Social Charter. Minister Schippers defended the measure as enforcing the principle that uninsured foreigners pay for care, saying it does not block necessary care, no means test is needed, collection costs are nil, savings are not the aim, and the Charter does not cover illegal residents.
I see no insurmountable barrier to obtaining care in the five-euro measure.
Ik zie in de vijf-euromaatregel geen onoverkomelijke drempel voor het verkrijgen van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het vertrek van de topman van zorgaanbieder Aafje

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the departure of Aafje's chair of the Executive Board, the 630,000 euro severance-style payment, and alleged conflicts of interest with a consultancy partnership linked to Aafje. The State Secretary answered that the Wnt rules were applied correctly, that the payment is a maximum liability subject to anti-cumulation rules, and that the ties described are either absent or pertain to Aafje's own organisational decisions.
In this case the applicable rules have been applied.
In deze casus zijn de geldende regels toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het budget voor transgenderzorg bij lange na niet toereikend is

MP Leijten asked the Health Minister whether the VUmc's funding shortfall for transgender care, reported in the press, would leave about 600 patients untreated and whether insurers could refuse care. The minister said she could not confirm the reported figures, expressed trust that insurers and the VUmc would meet their duty of care, and noted the regulator NZa is examining the matter.
The NZa has indicated that it is already examining this case, is alert to the issue, and will keep me informed of developments.
De NZa heeft laten weten deze casus al te onderzoeken, alert op deze kwestie te zijn en mij geïnformeerd te houden over de ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over zorgaanbieder Vivium Thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about care provider Vivium Thuiszorg, which sued municipalities over tender conditions and wage scales for home-care staff, and about a reported mass dismissal later reversed. The State Secretary answered that the courts had ruled, that Vivium has since re-graded staff retroactively, that no dismissal application was filed with the UWV, and that cao composition is for the social partners.
It is not for me to judge the court's ruling.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de uitspraak van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het massaontslag bij zorginstelling Philadelphia

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the announced dismissal of 900 staff at care provider Philadelphia, its consequences for clients, participation, and whether volunteers and digital tools replacing professionals is responsible. The government answered that the reorganisation is the organisation's own choice in anticipation of the 2015 decentralisation and reforms, that staff and clients were consulted, that UWV makes its own independent assessment of dismissal permits, and that it cannot comment on individual board bonuses.
UWV weighs all relevant facts in its assessment. It is not for me to enter into this assessment.
UWV weegt in de beoordeling alle relevante feiten mee. Het is niet aan mij om in deze afweging te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars risicoselectie toepassen bij de aanvullende verzekering

The SP MP Leijten asked the Minister of Health about reports that health insurers apply medical risk selection to supplementary insurance, citing Daniël de Rijke's case, and whether this undermines solidarity and the attractiveness of basic insurance. The Minister answered that supplementary insurance falls under the free market and EU non-life directives, so no acceptance duty can be imposed, that the NZa monitors the market, and that she sees no reason to change the situation.
It is up to insurers to determine what is included in the supplementary package, what acceptance policy is followed and what price they charge for it.
Het is aan verzekeraars om te bepalen wat in het aanvullende pakket zit, welk acceptatiebeleid wordt gevoerd en welke prijs ze ervoor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat MC Zuiderzee BV nu de enige aandeelhouder is van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

SP MPs asked the health minister about the takeover of Slotervaart Hospital by MC Groep, including the transfer of pharmacy and oncology neurosurgery to the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek, pressure from insurers and creditors, the role of the court-appointed administrator, and whether the IGZ is monitoring care quality. The minister answered that the takeover is a commercial matter, the IGZ has found no care risks, and she defends shareholder participation in healthcare, while promising a central shareholders register.
The amount is not known to me.
Het bedrag is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het besluit van Transvision om bij een vervoersreservering voor het bovenregionale Valysvervoer voor dezelfde dag 3 euro boete op te leggen

MP Leijten (SP) asks why Transvision will charge a 3 euro booking fee for same-day or late Valys transport bookings from 2014, and whether the Secretary of State was informed and will drop the fee. The Secretary of State replies that the fee was included in the tender requirements after consultation with client organisations to improve planning and reduce detours, and refuses to intervene.
I included this measure in the Programme of Requirements of the Valys transport tender in consultation with client organisations.
Deze maatregel heb ik in afstemming met cliëntenorganisaties opgenomen in het Programma van Eisen van de aanbesteding voor het Valysvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de verbeterplannen van zorginstelling NOVO een papieren werkelijkheid waren

An SP MP asked the state secretary about an ARGO evaluation finding that care provider NOVO's improvement plans were a paper reality, and how oversight, family involvement and reflection failed. The state secretary acknowledged the ARGO findings matched the inspectorate's concerns, pointed to ongoing inspections and governance reforms, and gave no reason for the lack of family involvement.
At this moment an inspection investigation is ongoing into quality and safety at NOVO's other locations.
Op dit moment is er een inspectieonderzoek gaande naar de kwaliteit en veiligheid binnen de andere locaties van NOVO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het bericht dat scholen steeds minder vaak schoolzwemmen aanbieden

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about reports that municipalities are cutting funding for school swimming and that swimming diploma rates among children are falling. The state secretary answered that swimming skills are primarily the parents' responsibility, supported by schools and municipalities, that 94% of children obtain a diploma, and that no change to the division of responsibilities is warranted.
I see no reason to change the current division of responsibilities.
Zie ik geen aanleiding om de huidige verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

SP MPs asked whether the 2014 requirement that undocumented migrants pay EUR 5 per prescription line at pharmacies, and must pay in full where a pharmacy lacks a CVZ contract, undermines access to necessary care and whether hospital access and reimbursement problems will be addressed. The minister defended the EUR 5 charge as a means to reduce non-payment, denied conflict with the law, said hospital access is sufficient and refused to commission further research.
I therefore do not share the view that an amount of EUR 5 hinders access to medically necessary care.
Ik deel dus niet de mening dat een bedrag van € 5 de toegankelijkheid tot medisch noodzakelijke zorg belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat logopedisten, fysio- en ergotherapeuten fors gekort worden op hun tarieven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers are cutting tariffs for speech therapists, physiotherapists and occupational therapists, whether the rates are reasonable, and whether contracting power and a ban on collective refusal to sign are acceptable. Minister Schippers replied that insurers are free to negotiate tariffs under the NZa maximums and competition rules, declined to publish per-insurer rates, and promised a joint ACM/NZa review of cooperation barriers.
Firstly, I do not have such data; insurers each make their own agreements on tariffs with care providers.
Ten eerste beschik ik niet over dergelijke gegevens, zorgverzekeraars maken ieder voor zich afspraken over tarieven met zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal adviesbureaus inhuren voor hulp bij decentralisaties

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked whether it is desirable that municipalities spend large sums on consultancy firms to prepare for the decentralisations and whether this should be stopped. The state secretary answered that municipalities bear their own responsibility and may hire commercial advisers, noted a non-commercial national transition bureau, and declined to commission a study of how much has been spent.

Given the municipalities' own responsibility for the decentralisation and my answers to the previous questions, I do not consider a study into the hiring of consultancy firms by municipalities necessary.
Gegeven de gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid bij de decentralisatie en mijn antwoorden op de vorige vragen acht ik een onderzoek naar de inhuur van adviesbureaus door gemeenten niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de helft van de zorgverleners vindt dat de zorg is verslechterd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health about a report that half of care workers feel care has deteriorated, along with questions on workload, flexible contracts, overtime, and working conditions. The government rejects the claim that care has deteriorated, points to sector benchmarks and inspection, announces a quality agenda, and defers collective labour matters to social partners while referring to its labour market letter.
I am of the view that additional measures, beyond existing policy and supervision by the Health Care Inspectorate, are not necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat extra maatregelen – naast reeds lopend beleid en het toezicht door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg – niet nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen door het nieuwe vergoedingensysteem duizenden euro’s zelf moeten betalen voor een hoortoestel

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether people must pay thousands of euros themselves for hearing aids under the new reimbursement system, whether insurers follow the protocol, and whether she will restore the UWV-provided hearing aid benefit. Minister Schippers replied that she cannot yet assess insurer compliance or harm, that the effects will be monitored with a report in spring 2014, that insurers may set policy conditions under the Zvw with disputes referable to the SKGZ, and that she will not restore the separate UWV scheme.

At present I cannot assess whether health insurers comply with the agreements they have made themselves with the hearing aid industry and other parties, nor the number of people who would allegedly have been harmed.

Ik kan op moment niet beoordelen of zorgverzekeraars zich houden aan afspraken die zij zelf met de hoortoestellenbranche en andere partijen gemaakt hebben, noch van het aantal mensen dat naar uw zeggen gedupeerd zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat dat zorgverzekeraar Achmea zich niks aantrekt van Drenten

An MP asks the Health Minister whether health insurer Achmea ignores patients' wishes in Drenthe and whether hospital and care provision there is at risk, citing a Zorgbelang Drenthe complaint. The minister says insurers have a duty of care, that Achmea is consulting regional stakeholders, that she has no signals of care disappearing, and that patients can switch insurers.
If the insurer does too little to contract sufficient care, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) can hold the insurer to account for its duty of care.
Wanneer de verzekeraar te weinig onderneemt om voldoende zorg te contracteren kan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de verzekeraar aanspreken op zijn zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Leijten over het financieel misbruik van ouderen

MPs De Wit and Leijten asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about financial abuse of elderly people, including whether notaries can report such abuse given their professional secrecy and whether it should be narrowed. The government answered that it had noted the broadcast and referred to earlier answers on notaries' duty of confidentiality and the KNB's step-by-step plan.
I refer to my answer to questions 2 and 3 from members Van Oosten and Van Veen.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de dagbesteding grotendeels wegbezuinigd wordt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether cuts to transport to day care have caused people with disabilities to lose day care, and how many centres closed or clients were affected. The State Secretary answered that few complaints reached his ministry, that day care and transport remain entitlements, that the NZa received extra funding of 25 million euro for wheelchair users and children, and that the sector's problems are considered incidents, while promising only continued monitoring and transition support to municipalities.
I will continue to closely monitor the practice.
Ik blijf de praktijk goed volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeenten Barendrecht, Albrandswaard en Ridderkerk (de BAR-gemeenten) de huishoudelijke verzorging kapot bezuinigingen

Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary about reports that the BAR municipalities are restructuring home help toward result-based provision, questioning legality, indication by desired outcome, intermediaries, transfer of staff and the risk of cuts. The State Secretary answered that municipalities remain bound by the Wmo, that a complaint and appeal route exists, that existing clients keep their hours, and that no current indication of unlawful conduct requires action.

Where it would appear that the BAR municipalities' policy starting points, in intent or in implementation, are not compatible with the legal framework, I will hold the municipalities to account and, if necessary, take further measures.

Daar waar zou blijken dat de beleidsuitgangspunten van de BAR-gemeente, in opzet of in de uitvoering daarvan zich niet verhouden met de wettelijke kaders, zal ik de gemeenten daarop aanspreken en zo nodig verdergaande maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeenten Gouda en Den Helder jonge kinderen verplicht te helpen in de huishouding

An MP asks the State Secretary whether municipalities such as Gouda and Den Helder may require young children to help with household chores under Wmo rules on usual care, and whether this harms children's wellbeing and schooling. The State Secretary replies that the Wmo places responsibility with municipalities, that children may do light household tasks according to their ability and age but should not take over professional care, that mantelzorg cannot be compelled, and that municipalities must assess each case individually.
This information is not centrally maintained.
Deze informatie wordt niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over investeren in luxueuze verpleeghuizen door zorgverzekeraar CZ

An SP MP asked the ministers whether health insurer CZ's investment arm, which funds luxury nursing homes for Alzheimer patients, is acceptable, whether vertical integration of insurers and providers is desirable, and whether premium money is used to create a two-tier elderly care system. The State Secretary replied that basic care is equal for everyone, that he has no objection to insurer investments unless they lead to vertical integration, and that the Martha Flora stake, paid from basic-premium income, is acceptable if transparent and intended for innovation.
As long as insurers' investments in care providers do not lead to vertical integration, I have no objection to them.
Zolang investeringen van zorgverzekeraars in zorgverleners niet leiden tot verticale integratie, heb ik daar geen bezwaar tegen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis en het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis een voorgenomen fusie hebben aangemeld bij de Autoriteit Consument & Markt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the proposed merger of St. Antonius and Zuwe Hofpoort hospitals notified to the competition authority, probing financial pressure, closure risks for emergency and other departments, staff and stakeholder views, and compliance with a pending merger-review bill. The minister declined to judge the individual merger, pointed to the ACM as competent authority, said she would write to both hospitals urging conduct in the spirit of the bill, and promised to forward any stakeholder views and publish the ACM and advisory opinions once issued.
It is for them to pass a judgment on this. I do not make statements on individual cases.
Het is aan hen hierover een oordeel uit te spreken. Ik doe geen uitspraak over individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport de afgelopen vier jaar bijna een ton heeft geschonken aan het Apollo netwerk

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that ministry officials, including the director of medicines, take part in the Apollo network alongside pharmaceutical companies, that the ministry has paid about a million euros to it, and whether all exchanges and the conditional-reimbursement report can be made public. The minister defends officials' participation as necessary for practical policy knowledge, reports the ministry's annual contributions (about 20,000 to 24,200 euros a year since 2010), declines to disclose the cost of the contractor Accenture and withholds the network's internal exchanges under agreed confidentiality, while saying it is not a stated aim to publish more.
The Apollo network agreed not to go public except with any completed reports of the network.
In het Apollo netwerk is afgesproken om niet naar buiten te treden behoudens met eventuele afgeronde rapporten van het netwerk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het aanprijzen van body scans

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she views a Prescan advertisement for a total body scan, whether such advertising should be allowed given the Dutch ban on these scans, and whether the scans cause unnecessary care costs and conflict with medical ethics. The minister answered that she awaits a Gezondheidsraad advisory report due in 2014 before taking a position, that the Dutch screening law does not cover examinations performed abroad, and that she could not provide data on costs or health gains.
As soon as I receive the advice from the Health Council, I will send a position to your House and include the issue of advertising in it.
Zodra ik advies van de Gezondheidsraad ontvang, zal ik een standpunt naar uw Kamer sturen en het punt van reclame daarbij meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat bureaus jeugdzorg mogelijk failliet gaan als gevolg van de decentralisatie jeugdzorg

Two SP MPs asked whether Bureaus Jeugdzorg may go bankrupt and lose staff and continuity of youth care as provinces transfer youth care to municipalities, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that regional transition arrangements are due by 31 October 2013, that a support team and an independent commission (TSJ) will assess continuity and possible failures, and that the government may issue binding instructions to municipalities if continuity is not secured.

If this assessment shows that continuity of care is insufficiently secured, or that the required continuity of infrastructure or cooperation agreements between municipalities are inadequate, the national government will issue a binding instruction to the municipality or municipalities concerned under the Youth Act.

Als uit deze toetsing blijkt dat de continuïteit van zorg onvoldoende is geborgd of de daarvoor benodigde continuïteit van de infrastructuur of de samenwerkingsafspraken tussen gemeenten niet toereikend zijn, dan zal het rijk de desbetreffende gemeente(n) binnen de betreffende regio op basis van de Jeugdwet een aanwijzing geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de ex-bestuursvoorzitter van het Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis die een exorbitante vergoeding opstreek

An SP MP asked the health minister about the exorbitant severance and salary paid to the former chair of the Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis, its financial distress, dismissal of 160 staff, and insurer Achmea's influence on the board and supervisory board. The minister called the sum a lot of money, said the Wnt now applies, left any clawback to the supervisory board, and defended the Achmea arrangement as giving no control over the hospital, while noting the insurer's nomination rights until 2014.
It is up to the Supervisory Board of the RKZ to possibly start a liability procedure.
Het is aan de Raad van Toezicht van het RKZ om eventueel een aansprakelijkheidsprocedure te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het sluiten van de huisartsenpost en het stoppen met kindergeneeskunde en geboortezorg bij het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the closure of emergency care, paediatrics and maternity care at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital and the possible relocation of the GP out-of-hours post were acceptable, and how access for patients would be guaranteed. The minister answered that the GP post location is a matter for the doctors, that the hospital cited lack of an IC facility for its decisions, that the Health Inspectorate supervises care quality, and that an extra ambulance is temporarily deployed until a review of drive times is completed.
If at any point it turns out that the preconditions for providing responsible care are not present, the IGZ intervenes.
Als op enig moment blijkt dat de randvoorwaarden om verantwoorde zorg te leveren niet aanwezig zijn grijpt de IGZ in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de ex-baas van Sanquin salaris krijgt doorbetaald

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about reports that Sanquin's former chair continues to receive salary until March 2014 while the organisation cuts costs and jobs, and whether the minister's earlier statement that he had no bonus or premium entitlement still holds. The minister answered that the payments come from accrued leave and the life-course scheme available to all staff, that the 12,000 euro concerns mandatory employer social charges and pension premiums rather than bonuses, and that the cost-cutting reorganisation is driven by declining blood use.
In Sanquin's annual accounts, the salary, social charges and pension premiums of the board members are specified.
In de jaarrekening van Sanquin worden salaris, sociale lasten en pensioenpremie van de bestuurders gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over langere ambulanceritten vanuit Spijkenisse

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about longer ambulance drive times from Spijkenisse after the emergency department of the Ruwaard van Putten hospital was scaled down, and whether the Inspectorate and GPs are adequately involved. The minister replied that RIVM calculations show the Spijkenisse ED is not crucial for the 45-minute norm, that an extra ambulance is being deployed temporarily, that the insurer and the Inspectorate are responsible for continuity and quality of care, and that GP concerns are handled in regional consultation.
The health insurer, under its duty of care, is responsible for the continuity of critical care and therefore for accessibility.
De zorgverzekeraar is vanuit zijn zorgplicht verantwoordelijk voor de continuïteit van cruciale zorg en daarmee voor de bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgorganisatie Vierstroom familieleden verplicht tot mantelzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether care provider Vierstroom's imposed moral obligation on relatives to provide informal care (4 hours a month) conflicts with government's stance that informal care may not be compulsory, and asked about pay, NZa oversight and concrete measures. The state secretary answered that no obligation exists, that the experiment is voluntary, that the NZa found no violation of the Wmg, and that no measures against Vierstroom are needed.
Vierstroom does not impose informal care and therefore I will not take any measures.
Vierstroom verplicht geen mantelzorg en daarom ga ik geen maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over over het bericht dat ambtenaren een 6-daagse cursus krijgen tot jeugdpsychiater

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked whether a six-day course giving civil servants a basic understanding of youth psychiatry is consistent with the transfer of youth care to municipalities, and whether officials deciding on care access could be influenced by municipal budgets. The state secretary replied that the course gives policy staff insight only, that diagnosis remains with qualified professionals, and that municipalities decide their own training and are bound by legal duties to provide adequate care.
It is up to municipalities to determine which training they consider necessary to be properly equipped by January 2015.
Antwoord 2 Het is aan de gemeenten om te bepalen welke opleidingen zij noodzakelijk achten om per januari 2015 goed toegerust te zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het opgezegde vertrouwen van de ondernemings- en de cliëntenraad in bestuur van Emergis

The SP MP Leijten asked the health minister about the ondernemingsraad and cliëntenraad withdrawing confidence in the Emergis board, including allegations of an intimidating culture, bypassing works council rights, and the role of the supervisory board. Minister Schippers answered that the matter is serious, that the supervisory board commissioned a Berenschot investigation, and that she would send a letter on good governance; she largely declined to judge the board or the supervisory board's conduct.
It is not known to me whether the board deliberately ignored the Works Councils Act.
Het is mij niet bekend of het bestuur bewust de Wet op de ondernemingsraden genegeerd heeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Leijten over braille leesregels voor blinden en slechtzienden

MPs Ulenbelt and Leijten asked why blind and partially sighted people with a job must often buy two braille displays, one funded by the health insurer and one by UWV, when one could serve both settings. The government answered that the insurer-funded display may be used at work and at home, and that UWV only funds a second device when the first is unsuitable for the job, so no change or consultation is planned.
A braille display provided by the health insurer may be used both privately and in the work situation.
Een braille leesregel die is verstrekt door de zorgverzekeraar mag zowel in de privé als de werksituatie worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het opgezegde vertrouwen van de familieraad in de Raad van bestuur van gehandicaptenzorginstelling NOVO

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about the family council's withdrawal of confidence in the NOVO care institution's Board, including a death in isolation, delayed informing of families, the regime method, and police detention of a resident. The state secretary largely declined to judge the board's conduct, pointed to the Inspectorate's findings, noted one board member had resigned, and said several matters were not known to him or fell to other bodies.

On the content of the central family council's considerations and statements I do not wish to make a judgment, because this is primarily a matter between the family council and the Board of Directors.
Over de inhoud van de afwegingen en uitspraken van de centrale familieraad wil ik geen uitspraak doen omdat dit primair een zaak is tussen de familieraad en de Raad van Bestuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de massaontslagen in de zorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary of health about mass layoffs across care providers ahead of planned cuts, questioning their consistency with government policy and how quality and workers would be protected. The state secretary replied that employers must respond to changing care demand and that layoff decisions are for employers subject to the preventive dismissal review, while stating the government's aim is sustainable care and that quality oversight remains unchanged.
It is the responsibility of employers to take account of numerous environmental factors and to act on them as well as possible.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers om met talloze omgevingsfactoren rekening te houden en daar zo goed mogelijk naar te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over nulurencontracten in de zorg

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Health whether zero-hours contracts in care are being disguised as variants, how many such contracts exist, and what measures will be taken. The state secretary mostly refers to earlier answers, says he has no data, and states that working conditions are for social partners to settle.
I do not know that. I also consider that a matter that primarily concerns the social partners in the sector concerned.
Dat weet ik niet. Dat vind ik ook een zaak die primair de sociale partners in de desbetreffende sector regardeert.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat een  in afwachting van hoger beroep zijnde veroordeelde zedendelinquent een baan in de gehandicaptenzorg kon krijgen

MPs asked why a convicted sex offender awaiting appeal could take a job in disability care, and how the government will prevent similar cases, including VOG requirements, IGZ reporting of sexual misconduct complaints, and supervision of offenders pending appeal. The state secretary said the pending Wkkgz bill would require providers to vet staff and allow a VOG requirement by decree, IGZ transparency is limited by confidentiality, and immediate enforceability of probation conditions now exists though no figures are kept, with evaluation planned after three years.

With every request for information, a judgement is made about which information can be disclosed without harming those involved, breaching medical confidentiality, or disrupting the treatment process.

Bij elk verzoek om informatie wordt de afweging gemaakt welke informatie naar buiten kan worden gebracht zonder de betrokkenen te beschadigen, het medisch beroepsgeheim te schenden, of het behandelproces te verstoren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het meldpunt ‘De overgang naar een nieuwe thuiszorg’

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Health about a complaints report on the transition to new home care in Rotterdam, including lost care hours, job losses and cuts to domestic help. The state secretary answered that the municipality and providers are responsible, that the Wmo gives municipalities that responsibility, and that he sees no reason to intervene at this stage.
It is up to the municipality of Rotterdam to assess the reports and take action where necessary.
Het is aan de gemeente Rotterdam om de meldingen te beoordelen en zo nodig tot actie over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hoofdbehandelaarschap van orthopedagoog-generalisten en kinder- en jeugdpsychologen

MP Leijten asked the health minister why orthopedagogen-generalisten and child and youth psychologists were excluded from head-treatment status in mental health care from 2014 (except dyslexia care), and how this fits with professionalisation of youth care. The minister answered that only BIG-registered professionals can be head treaters, grants a temporary exception for these two professions until youth mental health care moves to municipalities, and says the change aligns with the planned professionalisation policy.

I will ask the NZa as soon as possible to include the orthopedagogen-generalist registered with the NVO and the child and youth psychologists registered with the NIP in the limitative list of head treaters

Ik zal de NZa op de kortst mogelijke termijn vragen de orthopedagogen-generalist als geregistreerd bij de NVO en de kinder- en jeugdpsychologen als geregistreerd bij het NIP op te nemen in de limitatieve lijst van hoofdbehandelaars
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Leijten en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat zorginstelling Aafje uit voorzorg ontslag heeft aangevraagd voor honderden thuiszorgmedewerkers

MPs Kooiman, Leijten and Ulenbelt asked whether care provider Aafje's precautionary dismissal request for hundreds of home-care workers was premature and whether the UWV should grant it, and about municipal tendering practices. The state secretary replied that the dismissal request is not expected to proceed, explained the UWV's approach to dismissal permits tied to tenders, the rules on taking over staff, and that municipalities are responsible for tendering and must follow the law.
I have since understood that the dismissal request will not go ahead, at least for the time being.
Inmiddels heb ik begrepen dat de ontslagaanvraag er – in ieder geval voorlopig – niet gaat komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hebben van een ‘zomerstop’ in de thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities may impose a summer stop on home-care replacement for budget reasons, and how continuity of care is guaranteed. The state secretary replied that the matter concerns Wmo support, which is the municipalities' responsibility, that continuity is expected where signals show need, and that the Wmo offers legal remedies, but declined to compile an overview or ban summer stops.
There is no overview available of how municipalities provide household help to clients who depend on it.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van hoe gemeenten voorzien in de huishoudelijke hulp van cliënten die daarop zijn aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgverzekeraar Achmea een omzetgrens hanteert bij het inkopen van zorg

MP Leijten asked the minister whether health insurer Achmea's turnover threshold of 150,000 euros for contracting care providers undermines quality, patient choice and new entrants. The minister replied that insurers bear a duty of care and must contract transparently and non-discriminatorily, that quality and efficiency may justify the threshold, and that no formal opinion is given on individual insurer policy as long as the duty of care is met.

If the purchasing policy fits within the conditions set out in the negotiation results and the requirements mentioned above, it is not for me to give a substantive judgment on the policy Achmea applies.

Als het inkoopbeleid past binnen de randvoorwaarden zoals opgenomen in de onderhandelaarsresultaten en de hiervoor genoemde eisen, is het verder niet aan mij om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven over het door Achmea gehanteerde beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat huisartsen zich ernstige zorgen maken over de ontstane situatie na het faillissement van het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about GP concerns over acute care gaps after the bankruptcy of the Ruwaard van Putten hospital, the ambulance response times, the sale process and alleged backroom arrangements with insurers and the competition authority. The minister largely deflected: she said acute care coordination belongs to the regional forum, insurers and the NZa/IGZ are responsible, the sale was a curators' decision, and she had no role in the arrangements.
I will not go into what was or was not discussed by others at Saint Paul de Vence.
Ik ga niet in op wat er al dan niet in Saint Paul de Vence door anderen is besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over aangepaste lingerie voor vrouwen die een borstamputatie hebben moeten ondergaan

MP Leijten asks whether bras and swimwear adapted for women after breast amputation should be reimbursed from the basic insurance package, and whether their cost creates a barrier. Minister Schippers answers that such items are a common provision that is financially accessible, so they fail the necessity criterion and will not be added to the package.
No, I do not intend to do that.
Nee, dat ben ik niet voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het LangeLand Ziekenhuis behouden blijft

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister of Health about the rescue of LangeLand Hospital in Zoetermeer, covering its future profile, staffing, specialist shareholding, insurer and Vierstroom roles, Vebego's involvement, and comparison with the Ruwaard van Putten bankruptcy. The minister answered that essential emergency and maternity care will remain, that specialist participation is viewed positively, and that the Inspectorate was informed but not involved in the decisions, leaving most details to the hospital and regulators.
The inspectorate was not involved in the decision-making on the structure or the choice of acquiring partner.
De inspectie is niet betrokken geweest bij de besluitvorming over de constructie of de keuze voor een overnamepartner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat patiënten gedwongen worden te verhuizen

MP Leijten asks whether patients at GGZ Centraal are being forcibly moved out of long-standing homes, whether families, staff and works and client councils approved, what alternatives were examined, and how care and staffing are safeguarded. Minister Schippers answers that no patients are forced to move, that a few patients moved with consent to FACT-supported living or sheltered housing, that councils gave positive advice, and that the Inspectorate found care in order and will re-inspect within two months.
The inspectorate recently carried out unannounced inspection visits to several GGZ Centraal locations.
De inspectie heeft recent onaangekondigde inspectiebezoeken gebracht aan verschillende locaties van GGZ Centraal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat klinische verloskunde verdwijnt in Sittard-Geleen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the planned closure of the obstetrics ward in Sittard-Geleen and its concentration in Heerlen, including accessibility, staff consultation, and the role of insurers. The minister answered that she has no objection as long as quality and accessibility norms are met, and that the hospitals' strategic plan, staff consultation and any new travel-time calculations will be checked by the IGZ and NZa.
As long as the concentration plans meet the quality and accessibility standards, I see no reason to prevent this.
Zolang met de concentratieplannen wordt voldaan aan de normen voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid zie ik geen reden dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Keijzer over het extramuraliseren van ZZP 1 en 2 en het inkoopbeleid van zorgkantoren

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked the state secretary about the extramuralisation of care packages ZZP 1 and 2 at a care home, the withdrawal of funding for residents with heavy care needs, and care purchasing policy of care offices. The state secretary answered that existing clients' rights to residence will be respected, that the transition plan and contracting framework will be sent to parliament, but declined to give a count of closing care homes and referred to workforce effects being mapped.
As I indicated in my answer to question 3, the care office has, from a quality perspective, started the discussion about purchasing care without the treatment component.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heb aangegeven, is het zorgkantoor vanuit kwaliteitsoogpunt de discussie gestart over het inkopen van zorg zonder de behandelcomponent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Slotervaartziekenhuis in grote financiële problemen verkeert

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that Slotervaart Hospital faces serious financial problems, including bank credit cuts, debt recall risk, alleged misuse of funds by a former chair, and ministerial contacts. The minister replied that she has no signals of acute financial problems, that hospital governance and financing are the hospital's own responsibility, that the IGZ examined governance, and that she sees no role in a possible bankruptcy because the hospital is not indispensable for crucial care.
It is up to the hospital and to ING Bank themselves to answer these questions.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis en aan de ING Bank zelf om antwoord te geven op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat NOVO onder verscherpt toezicht staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the death of a resident of care institution NOVO after fixation, the IGZ's critical findings, and why the case was dropped and the institution's location closed. The State Secretary answered that structural shortcomings were found at the Onnen location, which has since closed, that the IGZ is monitoring the other locations, and that the public prosecutor's dismissal was upheld by the court.
The public prosecution service did take this decision carefully, however, and it was reviewed by the court.
Het OM heeft dit besluit echter zorgvuldig genomen en het is door de rechter getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een verstandelijk beperkte vrouw

An SP MP asked the state secretary and the justice minister about the death of a woman with an intellectual disability, including the NOVO care institution's kort geding to block broadcast of security camera footage, whether the IGZ had seen the footage, whether the footage was part of the criminal investigation, and the delay in answering. The government answered that the court, not the minister, decides on such privacy objections and did not ban broadcast, that the IGZ had viewed the footage at the police station, that the footage was included in the criminal investigation, and that more time was needed to answer.
It is not for me, but for the judge, to assess whether such an objection – in this case based on privacy considerations – is well-founded or not.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter om te beoordelen of een dergelijk verzet – in deze kwestie ingegeven uit overwegingen van privacy – gegrond is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de ouderenzorg slecht voorbereid is op een hittegolf

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether elderly care is poorly prepared for heatwaves, why many care institutions lack cooling and heat protocols, and whether inspection and the GGD monitor this. The state secretary rejected the generalisation, said heat protocols are not mandatory but care providers must deliver good care including heat measures supervised by the IGZ, and declined to commission a survey of protocol compliance.
I have asked the inspectorate to inform me directly if it appears that institutions do not have this policy in order.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd mij direct te informeren indien blijkt dat instellingen dit beleid niet op orde hebben.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er opnieuw is gefraudeerd in de thuiszorg (ingezonden 18 juni 2013).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health how a home-care organisation could over-declare hours and charge excessive rates for two years without detection by the care office or the NZa, and whether fraud would have surfaced without the takeover, along with questions on cooperation, consequences, reimbursement and staff. The State Secretary declines to discuss the specific case because the FIOD investigation is ongoing, describes the NZa's signal-based oversight and the care office's verification role, and points to a new anti-fraud convenant and expertise centre.
During this investigation I cannot go into the substance of this specific case.
Gedurende dit onderzoek kan ik inhoudelijk niet ingaan op deze specifieke zaak.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Cordaan opnieuw onder verscherpt toezicht is gesteld (ingezonden 12 juni 2013).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary about Cordaan being placed under intensified IGZ supervision again, including the causes of the problems, executive pay and severance, and visitation restrictions for relatives. The state secretary says a deeper cause analysis is unnecessary since Cordaan must fix its care, points to the Topinkomens law and to answers already given on the severance, and says he cannot intervene in the visitation dispute and that the IGZ knows of no such arrangements.
A further analysis of the causes of the problems at Cordaan is not necessary in my view.
Een nadere analyse van de oorzaken van de problemen bij Cordaan acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen aan mensen met een structurele functionele hoorbeperking

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked why people with a structural functional hearing impairment can no longer claim hearing aids from UWV for keeping their job, whether referral to health insurers is adequate, and whether the 25% co-payment and deductible burden is acceptable. The minister answered that since 2013 all necessary hearing aids fall under the Zvw, that the 25% co-payment applies to hearing devices, and that he is not willing to reverse the change, while providing UWV and insurer expenditure figures.
No, I am not willing to reverse the removal of hearing aid reimbursements from the UWV or to expand reimbursement of hearing aids in the basic package.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om het schrappen van de vergoedingen voor hoorhulpmiddelen vanuit het UWV ongedaan te maken of om de vergoeding van hoorhulpmiddelen in het basispakket te verruimen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een kwart van vrouwelijke co-assistenten seksueel wordt geïntimideerd

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that a quarter of female medical trainees (co-assistenten) face sexual intimidation, and why few report it. The minister says such intimidation is unacceptable, points to hospital CAO rules, sector action plans and a planned NFU review, and says the data on other training tracks are not available.
We do not have this information.
Wij beschikken niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de vertrokken bestuursvoorzitter van het VUmc 700.000 euro kreeg voor nog geen acht maanden werk

An MP asks the health minister how she views the 700,000 euro payout to the departed VUmc chairman of the executive board after less than eight months, the 433,107 euro departure bonus, the supervisory board's role, and sector culture on pay. The minister refers to earlier answers, says the board was bound by the 1999 contract terms, and notes the Wnt norm and that a court-formula payout could have been higher.
The current Supervisory Board is bound to honour the agreements the previous Supervisory Board made when the director was hired in 1999.
De huidige Raad van Toezicht is gehouden de afspraken na te komen die de toenmalige Raad van Toezicht is aangegaan bij de indiensttreding van de bestuurder in 1999.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen die geriatrische revalidatiezorg nodig hebben tussen wal en schip vallen

MP Leijten (SP) asks the minister of Health about reports that elderly patients needing geriatric rehabilitation fall between stools since its transfer to the Health Insurance Act, including the requirement of prior hospital admission and unclear referrals. Minister Schippers acknowledges signals, says the rules are not meant to leave patients out, commits to talks with the sector, a standard for care pathways and a CVZ advice, but declines to provide figures on affected patients, long hospital stays or AWBZ placements.
I have no figures on this and I do not see it as my task to collect these figures.
Hierover zijn mij geen cijfers bekend en ik zie het niet als mijn taak om deze cijfers te gaan verzamelen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat het aantal ziekenhuizen dat een vordering neerlegt op het tijdelijke vangnet het aantal betalers fors overstijgt

Leijten (SP) asked the health minister how it is possible that more hospitals claim transition payments from the safety-net scheme than pay into it, and whether fraud, cost overruns, financial distress or premium increases can be ruled out. Minister Schippers answered that all transition claims are still to be filed and assessed by the NZa, so no outcomes can yet be stated, and that any overrun would be discussed with the parties in 2014.
All of this means that at present nothing can yet be said about the final amount of the transition payments to be settled, which institutions will receive money and which will have to pay.

Dit alles betekent dat er op dit moment nog niets is te zeggen over de uiteindelijke hoogte van de te verrekenen transitiebedragen, welke instellingen geld zullen ontvangen en welke geld zullen moeten afdragen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de exorbitante ontslagvergoedingen aan bestuurders in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about large severance payments to former healthcare executives, including a EUR 200,000 payout at Medisch Centrum Haaglanden and EUR 650,000 at UMC Radboud. The minister said the Wnt pay cap took effect on 1 January 2013 with a EUR 75,000 norm for severance, that the earlier cases predate it, and that the government will tighten the Wnt as set out in the coalition agreement, while rejecting the demand for retroactive clawback as legally unworkable.
The intentions regarding tightening the WNT are included in the coalition agreement.
De voornemens ten aanzien van de aanscherping van de WNT zijn in het regeerakkoord opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Achmea Health Center adverteert met tien kilo afvallen in tien weken

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether Achmea Health Center's advertising of a ten-kilo, ten-week weight-loss programme is misleading, and about the financial ties and discounts between insurer Achmea and AHC. Minister Schippers replied that insurers may pursue such side activities, saw no reason to label the programme unhealthy or misleading, and saw no problem with the ownership link, the 20% discount for Achmea insured, or the advertising costs.
Insurers are free to pursue this kind of side activity and promote it publicly.
Het staat verzekeraars vrij dit soort nevenactiviteiten te ontplooien en publiekelijk aan te prijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat CZ vier privéklinieken heeft aangewezen voor ooglidcorrecties

MP Leijten asked the minister whether insurer CZ's selective contracting of four private clinics for eyelid corrections, mostly not covered by the basic insurance, undermines free choice of doctor and creates financial incentives to reject medical necessity. The minister replied that these corrections largely fall outside the Zvw and that insurers may contract selectively, declining to comment on motives and tariffs and stating the complex cases are handled elsewhere.
Eyelid corrections, except in the rare cases of congenital eye abnormalities, are not covered by the Health Insurance Act (Zvw).
Ooglidcorrecties vallen, behoudens in de zeldzame gevallen van aangeboren oogafwijkingen, niet onder de dekking van de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw).
