Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Orde van Medisch Specialisten vindt dat patiënten moeten meebetalen aan een second opinion

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the second opinion should remain covered in the basic insurance package and whether patients should co-pay, after the Medical Specialists' Association suggested patients pay. The minister declined to commit before a decision in spring 2014, said suggestions from parties are being collected and tested by the CVZ, and gave no figures on savings or outcomes.
I do not want to anticipate that decision-making, because I want to base my decision on all advice and suggestions available at that time.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op die besluitvorming, omdat ik mijn beslissing wil baseren op alle adviezen en suggesties die op dat moment voorliggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat 135 thuiszorgmedewerkers ontslagen worden

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about Zorggroep VDA's request to dismiss 135 home-care staff, whether other providers will stop home help, job security and wages for transferred staff, and claims of bureaucratic overload. The state secretary said the provider made its own business decision, that the 2015 home-help budget cut was softened, that continuity for clients is being arranged with other providers under the CAO, and that he will look at simplifying administrative burdens.
I contacted the director of Zorggroep VDA and asked for an explanation of the statements attributed to him in the article.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met de directeur van Zorggroep VDA en gevraagd om een toelichting op de aan hem toegeschreven uitspraken in het artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over opsporing van dopinghandel

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about the investigation of doping trade, including illegal laboratories, online sales, cooperation with Belgium and with police, prosecution, customs and the Dutch Doping Authority, plus the estimated 160,000 doping users and a 2005 internal report. The government referred to earlier answers, said the Doping Authority has no investigative task, confirmed the 2009 prevalence study, and declined to publish the 2005 internal note because it was not a final product.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het meldpunt ontruimingen van kamers in verzorg- en verpleeghuizen

An MP asked the state secretary about a Consumentenbond complaints point on rapid room clearances in care homes, and whether the NZa supervises compliance with clearance rules. The state secretary said the Consumentenbond may set up such a point, that the NZa has not investigated the double-billing risk since 2006, and that he will ask the NZa to investigate and report back.
However, I will ask the NZa to investigate the matter, take action if necessary, and report back to me on it.
Ik zal de NZa echter vragen een en ander te onderzoeken, zonodig actie te ondernemen en mij hierover terug te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen inspringen op cardiologische groeimarkt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether hospitals expanding into cardiology, and the rising number of ICD implantations, reflect financially driven overtreatment and what the government will do about it. The minister denied that financial motives drive ICD placement, cited a broader indication and more replacements as causes, and pointed to insurers' selective purchasing and a planned national study rather than new rules.
The suggestion in your questions that centres place implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) for financial motives is not something I recognise.
De suggestie die in uw vragen gewekt wordt, dat centra implanteerbare cardioverter defibrillatoren (ICD's) zouden plaatsen omwille van financiële motieven, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat 800 huishoudelijk verzorgenden ontslagen worden

An MP asks the state secretary whether the dismissal of 800 home-help workers at Sensire results from government policy, how many clients will lose their carers, and how municipalities can cope if a large provider withdraws. The state secretary replies that the provider's decision is its own business, municipalities are responsible for continuity, and existing transition measures and guidance are in place.
It is a consideration of the organisation itself which choices it makes and how it anticipates possible changes and adjusts its staffing.
Het is een afweging van de organisatie zelf, welke keuzes zij maakt en op welke wijze ze daarbij anticipeert op mogelijke veranderingen en haar personeelsomvang aanpast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Leijten en van het Leijten over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten

MPs Keijzer and Leijten asked the state secretary how care for youths was left unprovided after the bankruptcy of care provider Sterk!Zorg, and what role the Inspectorate, the care office and youth bureau had. The state secretary answered that replacement care was arranged via a takeover by De Driestroom, that the Inspectorate acted after an anonymous report, and that responsibility for PGB-funded care lies with the client, while the care provider failed.
The inspectorate will monitor the quality of care by re-checking within three to four weeks.
De inspectie zal de kwaliteit van zorg volgen door binnen drie à vier weken opnieuw te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that youth care clients were left without care after the provider Sterk!Zorg went bankrupt, including whether the IGZ should intervene, whether Bureau Jeugdzorg or the zorgkantoor neglected their duty of care, and whether staff wages went unpaid. The document refers to written answers sent on 29 May 2013 in a separate letter, so the substance of the government's replies is not reproduced here.

Further answer: the questions from MP Leijten (SP) to the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the report that youth care clients are left to their fate, submitted 18 April 2013, were also answered in the letter of 29 May 2013.

Nader antwoord De vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten, ingezonden 18 april 2013 (vraagnummer 2013Z07943 ) zijn ook beantwoord in de brief van 29 mei 2013
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de berichtgeving dat bezuinigingen op de AWBZ averechts werken

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether AWBZ cuts were backfiring, including a shift toward heavier care indications, removal of ZZP 1-2 people from care homes, the effects of dropping light support, and income effects. The state secretary denied that the policy was wrong, said the shift reflects natural care needs and ageing, promised a CIZ-based analysis and stricter indication controls, and declined to quantify income effects because they vary by person.
I would like to be able to substantiate this quantitatively and have therefore asked the Nza for an analysis.
Ik wil dat graag goed nader kwantitatief kunnen onderbouwen en heb daartoe de Nza om een analyse gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het contracteerbeleid van zorgverzekeraars bij logopedisten

The MP asks the minister about insurer contracting policy for speech therapists, including the value of speech therapy, whether a NZa-backed tariff increase has reached providers, shifts from school speech therapy to primary care, and market power. The minister answers that the tariff increase was substantial, that insurers may contract below NZa maximum tariffs, sees no abuse of market power, and declines an independent market study.
As I indicated in previous answers, I see no abuses in the speech therapy market that could harm the interests of the patient/consumer.
Zoals ik in voorgaande antwoorden heb aangegeven zie ik geen misstanden in de markt voor logopedie die nadelig kunnen uitwerken op het belang van de patiënt/consument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgkantoren zorginstellingen dwingen om dure keurmerken te kopen

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether care offices force care providers to buy costly quality certificates, questioning whether this conflicts with earlier policy against mandatory certification. The state secretary answered that providers must have a quality system under the Kwaliteitswet, that certification can serve as evidence of this but must stay proportionate, and that care offices ask for a working quality system without mandating specific certificates.
Inquiries with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland show that all care offices, in line with the AWBZ care purchasing guide, ask all care institutions to be contracted to have a working quality system.

Navraag bij Zorgverzekeraars Nederland wijst uit dat alle zorgkantoren in lijn met de Zorginkoopgids AWBZ van alle te contracteren zorginstellingen vragen dat zij een werkend kwaliteitssysteem hebben.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Roemer en Leijten over de contracteerruimte in de AWBZ, wachtlijsten en leegstand

SP MPs Roemer and Leijten asked why care-home rooms stand empty while people wait for institutional care, and asked for waiting-list and care-package figures plus an explanation of contracting room for 2013. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the zorgkantoren have a duty of care, that the waiting-list data was still being cleaned and would be sent around 1 June, and that the 2013 contracting room was reduced only by transfers to the Zorgverzekeringswet, not by a shortfall.
In early June, your House can expect information on the size and composition of the waiting list for long-term care.
Begin juni kan uw Kamer informatie tegemoet zien over de omvang en samenstelling van de wachtlijst in de langdurige zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de toenemende tweedeling in de ouderenzorg

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary whether the growth of private, premium elderly care residences creates a two-tier system in which wealthy elderly buy luxury care while others have no choice, and whether private providers offer better quality or an escape from strained regular care. The state secretary answered that residents may pay housing costs themselves, that about 2% of care staff and places are private, and that basic care must be guaranteed everywhere, while rejecting the two-tier concern as part of normal societal choice.
I am of the view that basic care must be in order in every place.
Ik ben van mening dat de basiszorg op elke plek op orde moet zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het sterftecijfer te hoog is bij het hartcentrum van het Haga Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reports of above-average cardiac surgery mortality at the Haga Hospital heart centre, the referral halt by MCH, the IGZ's role, and whether patient safety is guaranteed. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ found no evidence of deliberate misreporting, that the hospital itself took improvement measures and halted operations, and that the IGZ sees no need for further enforcement, while declining to publish the internal report and deferring referral policy to the hospital.
The IGZ therefore sees no reason to take further measures.
De IGZ ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie van het Scheper Ziekenhuis in Emmen en Ziekenhuis Bethesda in Hoogeveen met het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether she endorses the proposed merger of Scheper Hospital, Bethesda Hospital and Refaja Hospital, and whether service provision will suffer, given concerns from municipal councils, medical staff and GPs. The minister answered that the competition authority (ACM) already approved the merger, that she is neutral on mergers, and that the forthcoming stricter care-specific merger test (not yet in force) will require stakeholder involvement, but she gave no commitment to block or alter the merger.
Until the bill regulating the tightened care-specific merger review has force of law, it is reserved to the ACM to rule on mergers from a competition-law perspective.

Totdat het wetsvoorstel waarin de aanscherpingen van zorgspecifieke fusietoetsing worden geregeld kracht van wet heeft, is het voorbehouden aan de ACM om zich uit te spreken over fusies vanuit mededingingsrechtelijk perspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over de skydivesport

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether air traffic control's limits on skydiving centres' altitude and frequency threaten the sport, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that a 2010 regulation and the 2012 Luchtruimvisie prioritise Schiphol traffic, that talks are under way with the KNVvL and clubs on relocating springing sites, and that the sport will be facilitated but the choice of location is not the ministry's.

It is now essential to start a process for General Aviation as a whole to accommodate these functions in a future-proof way and, if necessary, relocate them within the framework of the Luchtruimvisie.

Het is nu zaak om voor de General Aviation in den brede een traject te starten om deze functies toekomstvast te accommoderen en indien nodig te verplaatsen binnen de kaders die de Luchtruimvisie biedt.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het opzeggen van het Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ door de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Vrijgevestigde Psychologen

MPs Leijten asked the minister about the NVVP suspending its obligations under the GGZ Administrative Agreement, the IGZ's changing advice on whether psychotherapists may be main treatment practitioners (hoofdbehandelaar), and related continuity and consistency concerns. The minister called the suspension premature, said she would take a position after the 30 May deadline for a joint field norm, and provided the consultation documents as an annex.
I am first waiting to see whether the field parties of the administrative agreement submit a proposal supported by all parties on 30 May for main treatment practitioner status
Ik wacht nu eerst af of de veldpartijen van het bestuurlijk akkoord op 30 mei een door alle partijen gedragen voorstel overleggen voor het hoofdbehandelaarschap
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de situatie bij het Slotervaartziekenhuis

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about the 2006 sale of the Slotervaart hospital to Meromi Holding BV, the state's role, ownership and governance concerns, and the hospital's continuity. Minister Schippers answers that the sale followed a CSZ-supervised transparent tender at market value, that the hospital remains bound by the WTZi, that IGZ is investigating possible violations, and that she sees no current signals that cruciale zorg is at risk.
I have asked the CSZ to send you these requests, correspondence and advice, but given the sensitivity of the information a special procedure will have to be used for that.
Ik heb het CSZ gevraagd u deze aanvragen, correspondentie en adviezen toe te sturen, maar gezien de gevoeligheid van de informatie zal daar een speciale procedure voor gebruikt moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanstelling van een toezichthouder als tijdelijk voorzitter van de raad van bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

An MP asked the health minister about a Slotervaart hospital supervisory board member being appointed interim chair of the management board, the Governance Code, statute changes allowing profit distributions, and the Achmea contract. The minister said combining these roles is prohibited under the Wtzi, the IGZ is investigating, compliance with the Governance Code is voluntary while Wtzi compliance is mandatory, and profit distribution is banned for specialist care providers.
Combining a role on the management board with a role on the supervisory board of the same provider is therefore incompatible in that light.
Het combineren van een functie in de raad van bestuur met een functie in de raad van toezicht van dezelfde aanbieder is in dat licht onverenigbaar.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de vertrekbonus van een ex-topman van het UMC St Radboud

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a large departure bonus and salary paid to the former head of UMC St Radboud, and about related advisory fees and cuts. The minister answered that the contract predated the WNT pay-cap law, that the board had lawfully honoured it, that nothing unlawful occurred so there is no basis for recovery, and that she cannot intervene in the hospital's staffing decisions.
From my responsibility I cannot intervene in the responsibility of the supervisory board in this matter.
Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid kan ik niet treden in de verantwoordelijkheid van de RvT in dezen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat ontslagrondes in de zorg in aantocht zijn

Leijten (SP) asked the health minister and state secretary about reports of dismissal rounds in healthcare, requesting regional and national data on expected surpluses, dismissals, staff shortages and the effects of extramuralisation. The minister answered that no forced dismissals are expected per current research, that national dismissal data are not kept, and that an labour market effect report is pending, with the government pointing to employers' primary responsibility and a three-track policy.
The figures on the number of (forced) dismissals cannot be provided.
De cijfers over het aantal (gedwongen) ontslagen kunnen niet worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de acties van de vakbond leiden tot de sluiting van het Sarphatihuis

MP Leijten asks the state secretary for Health about union actions and the threatened closure of the Sarphatihuis care home, including whether intensification funds were spent properly and whether funds were shifted from other Amsta locations. The state secretary answers that this is a dispute between an employer and its union, that no closure is currently planned, that the care office (zorgkantoor) rather than the ministry checks how funds are spent, and that Amsta is drawing up a plan with the works council and client council.
This is primarily a matter between a care employer and its employees, represented by a union. I am not a party to that.
Het gaat hier primair om een zaak tussen een zorgwerkgever en haar werknemers, vertegenwoordigd door een vakbond. Daarin ben ik geen partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de uitvoering van de huishoudelijke zorg in de gemeente Emmen niet aan de wet voldoet

MP Leijten asks the state secretary how he responds to a court ruling that Emmen's home-care arrangement (schoonmaakondersteuning) violates the Wmo, whether he still stands by his earlier view that gemeenten must follow the law, and how he will ensure compliance and inform other municipalities. The state secretary responds that the ruling concerned the specific implementation, not the policy itself, that Emmen will not appeal and will issue new decisions, that enforcement is primarily the municipality's responsibility though he retains systemic responsibility, and that he will ask the VNG to inform municipalities of the ruling.
I have asked the municipality to send me its analysis and to inform me of the follow-up actions.
Ik heb de gemeente verzocht mij haar analyse te doen toekomen en mij te informeren over de vervolgacties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de gevolgen van extramuralisering voor zorgaanbieders

An SP MP asks the state secretary how extramuralisation of low-care-intensity (ZZP 1-4) long-term care affects care providers, including whether care offices can guarantee capacity, continuity of care, and who is responsible when homes face vacancies. The secretary replies that providers must adapt, that care offices remain responsible for continuity of care but not for individual institutions, and that the NZa supervises, while giving few figures and promising further information later.
I am not aware whether all care offices have taken a position on the consequences of this measure.
Het is mij niet bekend of alle zorgkantoren een standpunt hebben ingenomen over de gevolgen van de maatregel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over grootschalige omkoping bij 380 sportwedstrijden

An SP MP asked the ministers about Europol findings of large-scale match-fixing in 380 football matches, including whether Dutch actors, arrests, profits and additional sports are covered by the government's investigation, and how whistleblowers will be handled. The government referred to its letter of 8 February 2013, said all relevant data will be considered, that no criminal investigation into match-fixing is ongoing in the Netherlands, that football, tennis and harness racing will be examined plus about two more sports, and that a broader study of match-fixing has been commissioned with whistleblower treatment being part of it.
In the Netherlands no criminal investigation into match-fixing is ongoing.
In Nederland loopt geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar matchfixing.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het Osteoporose Medisch Centrum via de huisarts een DEXA-scan aanbiedt

SP MPs asked the health minister about a Tros Radar report that the Osteoporose Medisch Centrum offers DEXA scans via GPs, raising questions about medical necessity, patient privacy, fees, GP payments, inspection complaints, ownership and possible action. The minister said the report was unclear about who made the offer, referred the matter to the Inspectie for investigation, stated that screening permit rules apply, and said a Gezondheidsraad advisory request on health checks may cover the case.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) will investigate whether what was shown complies with applicable legislation.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) zal onderzoeken of hetgeen getoond is in overeenstemming met vigerende wetgeving is.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een lijst met duizend medische zaken van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) is uitg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister how a list of about a thousand medical incidents leaked from the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) to RTL, how privacy-sensitive data is secured, and whether openness will be increased. The minister admitted an unintentional leak, gave no guarantee it will not recur, and committed to measures and to more transparency about reported incidents, though details were deferred to an ongoing improvement process.
A guarantee that this will never happen again, I cannot give.
Een garantie dat dit nooit meer zal gebeuren, kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over over reclames en patiëntenwerving van GGZ-instelling Indigo

MP Leijten (SP) asks the minister why, despite stating concern about misleading advertising by GGZ provider Indigo, no action is taken, and questions whether the NZa should monitor, whether the GP gatekeeper role is protected, and whether sister companies of Parnassia also recruit patients. The minister replies that Indigo's practices fall within the Wmg and Zvw, that no legal change is needed, that the NZa will monitor the case, and that a free first consult is not prohibited.
That is why I think it is important that the NZa will monitor this case.
Daarom vind ik het belangrijk dat de NZa deze casus wel gaat monitoren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jongeren geen jeugdzorg meer krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked about reports that young people lose youth care at age 18, with the case of Jabko, an autistic young man with no follow-up placement. The state secretary acknowledged such gaps occur, said he would investigate how often, rejected raising the age limit to 21 for now, and described efforts to develop follow-up care and a working group.
I am willing to investigate how often this happens and to inform the House about it.
Ik ben bereid uit te zoeken hoe vaak dit gebeurt en daarover de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix geen beschikbaarheidstoeslag ontvangt

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the NZa's initial rejection of a hospital availability allowance for Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix in Winterswijk, which they said threatened its survival and the 45-minute acute care norm. The minister said the hospital has appealed, that the hospital is important for the region, that the decision rests with the NZa and regional bodies, and that she has no figures showing financial trouble.
I do not have figures on the basis of which I could conclude that the hospital will run into financial problems in the long term without an SEH availability allowance.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op basis waarvan ik de conclusie zou kunnen trekken dat het ziekenhuis op den duur in financiële problemen komt zonder een beschikbaarheidbijdrage SEH.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen met een lager inkomen een grotere kans hebben om te sterven na een hartaanval

An SP MP asked the health minister how to respond to findings that people with lower income or education have a higher chance of dying after a heart attack, and what should be done about socioeconomic health gaps, medical training and an action plan. The minister answered that the causes are complex and shared among many parties, pointed to prevention, health-literacy and professional standards, and said a national prevention programme outline would be presented to parliament within weeks.
I am currently consulting with the State Secretary and various parties to arrive at a national prevention programme.
Ik ben op dit moment samen met de Staatssecretaris en met verschillende partijen in overleg om tot een nationaal programma preventie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de oprichting van het meldpunt Klokkenluiders verstandelijk gehandicapten

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Health why a whistleblower reporting point for people with intellectual disabilities was needed, and about complaint handling, the Inspectorate's capacity, and the power of care providers. The State Secretary acknowledged weaknesses in complaints procedures, pointed to planned reforms (Wet cliëntenrechten zorg, a Zorgloket, binding dispute procedures and a cliëntenvertrouwenspersoon) and largely declined to comment on individual cases or specific providers.
I will not comment on the views of individual care institutions such as Stichting Philadelphia Zorg.
Ik laat mij niet uit over de opvatting van individuele zorginstellingen zoals Stichting Philadelphia Zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zijn uitspraken over overheveling van zorgtaken naar gemeenten

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked State Secretary Van Rijn about his remarks that municipalities need not account separately for each decentralised care task, how this relates to the minister's stance, how outcomes will be monitored, and how the VNG's risk warnings, job impacts and continuity of care will be handled. The answers defend integrated budgeting with monitoring at the level of the whole social domain, promise a letter on long-term care, and decline to guarantee that all current AWBZ care will remain equally available.
Requiring financial accountability per component would unnecessarily frustrate this desired integrated approach.
Financiële verantwoording vragen per onderdeel zou deze gewenste integrale benadering onnodig frustreren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over e-Health diensten en btw-heffing

An MP asked whether the tax authority's demand that care provider Ksyos pay VAT on eHealth services was justified, and whether VAT blocks other care projects. The government declined to discuss the individual case citing tax secrecy, explained that VAT exemptions apply to medical care by doctors but not to the ICT services supporting teledermatology, and said it could not identify other affected projects while the ministries investigate attribution questions.
The questions concern an individual matter. Due to the tax secrecy obligation, no statements can be made about it.
De vragen betreffen een individuele aangelegenheid. Daarover kunnen in verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over misstanden bij Pleyade

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Social Affairs about understaffing, neglect and union access at care provider Pleyade, including a staff diary sent to the Inspectorate. The government answered that the Inspectorate monitors the institution, that the care provider is primarily responsible for staffing and quality, and that the Inspectorate will revisit and gather information, without committing to new extra inspections.
Following the diary, the IGZ requested information from Altenova. Once the IGZ has received the information it will visit Altenova again.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van het dagboek informatie opgevraagd bij Altenova. Als de IGZ de informatie heeft ontvangen zal zij Altenova nogmaals bezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen geen tegemoetkoming vanuit de Wtcg hebben ontvangen

An SP MP asks the state secretary why people entitled to a Wtcg allowance for chronically ill and disabled people have not been paid, how many are affected, and what will prevent recurrence. The state secretary attributes non-payment mainly to incomplete or incorrect client data (bank details), notes that about 85,000 payments were outstanding in early 2013 with 53,000 paid in January-February, and declines further measures.
Incomplete or incorrect client data are the main cause of the allowance not being paid (on time).
Onvolledige of incorrecte klantgegevens zijn de belangrijkste oorzaak van het niet (tijdig) uitbetalen van de tegemoetkoming Wtcg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Achmea en het Slotervaartziekenhuis geen contract hebben afgesloten

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the health minister about Achmea's refusal to contract the Slotervaart hospital, leaving insured patients to pre-pay partly reimbursed bills, and whether patients are being used as pawns and their choice of hospital undermined. The minister answered that non-contracting is a possible outcome of the decentralised system, that patients keep care rights and cancellation rights, that a bill to strengthen insured patients' information duties is pending, and that she sees no sign the dispute concerns quality of care.
How the hospital's invoices are settled is a matter for the parties, in which I cannot and will not interfere.
Hoe de declaraties van het ziekenhuis worden afgehandeld is een zaak van partijen waarin ik me niet kan en wil mengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Achmea en het Slotervaartziekenhuis geen contract hebben afgesloten

An MP asked the health minister whether Achmea's demand that Slotervaart Hospital cap its spending on rheumatology and cancer medicines could deny patients necessary drugs and push insured patients to other hospitals. The minister said insurers and hospitals keep their care duties even if budgets are exceeded, that Achmea must inform its insured about changes, and that the dispute is a normal outcome of decentralised steering and not yet final.
The failure to conclude a contract between a health insurer and a hospital can be an outcome within the decentralised steering model we have chosen for our healthcare.
Het niet tot stand komen van een contract tussen een zorgverzekeraar en een ziekenhuis kan een uitkomst zijn in het decentrale sturingsmodel waarvoor we voor onze gezondheidszorg hebben gekozen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat patiënten in de geriatrische revalidatiezorg buiten de boot dreigen te vallen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she would respond to provider Verenso's warning that patients in geriatric rehabilitation care risk falling through the cracks after its transfer from the AWBZ to the Zorgverzekeringswet, and how she would monitor and intervene. The minister rejected the claim, said Parkinson's patients remain covered under specialist care, promised consultations to clear up uncertainties and monitoring with the NZa, but gave no concrete threshold for intervention and no guarantee against transition problems.
Any unclarities about the transfer of geriatric rehabilitation care must be resolved as quickly as possible.
Eventuele onduidelijkheden omtrent de overheveling van geriatrische revalidatiezorg moeten zo snel mogelijk worden weggenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat concentratie van zorg niet noodzakelijk is om babysterfte terug te dringen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether concentration of obstetric care is needed to reduce infant mortality, citing reports that night-time births are not more dangerous, and asked about staffing, costs, hospital executive pay and consultation of midwives. The minister declined to reverse the concentration in Meppel and Dokkum, argued that 24/7 obstetric care in every hospital is not necessary, and promised a letter to parliament on consulting midwives.
However, it is not for me to decide on the concentration of care, as long as these decisions are taken within the preconditions for quality and accessibility of care.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te besluiten over concentratie van zorg, zolang deze besluiten worden genomen binnen de randvoorwaarden voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het advies van CVZ over geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) in het basispakket

The SP MP Leijten asks the health minister about public unrest over the CVZ draft advice on mental health care in the basic insurance package, whether the government will act, why the CVZ will not withdraw the draft despite many objections, and whether an advisory committee member's remarks on care boundaries are appropriate. The minister says the draft is still under consultation, invites the sector to propose alternatives, declines to comment on individual responses or committee members, and confirms that the CVZ is to clarify the boundary of insured mental health care and that GGZ treatment should follow guidelines.
I do not consider it appropriate to respond to a statement by an individual ACP member.
Ik acht het niet passend te reageren op een uitspraak van een afzonderlijk ACP-lid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de verdeling van topsportgelden door NOC*NSF

An SP MP asked the health and sport minister about NOC*NSF's reallocation of top-sport funds to a focus group of sports, which cuts programmes in many other sports. The minister replied that the sports federations themselves approved the top-10 ambition, that the process was transparent and audited, that talent support remains possible, and that she will not seek a different allocation.
As I understand from NOC*NSF, the process of reallocating top-sport funds based on the principles of the sports agenda proceeded in a transparent and objective manner.
Naar ik begrijp van NOC*NSF is het proces van herverdeling van de topsportmiddelen op basis van de uitgangspunten in de sportagenda op een transparante en objectieve manier verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over ouderen die letterlijk in de kou zitten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about elderly residents at a care home being kept cold, the home's large reserves despite not funding repairs, and whether the inspectorate checks temperature. The state secretary answered that a technical pump fault caused the cold, a replacement was installed, maintenance is ongoing, temperature is not a separate inspection criterion, and the inspectorate will raise it during a planned visit.
Temperature is not a separate criterion that the inspectorate checks.
Temperatuur is geen apart criterium waar de inspectie op toeziet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de heer van der V. op interim-basis toetreedt tot de raad van bestuur van het Kennemergasthuis

Two MPs asked the government whether the interim appointment of Mr. van der V. to the Kennemergasthuis board, his pay, and the related merger and reorganisation were acceptable and whether he falls under the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister said the supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and pay, that the WNT applies to interim directors after six months, and declined to disclose individual income or comment on the reorganisation and the merger.
The supervisory boards are responsible for appointing directors, including in the case of the Kennemergasthuis.
De Raden van Toezicht zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van bestuurders, ook in het geval van het Kennemergasthuis.

Antwoord vragen Leijten over de gevolgen van de verhoging van de eigen bijdrage voor de AWBZ en de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) als gevolg van de introductie van een vermogensinkomensbijtelling

An SP MP asked the health minister about hardship caused by the new capital-income surcharge (vermogensinkomensbijtelling) raising AWBZ and Wmo co-payments, including how many people were affected, whether people must borrow to pay, and what measures will be taken. The state secretary answered that 63,532 intramural clients saw a changed co-payment, that about 4,800 may need to draw on their capital, and that a 'review' with the Chamber would come first before any measures.
I consider it proper first to consult the Chamber on which consequences it deems undesirable.
Ik acht het zuiver eerst met de Kamer in overleg te treden over de vraag welke gevolgen kennelijk door de Kamer ongewenst worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de misleidende patiëntenwerving van GGZ-instelling Indigo

An SP MP asked the health minister about GGZ provider Indigo's metro advertising offering free first consultations without a GP referral, and whether this inflates care use and undermines the GP gatekeeper role. The minister answered that the practice appears to fall within the Zvw rules, that the GP still refers patients, and that she will ask the NZa to monitor such practices.
I will ask the NZa to closely monitor this kind of practice.
Ik zal de NZa vragen dit soort handelswijzen nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen een bezoek aan de huisarts mijden vanwege een hoger eigen risico

An SP MP asked the health minister about a NIVEL survey showing people avoid GP visits due to a higher deductible, and whether this harms access, health and socio-economic health gaps. The minister answered that the findings are not surprising, that no evidence yet shows people forgo necessary care, that the deductible increase is largely compensated via healthcare allowance, and that no new study is planned.
So far it has not been shown that the mandatory deductible leads insured persons to forgo necessary care.
Tot nu toe is niet gebleken dat het verplicht eigen risico ertoe leidt dat verzekerden afzien van noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het feit dat de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg geen dagboek over de situatie in een verpleeghuis in ontvangst wilde nemen

MP Leijten asks why the health inspectorate refused to accept a diary describing conditions in a nursing home and whether this reflects weak inspectorate involvement in elderly care. The state secretary replies that the IGZ asked to receive the diary and will take it into its supervision, and that the inspectorate intensified its elderly-care oversight from 2011 with visits to all care providers, to be completed in early 2013.
The IGZ told the provider, in response to the invitation to publicly receive the book, that it would like to be sent the book and will take it into account in its supervision.

De IGZ heeft in haar reactie op de uitnodiging om het genoemde boek publiekelijk in ontvangst te nemen aan de aanbieder laten weten dat zij het boek graag toegestuurd krijgt en zal betrekken bij haar toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de medicijncheck

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reported medication-related hospital admissions among older people, survey figures on pharmacist and GP medication checks, and whether an annual medication check should be mandatory in the basic health insurance package. The minister said the cited figures were not based on a government study, found the savings estimate unrealistic, and noted that periodic medication review already falls under pharmaceutical care that insurers and professionals can arrange, so no mandatory inclusion is planned.

As I also indicated in answering questions 7 and 8, periodic medication review already forms part of the entitlement to pharmaceutical care, and insurers and doctors/pharmacists can make further arrangements about it.

Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 7 en 8 heb aangegeven, maakt de periodieke medicatiebeoordeling al onderdeel uit van de aanspraak op farmaceutische zorg en kunnen verzekeraars en artsen/apothekers hier nadere afspraken over maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het contracteerbeleid van zorgverzekeraars bij logopedisten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister why insurers offer speech therapists tariffs 6.5 to 13% below the NZa maximum, questioning the NZa's inaction and insurers' market power. The minister answered that maximum tariffs leave insurers free to contract lower, that the NZa has found no grounds for intervention, and that the matter is for competition oversight rather than a norm income for therapists.
The NZa has no indications that corrective action against insurers is needed because they would be impeding competition by abusing their presumed purchasing power.
De NZa heeft geen indicaties dat er corrigerend tegen verzekeraars moet worden opgetreden omdat zij de concurrentie zouden belemmeren door misbruik te maken van hun veronderstelde inkoopmacht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het nieuws dat dokter Jansen Steur weer aan het werk zou zijn (geweest) in Duitsland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how the government responded to reports that the disciplined neurologist Jansen Steur was working in Germany, what steps were taken with German authorities, and how similar cases could be prevented across the EU. The minister said the IGZ contacted the Bezirksregierung Arnsberg about documents submitted in 2006, pointed to the cover letter for most substantive answers, and outlined existing tools such as restrictive measures in the BIG register and cross-border cooperation through HPCB.

I will explicitly point the competent authorities in the EU Member States to the list of measures under the BIG Act on the BIG register website and draw their attention to the amendments to the BIG Act since July 2012.

Ik zal de bevoegde autoriteiten in de lidstaten van de EU uitdrukkelijk wijzen op de lijst met maatregelen Wet BIG op de website van het BIG-register en hen daarbij wijzen op de wijzigingen van de Wet BIG sinds juli 2012.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het nieuws dat dokter Jansen Steur een verklaring van geen bezwaar zou hebben gekregen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether a German hospital's claim that neurologist Jansen Steur obtained a Dutch certificate of good conduct in 2006 is accurate, and how the minister views her remark that the hospital should have googled him. The minister referred to the accompanying letter for the origin of the certificate and the IGZ's handling, and argued that the 2006 certificate was not relevant to a 2011 application and that employers should check non-national sources and request recent certificates.
I refer you to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
Ik verwijs u naar paragraaf 4 van de begeleidende brief.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de waarde van een diploma naar aanleiding van een LOOT-programma

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether diplomas from LOOT elite-athlete programmes, with exemptions, carry the same value as regular diplomas, after a turnster was refused entry to a Saxion course because an exemption in economics left her deficient. The government answered that LOOT diplomas are full entry qualifications, that the refusal followed the course's own specific prerequisite, that the evaluation is due in summer 2013, and that no other similar cases are known.
Yes, that is correct. Pupils following an adapted programme in secondary education under the LOOT licence policy rule can obtain a full final diploma.

Leerlingen die een aangepast programma volgen op het middelbaar onderwijs in het kader van mijn Beleidsregel verstrekking Loot-licentie voortgezet onderwijs 1 , kunnen een volwaardig einddiploma verwerven.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht van slechte zorg en intimidatie in de locatie voor gehandicaptenzorg “Kleine Johannes” van de zorginstelling Amsta

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports of poor care, intimidation, unhygienic rooms, staff shortages and a visiting restriction imposed on a parent at the Kleine Johannes disability care location run by Amsta. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate placed the location under intensified supervision for six months on 3 December 2012, that it found high risks in restrictive measures and support plans, and that the Inspectorate handles individual complaints and cases while visiting restrictions are a matter for the institution and family to resolve.

That is why the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate placed the 'De Kleine Johannes' location under intensified supervision for six months from 3 December 2012 and is meanwhile conducting further investigation.

Daarom heeft de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (hierna: Inspectie) de locatie «De Kleine Johannes» op 3 december 2012 – voor een periode van 6 maanden – onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld en doet zij ondertussen nader onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de situatie bij het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about deaths linked to errors at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital and the regulator's response. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has taken several steps (admissions stop, transfer of cardiac patients, supervision, a ban on cardiologists providing care) and that the hospital and Inspectorate are investigating patient files, while withholding timing and detailed results pending the ongoing investigations.
Taking into account the privacy of the patients involved and medical confidentiality, I will inform your House in due course about the results of this investigation.
Met inachtneming van de privacy van de betrokken patiënten en het medisch beroepsgeheim zal ik uw Kamer ter gelegener tijd informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de mogelijk onveilige situatie in het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked Minister Schippers about possibly unsafe conditions at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital, including why the Inspectorate did not intervene earlier and whether patient safety and ambulance access are guaranteed. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has taken several steps (admission stop, transfers, six-month enhanced supervision, a ban on the cardiology group) and that it is examining safety across all departments, while defending the timing of its interventions and the ambulance arrangements.
Since 15 November, the Ruwaard van Putten hospital as a whole has been under enhanced supervision by the IGZ.
Het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis staat sinds 15 november jl. in zijn geheel onder verscherpt toezicht van de IGZ.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Keijzer over de bezuiniging op dagbesteding in 2013

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked how the planned 2013-2014 savings on day care (dagbesteding) and personal care under the AWBZ-to-Wmo transfer were built up, and about client numbers, new applications, admissions to institutions and costs per ZZP. The state secretary gave partial figures, explained the savings assumptions, said the final implementation may differ, and promised a letter to the House in early 2013 on the policy.
No data are available on clients assessed by the Bureaus Jeugdzorg.
Van de cliënten geïndiceerd door de Bureaus Jeugdzorg zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de acties in de verpleeghuiszorg van 3 november jl

MPs Kuzu, Leijten and Voortman asked whether care provider Amsta received intensification funds for extra staff yet did not hire them, and questioned executive pay and strike-related measures. The state secretary answered that Amsta received about 4.1 million euros, reported on its use via a progress report, and that the government does not intend to request an overview from each institution; he also stated the right to strike is not in question.
Beyond the oversight of the care office, I monitor the progress of the realisation of the extra funds at macro level.
Naast het toezicht van het zorgkantoor monitor ik op macroniveau de voortgang van de realisatie van de extra middelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het beleid bij IGZ

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how the IGZ enforces the duty of hospitals to report calamities on time, including fines, reporting quality, protection of whistleblowers and the safety culture. Minister Schippers answered that fines are possible but only three warnings and no fines have been issued, and she described the IGZ's enforcement framework and the pending bill on splitting large organisations.
The IGZ has to date not imposed any administrative fine for failing to report a calamity without delay.
De IGZ heeft tot op heden geen bestuurlijke boete opgelegd voor het niet onverwijld melden van een calamiteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het geruzie in het VUmc

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about reports of a possible conspiracy and patient-safety dangers at the VUmc hospital, including how many complaints the Inspectorate has received and what consequences follow. The minister replied that the Inspectorate is investigating the reports, will decide on follow-up actions based on that inquiry, and will refer possible crimes to the Public Prosecution Service, while declining to give complaint numbers yet.
The report in question is currently being investigated by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
De betreffende melding wordt momenteel door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het geruzie in het VUmc en de gevolgen daarvan en het wederom niet melden van een sterfgeval

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about infighting among specialists at VUmc, the IGZ's handling of an external review, and an unreported patient death during surgery. The minister answered that the IGZ asked VUmc to finish its own review first, that the death is being investigated by VUmc at the IGZ's request, and that the inspectorate sees no immediate need for further measures while monitoring under heightened supervision.
The inspectorate asked the hospital to complete its own investigation.
De inspectie heeft het ziekenhuis verzocht het eigen onderzoek af te ronden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraars

The SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether insurers' preferential drug policy has gone too far, endangering drug supply and encroaching on doctors' prescribing, and whether a uniform national scheme should replace it. The minister rejected the claim of excessive insurer power, said the insurers' duty of care is judged by the NZa and that complaints about drugs are few, and refused to abolish apothecary discounts and bonuses.
I do not have the requested information on the number of cases in which the drug dispensed is not the one the doctor marked with 'MN' (medical necessity) on the prescription.

Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie met betrekking tot het aantal gevallen waarin niet het geneesmiddel wordt verstrekt dat de dokter met «MN» (medische noodzaak) op het recept heeft aangegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de situatie bij Altenova

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the dispute at care centre Altenova, including whether union AbvaKabo was refused access, how many staff the intensification funds (EUR 1.6 million) created, and how care offices supervise spending. The state secretary answered that access is only by appointment, that about 20 FTE were funded, and that care offices supervise spending as part of regular contracting.
Agreements have been made with the care offices on supervising the efficient use of the extra funds.
Met de zorgkantoren zijn afspraken gemaakt over het toezicht op de doelmatige aanwending van de extra middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat in korte tijd twee gehandicapte bewoners zijn overleden bij zorginstelling Bartimeus

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports of two deaths of disabled residents at care institution Bartimeus, linked to a reorganisation, staff fears, intimidation, oversight and executive pay. The state secretary answered that investigations by the Inspectorate (IGZ) and an external bureau are ongoing, that the reorganisation was approved by the supervisory board and works councils, that the IGZ has received few staff reports, and that enforcement depends on the IGZ findings.
The IGZ wants to receive the outcomes of this investigation by 2 December at the latest and will use them in its own investigation.
De IGZ wil de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek uiterlijk vóór 2 december ontvangen en zal dit gebruiken bij haar eigen onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het schrappen van de functie huishoudelijke verzorging

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Health about Thebe's plan to drop the home-help (thuishulp) function and offer staff a pay cut or dismissal, and whether municipalities should stop this. The state secretary says the business decision is Thebe's, the social plan is a matter between employer and employees, municipalities remain responsible for providing help, and the government plans to restrict household help under long-term care reform.
It is up to municipalities to enable citizens, where necessary, to run a household and to deliver the tailored provision offered.
Het is aan gemeenten om burgers waar nodig in staat te stellen een huishouden te voeren en de op basis van maatwerk aangeboden voorziening uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanhoudende misstanden bij HWW Zorg

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about persistent abuses at care provider HWW Zorg, including underfunding from wrong care-intensity classifications, understaffing, intimidation of staff, neglect of residents, and whether directors can be held liable. The State Secretary answers that the provider is primarily responsible, the Inspectorate received no report of the incident, and the government will present a vision on governance including director liability.
I cannot assess whether and to what extent staff are being intimidated. In its next visits the IGZ will speak with staff and the client council.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of en zo ja in hoeverre personeel wordt geïntimideerd. In haar volgende bezoeken zal IGZ gaan praten met medewerkers en cliëntenraad.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het LangeLand Ziekenhuis overgenomen wordt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the takeover of LangeLand Ziekenhuis by Loek Winter, its financial problems, staff dismissals and risks to care quality. The minister answered that the hospital boards chose the buyer, that the Inspectorate monitors care quality, and that the takeover would be reviewed by the NMa and NZa.
I have no role in this.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat er steeds meer kinderen in de crisisopvang komen zonder goede hulp

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about reports that more children are entering crisis shelter without adequate help, and why the number of children in social shelter rose from 7,574 in 2008 to 8,791 in 2010. The state secretary said preventing homelessness is the priority, attributed the rise mainly to the financial crisis and divorces, and committed to adapting the Veerkracht method for social shelter with implementation from early 2014.
It is not known how many families across the Netherlands are on a waiting list at all shelter centres.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen in heel Nederland bij alle opvangcentra op een wachtlijst staan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat pijn bij dementie vaak niet behandeld wordt in verpleeghuizen

MP Leijten (SP) asked the ministers whether pain in dementia patients in nursing homes is often left untreated, what causes this, and what will be done about training, observation tools, research, home care and municipal transfer of care. The state secretary answered that the problem is known, that primary responsibility lies with care professionals and institutions, and that the government cannot judge causes or mandate tools, while pointing to Alzheimer Nederland, the transition bureau and an earlier letter on case management.
Primarily it is up to healthcare practitioners, such as geriatric and elderly care specialists, to take measures on this.
Het is primair aan de beroepsbeoefenaren, zoals specialisten ouderengeneeskunde en geriaters, om daar maatregelen op te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw wantoestanden zijn bij Cordaan

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports of renewed neglect of care at Cordaan, including a resident who went four days without care, the IGZ's oversight, complaint numbers and staff shortages. The state secretary said care must not be withheld, that IGZ monitors Cordaan without current measures, that Cordaan has launched an independent inquiry, and that labour conditions and CAO matters are not his responsibility.
I take the position that I have no responsibilities for or powers in CAO negotiations, and do not wish to have them.
Ik sta op het standpunt dat ik geen verantwoordelijkheden heb voor en/of bevoegdheden bij CAO-onderhandelingen, en wens die ook niet te hebben.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Van Gerven over het gebruik van DNA uit ziekenhuizen voor opsporingsdoeleinden in strafzaken

MPs Leijten, Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether draft legislation would let justice examine hospital-held DNA for criminal investigations, and whether this breaches purpose limitation and deters patient participation in research. The minister confirmed that draft texts of a Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal were circulated for pre-consultation, that they are not government-approved, and that the dilemmas will be for the new cabinet to decide, referring to an earlier letter.
The draft texts have therefore not yet been approved by me or by the cabinet.
De concept-teksten zijn dus nog niet door mij of het kabinet geaccordeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat klinische verloskunde in Meppel verdwijnt

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the closure of clinical obstetrics in Meppel, questioning whether the board's decision was careful, whether the 45-minute norm and quality conditions can be met within two months, and whether staff were consulted. The minister replied that a renewed careful process involving local stakeholders and mediation was followed, that care stays local where possible, and that she sees no reason to intervene or meet staff.
After the initially hastily taken decision, a new and careful process was started to speak and consult with all local stakeholders.
Na de aanvankelijk te snel genomen beslissing is een nieuw en zorgvuldig proces gestart om met alle lokale betrokkenen te spreken en te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de AWBZ tariefskorting in de vier grote steden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health whether AWBZ tariff reductions are imposed on care providers in the four largest cities, why parliament was not informed, and how this fits with needed quality improvements. The government replied that there is no city-specific tariff reduction, that contracts between care providers and care offices may set lower rates than NZa maximums, and that contracting space is not reduced.
There is no tariff reduction specifically aimed at the major cities.
Er is geen sprake van een tariefskorting, specifiek gericht op de grote steden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de invoering van een no-claim door Bewuzt/VGZ

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about VGZ/Bewuzt introducing a no-claim bonus on supplementary insurance, questioning consistency with the 2006 abolition of the basic-insurance no-claim and its effect on chronically ill people. The minister answered that supplementary insurance falls outside her responsibility, that the NZa has no substantive supervisory role there, and that enough choice exists for chronic patients.
As indicated in my reply to question 1, the supplementary insurance falls outside my responsibility.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn reactie op vraag 1 ligt de aanvullende verzekering buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de toekomst van het Landelijk Schakelpunt (LSP)

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister how the Landelijk Schakelpunt (LSP) health data exchange is financed in 2012, whether insurers will keep funding it, whether insurers can refuse providers who do not join, how many providers and patients have joined, and whether patients must re-consent when the system changes. The minister replied that insurers paid 6.6 million euro, that a three-year funding agreement has been reached, that the profession itself decides whether LSP membership is a quality requirement, and that exact opt-in numbers are not yet known.
Exact numbers of Dutch citizens who gave consent for data exchange via the LSP on 1 October 2012 are not known to the VZVZ.
Exacte aantallen van Nederlanders die op 1 oktober 2012 toestemming hebben gegeven voor gegevensuitwisseling via het LSP zijn bij de VZVZ niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het financiële beleid van zorgverzekeraars en de zorgpremies

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurers' profits, premium rises, reserves, advertising, salaries, administration costs and pharmacy pricing. The minister answered that insurers must meet solvency rules and are free in spending premium income within the law, pointed to the upcoming WNT salary cap and existing annual-report publication duties, and said pharmacy contracting is a matter for individual insurers and the regulators.
I have no powers to intervene in the financial management of health insurers.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheden om in te grijpen in de financiële huishouding van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de toekomst van het Bethesdaziekenhuis in Hoogeveen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the future of Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen, including a KPMG/Plexus report, a possible merger with Refaja, and the role of insurers. The minister said the hospital group decides on the report's publication and the merger is for the NMa to assess, while stating that accessibility and quality should stay central.
No, it is up to KPMG/Plexus and the hospital group itself to decide whether the report is made public.
Nee, het is aan KPMG/Plexus en de ziekenhuisgroep zelf om te besluiten of het rapport openbaar gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over zorgverzekeraars die prijsverschillen van geneesmiddelen ten laste brengen van het eigen risico

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer Agis charging €189.08 of the deductible for a medicine priced at €48.15 was justified, and whether insurers' divergent drug price agreements are opaque and wasteful. The minister replied that the price was a contractual agreement that had not yet been revised after a lower advisory price, that prices are visible on insurer websites and in declarations, and that no further investigation was needed.
Achmea is considering adjusting its sales prices more than twice a year in future, so that the agreed prices better match the advisory prices.
Achmea overweegt voor de toekomst hun verkoopprijzen meer dan twee keer per jaar aan te passen, zodat de afgesproken prijzen meer in overeenstemming zijn met de adviesprijzen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Smits over een groot tekort aan stages in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Smits asked the state secretary for Health about reports of a large shortage of internship places in care, why internship-fund-financed places are cut, whether students are being removed from training, and what will be done. The state secretary answered that nationally there is no general shortage, that the internship fund has increased realised placements, that no places were cut in the region concerned, and that no additional measures are needed for now.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over aanhoudende signalen van slechte en ontbrekende zorg bij Fokus-projecten

An SP MP asks the state secretary about persistent poor and missing care at Fokus projects, including a resident in Amsterdam whose ADL assistance is inadequate, and why nothing has been resolved. The state secretary answers that the Inspectorate is investigating quality and safety, that the resident is entitled to care but the relationship with Fokus is seriously disrupted, that a solution is being negotiated with the housing corporation, and that intimidation of complainants is worrying.
At my request, the Inspectorate is investigating the quality of care and client safety at the foundation Fokus exploitatie.
De Inspectie doet op mijn verzoek onderzoek naar de kwaliteit van zorg en de cliëntveiligheid bij de stichting Fokus exploitatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over mogelijk misbruik van het Zorgverzekeringsfonds door zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asked the health minister about possible misuse of the Zorgverzekeringsfonds by health insurers and hospitals under the transition model, and about the industry body's commissioned investigation. The minister replied that an independent expert group will examine signals, that misuse is unacceptable but not yet established, and that she sees no need to change the market model or the insurers' role.
Following the results of the investigation, I will consider whether further action on my part is needed.
Naar aanleiding van de resultaten uit het onderzoek zal ik bezien of er nader actie van mijn kant nodig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een klokkenluider in het VUmc wiens positie in het geding is

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether the VUmc board may demote whistleblower Professor Postmus for contacting the supervisory board and the IGZ about patient safety, and asked for a reason he cannot return as head of the Lung Diseases department. The minister declined to judge the labour dispute, pointing to the hospital's own whistleblower rules, the IGZ's enhanced supervision, the pending court case and the new Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, while promising answers before the court date.
As I have also written in answer to parliamentary questions from members Voortman and Van Gent, it is not for me to make statements about a labour law dispute.
Zoals ik ook eerder in antwoord op Kamervragen van de leden Voortman en Van Gent 4 heb geschreven, is het niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over een arbeidsrechtelijk conflict.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen voor ruim een half miljard euro aan zorggeld hebben opgepot

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether hospitals building reserves of over half a billion euro with public care money is an efficient use of funds, and how that can be checked. Minister Schippers replied that adequate reserves are necessary and desirable, that hospital solvency has risen but most have not yet reached the sector's 20% target, and that no investigation is needed for now.
Currently, as I outlined above, there is certainly no situation of excessive solvency among Dutch hospitals.
Momenteel is er, zoals ik hierboven schetste, zeker geen situatie van een te grote solvabiliteit bij de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de veiligheidsrisico’s in het VUmc

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether an independent inquiry into avoidable deaths at VUmc was needed, whether patient safety is guaranteed given board turmoil, whether the supervisory council and board are adequate, and about an IGZ internal draft document and the IGZ's expertise. The minister declined an external inquiry, noted the IGZ's enhanced supervision and the hospital's own external review, and said the IGZ acted adequately.
I currently see no reason for an external inquiry into avoidable deaths at VUmc.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar vermijdbare sterfte bij het VUmc.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het aangaan van een partnerschap door ZorgSaam en Curamus

An MP asked whether the announced partnership between healthcare organisations ZorgSaam and Curamus is a disguised merger, and about consultation of works and client councils, competition authority involvement, location closures and staffing effects. The state secretary answered that no merger is currently planned though one is not excluded later, that councils have been informed, no locations or departments are being cut, and no staffing consequences are foreseen.
From the institutions I have understood that there is no question of concentration or closing locations and departments.
Van de instellingen heb ik begrepen dat van concentratie of schrappen van locaties en afdelingen geen sprake is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Leijten, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het toegenomen aantal zelfdodingen

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the rising number of suicides, the effect of prevention policy, the new suicide treatment guideline, weekend psychiatric care and bank staff training. The minister acknowledged the increase, said the effect of policy is hard to measure, will seek advice from the VU on a target figure, and said weekend crisis care is sufficient while training bank staff is the financial sector's own responsibility.
Given that the absolute number of suicides rose again over the past year, I consulted relevant stakeholders on whether a target figure is possible and desirable.
Mede gezien de omstandigheid dat het absolute aantal suïcides over het afgelopen jaar wederom is gestegen, heb ik overleg gevoerd met betrokken veldpartijen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgkantoren geen lichte zorgzwaartepakketten meer inkopen

The MP Leijten asked whether care offices are refusing to purchase light care packages (ZZP 1-3) for intramural care despite indications, and whether this breaches their duty of care. The state secretary denied that care offices stop buying light packages, stating they remain bound by their duty of care but are cautious given falling new indications and planned extramuralisation.
Care offices must comply with their duty of care, including for existing clients with an indication for a light care package.
Zorgkantoren moeten aan hun zorgplicht voldoen ook voor bestaande cliënten met een indicatie voor een licht zorgzwaarte pakket.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over vergoeding van fingolimod bij patiënten met MS

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why some insurers reportedly do not reimburse fingolimod for MS patients and whether the CVZ advice allows that. The minister answers that reimbursement is restricted to second-line therapy under the regulation, that insurers apply the conditions, that she will ask the CVZ to review whether the conditions should be adjusted, and that the answers were late.
I will ask them to involve various relevant stakeholders in this.
Ik zal hen vragen om verschillende relevante veldpartijen hierbij te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over Vragen over mantelzorgers die zorgen in instellingen

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a Mezzo survey showing many family carers feel obliged to perform basic care tasks in nursing homes, and whether a national investigation is warranted. The state secretary called family involvement voluntary, proposed discussing and recording such arrangements in care plans, said the survey (51 respondents) was too small to justify a national study, and rejected any obligation on carers.
I will therefore first consult with ActiZ and Mezzo to get a better picture of the situation.
Ik ga daarom eerst in overleg met ActiZ en Mezzo om een beter beeld van de situatie te krijgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de mensonterende omstandigheden bij verpleeghuis Sint Jacob, onderdeel van Osira Amstelring

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about degrading conditions at nursing home Sint Jacob (Osira Amstelring), including staff shortages, unqualified staff, falls, lack of showers, unspent funds, nurse departures and whether managers should be sanctioned. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate sees ongoing improvement efforts, that extra funds are being deployed through approved plans, and that the board retains the cliëntenraad's confidence, so no sanctions are proposed.
If there is acute danger to residents, the IGZ will take immediate measures and inform me of this.
Als er sprake is van acute onveiligheid voor de bewoners, dan zal de IGZ direct maatregelen nemen en mij hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over overbelaste WMO-loketten en de scheiding van wonen en zorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about overloaded WMO counters at municipalities, requests to delay AWBZ decentralisation and ZZP cuts, the separation of housing and care, and the abolition of ZZP 1-3 for elderly care, posing 15 questions in total. The state secretary replied that she had postponed the measure for ZZP VV 3, GGZ 3 and VG 3 and the age-22 cohort to allow more time, but declined substantive response on transport-to-day-care harmonisation because the VGN had lodged an appeal.

On this basis I have decided to take more time for the elaboration of the measure for ZZP VV 3, GGZ 3 and VG 3 and for its introduction for clients up to and including age 22, in order to reach a responsible implementation with the parties involved.

Op basis hiervan heb ik besloten om voor de uitwerking van de maatregel voor ZZP VV 3, GGZ 3 en VG 3 en voor de invoering voor cliënten tot en met 22 jaar meer tijd te nemen om met betrokken partijen tot een verantwoorde uitvoering te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over Kamervragen over het ronselen van gehandicapte meisjes voor seks

An MP asked the government how it responds to reports that girls with intellectual disabilities were recruited by loverboys for sex, and what protection, aftercare, reporting and prosecution measures exist. The government answered that a cross-departmental action plan applies, that seven suspects in Limburg have been arrested, that victims were heard by certified officers, and that further measures will follow the ongoing inventory and GIA reporting.
The public prosecution service does not record the extent to which victims of human trafficking have intellectual disabilities.
Het OM houdt niet bij in welke mate de slachtoffers van mensenhandel verstandelijk beperkt zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de fusie tussen Thuiszorg Rotterdam en Espria en ADG

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about a possible merger of Thuiszorg Rotterdam with Espria and ADG, concerning market dominance, consultation of staff and clients, financial and personnel effects, and top-management pay. The state secretary replied that only a letter of intent exists, no merger notification has been received by the NMa, and that market share data and merger decisions are for the organisations and the competition authority, with the WNT applying once enacted.
I do not have this information. This is commercially sensitive information of the institutions themselves.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de bestuurderssalarissen bij bloedbank Sanquin weer zijn toegenomen

SP MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister why Sanquin's board salaries rose again, questioning whether they comply with the Balkenende norm and the BBZ code. The minister said the increase mirrored staff CAO raises, that existing contracts are respected under the WNT transitional rules, that Sanquin will be pressed to align contracts with the BBZ, and that the departing chair receives no bonuses.
I will hold Sanquin to account on this.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht bezuinigingen bij Centrum Eetstoornissen Ursula

MP Leijten asked the minister whether cuts at the Centrum Eetstoornissen Ursula, part of Rivierduinen, meant dropping meal moments for patients with eating disorders, and whether quality of care could be guaranteed.
