The minister replied that institutions decide how to implement cuts within the framework of quality of care, declined to guarantee that no meals would be dropped, and gave no overview of how other GGZ institutions implement cuts.
It is up to the institutions themselves how they give substance to this, provided the quality of care is maintained.
Het is aan instellingen zelf hoe zij invulling hieraan geven, mits de kwaliteit van zorg daarbij gehandhaafd blijft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over onder meer de vermindering van het aantal bedden in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the minister of Health about the planned one-third cut in GGZ beds by 2020, reported shortages of beds for domestic violence victims, human trafficking victims and GHB addicts, waiting lists, and the RvZ advice. The minister answered that the bed reduction is an ambition to be refined after a baseline measurement and cost-benefit analysis, that there is no national bed shortage, that GHB detox is exempt from bed reduction, and that the RvZ advice is left to a new cabinet.
At this moment there are still no aggregated national figures on developments in 2011.
Op dit moment zijn er nog geen geaggregeerde landelijke cijfers over de ontwikkelingen in 2011.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de dreigende sluiting van twee Groningse ziekenhuizen en de riante vertrekregeling van een directeur

SP MPs asked the health minister about the threatened closure of two Groningen hospitals based on a confidential report, the public access to that report, and a generous severance package for a former hospital director, including who is liable. The minister said the closure plans are not confirmed, that a public version of the report will follow, that remuneration decisions are the supervisory board's responsibility, and that she has no power to intervene.
I have no means to intervene in this. This is a responsibility of the Supervisory Board.
Ik heb geen mogelijkheden om hierop in te grijpen. Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over multidisciplinaire samenwerking in de zorg en btw-heffing

An SP MP asked whether VAT charged on support and coordination work by a multidisciplinary primary-care foundation is consistent with government goals of integrated care. The state secretary explained that such non-medical support and coordination services are not VAT-exempt, that the tax inspector decides case by case, and promised to examine with the health minister whether VAT rules for these services can be adjusted.

Given developments in cooperation in primary health care, I will, together with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and in consultation with the sector, examine whether there are possibilities to adjust the VAT levy on the services concerned.

Gelet op de ontwikkelingen op het terrein van samenwerking in de eerstelijnsgezondheidszorg zal ik, samen met de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en in overleg met de betrokken sector, bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn de btw-heffing ten aanzien van de in het geding zijnde diensten aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het correct uitvoeren van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary how municipalities must implement the Wmo for household care, including quality and staffing standards, basic tariffs, indexation and macrobudget figures. The state secretary answered that municipalities must meet the compensation duty, that wage grading is a matter for social partners, that tariff levels depend on local conditions, and that the handbook on tariffs and tendering was expected in autumn 2012.
Municipalities are responsible for setting quality requirements (including requirements for the staff deployed) for the household care they wish to procure.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het stellen van kwaliteitseisen (waaronder eisen aan het in te zetten personeel) aan de door hen gewenste huishoudelijke verzorging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars onmogelijke eisen stellen in de onderhandelingen met ziekenhuizen

Leijten (SP) asks whether insurers may intervene in hospital governance during contract talks, whether such demands are legally sustainable, why contracting for 2012 is delayed, and whether patients and the hospital framework agreement are at risk. Minister Schippers answers that contracting freedom applies, the legal assessment is not hers, contracting is progressing with no reported liquidity or waiting-list problems, and central planning would not solve allocation issues.
For both the content and the process of contracting between insurer and healthcare provider, there is freedom of contract.
Voor zowel de inhoud als het proces van de contractering tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder is er sprake van contracteervrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen achterstanden hebben bij het betalen van zorgpremie

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that more people are falling behind on health insurance premiums, questioning the nominal premium, the 30% penalty regime, the rising deductible, and royalties by insurers. The minister argued that payment arrangements are a positive development, that the health allowance keeps premiums affordable for low incomes, and that the government sees no reason to change policy while promising to route the allowance to collect the penalty premium from 2013.
Apart from two health insurers, ONVZ and ASR, all health insurers have implemented the defaulters' scheme since its entry into force in 2009.
Op twee zorgverzekeraars na, ONVZ en ASR, hebben sinds de inwerkingtreding van de wanbetalersregeling in 2009 alle zorgverzekeraars de wanbetalersregeling uitgevoerd.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de verplichting voor familie om mee te werken in het verpleeghuis De Vierstroom

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether care home De Vierstroom may oblige relatives to help four hours a month, and how this squares with volunteering, care budgets, waiting lists and executive pay. The state secretary rejected any mandatory character, saying compulsory contributions in kind are not permitted and that she has asked the NZa to review the experiment and will raise the answers with Vierstroom.
The mandatory character of Vierstroom's experiment, however, goes too far for me.
Het verplichtende karakter van het experiment van Vierstroom gaat me evenwel te ver.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over het contract van de GGZ-bestuurder van Mondriaan

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that the Mondriaan GGZ board chair had a 111% employment contract, and whether the BBZ pay code allows such contracts for executives. The minister answered that the 111% figure was an incorrect representation under the BBZ, which sets 100% as the maximum for a full-time contract, but that actual pay stays within BBZ scales, and that no 111% contracts were found in the 2010 annual reports.
In this case a part-time factor of 111% could therefore not have been justified.
In dit geval had er dus geen deeltijdfactor van 111% 2 kunnen worden verantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het uitkleden van de ziekenhuiszorg in Noord-Holland

SP MPs asked the health minister about the downgrading of Gemini Hospital in Den Helder, including loss of maternity care, ambulance response times, and whether mergers should be reversed or subjected to a moratorium pending patient and staff participation. The minister replied that the hospital keeps acute, maternity and planned care, that the merger is legally assessed by the NMa, that no moratorium can be imposed due to EU rules, and that stakeholder involvement is handled by the institutions themselves.
It is the responsibility of healthcare institutions themselves to ensure that stakeholders, including at least clients and staff, are involved in a planned concentration of care.

Het is een verantwoordelijkheid van zorginstellingen zelf om, in geval van een voorgenomen concentratie van zorg, ervoor te zorgen dat de belanghebbenden, waaronder in ieder geval cliënten en personeel, worden betrokken.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Leijten over "de onrust naar aanleiding van plannen van wethouder Florijn te Rotterdam om bijstandsgerechtigden in de thuiszorg te laten werken"

SP MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked about Rotterdam alderman Florijn's plan to place welfare recipients in home care, including social return quotas, wage levels, qualifications, and single-provider contracting. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for local labour market policy and social return, that cao wages apply to such workers, and that the government gives no job or income guarantees.
Policy under the Work and Assistance Act is the responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam.
Het beleid in het kader van de Wet werk en bijstand is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over broodmaaltijdvergoedingen in de intramurale AWBZ zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether residents of De Elsendonck care home receive a meal allowance too small to buy two bread meals a day, forcing them to shop for food, and about related laundry and price-labelling issues. The state secretary replied that bread meals are an AWBZ entitlement the provider must cover, that the allowance is voluntary and based on a LOC guideline, that no further investigation is needed, and that the provider's practices are being monitored through residents' councils.
I do not consider further investigation necessary.
Ik acht een nader onderzoek niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over de plannen voor een tv-serie over pleegkinderen die hun pleegouders kiezen

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked whether a planned Talpa TV series in which foster children choose their foster parents, and Jeugdzorg Nederland's involvement, respects children's privacy and welfare. The state secretary answered that the current format offers insufficient safeguards, that talks on an adjusted format are ongoing, that she cannot judge the programme until its format is final, and that recruitment is the responsibility of foster care providers.
The current format – in which a young person publicly chooses a foster parent – offers insufficient safeguards and is therefore not appropriate.
Het huidige format – waarin een jeugdige publiekelijk voor een pleegouder kiest – biedt onvoldoende waarborgen en is daarom niet passend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuisbestuurders nog altijd exorbitante vertrekpremies krijgen

An MP asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that 13 hospital executives received 3.3 million euro in departure payments, and whether self-regulation of executive pay works. The minister replied that a statutory pay-norm bill (WNT) is pending in the Senate, that no prior approval is needed for bonuses and no formal rules were breached, and that the bill would ban bonuses.
In the amended bill now before the Senate, however, bonuses are entirely prohibited.
In het geamendeerde wetsvoorstel zoals dat inmiddels bij de Eerste Kamer ligt, zijn bonussen echter helemaal verboden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over investeerders die azen op ziekenhuizen in financiële problemen

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about investors buying hospitals and clinics in financial trouble, expecting high returns despite the ban on profit distribution, and about constructions that may circumvent that ban such as outsourcing, interest payments and resale. Minister Schippers answered that paying return on capital is not prohibited, that private capital is needed for investment and innovation, that she has no data on financing arrangements, and that she will consult investigative authorities on outsourcing abuses.
I am not aware whether, and which, hospitals are technically bankrupt.
Het is mij niet bekend of en welke ziekenhuizen technisch failliet zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat topinkomens in de ouderenzorg blijven stijgen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that top salaries in elderly care keep rising, with a 5.6% increase for top executives, and pressed on pay restraint, dienstauto's, and whether the WNT pay-cap law will be enforced sooner. The government answered that it cannot explain the increases and that supervisory boards are responsible, while pointing to the WNT bill that is awaiting Senate approval as the instrument to cap top incomes.
It is the supervisory boards that are responsible for this and they should be held to account for it.
Het zijn de Raden van Toezicht die hiervoor verantwoordelijk zijn en daarop aangesproken moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de megafusie in de gehandicaptenzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Health about the planned merger of Promens Care and NOVO in disability care, including reasons, effects on residents and staff, surpluses, reserves, executive pay and whether the merger would be blocked. The secretary said the merger was not yet notified to the competition authority, referred consultation of staff and residents to the boards and works councils, noted a pending bill tightening care-specific merger review, and declined to intervene for now.
This is a matter between the boards of Promens Care and NOVO and the works councils. The government has no role in this at present.
Dit is een zaak tussen de bestuurders van Promens Care en NOVO en de medezeggenschapsorganen. De overheid heeft hierin op dit moment geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de uitslag van het referendum over de cao VVT (Verpleeg- en Verzorgingshuizen en Thuiszorgorganisaties)

MPs Leijten and Voortman asked why 96 percent of over 20,000 participants rejected the cao VVT in a referendum, how legitimacy could be restored and how the motion they filed would be handled. The state secretary said he had no explanation, stated that his personal view on the cao was not relevant as he is not a party to it, and passed the motion to the responsible minister at SZW.
I have no explanation for that.
Daar heb ik geen verklaring voor.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het concept-advies van het College voor Zorgverzekeringen omtrent het vergoeden van geneesmiddelen aan patiënten met een zeldzame ziekte

An SP MP asked the health minister whether she would distance herself from CVZ draft advice recommending that reimbursement for expensive Pompe and Fabry orphan drugs be ended, and whether price limits should guide the basic package. The minister replied that the CVZ has not yet issued advice, that therapeutic value and cost-effectiveness guide decisions without a fixed price limit, and that she will negotiate prices with manufacturers and inform the House.
I will therefore shortly sit down with the producers of these orphan drugs to negotiate the price in relation to the demonstrated therapeutic added value.
Ik ga dan ook op korte termijn met de producenten van deze weesgeneesmiddelen om de tafel zitten om te onderhandelen over de prijs in relatie tot de gebleken therapeutische meerwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de prijs van het geneesmiddel voor de zeldzame ziekte van Pompe

The MP asks whether the government will act on reports that the Pompe disease drug costs half as much in the US as in the Netherlands, and whether it will impose a price measure instead of delisting the drug. The minister says the US product is approved only for the classic form, that per-dose prices are comparable, and that she will negotiate prices with the manufacturer in pilots and report back.
I will therefore shortly sit down with the producers of these orphan drugs to negotiate the price in relation to the demonstrated therapeutic added value.
Ik ga dan ook op korte termijn met de producenten van deze weesgeneesmiddelen om de tafel zitten om te onderhandelen over de prijs in relatie tot de gebleken therapeutische meerwaarde.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de onbetrouwbaarheid van de Hospital Standardized Mortality Ratio (HSMR) als indicator van kwaliteit van zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the reliability of the Hospital Standardized Mortality Ratio as a quality indicator, citing a critical study, perverse incentives and the risk of patient refusal. The minister maintained that HSMR publication serves as a signal and incentive for quality improvement, acknowledged its limits for one-to-one comparison, and placed responsibility for publication, data quality and sanctions largely on hospitals, insurers and other parties.
However, publication is not my responsibility but that of the Dutch hospitals themselves.
Publicatie is echter niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid, maar die van de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over privé-afkickklinieken die verslaafden misleiden

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about private rehab clinics abroad that allegedly mislead addicts and charge insurers and patients very high bills, and how oversight, licensing and executive pay might be addressed. The minister answered that the reports seem to concern one clinic in South Africa, that the IGZ cannot supervise foreign clinics, that the NZa is monitoring and a legal dispute is ongoing, and that no licensing requirement is planned.
I have no insight into the amounts being claimed from health insurers in this matter and therefore do not know whether they can be described as exorbitant.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedragen die bij zorgverzekeraars in deze worden gedeclareerd en weet dus ook niet of deze als exorbitant kunnen worden bestempeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten aan over medicatiebeoordeling bij ouderen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about the new pricing and contracting of medication reviews for elderly patients, including the KBO and KNMP findings that few insurers contract them, and the removal of heartburn drugs from the basic package. The minister answered that the new system only started on 1 January 2012 and is too recent to draw conclusions, that patients bear responsibility for buying such drugs, and that the NZa quick scan and Zichtbare Zorg reports will follow.
The new tariff system and the new service descriptions, preceded by years of preparation and extensively discussed with the House of Representatives, were only introduced on 1 January 2012.

Het nieuwe tariefsysteem en de nieuwe prestatiebeschrijvingen, waaraan jarenlange voorbereiding vooraf is gegaan en waarover met de Tweede Kamer uitgebreid is gewisseld, is pas sinds 1 januari 2012 ingevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over een CAK-vordering van bijna 20.000 euro voor een burger

MP Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary of Health about a CAK claim of nearly 20,000 euro against a citizen whose parents' care indication changed without her being informed, and whether such situations are acceptable and how many similar cases exist. The state secretary regrets the situation, explains the claim arose from a two-year delay in reporting the indication change, notes the CAK partly waived the debt and offers payment arrangements, and promises a sanctions law for care partners from 1 January 2013.

Because the CAK depends on data from chain partners to correctly set the personal contribution, sanction possibilities were created in the CAK's establishing law to address chain partners when data delivery is structurally deficient.

Omdat het CAK voor de juiste vaststelling van de eigen bijdrage afhankelijk is van gegevens van ketenpartners zijn in de instellingswet van het CAK als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan ( Stb. 2011, 561 ) sanctiemogelijkheden gecreëerd om ketenpartijen aan te kunnen spreken
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over vrijgevestigde psychotherapeuten en zorgverzekeraar CZ

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about insurer CZ capping treatment revenue (omzetplafonds) for independent psychotherapists, restricting patient access and freedom of choice. The minister answered that such caps fall within agreed insurer procurement policy, that no contract breach occurs since caps change only with provider consent, and that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care, while the way insurers communicate is outside her responsibility.
Insurers are free to agree revenue caps with budgeted institutions, non-budgeted institutions and independent providers alike, as long as the insurer can meet its duty of care.

Het staat zorgverzekeraars vrij om omzetplafonds af te spreken met zowel gebudgetteerde instellingen als met niet gebudgetteerde instellingen als met vrijgevestigde zorgaanbieders, zolang de zorgverzekeraar aan zijn zorgplicht kan voldoen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over algemeen verbindendverklaring van de cao voor de verpleeg- en verzorgingshuizen en thuiszorgsector (VVT)

MPs Leijten and Voortman asked why the minister rejected a motion against declaring the VVT care sector collective agreement generally binding, and whether low sector-wide support and workload concerns are in the public interest. The state secretary answered that procedural and policy rules do not allow the government to weigh in, that representativeness will be assessed by the Minister of SZW, and that top-salary issues are addressed through the WNT bill.
I justified advising against the motion on the ground that the procedural and policy rules on declaring agreements generally binding do not allow me to play a role in it.
Ik heb het ontraden van de motie gemotiveerd met het argument dat de procedure- en beleidsregels rond het algemeen verbindend verklaren het niet toelaten dat ik daar een rol in speel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de financiële problemen van het ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the financial trouble at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital in Spijkenisse, including links to hospital discount penalties, insurer debts, insurer influence on hospital boards, and bank ties. The minister replied that continuity of care is the responsibility of insurers and providers, that insurers must guarantee emergency care within 45 minutes, and that the government will not support a hospital heading for bankruptcy.
I am not aware of which insurers the RPZ has debts with.
Het is mij niet bekend bij welke verzekeraars het RPZ schulden heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over zorgverzekeraars die neuzen in medische gegevens

An SP MP asked the health minister whether health insurers inspected psychiatric patients' treatment plans and interview notes and whether they had called patients, and asked about the legal limits and oversight of such checks. The minister replied that dossier inspection is allowed only as a last resort under the Health Insurance Act and the code of conduct, that the checks at CZ were proportionate and carried out under a medical adviser, and that the NZa and CBP supervise compliance.
Inspection of medical records can therefore only take place as a last resort, if its proportionality can be justified.
Inzage in medische dossiers kan dus uitsluitend plaatsvinden als uiterste middel, indien de proportionaliteit daarvan kan worden gemotiveerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over de sluiting van Klaver 6

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the planned closure of Klaver 6, a small-scale unit for six severely disabled children run by Philadelphia, and whether care quality and staff stability would be protected. The state secretary answered that care will be reorganised into a different location in small clusters rather than cut, that the inspectorate monitors quality, and that the decision lies with the provider.
I ask the IGZ to be extra alert given the emotions at this time.
Ik vraag de IGZ om extra alert te zijn gezien de emoties op dit moment.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de plannen van een nieuw toetredende zorgverzekeraar

MP Leijten asks the health minister about the planned new health insurer ANNO12, including licensing status, initiators' backgrounds, the EUR 850 entry payment, risk equalisation, rewards for health behaviour and organ donation, and protection for chronically ill people. The minister answers that no licence application has been filed, that the entry payment is voluntary and not contrary to the acceptance duty, and that NZa and SKGZ oversight remain available to complainants.
The initiators wish to remain anonymous at this stage.
De initiatiefnemers wensen in deze fase anoniem te blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat opnieuw fraude is aangetoond bij SPV

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports of renewed fraud at care agency SPV, including psychiatrists allegedly selling diagnoses, unclear oversight by the CIZ, and whether contracts were terminated. The state secretary declined to comment on ongoing criminal investigations, said the IGZ would not pursue disciplinary action solely on suspicion of crime, noted Menzis terminated its SPV contract and recovered 1.3 million euro, and promised to consider further investigation and talks with the profession.
I cannot make any statements about possible and ongoing criminal investigations.
Over mogelijke en lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat opnieuw fraude is aangetoond in de zorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about press reports of renewed care-fraud cases, the CIZ's role in assessing eligibility, and whether face-to-face assessment pilots and other measures are adequate. The state secretary said a criminal investigation prevents disclosure of details, that assessment procedures have been simplified with spot checks and monitoring, that a face-to-face pilot starts after summer, and that seized assets go to the state unless the court rules otherwise.
Since there is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide any information on this.
Aangezien er sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over psychische klachten

An MP asked the health minister about a CVZ advice that therapy for psychological complaints should be paid privately, and whether insurers and diagnosis coding are being abused. The minister said the advice clarifies insured GGZ care under stepped care, that providers must triage properly, that the NZa and insurers police improper billing, and that diagnosis codes on claims are legally required with exceptions.
Therefore I will discuss my expectations with the parties involved regarding supervision of correct billing for insured entitlements in mental health care.
Daarom zal ik met betrokken partijen mijn verwachtingen bespreken wat betreft het toezicht op het juist declareren inzake verzekerde aanspraken in de GGZ.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het declareren van psychische zorg door niet-geregistreerde hulpverleners

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about mental health care billed for services by unregistered practitioners through Europsyche, including the failure of insurers to check claims, and whether DBC financing and 'verlengde arm' constructions should be abolished. The minister said NZa and IGZ investigations are ongoing, insurers bear responsibility for checking claims, she has doubts about the verlengde arm constructie and has asked CVZ for advice, but rejected abolishing DBC financing and declined to confirm criminal investigations.

Following earlier reports about Europsyche, I asked the NZa and IGZ to investigate further the extent to which Europsyche and comparable care providers comply with all legal frameworks and to inform me about it.

Naar aanleiding van eerdere berichtgeving over Europsyche heb ik de NZa en IGZ gevraagd nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de mate waarin Europsyche en andere vergelijkbare zorgaanbieders in hun functioneren voldoen aan alle wettelijke kaders en mij daarover te informeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de handelwijze van zorgverzekeraar Achmea om het aanleveren van patiëntengegevens door fysiotherapeuten aan derden te verplichten

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether insurer Achmea's requirement that physiotherapists supply patient data to commercial firms for CQ-index measurement, under threat of tariff cuts, breaches medical confidentiality and privacy. The minister replied that contracting is a private matter, that the CQ-measure collects patient experiences with patient consent rather than medical data, and that the CBP handles such notifications without substantive review.
Insurers are private-law bodies. Contracting and any conditions an insurer or care provider wishes to include in those contracts are for the parties themselves.
Verzekeraars zijn privaatrechtelijke instanties. Contractering en eventuele voorwaarden die een verzekeraar of zorgaanbieder in die contracten wil opnemen zijn aan de partijen zelf.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat in de zorg miljoenen aan juridische adviezen worden betaald

An SP MP asked the health minister for a reaction to reports that hospitals, GPs and home-care providers spend millions on legal advice about competition law, and whether this frustrates cooperation and marketisation goals. The minister replied that care providers must follow competition rules enforced by the NMa, defended the patient-centred market model, and declined to collect data on advisory spending, deeming it unnecessary.
Care institutions are not public organisations, so they can themselves choose how they spend their financial resources.
Zorginstellingen zijn geen publieke organisaties, zodat zij zelf de keuze kunnen maken waaraan zij hun financiële middelen besteden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars belang hebben bij het in de schulden laten zitten van verzekerden

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether health insurers profit from insured persons with premium arrears, whether the debt-collection regime is fair, and whether insurers are sufficiently punished for negligence. Minister Schippers answered that the compensation is conditional and not profit, that the regime works and includes protections, that insurers should strengthen prevention with municipalities, and that NZa oversight of insurers will be tightened.
As a result of the recommendation in the evaluation report, I have since held talks with the NZa about tightening supervision of compliance with the debt-collection protocol.
Ik heb inmiddels, als uitvloeisel van de aanbeveling uit het evaluatierapport, gesprekken gevoerd met de NZa over een verscherping van het toezicht op de naleving van het incassoprotocol.
Antwoord vragen  Leijten en Van Gerven over extra zorgkosten, veroorzaakt door aanbieders van zorg die niet voldoet aan de stand van wetenschap en praktijk

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about unscientific medical checks such as full body scans and preventive vascular scans, their cost to health care, and whether the Wet op het Bevolkingsonderzoek should block them. The minister answered that such scans are not allowed in the Netherlands without a licence, that she will ask the Gezondheidsraad for advice on allowing them at patients' own request and expense, and that she will commission research on added costs while stressing self-determination and quality standards.
At the consultation on the national health policy note on 5 March I promised to have this investigated.
Ik heb tijdens het notaoverleg over de Landelijke nota gezondheidsbeleid «Gezondheid dichtbij» op 5 maart toegezegd om dit te laten uitzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over fraude met implantaten door tandartsen

Two SP MPs asked the minister of Health whether dentists profited from undisclosed implant discounts and whether the NZa and industry codes were adequate. The minister said no economic offence was clearly established, the NZa sees no reason for a new investigation, rejected a new study into beneficiaries, and relies on self-regulation through the Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen while promising to press professional bodies to sign it.
It is for the NZa to assess whether the applicable rules are being complied with.
Het is aan de NZa om te beoordelen of de geldende regels worden nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de zorgen van jonge huisartsen over de toekomst van het vak

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how she responds to young GPs' concerns that her policy (NZa advice, abolishing name-based registration, productivity incentives) undermines general practice and gatekeeping. The minister rejects the criticism, says she will receive the young GPs' representatives, denies abolishing registration, and maintains her policy strengthens the first line.
For this reason, a representative of the young GPs action group will also be received at the ministry to discuss their ideas.
Mede om die reden zal een vertegenwoordiging van de actiegroep Jonge Huisartsen ook worden ontvangen op het ministerie om in gesprek te gaan over hun ideeën.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over een nieuwe gerechtelijke uitspraak tegen de verplichting voor psychiaters om diagnose-informatie op declaraties te vermelden

MP Leijten asked the health minister how the NZa could ignore a repeated CBb ruling that diagnosis codes on psychiatric invoices must not be mandatory, and whether this infringes patient privacy. The minister regretted the NZa's failure, said the NZa must take a new decision, and maintained that exceptions for self-paying patients and those who request them suffice.
I expect the NZa to take a new decision in a responsible manner following this new ruling.
Ik ga ervan uit dat de NZa op verantwoorde wijze een nieuw besluit neemt naar aanleiding van deze nieuwe uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over inadequate zorg na de sluiting van de afdeling immunologie van het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AzM)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether patients were receiving adequate care after the Maastricht AzM closed its immunology department, and whether the AzM had kept its promise on follow-up care for a specific case. The minister declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, reported that the inspectorate found new patients were being taken over by Utrecht and Nijmegen but that about 250 top-referent patients still awaited transfer, and said the inspectorate continues to monitor the process.
First, for reasons of patient privacy I cannot and will not go into the specific case in substance.
Vooropgesteld kan en wil ik vanwege de privacy van de patiënt niet inhoudelijk op een specifieke casus ingaan.

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about online speech therapy (telelogopedie) by TinyEye, its claimed effectiveness, funding links between the UMCG's Triade Groep and the company, and whether the Spraakfonds, a charity chaired by TinyEye's director, supports the firm. The minister answered that telelogopedie is a welcome supplement if preceded by face-to-face intake, that no evidence shows worse results, that speech therapy is fully insured and funding questions fall outside her responsibility or are for donors to check.
Any investments made by the Triade Groep fall outside my area of responsibility.
Eventuele investeringen die zijn gedaan vanuit de Triade Groep vallen buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheidsdomein.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de contractering van zorg in 2012

Leijten (SP) asks whether patients should be protected from being left with hospital bills due to contracting disputes between hospitals and insurers in 2012, and whether insurers rather than hospitals should inform insured persons about which hospitals they are contracted with. Minister Schippers answers that insurers and hospitals must inform patients, that full reimbursement applies to ongoing treatment, and that parties will work out how to settle the contracting problems.
This means that health insurers must, given their duty of care, properly inform their insured persons about the consequences for reimbursement of costs.
Dit betekent dat zorgverzekeraars hun verzekerden, gelet op hun zorgplicht, goed moeten informeren over de gevolgen daarvan voor de vergoeding van kosten.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de contributiestijging bij patiëntenorganisaties als gevolg van de eisen van het Fonds PGO (Patiënten-, Gehandicapten- en Ouderenorganisaties)

MP Leijten (SP) asked whether the Fonds PGO requires patient organisations to charge at least 25 euro membership fees to qualify for subsidy, and whether this forces fee increases and member losses. Minister Schippers confirmed the rule from the 2011 policy framework (applying from 2014), said some organisations may need to raise fees, but refused to drop the requirement, arguing it reflects legitimacy and that smaller groups can receive practical support instead.
I do not consider it desirable and do not intend to drop the membership fee requirement.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk en ben niet van plan om de contributie-eis te laten vervallen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat zes op de tien medewerkers niet denkt hun pensioen te halen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that most care workers doubt they can keep working until retirement, and about workload, sick leave, job security in mental health care, and bureaucracy. The government answered that it supports individual arrangements, points to existing measures and a deregulation experiment running to 2014, and says it is an outsider to collective bargaining.
In collective bargaining negotiations the cabinet is simply an outsider.
In CAO-onderhandelingen is het kabinet gewoon een buitenstaander.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van orthopedische schoenen voor jonggehandicapten die deelnemen aan dagbesteding

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked whether disabled young people in day care can obtain orthopaedic work shoes, since the health insurance covers only everyday orthopaedic shoes and they may be forced to quit day care. The state secretary answered that forcing people to quit for lack of shoe reimbursement is undesirable, and that shoes needed for day-care activities are covered by the Zorgverzekeringswet if day care is indicated under the AWBZ, taking account of use in day care.
I do not consider it desirable that people are forced to give up their day care because they do not receive reimbursement for orthopaedic shoes.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk dat mensen genoodzaakt zijn hun dagbesteding op te zeggen, omdat ze geen vergoeding krijgen voor orthopedische schoenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de vervanging van de Inspecteur-generaal voor de Gezondheidszorg

The SP MP Leijten asked why an interim head was chosen for the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) while no new Inspector-General had been found, why that person was chosen without a medical background, and what his remuneration and daily costs were. The minister answered that Mr Weck was asked to act as interim Inspector-General given the weight of the tasks, that his remuneration falls under the Wet normering topinkomens, and that the IGZ's reorganisation will continue under his leadership.
Given the weight of the task packages involved with the Inspector-General, I chose to ask Mr Weck to take on the role of acting Inspector-General.
Gelet op de zwaarte van de betrokken takenpakketten van de Inspecteur-generaal heb ik ervoor gekozen om de heer Weck te vragen om de taak van waarnemend Inspecteur-generaal op zich te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een technische briefing over het scheiden van wonen en zorg in de AWBZ

Leijten (SP) asked whether a technical briefing on separating housing and care in the AWBZ was held only for coalition and gedoogpartner parties, why opposition parties were excluded, and whether the briefing would be shared with the Chamber. Minister Schippers answered that briefings are requested by the Chamber itself, that the 7 March briefing was at the request of coalition and gedoogpartner parties, and that the information will be sent to the Chamber, with a list of other briefings given this year and none yet planned.
Of course I am willing to send you this information that was provided on 7 March.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid u deze informatie die op 7 maart is verstrekt hierbij te doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars 58 miljoen euro aan reclame hebben besteed

An SP MP asked the health minister whether insurers spending 58 million euro on advertising, rising premiums, internet policies favouring younger insured people, and insurers' 7 billion euro reserves are acceptable. The minister replied that advertising spending and market strategy are insurers' own responsibility, that the Don committee is examining risk-equalisation incentives, and that reserves exceed the required solvency level.
The amount of money health insurers spend on advertising falls outside my responsibility.
De hoeveelheid geld die zorgverzekeraars uitgeven aan reclame valt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het betalen van 188.000 euro van VU medisch centrum (VUmc) aan miljonair R.O. van Eyeworks

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister why VUmc agreed to pay 188,000 euro toward production costs of a TV programme with Eyeworks after a medical confidentiality breach, and whether it should be recovered from VUmc decision-makers. The minister regretted the situation, said the costs come from general reserves rather than care funds, and stated the ministry cannot intervene in private contracts while the OM investigation continues, leaving liability to the parties or a judge.
While the OM investigation, which will also cover the agreements between VUmc and Eyeworks, is ongoing, no further statements can be made about the exact content of those agreements.
Lopende het onderzoek van het OM, dat ook betrekking zal hebben op de gemaakte afspraken tussen VUmc en Eyeworks, kunnen verder geen uitspraken gedaan worden over de exacte inhoud van die afspraken.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over Veiligheid van en controle op geneesmiddelen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the growing production of medicines in low-wage countries, contaminated Ranbaxy omeprazole, inspection limits, and transparency of quality controls. The minister answered that inspections, GMP certification, batch testing and publicly available reports ensure quality, while acknowledging rising risks and that labour conditions fall outside her responsibility.
I cannot comment on the oversight of social and working conditions on site, as this is not under my responsibility.
Over het toezicht op de sociale en arbeidsomstandigheden ter plaatse kan ik geen uitspraak doen, aangezien dit niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid valt.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat fysiotherapie te duur is voor mensen met reuma

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about a Reumafonds survey showing physiotherapy costs are unaffordable for rheumatism patients, and about CVZ's basis for excluding certain physiotherapy from basic coverage. The minister replies that only short-term effective physiotherapy is covered, that patients can take out supplementary insurance without medical selection in most cases, that CVZ's advice rests on evidence-based medicine, and that no extra costs are tracked.
CVZ's position on the effectiveness of physiotherapy and exercise therapy for rheumatism is not based on the judgment of a number of rheumatologists.
Het standpunt van het CVZ over de effectiviteit van fysio- en oefentherapie bij reuma is niet gebaseerd op het oordeel van een aantal reumatologen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de notoire zaken bij de IGZ

MP Leijten asked whether the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) had 215 cases over one year old in early 2011 and 57 in 2012, and why the Chamber was not informed, plus whether the backlog reflects a structural problem and whether media-prominent cases get priority. Minister Schippers answered that the backlog of cases over one year fell from about 1,000 to about 320, that the 25 high-impact cases were cleared, that a one-year norm was adopted with a commission to test feasibility, and that the figures cited concern only hospitals and specialists while the general table covers all providers.
I have also reported that to your Chamber.
Ik heb uw Kamer dat ook gemeld.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over dat de helft van de artsen en verpleegkundigen niet in de ouderenzorg willen werken

Parliamentary questions from MP Leijten (SP) ask how the government views reports that many doctors and nurses are unwilling to work in elderly care, and whether this lack of knowledge, skill and motivation harms care quality. The state secretary replies that the concern is recognised, that elderly care is not in fact unpopular among nursing students, and that education, internships and working conditions are being addressed through existing initiatives rather than new research.
I will, however, consult with the HBO Council, Actiz and V&VN on nursing education and elderly care, including dementia competencies.
Wel zal ik in overleg treden met de HBO-raad, Actiz en V&VN over de opleiding verpleegkunde en de ouderenzorg inclusief de «dementie»-competenties.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de informatievoorziening aan de Tweede Kamer in het kader van de plannen voor Olympische Spelen in 2028

An MP asks the health minister who received an internal cabinet note on exploratory studies for the 2028 Olympics, whether she knew of civil servants' preference to omit investment costs and cost-benefit balance from the letter, why a €8 billion Finance figure was not in the VMKB, and whether she will respond to and send the second opinion on the VMKB to parliament. The minister answers that the draft was circulated within the sport policy directorate, refers all substantive questions to her letter of 23 March 2012 and says the second opinion was published on planning bureau websites, not sent to parliament.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het plaatsen van tv-camera’s in het VU medisch centrum

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether filming hidden TV cameras at VUmc without patients' knowledge breached medical confidentiality and privacy, and about consent, deleted footage, hospital accountability and commercial ownership. Minister Schippers answered that privacy and confidentiality are distinct, that the CBP is investigating, that the posters approach is inadequate, and that hospital staff should be restrained in media cooperation, but she largely referred back to earlier answers and found no basis to link profit-making to such incidents.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is currently investigating whether privacy has been violated in this case.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) onderzoekt momenteel in deze zaak of de privacy is geschonden.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de stand van zaken binnen Charim thuiszorg

MP Leijten (SP) asks the State Secretary of Health about Charim thuiszorg: the balance between private responsibility and IGZ oversight, medication safety, alleged abuse, follow-up inspections, the independent investigation, fire safety and the chair of the supervisory board. The State Secretary answers at length, saying providers are primarily responsible, the IGZ can issue directions if improvement lags, follow-up inspections are planned, and labour conditions fall under other bodies.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over aanpak van fraude met persoonsgebonden budgetten

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary and Justice minister about court cases on fraud with personal budgets (pgb) not leading to convictions, the SIOD report on pgb fraud-sensitivity, and enforcement priorities. The government rejects the claim that pgb fraud goes unpunished, cites new measures and ongoing investigations, and promises a central fraud-reporting point and a cooperation agreement.

The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that most of the cases mentioned in a Volkskrant article of 27 January 2012 are still under investigation, and that the conclusion that prosecution is lacking is premature.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij medegedeeld dat het merendeel van de zaken dat wordt genoemd in een artikel in de Volkskrant van 27 januari 2012 nog in onderzoek is, en dat de conclusie dat vervolging uitblijft, voorbarig is.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat door het schrappen van dieetadvisering uit het basispakket, (dreigende) ondervoeding onbehandeld blijft

MP Leijten asked the minister whether removing dietary advice from the basic health insurance package leaves malnutrition untreated, citing over 100 reports and halved home visits, and asked about the total annual cost of malnutrition. Minister Schippers answered that the signal is serious but not directly attributable to the removal, that she does not intend to restore dietary advice to the package given the need for cuts, and that the total cost cannot be calculated due to lack of criteria.
However, I do not share the assumption that the (threatened) increase in malnutrition is a direct consequence of the removal of dietary advice from the basic package of the Health Insurance Act.
Ik deel echter niet de aanname dat de (dreigende) toename van ondervoeding direct het gevolg is van het schrappen van dieetadvisering uit het basispakket van de Zorgverzekeringswet.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over banenverlies en bezuinigingen bij de GGZ Drenthe

An SP MP asked the health minister about job losses, bed reductions and the EUR 8.5 million cut at GGZ Drenthe, and whether care gaps and drop-outs from the eigen bijdrage would be prevented. The minister regretted the job losses, said no sluiting of sites or forced dismissals were planned, and relied on GGZ Drenthe's assurances and her own monitoring of the eigen bijdrage, while declining to give a national overview of lost intramural places.
I cannot give an overview of the disappearance of intramural places, because implementing the cuts is the responsibility of the GGZ institutions themselves.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven van het verdwijnen van het aantal intramurale plekken, omdat het invullen de bezuinigingen de verantwoordelijkheid van de GGZ-instellingen zelf is.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het beleid ten aanzien van obesitas

An SP MP asked the health minister about obesity policy, premium differentiation by insurers based on overweight, the removal of dietetic care from the basic insurance package, and the framing of obesity as a lifestyle choice. The minister defended a prevention-focused approach, said insurers are free to differentiate premiums only outside the basic health insurance, and argued that dietetic advice can be borne by patients themselves.
The example that appeared in the media concerns an insurance premium for a death-risk insurance policy.
Het voorbeeld dat in de media verschenen is, betreft een verzekeringspremie van een overlijdensrisicoverzekering.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van orthopedische schoenen voor jonggehandicapten die deelnemen aan dagbesteding

SP MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked whether disabled young people in day care who work without wages should receive orthopaedic shoes, and whether UWV should provide them only with an employment contract. The government answers that day-care providers are responsible for enabling participation, that UWV support applies only to paid employment, and it does not wish to widen UWV's role.
Based on UWV's task of guiding people to the labour market, we do not consider it desirable to amend the law to make UWV responsible for such provisions in other situations as well.

Uitgaande van de taak van het UWV – toeleiding naar de arbeidsmarkt – vinden we het niet wenselijk de wet te wijzigen om UWV ook in andere situaties voor dit soort verstrekkingen verantwoordelijk te maken.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de brandonveiligheid in zorginstellingen (ingezonden 30 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport why fire safety in care institutions remains inadequate despite earlier measures, what has been done, whether sanctions will be imposed on administrators, and how municipalities will be urged to inspect more intensively. The state secretary points to a 2007 exploratory study and the Actieprogramma Brandveiligheid, refers to the 2012 cabinet letter on enforcement, and assigns municipal inspection to the Minister of Interior, while stating that sanctions follow existing sectoral rules.
For holding municipalities to account, the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) is primarily responsible.
Voor het aanspreken van gemeenten is de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) als eerste verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van het middel Caphosol en speekselsubstituten/mondspoelmiddelen aan onder andere kinderen met kanker

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the minister refuses to reimburse Caphosol and similar saliva substitutes for children and others with cancer-treatment mouth sores, and whether OHRA's exceptional reimbursement shows the drug should be covered. The minister answered that these products are not on the reimbursement list, are classed as self-care products not medically necessary, and that the CZ group's coulance policy would not generally cover them.
Caphosol, like all other saliva substitutes/mouthwashes (except Salvia Orthana), is not a registered medicine but an aid.
Caphosol is net als alle andere speekselsubstituten/mondspoelingen (behalve Salvia Orthana) geen geregistreerd geneesmiddel, maar een hulpmiddel.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Leijten over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op de GGZ voor de politie

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked whether cuts to mental health care (GGZ) and the introduction of patient contributions would increase police workload and crime, and whether such effects will be monitored and registered. The ministers answer that a monitor will track whether patient charges deter care use, that the police and GGZ have agreed new cooperation arrangements, and that registration of GGZ-related nuisance is only partly in place and will be developed regionally.
Whether the introduction of the patient contribution actually leads to avoidance of care will be closely monitored by the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport via a monitor this year.
Of de invoering van de eigen bijdrage daadwerkelijk leidt tot zorgmijding volgt de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport dit jaar nauwlettend via een monitor.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen voor uitwendige elektrostimulatie ter behandeling van chronische pijn

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether chronic pain should be treated as a serious condition rather than low disease burden, and whether TENS and similar electrostimulation should remain reimbursed despite a planned CVZ advice to drop them. The minister said the CVZ advice was still a confidential draft, that a position would follow with the annual package advice, and that reimbursement requires proven value rather than a physician's judgement.
I assume that the advice will be incorporated into the 2012 package advice.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het advies meeloopt in het pakketadvies 2012.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de sluiting van de GGNet- (poli)kliniek in Zevenaar en Winterswijk en groei aantal patiënten geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

An SP MP asks the health minister about the closure of GGNet clinics and outpatient clinics in Zevenaar and Winterswijk, the 7.2 million euro cut, job losses, longer travel for patients, and how the mental health cuts fit with rising client numbers. The minister answers that the board of GGNet is responsible for these choices, describes alternative care arrangements, and defends the policy of reducing inpatient capacity and introducing a co-payment in specialist mental health care.
However, the board of the institution is responsible for the choices it makes in this.
Het bestuur van de instelling is echter verantwoordelijk voor de keuzes die men hierin maakt.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verminderen van het aantal bedden in de GGZ en sluiting herstellingsoord (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about planned bed reductions at GGZ mental health institutions Mondriaan and Pro Persona, the closure of Pro Persona's recovery home, and whether insurers are driving these cuts. Minister Schippers answers that deinstitutionalisation is policy, that the institutions bear responsibility for bed decisions, and that insurers may decide what care they purchase, while offering no information on waiting lists or on the reasoning behind the cuts.
The institution's board is responsible for the decisions it takes on reducing beds, including where these concern crisis beds.
Het bestuur van de instelling is verantwoordelijk voor de besluiten die zij neemt met betrekking tot het reduceren van bedden, ook als dat crisisbedden betreft.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het moeilijk kunnen krijgen van een hypotheek of verzekering na kanker

SP MPs asked the health minister about cancer survivors facing higher premiums or refusal for life insurance and mortgages, and whether this breaches equal treatment. The minister acknowledged the social-economic problems, rejected the claim of exploitation or a constitutional breach, and committed only to general attention and existing contact between insurers and patient groups.
For life insurance there is no statutory duty to accept applicants, as there is for the basic health insurance package.
Voor levensverzekeringen geldt geen wettelijke acceptatieplicht, zoals die voor het basispakket van de zorgverzekering wel geldt.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stopzetten van de plannen Parkwijk de Zandheuvel op terreinen gehandicapteninstellingen Sherpa en de Amerpoort in Baa

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about the halted Parkwijk de Zandheuvel plans on the Sherpa and Amerpoort disability institution grounds in Baarn, including costs, forced relocation, lack of resident consultation and inspectorate handling. The secretary answered that the plans are not being carried out, that AWBZ funds do not finance private housing, that consultation rights exist under the complaints act, and that the inspectorate's investigations continue.
This investigation is expected to be concluded in March.
Dit onderzoek zal naar verwachting in maart worden afgerond.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het niet vergoeden van de kosten die ouders moeten maken om hun zieke kind te laten behandelen in het buitenland

Two SP MPs asked the health minister why insurers cover an experimental treatment abroad for a sick child but not the parents' living costs, and whether the treatment would be available in the Netherlands. The minister replied that experimental treatment abroad is not insured care under the Zvw, that living costs of family are not covered, that insurers can seek a CVZ opinion, and that no registry of such cases exists.
There are no public registrations tracking how many children undergo treatment abroad for life-threatening reasons.
Er zijn geen publieke registraties die bijhouden hoeveel kinderen er om levensbedreigende redenen een behandeling in het buitenland ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de juridische houdbaarheid van de verplichting voor zorgverleners om mee te werken aan het Elektronisch Patiëntendossier (EPD)

An SP MP asked the minister whether the duty for healthcare providers to cooperate with the electronic patient record (EPD), and insurers enforcing data delivery through contracts, is legally tenable and compatible with medical confidentiality. The minister replied that no statutory obligation to connect to the national switchpoint currently exists, that data may only be shared with patient consent, and that insurers' contractual demands and professional standards remain subject to that consent requirement.
To be clear, there is currently no obligation to connect to the national switchpoint.
Voor alle helderheid, er is momenteel geen verplichting tot aansluiting op het landelijk schakelpunt.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over dat de controle op medicijngebruik van ouderen faalt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how to ensure medication checks for elderly patients on five or more drugs, including pharmacist review, insurer reimbursement and oversight of mail-order pharmacies and self-bought medicine. The minister agreed such checks are important, pointed to pending NZa market scans and existing guidelines, declined to disclose insurer contract details citing competition sensitivity, and promised no new oversight measures.
I note, however, that this partly concerns competitively sensitive information that I could not simply disclose even if I had it.
Ik merk wel op dat het hier deels om concurrentiegevoelige informatie gaat die ik niet zonder meer naar buiten zou kunnen brengen als ik er wel over beschikte.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het verdwijnen van bedden bij de GGZ Noord-Holland Noord

An SP MP asked the health minister about the reduction of psychiatric beds at GGZ Noord-Holland Noord, including Geestercogge in Schagen, and whether this was driven by financial motives. The minister welcomed the shift to home crisis treatment, said the institution remains responsible for care quality, and declined to monitor the new model closely or order extra inspection beyond routine supervision.
I see no reason to instruct the IGZ, beyond its usual supervision, to pay extra attention to this situation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de IGZ, anders dan het gebruikelijke toezicht, een opdracht te geven om extra aandacht te besteden aan deze situatie.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er niet naar de zorgen en signalen van familie van de patiën

SP MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether family and friends of schizophrenia patients have nowhere to turn with their concerns, and how often police, municipalities, housing corporations and care providers receive such signals. The minister answered that relatives can approach GPs, municipal complaint points and the IGZ, that no figures are registered for most bodies, and that a family-involvement policy and a pending mental-health bill are being developed.
It is not possible to quantify "signals or cries for help from family members" from police systems.
Het is niet mogelijk om «signalen c.q. noodkreten van familieleden» uit de politiesystemen te kwantificeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het noodgedwongen stopzetten van psychologische behandeling door weigering aanvullende zorgverzekering

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about Menzis imposing turnover caps on psychotherapists, forcing patients to switch insurers, and the cuts to psychotherapy care. The minister answered that insurers may set such caps within their purchasing and duty-of-care framework, that medical selection in supplementary insurance is the insurer's own matter, and that she sees no reason to intervene or reverse the cuts.
Yes, as far as I am aware the majority of health insurers apply turnover caps for non-budgeted curative mental health providers, including self-employed psychotherapists.
Ja, voor zover bij mij bekend hanteert het merendeel van de zorgverzekeraars omzetplafonds voor niet-gebudgetteerde curatieve GGZ-aanbieders, waaronder vrijgevestigde psychotherapeuten.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de problemen bij de intensive care van het VU Medisch Centrum (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about serious problems on the VU Medical Centre intensive care unit, including two possibly preventable deaths, a whistleblower sidelined, and a possible link to a merger. The minister answered that the Health Inspectorate is acting actively, the hospital board has a remediation plan under inspection, the whistleblower is not suspended but not operating, and the merger is not considered a cause.
Both reports are under investigation and being handled by the IGZ.
Beide meldingen zijn in onderzoek en behandeling door de IGZ.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen Emergis en de Parnassia Bavo Groep (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about the proposed merger of Emergis and Parnassia Bavo Groep, including its cost control, continuity-of-care risks, advisory input from regulators and staff councils, whether the requested moratorium motion and stricter merger rules will block it, and job losses. The minister answers that merger assessment is for the competition authority, that stricter merger rules are not yet in force so parties cannot be compelled, that no withholding of the regulator's view is claimed since the NZa was not yet consulted, and that the Parnassia job losses are not directly linked to the merger.
Until the bill has entered into force, parties cannot be forced to do so.
Totdat het wetsvoorstel in werking is getreden kunnen partijen daartoe niet worden gedwongen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de toekomst van de ziekenhuiszorg in (Noord-oost) Friesland.

MPs Van Gerven, Leijten and Jacobi asked the health minister about the restructuring of hospital De Sionsberg in north-east Friesland, including reliance on confidential KPMG Plexus reports, lifting of supervision by the inspectorate, the insurer's role and the 45-minute ambulance standard. The minister answered that the restructuring decision rests with the hospital board and the inspectorate, that the study's costs, financiers and publication are for the commissioning parties, and that extra ambulance capacity secures acute access.
Information on the costs and financiers of this study and the involvement of researchers is therefore not available to me.
Informatie over de kosten en financiers van dit onderzoek en de betrokkenheid van onderzoekers heb ik dan ook niet tot mijn beschikking.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat De Jutters logeerhuizen moet sluiten (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked why De Jutters must close its respite-care guesthouses for children in the Haaglanden region, whether families are left without alternatives, and how the government will prevent losses. The state secretary answered that the closures followed a financial analysis by the provider amid fewer short-stay indications, pointed to alternative respite forms, and said the government has no role in individual contract negotiations between the care office and providers.
I have no role in the negotiations between the care office and individual institutions.
Ik heb geen rol bij de onderhandelingen tussen het zorgkantoor en individuele instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het faillissement van Stichting Zonnehuizen (ingezonden 30 december 2011).

MP Leijten asked the state secretary whether Stichting Zonnehuizen stopped paying payroll tax, health insurance premiums and pension premiums for staff, what the staff face as a result, whether the interim director and curator are liable, and whether deliberate steering toward bankruptcy warrants investigation. The state secretary said the curator reported unpaid premiums, that the amounts and individual staff consequences are unknown to him, that staff can pursue rights themselves, that enforcement is for the relevant agencies rather than VWS, and that he does not endorse the suggestion of deliberate bankruptcy while noting bankruptcy was unavoidable.
The amounts involved are not known to me.
Om welke bedragen het gaat is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over medische selectie door zorgverzekeraars

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about medical selection by health insurers for supplementary insurance, including whether it breaches equal treatment under Article 1 of the Constitution. The minister answered that insurers must accept everyone for basic insurance, that medical selection is permitted for supplementary insurance under EU rules, and that most supplementary policies still apply no selection; she rejected claims of discrimination and of profit-driven harm.
The acceptance policy for a supplementary insurance falls within the insurer's own powers, of which I have no insight.
Het acceptatiebeleid van een aanvullende verzekering behoort namelijk tot de eigen bevoegdheden van de verzekeraar waar ik geen inzicht in heb.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van pakketbezuinigingen voor reumapatiënten

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how cuts to physiotherapy coverage affect rheumatism patients, whether mobility is essential for them, and whether the government's constitutional duty for public health is met. The minister replied that long-term physiotherapy for several chronic conditions is not proven effective, that short-term proven treatments remain available at patients' own cost or via supplementary insurance, and that the coverage criteria follow the Zorgverzekeringswet and the Grondwet's health duty.
The CVZ examined whether long-term physiotherapy for certain conditions meets the statutory standard of science and practice and the package principle of necessity.

Het CVZ heeft onderzoek gedaan naar de vraag of langdurige fysio- en oefentherapie voor bepaalde aandoeningen voldoet aan het wettelijk criterium stand van de wetenschap en praktijk en het pakketprincipe noodzakelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de overname van Zonnehuizen en het ontslag van medewerkers

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary of Health about the takeover of bankrupt Zonnehuizen, job losses, care continuity, the role of the ministry, the Inspectorate and the guaranteed loans, and the recovery of lost funds. The state secretary answered most questions by saying the ministry was not involved in the takeover, the Inspectorate placed the organisation under intensified supervision, and the curator and new owners decide on staff, while withholding details on the property deal and Triodos Bank's role.
My ministry, nor I myself, have been involved in this takeover.
Mijn ministerie, noch ikzelf, zijn betrokken geweest bij deze overname.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Zorg over de reserves die zorginstellingen opbouwen (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about healthcare institutions building up reserves while staff shortages are reported, and whether this diverts care funds. The state secretary says reserves are an expected result of integrated tariffs, sees no need for measures, and points to a covenant with monitoring to ensure extra funds for staff are used properly.
I will closely monitor the progress of the implementation of the covenant.
Ik zal de voortgang van de uitvoering van het convenant goed monitoren.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verzet van de bevolking tegen de bezuinigingen op het ziekenhuis de Sionsberg in Dokkum (ingezonden 14

SP MPs asked the health minister why the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum faces closure of several departments, whether financial motives play a role, and what the government will do to keep a full hospital in northeast Friesland. The minister answered that the IGZ found the hospital too small to meet minimum volume norms, that finances also played a role, that a 2012 availability payment will match 2011 subject to an adequate plan, and that the government takes no initiative to preserve a full hospital since other hospitals can serve the region.
The IGZ will keep closely monitoring the Sionsberg to see whether the plans are responsibly developed and implemented.
De IGZ blijft de Sionsberg intensief volgen om te zien of de plannen verantwoord worden uitgewerkt en geïmplementeerd.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorgverzekeraars die met cadeautjes en kortingen verzekerden proberen te lokken (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how she views insurers luring policyholders with gifts and discounts, whether this is desirable, and whether the government will check insurers' promotion spending and premium effects. The minister replies that insurers' marketing strategy is their own responsibility, that she sees no need to investigate spending or intervene, and that the NZa supervises insurer information provision under the Wmg.
The strategy of health insurers to attract more policyholders is a matter each insurer must determine for itself and lies outside my responsibility.
De strategie van zorgverzekeraars om meer verzekerden te krijgen, is een zaak die iedere zorgverzekeraar voor zich moet vaststellen en ligt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de benoeming van een lid van de Raad van Toezicht bij Osira-Amstelring (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary of health whether a former interim director and merger adviser of Osira-Amstelring had joined its supervisory board, and questioned the independence of the board under the governance code. The state secretary said she could not find evidence from public sources of the appointment, that appointing supervisors is not her role, and that the code's three-year cooling-off rule and comply-or-explain mechanism apply; she disputed that the vacancy suggested backroom appointments.
In general, it is not for me to form a judgement on the appointment of a member of the supervisory board.
In het algemeen geldt dat het niet aan mij is om mij een oordeel te vormen over de benoeming van een lid van de raad van toezicht.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Psychose schrikbarend vaak gemist in Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister why many psychosis patients are missed or misdiagnosed in mental health care, whether diagnosis and outcome monitoring are adequate, and how psychosis detection and reporting of undertreatment are ensured. The minister replies that professionals are responsible for diagnosis, sees no reason for further investigation, points to existing guidelines, inspection oversight and ROM initiatives, and notes that a reporting duty exists only for calamities.

There is a reporting duty for calamities in care, but it is not possible to reliably determine in how many cases a patient with a psychotic disorder suffered physical and/or mental harm due to undertreatment or incorrect treatment.
Er is een meldplicht voor calamiteiten in de zorg, maar het is het niet mogelijk op een betrouwbare wijze te achterhalen in hoeveel gevallen sprake was van een patiënt met een psychotische stoornis

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen onvoldoende betrouwbaar zijn (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether hospital mortality figures (HSMR) give a distorted picture, whether insurers may unfairly blacklist hospitals, and whether government should take responsibility for hospital planning instead of insurers. The minister said the technical findings are accepted but HSMR publication is not blocked, insurers are expected to communicate carefully, government will not return to central planning, and the Swedish model is instructive but not directly transferable.
I am convinced that health insurers will not terminate contracts with hospitals solely on the basis of the corrected mortality figures.
Tegen die achtergrond ben ik ervan overtuigd dat zorgverzekeraars niet louter op basis van de gecorrigeerde sterftecijfers contracten met ziekenhuizen zullen beëindigen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de betrokkenheid van het CJIB en een deurwaarder bij het incasseren van de bestuursrechtelijke zor

An SP MP asked why health insurance premium arrears from March 2011 may be collected via the CJIB and a bailiff at escalating costs, instead of direct deduction by the CVZ, and whether the 30% surcharge should be lowered. The minister explains the collection sequence, reports case numbers and cost ceilings, and rejects lowering the surcharge while promising periodic income checks and use of the care allowance for payment.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de misstanden van zorgbureau SPV (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about misconduct at care agency SPV, including the termination of its contract by insurer Menzis, excessive director pay, sanctions, the inspectorate's knowledge, and prevention. The secretary answered that the insurer acted within its responsibilities, that most questions are premature or belong to supervisory boards, regulators, or the insurer, and that all clients were placed elsewhere.
Setting and supervising the individual salaries of executives is a task that lies with the supervisory boards.
Het vaststellen van en het toezicht houden op de individuele salariëring van bestuurders is een taak die ligt bij de raden van toezicht.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ontslaggolf en bezuinigingen in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary about job losses and cuts in mental health care (GGZ), including the planned introduction of co-payments and possible deterrence of patients. The minister answers that cuts are unavoidable, leaves job cuts to institutions, reports a reduced co-payment with exceptions and a monitor, and says alternatives will be explored for 2013.
I am setting up a monitor that will measure the effects of the co-payment on avoidance of care.
Ik zet een monitor uit die de effecten van eigen bijdrage op zorgmijding zal meten.
