Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gedwongen verhuizing van tientallen ouderen (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Health whether it is acceptable that dozens of elderly residents aged 80 and over are being forced to move from a care home to independent housing during a renovation, and whether this is linked to cutting care packages to raise the institution's income. The State Secretary answered that the institution assures no one is forced to move to independent housing, that residents keep their care entitlements, that the move is part of a large renovation and rehousing, and that no further measures or investigation are needed.
I do not consider it necessary to take additional measures, because there is no question of forced moves to independent housing.
Ik acht het niet nodig om extra maatregelen te nemen, omdat er geen sprake is van gedwongen verhuizingen naar zelfstandige woningen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de banden van de minister met de tabaksindustrie en falende rookpreventie (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about ties between her ministry and the tobacco industry, the value of official visits to tobacco firms, possible ministerial conflicts of interest, and whether tobacco-control policy is failing. The minister answered that contacts with industry are technical and occasional, that no ministerial-level meeting occurred, that civil servants' conflict-of-interest rules suffice, and that the disputed mortality estimate is unsubstantiated.
At ministerial level, no meeting with the tobacco industry has taken place since the cabinet took office.
Op ministerieel niveau heeft geen gesprek met de tabaksindustrie plaatsgevonden sinds het aantreden van het kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Patiënten terug op straat» (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister how she responds to reports that around a thousand psychiatric patients in Rotterdam will end up on the street due to the introduction of a personal contribution and budget cuts in mental health care, and how risks of care avoidance, coercion and nuisance are addressed. Minister Schippers rejects the claim that the measures will cause these effects, points to exemptions for outreach care, forced admissions and crisis treatment, and promises to monitor effects on care avoidance and report to the House.
The cabinet will monitor the effects of introducing a personal contribution on care avoidance.
Het kabinet zal de effecten van het invoeren van een eigen bijdrage op zorgmijding gaan monitoren.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het disfunctioneren van het bestuur van Charim (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Health about governance failures at care provider Charim, including alleged intimidation of staff, forced dismissals, reorganisation and fire-safety issues. The state secretary answered that the board, supervisory board and works council bear responsibility, that the Inspectorate has been monitoring Charim since August 2010, and that she will not intervene in individual personnel or management decisions.
It is not for me to form a judgement on the conduct of a specific board, supervisory board and works council, so not for Charim either.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vormen over het handelen van een specifieke raad van bestuur, raad van toezicht en OR, dus ook niet bij Charim.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zelfverrijking van toezichthouders van de Stichting Gehandicaptenzorg Limburg (ingezonden 27 okt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary for Health whether two supervisory board members of Stichting Gehandicaptenzorg Limburg who appointed themselves as temporary administrators and set their own high pay was acceptable, and what sanctions and reclaim measures would follow. The state secretary declined substantive judgement, citing an ongoing procedure before the Governance Commissie Gezondheidszorg, unclear facts, and that the pay norms of the forthcoming WNT would apply.
Given this procedural state of affairs, I therefore exercise restraint in this matter.
Gezien deze procedurele stand van zaken past mij in dezen dus terughoudendheid.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onterechte korting op de bijzondere bijstand van chroni

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why Amsterdam cut special assistance for chronically ill and disabled people after a court ruling, whether the state knew, and whether people will be compensated and municipalities obliged to grant categorical assistance. The state secretary replied that special assistance is decentralised to municipalities, that he does not comment on individual cases, will not compensate affected people, and will not oblige municipalities to grant categorical assistance.
In this context it is up to the independent judge to assess the decisions the municipality of Amsterdam made in individual cases.
In dit kader is het aan de onafhankelijke rechter om een oordeel te geven over de besluiten die de gemeente Amsterdam in individuele gevallen heeft genomen

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over financiële malaise in de AWBZ-zorg door afwaardering van vastgoed (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked how much profit the 50 largest AWBZ care providers made last year and where that money came from. The state secretary answered that the top 50 reported a positive result of €190.49 million, 1.57% of total income, and broke down their revenue sources, mostly statutory budgets.
The 50 largest AWBZ care-providing institutions (not exclusively AWBZ care) achieved a positive result of €190.49 million.
De 50 grootste AWBZ-zorg leverende instellingen (niet uitsluitend AWBZ zorg) hebben een positief resultaat gehaald van € 190,49 mln.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over belemmering door zorgverzekeraars van de toegang tot logopedie (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

MP Leijten asks the minister whether insurers making logopedie screenings conditional on expected demand amounts to risk selection and abuse of market power, and what the minister will do about it. The minister says direct access to logopedie is intended, insurers may still impose procedural conditions, the Zvw rules out rationing by expected demand, and abuse of market power is for the NZa to assess.
Should it nevertheless occur that an insurer denies an insured person care on improper grounds, it is not for me to intervene.
Mocht het toch voorkomen dat een zorgverzekeraar een verzekerde op oneigenlijke gronden (vergoeding van) zorg ontzegt dan is het niet aan mij om in te grijpen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financien en aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over introductie van tweedeling in de ouderenzorg d

MP Leijten asks whether the Menzis/AEGON care-savings product, which lets people save for extra care in old age, creates an undesirable two-tier system in elderly care and undermines the solidarity of the AWBZ. The minister replies that marketing is the insurers' own responsibility, that the AWBZ remains equal for all regardless of means, and that the savings product does not change collective arrangements, while answering the factual questions on deposit guarantees and the risks of the product.
The market positioning strategy is the insurer's own responsibility.
De marktpositioneringsstrategie behoort tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de verzekeraar.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over GGZ-instellingen die de familie van een patiënt buitenspel zetten (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary about mental health institutions that exclude patients' families, citing an enquiry showing inadequate family policy and unequal information access. The minister acknowledges the problem, supports family involvement, notes a legal right to information for some relatives, and announces a planned obligation in care plans regarding family involvement.
I am considering including in the Compulsory Mental Healthcare Act a requirement to record agreements on possible family involvement in care plans.

Verder overweeg ik om in het kader van de aanbieding van de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag en de nota van wijziging van de Wet verplichte GGZ een verplichting op te nemen om in zorgplannen afspraken vast te leggen over eventuele familiebetrokkenheid.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de thuiszorg goedkoper kan (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister why the government was not reversing product-based financing in home care, which requires per-task billing and creates fragmented functions, and whether the wijkverpleegkundige model is valued for cost or for humane care. The state secretary answered that she is not abolishing product differentiation, pointed to deregulation experiments and a planned shift to results-based financing in long-term care, and said the district nurse model is valued for better coordination.
I do not intend to abolish product differentiation.
Ik ben niet voornemens productdifferentiatie af te schaffen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aantrekken van Poolse werknemers in de zorg (ingezonden 9 septem

Two SP MPs asked the health and social affairs ministers about recruiting Polish care workers who live in the homes of the people they care for, working around the clock, with questions on labour conditions, BIG registration, training equivalence, exploitation risks and the WHO code. The government answered that employers are primarily responsible for staffing and housing, that EU labour rules and the Waga apply, that the Labour Inspectorate will pilot checks in care, and that the Polish workers in this case mostly do domestic and support work not requiring BIG registration.

In the autumn the Labour Inspectorate will start a pilot in the care sector checking compliance with the Foreign Nationals Employment Act and the Minimum Wage Act, including checks on intermediary agencies.

In het najaar start de Arbeidsinspectie een pilot in de zorgsector naar naleving van de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen en de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag, waarbij ook bemiddelingsbureaus gecontroleerd worden.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ZZP’ers genegeerd worden door zorgkantoren en over de gevolgen van de PGB-maatregelen voor de

An SP MP asks the health ministers whether health insurers' care procurement for 2012 is excluding self-employed care workers, what share of the 50 million euro extra will go to them, how many PGB income earners will lose income, and about unemployment benefit rights of former PGB workers. The state secretary answers that procurement criteria are being adjusted with the insurers, a pilot is running, no PGB holders lose their budget on 1 January 2012, and eligibility rules for unemployment and social assistance are explained.
This information is not known and cannot be calculated on the basis of the available data.
Deze informatie is niet bekend en op basis van de beschikbare gegevens niet te berekenen.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Indiase operatieassistenten en risico’s voor patiënten (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether she would send the Inspectorate's findings on risks from Indian operating-theatre staff and whether hospitals would stop recruiting from India given the Fonds Ziekenhuisopleidingen. The minister agreed to send the Inspectorate's findings with her response in spring 2012 and said recruitment from India would be much less needed as training intake rises, while noting temporary recruitment is acceptable if it meets quality standards.
I am willing to do so. I expect to be able to send the Inspectorate's findings to the House of Representatives in spring 2012, including a response from me.
Ik ben daartoe bereid. De bevindingen van de Inspectie verwacht ik in het voorjaar van 2012 naar de Tweede Kamer te kunnen sturen, inclusief een reactie van mijn kant.

Vragen van het lid Leijten aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over opsporing van fraude in de thuiszorg door de SIOD en politie Rotterdam Rijnmond (ing

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about a 2008 police and SIOD report on home-care fraud, its recommendations, prosecutions, and whether it applies to other care financing. The minister answers that the report led to a fraud-prevention working group, is public, the related prosecution is still pending, the fraud risk analysis covers other care types, and no statistics on care-fraud convictions are available.
I therefore cannot give you an overview.
Ik kan u derhalve geen overzicht geven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het tekort aan verpleeghuisartsen (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the shortage of geriatric physicians (specialisten ouderengeneeskunde), whether it endangers elderly care, why no measures were taken earlier, and whether nurse practitioners can compensate. The state secretary answers that alternatives are acceptable where needed, that talks with professional bodies on recruitment are under way, and that task reallocation and renewed talks with the professional bodies and the education ministry will follow.
Agreements have been made about which actions will be taken by whom in the coming period to solve the problem and when these actions will be evaluated.
Afspraken zijn gemaakt over welke acties wie de komende tijd oppakken ter oplossing van het probleem en wanneer deze acties geëvalueerd worden.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het van start gaan van SOS Arts (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the NZa's approval of the SOS Arts on-call doctor initiative, its claimed huisarts role, the risk of a two-tier system, and the supervision of the service. The minister defended innovation and new entrants, argued on-call care is not covered by the basic insurance, and said the IGZ will supervise quality.
I am of the view that more innovative initiatives, which may contribute to improving the quality, accessibility and efficiency of care and offer patients more choice, should be given a chance.

Ik ben van mening dat meer innovatieve initiatieven, die mogelijk kunnen bijdragen aan het bevorderen van de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid en doelmatigheid van de zorg en patiënten meer keuzemogelijkheden bieden, een kans moeten krijgen.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de financiële problemen van Zonnehuizen (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about Stichting Zonnehuizen's financial trouble, complaints ignored for years, the role of the IGZ inspectorate, the missing EUR 20 million, board conduct and the risk of closure. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate visited regularly, that board and supervisory board resigned in 2011, that early-warning rules for financial problems are proposed, and that closure risk is addressed in a separate letter.

Following the results of the supervision carried out, the inspectorate in early April 2011 called the Board of Management and the Supervisory Board to account for care that was deficient in parts and certain unsafe situations.

Naar aanleiding van de resultaten van het uitgevoerde toezicht heeft de inspectie begin april 2011 de Raad van Bestuur en de Raad van Toezicht ter verantwoording geroepen over de op onderdelen tekortschietende zorg en bepaalde onveilige situaties.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van bezuinigingen voor de kwaliteit van de zorg (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether budget cuts have lowered care quality, including night nursing at care homes, the supervision of woonzorggroep Samen after a reported neglect case, and the availability of wound nurses. The government replies that it has no data on night nurses, that the inspectorate sees no reason for enhanced supervision, and that it denies cuts harm care quality, pointing to extra investment in elderly care.
The inspectorate (IGZ) has the organisation well in view and indicates there are no reasons to place the care group under enhanced supervision.
De IGZ heeft de organisatie goed in beeld en geeft aan dat er geen redenen zijn om de woonzorggroep onder verscherpt toezicht te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het ontbreken van inzicht in de kwaliteit van de ouderenzorg (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary whether the government's elder-care quality measurement system and the kiesBeter website provide unreliable information on indicators like pressure sores and medication errors, and whether the minister would close kiesBeter and suspend transferring AWBZ to insurers. The state secretary denied a system failure, said indicators were being revised to publish results later this year, and declined to suspend the AWBZ plans.
There is therefore no question of a failing measurement system.
Er is dan ook geen sprake van een falend meetsysteem.

Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP), Voortman (Groenlinks) en Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over arbeidsvoorwaarden in de gemeentelijke thuiszorg (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary about a quality covenant requiring signalling in home care, its use in tendering, and why signalling is graded lower in the care job classification, and about a salary cut at a care provider. The state secretary said the Healthcare Institutions Quality Act already binds providers to the quality norms, declined to rule on classification disputes that belong to collective agreement procedures, and said salary matters are for employers and employees to settle.
In those procedures it is not fitting for a minister to make statements about labour disputes concerning working conditions.
In die procedures past het niet dat een bewindspersoon uitspraken doet over arbeidsvoorwaardelijke geschillen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het wegsluizen van tonnen aan Persoonsgebonden Budgetten (Pgb’s) in een Zeeuws afkickcentrum (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about suspected misuse of personal budgets (pgb) at a Zeeland addiction centre, including the role of a psychotherapist struck off by a disciplinary board whose diagnoses led to care indications, and the quality and integrity of private addiction care providers. The state secretary answered that the care office and Inspectorate are investigating, no criminal case is known, the BIG register was handled correctly pending appeal, the Inspectorate has halted part of the centre's activities, and no sector-wide investigation is planned.
It is not known how often this occurs. The CIZ checks the BIG register when there are reasons or indications to do so.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dit voorkomt. Het CIZ controleert het BIG-register als er redenen of aanwijzingen zijn die daartoe aanleiding geven.
Vragen van Lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het scheiden van geliefden in verzorgings- en verpleeghuizen (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary about couples being separated in care and nursing homes when one partner is hospitalised for more than fourteen days, and whether room-return guarantees and shared rooms are available. The state secretary says the rule was changed from 1 January 2012 so residents keep their room, that couples can share rooms, and that care providers and care offices are responsible for adequate housing, while promising to check waiting lists with the insurers' association.
This means that the rule that a room may be given to another client after hospitalisation longer than fourteen days has been adapted from 1 January 2012 for clients in nursing and care homes.

Dit betekent dat de regel dat bij ziekenhuisopname langer dan veertien dagen de kamer weggegeven kan worden aan een andere cliënt, per 1 januari 2012 aangepast is voor de cliënten in verpleeg- en verzorgingshuizen.
Vragen van lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de opnamestop bij verpleeghuisorganisatie Plantein (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary for health about a temporary admissions stop at nursing home organisation Plantein caused by a shortage of AWBZ budget, and whether the budget allocation or tightened risk-bearing is to blame. The secretary says the funding problem is resolved, places responsibility on the regional care office framework, rejects that the allocation or risk policy is the cause, and has started a review of how AWBZ funds are distributed across care office regions.
I have already initiated this research.
Ik heb dit onderzoek reeds in gang gezet.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de diamanten afvloeiingsregeling voor een adviseur van ziekenhuis de Tjongerschans in Heerenveen (ingezonde

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a possible 1 to 1.3 million euro severance arrangement for an adviser at hospital Tjongerschans, a prior 350,000 euro golden handshake, board accountability, supervision, a statutory route to reverse such deals, and a planned merger with MCL. The minister said the arrangement far exceeds the 75,000 euro cap, that the supervisory board decides, that the hospital must cover legal costs itself, that stricter supervision criteria do not cover board pay, and that the government favours the pay-norm legislation; the merger is for the NMa and NZa to assess.
The authority to decide on that lies with the Supervisory Board.
De bevoegdheid om daar een besluit over nemen, ligt bij de Raad van Toezicht.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de eigen bijdrage in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) voor mensen met dementie (ingezonde

MP Leijten asked the minister and state secretary whether the proposed co-payment in mental health care (GGZ) would deter dementia patients and elderly people from care, and why it was imposed without exemptions. Minister Schippers answered that the co-payment is capped at 200 euro per year to address rising GGZ costs, that an exemption by diagnosis or income was judged impractical for 2012, and that alternative measures for 2013 will be explored.
I have chosen a co-payment of at most 200 euro per patient per calendar year.
Ik heb gekozen voor een eigen bijdrage van maximaal € 200 per patiënt per kalenderjaar.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een frauderende psychiater een doorstart wil maken (ingezonden 25 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister how a psychiatrist suspected of large-scale PGB fraud could keep practising, and what the IGZ, OM and others can do. The minister explained that the IGZ found no grounds for restricting the first psychiatrist after an inspection, while the second was ordered to stop practising after refusing supervision, and that the OM's powers under Wet BIG art. 96 did not apply.
The IGZ cannot anticipate a criminal conviction, since the principle of the rule of law is that a person is innocent until convicted.
De IGZ kan niet vooruitlopen op een strafrechtelijke veroordeling, immers het principe van de rechtsstaat is dat iemand onschuldig is tot het moment dat hij is veroordeeld.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) om topsalarissen te matigen (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether Medisch Spectrum Twente's intention to align top executive pay with the sector pay code is meaningful, whether existing high contracts can be reopened, whether company cars and high salaries are justified, and whether she will intervene in other hospitals' governance. The minister replied that the code and pay norm apply to new contracts only, that existing contracts are hard to change, that company car decisions belong to institutions, and that intervening in hospital boards would not respect private responsibility, while noting the forthcoming pay norm law.

I have examined what role I can play in the appointment of boards and concluded that intervening in the governance of a care institution does not do justice to the private responsibility of the parties in care.

Ik ben nagegaan welke rol ik kan spelen bij de benoeming van besturen en ben tot de conclusie gekomen dat ingrijpen in het bestuur van een zorginstelling geen recht doet aan de private verantwoordelijkheid van de partijen in de zorg.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onderhandelingen over de ziekenhuiskosten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether insurers' letter to hospitals (ZN's campaign) undermines the 2.5% growth hoyer agreement, and how hospital care quality, waiting lists and hospital core tasks are safeguarded. Minister Schippers answered that the letter was not addressed to her, that it is not in conflict with the agreement, that hospitals must manage their finances, and that the agreement guarantees waiting-time norms and care access.
The letter from ZN is not addressed to me but to the Dutch Hospital Association, so it is primarily for those organisations to respond to it.
De brief van ZN is niet aan mij gericht maar aan de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Landelijke Vereniging van Bloed- en Plasmadonoren (LVB), (aspirant)donoren zal adviseren om

SP MPs asked the health minister how she would respond to a report that the blood donor association LVB would advise donors to stop giving blood over Sanquin board salaries, and whether she would ask board members to cut their pay. The minister called the advice irresponsible, said she has no legal instruments to intervene in existing board contracts, and refused to ask board members to give up salary, while noting new appointees will be paid under the BBZ and WNT norms.
I have no (legal) instruments at my disposal to intervene in existing contracts.
Ik heb geen (juridische) instrumenten tot mijn beschikking om in reeds bestaande contracten in te grijpen.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de overname van ziekenhuis ’t Lange Land (LZZ) (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

Two MPs (SP) asked the health minister about the planned takeover of 't Lange Land hospital in Zoetermeer, its effects on accessibility and emergency care, job losses, the risk of hospital bankruptcies, and the transfer of the Csz sanitation college to the NZa. The minister answered that hospital reorganisation is a matter for the hospital board, that accessibility norms are met, that the government will not rescue failing providers, and that the Csz tasks will move to the NZa.
I have no objection to a hospital seeking solutions to address its financial problems and realise a care offer more geared to the future.
Ik heb er niets op tegen dat een ziekenhuis op zoek gaat naar oplossingen om zo de financiële problemen het hoofd te bieden en een meer op de toekomst toegespitst zorgaanbod te realiseren.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergoeding in het ziektekostenpakket van lapatinib bij de behandeling van patiënten met gemetastaseerde

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health why lapatinib is not reimbursed for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer after trastuzumab failure, and whether this reflects cost, inconsistency, or class medicine. The Minister answered that reimbursement was refused on lack of demonstrated therapeutic added value and lack of proven survival benefit, not price, and declined to link the decision to pricing or private insurance.
No, this description is not correct. The reimbursement application for lapatinib was not rejected because it would be too expensive.
Nee, deze weergave is niet correct. De betreffende vergoedingsaanvraag van lapatinib was niet afgewezen omdat het te duur zou zijn.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zelfverrijking en wanbeleid bij GGZ WNB (Ingezonden 27 juli 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Health about an interim board chair at GGZ WNB who received about €246,000 for seven months and whether excessive pay, a €260,000 property loss, and dismissals should be borne by responsible executives, plus whether self-regulation of top pay works and whether caps should be adopted. The state secretary replies that the annual figure is misleading since the amount is an hourly-style contract rate including costs, that interim pay follows separate BBZ rules, that the earlier chair's pay was excessive but the property decision was made in 2007 and is for the new supervisory board, that personal liability rules exist, and that the government's pay-normalisation bill should be debated in parliament rather than through the amendments.
It is for the new supervisory board to assess whether, and if so which, consequences should be attached to this.
Het is aan de nieuwe Raad van Toezicht om te beoordelen of en zo ja welke consequenties daar aan moeten worden verbonden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de inzet van Poolse vakantiekrachten in verpleeghuizen (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary for health about a broadcast on Polish holiday workers in nursing homes, the number of foreign care workers, their language and qualification requirements, pay, tasks, and recruitment in Poland. The state secretary says the employer is primarily responsible, that no figures are known, that EU rules automatically recognise qualified Polish nurses, and that the sector's labour-market policy is being expanded with a letter promised by 30 September 2011.
I have no figures on the use of foreign workers to cover understaffing in nursing homes.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over de opvang van onderbezetting door buitenlandse arbeidskrachten in verpleeghuizen.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de beloning van de Raad van Bestuur van bloedbank Sanquin vorig jaar opnieuw fors is toegenome

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister how she views the rise in Sanquin board pay, with individual salaries up to 258,000 euros above the Balkenende norm, what she will do about it, whether it could harm donor willingness, and how she will ensure compliance with the BBZ care pay code. The minister explained the increase by a 2010 board change and indexation, said the two sitting board members' contracts still exceed the BBZ norms, pointed to a pending normeringswet covering Sanquin, and rejected a donor boycott as irresponsible.
The salary of the two sitting Sanquin board members is still under their earlier contracts, and that exceeds the BBZ norms, so in that respect it is too high.
Het salaris van de twee zittende bestuurders van Sanquin is nog steeds volgens hun eerder gesloten contract. En dat ligt boven de normen van de BBZ en in dat opzicht is het te hoog.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de omgang van Philadelphia met een bewoner en diens kritische ouders (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary whether parents may criticise a care institution's policy when inspections support them, and about the institution's termination of care, staff replacement, and weak quality oversight at Philadelphia. The state secretary largely defends the Wet cliëntenrechten zorg and existing complaint and inspection procedures, notes a settlement allowing the resident to stay until 1 January 2012, and says the inspectorate will act if the institution fails to improve.
In addition, the proposed Beginselenwet zorginstellingen provides that clients and their legal representatives can lodge serious complaints about personal care and treatment with the inspectorate.

Daarnaast voorziet de voorgenomen Beginselenwet zorginstellingen in de mogelijkheid voor cliënten en hun wettelijke vertegenwoordigers tot het indienen van ernstige klachten met betrekking tot persoonlijke verzorging en bejegening bij de inspectie.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het functioneren van maatschappen in ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether hospital boards lack tools to steer medical partnerships (maatschappen), whether poor cooperation harms safety and finances, whether a specific orthopaedic case shows weak grip on specialists, and whether employing specialists would strengthen quality control. The minister replied that hospital boards bear final responsibility and have adequate tools (quality system, contractual rights, the coming Wcz), that IGZ supervises risks, and that employment status is not linked to quality, so she sees no reason to mandate employment.
A good board member can therefore be expected to know what is happening within the organisation so that timely intervention and appropriate measures are possible.
Van een goed bestuurder mag dan ook verwacht worden dat deze weet wat er binnen de organisatie gebeurt zodat er tijdig kan worden ingegrepen en passende maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over prestatielijsten van een zorgverzekeraar (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister whether insurer Zilveren Kruis/Achmea published cardiology quality lists without verifying facts with hospitals, and how this will be prevented. Minister Schippers answers that the lists are based on NVVC-verified norms, distinguishes hospitals meeting criteria from those not yet verified, and sees no problem with differing insurer criteria if transparent.
As far as my information goes, Zilveren Kruis therefore bases its judgment on verified facts.
Voor zover mijn informatie reikt baseert Zilveren Kruis haar oordeel dus op gecontroleerde feiten.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verstrengeling van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ) met private partijen (ingezonden 12 juli 201

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital's creation of Zeeland Care, its funding via plastic surgery revenue, and outsourcing of dialysis to a partly privately financed entity are desirable, legal, and risk wasting insured care funds on private profit. The minister said the hospital may choose its legal form and financing within existing rules, that private financing is not prohibited, and that insurers must watch for unnecessary care.
I am not aware of the extent to which the various shareholders participate in Zeeland Care.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de mate waarin de verschillende aandeelhouders participeren in Zeeland Care.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toevoegingen aan sigaretten (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether tobacco firms are adding substances to make cigarettes more addictive, and why the Netherlands, unlike France and the US, has no ban on such additives. The minister said there is no reason to think additive use has increased, pointed to RIVM information and an ingredient-reporting scheme, and declined to regulate additives because it does not fit her tobacco policy and evidence is insufficient.
I do not intend to further regulate the composition of tobacco products, because this does not fit the tobacco discouragement policy I have in mind.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de samenstelling van tabaksproducten verder te reguleren, omdat dit niet past in het tabaksontmoedigingsbeleid dat ik voor ogen heb.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vorming van één ambulancedienst in Amsterdam (ingezonden 25 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about conflicts and stalled negotiations over merging Amsterdam's ambulance services, including the absence of a social plan with unions and whether the minister would step in by creating a regional ambulance facility. The minister replied that negotiations are the responsibility of the parties involved, that the municipal council has reopened talks, and that she sees no reason to intervene at this stage.
As said, I have no role in the negotiations and therefore can give you no more information than what is already public.
Als gezegd heb ik geen rol in de onderhandelingen en ik kan u hierover derhalve niet meer informatie geven dan wat reeds openbaar is.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het intrekken van een kritisch rapport door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ingezonden 8 juli 2

SP MPs asked the minister about the Inspectorate for Health Care's withdrawal of a critical report on a UMCG paediatric anaesthesia case, the lengthy investigation, the parents' lack of apology, and whether pressure was applied or a disciplinary case should follow. The minister answered that the withdrawal was for procedural reasons, that the Inspectorate-General has commissioned an independent review and the Ombudsman is also examining the matter, and that the inspectorate admits the investigation took too long.
The IGZ withdrew the report out of caution, because the conclusions in the first report were insufficiently supported by the facts.
De IGZ heeft uit zorgvuldigheidsoverwegingen het rapport ingetrokken, omdat de conclusies in het eerste rapport onvoldoende door de feiten werden gedragen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de prestatielijst van ziekenhuizen bij de behandeling van blaaskanker door zorgverzekeraar CZ (ingezonden 7

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether insurer CZ's published ranking of hospitals for bladder cancer surgery, which excludes some hospitals from contracts, is a marketing tool, and whether it is reliable and consistent with the IGZ's role. The Minister replied that insurers may set quality and volume criteria when contracting care, that volume (at least 10 operations per year) matters for quality, that the IGZ cannot judge hospital-level outcomes for this rare procedure, and that she sees no reason to stop insurers publishing such lists.
Care providers are primarily themselves responsible for determining what responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat verantwoorde zorg is.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gemeenten die mantelzorgers aan hun lot overlaten (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a Mezzo barometer showing most municipalities perform poorly on carer and volunteer support, and whether it will push municipalities to improve given broad Wmo policy discretion. The state secretary said the findings differ significantly from an earlier baseline measurement, wants a dialogue with the VNG, Mezzo and stakeholders, and promised fuller policy letters in the autumn.
I am not yet in a position to judge the figures presented.
Ik ben nog niet toe aan een oordeel over de gepresenteerde cijfers.

Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de intimidatie van werkgever Viva! Zorggroe

MPs Leijten and Voortman asked whether UWV's role in the Viva! Zorggroep dismissal applications concerns terminating employment or working conditions, whether the employer may obstruct union activity, and how to view the intimidating letters and refusal to let a union representative attend talks during a strike. The state secretary replied that UWV assesses only the business-economic necessity of the dismissals under the Ontslagbesluit, that the works council has a limited advisory role, that there is no legal duty for employers to permit union activity though dismissal protection exists, and that the labour dispute is not for government to judge.
This concerns a labour dispute between ViVa! Zorggroep and its employees. It is not for us to pass judgment on it.
Het betreft hier een arbeidsconflict tussen ViVa! Zorggroep en haar werknemers. Het is niet aan ons om hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de herbenoeming van FIFA-baas Blatter en het WK-bid (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister, among many questions, about FIFA corruption, the KNVB's vote for Blatter, the tax exemption and cost estimates for the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid, and the 'Bierbabes' prosecution issue. The minister answers that the KNVB's vote is its own responsibility, that the cost estimates were communicated with uncertainty margins, that the tax-law change needed parliamentary approval, and that the bid evaluation will follow after summer.
It was also one of the reasons the Netherlands made a constitutional reservation on the guarantees given to FIFA, because the necessary legislative changes would have required parliamentary approval.

Het is ook één van de redenen geweest dat Nederland een constitutioneel voorbehoud heeft gemaakt bij de afgegeven garanties aan de FIFA, omdat voor de daartoe noodzakelijke wetswijzigingen parlementaire goedkeuring verkregen had moeten worden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toepassing van een luiersensor in de ouderenzorg (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for health about a sensor diaper for elderly care, its alleged dehumanizing effect, staffing shortages, and a company's SBIR funding application. The secretary calls the sensor sympathetic if used to respect client wishes, says care must not be reduced to essentials, and states that innovation is the sector's own responsibility while the company is in a government innovation programme.
The procedure of the experiment is not in my possession.
De procedure van het experiment is niet in mijn bezit.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Stichting Zorggroep Charim (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary of Health about the Charim care group: alleged mistreatment of residents, inspection oversight, fire safety, staffing, works council independence and complaint handling. The state secretary answers that the IGZ is investigating, that the care provider and municipality handle fire safety and complaints, and that broader inspection studies are ongoing, while declining some matters as outside her responsibility.
I replied to Mr S. that I appreciate that he has made his signals known in detail to the care institution.
Ik heb de heer S. geantwoord dat ik waardeer dat hij zijn signalen uitvoerig heeft kenbaar gemaakt bij de zorginstelling.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over discriminatie van ouderen met hartproblemen (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister about professors' claims that older people with heart problems are excluded from research and treatment, and whether this is acceptable, its causes, and criteria for withholding treatment. The minister rejects the claim that older patients are wrongly denied treatment, notes older people are underrepresented in trials for valid reasons, and says decisions on forgoing treatment are made by patient, family and doctor based on quality of life.
I do not share the view that older people are wrongly excluded from treatment.
Ik deel de mening niet dat ouderen ten onrechte uitgesloten worden van behandeling.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de door de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit (NMa) opgelegde miljoenenboete aan

An MP asked ministers why the competition authority NMa fined home-care foundations millions of euros, whether this harms patients and staff, and how the fines relate to financial viability, sector transition, use of fine revenue and compliance. The government answered that the NMa acts independently, that the fines protect patient choice and competition, that the NMa considers financial health and reduces fines where bankruptcy becomes likely, and that fine revenue flows to the general treasury without earmarking.
The NMa is independent in assessing individual cases, and my reaction does not add to or subtract from the fine imposed.
De NMa is in de beoordeling van individuele zaken zelfstandig en een reactie mijnerzijds doet aan de opgelegde boete niets toe of af.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen te bezuinigen op de eerstelijns GGZ (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister about planned savings on first-line mental health care, including higher co-payments and fewer insured sessions, and the risk of patients dropping out or shifting to specialist care. The minister says savings options are under review in the spring budget process, declines to confirm the specific figures, argues efficiency via e-health and better triage can avoid barriers, and promises an NZa implementation review by end 2011.
I cannot yet make a statement on this at this time.
Hierover kan ik op dit moment nog geen uitspraak doen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het naast zich neerleggen van een gerechtelijke uitspraak door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa complied with a court ruling requiring it to re-justify its requirement that diagnosis information appear on psychiatrists' and psychotherapists' invoices, and whether it may keep that requirement. The minister answers that the court (CBb) is the authority to judge the new NZa decision, that the NZa has provided a fuller justification, that the matter is pending before the court, and that she will follow the case.
As I explained in my answer to question 3, the NZa has re-motivated the secondary decision extensively. Whether that is sufficient is not for me but for the CBb to judge.
Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heeft de NZa de secundaire BoB opnieuw en uitgebreid gemotiveerd. Het oordeel of dat afdoende is, is niet aan mij maar aan het CBb.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de barrières die chronisch zieken voelen bij een overstap naar een andere zorgverzekeraar (ingezonden 24 mei 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister about a NIVEL study showing chronically ill people face more barriers to switching health insurers, and questioned switching rates, price-versus-quality balance, insurer advertising and insurer marketing spending. Minister Schippers answered each question, stating that insurers' acceptance duty applies, that the Zvw is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a good price-quality balance, and that marketing budgets are for insurers to decide.
I do not know how many chronically ill people are refused supplementary insurance.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel chronisch zieken worden geweigerd voor een aanvullende verzekering.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie bij Viva zorggroep (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

The MP Leijten asks the state secretary for Health about Viva Zorggroep's collective dismissal request for 650 home-care workers, the works council's consent to wage cuts, guards restraining protesting staff, the lowering of job grading, and the HKZ certificate. The state secretary explains the collective dismissal rules and UWV's role, says the works council is not hers to judge, states that labour conditions are for social partners while she ensures citizens get support, points to courts as the remedy for contract breaches, and infers continued HKZ compliance from recertification.
I am not in a position to give a judgment on the Works Council.
Ik ben niet in de positie om een oordeel over de Ondernemingsraad te geven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het experiment in Drenthe met persoonsvolgende bekostiging (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary whether the Drenthe experiment with person-following funding in disability care had failed and about its lessons, the risk of care providers competing for clients, and the sustainability of ZZP funding. The state secretary rejected the failure conclusion, said the experiment yielded useful lessons, and answered that choice-support must be targeted, that waiting lists should be prevented, and that the ZZP amounts will be addressed in a forthcoming letter.
In line with my commitment to your House, I have attached the final report of this experiment.
In lijn met mijn toezegging aan uw Kamer heb ik het eindrapport van dit experiment bijgevoegd.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van het aantal GHB-verslaafden en het tekort aan behandelplekken (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister about rising GHB addiction, waiting lists for treatment in Noord-Brabant, and whether the government would act on treatment capacity. Minister Schippers answered that a new detoxification protocol will expand treatment capacity during 2011, that GHB risk assessment is being updated, and that no additional research is considered necessary.
For that reason I am encouraging a project in which addiction care institutions participate in developing, under scientific guidance, a new detoxification protocol for GHB addiction.
Om die reden stimuleer ik een project waarbij de verslavingszorginstellingen participeren in het onder wetenschappelijke begeleiding ontwikkelen van een nieuw ontgiftingsprotocol voor GHB-verslaving.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verslaafdenzorg voor welgestelde Nederlanders in het luxueuze Jellinek Retreat

An SP MP asked the ministers of Health and Interior about a luxury addiction clinic on Curaçao (Jellinek Retreat), its costs, its exclusive positioning, inequality with local addicts, and whether PSNA funding conditions on local staffing were met. Minister Donner answered that the Dutch basic insurance covers addiction care abroad up to Dutch tariffs, that the clinic is open to anyone who can pay, that local staffing conditions are nearly met, and that funds are advances subject to later clawback.
The funds transferred so far for this project are advances, which can be determined after completion.
De tot nu toe overgemaakte gelden aan dit project betreffen voorschotten, die na afronding kunnen worden vastgesteld.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitgaven aan de ontwikkeling van het Elektronisch Patiëntendossier (EPD) (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister whether much of the 300 million euros spent on the electronic patient record went to advisers, pilots and communication, and questions the costs, staffing and status of UZI-register and related ICT systems. Minister Schippers answers with itemised figures, states spending fits the budget, reports the project's external hires were terminated after the Senate rejected the EPD law, and explains that a motion means the ministry's involvement in the LSP ends.
The expenditures fall within the budget available for this in the VWS budget 2011.
De uitgaven vallen binnen het budget dat hiervoor in de VWS-begroting 2011 beschikbaar is.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kwaliteitsnormen voor kankeroperaties (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that Achmea rated ten hospitals as below quality norms for cancer surgery, questioning why the Inspectorate had not intervened, whether insurers may judge academic hospitals on incomplete data, and whether selective contracting limits patient choice. The minister replied that the NVvH norms are professional standards, that insurers may set quality requirements when purchasing care, that the Inspectorate will apply the same norms from 2012, and that patients remain free to choose providers.
Care providers are primarily themselves responsible for determining what good and responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat goede en verantwoorde zorg is.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma (PvdA), Leijten (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Wiegman-van Meppelen Schepping (ChristenUnie) en Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van

MPs from several parties asked the health minister why a second cochlear implant for young deaf children is not reimbursed, and whether the evidence supports it, including costs and the CVZ's pending reassessment. The minister said the CVZ must judge the added benefit, that the research in Nijmegen is uncertain, and that she is open to temporary admission or conditional financing to generate evidence, as the motion requested.
It is for the College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) to answer that question within the context of its role as package manager.
Het is aan het College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) om die vraag te beantwoorden binnen de context van zijn rol als pakketbeheerder.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over chaos bij de Osira Groep (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary for Health about chaos at care provider Osira, including the 4 million euro cost of care routes, calls for personal liability of board members, instability at Regio West 2, threats to care continuity, and complaints from the client council. The state secretary says the costs are regrettable, that she lacks power to hold board members personally liable, that she has invited the supervisory board, that a board change occurred, and that the Inspectorate has placed Osira Amstelring under heightened supervision.
I do not have the power to hold the board members personally liable.
Ik heb niet de bevoegdheid om de bestuurders persoonlijk aansprakelijk te stellen.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitzendkrachten op de ambulance (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether budget cuts in ambulance care are driving the use of temporary agency staff who may lack local knowledge, and about the numbers, recruitment, quality controls and responsibility for such staff. The minister denied a demonstrated link to the cuts, said agency numbers are not kept nationally, stated that staff must meet the same national training requirements, and said the Inspectorate will be asked to stay alert and report if further action is needed.
I have asked the IGZ to be extra alert in the coming period to signals from the field or the sector that may indicate substandard care or risks that norms and agreements are not being met.

Ik heb aan de IGZ gevraagd om in de komende periode extra alert te zijn op signalen uit het veld of de sector die kunnen wijzen op tekortschietende zorg of risico's dat normen en afspraken niet worden gehaald.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een Verklaring omtrent gedrag in de zorg (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

MP Leijten asks why a convicted sex offender is working in care despite a court ruling that no certificate of conduct (VOG) can be issued, whether employers should take action, and when a mandatory VOG in care will be legislated. Minister Schippers answers that employers are responsible for vetting staff, that a mandatory VOG will be added to the Wcz bill, and that the inspectorate can only act against individual professionals and cannot bar them from care, which only a judge can do.
In addition to the existing obligation in the Wcz, under which I require the care provider to investigate past functioning, I want a mandatory VOG. I will adjust the Wcz accordingly.
Ik wil naast de bestaande verplichting uit de Wcz, waarin ik de zorgaanbieder verplicht tot een onderzoek naar het functioneren in het verleden, een verplichte VOG. Ik zal de Wcz hierop aanpassen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toetreden van buitenlandse zorgondernemers tot de Nederlandse thuiszorg (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

MP Leijten asked the state secretary whether the entry of foreign care franchise groups such as Home Instead into Dutch home care threatens quality, supervision, labour conditions and small-scale care. The state secretary answered that foreign providers must meet Dutch law and fall under the same inspection regimes, and that no information on municipal or insurer interest was available.
If a foreign care provider is going to offer care in the Netherlands, it must simply comply with Dutch legislation.
Als een buitenlandse zorgaanbieder in Nederland zorg gaat aanbieden, moet deze gewoon voldoen aan de Nederlandse wetgeving.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de voorbereidingen tot het scheiden van wonen en zorg (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

MP Leijten asked the state secretary whether the cabinet plans to abolish the Normative Housing Component for the lowest care packages (ZZP1 and ZZP2) in 2012, and about the feasibility, client information, rent and co-payment effects, and the numbers of affected clients. The state secretary replied that the press report was premature, that a directive to the NZa and a parliamentary pre-consultation letter would follow, and that the separation of housing and care would be addressed in a June 2011 letter on long-term care reform.
In June 2011 I will send the House, on behalf of the cabinet, a letter on the reforms in long-term care.
In juni 2011 stuur ik namens het kabinet een brief over de hervormingen in de langdurige zorg naar uw Kamer.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over thuiszorg voor mensen met complexe problemen als verslavingen en psychiatrische aandoeningen (ingezonden 13 januari 2011)

MP Leijten asked the state secretary how the government would respond to a Noord-Holland home-care provider ceasing care for people with addictions and psychiatric conditions, and whether this threatens equal access and Wmo compliance. The state secretary said the municipalities are responsible under the Wmo compensation duty, that Wmo funds are non-earmarked, and that he will consult the VNG and inform parliament.
Under the Wmo, the municipality is responsible for the social support of its citizens.
Uit hoofde van de Wmo is de gemeente verantwoordelijk voor de maatschappelijke ondersteuning van haar burgers.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de staat van de ouderenzorg (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

SP MP Leijten asked the state secretary for Health about a TV report on undignified conditions in elderly care, the sector's shift toward business efficiency, the role of personal attention, the two-tier care system, and budget allocation. The state secretary largely rejected the critical premises, stressed trust in care workers and the autonomy of institutions, and said the ZZP financing model will be kept with a future move to outcome-based financing announced in a forthcoming vision letter.
I do not intend to abolish the care-weight (ZZP) financing.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de zorgzwaartefinanciering af te schaffen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de loonsverlaging van 650 thuiszorgmedewerkers van Viva zorggroep (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether it is right that 650 home-care workers at Viva zorggroep face wage cuts because municipalities pay too little, and whether tendering rules and FWG grading should be changed. The state secretary answers that municipalities are primarily responsible and parties should agree, that the CAO VVT already requires proper pay, and that tendering rules prevent mid-contract price changes, while expressing confidence the parties will resolve the unrest.
It is primarily up to ViVa! zorggroep, the trade unions and the municipalities to each take their responsibility and make good agreements about this.
Het is primair aan ViVa! zorggroep, vakbonden en gemeenten om ieder hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en om hier goede afspraken over te maken.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zogenaamde studiereis naar Zwitserland (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how the study trip with care executives to Switzerland came about, whether it fits cost-cutting goals, who paid, how participants were selected, which firms organised it, and what other trips occurred. The minister defends the trip as knowledge-gathering, says participants paid their own travel, explains the tender and selection, and lists past and planned foreign trips, though it could not answer by the deadline.
Naming the organisations that were rejected is commercially sensitive information.
Het noemen van de organisaties die zijn afgewezen is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tekortschietende controle op de hulpmiddelenindustrie en wachtlijsten bij scoliosepatiënten (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether oversight of prostheses and implants is inadequate, whether surgeon-industry contracts should be banned, and why scoliosis patients face long waiting times. The minister replied that the existing EU-based market-approval system and IGZ supervision are sufficient, that a voluntary industry code is due by January 2012, and that financing reform (DOT, expanded B-segment) is intended to address the scoliosis backlog.
I will inform the House as soon as possible about the results of the NOV's investigation.
Ik zal de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de resultaten van het onderzoek van de NOV informeren.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over het wijzigen van de mogelijkheid om dieetkosten af te trekken in het kader van de B

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether dietary-cost deductions under the BU-regeling were changed without informing Parliament or the CG-Raad, and what the reasons, savings, and effects on affected patients and allowances are. The State Secretary answered that a revised dietary cost table from 2010 uses a healthy diet as reference, that budget was not a motive, and that individual effects vary and were not quantified at macro level.
Since there is no insight into which diets are deducted to what extent, the financial consequences cannot be stated at macro level.
Aangezien er geen inzicht bestaat in welke diëten in welke mate in aftrek worden gebracht, is op macro-niveau niet aan te geven wat hiervan de financiële gevolgen zijn.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de reclames van de zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

SP MP Leijten asked the health minister about insurer advertising (Zekur, Promovendum, VGZ, Independer), covering acceptance duty, risk equalisation, discounts for higher-educated groups and the reliability of comparison sites. The minister's reply corrected an earlier answer: Independer no longer owns the health centres (transferred to Arts en Zorg) and has said it holds no other provider interests, and it has agreed to remove outdated website information.
Independer has agreed to (have) the outdated information removed from its websites.
Independer heeft toegezegd de verouderde informatie van de websites te (laten) verwijderen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de extra tegemoetkoming aan ouders van thuiswonende gehandicapte kinderen (TOG) (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Ms Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether it is fair that single-earner families with a disabled child receive the TOG allowance while families where both parents earn benefit-level incomes do not, and whether the allowance should be based on household income and parental rather than the child's AWBZ assessment. The minister defended the single-earner design as compensation for disadvantage in disposable income, said household income is not relevant, and stated that only AWBZ care counts for eligibility, with no plans to replace the AWBZ assessment with an income test.
I therefore see no possibility of replacing the AWBZ assessment with an income test.
Ik zie daarom geen mogelijkheid om de AWBZ-indicatie te vervangen door een inkomenstoets.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vergroten van de Lotto-inkomsten voor de sport (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether it is desirable for sports clubs to promote Lotto gambling to raise revenue for sport, whether sports dependence on gambling money is acceptable, and what is done about illegal online sports betting. The minister answers that involving sports clubs is not objectionable, that gambling revenue funding sport is permitted under EU case law, that the basic sports infrastructure is adequately secured, and that the new gambling authority and a forthcoming policy vision will address illegal online betting.
The bill amending the Gambling Act to establish the gambling authority is currently under consideration by the House of Representatives.
Het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wet op de kansspelen in verband met de instelling van de kansspelautoriteit is thans in behandeling bij de Tweede Kamer.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorg bij de OsiraGroep (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

The SP MP Leijten asked the state secretary for Health about the OsiraGroep's care quality, overhead caps, staff workload, flexible staffing, complaints handling, board pay and whistleblower protection, following a critical report. The state secretary largely deferred: she said the IGZ inspection would be awaited, that board pay and marketing were not her responsibility, and that she would reduce the gap between management and frontline staff and promote improvement programmes.
I do not know how much money Osira spends annually on press officers. This is an internal policy matter; again, as state secretary I am not responsible for this.
Ik weet niet hoeveel geld Osira jaarlijks uitgeeft aan persvoorlichters. Dit is een interne beleidsaangelegenheid, nogmaals als staatssecretaris ben ik hier niet verantwoordelijk voor
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voortbestaan van Fokus-projecten (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

MP Leijten asked the state secretary whether the unique Fokus housing-care model can survive its move into the AWBZ, and about client concerns over 24-hour ADL care, central units and loss of personal control. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, said 24-hour availability remains possible under regular AWBZ funding from 2012, but gave no guarantees and stressed shared responsibility of clients, municipalities, housing corporations and providers.
Vragen de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over personele gevolgen bij de invoering van de Wet ambulancezorg (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about staffing, collective agreement coverage, liability and response-time effects of introducing care ambulances (zorgambulances) and helper ambulances in The Hague. The minister answered that differentiated transport is acceptable, that the provider is responsible for staffing and liability, that the CAO question is being handled by sector parties, and that response-time impacts are not known.
I am not aware of any reports that preparedness is negatively affected by this.
Mij zijn geen berichten bekend dat de paraatheid hierdoor negatief wordt beïnvloed.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een medisch letselschadefonds (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

MP Leijten asks the health minister how victims of medical injury can obtain redress, the duration of claims, average payouts, and whether a no-fault compensation fund should be studied. The minister points to the Wcz complaints bill, a deelgeschilprocedure, legal aid rules, and refuses to examine a no-fault system, keeping the existing fault-based liability regime.
I see no reason to start new initiatives in this area.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op dit gebied nieuwe initiatieven te starten.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de inzet van alfahulpen in de thuiszorg door gemeenten (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An MP asks whether Breda's push toward alfahulpen (self-employed care helpers, with the client as employer) restricts residents' choice in home care and whether municipalities must inform clients fairly and avoid steering them. The state secretary replies that Breda seeks variety, that the EUR 3 million is a Wmo deficit rather than a savings target, that clients receive informed-consent information, and that no further investigation is planned.
Inquiries with the municipality of Breda have made clear that Breda does not aim to contract as many alfahulpen and as few regular care institutions as possible.
Navraag bij de gemeente Breda heeft duidelijk gemaakt dat de gemeente Breda niet streeft naar het contracteren van zoveel mogelijk alfahulpen en zo min mogelijk reguliere zorginstellingen

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een vrouw weken dood in huis heeft gelegen door tekortschietende zorg (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary for health about a report that a woman lay dead at home for weeks after a nursing home discharged her without adequate aftercare, and asked about inspection, responsibilities, coordination and data on neglect. The state secretary regretted the case, said the Inspectorate for Health Care is investigating with results expected in February, stressed the need for better cooperation and chain care, and said no reliable data exist on deaths from neglect or on care avoiders.
The death was reported to the IGZ as a calamity and the inspectorate has taken up the case in accordance with the Leidraad Meldingen.
Het overlijden is gemeld aan de IGZ als calamiteit en de inspectie heeft de zaak conform de Leidraad Meldingen in behandeling genomen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van tegemoetkoming en ziektekosten door het Centraal Administratie Kantoor (CAK) (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An MP asked why the CAK delayed paying out Wtcg tegemoetkomingen and eigen risico compensation, and whether telephone access was adequate. The minister explained the delay came from missing bank account numbers requiring 700,000 response cards, that about 130,000 payments were still outstanding in mid-January, and that the CAK expanded phone capacity and will scale up front-office staffing in peak periods.
The CAK has taken various actions to guarantee telephone accessibility.
Het CAK heeft verschillende acties ondernomen om de telefonische bereikbaarheid te garanderen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de DBC-financiering in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

MP Leijten asks the minister why the NZa regulation ignores the Van Gerven motion on DBC financing for independent mental health providers, and about privacy risks from diagnosis data being sent to insurers and reversibly pseudonymised in the DIS. The minister says the decentralised insurer commitment fits the motion, that the NZa must issue a new decision after the CBb ruling, and that the DIS data are pseudonymised with limited access.

In this decision the NZa must, on the instruction of the CBb, either demonstrate the necessity that diagnosis information reaches insurers via persons not bound by medical confidentiality, or limit the circle of persons receiving it to protect medical personal data.
In dit besluit moet de NZa in opdracht van het CBb hetzij de noodzaak aantonen dat de diagnose-informatie bij verzekeraars onder ogen komt van personen voor wie geen medisch beroepsgeheim geldt

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vertrek van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van HWW-Zorg (ingezonden 6 januari 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health about the sudden departure of the chair of HWW-Zorg's board, including whether he waived a departure bonus and what he earned in 2010. The state secretary answered that the departure was the board member's own decision for which she is not responsible, that 2010 income will appear in the annual report in mid-2011, and that she would answer before the scheduled debate.
However, it is a decision of the board member himself, for which I am not responsible.
Echter het is een beslissing van de bestuurder zelf, waarvoor ik niet verantwoordelijk ben.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het initiatief van het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMCG) om een besloten vennootschap (bv) voor

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether the UMCG setting up a BV for non-insured aesthetic plastic surgery is appropriate for an academic hospital, and whether it worsens waiting lists. The minister replied that the hospital decides its own service mix, the BV only separates administration and finances, staff salaries are unchanged, and the Treek waiting-time norms are aspirational, with no new action promised.
It is up to the UMCG itself to determine which types of treatment it offers and in which organisational form these treatments take place.
Het is aan het UMCG zelf om te bepalen welk type behandelingen ze aanbiedt en in welke organisatievorm deze behandeling plaatsheeft.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de alcoholpoli's in Eindhoven en Veldhoven moeten sluiten (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether alcohol clinics in Eindhoven and Veldhoven must close and how insurer CZ funds care for young people admitted with alcohol coma, and whether the clinics will stay open until effectiveness results are known. The minister said talks between parties are ongoing, that CZ does not intend to stop funding, that the pilot has ended with results published, and that a multidisciplinary implementation track will follow.
The parties are still in discussion with each other. I therefore cannot answer this question.
Partijen zijn nog met elkaar in gesprek. Ik kan deze vraag dus niet beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over AWBZ-premies (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the health and finance ministers how AWBZ premiums are defined, on what legal basis tax credits are deducted from them, for historical premium and tax-credit figures, and whether the BIKK was meant to compensate the AWBZ fund for all tax credits. The state secretary answered with definitions, the legal provisions, tables of premium and credit amounts, and confirmed the BIKK was only meant to offset premium losses from the 2001 tax reform.
It has always been the objective that the BIKK would solely cover the premium loss resulting from changes in regulations arising from the 2001 tax reform.
Het is altijd de doelstelling geweest dat de BIKK louter de premiederving zou opvangen die het gevolg is van de wijzigingen in de regelgeving die voortkwamen uit de belastingherziening 2001.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de betrouwbaarheid van «Kies Beter» (ingezonden 22 november 2010).
