MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police had its witnesses delete phone footage of a fatal arrest in Maastricht, and on what authority. The minister said a Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, that police have no power to order deletion of citizens' footage but may ask bystanders to delete it voluntarily in medical emergencies, and declined to report on complaints or the investigation's findings.
The police have no power to delete footage from citizens.
De politie heeft geen bevoegdheid om beelden van burgers te wissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de beschieting van de basisschool As-Siddieq in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the shooting at the As-Siddieq primary school in Amsterdam, the state of the police investigation, threats to Islamic institutions, and protection measures. The minister declined substantive comment on the ongoing investigation, referred to the NCTV threat assessment finding no indication of a general threat to Islamic institutions, and said local authorities decide on protection measures.
The criminal investigation is currently ongoing. In the interest of the investigation, I will not make substantive statements.
Het opsporingsonderzoek loopt momenteel. In het belang van het onderzoek doe ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over "salafisten die moskeeën dreigen over te nemen"

An MP asked whether salafist takeovers of mosques, including the Al Ummah incident in Amsterdam, and German bans on salafist organisations warrant concern and a ban in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the government is concerned, supports local partners through a three-track approach, sees no comparable violence in other mosques, and explains that banning a legal entity under Civil Code article 2:20 requires very high thresholds, so signals alone are insufficient.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, if there is reason to do so, it will consider submitting a request to the court, but that signals alone are in any case not sufficient.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen, maar dat enkel signalen daarvoor in ieder geval niet voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het lekken van geheime politieinformatie naar de Telegraaf

The MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether leaked secret police information in Telegraaf articles on extremism in mosques had harmed ongoing investigations and which police services and individuals had access. The Minister declined to answer on substance, citing the rule against operational disclosures, ongoing investigations, and the policy of not providing information to Parliament about individual police officers.
Not only could any ongoing investigations be harmed by reporting to the House, but in principle no information is provided to the House about individual police officers.
Niet alleen kunnen eventuele lopende onderzoeken door rapportage aan de Kamer worden geschaad, ook wordt in beginsel geen informatie verstrekt aan de Kamer over individuele politiemedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over het bericht dat niet-westerse Nederlanders vaker celstraf krijgen in plaats van taakstraffen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that non-Western Dutch nationals receive prison sentences more often than community service, and whether ethnic profiling could operate in sentencing. The minister, citing the Raad voor de rechtspraak research, said the differences are explained by practical and legitimate factors, saw no need for further research, and noted the judiciary will advise on adjusting penalty conversion ratios.
The report concludes that, using the conversion keys customary for substitute detention, there are no differences in sentence severity between origin groups.
Het rapport concludeert dat er, bij hantering van de bij vervangende hechtenis gebruikelijke omrekensleutels tussen soorten straffen, geen verschillen bestaan in sanctiezwaarte tussen herkomstgroepen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over maatregelen tegen discriminerende uitlatingen van medewerkers op Facebook

An MP asked ministers whether a PostNL driver's dismissal after a discriminatory Facebook post is being prosecuted, how often employers take measures against racist or discriminatory remarks, and whether employers should correct such conduct. The minister says the prosecutor is still considering prosecution, that no statistics exist on employer measures, that the labour inspectorate found 80-90 percent of 200 inspected firms lacked the legally required anti-discrimination policy and are being followed up, and that employers share responsibility through the Charter Diversiteit and the 2015 action plan.
The public prosecution service (OM) has the case under investigation.
Het openbaar ministerie (OM) heeft de zaak in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het weigeren van een Spaans rechtshulpverzoek door PSV

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why PSV refused a Spanish legal assistance request to identify fans who humiliated beggars in Madrid, and what Dutch authorities would do to help Spanish prosecution. The minister replied that football clubs' stadium bans and criminal prosecution are separate tracks that can be used alongside each other, that Dutch justice will help Spain, and that PSV has since done further research and the request is being considered at administrative level.
After the Spanish judicial authorities indicated they would persist with the request, Dutch justice made a repeated demand to PSV to identify the football supporters concerned.

Nadat de Spaanse justitiële autoriteiten hebben aangegeven bij het verzoek te persisteren, heeft de Nederlandse justitie een herhaalde vordering gedaan aan PSV om de betreffende voetbalsupporters te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Vermeij over de afwijzing als Gamze Gül en de uitnodiging als Hanneke bij Pathé Arnhem

MPs Marcouch and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Pathé Arnhem rejecting Gamze Gül but inviting 'Hanneke' with identical application materials. The minister confirmed the facts as reported, said discrimination is unacceptable but that judging individual cases is for the ADV, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or courts, and described the Inspectie SZW's existing discrimination-team role and industry initiatives such as the Charter Diversiteit.
Given this division of competences, it is not for me to pass a substantive judgement on this or to hold Pathé to account for it.
Het is gelet op deze bevoegdheidsverdeling niet aan mij om hierover een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen dan wel Pathé hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over het bericht "Spoedoverleg over zakkenrollende asielzoekers"

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the State Secretary about a mayor's call for faster deportation of asylum seekers from safe countries who commit pickpocketing and other offences, and whether these offenders work in organised groups. The State Secretary answered that such persons should be rejected and removed quickly, that local authorities act and detain offenders, that organised-group cooperation could not be established, and referred to letters of 17 November and 13 December for the measures taken.
I share your view that persons who invoke the asylum procedure and related facilities on improper grounds should be rejected as quickly as possible and then leave the Netherlands.

Ik deel uw mening dat personen die op oneigenlijke gronden een beroep doen op de asielprocedure en de daarbij behorende voorzieningen, zo snel mogelijk moeten worden afgewezen en vervolgens Nederland moeten verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanhouding van een bejaarde Marokkaanse Nederlandse man

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the handcuffing and detention of an elderly Moroccan-Dutch man was disproportionate, and what would prevent recurrence. The Minister said that questions about the specific incident fall to the Amsterdam mayor, that police acted out of concern, apologised to the family, discussed the matter with the officers, and pointed to existing complaint routes and training on diversity and confused persons.
Answering specific questions about the incident falls under the responsibility of the mayor as the local competent authority.
Het beantwoorden van specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester als lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de uitzetting van een “haatimam” van België naar Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Justice Minister whether Belgium's expulsion of a Dutch-Moroccan imam, who has a Dutch nationality, is unwelcome and how his return to the Netherlands could be prevented or monitored. The minister answered that Dutch nationals cannot be refused entry or expelled, that no Dutch national-security threat is known, and that municipalities, police and prosecutors will closely monitor him and act against incitement.
I cannot go into how they do that.
Ik kan hier niet in gaan op welke wijze zij dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het niet behandelen van aangiften van discriminatie door het Openbaar Ministerie

MP Marcouch asked the Justice Minister why roughly three quarters of discrimination complaints are not handled by the Public Prosecution Service, how this fits the Aanwijzing Discriminatie, and whether a planned revision lowers expectations. The minister answered that most complaints never reach the OM for evidential or other reasons, acknowledged that two cases were left unhandled through an omission, and said the Aanwijzing is being revised because it expires, not to lower standards.
That this did not happen in two cases mentioned in the RTL Nieuws report is an omission with no policy considerations behind it.
Dat dit niet is geschied in twee in het bericht van RTL Nieuws genoemde zaken is een omissie waaraan geen beleidsoverweging ten grondslag heeft gelegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over meer bevoegdheden om raddraaiers beter te kunnen oppakken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and mayors should gain new powers, such as preventive detention or 24-hour administrative holding, to take troublemakers off the streets before public order is disrupted. The minister answered that existing powers (administrative holding, emergency ordinances, area bans, criminal law) are sufficient, that the Zaanstad mayor already restored order with current tools, and that no expansion is planned.
No, there are sufficient other options to restore order and calm, see the previous answers.
Nee, er zijn voldoende andere mogelijkheden om de orde en rust te herstellen, zie de vorige antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over vechtende voetbalhooligans

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about secret fights between football hooligans, whether they resemble the 1997 Beverwijk fight in which a man died, and whether clubs share responsibility. The minister says the scale is unknown but appears limited to a few incidents, that the fights are less comparable to Beverwijk, that clubs should take a stand, and that participants commit a crime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Fokke over het bericht dat de politie in Maastricht een incident met drie drag queens niet serieus genomen zou hebben

MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Maastricht failed to act seriously when three drag queens were harassed by youths, and how such incidents are handled. The minister replied that questions about the local case belong with the mayor, noted that police are willing to discuss perceived bias, and said a meeting took place between police and COC Maastricht.
Specific questions about the incident in Maastricht can therefore be put to the local authority.
Specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval in Maastricht kunnen dan ook worden gesteld aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over problemen in een Zaandamse wijk

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about intimidation of a film crew and criminal disturbances in the Poelenburg district of Zaandam, including reports to police, arrests, and whether the situation is representative. The minister answered that 40 reports and 21 arrests related to the unrest were recorded over three months, that the local authority acted decisively, and that the district is not representative of the whole neighbourhood.
I do not make statements about reports by individual persons or parties.
Over aangiftes van individuele personen of partijen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Asante over een ernstig incident bij een ontgroening in Groningen

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Asante asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a serious injury during a Groningen student hazing and whether criminal prosecution, victim reporting, and a 25,000 euro confidentiality fine clause in a student association contract are legally valid. The Minister said mistreatment is condemnable, the public prosecutor opened an ex officio investigation, the association filed a report, and the confidentiality fine is a civil, not criminal, sanction that can be contested or moderated.
While this investigation is ongoing, I will not make substantive statements.
Lopende dit onderzoek doe ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de door Turkije verspreide lijst van zogenaamde Gülenorganisaties in Nederland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the government about a list of Dutch organisations labelled as Gülen-linked that Turkey's state news agency circulated, and whether the government would act against Turkish interference and protect those named. The Minister of Foreign Affairs condemned such lists, said he had conveyed to Turkish officials that direct interference in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to letters and the government's existing protection arrangements for those under threat.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating in any form, regardless of who is on them.
Het kabinet keurt ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm dan ook en ongeacht wie daarop staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over overlast van hangjongeren in Maassluis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police, budget cuts and the creation of the national police cause youth nuisance in Maassluis, whether police should do more, and how reports and 112 response times were handled. The minister rejects a direct causal link, says all reports (8) are being investigated under OM direction with 5 suspects arrested, and states the 15-minute response norm for emergency calls.
This week all victims will again be informed by the police about the status of their reports.
Deze week worden alle slachtoffers nogmaals door de politie op de hoogte gebracht over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot hun aangiften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over spanningen binnen de Turkse gemeenschap in Nederland

An MP asked ministers about attacks on a Turkish mosque and intimidation of a Kurdish family, possible cross-border involvement, and tensions between Turkish, Kurdish and Alevi communities, and what was being done about reported incidents. The minister answered that criminal investigations are ongoing and details cannot be shared, that incidents are reported to police rather than a central registry, and that dialogue meetings with community organisations continue.
In the interest of this ongoing investigation, no further substantive statements can be made.
In het belang van dit lopende onderzoek kunnen geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over bedreigingen en geweld tegen de Hizmet gemeenschap in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers about threats and violence against the Hizmet community in the Netherlands and what the government was doing to register, investigate and protect targets and to address online hate. The ministers answered that police handle criminal cases, that a special police team now collects reports, that local authorities bear primary responsibility with national support available, and that agreements exist with social media companies.
Given the large concentration of reports in the Rotterdam unit, it was decided to temporarily set up a special team at the police for this purpose.
Gezien de grote concentratie van aangiften in de eenheid Rotterdam is besloten om hiervoor tijdelijk een speciaal team in het leven te roepen bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked ministers to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on unintended loss of Dutch nationality, including whether government informed citizens adequately and whether nationality law should change. The government largely rejects the claim of inadequate information, pointing to past campaigns and its website, promises to examine how outreach can be more active, and says it cannot yet judge the report's findings on nationality law.
On the basis of the recommendations in this report, I will examine whether that information can be made even more active and targeted.
Aan de hand van de aanbevelingen van dit rapport zal ik onderzoeken of die voorlichting nog actiever en gerichter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en van Dekken over de ‘Soldiers of Odin’

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about the Soldiers of Odin group, a far-right street patrol in Winschoten, including whether a man allegedly assaulted by the group had been properly investigated and whether the police response was too lenient. The minister answered that the group is limited in size, opposes intimidation, that police investigated the injuries and the man's conduct, and that no criminal offences were yet established.
Intimidating or discriminating against groups or persons is prohibited.
Het intimideren en/of discrimineren van groepen of personen is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Maij en Marcouch over het bericht “Frontman Pegida Nederland jaagt in Bulgarije op vluchtelingen”

MPs Kuiken, Maij and Marcouch asked whether a Dutch Pegida frontman hunting refugees in Bulgaria is a matter for private citizens, whether his conduct is punishable, whether a private army is criminal, and whether a passport ban could apply. The minister replied that border control is for the competent authorities, he has no knowledge beyond media reports, Dutch criminal law may apply extraterritorially under article 7 Sr, and he sees no current grounds for passport revocation.
I am not aware of the activities of the Dutch man mentioned in the report, other than what emerges from media coverage.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de activiteiten van de in het bericht genoemde Nederlandse man, anders dan uit de berichtgeving in de media naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het antiracisme advies van de Europese Commissie tegen Racisme en Intolerantie (ECRI)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about ECRI's 2016 report criticising the Netherlands on anti-racism policy, follow-up to its 2013 recommendations, racism as a sentencing aggravator, and exploitation of temporary agency workers. The minister replied that the government sees the report as useful, rejects a separate anti-racism strategy in favour of a broad anti-discrimination programme, sees no need for racism as a statutory aggravating factor because prosecutors already seek 50-100% higher sentences, and relies on self-regulation of the temp sector rather than licence withdrawal.
The cabinet regards the ECRI report as a valuable instrument for improving citizens' protection against discrimination.
Het kabinet beschouwt het ECRI rapport als een waardevol instrument om de bescherming van burgers tegen discriminatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Marcouch over huuropzegging wegens langdurig verblijf in het buitenland

MPs De Vries and Marcouch asked the Minister for Housing about tenancy terminations for long stays abroad, including the term 'housing fraud', the grounds for dissolving leases, the lack of statutory minimum occupancy rules, information for tenants, and risk of arbitrary enforcement. The minister answered that the term has no legal consequence, that landlords set occupancy rules contractually and courts decide case by case, and that no new regulation is needed.
I see no need to introduce further regulation on this point.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om op dit punt met nadere regelgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch, Yücel en Van Dekken over onveiligheid voor  homo's en lesbiennes

MPs asked the Justice Minister about insecurity for gay men and lesbians in nightlife, reports that incidents were not reported to police, and how reporting rates would be raised. The minister confirmed that 30.2% of gay men and lesbians feel unsafe near nightlife venues, said the police is improving the reporting process and training, and listed a campaign and Roze in Blauw networks to increase reporting.
Reports arising from such incidents must be taken seriously.
Aangiften n.a.v. dergelijke incidenten dienen serieus genomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over onderzoek naar het overlijden van een man in Groningen in 1990

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a 1990 death in Groningen, reported as possibly a killing, could still be prosecuted and whether new information justifies reopening the case. The minister answered that no indications of murder exist, the 2005 closure was based on investigative findings, doodslag would be time-barred, and there is no reason to reopen.
The investigation was closed by the Public Prosecution Service in 2005 due to the lack of sufficient investigative indications.
Het onderzoek is in 2005 door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) gesloten vanwege het ontbreken van voldoende opsporingsindicaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanpak van Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the approach to Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs, including case numbers, whether OMGs can be barred or required to obtain certificates, and whether the law should make banning them easier. The minister promised to report on case figures later and said the civil ban route is complex and slow, with the outcome uncertain; he declined to commit to a legislative change for now.
As promised in the police committee meeting of 19 April, I will inform your House more fully about the approach to motorcycle gangs before the planned general meeting on organised crime on 16 June.
Ik zal, zoals toegezegd in het AO Politie van 19 april jl., uw Kamer vóór het geplande algemeen overleg georganiseerde criminaliteit op 16 juni a.s, nader informeren over de aanpak van motorbendes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat de Haagse politie een rapport over discriminatie zou hebben gemanipuleerd

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Hague police manipulated a study on discrimination and whether the government misinformed parliament about the research on ethnic profiling. The minister denied misinforming parliament, said the research was not designed to be a ministry study, and stated that the study had value but no further investigation is planned given other ongoing reports.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Gemaskerd protest tegen ‘asielfabriek’

Two MPs asked whether the Kameraadschap Noord-Nederland demonstrations against an asylum centre were legally notified, whether masked participants can be restricted, and whether they can be asked for ID. The minister answered that the group is extreme-right, that Oldambt required notice for one demonstration, that the mayor could impose mask bans and issued an emergency order, and that police may request ID when there is a good reason.

This emergency order requires demonstrators wearing face-covering clothing in Winschoten to keep away from, or be removed on first police instruction from, the gathering before, during and after the event, until 23.00.

In dit noodbevel is voorzien in een verplichting voor demonstranten met gezichtsbedekkende kleding die zich in Winschoten bevinden om zich voor, tijdens en na de bijeenkomst op eerste aanzegging van de politie verwijderd te houden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat aan Turken in Nederland om beledigingen te melden

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked ministers about a Turkish consulate call for Turks in the Netherlands to report insults against Turkey, its president and flag, and whether this undermines free speech and intimidates critics. The government response is a cross-reference to a letter answering a related Karabulut question, so the substance is not given in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over geweld in het amateurvoetbal

Two MPs asked whether violence in amateur football is increasing and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that police and KNVB figures show no clear upward trend, that incidents still occur, and that the safer sports action plan will be continued with added support for at-risk clubs.
On the basis of the available figures, there is so far no sign of an increase in violence in amateur football.
Op basis van de beschikbare cijfers lijkt van een stijging van geweld in het amateurvoetbal vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een mishandeling van een lesbisch stel in Groningen

The MP asks the Justice Minister about a violent assault on a lesbian couple in Groningen, the role of Roze in Blauw police teams, and how to tackle anti-gay harassment and under-reporting. The minister condemns the incident, says the mayor's contact with victims is a municipal matter, reports 19 sexual-orientation complaints to the Groningen discrimination reporting point in 2015, and commits to continued campaigns to raise reporting willingness.
Information on police reports of discrimination will be provided to the House of Representatives through the national police discrimination figures report, expected before the summer.

Over de aangiften bij de politie wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd via de landelijke politierapportage over discriminatiecijfers, die naar verwachting voor de zomer aan de Tweede Kamer zal worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Wie is wie in de Amsterdamse Mocro-oorlog?”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a news report on criminal violence in the Amsterdam underworld involving many suspects of Moroccan origin, and whether police information positions and the share of police officers of Moroccan origin could be improved. The minister declined to comment on ongoing investigations, said police do not record ethnicity but noted the importance of intelligence and diversity programmes, and stated that promotion depends on several competencies, not seniority alone.
Since the question is directed at ongoing investigation, I cannot make further substantive statements about it.
Nu de vraagstelling gericht is op lopend onderzoek, kan ik hier geen verdere inhoudelijke uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie bij het zoeken van stageplaatsen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about reports that vocational students, especially girls wearing headscarves and boys of Moroccan background, face discrimination when seeking internships, and what schools, employers and the government will do. The minister acknowledged the problem as unacceptable, announced City Deal measures, a study with the SBB, and said students can report discrimination, though no formal parliamentary-oversight change is proposed.
Discrimination in finding an internship is unacceptable and unacceptable.
Discriminatie bij het vinden van een stage is onaanvaardbaar en onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over nepwapens

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about replica firearms that look like real guns and the police response they trigger. The State Secretary answered that police seized 125 and 140 such items in 2014 and 2015, that the Toy Directive limits national options, and that current airsoft rules are considered adequate, without committing to new measures.
I do not consider it appropriate to call the Toy Directive into question.
Ik acht het niet aan de orde om de Speelgoedrichtlijn ter discussie stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Marcouch over passagiers die grote vertraging hebben opgelopen op Schiphol door een overboekt vliegtuig

MPs Monasch and Marcouch asked the state secretary about passengers held for hours on an Air Arabia flight from Amsterdam to Nador, and how compensation, enforcement and in-flight care are handled. The government answered that a sudden crew illness forced offloading of 21 passengers on a voluntary basis, that the ILT found no violation, and that the ILT enforces the EU passenger rights regulation through complaints and inspections.
Based on the information currently available, the ILT has found no violation, so enforcement action is not at issue.
Op basis van de nu beschikbare informatie heeft de ILT geen overtreding geconstateerd, daarom is optreden niet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van transportcriminaliteit door de Nationale Politie (ingezonden 25 februari 2016).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about conflicting reports on cargo theft, underreporting, violence and organised roaming gangs, and whether the disbanded Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit left enforcement weaker. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, denied that the team was abolished (its work continues under Team Vervoer en Transport and the Landelijke Eenheid), and described the current enforcement set-up.
It is a misunderstanding that the Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit has been abolished.
Het is een misverstand dat het Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit is opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over oerwoudgeluiden bij Harkemase boys

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about racist shouting by a supporter toward a dark-skinned player at an amateur football match, whether such incidents are frequent, and what the Safe Sport programme does to prevent them. The minister condemned the behaviour, said no figures exist on amateur incidents, pointed to reporting channels, and described the KNVB-HALT action plan and monitoring results showing reduced feelings of insecurity.
No figures are available on how often incidents of this kind occur on amateur football pitches.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal keer dat incidenten van deze aard plaatsvinden op het amateurveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over wangedrag van zichzelf voetbalsupporter noemende Nederlanders in Madrid

MPs asked how the government views Dutch football supporters' misconduct in Madrid, whether mayors can impose liberty-restricting measures under article 172a of the Municipalities Act for racist behaviour, and when the new football-violence law takes effect. The minister said Spanish authorities lead, the club has issued stadium bans, mayors decide on individual measures, and the law has applied since 1 July 2015, extending the available powers.
It is up to the mayor of the municipality from which a person originates to determine whether there is cause to impose a measure under the Municipalities Act.
Het is aan de burgemeester van de gemeente waaruit een persoon afkomstig is om te bepalen of er aanleiding is om een maatregel op grond van de Gemeentewet op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een nazistisch “pamflet” dat aan moskeeën in Nederland is gestuurd

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a Nazi-themed pamphlet with anti-Islam text sent to many mosques, how many mosques received it, and what was being done about its authors and the safety of mosques. The minister confirmed the pamphlet is condemnable, reported 33 mosques had filed complaints, said the OM considers it punishable and a criminal investigation is ongoing, and committed to renewed talks with mosque leaders and heightened vigilance.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik hierover verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Marcouch en Servaes over het bericht dat Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland zich uit breidt

PvdA MPs asked whether Eritrean regime-linked intimidation and extortion of diaspora members in the Netherlands is known, what action is taken, and whether the Eritrean embassy was confronted and funds traced. The minister answered that the government knows of the reports, has not found evidence of Eritrean support to Al-Shabaab, held a warning meeting with the Eritrean ambassador, and that police and prosecutors investigate concrete suspicions of crimes, while no overview of incidents exists.
There is no overview of the number of incidents in relation to the Eritrean regime.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal incidenten in relatie tot het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de uitspraak van een gemeenteraadslid dat de Islam “weggevaagd” mag worden

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hague councillor's statement that Islam may be wiped away, asking whether criminal law applies, whether a complaint was filed, and whether the law on group insult should cover religion. Minister Van der Steur replied that the municipality distanced itself from polarising statements, a complaint was filed on 8 February and is being studied by the Public Prosecution Service, and that case law shows such statements may be criminal depending on circumstances, so no change to the law is needed.
A complaint was filed on 8 February, and this complaint is currently being studied by the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Op 8 februari jl. is aangifte gedaan, deze aangifte wordt momenteel door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het aanvallen van een scheidsrechter door spelers van de voetbalclub Nieuw Sloten

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a complaint had been filed over football players of Nieuw Sloten attacking a referee, whether the Public Prosecution Service would prosecute, and whether the KNVB was investigating. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the OM decided not to prosecute given the seriousness, the referee's wish not to file, and the club withdrawing the team, and that the KNVB disciplinary investigation is ongoing with players suspended.
The Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute ex officio, given the seriousness of what occurred.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft besloten niet ambtshalve tot vervolging over te gaan, vanwege de ernst van hetgeen dat is voorgevallen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het ontslaan van leden van Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs (OMG)

An MP asked the ministers whether municipalities can dismiss civil servants who belong to Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs, and whether membership is incompatible with public employment. The minister answered that dismissal requires concrete conduct linked to the function and prior dialogue, that the government considers such membership undesirable, and that a civil-law ban on OMGs is being assessed by the Public Prosecution Service.
Before imposing a disciplinary measure or initiating a dismissal procedure, it is reasonable for the employer to talk with the civil servant about membership and about keeping distance from the OMG.

Alvorens over te gaan tot het opleggen van een disciplinaire maatregel of het in gang zetten van een ontslagprocedure, ligt het overigens in de rede dat de werkgever met de ambtenaar in gesprek gaat over het lidmaatschap en over afstand houden van de OMG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over de hoge salarissen van de top bij de politie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police leadership salaries exceeding a minister's pay, whether the 2013 request to waive part of salaries was honored, and whether the top can be made to lower incomes. The minister answered that no top officials exceeded the WNT salary norm in 2013 or 2014, that no legal means exist to force reductions for non-top staff, and that he is willing to talk with the officials concerned.
Legal possibilities are therefore lacking to enforce a reduction.
Juridische mogelijkheden ontbreken derhalve om verlaging af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over het bericht dat de nieuwe korpschef van de Nationale Politie € 75.000 compensatie voor salarisverlies krijgt

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Marcouch asked about the reported €75,000 compensation for salary loss given to the new national police chief, and why it was paid as a severance under the civil service rules rather than a WNT exception. The ministers answered that it is a discretionary payment under the civil service regulation capped at €75,000 by the WNT, justified by the public interest in filling the post quickly, with any further compensation to be arranged within police employment rules.
In order to remove this obstacle, it was examined whether there was a possibility to compensate.
Ten einde deze belemmering weg te nemen, is bezien of er een mogelijkheid was te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het rapport Racisme, antisemitisme en extreemrechts geweld in Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reported rise in racist incidents, the low level of prosecution and conviction for discrimination offences, and whether crimes with a discriminatory aspect are properly registered. The Minister acknowledged the rise in police-registered incidents, attributed it partly to changed registration methods and possibly greater reporting willingness, and gave prosecution figures while noting data limitations and no concrete new measures beyond an upcoming action programme.
The cabinet is making efforts to prevent and combat racism.
Het kabinet spant zich in om racisme te voorkomen en te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Marcouch inzake het bericht dat er voor een docent geen ruimte op school is om te bidden

MPs Ypma and Marcouch asked whether a praying teacher being unwelcome at a Rijswijk public school sends children the message that their identity is unwelcome and pushes families toward separate religious schooling. The State Secretary said the school states it is open to all, that such exclusion would be unacceptable if it occurred, that schools must ensure social safety, and that public and denominational schools coexist.
I cannot assess whether in this case the teacher was indeed not welcome.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of het in deze zaak inderdaad zo is dat de docent niet welkom was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie van jongeren bij het vinden van een bijbaan of stageplaats

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked ministers about discrimination against young people, including migrant youth, when seeking part-time jobs or internships, and about the measures taken. The minister acknowledged that discrimination is unacceptable and that migrant youth need more applications for internships, described programmes such as the City Deal, Werkakkoorden and training initiatives, and said the anti-discrimination action programme would be updated in early 2016.
The revision of the action programme will work across specific policy tracks.
De herijking van het actieprogramma zal overkoepelend werken ten aanzien van specifieke beleidstrajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers about the tendering of forensic medical care and forensic investigation by the National Police, including whether the process was stalled, who provides the care, and whether tendering should be avoided until legal safeguards are in place. The minister answered that the tender was halted in July because no bidder met the requirements, existing contracts are being extended, and the police are deciding on next steps while maintaining that current arrangements sufficiently safeguard forensic medicine.
The police are currently deliberating on the follow-up to the halted tender procedure.
De politie beraadt zich op dit moment over het vervolg op de gestaakte aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over Ajax-fans die gedupeerd worden door antisemitische uitlatingen van anderen

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about antisemitic chants at a football match and whether an KNVB sanction that let FC Utrecht fans sit elsewhere in the stadium undermined the fight against antisemitism. The minister replied that the sanction was legally applied, that no perpetrators could be identified for criminal prosecution, and that a zero-tolerance policy already exists.
I understand that FC Utrecht has decided to allow the supporters of the Bunnikside to take seats elsewhere.
Ik heb begrepen dat FC Utrecht besloten heeft de supporters van de Bunnikside in de gelegenheid te stellen elders plaats te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over bedreigingen, geweldsdelicten en brandstichtingen gericht tegen Turkse of Koerdische buurthuizen

Marcouch asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about threats, violence and arson against Turkish or Kurdish community centres, and whether Turkish-Kurdish tensions are spilling over to the Netherlands. The minister said police do not record incidents by target type so no reliable figures exist, described tensions linked to Turkey and outlined dialogue efforts and possible security measures.
The police record numbers of incidents such as threats, violent offences and arson, but do not routinely record which type of object they were directed against.
De politie registreert aantallen incidenten zoals bedreigingen, geweldsdelicten en brandstichtingen, maar registreert daarbij niet standaard tegen welk soort objecten dit is gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Volp over het bericht dat de politie dagelijks met levensgevaarlijke chemicaliën werkt

MPs Marcouch and Volp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police dismantling illegal drug labs face life-threatening conditions, including work weeks of 60 hours, staffing levels of the LFO team, and whether a safety analysis was done. The Minister confirmed the 2014 Inspectorate re-inspection report, attached it with correspondence, referred to earlier answers for substance, and said a mandatory safety analysis has since been carried out for LFO work.
As requested, I am sending you the report and the accompanying correspondence as an annex to these answers.
Zoals gevraagd doe ik u als bijlage bij deze antwoorden het rapport en de begeleidende correspondentie toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat agrariërs in Eemnes een auto met drie Marokkaanse jongens hebben geblokkeerd

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether farmers in Eemnes blocking a car with three Moroccan youths, and alerting police, amounted to suspicion based on ethnicity and whether the minister would discuss this with the mayor. The minister relayed the mayor's account that the car was parked suspiciously at night, the road was not actually blocked, police checked the occupants, and declined a meeting, leaving public order to local authority.
It is up to the local authority to maintain public order and up to the municipal council to exchange views with the mayor on this if desired.
Het is aan het lokale gezag om de openbare orde te handhaven en aan de gemeenteraad om hier desgewenst met de burgemeester over van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Marcouch over de gewelddadige dood van een vrouw uit Waalwijk

MPs Rebel and Marcouch ask the Minister of Security and Justice how police handled reports and complaints of threats, stalking and domestic violence before a woman from Waalwijk was killed, and whether it was linked to shelter capacity, police capacity or the lack of a protocol. The minister answers that police assess each case, that there is no evidence of cuts to women's shelters, that recruitment and capacity have grown, and that no additional protocol or investigation is needed beyond planned victim-protection implementation.
I therefore do not consider an additional protocol necessary.
Ik acht een aanvullend protocol dan ook niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie dat het verplichte basisexamen inburgering gezinshereniging ‘onmogelijk of uiterst moeilijk’ maakt

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the State Secretary whether the mandatory civic integration exam for family reunification, as held by the EU Court of Justice to make reunification impossible or extremely difficult, breaches EU law, and how the government will respond on the hardship clause and exam costs. Minister Asscher answered that the Council of State will decide the case after the summer, that the government will set its position afterwards, and that it is not opportune to make policy choices ahead of that outcome.
I do not consider it opportune to make a policy choice in advance of the outcome of this procedure.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om vooruitlopend op de uitkomst van deze procedure een beleidskeuze te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over allochtone studenten die volgens de stagemonitor minder stagevergoeding krijgen en vaker moeten solliciteren voor ze een stageplek vinden

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether the National Internship Monitor shows that students with foreign-born parents receive lower internship pay, must apply more often, and get lower grades, and whether this amounts to discrimination, and what institutions and employers should do. The minister answers that the monitor shows more applications and lower pay for this group but cannot establish systematic differences or discrimination given sample and confounder gaps, acknowledges possible discrimination as a serious concern, and points to existing policy programmes and a forthcoming ROA study without committing to new concrete action.
On the basis of this monitor I cannot establish whether allochtone students are discriminated against in internships.
Op basis van deze monitor kan ik niet vast stellen of allochtone studenten worden gediscrimineerd bij stages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het bericht dat listige jihadloverboys piepjonge meisjes inpalmen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that jihadist 'loverboys' groom young girls for marriage and travel to the caliphate, asking for numbers, the role of advisory bodies, and the legal tools available. The minister answered that signals exist and some cases involve possible grooming, but declined to give numbers due to ongoing investigations, and described existing criminal law, school support and prevention measures.
The Public Prosecution Service will not make further statements about these ongoing investigations and concrete numbers because of investigative and prosecution interests.
Over deze lopende onderzoeken en concrete aantallen doet het OM geen nadere mededelingen vanwege opsporings- en vervolgingsbelangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over concrete ervaringen van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked ministers about a reported case of a qualified Moroccan-origin applicant being rejected in favour of a less experienced candidate, and about discrimination in hiring generally. The government answered that complaints go to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, courts or police, that the Inspectie SZW only supervises employer anti-discrimination policy and not recruitment, and that it set up a new team on labour-market discrimination without committing to a wider role.
No police records specifically on discrimination in job applications can be derived from the police systems.
Aan de politiesystemen zijn geen aangiftecijfers specifiek over discriminatie bij sollicitaties te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over concrete ervaringen van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that a man was turned away by police when trying to file a discrimination complaint after applying for jobs under different names. The minister acknowledged the officer wrongly refused the report, said police contact him for a new appointment, and stated that complaints must be taken seriously and officers are trained on discrimination law.
When he told the police station that he had applied under different names, the police officer wrongly stated that they could not take a report about this.

Toen hij op het politiebureau vertelde dat hij onder verschillende namen heeft gesolliciteerd, heeft de betrokken politieambtenaar ten onrechte aangegeven dat zij hier geen aangifte over op kon nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de verkoop van voetbalkaartjes via Marktplaats

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about the resale of football tickets on Marktplaats, including security risks, price inflation, fraud and the powers of clubs and the KNVB to stop it. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the KNVB can cancel invalid tickets and impose stadium bans, and concludes that further government intervention does not appear necessary for now.
No, this does not appear to be necessary for now.
Nee, dit lijkt vooralsnog niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over radicalisering in de Somalische gemeenschap

An MP asked the ministers about radicalisation in the Somali community, including returns to Somalia and whether Dutch Somalis radicalise there. The minister said no return figures or reasons are systematically recorded, radicalisation abroad cannot be ruled out, and prevention work such as the POLRAD project is ongoing.
The reasons for their return are not recorded by the government, because there is no ground or reason to do so.
De redenen voor hun terugkeer worden niet door de overheid geregistreerd, omdat hier geen grond of aanleiding voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de vervolging van politieagenten na een schietincident

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers who shot people should always be investigated by the Rijksrecherche, whether they can be prosecuted for disproportionate force, and whether the legal status of officers using firearms should be changed. The minister confirmed mandatory Rijksrecherche investigation and prosecution possibilities, argued officers face a fundamentally different situation from civilians, and announced a broader review of the legal position of officers who use force, with a letter to parliament before the Christmas recess.
In investigating and assessing force applied by the state, any appearance of partiality must be avoided.
Bij het onderzoek naar en het toetsen van het van overheidswege toegepaste geweld moet elke schijn van partijdigheid worden vermeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het aanpakken van overlastgevers met een koopwoning

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the rules for evicting nuisance-causing owner-occupiers should match those for tenants, as Amsterdam's mayor wished. The minister said nuisance cases are handled the same regardless of ownership, acknowledged Amsterdam's call for more instruments, and offered talks while noting strict human-rights limits on eviction.
I am willing to discuss this with the municipality of Amsterdam and other municipalities.
Ik ben graag bereid daar met de gemeente Amsterdam en andere gemeenten over te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de bezetting van een moskee in Leiden

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the occupation of a mosque in Leiden by Identitair Verzet, the consequences of such actions for Muslim organisations, and the threat of right-wing extremism. The minister answered that the occupation led to a penalty order for unlawful entry on a construction site, that vandalism near the mosque site cannot be linked to its construction, and that the government condemns the action and is in contact with the mosque and partners.
The cabinet strongly condemns the action and understands the unrest that has arisen.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de actie sterk en heeft begrip voor de onrust die is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over voetbalgeweld door zichzelf Feyenoord-supporters noemende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked about Dutch Feyenoord supporters rioting in Rome, Dutch mayors' powers to impose restrictions for conduct abroad, EU options to deport or ban convicted hooligans, Italian fine enforcement, and Engeland's travel bans. The government answered that mayors may consider foreign conduct under art. 172a Gemeentewet, that EU deportation is limited to genuine threats to public order, that Italy may seek Dutch help on fines after judgments become final, and that it will raise an international stadium ban in EU and Council of Europe fora.
I will ask the European Union and the Council of Europe to pay attention to establishing an international stadium ban and to explore other options to prevent hooligans from causing problems abroad.

Ik vraag binnen de Europese Unie en de Raad van Europa aandacht voor het tot stand brengen van een internationaal stadionverbod en voor het onderzoeken van andere mogelijkheden om te voorkomen dat hooligans in het buitenland voor problemen zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Jacobi over de aanwezigheid van de politie in Friesland

MPs Marcouch and Jacobi asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police response times and presence in Friesland, including missed 15-minute targets in the North Netherlands unit and whether police posts had closed. The minister confirmed the target was missed in 2014 but improving since 2012, listed measures taken, said no posts in Friesland had closed since 2012, and stated that cell facilities on the Wadden islands exist for the first six hours with transfer to the mainland beyond that.
Yes, the police target standard was not met in North Netherlands in 2014.
Ja, de streefnorm van de politie is in Noord-Nederland in 2014 niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over Kamervragen ECRI rapport over Griekenland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about the Council of Europe ECRI report on rising hostility toward migrants in Greece, including violence and whether the EU should act. The minister confirmed the report's findings on rising racist incidents linked to Golden Dawn, described the Greek government's response and that the new government had not yet formulated migration policy, and said the Netherlands supports EU rule-of-law and anti-discrimination initiatives without seeing a broad EU-wide rise in xenophobia.
Non-discrimination forms part of the fundamental EU values as laid down in Article 2 of the Treaty on European Union.
Non-discriminatie maakt onderdeel uit van de fundamentele EU-waarden zoals neergelegd in artikel 2 van het Verdrag betreffende de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Spoorloos verdwenen na jaren van gedwongen isolement’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a report of a woman who disappeared after years of forced isolation, asking about prior warning signs, a 'cover-up culture', non-cooperation, and the welfare of her children. The minister declined to give details on prior signals and the criminal investigation, described the wider collectivist-culture risks in general terms, and stated that no information about child protection measures could be given.
I cannot provide information on this because of the interests of investigation and prosecution connected to the criminal investigation into this case mentioned in my answer to question 4.
Hierover kan ik geen mededelingen doen vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging die verbonden zijn aan het in mijn antwoord op vraag 4 genoemde strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over nepwapens

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether removing the ban on toy guns resembling real firearms (due to the EU Toy Safety Directive) allows such toys to be sold and carried in the Netherlands, and whether safety should prevent their sale. The minister answered that such toys may be sold and carried unless they are classed as weapons by intent, that there is no national data on incidents with replica guns, and that the EU directive cannot be reopened.
A European directive is binding on all member states.
Een Europese richtlijn is bindend voor alle lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Mohandis over de aanpak van radicalisering en de handelingsverlegenheid van scholen om de actualiteit naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenissen in Parijs bespreekbaar te maken in d

MPs Marcouch and Mohandis asked how the government addresses radicalisation and why schools struggle to discuss the Paris attacks in class, including training, teaching materials and teacher education. The minister answers that schools are expected to act on their civic mandate, that training and portals exist, that a Jihadism intervention team is being discussed with municipalities, and that further studies and reports will follow.
We will return to this in the spring when we report on progress on citizenship education.
Wij zullen hier nader op ingaan als we in het voorjaar rapporteren over de voortgang op burgerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over agenten die hun eigen DNA niet willen afstaan

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why around 300 police officers, including forensic detectives, have not given their DNA to the forensic elimination database, and what is being done about it. The minister answered that participation is voluntary under Article 11 of the Constitution, that a new uniform privacy regulation has been adopted, and that supervisors will approach the remaining officers, without planning further measures.
From the right to bodily integrity, laid down in Article 11 of the Constitution, it follows that DNA material may only be taken with the explicit consent of the employee.

Uit het recht op onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam, neergelegd in artikel 11 van de Grondwet, wordt afgeleid dat de afname van DNA-materiaal slechts met uitdrukkelijke toestemming van de medewerker mag plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch over het bericht dat allochtone daders een grotere kans op een zware straf hebben

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about research showing foreign-origin offenders face a higher chance of prison sentences, and whether judges may be discriminating. Minister Opstelten answered that the differences largely disappear after controlling for factors such as prior record and employment, so no conclusion of judicial bias can be drawn, while the Judiciary Council has commissioned further research including talks with judges.
It cannot be concluded from this that judges, consciously or unconsciously, take the ethnic background of the suspect into account.
Hieruit kan niet afgeleid worden dat rechters, bewust of onbewust, rekening houden met de etnische achtergrond van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de opname van aangiftes naar aanleiding van de twee incidenten afgelopen weken tegen vrouwen met een moslimachtergrond

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police recorded complaints about two attacks on Muslim women in Almere thoroughly, including the discriminatory background, and what is done to instruct officers and prevent discrimination cases going unprosecuted. The minister replied that the complaints were recorded as assault with discriminatory remarks noted in one case, described police training and a discrimination network, and announced a study of discrimination cases in the criminal justice chain due end 2015.
The account of the complainant is leading when taking the complaint and its write-up in the official report.
Het verhaal van de aangever/aangeefster is leidend bij het opnemen van de aangifte en de uitwerking in het proces verbaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over het bericht “Bomalarm op station Leiden door misverstand”

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked about a bomb alarm at Leiden Central station caused by a camera rig hung there by a media agency's technician for ad-viewing measurement. The government described the sequence of events, said NS had been aware of the test but failed to communicate it internally, rejected that anyone acted knowingly, and found no criminal offence.
The incident must therefore be regarded as an unwise action combined with poor communication.
Het gebeurde moet dan ook beschouwd worden als een onverstandige actie in combinatie met gebrekkige communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat met software criminaliteit kan worden voorspeld

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam predictive policing software CAS reduces crime, whether it should be rolled out nationally, and about burglary figures and local innovation. The minister said predictive policing is promising, that pilots will be studied, and gave burglary counts for 2010-2014 while declining to answer the questions in time for the scheduled debate.
I therefore consider it worthwhile to examine whether predictive policing can have the same effect in the Netherlands and which preconditions apply.
Ik vind het daarom zinvol om te bezien of predictive policing in Nederland eenzelfde effect kan hebben en welke randvoorwaarden hierbij gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de politievakbond zijn vriendin via het ministerie van V&J aan een baan hielp

MP Marcouch asked Minister Opstelten whether the head of the police union ACP secured a job for his girlfriend on the Cultuurmonitor research team, whether this conflict of interest was overlooked, and related questions on the monitor's origins, procurement, and publication. The minister answered that the partner was added by the independent researcher, that procurement rules were followed at EUR 87,500, and that the instrument was not used after the steering group rejected it, with a new approach commissioned under WODC.
In the present case the latter procedure was properly followed.
In het onderhavige geval is de laatstgenoemde procedure ordentelijk gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat agenten onveilig zijn vanwege een gebrek aan training

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers feel unsafe due to insufficient training, citing a police union survey on shortages, cancelled lessons, sick leave and tests replacing real training. Minister Opstelten answered that officers receive sufficient training (raised to about 45 hours a year), that training is being developed from testing to practical preparation, that officers share responsibility for their own training, and that training is assessed in appraisal interviews.
No, I do not know it. It is up to the ACP to share this with me, possibly in regular contacts.
Ik ken deze niet. Het is aan de ACP om dit eventueel met mij in de reguliere contacten te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hoogland over voortdurende agressie tegen NS-personeel

Two MPs asked the government about persistent aggression against NS rail staff, including survey figures, prosecution rates and measures taken. The minister acknowledged the problem, gave differing incident figures, said police and prosecutors do not register NS-specific cases, and listed existing and planned measures.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS-personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het opsluiten van terroristen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked about criteria for placing terrorism suspects in a dedicated prison wing, whether such concentration causes radicalisation, and whether resocialisation is tailored. The State Secretary said placement follows Regeling SPOG criteria with periodic review via a multidisciplinary consultation, that individual regimes allow tailored treatment, and that no concrete evidence of radicalisation through grouping is known, while refusing to give exact figures for security reasons.
I cannot provide further information for security reasons.
Verdere mededelingen kan ik om veiligheidsredenen niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het bericht “Koper breekijzer in regio Ede krijgt aandacht politie”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in the Ede region monitor camera footage and sales records at hardware stores to track buyers of tools that could be used for burglaries, and on what legal basis and with what proportionality. The minister replied that stores voluntarily report suspicious purchases, police assess these tips under their general preventive task, privacy is not violated, and effectiveness will be evaluated over time.
So the police do not request footage or data.
Het is dus niet zo dat de politie beelden of gegevens vordert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marcouch over misbruik van de introducéregeling bij schietsportverenigingen

MPs Kooiman and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of the introducé rule at shooting clubs after a TV broadcast showed clubs still ignoring tightened rules, and about inspections, sanctions, certification and a national registration system. The Minister said he was disappointed, outlined sanctions (certificate withdrawal, police permit revocation), argued that additional inspections are unnecessary given the limited scale, and said a national registry lacks added value per the KNSA.
Given the limited scale of the problem and the measures already introduced, in my view there is no reason to deploy more quantitative supervision by the police and inspection visits by the KNSA.

Gelet op de beperkte omvang van de problematiek en de reeds ingevoerde maatregelen, is er naar mijn mening geen aanleiding méér kwantitatief toezicht door de politie en controlebezoeken door de KNSA in te zetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over ‘Niet méér, maar slimmer blauw op straat’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a PhD study claiming intelligence-led policing has not taken off, and about whether local priorities like public order risk being lost to numerical targets. The minister disputes that intelligence-led policing has failed, points to planned real-time intelligence centres and the 2015-2018 security agenda, and says numerical targets are set with local authorities.
The information discipline of the police will be strengthened in the coming years.
De informatiediscipline van de politie zal de komende jaren versterkt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat een relatief groot deel van de homo’s zich onveilig voelt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a quarter of gay men feel unsafe in their neighbourhood, including whether discrimination-related crimes against LHBT people are underpunished and how cooperation between security partners and the 'Roze in Blauw' approach are being handled. The minister acknowledged the higher insecurity among gay and lesbian respondents, pointed to a forthcoming discrimination progress letter and the Veiligheidsagenda 2015–2018, and largely described existing cooperation and policy without new binding commitments.

In the progress letter on Discrimination, to be sent to your House later this calendar year, I will report the most recent figures from the police and the Public Prosecution Service on discrimination.
In de voortgangsbrief Discriminatie, die nog in dit kalenderjaar aan uw Kamer zal worden gezonden, maak ik melding van de meest recente cijfers van de politie en het OM inzake discriminatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Marcouch over zijn aanpak om het aantal winkeldiefstallen te verminderen en de derving voor de retailers terug te dringen

MPs Oskam and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he will reduce shoplifting and the losses retailers suffer, and about the rules for sharing camera images of suspected shoplifters between shops and chains. The minister answered that no concrete reduction target can be set from the barometer, that sharing suspect data outside a corporate group requires prior review by the CBP, and that a draft bill and a sector protocol are in preparation.
Sharing images of (suspects of) shoplifting between entrepreneurs from different legal entities and groups is part of that.
Het uitwisselen van beelden van (verdachten van) winkeldiefstal tussen ondernemers uit verschillende rechtspersonen en groepen is daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over discriminerende opmerkingen op internet over Nederlandse profvoetballers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked ministers whether they would act on racist online comments about Dutch professional footballers and whether the victims had filed reports. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has opened a preliminary fact-finding inquiry, that MiND has forwarded five reports, and that he sees no need to direct the players or the KNVB to file complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service is opening a preliminary fact-finding inquiry to assess whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een oriënterend feitenonderzoek in om te beoordelen of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over criminaliteit veroorzaakt door “spookburgers”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the ministers about crime by 'ghost citizens' (unregistered residents) in Amsterdam and elsewhere, and about how to tackle it. The government answered that such crime exists in other municipalities, that the number of ghost citizens is at most 100,000 without indicating criminal involvement, that landlords have no duty to check registration, and that a RIEC Amsterdam project is being evaluated.
No (overview) information on this can be obtained from the existing registration systems.
Hierover is geen (overzichts-)informatie uit de bestaande registratiesystemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Jihadgemeenten eisen staatshulp’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about municipal demands for state support in tackling jihadism and returning fighters, including the Hague's call for coordination with central government, screening, and the placement of dangerous returnees in a detention facility for habitual offenders. The minister said the government consults mayors every six weeks, supports municipalities with expertise, and is still examining whether elements of the ISD programme could apply to returnees, without committing to a specific new measure.
At present I am examining whether it is possible to apply elements of the programme offered by the Inrichting Stelselmatige Daders (ISD measure) that address behavioural change to returnees
Momenteel bezie ik of het mogelijk is om elementen uit het programma-aanbod van de «Inrichting Stelselmatige Daders (ISD-maatregel)», die zien op gedragsverandering, toe te passen op terugkeerders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over de integratie van vluchtelingen naar aanleiding van de Integratiebarometer van Vluchtelingenwerk

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the poor labour-market and poverty outcomes of refugees shown in the Vluchtelingenwerk Integratiebarometer 2014, and whether current integration instruments and municipal support are adequate. The government acknowledges the weak outcomes, points to language, education and recognition gaps and to Somali refugees doing worst, and cites new labour-market orientation in civic integration from January 2015, but makes no concrete new commitments.
The civic integration policy was recently changed and needs time to prove itself.
Het inburgeringsbeleid is recent gewijzigd en heeft tijd nodig om zich te bewijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over extra maatregelen tegen autodiefstal

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked about a news report on car theft, rising theft numbers, police priority, a ban on sale of key duplicators and car-theft electronics, ANPR camera privacy rules, and online sale of moped tuning kits. The minister denied a rise in thefts, said a sales ban is legally hard to justify under proportionality and EU law, noted a pending bill allowing 28-day retention of ANPR passage data, and offered to consult the trade on other options.
A sales ban is very difficult if it cannot be shown that these systems have no other use than carrying out criminal activities.
Een verkoopverbod is erg lastig als niet kan worden aangetoond dat er geen enkel ander nut is voor dit soort systemen dan het uitoefenen van criminele activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de betrokkenheid van jihadisten  bij onderwijsorganisaties

Two MPs asked ministers about jihadist involvement in a private Arabic-language and Islamic education foundation, including oversight, funding and whether such bodies can be shut down. The government said it finds extremist messaging unacceptable, that the foundation falls outside inspection as non-recognised education, and that it will act if laws are broken, while declining to give details on specific persons or organisations.
No public statements will be made about investigative information on specific persons or organisations.
Over onderzoeksgegevens over specifieke personen of organisaties worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Rebel over de omstandigheden waaronder politiemensen drugslaboratoria en -afval moeten opsporen en opruimen

MPs Marcouch and Rebel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about the working conditions of police and inspectors who detect and clean up drug labs and dumped drug waste, citing a union letter on unsafe conditions, the LFO team's capacity and falling numbers of green BOAs. The minister said the Inspectie SZW will investigate working conditions with no timeline, that LFO capacity has been doubled with new staff expected by 1 January 2015, and that green BOA numbers fluctuate without a structural downward trend.
The Inspectie SZW has since confirmed that it will carry out this investigation.
De Inspectie SZW heeft inmiddels bevestigd dat zij dit onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de inzet van de politie bij het aanbieden van gestolen spullen op internet

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police should intervene to help a victim recover a stolen bicycle offered for sale online, and how this fits police guidance on handling. The minister answers that police followed up after tracing the seller, leading to an arrest and return of the bike, that local police policy governs such cases with no national line, and that victims cannot be guaranteed recovery of stolen goods.
There is no general, national policy line in this area.
Er is geen algemene, landelijke beleidslijn op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over medische zorg voor gedetineerden

The MP asked whether the ECtHR Rudyak v. Ukraine judgment requires doctors to examine all arrestees on arrival at police stations, and whether current police health screening complies with Articles 2 and 3 ECHR. The Secretary of State replied that the judgment does not require a doctor examination for every arrestee, that detainees have access to a doctor and screening by trained staff is followed by a doctor when needed under a police-GGD protocol.
It therefore does not follow from the judgment that every arrestee must be examined by a doctor immediately on arrival at the police station.
Uit de uitspraak volgt dus niet dat iedere arrestant direct bij aankomst op het politiebureau dient te worden onderzocht door een arts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over euthanasie bij Belgische tbs'ers

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Belgian forensic patient granted euthanasia due to inadequate care, and whether Dutch longstay tbs differs and whether Belgian detainees face legal barriers to transfer. The State Secretary answered that Dutch longstay tbs keeps resocialisation prospects through three-yearly reviews and biennial court hearings, that no transfer request was made, and that EU-level discussion is unwarranted as Belgium bears responsibility.
I see no reason to request such data.
Ik zie geen aanleiding dergelijke gegevens op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over hoog ziekteverzuim en gebrek aan begeleiding van jonge criminelen in jeugdgevangenissen

MP Marcouch asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that high staff sick leave in youth detention centres leaves young offenders with too little treatment, supervision and leave, and about related complaints, incidents and recidivism risk. Secretary Teeven rejected the claim that sick leave causes insufficient care, gave sick-leave and complaint figures, explained that leave cancellations have varied causes, and stated that community sanctions are preferred over detention.
I do not endorse the gist of the article that young people in a youth detention centre receive too little treatment or supervision because of high staff sick leave.

Ik onderschrijf niet de strekking van het artikel dat jeugdigen in een justitiële jeugdinrichting (JJI) te weinig behandeling of begeleiding zouden krijgen vanwege een hoog ziekteverzuim onder het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het tekort aan wijkagenten
