MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether there is a serious shortage of neighbourhood police officers across most of the Netherlands, how many exist versus the statutory norm of one per 5,000 residents, and when the norm will be met nationally. The Minister denied a serious nationwide shortage, stated 3,444 officers are employed against 3,413 in the implementation plan, and said the norm is met nationally while some units fall short and vacancies are being filled under agreed personnel rules.
Nationally, the police meet the statutory norm set in the Police Act 2012: on average there is at least one neighbourhood officer per 5,000 residents.
Landelijk gezien voldoet de politie aan de wettelijke norm zoals deze is opgenomen in de Politiewet 2012: gemiddeld is er ten minste één wijkagent werkzaam per 5.000 inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de demonstratie van ISIS-aanhangers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports of an ISIS-supporter demonstration in The Hague, including alleged Hitler salutes, racist chants, and a threatened journalist. Minister Opstelten answered that police observed no hate-inciting or offensive texts, that investigations found no Hitler salute, and that prosecution decisions rest with the public prosecutor.
It is for the public prosecutor to judge whether criminal limits were exceeded in this case.
Het is aan het OM om te oordelen of er in dit geval strafrechtelijke grenzen zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over medische zorg voor gedetineerden

MP Marcouch asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about medical care for detainees, including whether police should involve medically trained staff, how medical information is passed on at transfer, and whether acute cases can be admitted to the Justitieel Medisch Centrum. The State Secretary answered that a police-GGD protocol requires medical assessment, that new transfer forms and an expanded electronic patient file are being rolled out, and that the JCvSZ admits only non-urgent somatic cases as the IGZ confirmed.
Several initiatives are underway to improve information exchange between the police and the Custodial Institutions Agency (DJI).
Verschillende initiatieven zijn gaande om de informatie-uitwisseling tussen de politie en de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Health, and Interior about the planned tendering of forensic medical care and examination by the National Police, including quality, fragmentation, and ministerial responsibility. The government answered that the tender is in its preparatory phase under the light regime of the Aanbestedingswet, that existing providers may bid, and that it rejects a single-ministry responsibility, while declining to disclose some preparatory information.
For the second part of your first question, answering it would release information that may not be disclosed during the preparation of this tender.
Voor het tweede deel van uw eerste vraag geldt dat antwoord geven op deze vraag leidt tot het vrijgeven van informatie die tijdens de voorbereiding van deze aanbesteding niet vrijgegeven mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de doodsoorzaak van een gedetineerde die in 2011 is overleden

An MP asked the minister whether a forensic report showing police-violence injuries on a detainee who died in 2011 should prompt a new investigation into the cause of death. The minister answered that a complaint procedure under article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is pending, so no comment can be made while the case is before the court.
Since this case is before the court, no statements can be made about it.
Nu deze zaak onder de rechter is, kunnen er geen mededelingen over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Marcouch over coulance voor kerkgenootschappen ten aanzien van de publicatieplicht voor ANBI’s

Two MPs asked why church communities get until 1 January 2016 to meet the ANBI publication requirement while mosques and other faiths must comply from 2014, and whether that is fair. The State Secretary explained the transitional rule is for church bodies covered by group rulings that lack their own RSIN, applied in practice to all religious bodies including mosques, and that about 2,000 ANBIs (none religious) will lose status for not complying.
That means, for example, that mosques also have until 1 January 2016.
Dat betekent dat bijvoorbeeld ook moskeeën tot 1 januari 2016 de tijd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over de uitspraken van de heer K. (bestuurslid van de Stichting Islamitisch Onderwijs (SIO) Amsterdam en Omstreken)

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether a board member of the Islamic education foundation SIO Amsterdam, who publicly expressed support for ISIS, should be a reason to reconsider the approved Islamic secondary school and whether the foundation can be blocked from operating a school. The State Secretary answered that the school's approval was mandatory under the law and cannot be revised, that the inspectorate will be asked to examine the board's suitability before any funding begins, and that the government will act to prevent the school opening if it fails the civic-education requirements.
As soon as I receive notification that the school can actually become eligible for funding once housing becomes available, I will call in the inspectorate.
Zodra ik de melding ontvang dat de school door het beschikbaar komen van huisvesting daadwerkelijk in aanmerking kan komen voor bekostiging, zal ik de inspectie inschakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Marcouch over het bekladden van een huis in Almere

MPs Yücel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a house in Almere smeared with swastikas, whether neighbours had been targeted before, whether a complaint was filed, and whether this signals wider intimidation of ethnic minorities, plus election results in Duindorp and Almere Poort. The minister confirmed a police complaint for vandalism, discrimination and insult, found no prior signals in the street, condemned the incident as isolated, and promised to publish a 2013 police registration report on discrimination in August 2014.
For the results of the local elections I refer you to the websites of both municipalities.
Voor de uitslagen van de lokale verkiezingen verwijs ik u naar de websites van beide gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Marcouch over stelselmatige discriminatie van bewoners in de Haagse wijk Duindorp

MPs Yücel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about alleged systematic harassment of migrant-background residents in The Hague's Duindorp district, whether the minister would visit, what measures were taken, and whether similar problems exist elsewhere. The minister answered that the mayor reports no systematic driving-out of residents, that local police, the housing corporation and municipal partners are handling incidents through an integrated approach, and that anti-discrimination policy is a local responsibility with no national overview.
The cabinet does not have a national overview at the level of cities or neighbourhoods of cases of driving out neighbourhood residents on grounds of racial discrimination.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een landelijk overzicht op het niveau van steden of wijken van gevallen van het (weg)pesten van buurtbewoners op grond van rassendiscriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over misbruik van camerabeelden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of security camera footage, including the legal limits on repurposing such footage, staff training, criminal liability for covert filming and posting images to shame people, and how victims are encouraged to file complaints and how social media platforms handle removal. The minister answered that repurposing footage to publicize intimate scenes breaches the Wbp and that disciplinary rules exist, cited criminal provisions, declined to give details of the ongoing police investigation, and said the Facebook page had been removed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat criminele meisjes een andere aanpak nodig hebben

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether criminal girls need a different approach, including their share in youth detention, whether a new group of difficult girls exists, and whether multisystemic therapy is effective for them. The State Secretary answered that girls are about one in five suspects, are underrepresented in detention relative to offences, that no new group of difficult girls is evident, that girls receive specific facilities and interventions including MST, and that girls' recidivism (19.3%) is lower than boys' (39.2%).
This is reflected, among other things, in the fact that there are special departments for girls within the youth correctional sector.
Dat komt onder meer tot uiting in het gegeven dat er binnen de sector JJI speciale afdelingen voor meisjes zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het gebruik van camera's door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police use of smart cameras and a planned national sensor network, including whether new legislation is needed to protect privacy. The Minister answered that no police smart cameras are in use yet, that existing legal frameworks suffice for current sensing, and that the sensing policy vision is still in development.

For the forms of sensing currently applied, existing laws and regulations already provide sufficient frameworks and safeguards in terms of proportionality, subsidiarity and lawfulness, including protection of private life.

Voor de vormen van sensing zoals nu toegepast, bestaan binnen bestaande wet- en regelgeving op dit moment voldoende kaders en waarborgen in termen van proportionaliteit, subsidiariteit en rechtmatigheid, inclusief bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de beveiliging van een bedreigde eigenaar van een schoonmaakbedrijf

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about state protection for a threatened owner of a cleaning company, and how responsibility is divided between the person, the employer and the government. The minister answered that citizens and employers have primary responsibility for safety, that the government steps in when threats exceed their own capacity, and that a police report is not strictly required for protection.
The general principle of the protection system is that citizens are themselves primarily responsible for their own safety.
Algemeen uitgangspunt van het stelsel bewaken en beveiligen is dat de burger zelf in eerste instantie verantwoordelijk is voor de eigen veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de kwaliteit van Buitengewone Opsporingsambtenaren (boa’s)

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the quality, training and retraining requirements for buitengewone opsporingsambtenaren (boa's) are too low, and whether detachment firms risk creating disposable boa's and whether a quality mark is needed. The minister answered that the existing requirements are adequate, recently tightened in 2012/2013, and that detached boa's face the same rules, so no quality mark is necessary.
No, I consider the current requirements for quality, training and retraining, which apply to all boa's, appropriate.
Nee, de huidige eisen ten aanzien van kwaliteit, opleiding en bijscholing, die gelden voor alle boa's, acht ik passend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Gangster vrij na tikfout’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how a convicted gangster was wrongly released after a clerical error recorded six months instead of six years, why no one caught it, and what is being done. The minister answered that the error passed two-person checks, was discovered via a journalist, that the rechtbank has tightened procedures, and that the suspect is being actively sought.
I therefore consider it of great importance that, following this incident, the judiciary takes and will take steps to tighten its working methods to prevent recurrence.
Ik acht het dan ook van groot belang dat naar aanleiding van dit incident door de rechtspraak stappen zijn en worden ondernomen om de werkwijze aan te scherpen om herhaling te voorkomen.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Jihadisten in Den Haag trouw aan Al-Qaida zweren (ingezonden 30 december 2013).

Labour MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice and Security Minister about a video in which jihadists in The Hague pledge allegiance to Al-Qaida, asking whether this is punishable, whether it threatens security, whether participants may be preparing armed struggle, what tools exist to act against them, and whether the group can be treated as part of a terrorist organisation. The minister answered that recruitment for armed struggle is punishable under article 205 Sr but the video does not clearly meet that threshold, listed measures taken (passport invalidation, benefit cuts, asset freezes, prosecutions, local interventions), declined to discuss individual cases citing intelligence sensitivity, and said Arabic-language expertise is not deemed necessary because police can call interpreters.
I cannot make further public statements on the application of the aforementioned measures on an individual basis because this partly concerns intelligence information.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over toepassing van voornoemde maatregelen op individuele basis omdat het hier (deels) inlichtingeninformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de behandeling van een diabetespatiënte door particuliere beveiligers en de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the treatment of a diabetic woman detained by private security and police after urinating in a HEMA fitting room, including alleged remarks by officers and whether an apology was due. The minister answered that police acted lawfully and professionally, found no basis for excuses, and noted the public prosecutor had dismissed the case.
Together with the competent authority, however, I am of the opinion that the police acted lawfully and professionally in this situation.
Samen met het bevoegd gezag ben ik echter van mening dat de politie in deze situatie rechtmatig en professioneel heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over discriminatie van allochtone politieagenten binnen de politieorganisatie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about discrimination against ethnic-minority police officers, their departure rates, and how discrimination complaints are handled. The minister answered that no targets are set, that the last published ethnic minority share was 7% in 2011, that no current data on entries and exits exists, and that a staff satisfaction survey in 2014 will cover the issue and results will be shared with parliament.
After 2011, the number of ethnic minority employees was no longer actively tracked by the police organisation.
Na 2011 is het aantal allochtone medewerkers door de politieorganisatie niet meer actief bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het tegengaan van internationale voetbalhooliganisme

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about a new generation of Ajax hooligans shifting violence to international away matches and how to prevent it, including cross-border cooperation. The Minister said football violence abroad is not new, cited existing stadium bans and possible reporting obligations, and promised to raise a travel-ban-style reporting obligation in European fora, but gave no contact with Ajax or Italian authorities.

As I answered in previous written questions, I will shortly raise attention at European level for the possibilities of including a travel ban in the form of a reporting obligation in national regulations.

Antwoord 5 Zoals ik u heb geantwoord op eerdere schriftelijke vragen 2 zal ik op korte termijn in Europees verband aandacht vragen voor de mogelijkheden om in nationale regelgeving een uitreisverbod in de vorm van een meldplicht op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over geestelijk verzorgers bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI)

Parliamentarian Marcouch asked the State Secretary about chaplains at the Dutch prison service DJI, including dismissals under the Masterplan, religious backgrounds, the use of temporary staffing, and whether recent graduates are disadvantaged. The State Secretary answered that no dismissals have yet occurred, 32 humanist and 44 Islamic chaplains are candidates for voluntary redeployment pending assessment of surplus staffing, and that flexible temporary staffing and language requirements are justified.
At this moment there is no question of dismissals.
Op dit moment is geen sprake van ontslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Gesjoemel bij reclassering”

The MP Marcouch asked the State Secretary about press reports of misconduct at the probation service, including community-service offenders making furniture for themselves, and whether independent investigations were adequate and whether criminal investigation was warranted. The State Secretary replied that the internal and external Hoffmann investigations found no proof of the alleged misconduct, that the supervisory board judged the investigation adequate, and that no further criminal inquiry was needed.
Neither on the basis of this investigation, nor on the basis of the follow-up investigation that subsequently took place, could it be established that the reported misconduct had actually occurred.

Noch op basis van dit onderzoek, noch op basis van het vervolgonderzoek dat aansluitend hierop heeft plaatsgevonden, kon worden vastgesteld dat de gemelde misstanden ook daadwerkelijk hadden plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over de Taskforce hennep

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a waterbed effect in cannabis crime moving from big cities to rural Brabant, and about the expansion of the Taskforce hennep to all of Brabant and Zeeland. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the expansion reflects a general need for resilience rather than a direct response, and said there is no hard evidence yet of displacement to Belgium, while noting that cooperation with Belgian authorities is being structured.
It is correct that the TaskForce B5 will expand to all of Brabant and Zeeland.
Het klopt dat de TaskForce B5 gaat uitbreiden naar heel Brabant en Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over de toename van agressie tegen treinpersoneel

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked the ministers about rising aggression against rail staff, the measures taken with NS, the role of passengers and bystanders, use of Burgernet, and the arrest rate and sentences for offenders. The minister answered that NS takes measures such as cameras, security teams, training and a 24-hour control centre, that bystander e-learning and a publicity campaign are planned, that Burgernet is unsuitable, and that offender statistics are not registered separately and referred to an earlier study on sentencing.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen in die systemen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het rapport van Amnesty International over etnisch profileren door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Amnesty International's report on ethnic profiling by police, including complaint numbers, complaint reporting, and whether proactive policing can avoid discrimination. The minister states that the report is taken seriously, that stelselmatig discriminatory profiling has not been demonstrated, and points to ongoing Leiden research and planned follow-up letters, while listing existing anti-discrimination training and complaint statistics.

I will consult the local triangles of Amsterdam and The Hague and will include the research results and the measures taken in a follow-up letter on ethnic profiling that I will send to the House in the spring to inform it further.

Ik treed in overleg met de lokale driehoeken van Amsterdam en Den Haag en zal de onderzoeksresultaten alsmede de (genomen) maatregelen betrekken in een vervolgbrief over etnisch profileren die ik in het voorjaar zend om de Kamer nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het stilliggen van een succesvol werklozenproject bij de politie te Assen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a successful youth employment project at the Assen police was halted, and whether work-experience places at the National Police would be created as the Marcouch motion requested. The minister answered that the Drenthe training project has ended, a working group is studying national options, several units are offering places, and the ambition is 100 places with 5 to 10 realised this autumn.
Last January, in implementation of the Marcouch motion, I indicated that I would investigate national possibilities for the National Police to offer work-experience places to unemployed young people.

Afgelopen januari heb ik ter uitvoering van de motie Marcouch aangegeven onderzoek te gaan doen naar landelijke mogelijkheden voor de nationale politie om werkervaringsplaatsen aan te bieden aan werkloze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het bericht dat de Politie de groei van xtc-labs niet kan bijbenen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked whether police can keep pace with the rapid growth of ecstasy labs, including staffing of the four specialists, overtime, health risks and the APAAN precursor ban. Minister Opstelten answered that lab numbers rose but growth is unclear, that only four specialists handle dismantling with measures planned to ease workload, and that APAAN will become a registered category 1 substance once the EU regulation takes effect.

Due to the specific nature of dismantling laboratories and the required specialist knowledge level, this work is always and exclusively carried out by the specialists of the National Facility for Dismantling Support (LFO) of the national police unit.

Door de specifieke aard van de werkzaamheden bij het ontmantelen van laboratoria en het vereiste specialistische kennisniveau worden deze werkzaamheden altijd en alleen verricht door de specialisten van de Landelijke Faciliteit ondersteuning Ontmantelen (LFO) van de landelijke eenheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een app waarmee personen die staande worden gehouden hun rechten kunnen beschermen

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether citizens stopped by police should know their rights and whether a 'Stop and Search' app could help raise awareness among citizens and officers. The minister agrees citizens should know their rights and that respectful treatment matters, but declines to pursue a similar app, pointing to existing channels and planned website improvements.
In view of the above answers, I will not now make efforts to develop such an app.
Gelet op bovenstaande antwoorden zal ik me nu niet inspannen voor de ontwikkeling van een dergelijke app.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het tegengaan van internationale voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to curb foreign football hooligans, including entry and exit bans, EU cooperation, and dissolving supporter associations. The minister answered that proposed local measures are ineffective against one-off foreign visitors, that Dutch courts cannot impose exit or entry bans on non-residents, that such matters are for member states and possibly EU-level discussion, and that associations can only be dissolved if their own activities breach public order.
I will raise this at European level.
Ik zal hiervoor in Europees verband aandacht vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Duizenden agenten aan sufmakende pillen”

Labour MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether about a thousand police officers working under the influence of drowsiness-inducing medication poses a safety problem. The minister answered that the underlying study shows the press report misrepresents its findings, that medication use poses no known safety problem, and that medical confidentiality prevents tracking whether medication use is work-related.
The medication use of every individual Dutch citizen falls under medical professional confidentiality.
Het medicijngebruik van iedere individuele Nederlander valt onder het medisch beroepsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over drankrijders die toch hun rijbewijs mochten behouden

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked whether some police regions failed for years to report drunk and asocial drivers to the CBR, endangering road safety. The minister denies police negligence, attributes the rise in reports in 2012 to improved automation and information, and says no structural problems remain.
In my view there has been no negligence on the part of the police.
Er is naar mijn mening geen sprake geweest van verzuim door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over jonge criminelen die zich tot zware criminelen ontwikkelen

An MP asks the Justice Minister about research showing youth gang members developing into serious criminals, whether the 89 gangs targeted by current policy show escalation, and what is being done about criminal role models and the 'Dalton effect'. The minister answers that the studied gangs are different from the 89, that the integrated multi-track approach is being strengthened, and that criminal proceeds are being confiscated.
The approach to criminal youth groups, both old and new, will continue unabated.
De aanpak van criminele jeugdgroepen, zowel oude als nieuwe, wordt onverminderd voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Haagse politie gebruikt buitensporig geweld tegen buitenlanders”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Hague police use excessive force against foreigners, whether there is intimidation and racism around De Heemstraat station, and whether an investigation and talks with Schilderswijk residents will follow. The minister replied that this is primarily a local matter for the mayor, that the mayor sees no indication of misconduct, that 2012 force data show 19 unlawful uses out of 663 incidents, and that he knows of no racist climate, while declining to order an investigation or host talks, deferring to the mayor.
This is primarily a matter for local authority.
Dit is primair een kwestie van het lokaal gezag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over heling van door Oost-Europese bendes gestolen goederen in Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch markets openly sell goods stolen by Eastern European gangs, and what the government will do about fencing and police capacity. The minister answered that the claims are not recognised locally, that existing oversight and prosecutions apply, and that a digital purchasers' register and integrated approach to mobile gangs are being rolled out.
The parties involved in Rotterdam indicate that they do not recognise the signals about the Afrikaanderplein in that form and extent.
De betrokken partijen in Rotterdam geven aan de signalen over het Afrikaanderplein niet in die vorm en mate te herkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een angstcultuur bij de Nationale Politie

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an atmosphere of fear exists in the National Police, where officers who speak out about abuses are targeted, and how reporting of misconduct is safeguarded. The minister rejects the unions' picture, points to internal channels, the national reporting point and the Dutch whistleblower decree (Besluit melden vermoeden van misstand), and says the korps chief's reminder about sharing confidential material is endorsed; he commits only to talk with those raising signals.
I do not recognise the picture painted by the union chairs.
Ik herken het geschetste beeld van de voorzitters van de vakbonden niet.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het beleid van de politie in Amersfoort ten aanzien van het aanhouden van Marokkaanse jongens (ingezonden 20 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether Amersfoort police stop and frisk Moroccan boys without clear reason, and whether this amounts to ethnic discrimination. The minister answers that the police acted on their own authority, the Public Prosecution Service found the officer acted correctly, and the police use objective selection criteria, but the answers on wider profiling and past cases are largely general.
In this case the police acted on their own authority.
De politie heeft in deze zaak op eigen gezag opgetreden.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Winkeldieven kunnen slag slaan» (ingezonden 12 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether police do little with camera footage supplied by shopkeepers, how footage from shop theft is handled and whether it is seized, whether national sharing of footage and media warnings about mobile gangs are possible, and whether winkeldiefstal is a police priority. The state secretary replies that footage is used in investigations and sometimes handed over voluntarily, that an integrated action plan with 21 measures and a new information organisation is under way, and that shop theft is still a shared public-private responsibility with overvallen given priority.
I am fully aware that mobile gangs pose a major problem for shopkeepers.
Ik ben me er terdege van bewust dat mobiele bendes een groot probleem vormen voor winkeliers.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van transportcriminaliteit door de Nationale Politie (ingezonden 19 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice how the Nationale Politie will tackle transport crime after the Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit is folded into the Landelijke Eenheid, and whether industry concerns about lower priority are justified. The state secretary replies that the successful approach is preserved within the national police, that transport crime is now handled by the DINFRA unit with a focus on it, and that industry worries are not shared.
Transport crime will be tackled programmatically from the National Unit (LE), in cooperation with the regional units and the (chain) partners.
Transportcriminaliteit zal vanuit de Landelijke Eenheid (LE) programmatisch worden aangepakt, in samenwerking met de regionale eenheden en de (keten)partners.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over een bericht over een “wraakactie” van cipiers tegen een verdachte

An MP asked the state secretary whether prison guards who posted threatening remarks about a detainee on Facebook had acted improperly and whether the matter warranted investigation. The government answered that the guards admitted the posts, were reprimanded, and that Bureau Integriteit judged further investigation unnecessary; it added that the case stands on its own.
Bureau Integriteit ultimately decided, in consultation with the directorate, that further investigation was not necessary in this case.
Bureau Integriteit heeft uiteindelijk in goed overleg met de directie besloten dat nader onderzoek in dit geval niet nodig was.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch, Heijnen en Monasch over de toekomst van het Oranjehotel Scheveningen nu het kabinet van plan is de Scheveningse gevangenis te sluiten

MPs Marcouch, Heijnen and Monasch asked whether the government still supports keeping the Oranjehotel monument (Dodencel, Poortje, Gedenkplaat) after the planned closure of the Scheveningen prison, and how its future will be secured. The state secretary confirmed the monument should be preserved, said a future design is being developed with the Stichting Oranjehotel and that the detailed plan will follow once the DJI masterplan decision is taken.

Once the decision-making on the DJI Masterplan is completed, and it is therefore clear whether the PI Scheveningen will continue to exist, the Foundation, in consultation with the state, will further develop the preliminary design of a Oranjehotel Monument.

Zodra de besluitvorming over het Masterplan DJI is afgerond en daarmee ook duidelijk is of de PI Scheveningen blijft bestaan, zal de Stichting in samenspraak met het rijk het voorlopige ontwerp van een Monument Oranjehotel verder uitwerken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de gemeente Venray die in gesprek is met de Marokkaanse overheid over criminele jongeren

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked whether the municipality of Venray has received help from the Moroccan government in tackling criminal youths of Moroccan origin, and whether this is appropriate. The minister replied that the mayor only had informal, informative contacts with Moroccan officials, no agreements were made, that the problem is a Dutch responsibility, and that his ministry has itself provided support.
There is, however, no question of cooperation or assistance in tackling this problem.
Van samenwerking en hulp bij de aanpak van dit probleem is echter geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over de inzet door hun ouders van minderjarige kinderen voor het plegen van misdrijven

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the Justice Minister about reports that parents from Roma families use their minor children to commit burglaries and thefts, and about related police, child protection, municipal registration and enforcement questions. The minister confirmed the problem is recognised, explained that children under 12 are not prosecuted while parents can be prosecuted for inciting offences though evidence is hard to gather in families, and outlined planned registration and multi-problem family measures.
I have no insight into numbers, neither for children in general nor for Roma children in particular.
Ik heb geen inzicht in aantallen, noch voor kinderen in het algemeen, noch voor Roma kinderen in het bijzonder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over de rechts-extremistische organisatie “Blood&Honour”

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked whether statements on the Blood&Honour website could be criminal, whether Mein Kampf publication and SS race-theory content are punishable, and whether the organisation could be dissolved. The minister answered that criminality must be assessed case by case by the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that there are currently no grounds to start a dissolution procedure since Blood&Honour lacks legal personality.
That assessment of criminality must in an individual case first be made by the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately by the criminal judge.
Die beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Ypma over een illegale verstandelijk gehandicapte jongen die in een schoolbus is opgepakt en een week in vreemdelingenbewaring heeft verbleven

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Ypma asked the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice about a mentally disabled undocumented youth stopped in a car and held in immigration detention for about a week, asking why he was detained, whether his vulnerability was considered, and whether a 48-hour judicial review should be introduced. The state secretary answered that the vulnerability was unknown to police and not reported, detention was justified by the risk of absconding, compensation was offered, and a future policy vision would follow, while declining to examine the case further beyond answering the questions.
Personal information about the person concerned and his immigration status has been limited as much as possible in these answers, given his privacy.
Persoonlijke informatie over betrokkene en zijn vreemdelingrechtelijke status is zo veel als mogelijk beperkt in deze antwoorden, gelet op zijn privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Terbeschikkingstelling (TBS) - klinieken verdienen goud geld aan TBS-ers, andere patiënten creperen?

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a report alleging TBS clinics profit from TBS patients while neglecting others, with thin therapy and lax leave rules. Teeven denied the description, cited evidence-based treatment programmes, a no-drugs policy and low recidivism figures, and rejected the claim of widespread demotivation.
I do not recognise the description of this alleged employee.
De beschrijving van deze vermeende medewerker herken ik niet.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hamer over het bericht “Vraag geen verlof aan voor staking DJI!

MPs Marcouch and Hamer asked whether the Ministry of Justice and Security's circular on union actions wrongly required staff to request leave for strike participation, and whether those staff should have leave reversed. The state secretary acknowledged the wording wrongly suggested leave was required, clarified that pay is withheld only when working time is used without leave, and issued a corrected letter with a special arrangement for the 25 April action.
With this wording, the suggestion was unintentionally created that action may only be taken if leave has been taken.
Met deze formulering is onbedoeld de suggestie gewekt dat alleen actie mag worden gevoerd als verlof is opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel en Kooiman over de bedreiging van enkele jongeren uit Arnhem aan het adres van een stadsgenoot

MPs asked whether a Turkish man who publicly condemned antisemitic remarks by young Turks in Arnhem went into hiding after death threats, and whether the victim was supported and the perpetrators identified. The minister answered that the mayor advised him to stay elsewhere temporarily, police found no concrete threats, no complaint was filed, and the prosecutor opened an investigation into one minor for group insult, leading to a educational sanction.
Police research shows there is no question of concrete threats against the Turkish man or his family.
Uit onderzoek van de politie blijkt dat er geen sprake is van concrete bedreigingen tegen de Turkse man of zijn gezin.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over preventief fouilleren

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the current system of preventive frisking should be overhauled, given its privacy costs and disproportionate police effort, and whether frisking should be selective under judicial supervision. The minister agrees that targeting could be improved using objective selection criteria, but rejects leaving selection to police intuition under supervision of a rectercommissaris, and says the surprise effect already exists and training is adequate.
Without an objective, verifiable criterion, supervision by an examining magistrate of the lawfulness of the selection is not meaningful.
Zonder een objectief, controleerbaar criterium is toezicht door een rechter-commissaris op de rechtmatigheid van de selectie niet zinvol.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het verwisselen van identiteitspapieren

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked about a RamBam broadcast showing identity documents being swapped, enabling bank accounts, car rentals, Schiphol border passage and an ID card with another person's photo. The ministers confirm the facts, describe the Marechaussee's checks and planned training, and announce a review of the reisdocument application process.
This also applies if a photo of someone else is accepted when applying for an identity card.
Dit geldt ook als een foto van iemand anders wordt geaccepteerd bij de aanvraag van een identiteitskaart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over in België woonachtige verdachten van een mishandeling te Eindhoven

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Belgium will still extradite minor residents suspected of crimes abroad after a Belgian Court of Cassation ruling, and who prosecutes them if not. The minister answered that nationality is not a ground for refusal under the EAW framework, that age can be, that the ruling concerned enforcement of a sentence so its effect on prosecution warrants is unclear, and that under aut dedere aut judicare Belgium must prosecute if it refuses extradition, including minors under Belgian youth law.
It remains to be seen whether the Court of Cassation will follow similar reasoning for a European arrest warrant for the purpose of prosecution.
Het valt te bezien of het Hof van Cassatie een analoge redenering zal volgen voor een aanhoudingsbevel ter fine van vervolging.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Heijnen over het ontslaan van Hells Angels in dienst van de overheid

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers whether dismissing civil servants who belong to outlaw motorcycle clubs such as Hells Angels fits the criminal-justice approach, and whether central government employs such people. The government answered that membership is undesirable for civil servants, that existing integrity and employment law allows measures including dismissal, and that it will promote the norm to other governments and update the integrity code, without a separate investigation.
Since the procedure within the municipality is still ongoing, no further comment can be made on the specific status and functions of the employees.
Aangezien de procedure binnen de gemeente nog loopt, kan verder niet op de specifieke stand van zaken en de functies van de medewerkers worden ingegaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de aanhouding van Willem II fans te Utrecht

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the arrest of around 42 Willem II supporters in Utrecht and whether a combi-ticket scheme would have prevented it, plus what legal remedies the supporters had and how this fits the planned Voetbalwet changes. The minister explained the police and municipal reasoning for the arrests, said complaints and objections via a bestuurlijke strafbeschikking were available, and argued a combi-ticket scheme was unlikely to have prevented the incident.
The police surrounded and arrested a large group.
Door de politie werd een grote groep ingesloten en aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Wolbert en Van Dekken over het bericht dat per 1 maart 2013 al banen verdwijnen bij gevangenissen in Ter Apel, Hoogeveen en Veenhuizen

MPs Marcouch, Wolbert and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether job losses at prisons in Ter Apel, Hoogeveen and Veenhuizen from 1 March 2013 were true and linked to the unpublished Masterplan. The state secretary denied that dozens of jobs were disappearing, said empty capacity is being concentrated for efficiency as a separate operational measure, and gave partial answers on consultation, cells and transfers.
Pending the discussion of the Masterplan in your House, no irreversible steps will be taken.
Vooruitlopend op de bespreking van het Masterplan in uw Kamer zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen worden gezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘politie laks bij aangiften’

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police handle citizens' complaints (aangiften) lazily, citing the National Ombudsman's findings, and how this relates to survey data and the importance of reporting crime. The minister acknowledged room for improvement, pointed to the Inspectorate's report and to measures such as multichannel reporting, faster appointments, better website information and feedback on reports, and promised a letter to parliament by mid-2013 on improving the handling of reports.
By mid-2013 I will inform the House about the measures the police are taking to improve the handling of reports.
Medio 2013 zal ik de Kamer informeren over welke maatregelen de politie neemt om de afhandeling van aangiften te verbeteren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat het opleiden van nieuwe politiemensen met onmiddellijke ingang is gestopt

MP Marcouch asked the minister whether the national police had halted recruitment and training of new officers, and whether this undermines the coalition goal of more police capacity. The minister denied any training or intake stop for 2013, explained a planned numerus fixus of 800 trainees and admitted that some applicants were wrongly notified before being recontacted.
The police will simply continue training new police officers in 2013.
De politie gaat in 2013 gewoon door met het opleiden van nieuwe politiemensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het vechten voor een schone vechtsport

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked ministers about inadequate medical oversight, instructor quality, criminal links and the need for a sports commission in the martial arts sector. The minister acknowledged problems, reported a RIEC report finding criminal links at nearly half of events, noted municipalities are amending local rules, and said she would consult stakeholders on a commission before the summer recess.
I am willing to invite a number of relevant stakeholders to explore what could be a good and feasible way forward in this matter.
Ik ben bereid een aantal relevante stakeholders uit te nodigen om te verkennen wat in deze een goede en begaanbare weg zou kunnen zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over mijn toezegging om de slachtoffers van het schietincident in Alphen aan den Rijn het onderzoeksrapport van de Rijksrecherche integraal openbaar te maken

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the promise to give shooting victims in Alphen aan den Rijn the full Rijksrecherche report was kept, and whether victims have received the readable report and other documents. The minister answered that victims were given an anonymised version of the report on 18 January 2013 after agreement with their lawyer, but access to the post-mortem psychiatric report was refused on medical confidentiality and privacy grounds, a point the court later upheld.
The OM, given the applicable regulations and case law, saw no room to grant access to this medical file.
Het OM heeft gelet op toepasselijke regelgeving en jurisprudentie geen ruimte gezien om inzage in dit medische dossier te geven.
Antwoord vragen Recourt en Marcouch over het afluisteren van telefoongesprekken van gedetineerden

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked about the recording of detainees' phone calls, including with lawyers, after an RSJ ruling that standard recording must end. Minister Teeven answered that the current rules already allow standard recording, that a number-recognition system with the NOvA is planned for 2013, and that interim alternative phones will be arranged for calls with lawyers.
I point out that the amendments to the Penitentiary Principles Act and underlying regulations in force since 1 January 2011 already provide a basis for standard recording.
Ik wijs er op dat met de sinds 1 januari 2011 inwerking getreden wijzigingen in de Pbw en onderliggende regelgeving al is voorzien in een grondslag voor het standaard opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de Grensoverschrijdende samenwerking tussen de Duitse en Nederlandse politie

The MP asks whether cross-border police cooperation with Germany is too slow, since a stolen-goods case required a formal mutual legal assistance request, and whether weekend handling is weaker. The minister replies that the house was searched the same morning of the tip-off, that direct police contact is already possible but coercive measures need a prosecutor and formal request, and that a 24/7 coordinating system exists on the Dutch side.
In cases of cross-border crime, swift and effective action must be possible.
In gevallen van grensoverschrijdende criminaliteit moet er spoedig en doeltreffend actie ondernomen kunnen worden.
Vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een lek bij Burgernet (ingezonden 3 december 2012).

MPs Oosenbrug and Marcouch asked whether citizens' data registered with Burgernet was inadequately secured, why the signup form lacked HTTPS, whether private data reached third parties, and how trust in the site is affected. Minister Opstelten answered that the signup page lost HTTPS after an update due to human error, was restored once discovered, that no third-party access signals exist, and that trust and participation remain high.
After installing a recent update, the security specifically for the registration form was not reactivated.
Na de installatie van een recente update is de beveiliging specifiek voor het aanmeldformulier niet opnieuw geactiveerd.
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug en Marcouch over de privacy van getuigen van misdrijven

MPs Oosenbrug and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a police appeal for witnesses to a severe assault on two gay men was publicised, and on what criteria privacy of witnesses is weighed against investigation needs. The Minister answered that public appeals for witnesses are used only in exceptional cases, that the prosecutor must approve footage that intrudes on privacy, and that the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving is being updated with explicit safeguards.
Currently work is underway to update the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan actualisering van de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Hamer, Van Dekken, Albert de Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat er gevangenissen in Groningen, Drenthe Zeeland worden gesloten

PvdA MPs asked whether plans to close prisons in Groningen, Drenthe and Zeeland exist, and about the employment, visitor travel and cultural-heritage effects of such closures. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, closures cannot be avoided given budget cuts, a Masterplan on detention capacity will be presented in April 2013, and regional employment and visits will be weighed.

With a view to a careful decision-making process, I have asked the Director-General of DJI to draw up a Masterplan on DJI detention capacity, which will show the consequences of the cuts for cell capacity and staff.

Met het oog op een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces heb ik de hoofddirecteur van DJI verzocht om een Masterplan detentiecapaciteit DJI op te stellen, waarin de gevolgen van de ombuigingen voor de celcapaciteit van DJI en het personeel in beeld worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over geweld tegen NS-medewerkers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether violence against NS railway staff is a structural societal problem, the respective responsibilities of NS, police and prosecutors, and what protection citizens who intervene have under self-defence law. The minister replied that violence against public-facing workers is a structural problem tackled jointly with BZK, that responsibilities are shared, and that existing self-defence rules (art. 41 Sr) offer adequate protection.
This cabinet regards aggression and violence against workers with a public task, including NS staff, as a societal problem, not merely isolated incidents.
Agressie en geweld tegen werknemers met een publieke taak, waaronder NS-personeel, ziet dit kabinet als een maatschappelijk probleem, niet enkel als losse incidenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over een bericht over toegenomen geweld tegen politieagenten

MP Marcouch asked the minister whether reported increases in violence against police officers, based on press-release data from a website, reflect a real rise and whether the government will change its policy. The minister answered that the website data cannot establish an increase, that victimisation surveys show stable levels, and that the government sees no reason to change its policy beyond existing measures.
That does not mean, however, that the number of violent incidents has risen; after all, not every violent incident against the police leads to a press release.
Dat wil echter niet zeggen dat het aantal geweldsincidenten is gestegen; immers, niet elk geweldsincident tegen de politie leidt tot een persbericht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat allochtone verdachten met een psychiatrische stoornis vaker gedwongen worden opgenomen dan vergelijkbare autochtone verdachten

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the minister whether forensic psychiatric reports (pro justitia) assess and recommend compulsory admission differently for allochtone and autochtone suspects. The state secretary confirmed a published study finding such differences, said the NIFP has transcultural expertise and training measures, and stated that reports are advisory and the final verdict may differ.
The pro justitia report is advice to the judiciary, which takes this advice into consideration when issuing a ruling.
De pro justitia-rapportage is een advies aan de Rechterlijke Macht, die dit advies in overweging neemt bij het doen van een uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over WOTS-verzoeken uit Panama

MP Marcouch asked whether Dutch prisoners in Panama seeking transfer under the WOTS are routinely refused, on what grounds, and whether agreements with Panama exist. The minister answers that requests are assessed individually, that transfer requires roots in the Netherlands and at least four months of remaining sentence, that all six 2012 and one 2011 Panama requests were refused for insufficient remaining sentence, and that Panama is bound only by the Council of Europe transfer convention, with no further agreements needed.
All requests made from Panama in 2011, namely one, and so far in 2012, namely six, were rejected by the Netherlands because the remaining sentence was insufficient.
Alle aanvragen die in 2011, te weten één, en tot op heden in 2012, te weten zes, vanuit Panama zijn gedaan zijn door Nederland afgewezen omdat er een onvoldoende strafrestant was.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt over de sterk gestegen criminaliteit in Noord-Holland

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a sharp rise in burglaries, car theft and public violence in Noord-Holland, and what is being done about it. The minister confirmed the increases over 2008-2011 (burglary tracking the national trend, car theft and violence diverging), reported declines in 2012, and said an intensified approach already exists through burglary teams and a regional taskforce on robberies, with the new national police expected to help.
For burglaries this matches the national trend in that period, but the rise in car thefts and public violence deviates from the national picture.

Ten aanzien van woninginbraken komt dit overeen met de landelijke ontwikkeling in die periode, maar de stijging van het aantal autodiefstallen en openlijke geweldplegingen wijkt af van het landelijk beeld.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over een zelfmoord in de gevangenis Vught

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the minister about a reported suicide in the Vught prison and whether structural problems at the facility warranted a broader inquiry beyond individual cases. State Secretary Teeven replied that the facility generally functions well, that six deaths occurred in 2012 including four suicides, and that the Inspectorates of Justice and Health have been asked to investigate whether there is a causal link to care, with results due spring 2013 and no immediate additional measures planned.
Because of this relatively high number of deaths, I have asked the IVenJ and the IGZ to jointly investigate whether there is a causal link between these suicides and the care provided by DJI.
Vanwege dit relatief hoge aantal sterfgevallen heb ik de IVenJ en de IGZ gevraagd gezamenlijk te onderzoeken of er een causaal verband tussen deze suïcides en de door DJI verleende zorg is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over illegale bordelen in massagesalons

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about half of Chinese massage parlours in the Netherlands are in fact illegal brothels, including whether the OM research would be shared, whether massage parlours should be subject to licensing and Bibob screening, and whether victim support and information for Chinese-speaking sex workers is adequate. The minister confirmed the research estimates illegal prostitution in roughly half the parlours, said it does not change existing rules, noted parlours offering sexual services need a municipal permit that allows Bibob screening, and pointed to a Chinese-language brochure and planned Chinese translation of a victim-rights leaflet, with a separate letter promised on the report.

Following a request from the Security and Justice committee of your House dated 8 November 2012 for a response on the state of efforts against Chinese massage parlours, I will address the research report in more detail in a separate letter.

Naar aanleiding van een verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Veiligheid en Justitie van uw Kamer van 8 november 2012, waarin wordt gevraagd om een reactie op de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de aanpak van Chinese massagesalons, zal ik in een aparte brief nader ingaan op het onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch en Van Dam over drugssmokkel naar Schiphol

Opposition MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the minister about drug smuggling via Curaçao to Schiphol, including whether Curaçao's detention facilities for swallowers are adequate and whether suspects are wrongly allowed to fly on. The minister replied that Curaçao is responsible for its own law enforcement, cells are available for non-swallowers, the swallower toilets are not working optimally, and a broader integrated approach including the Schiphol team is being reviewed with a later update promised.
Law enforcement in Curaçao is the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
De rechtshandhaving in Curaçao betreft de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over een ontsnapte serieverkrachter

Marcouch asked the state secretary how a juvenile detainee (described in the press as a serial rapist and tbs'er) escaped while under escort for a medical visit, whether staff were warned of recidivism risk, and why the escape was not publicized. The state secretary explained the escape, the escort arrangements and the risk assessment, and said media publication was withheld after a case-by-case balancing of investigation interests against victim and public safety.
In this case, after a carefully considered assessment, it was decided that media reports would not serve the investigation interest.
In de onderhavige zaak is, na een weloverwogen inschatting, besloten dat mediaberichten niet in het opsporingsbelang zouden dienen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over agressie tegen medewerkers van de NS door drugsrunners op Rotterdam CS

Labour MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about aggression against NS railway staff by drug runners at Rotterdam Centraal, including whether the wietpas (cannabis pass) caused their return, and whether a full police post should be present. The minister said the incident involved a drunk youth rather than a drug runner, that a small number of drug runners are handled by a local supervision model, and that the police post was moved during renovation and will return.
Information from the Rotterdam-Rijnmond police shows there are no indications that the person who fought with the NS employees was a drug runner.

Uit informatie van het korps Rotterdam-Rijnmond blijkt dat ten aanzien van het in de media genoemde incident geen aanwijzingen bestaan dat de persoon die in gevecht raakte met de NS-medewerkers een drugsrunner was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanpak van homogeweld als prioriteit bij de Nationale Politie

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the anti-violence-against-gays approach in Amsterdam should become national policy, whether it should be a separate priority for the new National Police, and whether specialised 'Roze in Blauw' capacity should be created. The minister answered that the Amsterdam practice is being rolled out nationally, that anti-gay violence is handled within broad priorities rather than as a separately labelled category, and that a further progress letter will follow this autumn.
This autumn I will again inform your House about the progress of the approach to discrimination.
Dit najaar zal ik uw Kamer wederom informeren over de voortgang van de aanpak van discriminatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch met betrekking tot de halvering van de politie inzet voor zakkenrollerij

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam police pickpocketing team had been halved and how many officers it had, and whether this explained a rise in pickpocketing reports during Gay Pride. The minister confirmed the team is a flexible, non-fixed unit whose size depends on available capacity, said reports rose from 21 to 42 on the busiest Gay Pride day, and denied a demonstrable link to team cuts while committing to continued attention to pickpocketing.
As a result, the deployment of this target group team is difficult to quantify in terms of the number of police officers who carried out work within this temporary arrangement.
Hierdoor is de inzet van dit doelgroepenteam lastig te kwantificeren in termen van aantallen politiemensen die werkzaamheden hebben verricht binnen dit tijdelijke verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanpak van homogeweld als prioriteit bij de Nationale Politie

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a gay man in Helmond who has not returned home for seven weeks after alleged anti-gay violence shows that a national anti-homophobic-violence policy and specialised 'Roze in blauw' police capacity are needed. The minister answers that the police and prosecutor handled the complaints, the prosecutor dropped them for lack of evidence and partial contributory fault, and that the national police will have national oversight of such violence without announcing new specialised capacity.
Within the national police there will be national oversight of the approach to anti-homosexual violence.
Binnen de nationale politie zal er landelijk zicht zijn op (de aanpak van) anti-homogeweld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat het succesvolle Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit door de minister wordt opgeheven

MP Marcouch asks the minister why the successful Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit is being dissolved, why the House learned of it from the press, and whether the successful approach to cargo theft will be maintained. The minister answers that the team's knowledge and expertise will be secured within the National Police through the Landelijke Eenheid, that cargo theft has fallen sharply, and that the public-private convenant runs until end 2013 with continuation after 2013 under consideration.
This does not mean, however, that existing successful working methods, such as the deployment of the police in tackling transport crime, will be ended.
Dit betekent echter niet dat bestaande succesvolle werkwijzen, zoals de inzet van de politie bij de aanpak van transportcriminaliteit, worden beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over berichten dat ouderen steeds vaker slachtoffer van misdrijven worden

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that elderly people are increasingly victims of crime, including figures on Slachtofferhulp Nederland clients aged 65 and over and whether the risk is rising. The minister answers that the rise in elderly clients reflects automatic referral and greater vulnerability rather than proven growth in crime, that elderly victims remain less likely to be victimised than others but are more vulnerable to impact, and lists preventive measures and sentencing practice.
On the basis of the figures from Slachtofferhulp Nederland no conclusion can be drawn about an actual increase in violence against the elderly.
Op basis van de cijfers van Slachtofferhulp Nederland is geen conclusie te trekken over de daadwerkelijke toename van geweld tegen ouderen.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marcouch over de staat van de Politieacademie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the minister about the Police Academy's deficit, its governance and budget approval, exam backlogs, examiner withdrawals and external training purchases by police forces. The minister answered that the supervisory board did not approve the 2012 budget over a financing risk, that a financial and operational audit and an improvement plan were ordered, that exam backlogs were largely cleared by August 2012, and that a Rekenkamer investigation was not warranted.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans, Recourt en Marcouch over neonazi’s in Duitsland

MPs Timmermans, Recourt and Marcouch asked the Justice minister about the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia banning three far-right groups and a large police raid, and whether this threatens spillover into the Netherlands and whether closer cooperation is needed. The minister answered that cooperation with German police and the AIVD is good and structural, that the raid led to no Dutch link so far, and that action will follow if Dutch links emerge.
Should facts emerge later in the investigation that relate to the Netherlands, action will be taken on this.
Mochten er in het verdere verloop van het onderzoek alsnog feiten boven tafel komen die verband houden met Nederland, dan zal hier actie op worden ondernomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de georganiseerde escorte van de begrafenisstoet van een lid van de motorclub Satudarah

MP Marcouch asked whether police escorted the funeral procession of a Satudarah motorcycle club member, how such escorts are decided, and how to avoid giving the impression of endorsing criminal clubs. The minister replied that no police escort took place, that the club was not allowed to escort the procession, that police only enforced traffic rules, and that no disorder or safety problems occurred.
There has been no police escort.
Van een politiële escorte is geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat winkeliers moeten opdraaien voor letsel dat personeel bij een overval oploopt

An MP asked the minister whether employers can be held liable for injuries their staff suffer in robberies, whether damages should first be recovered from the offender, and whether employers or insurers can get an advance from the State's victim-advance scheme. The minister answered that employers can be held liable mainly for failing their duty of care, that the State's advance scheme covers only direct victims not employers or insurers, and that no figures on such liability claims are known.
Figures on how many liability claims are brought by employees against employers where the employee suffered injury from a robbery or other crime are not known to me.

Cijfers over hoeveel aansprakelijkheidsstellingen er plaatsvinden door werknemers van werkgevers waarbij vanwege een overval of andere vorm van criminaliteit de werknemer letselschade heeft opgelopen, zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over het bericht dat een VVD-raadslid te Noordwijk van mening is dat de politie medeverantwoordelijk is voor agressie tegen ambulancemedewerkers

An opposition MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police were partly responsible for aggression against ambulance staff during disturbances in Noordwijk, and requested a factual account of police conduct. The minister reported the incident, denied police shared responsibility, said the conduct was discussed locally and noted one complaint had been filed under the standard procedure.
One complaint has been filed with the Hollands-Midden police regarding the police conduct on the Grent.
Er is bij de politie Hollands-Midden één klacht ingediend omtrent het politieoptreden op de Grent.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat gemeenten woonwagenkampen mijden

An MP asked whether municipalities avoid enforcing law on caravan (woonwagen) sites, whether residents or staff face disproportionate aggression, and about victim support and training; the minister said 44 municipalities may face 'vrijplaats' problems, police do not record residence on caravan sites so no data exist, and referred to handbooks, anonymous reporting options and the Veilige Publieke Taak programme, with no concrete new commitment.
Police registration systems do not record whether a person lives on a caravan site.
In de registratiesystemen van de politie wordt niet vastgelegd of een persoon woont op een woonwagenlocatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over het gebrek aan regels bij het opzetten van een filefuik bij autoachtervolgingen

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister why police officers deciding on creating a traffic blockade (filefuik) during car chases have no clear rules, and about prosecution after the A2 incident. The minister said a national framework is being drafted within three months, police will show restraint meanwhile, and the Public Prosecution Service found the risk to road users too high, but corporate criminal liability and individual prosecution were ruled out.
In the meantime, restraint will be exercised in creating a traffic blockade to arrest a suspect.
In afwachting hiervan zal terughoudendheid worden betracht met het creëren van een filefuik ter aanhouding van een verdachte.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de bedreiging van Turkse homo’s

An MP asked the Justice and Education ministers about threats against Turkish gay pride boat participants, including whether complaints led to prosecution and whether victims were supported. The minister reported five police reports, no formal complaints filed, no ex officio prosecution for now, and that contact and emancipation support continue.
Discrimination offences such as articles 137c and 137d of the Criminal Code can be prosecuted ex officio, but the Public Prosecution Service currently sees no reason to do so in this case.

Discriminatiedelicten zoals artikel 137c en 137d van het Wetboek van Strafrecht kunnen wel ambtshalve worden vervolgd, maar het Openbaar Ministerie ziet hiervoor in dit geval vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de al maar weer terugkerende berichten dat er vele veroordeelde criminelen nog steeds vrij rond lopen

Labour MP Marcouch asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about reports that around 15,000 convicted criminals remain at large, and what the government is doing about it. The state secretary confirmed roughly 15,000 people must still serve custodial sentences, described enforcement measures and the USB programme, and said the figures differ from earlier answers only because they are snapshots taken at different dates.
Question 6: Can you now indicate how many of the criminals at large have committed new criminal offences during their freedom?
Vraag 6 Kunt u inmiddels wel aangeven hoeveel van de vrij rondlopende criminelen tijdens hun vrijheid opnieuw strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd?
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Eijsink over de bestrijding van drugssmokkel via Schiphol

MPs Marcouch and Eijsink asked whether the Schiphol team combining Customs and Marechaussee officers is effective against drug smuggling and whether it is being dismantled. The minister denied plans to split the teams, said the integrated approach will be extended, and promised to inform parliament once an ongoing review of the team's functioning is complete.
Once the review is completed, I will inform your House of the outcomes and the consequences for the Schiphol team.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond, informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten en de consequenties hiervan voor het Schipholteam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Marcouch over een verplichte alcohol- of drugstest

MPs Bouwmeester and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the commitment to systematically record alcohol and drug use in violent incidents, made in 2005, and the promised mandatory drug/alcohol test have taken so long to turn into action. The minister answered that pilots and an evaluation were carried out, registration was introduced, and a bill allowing mandatory drug and alcohol tests in violent offences went to consultation in August 2012, with entry into force planned for 2013.
It provides for the possibility of a mandatory drug and alcohol test in cases of violent offences.
Het voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een verplichte drugs- en alcoholtest bij geweldsdelicten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester over de ontsnapping van twee jeugdige gedetineerden

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked about a police report on two girls who escaped from Het Poortje youth institution during a theme park outing, and whether the outing and supervision were appropriate. The state secretary answered that the girls were not detainees but were in closed youth care, that the outing followed a planned, individually assessed reintegration step with parental consent, and that the institution acknowledges the individual risk assessment should have outweighed the group interest.
The institution acknowledges that in this case the individual risk assessment of the girls should have weighed more heavily than the group interest.
De instelling erkent dat in dit geval de individuele risicotaxatie van de meisjes zwaarder had moeten wegen dan het groepsbelang.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over identiteitsfraude

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked about identity fraud in which a criminal opened a PostNL business mail-forwarding account in a victim's name and redirected post, including private mail. The state secretary said attempts are rare (under 0.03%), PostNL has taken measures, the police investigation found no suspect, and the matter is being looked into, but declined to give details on the specific case.
In the interest of the investigation and with a view to possible future fraud attempts, no further information can be given about specific cases.
In het belang van het onderzoek en met het oog op eventuele toekomstige fraudepogingen kan over specifieke zaken geen verdere mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over trage teruggave van gestolen goederen

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister why stolen goods recovered by police were returned to the victim only after more than half a year, and what will be done to speed up such returns. The minister agreed goods should be returned once no prosecutorial interest remains, regretted the one-month delay after the investigation ended, denied the return was forced by publicity, and pointed to victim-care policy and pending legislation without giving a fixed timeframe.
The importance of prompt handling of seizures, including the options of article 116 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, will be emphasised within the Public Prosecution Service.
Het belang van een snelle afhandeling van beslag, waaronder de mogelijkheden van artikel 116 Sv., zal binnen het OM worden benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra, Van Gent en Marcouch over het niet uitvoeren van de motie die verzoekt bloeddonatie voor homoseksuelen mogelijk te maken

MPs Dijkstra, Van Gent and Marcouch asked why the minister did not implement a motion to allow blood donation by gay men and whether she would reconsider using new scientific evidence and foreign practice. The minister replied that she relies on Sanquin's advice and current epidemiological data, will not yet reconsider, and will inform parliament after consultations with other experts by early September.
I aim to send your House a letter on this subject in the short term, by early September at the latest.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer op korte termijn, uiterlijk begin september, een brief over dit onderwerp te sturen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch met betrekking tot het toenemend aantal woninginbraken

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the rising number of home burglaries, the police priority and new approach, forensic investigation, the Politiekeurmerk Veilig Wonen certification and financial incentives for burglary prevention. The minister answers that burglaries rose about 7% but the detection chance also increased, that a forensic pilot is still running, that municipalities decide on certification and subsidies, and that a website already exists.
This pilot is still running. Once the pilot is completed, insight can be provided into the results and the possible nationwide rollout.
Zodra de pilot is afgerond kan er inzicht worden verschaft in de resultaten en het mogelijk uitrollen op landelijke niveau.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Van Dekken en Timmermans over homorechten in Oekraïne

MPs Marcouch, Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about the cancelled Kyiv gay pride, a Ukrainian bill criminalising public expression of homosexuality, and whether this should affect Dutch attendance at Euro 2012 matches and the final's location. The government condemned the violence and bill, said Dutch ministers would attend a match with a human rights programme, but rejected moving the final to Poland as impractical.
On 21 May I expressed to the media my disappointment at the cancellation of the Kyiv Pride Parade.
Ik heb op 21 mei jl. tegenover de media mijn teleurstelling uitgesproken over de afgelasting van de Kyiv Pride Parade.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch met betrekking tot de verhouding tussen de politie en buitengewone opsporingsambtenaren (boa’s)

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the relationship between police and municipal enforcement officers (boa's), including the risk of a fragmented, overlapping framework and calls for a single municipal enforcement service. The minister replies that existing rules are adequate, that municipalities set their own arrangements, and that exam standards for boa's will be tightened from 1 October.
I do not intend to make further changes to this.
Ik ben niet voornemens hier verder wijzigingen in aan te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over antiterrorisme controles op Utrecht Centraal Station

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about a large police 'spotter' control at Utrecht Centraal station in March 2012 and its legal basis, purpose, frequency, public impact and proportionality.
