The minister answered that it was a preventive KLPD action without a terrorism threat, that such actions recur without advance notice, that citizens are not informed beforehand, and that the method is proportionate and effective, but declined to commission a new study.
The usefulness and necessity of the spotter actions have been proven during earlier actions.
Het nut en de noodzaak van de spotteracties zijn tijdens eerdere acties bewezen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Marcouch over homo-acceptatie in het voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether homo-acceptance in football needs an active action plan, whether the Netherlands lags Germany and England, and whether a national John Blankenstein prize should be introduced. The minister answered that existing measures (the safer sport action plan and the Gay Straight Alliance) suffice, declined to draw up a new football-specific plan, and left initiatives such as a prize to the sports parties themselves.
No, the effort described above is comprehensive and already takes the lead in keeping sport enjoyable for everyone regardless of sexual orientation and countering aggression.
Nee, de hierboven beschreven inzet is veelomvattend en neemt al het voortouw om sport voor iedereen ongeacht geaardheid leuk te houden en agressie tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Çelik en Marcouch over bestuursperikelen bij de Amsterdamse Islamitische Basisschool As-Siddieq

MPs Çelik and Marcouch asked the Minister of Education about governance turmoil and possible financial mismanagement at the Amsterdam Islamic primary school As-Siddieq, including suspended board chair and salary risks. The minister replied that no financial mismanagement or unpaid salaries were established, that the inspectorate is tightening supervision because of a dual role of the board chair, and that teaching continues without lesson loss.
The inspectorate ensures that this governance arrangement is terminated.
De inspectie ziet erop toe dat deze bestuurlijke constructie wordt beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Monasch over het ontstaan van no-go area’s in de grote steden

Two PvdA MPs asked whether neglected neighbourhoods in Rotterdam and Amsterdam risk becoming no-go areas, how the government supports municipalities and measures investment there, and how cuts to municipal safety and neighbourhood policy fit with that risk. The minister rejects the professor's conclusion, describes the monitoring instruments and the continued neighbourhood approach, and refers back to earlier answers without committing to new action.
The total investment in the neighbourhoods is not tracked at national level.
Het totaal aan investeringen in de wijken wordt niet op rijksniveau bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hilkens over criminele vreemdelingen

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration about criminal foreigners in Amsterdam, including their share among suspects, their illegal residence, and whether removal powers or capacity should be expanded. The government said national data are not available for the largest cities, that expulsion tools exist and the sliding scale will be tightened from July 2012, and that a targeted use of existing capacity is preferred to new specialist capacity.
We do not have data specific to the situation in the ten largest cities.
Wij beschikken niet over gegevens specifiek voor de situatie in de tien grootste steden.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Arib over politieprioriteiten in Twente

MPs Marcouch and Arib asked the Minister of Security and Justice about local police priorities in Twente, after reports that local CDA and VVD prefer animal police to address sex crimes and that a motion urged broader use of animal cops. The state secretary answered that local input on police priorities is welcome under existing and proposed law, that animal police work within the general police task with regular powers, and that both animal welfare and child pornography are national priorities.
I welcome that municipalities are thinking about how to fill in police priorities.
Ik juich het toe dat in de gemeenten wordt nagedacht over de invulling van politieprioriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over het verzwijgen van feiten rondom een wapenvergunning voor Tristan van der V.

An MP asks the Justice minister whether police concealed facts about the gun permit granted to Tristan van der V., including whether the officer knew of his psychiatric problems and whether the 2005 refusal and the 2008 grant were discussed or documented. The minister answers that the Rijksrecherche investigation found no evidence the officer knew of the psychiatric problems in 2005, that the 2005 letters were lost in a system migration, and that the 2008 file contains no psychiatric information.
The Rijksrecherche conducted an extensive investigation into the granting of the gun permit to Tristan van der V.
De Rijksrecherche heeft uitvoerig onderzoek gedaan naar het verlenen van de wapenvergunning aan Tristan van der V.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, Arib en Marcouch over ongeregeldheden in Noord-Marokko

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about arrests of demonstrators in northern Morocco, including a Dutch-Moroccan man detained for photographing a demonstration, and about Morocco's democratic and human rights reforms. The minister said protesters were detained, that the government should allow peaceful demonstrations, that the man is now free but still faces trial, and that further steps depend on the court outcome.
It is important that the new government shows it takes the modernisation process seriously and allows peaceful demonstrations.
Het is belangrijk dat de nieuwe regering aantoont het moderniseringsproces serieus te nemen en vreedzame demonstraties toestaat.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over een internationale aanpak van voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked whether an international approach to football hooliganism exists, whether an international combined-ticket scheme should be introduced, and whether municipalities should be compensated for extra costs. Minister Opstelten answered that EU cooperation and information exchange already exist, that a combined-ticket scheme is impractical, that police deployment figures are given, and that municipalities remain responsible and need no compensation.
Maintaining public order remains the responsibility of mayors under article 172 of the Municipalities Act.
De handhaving van de openbare orde is en blijft een verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeesters ingevolge artikel 172 van de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt met betrekking tot het gebrek aan tijd bij de politie om winkeldieven aan te pakken

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked whether police lack time to tackle shop theft and whether municipal enforcement officers (BOA's) should handle minor shop theft. The minister replies that shop theft is a serious crime but that BOA's are a complement to police, that a pilot with shop-theft BOA's runs in five municipalities, and that a convenant on sharing camera images with retailers has been signed.
To speed up the handling of shop theft, a pilot with shop BOA's is now being carried out in five municipalities.
Om de afhandeling van winkeldiefstal te versnellen wordt er nu een proef uitgevoerd met winkelboa's in een vijftal gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marouch over het sluiten van de helft van de politiebureaus in Amsterdam

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the minister whether half of Amsterdam's police stations would close under the national police reorganisation and how this squares with promises of local presence and accessibility. The minister said plans were not yet fixed, that the national police will stay rooted locally, that online reporting is being expanded, and that accessibility is a matter of ongoing discussion with the local authority.
Statements about the possible closure of neighbourhood police stations are premature in relation to the national police.
Uitspraken over het mogelijk sluiten van wijkbureaus zijn prematuur in relatie tot de nationale politie.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt over veroordeelde criminelen die nog niet in de gevangenis zitten

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about convicted offenders who have not yet served their prison sentences, including figures on warrants, statute-of-limitations expiry and the TES team. State Secretary Teeven answered that the government takes the problem seriously, gave case figures from the CJIB and OPS, and listed measures to speed up enforcement, though he could not give a precise forecast of future non-enforcement.
I therefore consider it of great importance that the sentences imposed by the judge are actually enforced.
Ik acht het daarom van groot belang dat de door de rechter opgelegde straffen ook daadwerkelijk ten uitvoer worden gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over problemen bij de vorming van de nationale politie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Justice Minister about problems in forming the national police, including a technocratic approach, planning delays, local discretion, centralisation of support services and leadership. The minister rejects the technocracy claim, says the implementation and realisation plans will only be adopted after the law is published, and promises ongoing consultation and communication.
I have promised your House not to take irreversible steps before parliamentary approval of the bill.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten voor parlementaire goedkeuring van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marcouch over overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet door de politie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported widespread violations of the Working Time Act by the police, including whether this amounts to overwork of officers and whether exemptions for special police units are being pursued. The Minister answered that about 180,000 violations were counted in the first half of 2011, that the problem is serious but not proof of systematic overwork given compensation rules, and that part of the issue lies in police pay regulations to be addressed in CAO negotiations, with a letter on the Inspectorate report promised.
The number the Telegraaf describes is therefore its own conclusion.
Het aantal dat de Telegraaf beschrijft, is daarmee een eigen conclusie.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over de zorg van hoofdcommissarissen van politie over de toename van criminaliteit en onveiligheid in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police chiefs' warnings about rising crime, young repeat offenders, and cuts to youth care and mental health services are justified. The minister replied that crime has fallen since 2005, described police networks and programmes against repeat offending, and said youth-care funding was raised and reforms aim at earlier, integrated support.
Despite the economic crisis, crime in the Netherlands has fallen.
Ondanks de economische crisis is de criminaliteit in Nederland gedaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch over het strafrechtelijk afkopen van vervolging na het lastigvallen en bedreigen van een scheidsrechter

MPs asked why three men who harassed and threatened a referee received a 210 euro settlement offer roughly ten months after the incident, and how this fits the government's tough approach to football violence. The minister replied that evidence was insufficient for harassment and threats, that the suspects were offered a 210 euro transaction for theft in association, and that the delay stemmed from further investigation needed after the first report.
For this offence, in line with the applicable guidelines, the Public Prosecution Service offered each of the suspects a transaction proposal of 210 euros.
Het OM heeft voor dit feit – overeenkomstig de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen – aan ieder van de verdachten een transactievoorstel van € 210,– aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Kuiken over problemen bij de examinering in het politieonderwijs

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the minister about exam chaos at the Police Academy, including whether budget cuts caused a shortage of examiners, delays for students, and whether unions had warned in advance. The minister replied that the shift to a new system of police staff serving as examiners within working hours caused a temporary shortage, delaying some exams with priority for final-year students, and that backlogs will be cleared by 1 August 2012.
I have agreed with the Police Academy's executive board that all backlogs will be resolved by 1 August 2012 at the latest.
Met het college van bestuur van de politieacademie afgesproken, dat alle achterstanden uiterlijk 1 augustus 2012 zullen zijn opgelost.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Dikkers over het ontbreken van een deugdelijk rampenplan bij TWO Chemical Logistics

Two PvdA MPs asked why TWO Chemical Logistics in Nijmegen reportedly lacks an adequate disaster plan and what inspections found. The minister reported 2011 Brzo and environmental inspections with remedial deadlines, and said the regional safety board aims to adopt an updated disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
The board of the Gelderland Zuid Safety Region aims to adopt the new disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
Het bestuur van de Veiligheidsregio Gelderland Zuid streeft naar vaststelling van het nieuwe rampbestrijdingsplan op 10 mei 2012.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over criminele jeugd die in Utecht vrij spel heeft (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a criminal youth group intimidating residents in the Utrecht district of Terwijde is active, what is being done, whether it is among the 89 criminal youth groups targeted, and whether forced treatment of group members is possible. The minister answers that the group is classified as a nuisance group with some members committing offences, that police, prosecution and municipality are acting with intensified measures, that the group is not among the 89 criminal groups, and that the ISD programme for young adults will be examined and possibly adapted.
These 89 criminal youth groups will be tackled within two years.
Deze 89 criminele jeugdgroepen worden binnen twee jaar aangepakt.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over tekortkomingen in de werkwijze en aansturing van de wijkagent (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about research showing neighbourhood police officers (wijkagenten) feel isolated, lack time in their neighbourhood, and are poorly supported by detectives, and asked what measures would follow. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to existing and planned measures such as the Nationale Politie reform, robust basic teams, and the Gebiedsscan, but gave few concrete commitments.

The results of the research support the statutory anchoring of the neighbourhood officer and the norm of on average 1 neighbourhood officer per 5000 residents in the Police Act 201X now before the Senate.
De resultaten van het onderzoek ondersteunen de wettelijke verankering van de wijkagent en de norm van gemiddeld 1 wijkagent op 5000 inwoners in de Politiewet 201X die nu voorligt in de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, De Lange en Marcouch over een anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

MPs Timmermans, De Lange and Marcouch asked the foreign minister whether she knows the anti-homosexuality bill providing for the death penalty has been reintroduced in Uganda's parliament, whether she considers it a human rights violation, and how she will increase pressure on Uganda. The minister confirmed the bill violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations, said the Netherlands has repeatedly raised this bilaterally and multilaterally, and noted the Ugandan prime minister distanced himself from the proposal in a written statement.
The Netherlands has repeatedly pointed out to the Ugandan authorities, both bilaterally and multilaterally, that such a law violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations in this area.

Nederland heeft herhaaldelijk in zowel bi- als multilateraal verband de Oegandese autoriteiten erop gewezen dat een dergelijke wet in strijd is met de mensenrechten en de Oegandese internationale verplichtingen op dit terrein.

Vragen van de leden Samsom en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het voorkomen van het opzuigen van bommen bij zandwinning (ingezonden 23 december 2011

MPs Samsom and Marcouch asked ministers whether dredging for sand had brought WWII bombs to the surface and transported them, what risks and safety measures applied, who bears the costs, and whether the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid should review the procedure. The government answered that risks cannot be fully excluded and that extra measures were taken near the Weesp railway bridge, but declined to instruct the Safety Board since it is independent.
The Dutch Safety Board is independent in determining which accidents it investigates within the framework of the Safety Board Act.
De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is onafhankelijk bij het bepalen van de door haar, binnen de kaders van de Wet Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, te onderzoeken ongevallen.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over een vuurwerkverbod

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a possible ban on private fireworks, citing news reports, a No Ties poll and enforcement costs. The minister declines to pursue a total ban for now, calls the No Ties poll less representative than a 2008 TNS NIPO study, and notes municipalities can only designate specific no-fireworks zones.
The No Ties research is, as far as I can tell, more limited in design, and I therefore consider it less representative.
Het onderzoek van onderzoeksbureau No Ties is voor zover ik na kan gaan beperkter van opzet en acht ik daardoor minder representatief.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over de vertraging en het nut van een Nationaal Noodnet voor communicatie bij rampen

Marcouch and Van Dekken (PvdA) asked why the Nationaal Noodnet replacement for disaster communication is delayed and whether it is useful. Minister Opstelten answered that migration to the NCV is slower than expected because users are reconsidering, the old network still functions, the NCV has extra functions, and the government will not terminate the KPN contract.

In line with the commitment made during the consultation of 8 February 2012 on the amendment of the Safety Regions Act, I will inform the House further about the management, monitoring and execution of various ICT projects.

Conform de toezegging tijdens het overleg van 8 februari 2012 inzake de wijziging van wet Veiligheidsregio's, in verband met de oprichting van het Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid, zal ik u de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over het beheer de monitoring en de uitvoering van verschillende ICT-projecten.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «doorgesnoven» en «ladderzatte» hooligans die de benefietwedstrij

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers why about 100 Feyenoord hooligans, some under stadium bans, attended and allegedly disrupted a charity match in Spakenburg and why the riot police were not deployed earlier, and whether the Football Act should bar banned fans from friendly matches. Minister Opstelten answered that the group left without disrupting the event, police lacked validated prior information, the ME was only kept on standby, the Wmbveo already offers tools such as area bans and that the law is being evaluated early, and the club can recover its own damage.
This is also the conclusion from the press release of VV IJsselmeervogels of 12 January 2012.
Dit is ook de conclusie uit de persverklaring van de VV IJsselmeervogels van 12 januari 2012
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik door de politie van een zwarte lijst van overvallers (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about police use of a 'black list' (Top-X list) of robbers subjected to intensive monitoring to reduce recidivism, and how it fits national priorities and could be applied more widely. The minister replied that the method is still young, its effects on recidivism will be monitored in several municipalities with a first report only after two years, and that the approach may be extended to other high-impact crimes if it succeeds.
The effect of this deployment on recidivism (within two years) among robbers is being monitored in a number of municipalities.
Het effect van deze inzet op de recidive (binnen twee jaar) van overvallers wordt in een aantal gemeenten gemonitord.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Kuiken over het geven van een taakstraf na mishandeling agent

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why a Utrecht man who struck a police officer received a partly suspended 40-hour community service sentence, and whether the prosecution's demand was adequate. The minister said the prosecution had itself judged a partly unconditional prison sentence more appropriate, that it has appealed, and that a local group-based approach to the Terwijde neighbourhood is underway.
On reflection, according to the Public Prosecution Service, demanding a (partly) unconditional prison sentence would have been appropriate.
Bij nader inzien had volgens het Openbaar Ministerie het eisen van een (deels) onvoorwaardelijke gevangenisstraf in de rede gelegen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wantoestanden bij het Landelijk Expertise Centrum Diversiteit (LECD) (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported crisis and misconduct at the police diversity centre LECD, including staff departures and whether the centre can contribute to police diversity. The minister said an independent investigation led by Marijnen is due by 1 March 2012 and would then inform parliament, restated the diversity policy framework, and referred back to that answer for the remaining questions.
The Police Academy is having an independent investigation carried out into the situation reported on by the programme Nieuwsuur.
De Politieacademie laat een onafhankelijk onderzoek verrichten naar de situatie waarover het programma Nieuwsuur heeft bericht.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over voetbalrellen in Utrecht (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about football riots in Utrecht, the responsibility of supporters, information exchange between police forces, national handling of football violence, and whether the Football Act should be tightened. The minister said the investigation is ongoing, described the existing information-sharing system, defended regional policing of football violence, and announced an early evaluation of the football violence act including area bans and penalties.
I consider it desirable that all police forces take part in the Hooligans in Beeld programme and I will address them on this.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat alle korpsen deel nemen aan het programma Hooligans in Beeld en zal hen hier op aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over angst om aangifte te doen tegen homohaters (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

MP Marcouch asks the Justice minister whether the government will act on residents of a Amsterdam neighbourhood who reportedly fear reporting threats against gay people, and on whether police did enough to find the perpetrators. The minister answers that the district and police organised meetings, actively urged reporting, offered anonymous reporting options and that police opened an investigation with one arrest and one further suspect heard, while stating that police capacity cannot be reconstructed.
It is administratively very burdensome to map out the police capacity deployed in this case.
Het is administratief zeer bewerkelijk de politiecapaciteit in kaart te brengen van de inzet in deze zaak.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een gerechtelijke uitspraak ten aanzien van ernstige woonoverlast en

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a court ruling on serious nuisance between neighbours and the use of cameras, and how government supports victims and equips municipalities. The ministers answered that the ruling is consistent with existing views on private camera surveillance, that existing instruments suffice, and that the CCV will be asked to add the case to its handbook and continue expert meetings.
I will, however, bring the court ruling to the attention of the Centre for Crime Prevention and Safety (CCV).
Wel zal ik de uitspraak van de rechter onder de aandacht brengen van het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid (CCV).
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over haatcriminaliteit tegen het openbaar gezag (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a tweet insulting the Rotterdam mayor, hate crime via social media, and whether mayors should report hate crime against officials. The minister said such insults could fall under criminal insult provisions, no separate hate-crime data exists, and officials should report offences, with registration and a support website promoted.
No data are available on the total number of criminal offences that could be classed as hate crime.
Over de omvang van alle strafbare feiten die als haatcriminaliteit te betitelen zijn, zijn daarom geen gegevens voorhanden.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van jeugdbendes (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

MP Marcouch asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a report on removing younger siblings of gang members from their homes, whether this fits the policy against youth gangs, the legal basis, family links in gang crime, and whether youth groups are becoming more organised. The minister responds that removal is a last resort under child-protection law, that the approach focuses on the offender with preventive attention to siblings, that parents are increasingly involved through existing procedures, and that gangs are fluid rather than becoming more structured.
I focus the approach primarily on the person causing the problems.
Ik richt de aanpak in de eerste plaats op degene die de problemen veroorzaakt.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over hatecrimes (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about hate crimes, including reports of 158 people driven out of their homes or workplaces for who they are, and proposals for a police hate-crime unit, anonymous reporting and better registration. The minister answered by referring to the July 2011 anti-discrimination letter listing measures, said anonymous reporting is limited to exceptional threatening situations while hate crimes can be reported anonymously online, and promised a progress report on homo-emancipation policy and discussion of the motion at a committee meeting.
The discrimination letter (Parliamentary Papers II, 2010–2011, 30 950, no. 34) lists a large number of measures against hate crime.
In de discriminatiebrief (Kamerstukken II, vergaderjaar 2010–2011, 30 950, nr. 34 ) wordt een groot aantal maatregelen tegen haatcriminaliteit opgesomd
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het weggepeste homostel uit Ulft (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP asks ministers whether a gay couple in Ulft driven out by local harassment reflects systemic failures by municipalities and police, and what will be done to improve reporting, expertise and registration. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to police training, a discrimination letter, national rollout of a police LHBT approach, and better registration and annual reporting to parliament.
I can only observe that it is not self-evident that reports of nuisance also reach police officers and municipal officials who focus on combating discrimination.

Ik kan alleen constateren dat het niet vanzelfsprekend is dat meldingen over overlast ook terecht komen bij politiemedewerkers en gemeenteambtenaren die zich richten op de bestrijding van discriminatie.

Vragen van de leden Albayrak en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de Servische regering zwicht voor homofoben (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the government about reports that Serbia's government was giving in to homophobic pressure, after the Belgrade Gay Pride was cancelled for security reasons, and how the Netherlands would press Serbia to protect sexual minorities. The minister answered that the Pride cancellation was a step back, that Serbia should work to hold future events, and that the Netherlands raised the issue with EU and Serbian officials and supports NGOs promoting LGBT rights.
The cabinet understands these considerations, but believes Serbia should do everything possible to allow the Gay Pride to take place in the future.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze overwegingen, maar vindt dat Servië alles in het werk moet stellen om de Gay Pride in de toekomst doorgang te laten vinden.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de overbelasting van het pestmeldpunt van de Gay Krant (ingezonden 24 oktober 2011).

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Gay Krant's anti-bullying reporting point being overloaded, arguing that victims avoid going to police and whether the paper should be handling tasks police should perform. The minister said reporting via LHBT organisations is acceptable provided potentially criminal cases reach police and the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to measures already taken to encourage reporting, and noted ongoing talks with LHBT groups and the OM on handling such reports.
It is important that cases in which criminal offences may be involved are then also made known to the police and the Public Prosecution Service
Het is wel zaak dat de gevallen waarin mogelijk sprake is van strafbare feiten vervolgens ook bij de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie bekend worden
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de kosten van het bellen naar het Landelijk Telefoonnummer Politie (09008844) (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why calling the national police number 0900-8844 costs money, what the per-minute costs are across providers, and whether the number should be free. The minister answered that the number carries a low local tariff, that mobile tariffs vary, that prices have been lowered through agreements and that new regulation is being prepared so that mobile operators cannot charge more than for geographic numbers.
The starting point is that the tariff equals the tariff for calling geographic telephone numbers.
Het uitgangspunt is dat het tarief gelijk is aan het tarief voor het bellen naar geografische telefoonnummers
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de reactie van OM en politie op rellen door Feyenoordhooligans (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the Justice minister why two suspects in the Feyenoord stadium riot were released with summonses before their role was found to be larger, whether they can be re-detained, and whether lifetime stadium bans should be introduced. The minister said both suspects were later taken into custody, one detention was suspended, the prosecution is investigating actively, and he will await the 2012 evaluation of the football violence law before changing it.
Since the criminal investigation into the suspects is still in full swing, I cannot provide any further information at this time.
Aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachten nog in volle gang is, kan ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen doen.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het dreigende ontslag van een homoseksuele docent op een gereformeerde school (ingezonden 30 september 2011).

An MP asks the Education Minister about the threatened dismissal of a gay teacher at a Reformed school, whether this conflicts with equal treatment and sends a harmful signal to gay pupils. The minister confirms the suspension, says the matter is for the courts, and states that schools may not dismiss staff for being gay or for a same-sex relationship under the Awgb, pointing to anti-bullying and safety policy and a forthcoming government position on the 'enkel-feit' construction.
For the rest I cannot make statements about this because it is a matter for the courts.
Voor het overige kan ik hierover geen uitspraken doen omdat dit aan de rechter is.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de afwezigheid van een vacature voor medewerker dieren politie bij het KLPD (ingezonden 26 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a KLPD vacancy page said no vacancy could be filled because the duties of animal police were unknown, and whether 500 animal police staff were needed. The minister acknowledged the website text was outdated and replaced, stated no open applications were received, and said animal police is a priority within the operational strength available for all police tasks.
The text on the KLPD website is outdated and has since been replaced by a current text.
De tekst op de website van het KLPD is achterhaald en inmiddels vervangen door een actuele tekst.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dreigende leegloop van de politieacademies (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police trainees' salaries were cut by 18-22% from July 2011, possibly discouraging enrolment and increasing dropout, and how this fits with recruitment targets. The minister answered that the cut follows from the 2010 package deal with police unions, was foreseeable through recruitment information, may cause limited pay differences where korpsen apply maatwerk, and that police remain attractive and recruitment targets are being pursued.
To the extent that other differences have arisen within the korpsen, I have again pointed out to the korpsen that remuneration must take place in accordance with the applicable regulations.
Voor zover er binnen de korpsen andersoortige verschillen zijn ontstaan heb ik de korpsen er nogmaals op gewezen dat de salariëring conform de geldende regelgeving moet plaatsvinden.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat nepvuurwapens grootschalig worden gebruikt voor het begaan van misdrijven (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that imitation firearms are widely used in crimes, including whether police forces register them consistently, whether a total import ban on realistic replica firearms is possible, whether air guns that look like real guns can be told apart from them, and whether air guns should be brought under a stricter permit regime. The minister answers that police registration will be improved, that realistic replicas are already banned under category I of the Weapons and Ammunition Act, that records do not distinguish how often realistic air guns were used, and that air gun regulation will be reviewed by the end of the year.
The official police report only records which category the weapon belongs to.
In het proces verbaal wordt alleen geregistreerd tot welke categorie het wapen behoort.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wijkenaanpak van de regering naar aanleiding van de voortdurende onrust in de Culemborgse wijk Terweijde (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011)

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the government's neighbourhood approach after renewed unrest in Culemborg's Terweijde district, including the causes of the unrest, investment and results, incident and arrest figures, and the need for a long-term approach. Minister Opstelten answered that the municipality's 'Aansprekend Terweijde' plan has reduced nuisance and vandalism, that Rijk and gemeente invested 3 million euro, that 73 people were arrested since January 2010, and that local authorities hold the primary responsibility for order and safety.
The local authority has the instruments and possibilities to enforce public order and safety.
Het lokale gezag heeft de instrumenten en mogelijkheden om openbare orde en veiligheid te handhaven.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over geweld tegen de politie (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Interior about rising violence against police, police use of firearms, calls to widen police force powers, and EU comparisons. The minister answered that victimisation has stayed high with a shift from physical violence to intimidation, that firearm use with injury has not increased, that no broader force powers are needed, and that EU countries are broadly similar.
Although there is no national registration of police firearm use, research shows that police firearm use resulting in injury has not increased.
Hoewel er geen landelijke registratie is van het vuurwapengebruik door de politie blijkt uit onderzoek 3 dat het vuurwapengebruik – met letsel tot gevolg – door de politie niet is toegenomen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gegeven dat Nederland de mensenrechten van transgenders schendt (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands violates transgender rights by requiring sterilisation for legal gender recognition under article 28 of the Civil Code, and whether article 28 will be amended. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the HRW report and said the sterilisation requirement will be removed, with a draft bill out for consultation and simplified changes to diploma gender markers planned.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen voor het aantal inbraken (ingezonde

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked ministers whether budget cuts are driving a rise in home burglaries and what will be done about it. The minister confirms a rising trend in registered burglaries, cites a CBS and CCV decline in Politiekeurmerk certificates, and points to prevention measures and citizen responsibility without committing to new funding.
An increase in home burglary is for me a worrying signal.
Een toename van woninginbraak is voor mij een zorgwekkend signaal.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bescherming van juweliers en andere middenstanders (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about protection of jewellers after a Nijmegen jeweller threatened legal action over inadequate protection, the reported 'no-entry for allochtonen' shop policy, robbery statistics and the anti-robbery action plan. The minister answered that victim support schemes are offered, that shopkeepers may apply a door policy, provided robbery figures and clearance rates, and that the focus is on priority and detection rather than capacity.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot provide any information on this at this time.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik daarover op dit moment geen mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over terreur van Marokkaanse jongeren in Helmond. (Ingezonden augustus 20

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked ministers about intimidation and harassment by Moroccan youths in the Binnenstad Oost district of Helmond, including the role of local authorities and police, the number of youths involved, parental responsibility, reporting of crimes, camera monitoring and a reported neighbourhood curfew. The ministers answered that the situation is a nuisance problem rather than uncontrollable, describing an integrated local approach with arrests, a nuisance hotline, area bans and individual trajectories, and reported falling incident and nuisance figures.
There is a nuisance situation that must be tackled. There is no uncontrollable situation as presented in the cited article.
Er is sprake van een overlastsituatie die aangepakt moet worden. Er is geen sprake van een onbeheersbare situatie zoals deze wordt voorgesteld in genoemd artikel.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bedreigen en wegpesten van een lesbisch stel uit Haarlem (ingezonden 8 aug

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Education, Culture and Science about the threats and harassment of a lesbian couple in Haarlem, including whether police had been contacted over 20 times, whether such relocations are common, and whether a specific police code and a hate-crimes provision should be introduced. The minister answered that police recorded reports, six complaints were filed, two cases were sent to the prosecutor, and the municipality's mediation failed, while the government opposed a separate hate-crimes article and pointed to existing sentencing guidelines and planned measures.
There are however no concrete figures available showing how often this occurs.
Er zijn evenwel geen concrete cijfers beschikbaar waaruit blijkt hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de gang van zaken bij een gewelddadige overal op een geldtransportbedrijf in Amsterdam (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the armed robbery at the Brinks cash transport company in Amsterdam, including the chase, police preparedness, escalation of response and cross-border cooperation. The minister described the event as exceptionally violent, outlined the response timeline, said a new coordinated operational plan for special units has been implemented, and stated existing EU and bilateral tools suffice for cross-border action.
After the violent robbery at Brinks, I asked the Korps Landelijke Politie Diensten, in cooperation with the special units of the police and the Royal Military Police, to draw up an operational plan.

Na de geweldadige overval op Brinks heb ik het Korps Landelijke Politie Diensten gevraagd om in samenwerking met de speciale eenheden van de politie en de Koninklijke marechaussee een operationeel plan op stellen.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over lesbisch ouderschap (ingezonden 25 juli 2011).

An MP asks the ministers why the Lesbian Parenthood bill has been delayed repeatedly and whether it will be submitted this summer, and how this fits earlier commitments. The state secretary replies that the Council of State has advised, a further report is being prepared, and submission is expected mid-September, in line with the summer commitment, while citing the complexity of the report as the reason for delay.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Dikkers en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over anti-homo uitspraken van een Surinaamse parlementslid (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns anti-gay remarks by a Surinamese parliamentarian, Asabina, and whether the EU will jointly condemn them and open dialogue with Suriname on LGBT rights. The minister agreed the remarks are undesirable, stated they do not reflect the Surinamese government's position, and said LGBT rights are part of bilateral and EU human rights dialogue and that the ministry supports Surinamese LGBT organisations.
The statements by parliamentarian Asabina do not reflect the position of the Surinamese government.
De uitlatingen van de parlementariër Asabina geven niet het standpunt van de Surinaamse regering weer.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie in Marokko van de Nederlandse pro-democratie activiste Fatima Zahra Moukafih (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011

MPs Timmermans and Marcouch asked the foreign minister whether Dutch activist Fatima Zahra Moukafih had been arrested in Morocco and whether the government would protest and use diplomatic means to secure her release. The minister confirmed the arrest and replied that she had already been released, so no protest was made.
No, the person concerned has meanwhile been released.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van verdachten van een overval op een Amsterdamse juwelier (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice why suspects in an Amsterdam jewellery robbery were released by a court, and why victims learned of it from a journalist rather than from the prosecution, and what the OM and courts do to inform victims and the neighbourhood. The state secretary answered that the OM has appealed, that victims' information duties are clear and the OM did not inform them promptly, that local mayors are responsible for informing residents, and that the OM does not consider the released suspect a flight risk.
It is not for me to take action in an individual criminal case or to pass judgment on a court ruling.
Het is niet aan mij om actie te nemen in individuele strafzaak of om een oordeel te vellen over een uitspraak van de rechtbank.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bestrijding van de visstroperij in Nederland en in F

MPs Jacobi and Marcouch asked why the Friesland fish-poaching enforcement team was dissolved amid budget cuts, and about the current approach to fish poaching. The state secretary answered that enforcement continues in three regional teams, that a bill strengthening poaching enforcement is pending, and that a more offender-focused approach and animal police are planned, though the future institutional arrangement is still to be decided.
What matters is that fish poaching enforcement is not endangered. I will, together with my colleague of Security and Justice, examine what the most appropriate form for this is.
Van belang is dat de stroperijbestrijding niet in gevaar komt. Ik zal samen met mijn ambtgenoot van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien wat daarvoor de meest passende vorm is.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de brandweerkorpsen die te weinig tegen agressie en geweld tegen hun personeel doen (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why eleven fire brigade units received warnings from the Labour Inspectorate for insufficient measures against aggression and violence toward staff, which units still fall short, and what the Public Prosecution Service and police are doing about reporting and prosecution. The government answered that eight units still do not meet the inspectorate's requirements, that the responsibility lies mainly with the employers and regional safety councils, and that it is strengthening reporting, prosecution and monitoring through existing programmes.
The Minister of Security and Justice will press for the fire brigade units to meet the requirements set by the Labour Inspectorate as soon as possible.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie zal er op aandringen dat de brandweerkorpsen op zo kort mogelijke termijn voldoen aan de door de Arbeidsinspectie gestelde eisen

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het stopzetten van het onderzoeksprogramma Politie en Wetenschap en de toekomst van het wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he plans to end the independent Police and Science research programme and move its work into the Police Academy and WODC, and about the budget and independence of police research. The Minister denied ending the programme outright, said he will replace the Commission with an independent Police Knowledge Council, keep independent allocation of research funds, and stressed the research budget will follow demonstrated need without a cut as the primary aim.
My proposal is to merge the Police and Science Commission into a new independent Police Knowledge Council.
Mijn voorstel is om de Commissie Politie en Wetenschap op te laten gaan in een nieuwe onafhankelijke Politiekennisraad.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de handhaving van wapenverloven voor sportschutters (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about enforcement of firearm permits for sport shooters, following a Zembla broadcast, including police compliance with the firearms circular, verification of applicants' mental health and a proposed KNSA reporting point. The State Secretary responds that the OVV is investigating the legal firearm control system and that he will inform parliament once its findings are available, without answering the substantive questions now.

The letter further indicated that, on the basis of the research findings, it will be considered which conclusions should be drawn regarding the policy on legal firearm possession and the supervision thereof.

In de brief is verder aangegeven dat op basis van de onderzoeksuitkomsten zal worden bezien welke conclusies zouden moeten worden getrokken ten aanzien van het beleid met betrekking tot legaal wapenbezit en het toezicht daarop.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het waarborgen van de veiligheid bij het opstellen van dekkings- en spreidingsplannen voor de brandweer en de keuze voo

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch ask the Minister of Security and Justice how safety is guaranteed when fire service coverage and dispersal plans are drawn up, including variable vehicle crewing and deviations from response times. The minister replies that no single national model yet exists, that regions remain responsible for deviations, and that an IOOV study on actual response times will report by end 2011.
To get a picture of response times in the Netherlands, a study of actual response times and their (administrative) deviations will be carried out on behalf of my Ministry and the Security Council.

Om een beeld te krijgen van de opkomsttijden in Nederland komt er, in opdracht van mijn Ministerie en het veiligheidsberaad, een onderzoek naar de daadwerkelijk gerealiseerde opkomsttijden en de (bestuurlijke) afwijking hiervan.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers , Timmermans en Marchouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitwet in Oeganda (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

MPs Dikkers, Timmermans and Marchouch asked whether the Netherlands would use development aid as leverage against Uganda's proposed anti-homosexuality bill, whether it would press the EU and World Bank to condition aid, what was being done to protect threatened LGBTI activists, and whether the embassy would open to them. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposes the bill and has raised concerns at the highest level, but that aid conditionality is not currently on the table, that EHAHRDP has run a security assessment and provided practical protection, and that the embassy already maintains contacts with the LGBTI community.
Using Dutch aid to Uganda as a means of pressure, as well as making EU and World Bank aid conditional, is currently not on the agenda.
Het inzetten van de Nederlandse hulp aan Oeganda als pressiemiddel, maar ook het conditioneel maken van de hulp van EU en Wereldbank, is op dit moment niet aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over rellen en vernielingen bij het huis van de burgemeester van Urk (ingezonden 13 mei 2011

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about riots and vandalism at the Urk mayor's home, the police investigation, the mayor's protection, and whether the Urk culture-change approach is sufficient. The ministers said the mayor deserves support, a criminal investigation is ongoing with three arrests, and that the police and municipality handle the situation locally, with no further intervention planned beyond existing measures.
To protect the investigation, no further details can be given about the start of the investigation, its progress, and the cooperation received.
Ter bescherming van het opsporingsbelang kunnen geen verdere bijzonderheden worden gegeven over de start van het onderzoek, het verloop daarvan en de medewerking daaraan.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het aantal opgeloste woninginbraken (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about the low share of solved home burglaries, rising burglary numbers, perpetrator profiles, hotspot targeting, and whether tenants can require burglary-proof security. The minister acknowledges a slight rise since 2007, describes police pilots, forensic expansion, hotspot analysis, voluntary prevention schemes, and states that tenants' rights do not require a statutory rule because landlords generally cooperate.
There is no detailed picture of the share of Eastern Europeans in home burglaries, partly because not all burglaries are reported and far from all reported burglaries are solved.

Er bestaat geen gedetailleerd beeld van de omvang van het aandeel Oost-Europeanen bij woninginbraken, onder andere omdat niet alle woninginbraken worden gemeld en lang niet alle gemelde woninginbraken worden opgelost.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het terugdringen van de Combi-regeling en het verminderen van de politie-inzet bij voetbalwedstrijden (i

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked whether agreements had been made nationally to reduce the Combi-regeling and police deployment at football matches, and about the role of the health minister and the 'Nieuw beleidskader voetbal en veiligheid'. The government confirmed that national partners agreed to reduce combi-cards and that the framework would be sent to parliament, while stating that the health ministry plays only a limited role and that supporter demands on kick-off times and stadium bans are for clubs and local actors rather than the minister to examine.
The framework for policy will be sent to your House this week.
Het kader voor beleid zal deze week aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over onderzoek naar de bedreiging van medewerkers van jongerencentrum Asri (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether threats against staff of youth centre Asri, triggered by a campaign poster before the provincial elections, are being investigated and how staff can be protected to file complaints. The minister answered that anonymous reporting and other protections exist, that police are investigating, and that he will consult the Public Prosecution Service on making ex officio investigation of serious threats standard policy.

If it can be established that there are serious threats against Asri staff, the public prosecutor will instruct the police to conduct a criminal investigation into the possible perpetrators, even without a complaint having been filed.

Indien vastgesteld kan worden dat er sprake is van ernstige bedreigingen aan het adres van medewerkers van Asri, dan zal de officier van justitie de politie opdracht geven om een opsporingsonderzoek te verrichten naar de mogelijke daders, ook zonder dat aangifte is gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over taakstraf in de buurt (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the state secretary about community service (taakstraf) carried out in the offender's neighbourhood, failure rates, arrests and speed of enforcement. The state secretary answered that work in the neighbourhood will be explored with the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, that enforcement timelines and protocols are being reviewed, and that the pilot evaluation results will feed into quality improvements.
I will explore with the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming the possibilities to further expand carrying out community service in the neighbourhood.
Ik ga met de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming de mogelijkheden verkennen om het uitvoeren van werkstraffen in de buurt verder uit te breiden.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het falen van de opsporing (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

The MP Marcouch asks the Minister of Security and Justice about alleged police failure in investigating serious crime, including a faulty central computer system (BVH/BVO), victims' dissatisfaction with reports, falling reporting rates, and an annual quota of 250,000 suspects. The minister denies that police are unable to act on serious crime, acknowledges temporary system problems and reporting delays, states no evidence that suspects walk free, and says the quota was replaced by new priorities, with some points deferred to the Algemene Rekenkamer report.
The picture painted in the broadcast of the three cases, however, does not match the information the Public Prosecution Service has provided me.
Het beeld dat in de uitzending werd geschetst van de drie zaken komt echter niet overeen met de informatie die mij door het Openbaar Ministerie is verstrekt.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het in dienst nemen van oudere politieagenten (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether physical entry requirements for police recruits should differ by age, following a report recommending an older police force. The minister said no age differentiation currently exists, that the Police Academy is analysing age-differentiated norm times for the physical test due for introduction around summer 2011, and that other selection criteria apply equally to all candidates.
The objective is to introduce the new norm times for the physical motor test around the summer.
Doelstelling is om de nieuwe normtijden voor het fysiek motorisch onderzoek rond de zomer in te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over auto-inbraken in Amsterdam (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why car break-ins in Amsterdam Nieuw-West are not a police priority, whether cuts to Montfrans funds for neighbourhood safety will worsen insecurity, and what budget will be freed. The minister answers that local authorities set priorities, that national priorities include high-impact crime with a 25% higher arrest-chance target, and that structural safety funds via the Gemeentefonds continue after 2011.
It is up to the local authorities to set priorities and take action in a specific situation like this one.
Het is aan het lokale gezag om in een specifieke situatie als deze prioriteiten te stelen en acties te ondernemen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van brandweerwagens (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reduction of fire engines and volunteer firefighters in the Midden- and West-Brabant safety region, and whether this follows from a national coverage plan. The minister answered that the reduction results from a regional risk profile and coverage plan approved by the regional board, that response times stay within legal norms, and that the government is not responsible for the operational decisions.
The board of the MWB safety region will make choices and decisions on substantive grounds.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio MWB zal op inhoudelijke gronden keuzen maken en besluiten nemen.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over int

MPs Klijnsma and Marcouch ask how intersex people can obtain legal recognition of their sex and whether a sex-change operation should be required. The government answers that sex can be corrected in the birth register via court order under article 1:24 BW without surgery, and that the sterilisation requirement for transgender people will be dropped in a forthcoming bill.
The requirement of a sex-change operation is not relevant in that regard.
Het vereiste van een geslachtsveranderende operatie is daarbij niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het kunnen sluiten van mechanische ventilatie bij rampen (ingezonden

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked whether mechanical ventilation in homes can be quickly switched off during disasters involving hazardous substances, and what has been done since 2008 (including after the Moerdijk fire). The minister answered that switching off is desirable, that industry guidance exists, that the situation has changed little, and that calamity switches are rarely installed, while promising a policy response in a later progress report.

Consultation in the industry has led to the technical information on arrangements for temporarily switching off mechanical ventilation systems being developed, generally available and brought to the attention of members by industry organisations.

Overleg in de branche heeft er toe geleid dat nu de informatie over de technische mogelijkheden om voorzieningen te realiseren voor het tijdelijk uitschakelen van mechanische ventilatiesystemen is ontwikkeld, algemeen beschikbaar is en door brancheorganisatie bij hun leden onder de aandacht wordt gebracht.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en Veiligheid en Justitie over grievende uitspraken over homo’s door leraren te Kampen (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MP Marcouch asked ministers whether teachers at a Kampen school holding that homosexuality is a psychiatric disorder was acceptable, whether the government would investigate, and whether teachers could be sanctioned or prosecuted. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found the statement was a debate proposition in class, not a teacher's or school's view, so no further investigation, sanctions or criminal proceedings were deemed warranted, while pointing to existing school anti-bullying and homo-emancipation measures.

From information from the Inspectorate of Education, it has become clear that at Ichtus College in Kampen a debate took place in 6 vwo based on various propositions, including the proposition that homosexuality is a psychological disorder.

Uit informatie van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, is mij gebleken dat bij het Ichtus College in Kampen in 6 vwo een debat heeft plaatsgevonden aan de hand van diverse stellingen, waaronder de stelling dat homoseksualiteit een psychische aandoening betreft.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de positie van homoseksuele asielzoekers (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MP Spekman asked the immigration minister whether existing policy suffices for LHBT asylum seekers facing problems in reception centres, and about protection, housing and status criteria. The minister replied that policy is adequate but that COA will study how to lower barriers to reporting incidents, that homosexuals with a well-founded fear of persecution can receive asylum regardless of criminalisation, and that a study will conclude in summer 2011.

That is why, in my conversation with Secret Garden and COC Nederland, I agreed that COA will examine with these organisations how possible barriers to reporting incidents that LHBT people may experience can be removed.

Daarom heb ik tijdens het gesprek met Secret Garden en COC Nederland afgesproken dat het COA samen met deze organisaties onderzoekt hoe mogelijke drempels voor meldingsbereidheid, die LHBT's bij incidenten kunnen ervaren, kunnen worden weggenomen.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onveiligheid in Vinexwijken (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about insecurity in Vinex neighbourhoods, including the claim that these areas could become future ghettos, rising complaints, and budget cuts to safety funding. The minister replied that there is no evidence Vinex areas are worse than elsewhere, that local problems are primarily for municipalities with national support, that structural safety funding continues, and that police intervention is not shown to be higher than in comparable neighbourhoods.
Centrally there is no insight into this information at neighbourhood or district level.
Centraal bestaat er geen inzicht in deze informatie op wijk- of buurtniveau.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers die hulp moeten ontberen vanwege een falend computersysteem bij de politie (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police IT failures left about 15,000 crime victims without referral to Slachtofferhulp Nederland. The state secretary denied a system fault, acknowledged that officers often do not tick the referral box, and said he asked police leadership to make referral automatic and to ensure correct entry in all forces.
I have therefore asked the police to introduce such a 100% referral in the system as soon as possible.
Ik heb daarom aan de politie gevraagd om op zo kort mogelijke termijn een dergelijke 100%-doorverwijzing in het systeem in te voeren.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bestrijding van antisemitische uitingen (ingezonden 11 februari 2011

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about a TV item showing a youth giving a Hitler salute and shouting antisemitic slurs at an interfaith walk, whether a complaint was filed, whether police acted, and whether police should use undercover officers and how many arrests for antisemitism occurred. The minister replied that a complaint was filed, a criminal investigation is ongoing with the suspect's photo published, police can act without a complaint and prosecution follows under the discrimination directive, no police were present at the walk, undercover deployment is a local matter, and national figures will follow before summer.
As the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any further statements.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog loopt, kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over verkeerd gebruiken van Meld Misdaad Anoniem door de politie (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Noord-Holland-Noord used anonymous tips from Meld Misdaad Anoniem to approach suspects without further evidence, and how this affects trust in the tip line. The minister answered that the tip was supported by additional investigation, that anonymous tips may be used as starting information under Supreme Court case law, and that the police acted carefully.
The anonymous tip referred to in the article was supported by additional investigative information.
De anonieme tip waaraan het artikel refereert was onderbouwd met aanvullende onderzoeksgegevens.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet werken van het politiecommunicatiesysteem C2000 (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the C2000 police communication mast on the Essenburgsingel in Rotterdam is still not fully working, whether it is needed at that location, and whether that creates unsafe situations in the city centre. The minister replied that the mast has been operational since November 2009 and covers the Blijdorp area, that the antenna for the city centre is not yet switched on (expected in May), that no equivalent alternative locations exist, and that the central-city coverage improvement requires a package of technical measures.
Given the location of the other installed antenna sites, no alternative locations are available for this site that would provide equivalent coverage for the Rotterdam city centre.

Er zijn – gezien de locatie van de overige geplaatste opstelpunten – geen alternatieve locaties voor dit opstelpunt beschikbaar die een gelijkwaardige dekking voor de binnenstad van Rotterdam opleveren.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de oproep van de voorzitter van het College van procureurs-generaal om winkelbeveiligers te bewapenen (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

Marcouch (PvdA) asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the chair of the College of Procurators-General's call to arm private shop security guards, and their possible deployment as BOAs, is acceptable, and questions the state's monopoly on force and oversight. Minister Opstelten answers that the state's monopoly on force remains intact, that he was not informed in advance of the speech, that he is exploring public-private roles, and that he will not anticipate that exploration, promising to inform parliament once conclusions are reached.
I do not consider it desirable to anticipate the exploration mentioned in the answer to question 2.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk vooruit te lopen op de in het antwoord op vraag 2 genoemde verkenning.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over tekortschieten van de Wet Victoria bij de aanpak van ernstige overla

MPs Marcouch and Monasch asked ministers whether the Victoria Act is inadequate for tackling serious housing nuisance, citing a Council of State ruling, and about anonymous complaints, evidence use, tenants' rent suspension and drug-cultivation clauses in mortgages. The minister answered that the instrument suffices and is a last resort, that the handbook supports municipalities, that evidence must be concrete and verifiable, and that no legal amendment is planned for now.
I currently see no reason to amend the law.
Ik zie op dit moment geen reden om de wet aan te passen.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verviervoudiging van het aantal overvallen in Zuid-Limburg (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the sharp rise in armed robberies in South Limburg, including solution rates, perpetrators, cross-border drug trade, police capacity, extra support, methods and the possibility of driving bans as additional punishment. The minister answered that solution rates rose to 30% in 2010, that cross-border links were not found, that no special support is planned for now beyond the national action programme, and that he is not inclined to legislate driving bans for robbers.
For now I do not intend to initiate legislation that would make this possible, because I doubt the effectiveness of such a measure.
Ik ben vooralsnog niet van plan om wetgeving te initiëren die dit mogelijk zou maken omdat ik twijfel aan de effectiviteit van een dergelijke maatregel.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over oproepen tot jihad en invoering van de shariah (ingezonden 18 januari 2011).

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a online interview with a Sharia4Belgium spokesman calling implicitly for violence and discrimination against homosexuals and critics, and about links between Sharia4Belgium, Sharia4Holland and arrests in Belgium and the Netherlands. The minister answered that the prosecutor judged the passages not punishable under the criminal code, that Dutch jurisdiction exists, that the three arrested persons were handed over to Belgium at its request, and that ongoing investigations cannot be discussed.
Because of the possible disruption of investigative interests, I cannot provide information about any ongoing criminal investigations.
In verband met het mogelijk doorkruisen van opsporingsbelangen kan ik geen mededelingen doen over eventueel lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over homohuwelijk in Rhenen (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

Marcouch asks the minister whether Rhenen's decision to let mayors, aldermen and councillors refuse to marry same-sex couples as honorary civil registrars is acceptable, and whether such refusals should be allowed elsewhere. The minister says municipalities bear their own responsibility within the legal framework, notes the Rhenen council motion and that refusal exceptions for elected officials are not objectively justified, but declines to enter talks with Rhenen given its autonomy.
Municipalities have their own responsibility when appointing marriage officials within the existing (constitutional) legal framework.
Gemeenten hebben bij het aanstellen van trouwambtenaren een eigen verantwoordelijkheid binnen de bestaande (grond)wettelijke kaders.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het opstappen van een groot aantal brandweervrijwilligers in Almere (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked the Minister of Security and Justice about volunteer firefighters leaving Almere over plans to sleep on the station and work with reduced crew levels, and whether staffing and safety are secured. The minister answered that about nine firefighters have left since 2009, that the variable crew experiment protects safety, that staffing is adequate now with about 25 more needed later, and that the sector bodies will be involved in a national project.
It is difficult to determine how many of those people left because of the changes within the corps.
Het is moeilijk na te gaan voor hoeveel van die mensen de veranderingen binnen het korps aanleiding zijn geweest om op te zeggen.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bezuinigingen op het gemeentelijk veiligheidsbudget (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt ask the Minister of Security and Justice about cuts to municipal safety funding, including whether 94 million euro a year is lost and whether local safety initiatives and Veiligheidshuizen will suffer. The minister replies that the cut concerns temporary extra funds ending after 2011, that structural safety funds through the municipal fund continue, that municipalities are best placed to set priorities, and that no inventory of municipal choices is needed.
The amount of 94 million euros does not seem familiar to me.
Het bedrag van 94 miljoen euro komt mij niet bekend voor.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over verklaringen omtrent gedrag voor criminele jongeren (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice minister why so few conditional certificates of conduct (VOG) were issued to young offenders under the Rotterdam pilot, and whether rigid application of the rules hinders resocialisation. The state secretary answered that only three conditional VOGs were issued, the pilot runs until October 2011 without extension, and the VOG is a preventive administrative tool rather than a punishment.
Because of the limited demand for a conditional VOG, a conditional VOG was also issued in only a limited number of cases.
Vanwege de beperkte vraag naar een VOG onder voorwaarden, is ook slechts in een beperkt aantal gevallen een VOG onder voorwaarden verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een YouTube-filmpje waarin in Gouda een paar meisjes worden belaagd en bestolen (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a YouTube video showing youths threatening, robbing and assaulting girls in Gouda, asking whether those responsible will be prosecuted, whether the youths have prior police contact, and how the public sense of justice will be restored. The minister answered that 13 people were arrested, nine cases will be heard together in court, two youths had prior police contact, the school and Raad voor de Kinderbescherming are involved, and the municipality is taking measures against nuisance.
Since 8 February, 13 persons have been arrested.
Vanaf 8 februari jongstleden zijn 13 personen aangehouden.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over politieagenten die een sollicitatiecursus zouden geven aan jongeren in Amsterdam Nieuw West (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers in Amsterdam Nieuw West would give a job-application course to young people, on what authority, and whether this falls within police core tasks. State Secretary Teeven answered that a single, small evening training is planned at the initiative of the regional police leadership, aimed at helping youth find work, and that in his general view job-application training is not a police task.
