In general, I am of the opinion that giving a job-application training does not fall within the tasks of the police.
In het algemeen ben ik van oordeel dat het geven van een sollicitatietraining niet tot de taken van de politie behoort.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de schade die is veroorzaakt door vuurwerkvandalisme (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported rise in fireworks vandalism damage to municipalities, the concentration of damage in the Biblebelt, the profile of vandals, and a proposed fireworks levy. The minister says he has no figures on municipal damage, cites a fall in private insurance damage, notes continued awareness efforts and a toolkit for recovering damages, and rejects the levy based on a 2002 study.
Figures on damage suffered by municipalities from fireworks vandalism are not known to me.
Cijfers over schade geleden door gemeenten door vuurwerkvandalisme zijn mij niet bekend.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de moord op een Oegandese homoactivist (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about the murder of a Ugandan gay activist, whether nine people named in a local newspaper list face threats, and whether the Netherlands has protested Uganda's anti-homosexuality bill. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns with Uganda bilaterally and within the EU, is funding a protection assessment, and will assess asylum claims individually.

Following the murder of human rights activist David Kato, the Netherlands has already urged the Ugandan authorities to provide adequate protection for activists working on the rights of sexual minorities.

Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van de moord op mensenrechtenactivist David Kato reeds bij de Ugandese autoriteiten aangedrongen op adequate beveiliging van activisten op het gebied van de rechten van seksuele minderheden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de positie van homoseksuele asielzoekers in de asielopvang in Nederland en in het Nederlandse asielbeleid (ingezonden 18 novemb

MPs Spekman and Marcouch asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how homosexual asylum seekers are protected in reception centres and under asylum policy, after a press report of hostility toward a gay asylum seeker. The minister replied that existing safety rules and sanctions are adequate, that homosexuals from Afghanistan, Iraq and Iran receive special protection, and that the COA will work with LGBT and faith organisations to improve reporting of aggression and discrimination.
The existing policy aimed at safeguarding the safety and liveability of all asylum seekers is sufficient to also address group-specific problems.
Het bestaande beleid dat ertoe dient de veiligheid en leefbaarheid van alle asielzoekers te borgen is toereikend om ook groepsspecifieke problematiek aan te pakken.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de strenge regels die gesteld worden aan bezoekers van voetbalwedstrijden (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the minister about strict rules for football visitors, including a mandatory car-combi ticket in Heerenveen, reports that stadium bans are being overturned by courts, and a new anti-hooliganism approach. The minister answered that the transport measure is a local mayoral decision based on prior incidents, that the KNVB reported only seven court losses in two seasons on stadium bans, and that a Veiligheid en Justitie policy framework and a sports action plan are in preparation.
The Ministry of Security and Justice is working with representatives from the national football and safety steering group on a renewed policy framework titled Football and Safety.
Het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie werkt samen met de vertegenwoordigers uit de landelijke regiegroep voetbal en veiligheid aan een vernieuwd beleids-kader, getiteld Voetbal en Veiligheid.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bedreigingen tegen religieuze gebouwen en groepen in Amsterdam (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about threats against religious buildings and groups in Amsterdam, including concrete steps taken since the November debate and whether the state should provide more protection. The minister said the government will send a letter on anti-discrimination action in the first half of 2011, that no threatened mosque is known to the municipality, and that the principle of individual and organisational responsibility for security, with the state stepping in where needed, will not change.
I promised you in the debate of 4 November that in the first half of 2011 I would send a letter on the action programme to tackle discrimination.
Ik heb u in het debat van 4 november jongstleden toegezegd om in de eerste helft van 2011 een brief te zenden over het actieprogramma aanpak discriminatie.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van een man die verdacht wordt van het mishandelen van een agente en een politiebrigadier (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of a minor suspected of assaulting a police officer and a police colleague, and requested the facts of the case, whether the ELA agreements were followed, and whether parents were questioned. The minister answered that the suspect was detained, then released under strict conditions by the court on advice of the Child Protection Council, that the ELA priority on pre-trial detention was applied, and that one officer took one week sick leave before returning to full duty.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de behandeling mensen die mensen die zelf slachtoffer zijn geworden van een belager (ingezonden 15 december 20

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about a new Public Prosecution Service directive on self-defence (noodweer), which stops arresting people who defended themselves against an attacker, and whether such people are still recorded as suspects. The state secretary answered that the directive asks for restraint in arrests where self-defence is likely, that the OM cannot provide the requested statistics, and that suspect status remains necessary for investigation and gives the person a protected position.
The figures requested cannot be provided by the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
De gevraagde cijfers zijn door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) niet te leveren.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch, Recourt en Kuiken (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over onbevoegde hulpofficieren bij de politie (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about unauthorised police auxiliary officers (hulpofficieren) and the damage to police authority, causes, consequences for criminal cases and evidence. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained certification lapses and procedural causes, reported five criminal investigations, and explained that consequences for cases depend on circumstances and that the inventory is still ongoing.
It is necessary to first await the outcomes of the national inventory by the police before this question can be answered.
Het is noodzakelijk om eerst de uitkomsten van de landelijke inventarisatie door de politie af te wachten voordat op deze vraag antwoord kan worden gegeven.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over gewapend geweld in Amsterdam Zuidoost (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about armed violence and shootings in Amsterdam Zuidoost, including sentencing, arrests, weapon detection, search powers and community knowledge. The minister answered that an intensive repressive and preventive approach continues, that more than half of shooting incidents led to arrests, that search powers under the Weapons and Ammunition Act are sufficient, and that police-community contacts will be maintained.
Since convictions are not registered by district, no overview of these can be provided.
Aangezien veroordelingen niet worden geregistreerd per stadsdeel kan hiervan geen overzicht worden verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van sociale media door de politie (ingezonden 30 december 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a police chief suspended after a tweet about a Meppel Christmas tragedy, whether suspensions for social media use are common, how officers are taught social media conduct, and whether the Code Blauw gives enough guidance and new guidelines are needed. The minister answered that suspensions are not centrally tracked, that training covers social media, that the professional judgement of officers applies, and that the existing Code Blauw suffices without separate guidelines.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie van de koptische gemeenschap in Nederland en andere Europese landen (ingezon

MPs Timmermans and Marcouch asked about online threats against Coptic communities in Europe, protective measures, and whether Dutch Coptic churches were on an Al-Qaeda list. The minister replied that NCTb and police see no concrete threat in the Netherlands, will stay alert, take security measures where needed (including at Christmas), and that European coordination on protection and prosecution already takes place.
As usual, no further details are provided on the nature of these measures.
Over de aard van deze maatregelen worden, zoals gebruikelijk, geen nadere mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld tegen winkelpersoneel (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked the Justice Minister about violence against shop staff, including the claim that a third of supermarket staff are threatened, police inaction, legal protection, employer reporting duties and security certification. The state secretary answered that the figures are unclear, that violence has complex causes, that police registration is comparatively good, that existing sentencing guidelines already cover shop staff, and that the government is preparing to simplify reporting and give feedback to complainants.
I am currently preparing, in line with the coalition agreement, measures to simplify and speed up the reporting process and to provide timely information on what has happened with the report.

Ik tref thans, conform het voornemen in het Regeerakkoord, voorbereidingen om het aangifteproces te vereenvoudigen en versnellen en daarbij ook tijdig informatie te doen verstrekken over wat er met de aangifte gebeurd is.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Albayrak en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een «homotest» die de Tsjechische autoriteiten gebruiken bij asielzoekers die vanwege hun geaardheid in eigen

MPs Timmermans, Albayrak and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about the Czech authorities' use of a 'homotest' on asylum seekers persecuted for their sexual orientation, how often it was used, and whether concerns were raised with Czech authorities. The minister answered that ten asylum seekers were tested voluntarily in 2008-2009, that the test was discontinued in early 2010, and that no concerns were raised since the test had ended.
I am, together with the EU agency, of the view that such tests are not compatible with existing European and international treaties and are an infringement of the right to privacy.
Ik ben, met het EU-agentschap, van mening dat dergelijke testen niet verenigbaar zijn met bestaande Europese en internationale verdragen en een aantasting zijn van het recht op privacy.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het handhaven van de openbare orde tijdens de komende jaarwisseling (ingezonden 29 december 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice how public order will be maintained during the coming New Year's Eve, including preparations, use of preventive fines against nuisance-makers, recidivism and available legal instruments. The state secretary answered that the government shares the aim of deterring repeat offenders, that local authorities are best placed to decide measures, that letters were sent to relevant parties, and that a detailed letter with figures will follow to the Chamber in February.
As in previous years, your Chamber will receive a letter in February addressing the preparations made and the measures taken.
Uw Kamer zal, evenals in voorgaande jaren, in februari een brief ontvangen waarin wordt ingegaan op de getroffen voorbereidingen en de genomen maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans, Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitspraak van de Keniaanse premier Raila Odinga over homoseksuele mannen (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga's reported call for arrests of gay men, whether such remarks are undesirable, whether the Dutch ambassador should discuss them, and what risks gay men face in Kenya. The minister agreed the remarks are undesirable, judged a meeting with the Kenyan ambassador unnecessary since Odinga had already corrected the picture, described limited risks and reported the embassy's ongoing work with local groups and the expected repeal of the colonial-era ban.
The embassy will continue to follow this process closely.
De ambassade zal dit proces nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over zelfmoord onder politieagenten (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising psychosocial complaints and suicides among police officers, and whether mental resilience problems are linked to leadership and staffing. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to a national resilience programme, cooperation with Defence on a mental shield, further research into suicides, and a commitment to maximum operational strength.
At this moment I do not yet have insight into the extent of the problem.
Op dit moment heb ik nog geen inzicht in de omvang van het probleem.
Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de voortzetting van de campussen (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

MPs Dijsselbloem and Marcouch asked the state secretary whether the nine pilot 'campus' projects for at-risk youth would be stopped and why, given favourable evaluation results. The state secretary confirmed that continued federal funding is unlikely, citing the temporary nature of the pilots and a control group showing no significant difference in effectiveness, and declined to distinguish between campus types, pointing to local tailored care.
However, the control group assembled within the same research showed no substantial difference in terms of the effectiveness in outcome referred to (68%).
Echter, de in het kader van hetzelfde onderzoek samengestelde controlegroep heeft voor wat betreft de hiervoor bedoelde effectiviteit qua uitkomst (68%) geen wezenlijk verschil laten zien.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat Regionale Opleiding Centra (ROC’s) wel leerlingen opvoeren voor de financiering, maar na de te

MPs Çelik and Marcouch asked the education minister about reports that ROCs enrol students for funding but refuse them after the 1 October count date, often on grounds of age, and asked for a response on the practice. The minister said she had no knowledge of dozens or hundreds of youths being excluded, referred age-discrimination complaints to the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling, argued enrolment creates binding obligations, and said she no longer receives such reports.
I am not aware that dozens and perhaps hundreds of young people are staying at home because they are not readmitted to school after the count date.
Mij is niet bekend dat tientallen en misschien honderden jongeren thuiszitten omdat ze na de teldatum niet weer worden toegelaten op school.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraken van de Ombudsman over afgestudeerde vmbo-ers die worden geweigerd door havo-opleidingen (ingezon

MPs Çelik and Marcouch asked the education minister about Ombudsman findings that vmbo graduates are refused entry to havo programmes through selection criteria such as minimum grades. The minister answered that schools may set admission requirements for later-year entry, that this does not affect funding, and that she recognises pupils' right to know entry criteria while stressing stapelen and doorstroom are mainly the responsibility of schools, pupils and parents.
I am of the view that pupils and their parents have the right to know what admission requirements a secondary school applies.
Ik ben van mening dat leerlingen en hun ouders het recht hebben om te weten wat de toelatingseisen zijn die een school voor voortgezet onderwijs hanteert.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over aanslagen op moskeeën (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about shootings at mosques, including the rise in attacks, whether extra surveillance is planned, and the police response in Dordrecht. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and referred the other questions to earlier answers, stating local threat analysis determines measures and declining to comment on security measures for operational reasons.
For security reasons, as is customary, I will not comment on any security measures.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik, zoals gebruikelijk, geen uitspraak over eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het inzetten van lokagenten ter bestrijding van discriminatie (ingezonden 23 juni

Two PvdA MPs asked whether existing investigative tools suffice against discrimination and violence targeting Jews, gay people and Muslims, and whether undercover decoy agents (lokagenten), such as one wearing a kippah, are legitimate and used abroad. The Justice Minister replied that existing tools are in principle adequate but that decoy agents are not excluded case by case if proportionate and effective, that wearing a kippah is not in itself incitement, and that no detailed information on other EU states is available.
No detailed information is available at my department on the use of and legal possibilities surrounding this specific investigative tool in other EU Member States.
Op mijn departement is geen gedetailleerde informatie beschikbaar over het gebruik van en de juridische mogelijkheden rondom dit specifieke opsporingsmiddel in andere EU-Lidstaten.
qn: Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van een man die verdacht wordt van het mishandelen van een agente en een politiebrigadier (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of a young man suspected of assaulting a police officer and a police brigadier, asking for the facts, whether the officers stayed on duty, consistency with the national guidelines on violence against public officials, and whether the parents were questioned. The state secretary replied only with a notice that the answers would be delayed because not all required information had yet been received.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

m: Amendement van de leden Saris en Mohandis ter vervanging van nr. 11 over extra financiële ondersteuning voor de inrichting van het Uniek Sporten Centraal Loket
Shifts 750,000 euro in 2025 from long-term care to sport and exercise to fund the Uniek Sporten Centraal Loket.
In article 3 Long-term care and support, the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by 750 euros (x 1,000).
In artikel 3 Langdurige zorg en ondersteuning worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 750 (x € 1.000).
Motie van het lid Mohandis c.s. over het archiveerbaar maken van zakelijke en bestuurlijke chatberichten van departementen
Asks the government to make business and administrative chat messages of ministries archivable before the new Archiefwet takes effect and to inform the House.
requests the government to provide, before the new Archiefwet takes effect, a scheme for making business and administrative chat messages of departments archivable, and to inform the House

verzoekt de regering om voorafgaande aan de inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe Archiefwet te voorzien in een regeling voor het archiveerbaar maken van zakelijke en bestuurlijke chatberichten van departementen
Motie van de leden Beckerman en Mohandis over onderzoeken hoe archiefopleidingen ook buiten Amsterdam kunnen worden aangeboden
Asks the government to investigate how archivist training can be offered outside Amsterdam in several regions.
requests the government to investigate how archive training can also be offered outside Amsterdam
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe archiefopleidingen ook buiten Amsterdam kunnen worden aangeboden
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Mohandis c.s ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het handhaven van de opleidingseis
Amends the Archiefwet to require archivists to hold a diploma, with the detailed rules set by general administrative order after a voorhang giving both chambers four weeks to comment.
By providing for a voorhang, the chambers are given the opportunity to include input from professional representatives in their contributions.
Door te voorzien in een voorhang worden de Kamers in de gelegenheid gesteld om de eventuele inbreng van vertegenwoordigers uit het beroepenveld bij hun inbreng te betrekken.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Mohandis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 31 over het handhaven van een opleidingseis
Amendment adds a diploma requirement for archivists to the Archiefwet, with details set by AMvB and a voorhang so both Chambers can comment before the decree is adopted.
By providing for a pre-consultation procedure, the Chambers are given the opportunity
Door te voorzien in een voorhang worden de Kamers in de gelegenheid gesteld
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over een oplossing voor de financiële consequenties van de nieuwe Archiefwet
Asks the government to work with municipalities and provinces to resolve the financial consequences of the new Archives Act, including the mandatory archivist.
requests the government to work together with subnational governments to reach a solution
verzoekt de regering om samen met medeoverheden tot een oplossing te komen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Mohandis en Beckerman ter vervanging van nr. 18 over het handhaven van de opleidingseis
Requires that archivists hold a relevant diploma and makes diploma rules set by general administrative order subject to advance parliamentary submission (voorhang).
The submitters propose that the diploma requirements in the general administrative order be submitted to parliament in advance (voorhang)
Indieners stellen voor om de bij algemene maatregel van bestuur opgenomen diploma-eisen in voorhang aan het parlement voor te leggen

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Mohandis ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het bij de rijksarchivaris beleggen van de bevoegdheid ontheffing van de overbrengingsverplichting te verlen
Amends the Archives Act so the chief national archivist, not the minister or provincial executive, grants exemptions from transfer obligations, with public access safeguards.
The responsible government body ensures that documents exempted are freely consultable by anyone unless a legal provision opposes this

Het verantwoordelijke overheidsorgaan zorgt ervoor dat: a. de documenten waarvoor ontheffing is verleend, tenzij enig wettelijk voorschrift zich hiertegen verzet, voor eenieder kosteloos zijn te raadplegen
Amendement van het lid Mohandis over de archivaris na raadpleging van het verantwoordelijk overheidsorgaan te laten besluiten over toegang tot beperkt openbare documenten
Has the archivist, after consulting the originating government body, decide on access to documents that are partly open, and removes the second sentence of the article.
In the first sentence, after 'is decided on that request by', the words 'the archivist, after consulting' are inserted.
In de eerste zin wordt na «wordt op dat verzoek beslist door» ingevoegd «de archivaris, na raadpleging van».
Amendement van de leden Mohandis en Beckerman ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het handhaven van de opleidingseis
Replaces a prior amendment so that the Archiefwet requires archivists to hold an archival diploma and allows rules on archival education by general administrative order.
must hold an archival diploma and
dient in het bezit te zijn van een diploma archivistiek en
Amendement van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Mohandis over het bij de rijksarchivaris beleggen van de bevoegdheid ontheffing van de overbrengingsverplichting te verlenen
Transfers the power to grant exemptions from the duty to transfer archival records to the National Archivist and requires equivalent public access for exempted records.
The proposers also propose to place the power to grant the exemption with the National Archivist.
Daarnaast stellen de indieners voor om de bevoegdheid tot het geven van de ontheffing neer te leggen bij de rijksarchivaris.
Amendement van het lid Mohandis over het handhaven van de opleidingseis
Requires by general administrative order rules on archivist training and diplomas and requires archivists to hold an archival diploma under the Archives Act.
must hold an archival diploma and
dient in het bezit te zijn van een diploma archivistiek en
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 117 over middelen voor de KNWU ten behoeve van een landelijke richtlijn burgermotorverkeersregelaars bij wielerkoersen
Shifts 215,000 euro within the sport budget to fund a national KNWU guideline for civilian traffic marshals at cycling races.
The coverage for this amendment is found within the funds still available for spending under article 6, sport and exercise.
De dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden binnen de nog vrij te besteden middelen op artikel 6, sport en bewegen.
Amendement van het lid Mohandis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 114 over 500 duizend voor zwemles voor kinderen die opgroeien in armoede
Replaces a earlier amendment to shift €500,000 within the Sport budget to the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur for swimming lessons for children growing up in poverty.
This amendment ensures that €500,000 is released for the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, among other things for swimming lessons for children growing up in poverty
Dit amendement regelt dat er 500 duizend vrijkomt voor het Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur voor onder meer zwemles voor kinderen die opgroeien in armoede
Motie van de leden Krul en Mohandis over zowel een ondergrens als een streefcijfer voor het aantal programma's met audiodescriptie afspreken

Amendement van het lid Van Meenen c.s. dat regelt dat naast het bij dit wetsvoorstel geïntroduceerde instemmingsrecht voor de medezeggenschap op de hoofdlijnen van de begroting, het huidige adviesrech
Amendment keeping the existing advisory right of works councils on the whole education budget alongside the new consent right on budget outlines.
alongside the consent right on the main lines of the budget for works councils introduced by this bill, the current advisory right on the budget as such also remains
naast het bij dit wetsvoorstel geïntroduceerde instemmingsrecht op de hoofdlijnen van de begroting voor de medezeggenschap, ook het huidige adviesrecht op de begroting als zodanig blijft bestaan
Motie van de leden Ypma en Mohandis over het belang van het beheersen van complexe vaardigheden door leraren
Asks the government to stress mastery of complex teaching skills by teachers and make them a main objective of the Teachers Agenda.
requests the government, in consultation with sector councils on the Teachers Agenda, to emphasise the importance of teachers mastering complex skills
verzoekt de regering, bij het overleg met de sectorraden over de Leraren agenda het belang van onder andere het beheersen van complexe vaardigheden door leraren te benadrukken
Motie van het lid Mohandis c.s. over betere voorlichting over de klachtenregeling
Asks the government, with schools and student organisations, to improve information for students about where to lodge complaints within their institution.
to better position students and that accessibility of and information about the existing complaints procedure is essential
om studenten beter in positie te brengen en dat hierbij de toegankelijkheid van en informatievoorziening over de bestaande klachtenregeling essentieel is
Motie van het lid Rog c.s. over het gewenste opleidingsniveau van docenten
Asks the government to set clear ambitions in sector agreements for teachers' qualification levels, aiming for most teachers to hold a master's degree.
requests the government to make efforts to formulate clear and sharp ambitions in the sector agreements
verzoekt de regering, zich in te spannen om in de sectorakkoorden heldere en scherpe ambities te formuleren
Motie van de leden Klaver en Mohandis over het halen van de doelstelling voor de functiemix in het vmbo
Asks the government to make more effort to reach the vmbo salary-scale target so that better-paid teaching posts are created, and to report to the House before the education budget debate.
requests the government to increase its efforts to reach the vmbo salary-mix target
verzoekt de regering, haar inspanning te vergroten om de doelstelling voor de functiemix in het vmbo te halen
Motie van het lid Duisenberg c.s. over een academisch opleidingsniveau voor alle leraren in de bovenbouwklassen VWO
Asks the government to encourage academic-level teacher training for upper-secondary VWO teachers by 2020 as a starting point.
take academic training level for all teachers in these upper classes in 2020 as the starting point
het academisch opleidingsniveau voor alle leraren in deze bovenbouwklassen in 2020 als uitgangspunt te nemen
Amendement van het lid Van Meenen c.s. dat een herschikking van het extra vrijgekomen budget van 650 miljoen euro regelt
Amendment reallocating the extra 650 million euro education budget among primary, secondary, vocational, higher and university education.
This amendment arranges a reallocation of the extra freed-up budget of 650 million euros.
Dit amendement regelt een herschikking van het extra vrijgekomen budget van 650 miljoen euro.
Motie van het lid Rog c.s. over onderzoek naar lagere lasten van het accreditatiestelsel
Asks the government to study and pilot ways to substantially reduce administrative burdens of the education accreditation system and report to the House.
requests the government to investigate how the administrative burdens of the accreditation system can be substantially reduced
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe de administratieve lasten van het accreditatiestelsel substantieel kunnen worden verlaagd
Motie van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over de rol van de opleidingscommissies in het verbeteren van de kwaliteit van het onderwijs
Asks the government, in consultation with the NVAO, to examine how programme committees can get a more explicit role in institutional and programme accreditation.
requests the government, in consultation with the NVAO, to examine how the programme committees can explicitly get a place
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg met de NVAO te bezien hoe de opleidingscommissies explicieter een plaats kunnen krijgen
Motie van de leden Mohandis en Ypma over zwijggeldclausules in verband met windturbines
Asks the government to allow the regional boundaries for special-needs education partnerships and youth care to be aligned, and to inform municipalities about boundary corrections.
requests the government to offer the possibility of aligning the regional division of the special-needs education partnerships and youth care
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheid te bieden de regio-indeling van de samenwerkingsverbanden passend onderwijs en jeugdzorg op elkaar af te stemmen
Motie van het lid Mohandis over de evaluatie van de collegegeldtarieven voor de tweede studie
Motion asking the government to make transparent the tuition fee tariffs for a second degree and to examine capping them in the upcoming evaluation.
requests the government to show in this evaluation how it wants to achieve transparency on the level and structure of tuition fees for a second degree
verzoekt de regering om in deze evaluatie inzichtelijk te maken hoe zij transparantie met betrekking tot de hoogte en opbouw van de collegegeldtarieven voor de tweede studie wil bewerkstelligen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het 60 ec per jaar in de verkorte HBO
Lets accelerated three-year HBO bachelor programmes for VWO students set 60 study credits per year instead of 80.
This amendment provides that the requirement of 80 study credits per year for three-year HBO programmes is changed to 60 study credits per year.
Dit amendement regelt dat de eis van 80 studiepunten per jaar voor 3 jarige HBO opleidingen wordt gewijzigd in 60 studiepunten per jaar.
Motie van het lid Mohandis over uitstel van de inwerkingtreding van de collegegelddifferentiatie

Asks the government to delay bringing into force the college fee differentiation provision for excellent programmes until the effects of a social loan system on access to higher education are clearer.
to only bring into force the statutory article on college fee differentiation for excellent programmes once there is more clarity on the effects of a social loan system
de inwerkingtreding van het wetsartikel dat collegegelddifferentiatie bij excellente opleidingen regelt pas te effectueren op het moment dat er meer duidelijkheid is
Amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over studievoorlichting
Amends the higher education law to extend mandatory study information with contact hours, study load, staff-student ratio, labour market prospects and follow-up master programmes.
the number of contact hours per programme
Amendement van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over het 60 ec per jaar in de verkorte HBO
Amendment changing the required study credits per year for three-year HBO bachelor programmes from 80 to 60, a higher education matter with no bearing on executive power.
in article 7.4, third paragraph, '80' is replaced by 60
wordt in artikel 7.4, derde lid, «80» vervangen door: 60
Motie van de leden Mohandis en Duisenberg over aanvullende (machts)middelen
Asks the government to pursue additional enforcement powers and legislation to recover student loans owed by people living abroad.
requests the government to work toward additional (enforcement) powers and legislation where needed
verzoekt de regering, in te zetten op het realiseren van aanvullende (machts)middelen en wet- en regelgeving
Motie van het lid Klaver c.s. over aanscherping van richtlijnen voor jaarrekeningen van onderwijsinstellingen
Asks the government to examine whether accounting guidelines for education institutions can be tightened so that no items are kept off the balance sheet.
to examine whether the guidelines for the annual accounts of education institutions can be tightened
te onderzoeken of de richtlijnen voor de jaarrekening van onderwijsinstellingen kunnen worden aangescherpt
Motie van het lid Duisenberg c.s. over het aflopen van het convenant Tweede Studies
Asks the minister to consult universities and universities of applied sciences to cushion the effects of the expiring 'Tweede Studies' covenant and inform the House.
requests the minister to consult with the VSNU and HBO-raad to absorb the consequences of the expiry of the Tweede Studies covenant
verzoekt de minister, in overleg te treden met de VSNU en de HBO-raad om de gevolgen van het aflopen van het convenant «Tweede Studies» op te vangen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de transparantie van besteding van budget door een aspirant-omroeporganisatie

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a public broadcaster-in-waiting covered a presenter's legal costs and planned to disguise them in its annual report, and about sanctions for non-compliance with the Mediawet. The Minister declined to comment on the case because the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating it, explained the regulator's oversight and graduated sanctions, and said the licence-withdrawal power is a last resort to be considered in the upcoming media law reform.
Because this case is the subject of an ongoing investigation by the regulator, it is not appropriate for me to make further statements about it.
Omdat deze zaak onderwerp van lopend onderzoek van de toezichthouder is, past het mij niet hier verdere uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over burgermotorverkeersregelaars bij wielerkoersen

MP Mohandis asks the State Secretary of VWS and the Justice Minister about capacity pressures on police motorcycle escorts for cycling races, whether government should structurally fund civilian traffic controllers, the status of the national guideline and the local allocation of police. The government answers that event organisers and the competent local authority are responsible, that structural funding is not a national responsibility, that the guideline subsidy was only recently paid, and that local allocation is deliberately kept with the competent authority.
Responsibility for the safe and orderly conduct of cycling races lies with the organiser of the event.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor een veilig en ordelijk verloop van wielerwedstrijden ligt bij de organisator van het evenement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over het bericht dat atlete Zoë Sedney zich in de steek gelaten voelde door de Atletiekunie na grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een teamgenoot

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked about a report that athlete Zoë Sedney felt abandoned by the Atletiekunie after a teammate's boundary-crossing conduct, including whether the victim was informed and consulted on the perpetrator's return, and about oversight of sports federations, the planned integrity centre, and case durations in sexual offence cases. The government answered that sports federations have a duty of care under the Blauwdruk, that it cannot judge individual cases, and that the Integere Sport Nederland integrity centre is in internet consultation, while case-duration measures are ongoing.
It is not for me as State Secretary to assess individual cases.
Het is als niet aan mij om als Staatssecretaris casuïstiek te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Patijn over interim-salarissen in de publieke sector

MPs Mohandis and Patijn asked how interim executives in the public sector can combine several assignments to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether the rules should change. The minister says the WNT is not being circumvented, commits to investigating whether the situation recurs and, if so, to proposing an extension of the anti-cumulation rule to interim managers, and explains the enforcement roles of the Tax Authority and supervisory bodies.
Following this case, the Minister of BZK will have it investigated whether the situation described occurs or has occurred more often.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zal de Minister van BZK laten onderzoeken of de beschreven situatie zich vaker voordoet of heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de voorgenomen stelselherziening van lokale publieke omroepen

MP Mohandis asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the status of the reform of local public broadcasting, the budget and distribution key, public-private cooperation, the 80 regional broadcasting areas, and the boundary with regional broadcasting. The Minister answered that the bill is with the Council of State, aims for entry into force in 2026 and start in 2028 with gemeenten retaining an advisory role and a budget distribution key still under development, while committing to publish budget figures later.
The intention is that as soon as possible afterwards two things become known: first, the intended total budget available from 2028 for all local broadcasters.
Het is de bedoeling dat zo snel mogelijk daarna twee zaken bekend worden: ten eerste het voorgenomen totaalbudget dat met ingang van 2028 beschikbaar is voor alle lokale omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Haage over het besluit van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs judolessen niet langer te erkennen als volwaardige invulling van het bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Haage asked whether the Inspectorate's decision that judo lessons at a Dalton school no longer count as full physical education, despite a qualified teacher, is justified, and whether the ministries will talk to the Judo Bond and what the end of the physical-education subsidy means. The state secretary defended the Inspectorate's position that structural judo cannot meet the core goals alone, declined a direct meeting with one provider, and said ending the subsidy will not reduce physical-education hours.
By structurally offering judo lessons as part of physical education, a school cannot meet the implementation of the core goals.
Met het structureel aanbieden van judolessen als onderdeel van het bewegingsonderwijs kan een school niet voldoen aan de uitvoering van de kerndoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de Nederlandse audiovisuele sector

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the status of an independent sector-wide study of the Dutch audiovisual sector, the lessons from Belgium's Tax Shelter, the PPMC report on fair pay costs, and steps to advance fair pay. The minister answered that the study starts in Q3 2025 with a first edition expected in Q2 2026, that a comparative country analysis including the Belgian Tax Shelter will be commissioned, and that fair pay is a shared responsibility supported by existing funding and practice instruments.
I will share the research report with your House in due course.
Ik zal het onderzoeksrapport te zijner tijd met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis, Eerdmans, Kostić en Oostenbrink over ledenwerving van ledenomroep WNL op het VVD-congres

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, JA21, PvdD and BBB asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether it is acceptable that broadcaster WNL recruited members at the VVD party congress while wearing press badges, and how this squares with the integrity code and WNL's statutes. The Minister says such recruitment is undesirable, that broadcasters must be careful to distinguish membership drives from journalism, that the Commissariaat voor de Media is the supervisor of the binding parts of the code, and that the membership criterion will be abolished in the planned reform of the public broadcasting system.
I attach great value to the independence of the media.
Ik hecht zeer grote waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de media.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bestuurders van sportclubs afhaken

MPs asked whether the government shares concerns that board members of sports clubs are withdrawing due to regulatory burden and the Wbtr's director-liability risks, and whether proposals and timelines will follow. The government answered that it is running a regulatory-burden review and a Significant Public study on whether volunteer insurance covers liability risks, with results expected before summer recess, and that the Wbtr evaluation (due before 1 July 2026) will examine unintended effects on volunteer liability.
The expectation is that the outcomes of this study will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Het is de verwachting dat de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek voor het zomerreces naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over Gratis bibliotheeklidmaatschap

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Rotterdam's free library membership for all residents and whether financial barriers to libraries should be removed, and asked whether the initiative could be rolled out more widely. The minister welcomed the Rotterdam measure, pointed to existing access-widening efforts and a study on free or automatic membership due by year-end, and noted library membership fees amount to about 10% of operating costs.
I will certainly take the experiences of libraries with free membership into account in the study described in the answer to question 3.
Ik zal de ervaringen van bibliotheken met een gratis lidmaatschap zeker betrekken bij het onderzoek beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over artiesten en concert-/festivalgangers met een beperking

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the accessibility of concerts, festivals and theatre for artists and audiences with disabilities, referring to a manifesto, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and shortages of accessible seating and sign-language interpreters. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps but states that the cultural sector itself is primarily responsible, that the ministry sets frameworks and funds initiatives such as the Routekaart Toegankelijke Festivals and a planned Kennispunt Toegankelijke Cultuur, and that a work agenda on the UN Convention will be sent to Parliament.
The ministry takes its responsibility by setting preconditions and creating frameworks.
Het ministerie neemt zijn verantwoordelijkheid door randvoorwaarden te stellen en kaders te scheppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over een onderzoek naar misstanden bij NPO

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the NPO supervisory board acted in time and adequately on reports of intimidation and an unsafe work climate at the NPO, and what lessons and steps should follow. The minister said the board had talked with the works council, pointed the board chair to his responsibility, received assurances of closer oversight and an interim chair, and declined to judge the board's handling beyond saying social safety is primarily the employer's matter; he noted the Commissariaat voor de Media or the board itself could order an investigation.
That is always in the first instance a matter for the employer, and as Minister I should exercise restraint there.
Dat is altijd in eerste instantie een zaak van de werkgever en daar past mij als Minister terughoudendheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het alarmerende boek 'Mijn Hoofd Doet Gek, over de relatie tussen ‘koppen’ en hersenschade in het Nederlandse voetbal' en n.a.v. het Eenvandaag-item over de schadelijke effect

An MP asked the State Secretary about research linking heading in football to brain damage and dementia, and whether youth heading should be restricted as in Flanders, Scotland, England and Northern Ireland. The State Secretary answered that the Health Council advice is due mid-2025 and the Sports Council will issue action perspectives, deferring any concrete measures until then.
I think it is too early now to discuss appropriate measures.
Ik vind het nu te vroeg om passende maatregelen te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Zorgen over sluiting zwembaden in Zuid-Limburg’

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Mosaqua pool in Zuid-Limburg, municipal finances, and whether the state should intervene (handremprocedure or a statutory duty) to keep pools open. The state secretary says pools are a municipal responsibility, rules out a handremprocedure for now, and says research into a municipal pool duty will finish in autumn 2025.
There is currently no statutory duty for municipalities to keep swimming pools open.
Er bestaat momenteel geen wettelijke zorgplicht voor gemeenten om zwembaden in stand te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van der Wal over uitvoering van de motie Van der Wal en Mohandis en eerder onbeantwoorde schriftelijke vragen over de bevrijdingsfestivals in het kader van 80 jaar vrijheid

MPs Mohandis and Van der Wal asked whether the government would fund Bevrijdingsfestivals in 2025 through a guarantee scheme, given a Chamber-adopted motion. The state secretary replied that interdepartmental talks ended with a one-off, final contribution of EUR 700,000 for 2025 but explained that a guarantee scheme would imply a structural relationship the government does not intend.
The cabinet, however, sees the contribution as incidental.
Het kabinet ziet de bijdrage echter als incidenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over de beantwoording van Kamervragen d.d. 3 oktober 2024 over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen ask about the responsibility of dance sport federations (NADB) for misconduct, the lack of apology and recognition for a whistleblower, the absence of mandatory VOG checks, the independence of the CVSN reporting centre, and the reach of the Alliantie Dans Veilig. The Secretary of State answers that federations have limited responsibility, that a whistleblower meeting will be arranged, that VOG remains voluntary and that a law to create an independent integrity centre is in preparation.
To strengthen social safety in sport, I am currently working on a bill that will lead to the establishment of an independent integrity centre, which will also separate the CVSN from NOC*NSF.

Om sociale veiligheid in de sport te versterken, werk ik momenteel aan een wetsvoorstel dat zal leiden tot de oprichting van een onafhankelijk integriteitscentrum, waarmee het CVSN tevens wordt losgekoppeld van NOC*NSF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Wal, Diederik van Dijk en Mohandis over de digitale openbaarmaking van het Centraal Archief Bijzondere Rechtspleging

MPs from D66, VVD, SGP and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science when and how the Central Archive of Special Jurisdiction (CABR) can be searched online by name of war victims and suspected collaborators, and why only names but not the underlying dossiers were published. The Minister answers that a temporary searchable facility at the National Archives is being prepared, a bill creating a legal basis for balancing privacy against access will go to consultation by end of March, and that the name index must be public as the only way to request dossiers, despite Data Protection Authority concerns.

I intend to put a draft bill out for consultation before the end of March that will create the legal basis, missed by the Data Protection Authority, for access to archives containing ordinary, special and criminal personal data.

Ik wil vóór eind maart een conceptwetsvoorstel in consultatie brengen die de door de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) gemiste grondslag zal creëren voor toegang tot archieven met gewone, bijzondere en strafrechtelijke persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Slagt- Tichelman over de financiering van de bevrijdingsfestivals

MPs Mohandis and Slagt-Tichelman asked whether the government will keep financially supporting the Dutch liberation festivals, which are at risk, and about the status of a broad future vision for 5 May. State Secretary Karremans answers that the national committee receives structural funding, that one-off direct aid was given in 2024 and no structural state guarantee is provided, and that talks with other ministries on a final one-off contribution are ongoing.
I have at least reserved budgetary space for a one-off contribution from VWS in 2025.
Ik heb in ieder geval budgettaire ruimte gereserveerd voor een incidentele bijdrage vanuit VWS in 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de brief van de Nederlandse Stichting Water- & Zwemveiligheid (NSWZ) betreft het verzoek tot heroverweging van de voorgenomen btw-verhoging op zwemlessen

An MP asks the State Secretary to reconsider the planned VAT increase on swimming lessons, citing differences between commercial and non-profit providers, litigation risk, accessibility and a possible two-tier outcome. The State Secretary largely defends the policy, says the VAT rise is expected to hold in court under EU case law, and promises a schoolswimming study in early 2025 while refusing to reconsider the decision.
Are you willing to reconsider the planned cabinet decision on the VAT increase on swimming lessons given the two-tier system it creates?
Bent u bereid om het voorgenomen kabinetsbesluit van de Btw-verhoging op zwemles te heroverwegen gegeven de tweedeling die het creëert?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat de cultuursector een kaalslag vreest

MP Mohandis asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report warning of a 'kaalslag' in the culture sector from planned cuts and the VAT increase, asking about impact analyses, fair pay and local culture. The minister acknowledged the impact, defended the VAT decision as based on a prior evaluation and an ambtelijke verkenning, said no further impact analysis was planned before a 2028 evaluation, and offered continued dialogue but declined to reconsider the VAT measure.
No specific impact analysis has further been carried out for the planned VAT increase.
Voor de voorgenomen btw-verhoging is verder geen specifieke impactanalyse verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kwart van ouders met lager inkomen doet kind niet op zwemles, oplopende kosten vaak de reden’

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the state secretary about low-income parents not enrolling children in swimming lessons due to rising costs, including VAT, municipal provision, a motion on subsidies and school swimming. The state secretary said municipal schemes and the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur exist, that no budget is available now, and that school swimming scenarios will be presented around early 2025.
I expect the results of a study by the Mulier Institute this autumn, which will clarify the obstacles for municipalities to join one or more funds.
Ik verwacht dit najaar de resultaten van een onderzoek van het Mulier Instituut waarin duidelijk wordt wat de belemmeringen voor gemeenten zijn om aan te sluiten bij één of meerdere fondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘(Oud-)topsporters noemen lagere inkomsten ‘ramp voor de clubs’: ‘Bezuinig niet op sport’’

Three MPs asked the minister about press reports that budget cuts threaten sport, including volunteer burden, the CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA proposals, gambling tax differentiation and the health costs of cutting sport. The state secretary answered that sport is valued and that a multi-year strategy and clearer information will follow, but gave no figures on the cuts and no firm commitment on the gambling-tax motion or a sports law.
As indicated in the letter of 2 April 2024, I aim to inform the House further on this before the legislative consultation on the Sport and Exercise budget item for 2025.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief 2 van 2 april 2024 streef ik ernaar uw Kamer hier voor het wetgevingsoverleg over begrotingsonderdeel Sport en Bewegen voor het jaar 2025, nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over olympische sporters die moeite hebben met rondkomen

MPs asked whether the topsport stipend is adequate for elite athletes who struggle to make ends meet, whether it should be seen as a job, and about claw-back rules, the income threshold, and the ongoing review of the support package. The state secretary answered that NOC*NSF and the Fonds voor de Topsporter are primarily responsible for the stipend rules, that a new support model is being explored, and that an update will follow in autumn 2024.
It is my intention to inform your House in autumn 2024 about the progress.
Het is mijn voornemen om uw Kamer in het najaar van 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis , Inge van Dijk, Van Eijk en Paulusma over de afhandeling van de misstanden in de danswereld en de omgang met slachtoffers

MPs asked the Minister of VWS and the State Secretary of OCW how the government is handling misconduct in the dance sector, including compensation, apologies, trauma care for victims, and the status of adopted motions. The government responded that the Alliantie Dans Veilig, with recognition statements, support networks, OCW dance round tables and a school-level social safety programme, is taking action, while leaving the date for compensation and the sports-offender ban to a separate letter on motions.

Recently the omnibus letter on motions and commitments on sport and exercise was sent by the Minister of VWS to the House of Representatives, and the motions concerning the dance sector form part of it.

Onlangs is de verzamelbrief over de moties en toezeggingen sport en bewegen door de Minister van VWS naar de Tweede Kamer verzonden, de moties met betrekking tot de danssector vormen daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mohandis over het bericht 'Incassobedrijf gebruikt AI om kwetsbare schuldenaar te spotten: 'Kan bizarre situaties opleveren''

MPs Kathmann and Mohandis asked about reports that debt collector Intrum uses AI to scan correspondence of vulnerable debtors, raising risks of discrimination, privacy breaches and lack of transparency. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the government cannot guarantee AI use is optional for consumers, and pointed to existing GDPR and WKI rules and the forthcoming EU AI Act, while stating the details of Intrum's practices are not yet known and a meeting with Intrum is planned.
From the article, the precise methods or working practices of Intrum are not clear to me.
Uit het artikel worden de precieze methoden of werkwijzen van Intrum mij niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en van Nispen over de gestegen prijzen van zwemles

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the health minister about rising swimming lesson prices, the number of families supported by the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, funding for poor households and whether the minister will set targets to reduce children without swimming diplomas. The minister answered that the Jeugdfonds supported 20,707 children in 2023, but gave no exact figures for children in poverty, estimated costs of full funding at 3.5 to 10.5 million euro, and declined to commit to a target because swimming diplomas are primarily the parents' responsibility.
Obtaining swimming diplomas for children is primarily a responsibility of the parents.
Het behalen van zwemdiploma's door kinderen is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Ceder over de noodzaak tot verplichte leeftijdscontrole bij BNPL-diensten

MPs Mohandis and Ceder asked the government about minors using Buy Now, Pay Later services, the lack of mandatory age verification, the effect of the revised Consumer Credit Directive, fees, and sanctions. The minister acknowledged the risks, reported that BNPL providers committed from 1 June to verify all users' age, and said the government is still working out how to make age verification legally mandatory and will report after the summer.
The cabinet is currently working out how age verification can be made mandatory.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment uit hoe leeftijdscontrole verplicht gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat honderden sportclubs niet meer kunnen verduurzamen

MPs Van Dijk, Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the minister about reports that hundreds of sports clubs cannot sustainably upgrade their facilities because the BOSA subsidy budget is exhausted, and about whether the budget should be increased. The minister answered that the budget ceiling for 2024 is raised from 79 to 111.5 million euro, that demand still exceeds it, and that the application portal closes on 1 August.
The subsidy ceiling for 2024 is thus raised in total from 79 million euro to 111.5 million euro.
Het subsidieplafond voor 2024 wordt daarmee in totaal verhoogd van € 79 miljoen naar € 111,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de subsidieregeling Stimulering bouw en onderhoud van sportaccommodaties (BOSA)

The MP asks for an update on the BOSA sports-facility subsidy scheme (spending, pending applications, remaining budget), whether it is adequate, and whether sports clubs can still get funding to become more sustainable. The minister reports applications of 122.2 million euros against a 79 million budget, raises the 2024 ceiling to 111.5 million via a cash shift and a transfer from DUMAVA, and says new applications will be refused once the ceiling is reached and will not be carried into 2025.
The 2024 subsidy ceiling is thereby raised in total from 79 million euros to 111.5 million euros.
Het subsidieplafond voor 2024 wordt daarmee in totaal verhoogd van € 79 miljoen naar € 111,5 miljoen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Mohandis over het bericht dat geïnstalleerde trapliften vaak nog steeds niet voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit en dit tegenstrijdig is met valpreventie beleid

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Mohandis asked whether stairlifts installed via the Wmo often fail Bouwbesluit safety minimums, whether the ministry's guidance is being used, and whether compliance can be a GALA funding condition, among nine questions. The minister said no signals of widespread non-compliance were received, that enforcement and compliance are municipal responsibilities under the decentralised Wmo and Woningwet, and that the guidance is voluntary and not a GALA condition, while committing to ensure the VNG repromotes the guidance.
Under the Wmo 2015, the municipality (as client and owner) must ensure that the stairlift complies with all regulations, including the Bouwbesluit.
Op grond van de Wmo 2015 moet de gemeente (zijnde opdrachtgever en eigenaar) zich verzekeren dat de traplift voldoet aan alle regelgeving waaronder het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Valkenburgse raad bezorgd om sluiting mosaqua

An MP asked the health minister about the possible closure of the Mosaqua swimming pool in Gulpen-Wittem, its regional role, swimming lesson capacity and alternatives for vulnerable groups. The minister said alternatives exist in neighbouring municipalities and that the closure decision is a local responsibility weighing demographic and cost factors.
This is a local responsibility and consideration.
Dit is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid en afweging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over de individuele studietoeslag

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked how municipalities grant the individual study allowance under the Participatiewet, whether it is withheld when students spend part of a compulsory curriculum abroad, and whether it should continue in that case. The minister explains the allowance's purpose, notes the government lacks a full picture of municipal decisions, states that a student keeps the right abroad unless the main residence has moved, and says students with a disability should be enabled to gain study-related experience abroad without unnecessary barriers.
It is up to the municipality to assess this.
Het is aan de gemeente om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de inlichtingenplicht in de bijstand

An MP asked the minister whether the benefit information duty (inlichtingenplicht) leads to harsh outcomes, such as large repayments and fines for incomplete information, and whether personal conversations should replace direct sanctions. The minister agreed that fines must not be imposed lightly, said municipalities must investigate carefully and give people a chance to explain, and pointed to planned changes in the Participatiewet in Balans program while keeping the information duty in place.
It is therefore important that imposing a claim and fine does not happen lightly.
Het is dan ook belangrijk dat het opleggen van een vordering en boete niet lichtvaardig gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over de geplande toewijzing van het WK mannenvoetbal in 2034 aan Saoedi-Arabië

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked the government about human rights concerns (migrant workers, women, LGBTQI people, press freedom) tied to the planned 2034 men's World Cup award to Saudi Arabia and what the Netherlands would do. The minister acknowledged these concerns, pointed to ongoing human rights dialogue and FIFA requirements in the bid book, and said the Netherlands would raise the issue, but did not commit to a concrete new step regarding the award itself.

The cabinet considers it important that the bid book addresses Saudi Arabia's commitment to the human rights conditions set by FIFA and how it will meet them, and that this commitment is assessed technically.

Het kabinet acht het van belang dat het bidbook ingaat op de inzet van Saoedi-Arabië ten aanzien van de door de FIFA gestelde mensenrechtenvoorwaarden en hoe hieraan te voldoen, en dat deze inzet technisch wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht 'Geldproblemen door chronisch ziek kind: 'Ik voel me een schooier''

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked about a family with a chronically ill child forced to move because municipal refusal to fully fund home adaptations and rising care costs, and about VN-verdrag Handicap compliance. The minister says Wmo 2015 allows adaptations and municipalities weigh alternatives including relocation allowances, declines to change the law, and gives no data on parents' financial problems or on how many use each scheme.
No, as stated in my answer to question 2, home adaptations can be reimbursed under the Wmo 2015.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 kunnen vanuit de Wmo 2015 woningaanpassingen worden vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over het bericht 'Percentage kinderen zonder zwemdiploma verdubbeld'

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked the minister about the doubling of children without swimming diplomas between 2018 and 2022 and what policy is being taken. The minister agreed the trend is undesirable and listed initiatives (Nationaal Plan Zwemveiligheid, Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, teacher and pool support, plans with municipalities expected in autumn), without a single definitive solution.
I expect to be able to inform you in the autumn about the plan at municipal level.
Ik verwacht u in het najaar te kunnen informeren over het plan op gemeenteniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de noodzaak van ondersteuning voor sportverenigingen en -accommodaties

MP Mohandis asked the minister about support for sports clubs and facilities, including energy-cost relief (TEK, SPUK MEOZ, SPUK NEAS), local funding, greening, and whether support will continue in 2024. The minister answered in detail, citing monitoring by the Mulier Institute, that the energy-cost measures were temporary, no additional swimming-pool aid is planned now, and that a plan with the VSG for regional greening coordination is being prepared.
I have discussed the expected energy-cost problems for 2024 with the VSG but unfortunately see no possibilities at this time to provide additional financial support to the swimming pools.

Ik ben met de VSG in gesprek gegaan over de verwachte problemen bij energiekosten in 2024 maar zie op dit moment helaas geen mogelijkheden om aanvullende financiële ondersteuning te bieden aan de zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht ‘Opera Zuid luidt noodklok: ‘Reële kans dat we verdwijnen’’

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked whether the state secretary will ensure Opera Zuid's survival given rising wage costs and its limited subsidy share. The state secretary declines extra funding, says the three opera functions and subsidy ceilings are set, and defers the assessment to the Raad voor Cultuur.
I see no room to provide additional support to one or more institutions.
Ik zie geen ruimte om een of meer instellingen extra te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over indiceren bij ouders en kinderen die intensieve kindzorg nodig hebben

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care why parents of children needing intensive child care are caught between nurse-led indications, insurers' adjustments, and objections, and whether the treating physician and parents should co-determine care plans. The Minister answers that the child nurse alone holds autonomous indication authority while consulting physicians and parents, that insurers may only check legality and efficiency, and that escalation routes and an action plan exist, but declines to amend the objection procedure or the motion's approach.
I can carry out your motion if I do so in line with the intention of this motion.
Ik kan uw motie uitvoeren als ik dit doe langs de bedoeling van deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over dehandhaving van het online verkoopverbod op vapes

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health how enforcement of the online sales ban on vapes is failing after an RTL investigation found it easy to order them online. The State Secretary acknowledges a group of deliberate offenders, adds two inspectors now expanding to five, and plans legislative changes to raise fines and broaden enforcement powers.
I am working on a legislative amendment so that the NVWA also receives more enforcement instruments to enforce compliance.
Ik werk aan een wetswijziging zodat de NVWA ook meer handhavingsinstrumenten beschikbaar krijgt om de naleving af te dwingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Mohandis over het bericht 'Minder personeel dreigt in ouderenzorg door geldruzie met zorgkantoren'

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that staff cuts threaten elderly care due to tariff disputes with care insurers (zorgkantoren) and a court case. The minister responded that layoffs are undesirable, that the court found the tariffs generally reasonable, and listed measures (WOZO, TAZ, budget increase) to protect staffing and quality, while not committing to a specific new legal change.
In response to the Mohandis motion, I will map the extent to which elderly care organisations are threatening to collectively dismiss staff.
Als reactie op de motie Mohandis ga ik dan ook in kaart brengen in welke mate organisaties in de ouderenzorg personeel collectief dreigen te ontslaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'Drugscrimineel was de baas van zorguitzendbureau dat personeel levert aan Jeugdhulp Friesland'

MP Mohandis asked about a report that a drug criminal headed a care staffing agency supplying Jeugdhulp Friesland, and about oversight of Woodbrookers and fraud prevention. The government answered that the IGJ moved its planned supervision forward, Jeugdhulp Friesland will stop closed youth care in its current form by July 2024, and fraud measures (Bibob, Wbsrz, pilots) and a sector working group on flex staffing are underway.
Such an investigation commissioned by the IGJ is in principle never made public.
Een dergelijk onderzoek in opdracht van de IGJ wordt in beginsel nooit openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over Eenmalige specifieke uitkeringen lokale bibliotheekvoorzieningen 2023 – 2024 (SPUK Bieb)

An MP asked the state secretary about the SPUK Bieb library grants for 2023-2024, including how many applications were made and funded, how the budget was split, and whether the statutory library duty for municipalities will still come by mid-2024. The state secretary answered that 210 applications from 148 municipalities led to 79 grants, that the budget was oversubscribed by 21.7 million euros with a ranking published in annexes, and that the bill is now planned for late 2024 because of the caretaker cabinet.
The aim is to submit the bill to parliament by the end of 2024.
Het streven is om het wetsvoorstel voor eind 2024 in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over verduurzaming van de cultuursector

MP Mohandis asked the state secretary whether the cultural sector can decarbonise voluntarily, what a decarbonised sector means, how it will be supported, and whether a reduced cultural offer is a risk. The state secretary answered that initiatives are fragmented, that an inventory questionnaire and monitoring will precede any decision on further regulation, and that the Raad voor Cultuur's advice will be answered in 2024.
I am convinced that intrinsic motivation is very powerful.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat intrinsieke motivatie heel krachtig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de toenemende problemen in de ouderenzorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about projected 2024 financial shortfalls in northern elderly care, possible job cuts, the realism of the WOZO programme's effects, the reliance on technology to save staff, and whether enough clustered housing will be built. The Minister said providers foresee an exceptional combination of costs, that sector responsibilities are shared, that technology can save labour if organisations reorganise, and cited a target of 80,000 clustered housing units and 40,000 clustered nursing places.
Care providers indicate they expect an exceptional combination of circumstances for 2024, including high sick leave, heavy use of temporary non-employed staff (PNIL) and inflation.

Zorgaanbieders geven aan dat zij voor 2024 een uitzonderlijke samenloop van omstandigheden verwachten, waaronder een hoog ziekteverzuim, hoge inzet van tijdelijk personeel niet in loondienst (PNIL) en inflatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Nijboer over de Amsterdamse voorrangsregeling op woningen voor docenten, die nog altijd onvoldoende merkbaar is voor onderwijspersoneel dat daar werkt

MPs Mohandis and Nijboer asked whether Amsterdam's priority housing scheme for teachers is effective given housing scarcity, what national rules hinder it, and how teacher shortages can be tackled. The government answered that 99 social and 29 mid-rent homes were allocated to teachers, that scarcity persists, that a law change lets municipalities allocate up to 50% of freed affordable rentals to vital professions, and that regional teacher-shortage convenants and wage measures are being pursued.
It is up to the municipalities to weigh the interests of the different groups of housing seekers carefully when making policy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om de belangen tussen de verschillende groepen woningzoekenden goed te wegen bij het maken van beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over discriminerende spreekkoren in de stadions

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about discriminatory chants in football stadiums, including the KNVB guideline, enforcement by clubs, ongoing talks, and a technology pilot. The minister answered that the KNVB guideline lets referees stop matches, that from the 2023/24 season homophobic chants aimed at individuals will lead to warnings, stoppages and stadium bans, and that the technology pilot continues and will be scaled up.
The KNVB does not explicitly keep track of how many matches are stopped.
De KNVB houdt niet expliciet bij hoeveel wedstrijden worden stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de oproep van gemeenten om handvatten voor het verminderen van het aantal tabaksverkooppunten

An MP asked the state secretary for health whether municipalities will get tools quickly to reduce tobacco outlets, and about shop-in-shop constructions and Utrecht's temporary ban on new tobacco shops. The state secretary answered that reducing outlets is a key goal, that a shop-in-shop loophole is not allowed under the planned supermarket ban, that municipalities decide locally, and promised to inform parliament before the November 2023 committee meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'Minder theatervoorstellingen door hoge kosten en personeelstekorten'

An MP asked the state secretary about theatres cutting programming by 10-15% due to high costs and staff shortages, and whether extra cultural funding and fair pay measures are adequate. The state secretary acknowledged the pressure, pointed to coronavirus support and reserves, reduced the required number of large-stage productions, and announced structural fair pay funding from 2025 and collective tariff agreements.
