To reduce performance pressure, in the coming bis period I will reduce the number of large-stage productions required by the regulation for the large theatre companies from three to two.
Om de prestatiedruk te verminderen, breng ik de komende bis-periode voor de grote theatergezelschappen het in de regeling opgenomen aantal grotezaalproducties terug van drie naar twee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'En weer is een muziekschool failliet gegaan. Wie kan er nog naar muziekles?'

An MP asks the state secretary about the bankruptcy of a Drenthe arts centre (Scala) and the threat to arts education access, and about funding, self-employment of teachers and inclusion. The state secretary acknowledges the vulnerability of local arts infrastructure but states that financing arts centres and music schools is a municipal responsibility, pointing to a planned national amateur arts accord and an evaluation of cultural education policy without committing to legislation.
Financing arts centres and music schools, such as Scala, is a municipal responsibility.
Het financieren van de kunstencentra en muziekscholen, zoals Scala, betreft een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van der Laan, Mohandis en Bikker over het lekken van cijfers over misbruik in de danswereld

MPs asked the minister why figures from the dance-sector abuse investigation leaked before the victims were informed, and who held the figures. The minister answered that the leak is regretted, that only the ministries of VWS and OCW received the draft conclusions, and that the government will respond after studying the final report due 22 May.
I have not yet responded substantively, but I think it is important to state that my concern is with the victims.
Ik heb nog niet inhoudelijk gereageerd, maar vind het wel belangrijk om aan te geven dat mijn zorg uitgaat naar de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en De Hoop over de negatieve gevolgen van de brede SPUK-regeling voor kleinere gemeenten

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether the bundling of sport and health-promotion grants into the SPUK specific grant harms small municipalities, including the Wadden islands, and how it would be fixed. The government replied that over 98% of municipalities receive more money, that three municipalities (two Wadden islands and Rozendaal) would be topped up to their 2022 level, and that the new allocation key is meant to expand sport and health spending.
For these three municipalities, the specific grant will be increased to the level they received in 2022 from the aforementioned programmes.
Daarom zal voor deze drie gemeenten de specifieke uitkering worden opgehoogd tot het niveau dat zij in 2022 kregen uit genoemde programma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Mohandis, Werner en Sylvana Simons over het ratificeren van het facultatief protocol bij het VN-verdrag voor rechten van mensen met een beperking

Five MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether she would keep her promise to decide by the end of Q1 2023 on ratifying the optional protocol to the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and to give clarity within a week. The minister confirmed the commitment, explained that the decision requires broad consultation across the cabinet because the Council of State advised on related protocols, and promised the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023.
My aim is to send you the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023 at the latest.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om u uiterlijk medio mei 2023 het kabinetsbesluit te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de voortgang van de toekomstgerichte bibliotheekvoorziening in elke gemeente

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about progress on a statutory duty for municipalities to provide library facilities by 2025, including new branches, funding accountability, school library coverage in vocational schools, and Caribbean Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that a bill is expected mid-2024, a specific grant scheme is open to municipalities, and a separate budget applies to the Caribbean public bodies.
One of those changes is a statutory duty for municipalities and provinces, which will be introduced in 2025.
Eén van die wijzigingen is een zorgplicht voor gemeenten en provincies, die in 2025 zal worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over mantelzorgwoningen

An MP asked the Minister about problems with care homes (mantelzorgwoningen), municipal policy variation, medical certificates and pre-care housing policy. The State Secretary answered that no national data exist, that municipalities have wide policy discretion so no uniform national framework is intended, and that an action agenda on informal care is being prepared with partners including commitments to bundle good examples and an instruction rule in the environmental plan rules.
Municipalities have considerable policy discretion to support citizens tailored to their needs.
Gemeenten hebben een grote beleidsruimte om burgers, op maat, te kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat GGZ patiënten niet thuis mogen slapen

An MP asked why answers to earlier questions on GGZ patients being unable to sleep at home took so long, why a trial with three nights of home leave was chosen rather than allowing home overnight stays outright, and how this fits with the minister's stated priority of care over financial considerations. The minister explained that the trial was started in April 2020 at the request of provider Yulius and insurer VGZ, that the existing financing already covers night leave, and that the trial ends in April 2023 with the NZa to advise on next steps.
At the end of April 2023 this experiment ends and the NZa will, together with the parties involved, consider which follow-up steps are needed.
Eind april 2023 loopt dit experiment af en zal de NZa samen met betrokken partijen bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat veel ggz patiënten mogelijk geen vergoeding van hun zorg krijgen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the many mental health patients who may not have their care reimbursed because insurers lack contracts with their providers, including the risks to continuity of treatment and patient choice. The Minister reports that about 73% of offered GGZ institution contracts were signed by early 2023, that existing treatments are protected by law, that insurers must inform patients transparently, and that agreements to finalise contracting before 12 November are being worked out.
Health insurers annually make transparent, before 12 November, with whom they have concluded a contract.
Zorgverzekeraars maken jaarlijks voor 12 november transparant met wie zij een contract hebben afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over samenwerking tussen retailers en de tabaksindustrie om extra tabakswinkels te openen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about retailers and the tobacco industry opening tobacco shops next to supermarkets, which could offset the planned supermarket sales ban, and asks about monitoring and licensing. The State Secretary says the ban will reduce outlets sharply (SEO estimates from about 10,000 in 2021 to under 2,000 by 2032), announces a registration obligation requiring a law change so it cannot start in 2023, and rejects a licensing system with time-limited permits as too costly and inflexible.
I am working hard to have this law change in force in 2024, but given this lengthy process, 2023 is unfortunately not possible.
Ik werk er hard aan deze wetswijziging in 2024 van kracht te laten zijn, maar 2023 is, gezien dit langdurige proces, helaas niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het intrekken van de vergunning van de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary about the NPO imposing a third sanction on Ongehoord Nederland and whether the minister should revoke its broadcasting recognition under the Mediawet. The State Secretary replied that revocation requires a request from the NPO that has not yet been made, that the minister cannot prejudge it, and that the law gives no direct ground for action now.
Only at the moment the NPO makes a request for revocation of recognition can I make that assessment.
Pas op het moment dat de NPO een verzoek tot intrekking van de erkenning doet, kan ik die afweging maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat GGZ patiënten niet thuis mogen slapen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why GGZ patients may not sleep at home on leave even when their treating doctor approves, and whether a legal rule forces insurers to cut budgets. The minister answered that payment depends on overnight stays set by NZa tariff rules rather than a statute, that financially driven refusals are not acceptable, and that an NZa experiment with home sleep leave runs until April 2023 with follow-up to be decided then.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Mohandis en Bikker over het uitgesteld betalen bij het online afrekenen van alcoholische dranken

MPs Kuik, Mohandis and Bikker asked whether online alcohol shops offering buy-now-pay-later payment undermine the Alcohol Act and encourage overconsumption, and whether the state will stop or ban it. The state secretary agrees with the concerns, notes that the Alcohol Act still applies, says some shops are already exploring alternatives, and will examine legal measures if shops do not stop.
If the liquor stores do not stop, I am willing to examine legal measures and discuss this with my colleagues in the cabinet.
Als slijterijen niet stoppen, dan ben ik bereid om wettelijke maatregelen te onderzoeken en hierover in gesprek te gaan met mijn collega’s binnen het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Mohandis over ‘De impact van geldstress en schulden op de (mentale) gezondheid van mensen’

MPs Kuiken and Mohandis asked how financial stress and debt affect mental and physical health, whether care pressure on GPs and mental health services will rise, and why a fund for energy debts was chosen over preventive measures. The government acknowledges the health link, points to its broader poverty, debt and mental health policies and a temporary energy price cap, and says a temporary emergency fund for energy debts is being explored.
To prevent this, the possibility of a temporary emergency fund is currently being explored.
Om dit te voorkomen wordt momenteel de mogelijkheid van een tijdelijk noodfonds verkend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Justice Minister and the Health State Secretary about criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus, including police handling, enforcement against snus sales and planned awareness campaigns. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited a broad youth crime prevention programme, said no police figures on the phenomenon exist, and pointed to ongoing NVWA enforcement and a forthcoming decision on a snus ban.
The police registrations contain no concrete indications of criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus.
In de registraties van de politie zijn geen concrete aanwijzingen gevonden voor criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat geïnstalleerde trapliften vaak niet voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit

An MP asked the state secretary whether stairlifts often fail the Building Decree and whether municipalities enforce it, including questions on contractor self-inspection, liability, and minimum standards. The government says municipalities are responsible as competent authority and as Wmo commissioner, promises an information sheet with the Minister for housing and VNG, and plans to report progress in early 2023 while judging a certification body unnecessary.
I will consult with municipalities and draft an information sheet to prevent unsafe stairlifts and staircases.
Ik ga in overleg met gemeenten en stel een informatieblad op ter voorkoming van onveilige trapliften en trappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat aanbieders van wijkverpleging miljoenen euro’s verlies lijden en de toegankelijkheid van de zorg in gevaar is

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care whether home-care providers' losses and access problems are caused by the tariff system, what the NZa's role is in enforcing insurers' duty of care, and how care at home can be ensured. The minister answered that contracting is free and the hourly model no longer fits the goals, that insurers expect extra revenue in 2023, that the NZa decides on interventions, and pointed to the WOZO programme.
It is up to the NZa, as independent supervisor, to choose an appropriate intervention.
Het is aan de NZa, als onafhankelijke toezichthouder, om hierbij een passende interventie te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de oplopende kosten bij verpleeghuizen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about rising costs for nursing homes (energy, food, laundry), whether staff can get inflation-linked pay rises, whether one-off compensation is planned, and what room remains for investment. The minister pointed to an ongoing inventory of energy-cost effects, an early tariff update for 2023 and the government's general support and wage-funding measures, but gave no concrete compensation decision.
On the basis of this inventory, I will assess together with the cabinet whether additional measures are needed to ensure continuity of care.
Op basis van deze inventarisatie beoordeel ik samen met het kabinet of er aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn om de continuïteit van zorg te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het artikel 'Voor altijd een piep in je oor'

An MP asked the state secretary for health about rising hearing damage among young people, including structural hearing screening, a legally binding decibel limit and legislation. The state secretary pointed to the existing convention, screening studies and a pending Health Council advice, and promised to inform parliament after that advice.
After the Health Council's advice has been published, I will inform you about possible additional measures.
Na het verschijnen van het advies van de Gezondheidsraad zal ik u informeren over mogelijk aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de vaccinatie tegen apenpokken

An MP asked the health minister whether the GGD can identify the full at-risk group for monkeypox vaccination, whether the target group should be widened, and whether enough vaccine is available. The minister answered that identifying the group takes time but does not currently slow vaccination, that the GGD cannot have a complete picture, that expert advice does not call for widening the group, and that extra vaccine is being procured via EU joint purchase for delivery in Q3 2023.
Through a joint purchase at EU level, work is currently underway on the availability of additional vaccine.
Via een gezamenlijke aankoop in EU-verband wordt op dit moment gewerkt aan de beschikbaarheid van extra vaccin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het toezicht op gezinshuizen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about supervision of family-style foster care homes (gezinshuizen) in youth care: rent costs, use of interns, quality criteria, profit-making, metatoezicht, powers of the inspectorate and advocates, and handling of upheld complaints. The State Secretary answers that cost elements and quality criteria guide pricing and oversight, that the inspectorate can issue binding orders but not close homes indefinitely, and that a metatoezicht pilot runs until mid-2023 before any decision.
The definitive use of metatoezicht will only happen once the IGJ has confidence in these parties.
Het definitief inzetten van metatoezicht zal pas gebeuren als de IGJ vertrouwen heeft in deze partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over beschikbaarheid van nachtzorg

The MP asks how the government will ensure all regions make agreements on unplannable night-time home care, how it will enforce cooperation and landsdekkendheid, and what the Berenschot evaluation is for. The minister answers that the responsibility lies with regional providers and insurers, that the government monitors implementation and will apply administrative pressure if needed, that Berenschot found freerider behaviour in 13 of 23 regions, and that joint purchasing by insurers adds little and would reduce competition.
I expect parties to make every effort to implement the agreements made, and if implementation lags, I will exert administrative pressure to bring it about.

Ik verwacht van partijen dat zij zich maximaal inspannen om de afspraken die gemaakt zijn te implementeren en zal, indien de implementatie achterblijft, bestuurlijke druk uitoefenen om dat te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over diplomafraude in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about concrete actions against diploma fraud in care, the number of investigations over ten years, prosecutions, how to stop unqualified staff, and whether DUO diploma extracts could be required. The minister answered that DUO runs a campaign on the Mijn diploma's register, that the IGJ reports rising numbers of notices, that a criminal investigation is ongoing without further detail, and that employers should require DUO extracts, though no binding measure was committed.
There is no nationwide comprehensive registration of the number of investigations into diploma fraud in care over the last ten years.
Er is geen landelijk sluitende registratie over het aantal onderzoeken naar diplomafraude in de zorg over de laatste tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het artikel 'Klokkenluiders slaan alarm

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reported abuses at a youth family home (Villa Maria) and how complaints can be safely reported and handled. The state secretary explained the complaint channels (LMZ, IGJ meldpunt, Jeugdwet complaint committees, AKJ) and said the inspectorate is investigating, but declined to detail individual complaints citing confidentiality and privacy.
Due to the confidentiality of the information and the privacy of those involved in the submitted reports and signals, the individual reports or signals cannot be addressed.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie en de privacy van betrokkenen bij de afgegeven meldingen en signalen, kan niet op de individuele meldingen of signalen worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de gezinshuizen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about the rapid growth of family homes in youth care, their for-profit BV structures, tariff differences between municipalities, and whether WNT pay caps and quality supervision apply. The state secretary confirmed the growth, said legislation permits various organisational forms including BVs, referred tariff setting to municipalities and providers with supporting guidelines, said WNT does not cover partnerships (vof), and pointed to planned Wibz legislation and IGJ supervision.
This bill was recently explained in more detail by the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport in her letter of 29 June regarding tackling non-integrous care providers.
Dit wetsvoorstel heeft de Minister voor Langdurige zorg en Sport onlangs nader toegelicht in de brief van 29 juni jongstleden met betrekking tot de aanpak van niet-integere zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de uitspraak van de ombudsman van de publieke omroepen dat de omroep Ongehoord Nederland in publicaties de Journalistieke Code van de NPO heeft geschonden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the NPO can act after the public broadcasters' ombudsman ruled that Ongehoord Nederland breached the NPO Journalistic Code, how this fits the public broadcasting mandate, and whether the report risks being shelved. The government referred to its answers to questions 8 to 11 and said the NPO must first form its own judgement on the report.
The NPO is now first to form a judgement on the basis of the report.
De NPO is nu eerst aan zet om op basis van het rapport een oordeel te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Mei Li Vos over ondersteuning van het postbedrijf, de kranten en tijdschriften en het culturele erfgoed

MPs Mohandis and Mei Li Vos asked whether Belgium's 2016 bpost concession, which requires early newspaper delivery and nationwide coverage funded up to EUR 200 million, is approved state aid and whether the Netherlands could use the same model. The minister confirmed the Belgian arrangement was approved by the European Commission but declined to use such compensation in the Netherlands, judging the domestic distribution network already adequate.
I see no reason to make use of this possibility in this case.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om in dit geval van deze mogelijkheid gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Mei Li Vos over staatssteun voor Belgische mediabedrijven die Nederlandse krantenbedrijven willen overnemen

MPs Mohandis and Mei Li Vos asked about Belgian state support (postal distribution compensation to bpost and a 0% VAT rate on printed newspapers) enabling Belgian media firms to acquire Dutch newspapers, and whether this distorts the Dutch market. The Secretary of State answered that the EU Commission has found both measures compatible with EU rules, that no distortion was established, and that the future of the Dutch press is primarily the sector's responsibility, with a promised information letter on research into independent journalism before summer.
The European Commission concluded in its aforementioned decision that the Belgian DAEB press distribution complies with EU state aid rules.
De Europese Commissie heeft in haar voornoemd besluit geconcludeerd dat de Belgische DAEB persdistributie voldoet aan de EU staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht 'Nieuwe opwinding over GIEL-salaris'

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked whether a reported salary of 560,000 euros for a public broadcaster's radio presenter is reasonable and whether non-top staff in the public sector should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT). The State Secretary called such a salary unreasonable and said the WNT-3 bill extending the pay norm to non-top staff, including presenters, is expected to go to the Council of State for advice soon.
The cabinet also wants the statutory pay norm to apply to non-top officials in the (semi-)public sector, including presenters, programme makers and radio DJs at the public broadcaster.
Het kabinet wil daarnaast dat de wettelijke bezoldigingsnorm ook op niet-topfunctionarissen in de (semi)publieke sector van toepassing wordt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het topinkomen van een radiomaker

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a public broadcasting radio presenter earns about 560,000 euro a year, and whether public-broadcaster staff should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) salary cap of 181,000 euro. The government says it cannot verify the reported salary from WNT disclosures, finds such pay undesirable, has demanded concrete follow-up from the broadcaster, and says a WNT-3 bill extending the cap to non-top officials is in preparation.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me shortly which concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding a more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven over geheime contracten en onzorgvuldige begeleiding van deelnemers bij RTL-programma's rond hulp-tv

MPs asked the state secretary about RTL reality-help programmes allegedly misleading vulnerable participants, binding them to secret contracts, and filming therapy under pressure, and whether the state has adequate legal tools and oversight. The state secretary said producers and broadcasters bear primary responsibility, the Mediawet 2008 contains no such rules and no new legislation is planned, RTL (under Luxembourg supervision) has promised to review its practices and media code, and medical questions were referred to the health minister.
I also see no reason to propose statutory rules for this.
Ik zie ook geen aanleiding om daar wettelijke regels voor te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Mohandis over problemen in de doorstroom vmbo-mbo

MPs Vermue and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about vmbo graduates under 16 being refused entry to mbo, allegedly due to funding rules, incomplete files or weak motivation, leaving them at home without education. The minister denied that funding depends on age, explained the legal admission rules and leerplicht exemptions, said she lacks data on how many students are affected, and pointed to a bill granting a right of admission to mbo.
However, I do not have information that can confirm or deny the extent to which this actually occurs.
Ik beschik echter niet over informatie die kan bevestigen of ontkennen in hoeverre dit ook daadwerkelijk voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de ontevredenheid rond flexibele werkplekken in de nieuwbouw van de Hogeschool Utrecht

An MP asked the minister about staff and student dissatisfaction with flexible workspaces in the new Hogeschool Utrecht building and whether this shows the need for stronger participation rights. The minister said the college of governors is responsible for housing and staff policy, that staff and students were involved and evaluations are ongoing, and that changes are being implemented without committing to new state action.
The executive board of an institution is responsible for both housing and personnel policy.
Het college van bestuur van een instelling is verantwoordelijk voor zowel de huisvesting als het personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Mohandis over de toegankelijkheid van grote sportevenementen op televisie

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked whether major sporting events such as Formula 1 should be available on free-to-air television and whether the events list should be widened, after Formula 1 moved to subscription broadcaster Ziggo Sport. The Secretary of State agrees such events should be accessible on free-to-air television if of significant national importance, but declines to amend the events list now, citing legal certainty and recent 2015 changes, and points to digital options.
At this moment, however, I do not wish to amend the events list.
Op dit moment wil ik de evenementenlijst echter niet aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake de toename van fraudegevallen op hogescholen en universiteiten en de wijze waarop instellingen hiermee omgaan

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the rise in reported exam fraud at universities and universities of applied sciences, and whether institutions do enough to prevent it, including reuse of old exams, unreported cases, and unclear rules. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate reports more fraud reports without knowing the cause, that examination boards have strengthened and most have fraud rules, but that monitoring of compliance is a gap, and that a follow-up inspection will be held in a few years.
I do not consider the approach of the University of Groningen to be in conflict with the applicable legislation in this area.
Ik vind de handelwijze van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen niet strijdig met de vigerende wetgeving op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Otwin van Dijk inzake de toegankelijkheid van hoger onderwijs voor dove 30+ studenten

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked whether the ministry's age-30 cutoff for sign-language interpreters in higher education leaves deaf students over 30 unequally treated, and how this fits the UN disability convention. The minister replied that responsibility shifts to the individual after 30, that no unequal situation exists, that UWV or municipalities may fund an interpreter under conditions, and pointed to earlier answers for further options.
From the age limit of 30 years, responsibility for education rests with the individual and no longer with the Ministry of OCW.
Vanaf de leeftijdsgrens van 30 jaar komt de verantwoordelijkheid voor onderwijs bij de persoon te liggen en niet meer bij het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Kerstens over de beloningen in dienstverlenende non-profit organisaties in het onderwijs

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Education about reported salaries of top executives at education-serving non-profit organisations, some above the minister's pay, and whether these fit the WNT pay cap and whether organisations publish annual accounts. The minister replied that the salaries were within the 2014 norm, that the WNT applies uniformly, that transitional rules explain remaining excesses, and that she has urged transparency and compliance.
I attach importance to this transparency and closely monitor compliance with it.
Ik hecht aan deze transparantie en houd de naleving daarvan nauwlettend in het oog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jadnanansing inzake het misbruik van studiefinanciering

MPs Mohandis and Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Education about students receiving study grants without actually studying, as reported by the NOS. The minister said DUO holds no data on such students, that mbo institutions do not recognise a massive problem, and that attendance monitoring will be improved and the phenomenon investigated further.
As previously reported, I will investigate how often young people receive study financing without following education and what motives play a role.
Zoals reeds eerder gemeld ga ik onderzoeken hoe vaak het voorkomt dat jongeren wel studiefinanciering ontvangen maar geen onderwijs volgen en welke motieven daarbij een rol spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over "misleidende informatie van opleidingen over de arbeidsmarktpositie van hun afgestudeerden"

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about study programmes presenting misleading labour-market outcomes for graduates, and about abuse of internships. The minister acknowledges an error in the Studie in Cijfers indicator, promises a repaired version, and says internship abuse will be examined based on concrete reports.
It is regrettable that this happened, because the study fact sheet was only recently established.
Het is betreurenswaardig dat dit gebeurd is, want de studiebijsluiter is pas recent tot stand gekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de boete voor het niet tijdig stopzetten van het studentenreisproduct

An MP asks the Minister of Education about fines of 97 euro per half month imposed on former students who fail to stop their student transport product in time, and whether automatic termination could be used instead. The Minister acknowledges the signals, says automatic termination is desirable but technically not possible for now, outlines DUO's information channels, and promises research into students' motives and a discussion with student organisations before summer.
These signals have given rise to further research into the motives of (former) students for not stopping their travel product on time.
Deze signalen hebben aanleiding gegeven nader onderzoek te doen naar de motieven van (oud-)studenten om hun reisproduct niet tijdig stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Meenen inzake het intrekken van het instemmingsrecht op de faculteitsbegroting door de faculteitsraad

MPs Mohandis and Van Meenen asked whether the Leiden executive board's withdrawal of faculty-level consent rights over the faculty budget undermines student influence. The minister answers that no formal withdrawal occurred, that consent on budget outlines applies at institutional level in principle, and that she sees no reason to intervene with the board or other institutions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Mohandis over beloningsonderscheid op hogescholen

MPs Yücel and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens study finding pay-discrimination risks between men and women in universities of applied sciences (hogescholen), and the underrepresentation of women in the highest pay grade. The minister answered that hogescholen are responsible for their own pay policy, pointed to existing works council duties, the Charter Talent naar de Top and the national anti-discrimination action plan, and said the sector is taking up the issue.
Hogescholen are themselves responsible for their pay policy, but I think it is important that the sector takes up this problem.
Hogescholen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beloningsbeleid, maar ik vind het belangrijk dat de sector dit probleem oppakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het bericht dat selectie aan de poort allochtonen dupeert

An MP asked the Education Minister whether selection at the entrance of higher-education programmes disadvantages non-Western, lower-achieving and male students, and whether this conflicts with a motion against extra admission requirements. The minister acknowledges the inspectorate's findings of modest differences, attributes them partly to sector choice, says no new selection instruments will be added, and promises further monitoring, regional cooperation and discussions with stakeholders.
In line with the Klaver/Mohandis motion, I will therefore not further expand the number of selection instruments.
In lijn met de motie Klaver/Mohandis 3 zal ik het aantal selectie-instrumenten dus ook niet verder uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over DaMu scholieren naar aanleiding van de uitzending "Alles voor je kind"

MPs Duisenberg and Mohandis asked the State Secretary about travel costs for DaMu dance and music pupils and whether existing schemes or funds could cover them. The State Secretary said no government scheme exists, estimated the cost of a student travel pass at about 600,000 euros, and announced from school year 2016/2017 an exceptional travel-cost contribution run by the Stichting DaMu.
After consultation with the Stichting DaMu, I have decided to provide, from school year 2016/2017 and in exceptional cases, a contribution towards travel costs for DaMu pupils.
Na overleg met de Stichting DaMu heb ik besloten om met ingang van schooljaar 2016/2017 in uitzonderlijke gevallen te voorzien in een tegemoetkoming van reiskosten voor DaMu-leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het bericht dat cijfers in de universitaire studiebijsluiter een vertekend beeld geven

An MP asked whether universities can choose which employment figures from studiekeuze123 they use in study fact sheets, and whether these give a distorted picture of job prospects. The minister replied that the figures are fixed and identical for all programmes, that the indicator is a national average, and that she sees no need to act or contact studiekeuze123.
Studie in cijfers is a fixed pdf format that is identical for all hbo or wo programmes.
Studie in cijfers is een vast pdf-formaat dat identiek is voor alle hbo-opleidingen dan wel wo-opleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over het opzeggen van de FM-vergunning door Open Rotterdam

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether Open Rotterdam's decision to stop radio broadcasting, leaving the FM frequency unused, could be remedied before 2018 by letting another broadcaster use it. The minister confirmed that under the Mediawet only one local public broadcaster per municipality may be designated and that the frequency is reserved for Open Rotterdam, so reallocation to others is not possible, though a third party could broadcast on Open Rotterdam's frequency in agreement with it and the municipality.
An FM licence for local public broadcasting is only granted to the local public media institution designated by the Commissariaat voor de Media for that municipality.
Een FM-vergunning voor lokale publieke omroep wordt slechts verleend aan de lokale publieke media-instelling die door het Commissariaat voor de Media voor deze gemeente is aangewezen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het bericht dat masteropleidingen 'zesjesstudenten' gaan weren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether master programmes excluding students with bachelor grades below a seven is acceptable and whether bachelor graduates can always find a master place. The minister defended the abolition of pre-entry master rights and the allowance of quality criteria, said the Inspectorate will monitor access, and promised intervention powers if bachelor graduates are shut out.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education (hereafter: Inspectorate) to monitor this.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: Inspectie) gevraagd dit te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de buitensporige declaraties van bestuurders van de hogeschool Windesheim

An MP asked the Minister of Education about excessive expense claims (88,000 euro, mostly travel) by board members of Windesheim university of applied sciences, whether they were lawful, and whether a uniform sober expense code should be drawn up. The Minister answered that existing rules require sober, transparent claims, that the Inspectorate of Education is investigating, that the supervisory board is responsible for oversight, and that she will consider stricter rules after the investigation's outcome.
I have now instructed the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the expense claims of board members in higher education.
Inmiddels heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs opdracht gegeven het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het veelvuldig gebruik van flexcontracten door de UvA

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Amsterdam's heavy reliance on flexible, temporary contracts in the Faculty of Humanities and whether this conflicts with the CAO and the Wet Werk en Zekerheid. The minister answered that the UvA has a 10-point plan and a working group on temporary contracts, denied that two-thirds of staff are flex workers, said the CAO and labour law must be complied with, and declined to start talks with the UvA.
From the Executive Board of the UvA I have understood that the provisions in the CAO universiteiten and other laws and regulations must be fully complied with.
Van het College van Bestuur van de UvA heb ik begrepen dat de bepalingen in de CAO universiteiten en andere wet- en regelgeving volledig dienen te worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over de implementatie van het cookiebeleid op de websites van de Publieke Omroep

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether NPO websites respect users' cookie choices, whether settings are remembered, and what the government will do to make sites accessible without accepting privacy-sensitive cookies. The minister answered that the sites were reviewed, the NPO fixed a display error and a remembering problem, and enforcement rests with the ACM and CBP, which have already acted.
Whether the NPO complies with the legal requirements and continues to do so is of course for the ACM to assess.
Of de NPO aan de wettelijke eisen voldoet en blijft voldoen is uiteraard aan de ACM om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de voorinvesteringen en medezeggenschap in het kader van het studievoorschot

An MP asked the minister about whether universities were presenting budget outlines to works councils (instemmingsrecht op hoofdlijnen) and about the sector-wide 200 million euro pre-investment under the study-fee reform. The minister said universities were implementing the consultation duty, that details are left to institutions, and that she will report on pre-investments at year end.

Following signals that some universities do not submit the main lines of the budget to the works council, I made inquiries, among others, with the University of Amsterdam, the VU and the University of Groningen.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van signalen dat er universiteiten zijn die de hoofdlijnen van de begroting niet voorleggen aan de medezeggenschap, onder andere navraag gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het inschrijfgeld voor een master aan de Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam

An MP asks whether the Erasmus University Rotterdam may charge a 100 euro application fee for master's programmes, and whether this breaches the principle that Dutch bachelor graduates pay only tuition. The minister confirms the principle, says the university deviates from it, and says a general administrative order will clarify rules on fees, though no investigation of other universities is planned.
I will provide the institutions with further clarification of the statutory principle
Ik zal de instellingen voorzien van een nadere toelichting op het wettelijke uitgangspunt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Bestuur gaat te ver, vinden Leidse studenten’

An MP asked the education minister about student criticism at Leiden University of its binding study advice (bsa) experiment in the second year, and whether this lacks support in the participation council. The minister answers that the university board is in ongoing dialogue with students, that the experiment will be evaluated internally and by the minister in 2018, and that she sees no reason to halt it.
I see no reason to halt this ongoing experiment prematurely.
Voor het voortijdig staken van dit lopende experiment zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mohandis over te dure studentenkamers

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked the minister about student room rents said to be too high, the LSVb findings, possible tougher rules against landlords, how students use rent-review routes, and whether the student housing action plan will ease scarcity. The minister acknowledged the concern, committed to tracking affordability in the monitor, saw no reason to abandon freedom of contract, described the Huurcommissie procedures as accessible, and gave supply figures with a promise of a later update.
From 2015 onward, affordability will be included as a regular indicator in the National Student Housing Monitor to gain better insight into the affordability problem for students.
Vanaf 2015 wordt in de Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting betaalbaarheid als reguliere meetindicator opgenomen om beter inzicht te krijgen in de betaalbaarheidproblematiek voor studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) voornemens is om extra te bezuinigen op het onderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Education about the UvA's projected deficits of up to 83 million euros, possible education cuts, and derivatives losses that the inspectorate had not flagged. The minister answered that the UvA is drafting a future plan, that the inspectorate sees no acute continuity risk, that existing derivatives oversight is adequate, and that she has talked with the executive board and will keep monitoring.
I am of the opinion that the current financial supervision by the inspectorate regarding derivatives is adequate.
Ik ben van mening dat het huidige financieel toezicht door de inspectie met betrekking tot derivaten toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mohandis over de hernieuwde plannen voor experimenten op honden door de Universiteit Maastricht

MPs Van Dekken and Mohandis asked whether Maastricht University's renewed plans for dog experiments on pacemaker research, suspended last year, were reasonable, including the ethics committee's approval and alternatives. The government replied that the research is not yet resumed, an external commission is reviewing the internal approval procedure first, the DEC's approval meets the legal requirements, and no further inquiry is planned.
Maastricht University has indicated that the internal procedures that led to approval of this animal experiment will be evaluated by an external committee.
De Universiteit Maastricht heeft aangegeven dat de interne procedures die hebben geleid tot de goedkeuring van deze dierproef geëvalueerd zullen worden door een externe commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het inschrijfgeld voor een master

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether universities may charge application fees to master's applicants, especially selective ones, and whether there is a legal basis for such fees. The Minister said such fees are acceptable only for applicants without a Dutch bachelor's diploma, must not exceed actual costs, and that no action against institutions is needed.
The legal starting point is that students in principle pay no contributions other than tuition fees.
Het wettelijke uitgangspunt is immers dat studenten in beginsel geen andere eigen bijdragen betalen dan het collegegeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Oosenbrug over de slechte ontvangst van TV West en TV Utrecht

MPs Mohandis and Oosenbrug asked whether the government is aware of poor reception of TV West and TV Utrecht after the channels were re-tuned, and whether this is undesirable given their emergency-broadcasting role; they also asked about frequency choice and when Ziggo will resolve it. The Secretary of State confirmed awareness, noted that the regional radio stations (not TV) are formal emergency broadcasters, said frequency management is Ziggo's responsibility, and reported that Ziggo promised to fix complaints via a free cable and technician visit, with all complaints so far resolved.
The emergency broadcaster status applies only to radio, not to television and online media.
De status van calamiteitenzender geldt alleen voor de radio, niet voor televisie en online media.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Mohandis over de aanpak van radicalisering en de handelingsverlegenheid van scholen om de actualiteit naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenissen in Parijs bespreekbaar te maken in d

MPs Marcouch and Mohandis asked how the government addresses radicalisation and why schools struggle to discuss the Paris attacks in class, including training, teaching materials and teacher education. The minister answers that schools are expected to act on their civic mandate, that training and portals exist, that a Jihadism intervention team is being discussed with municipalities, and that further studies and reports will follow.
We will return to this in the spring when we report on progress on citizenship education.
Wij zullen hier nader op ingaan als we in het voorjaar rapporteren over de voortgang op burgerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat universiteiten geen inzage willen geven in de opbouw van het collegegeld voor de tweede studie

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether universities will disclose how the institutional tuition for second degrees is built up, following reports of opaque fees and a court ruling that such fees can be tested by civil courts. The Minister says the institutions must justify the fees clearly, announces a review of transparency and a dialogue with the universities and colleges, and rejects capping the fees for now.
I have pointed out to the institutions that the Executive Board must provide clear information on this, both to the participation bodies and to students.
Ik heb de instellingen erop gewezen dat het College van Bestuur hierover duidelijke informatie moet geven, zowel aan de medezeggenschap als aan studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht “Burgemeester 'geeft' Omroep West-baas bonus”

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a mayor approved a 13,844 euro bonus for the director of regional broadcaster Omroep West, which may breach the WNT pay-cap law, and about related questions on the L1 case, oversight and subsidy conditions. The minister says the Commissariaat voor de Media found the bonus was paid, that a fuller WNT compliance investigation is underway with results expected within six weeks, that bonuses are generally barred under the WNT, and that proactive checks at other regional broadcasters will follow.
It is expected that the entire investigation can be completed within six weeks.
Naar verwachting kan het hele onderzoek binnen zes weken worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over het verbod voor studenten van de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) om voor stage of studie af te reizen naar Afrika

MPs Van Laar and Mohandis asked the ministers whether they know of the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences ban on student internships and study trips to Africa, and whether they agree that Africa should not be treated as one region. The minister acknowledged the ban is not absolute, agreed that per-country risk assessment is better, and said institutions set their own policy while the government advises following the Foreign Affairs travel advice without issuing binding national guidelines.
It is up to the institutions themselves to determine their policy in this matter; I will not draw up national guidelines on this.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om in hierin hun beleid te bepalen, ik zal daarover geen landelijke richtlijnen opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Mohandis en Segers over het bericht “Bonus directeur regionale omroep L1 onder de loep”

MPs Kerstens, Mohandis and Segers asked whether regional broadcaster L1 paid a director a bonus of over 26,000 euro, whether bonuses fall under WNT transitional law, and how unlawful bonuses are recovered and sanctioned. The Minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating, that bonuses agreed after 6 December 2011 are unlawful and must be recovered via a set procedure with penalty orders, and that he will consult VNG and IPO on model subsidy rules.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is currently investigating this.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media onderzoekt dit momenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het een rommeltje is met de beloning van hbo-bestuurders

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether some hbo (higher vocational) executives still earn more than the WNT pay cap allows, whether contracts signed after the WNT took effect breach it, and how the sector's pay code and salary-class rules will be enforced. The Minister replied that the first WNT reporting on 2013 pay is still being analysed and will be sent by year-end, that sector self-regulation is being monitored, that all onderwijsbestuurders have been under the WNT since 2013 with the Inspectie van het Onderwijs enforcing it, and that a moral appeal to executives produced positive responses from ten of eleven.
At the end of this year the first WNT report will be sent to your House.
Eind van dit jaar zal de eerste WNT-rapportage aan uw Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Wolbert over stagetekort voor studenten Medische hulpverlening

MPs Mohandis and Wolbert asked about a shortage of internship places for Medical Assistance (Medisch hulpverlener) students and whether the profession would be BIG-registered. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said it is primarily the responsibility of hospitals, and said registration decision is being prepared with an expected answer after the summer.
The civil-servant preparation for the decision-making by the Minister of VWS has meanwhile been set in motion.
De ambtelijke voorbereiding voor de besluitvorming door de Minister van VWS is inmiddels in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Mohandis inzake het bericht dat studenten van de Haagse Hogeschool tentamens vooraf kunnen inzien

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about reports that students at the Haagse Hogeschool could view exams in advance, possibly for four years, and whether such fraud was being investigated and prevented. The Minister answered that an investigation found no evidence of exam fraud in the ICT courses, that seven students with prior knowledge of exams were expelled and reported, that the wider investigation continues, and that institutions themselves are responsible for preventing fraud.
This investigation is still ongoing and has been extended with the latest signal regarding fraud (July 2014).
Dit onderzoek loopt nog en is uitgebreid met het laatste signaal met betrekking tot fraude (juli 2014).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake Het bericht ‘Grootschalige fraude door eerstejaars economie Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether first-year economics students at the UvA committed large-scale fraud on weekly online progress tests by logging into two browsers at once, and how many were affected and what will be done. The Minister answers that the progress tests were invalidated, fifteen students failed the course as a result, individual review requests are handled by the examination board, no further sanctions were imposed, and institutions are tightening software and testing procedures.
The UvA established that fifteen students (out of the 870 who took the exam) received a failing grade because the half bonus point was removed.
De UvA heeft vastgesteld dat vijftien studenten (van de 870 studenten die deelnamen aan het tentamen) een onvoldoende hebben gehaald door het wegvallen van het halve bonuspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Tijd dringt voor nieuwe studenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that many prospective students had not yet registered before the new 1 May deadline, and whether DigiD delays and information provision were adequate. The minister answered that registrations are rising sharply, that extensive information campaigns have been run, and that she will monitor the situation and take further communication steps before drawing a final balance after 1 May.
Studielink only provides information on the actual number of applications submitted in Studielink, without distinguishing between final-year secondary school students and switchers.
Studielink geeft alleen informatie over het feitelijke aantal ingediende aanmeldingen in Studielink, zonder onderscheid te maken tussen eindexamenkandidaten en switchers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over het frequentiespectrum voor draadloze microfoons

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether reallocating radio spectrum (the 700 MHz band) could disrupt wireless microphones used in broadcasting, and what compensation or solutions would be offered. The minister answered that the 800 MHz reallocation was handled through consultation with the sector and a three-year transition, that no compensation is considered necessary, and that the 700 MHz decision will be handled similarly with flexible, sector-involved solutions.
Given these measures, in my view additional provisions such as compensation are not necessary.
Door deze maatregelen zijn in mijn ogen aanvullende voorzieningen in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld compensatie niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Dure tentamens in Leiden’

An MP asked whether Dutch universities may charge students fees for late registration for exams and whether this is lawful. The minister answered that no legal basis exists for such charges, that institutions must set reasonable, clearly communicated registration deadlines, and that exam registration may be separate from course registration.
There is no legal basis for charging costs when students register late for an exam.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag voor het in rekening brengen van kosten indien studenten zich te laat inschrijven voor een tentamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat scholen geld overhouden

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether schools were holding unspent funds (about 300 million euros) and whether this should be spent on education, and how much was underspent by sector in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that positive results do not necessarily mean money is being hoarded, gave 2012 sector figures, said 2013 figures are not yet available, and noted that the inspectorate monitors institutions with high reserves.
An incidental positive result does not by definition mean that the sectors are 'holding on to' money.
Een incidenteel positief resultaat betekent niet per definitie dat de sectoren geld «overhouden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Klein over het bericht “School doet er alles aan om van oudere leraar af te raken”

MPs Mohandis and Klein asked the Minister of Education whether schools push older teachers out for financial reasons and whether the government will protect older teachers and their competence. The Minister rejects the claim that older teachers are disproportionately dismissed, points to UWV unemployment inflow figures, and says personnel policy and cao rules are the responsibility of schools and cao parties, promising only a new senior scheme to be elaborated at the cao table.
Conducting good personnel policy is the responsibility of the schools themselves.
Het voeren van een goed personeelsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht “Hoogleraren stapelen bijbanen op”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that professors accumulate side jobs and how this affects independence and conflicts of interest. The minister said side-job numbers are the responsibility of universities, that transparency is ensured via public profile pages, and that the Dutch research integrity code applies.
Numbers of side functions of professors are not kept by the ministry.
Aantallen nevenfuncties van hoogleraren worden niet door het ministerie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over de mogelijke sluiting van de Saint James School of Medicine op Bonaire

Two MPs asked whether the Saint James School of Medicine on Bonaire must close by 2015 because it fails Dutch inspection requirements, and what efforts and options exist to prevent closure. The minister answered that the school never received Dutch accreditation, withdrew its higher-education procedure, and therefore lost ECFMG recognition, while acknowledging some economic impact and noting that the government had already extended the deadline.
The medical school chose, after the investigation under the new programme assessment, to withdraw its application for that assessment.
De medical school heeft ervoor gekozen na het onderzoek in het kader van de toets nieuwe opleiding, de aanvraag voor die toets in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat studenten van Inholland problemen ervaren bij het afronden van hun studie

MPs Mohandis, Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Inholland's tightened graduation requirements are leaving students unable to finish, and what compensation is available. The minister answered that Inholland's extra support measures are adequate, that she does not expect large numbers to be stranded, and that students can seek support from the profileringsfonds or claim damages under general law.
I consider the measures taken by Hogeschool Inholland (see my answer to question 2 above) sufficient.
Ik acht de maatregelen die zijn getroffen door Hogeschool Inholland (zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 2 hierboven) voldoende.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht “Oud hoogleraar Bax schuldig aan wetenschappelijk wangedrag”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the finding that former professor Bax committed scientific misconduct, including the consequences for supervised PhD students, why earlier warnings and checks did not detect it, whether sector measures would have caught it, what integrity steps were taken, and whether criminal complaint would be filed. The minister answered that the PhD students face no consequences, that the VU will have the report translated and notify journals and registries, that the VU is responsible for any criminal complaint, and that institutions have reformed integrity policy.
The Vrije Universiteit has decided to have the Baud committee report translated into English and sent to the journals in which the articles appeared.
De Vrije Universiteit heeft besloten het rapport van de commissie Baud in het Engels te vertalen en te doen toekomen aan de tijdschriften waarin deze zijn verschenen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat de universiteit Leiden een bindend studieadvies in gaat voeren voor unieke opleidingen

An MP asks the Education Minister whether Leiden University's participation in the binding study advice (BSA) experiment, which reportedly includes unique programmes, breaches the agreed exclusion of unique programmes and the Chamber's conditions. The minister replies that unique programmes are excluded, that the programmes concerned have alternatives elsewhere, and sees no reason to exclude them from the experiment.
I currently see no reason to exclude the programmes in question from participation in the experiment.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de onderhavige opleidingen van deelname aan het experiment uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Mohandis over opleidingen die studenten met autisme weigeren

MPs Ypma and Mohandis asked about vocational and higher education institutions refusing students with autism, and the government's support for students with disabilities. The minister said the inspectorate had received no reports from institutions, that Start Foundation had about 100 unverified reports, and that the Equal Treatment Commission had handled only four cases, all in vocational education.
For now it is not known whether higher education institutions have refused admission to autistic students.
Vooralsnog is niet bekend of ho-instellingen autistische studenten niet hebben toegelaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘VO-raad jokt: promotie van leraren kan wel’

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a report that secondary school employers' body VO-raad claimed promotion of teachers to higher pay scales could be paused, and about union claims that the functiemix policy had yielded funds for schools. The state secretary said the agreed goals of the functiemix will be upheld within available funds, that talks with VO-raad and unions are ongoing, and that schools will be reminded of their commitments to promote teachers.

Based on the goals of the Leerkracht covenant and the outcomes of the consultation, I will, together with the social partners, inform the schools and hold them to account on the importance of fulfilling the covenant's agreements to promote teachers to higher positions.

Aan de hand van de doelstellingen uit het convenant Leerkracht en de uitkomsten van het overleg zal ik samen met de sociale partners de scholen informeren en hen aanspreken over het belang van het nakomen van de afspraken uit het convenant om leerkrachten te bevorderen naar hogere functies.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Mohandis over de kosten van kamerverhuur

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked about the high cost of student rooms in Amsterdam and Utrecht, the norm rent used for student housing, and how many extra student rooms are needed beyond the national action plan. The minister answered that rents are set by free contract with limited tenant remedies via the rent commission, that housing shortages are tied to tight local markets, and that the action plan's additional units are considered sufficient with private landlords expected to expand supply.
In rent law for residential accommodation, the principle of contractual freedom applies in principle.
In het huurprijzenrecht voor woonruimte geldt in beginsel contractvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jadnanansing inzake het feit dat studenten problemen ervaren tijdens hun stage

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about student interns facing bullying and weak supervision, citing a 2013 stage monitor showing supervision rated only barely sufficient and one in five students reporting harassment. The minister called the findings serious and said schools must ensure supervision and teachers need adequate time, but left concrete improvements to schools and employers, seeing no direct role for herself.
I do not see a role for myself here in the first instance.
Ik zie hier in eerste instantie geen rol voor mijzelf weggelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat ruim zesduizend studenten boetes krijgen wegens het aflopen van het recht op reizen met het OV

An MP asked the minister of Education about reports that over six thousand students face fines for not stopping their public transport pass after leaving education, and why the fine was raised. The minister explained the stopping procedure, the reminders and communication sent to students, the reason for the fine increase, and said she will ask student organisations for suggestions to improve communication.
I will ask student organisations what suggestions they have for improving the communication.
Ik zal studentenorganisaties vragen welke suggesties zij hebben voor verbetering van de communicatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Bestuurlijke crisis bij VU- rapport velt hard oordeel over onderwijs’?

An MP asked the education minister about reported governance turmoil at the Vrije Universiteit, including a dispute between its deans and supervisory board, a critical internal commission finding that the education vision was insufficiently concrete, and the effect on a planned merger of science faculties with the University of Amsterdam. The minister said she had no substantive view on the dispute, is being informed by the Inspectorate, and that the merger is a matter for the two institutions.
I am having the Inspectorate keep me informed of further developments, partly on the basis of additional information it is gathering from the VU.
Ik laat mij door de IvhO informeren over verdere ontwikkelingen, mede op basis van nadere informatie die door haar bij de VU wordt ingewonnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over verkeerde registraties in het CRIHO

An MP asked the education minister about students whose completed non-teaching, non-care degrees were wrongly registered in CRIHO, forcing them to pay institutional rather than statutory tuition for a second teaching or care study. The minister acknowledged the cause lies in past hogeschool practice, said the situation is not a flaw in the law, and declined to restore statutory tuition, leaving a solution to the hogescholen.
No. I am of the view that the institutions involved are responsible for a financial solution to this problem, and I have confidence that they will succeed.
Nee. Ik ben van mening dat de betrokken hogescholen verantwoordelijk zijn voor een financiële oplossing voor deze problematiek en ik heb er vertrouwen in dat zij daarin zullen slagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de cijfers en feiten rond schuldenlast van studenten bij het sociaal leenstelsel

An MP asked the minister of Education about the debt burden of students under the proposed social loan system, and whether the BKR's warnings about debt, interest rates and registration are accurate. The minister rejects the BKR's figures as partly incorrect, argues the system is a mix of grants and loans with income-contingent repayment, and says BKR registration is unnecessary.
The BKR supports its argument with several factual inaccuracies.
Het BKR onderbouwt zijn betoog met meerdere feitelijke onjuistheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het tekort aan leraren wiskunde en Nederlands, naar aanleiding van het artikel daarover in de Volkskrant van 1 maart 2013

An MP asked the education minister about the reported shortage of mathematics and Dutch teachers and its consequences for pupils. The minister accepted the CentERdata/VOION projections of a future shortage and described regional projects, a 100 million euro programme and a possible mobility centre to address it.
Work is currently under way to address the projected future shortages.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan de ondervanging van geraamde toekomstige tekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over boetes voor buitenlandse studenten wegens vermeend ontbreken ziektekostenverzekering

MPs Mohandis and Bouwmeester asked whether foreign students are wrongly fined by the CVZ for allegedly lacking health insurance and how to prevent this. The minister explains that students under 30 who work alongside their studies are rightly insured under Dutch rules, while exchange and non-publicly funded students are wrongly contacted because current administration cannot screen them, and says the communication is being improved and the group may be narrowed further.
In addition, I am examining the possibilities to further limit the group of international students who are currently wrongly contacted.
Daarnaast onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de groep internationale studenten die nu onterecht worden aangeschreven nog verder te beperken.
Antwoord vragen Mohandis over het onderzoek ‘Teacher evaluations and pupil achievement: Evidence from classroom observation’ van het Centraal Planbureau

An MP asked the education minister about a CPB study linking classroom observation of teachers to pupil achievement, and whether observation methods could improve teacher quality and inspectorate assessments. The state secretary said the method is promising and will be used in coaching and the Nationaal Onderwijs Akkoord, but rejected making teacher quality a larger part of inspectorate school assessments, leaving that role to school leaders and boards.
I do not share that view. The inspectorate assesses teacher quality at risk schools.
Ik deel die mening niet. De inspectie beoordeelt de lerarenkwaliteit bij risicoscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Mohandis over vrouwen in topfuncties bij universiteiten en hogescholen

Two MPs asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about the low share of women in professorships and top posts at universities and universities of applied sciences, including measures, a 30% target and gender training. The minister answered that universities are autonomous, cited measures such as Talent naar de Top, Aspasia and the LNVH network, said a 30% target is reasonable with tailoring, and noted there is no mandatory gender training.
The Dutch universities are autonomous. The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science does not have figures on women who cannot progress.
De Nederlandse universiteiten zijn autonoom. Het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap beschikt niet over cijfers met betrekking tot vrouwen die niet kunnen doorstromen.
Antwoord vragen Mohandis en Otwin van Dijk over de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een beperking

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked the education minister about accessibility of higher education for students with disabilities, citing a report that rated it poorly and asking why vocational institutions score lower and what target to set. The minister answered that satisfaction (3.3 of 5) is sufficient and improving, that she will await the longitudinal study due in spring 2013 and will consult partners if warranted, but declined to set a numerical target.
I consider the accessibility of higher education for this group of students very important.
Ik vind de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor deze groep studenten heel belangrijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat veel jonge docenten moeilijker aan het werk kunnen komen

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether falling employment for young, newly graduated teachers in primary and secondary education is a concern and what policy response is planned. The minister answers that regional shortages and surpluses exist, that graduates still find jobs fairly quickly nationally, and that cross-regional cooperation and an impulse plan for teachers are being pursued.
Where regional bottlenecks arise, I take measures.
Waar er op regionaal niveau knelpunten ontstaan neem ik maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het schrikbewind dat conciërges, onderwijsassistenten en administratief personeel op school zouden ervaren

An MP asked the education minister how she assesses a CNV Onderwijs study reporting a 'reign of terror' by pupils against school support staff, and whether schools should have safety policies. The state secretary acknowledged the incidents, pointed to the government's safety monitor and existing school safety obligations, and said she would convene employer and union organisations to address aggression in education.
I have invited the employers' organisations and trade unions to enter into consultation soon to arrive at a joint approach to aggression in education.
Ik heb de werkgeversorganisaties en vakbonden uitgenodigd om op korte termijn met elkaar het overleg aan te gaan om tot een gezamenlijke aanpak van agressie in het onderwijs te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over een nieuwe, eenvoudige Cito-toets voor leerlingen met taal- een rekenproblemen

An MP asked whether an easier Cito end-of-primary test for pupils with language and arithmetic difficulties, and its possible effects on advice and stigma, was justified. The state secretary answered that Cito designs the Eindtoets Niveau, that it is scored on the same scale as the regular test so advice stays the same, and that schools already manage two-level tests without extra instruction.
The answer to the previous question also applies to possible over-advising: taking the Eindtoets Niveau leads to the same advice as taking the Eindtoets Basis.
Het antwoord op de voorgaande vraagt geldt eveneens voor mogelijke overadvisering: deelname aan de Eindtoets Niveau leidt tot hetzelfde advies als deelname aan de Eindtoets Basis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het gebruik van een schoollokaal voor flexwerkers

An MP asked the education minister whether a Arnhem Jenaplan primary school renting a vacant classroom to flexworkers was a model for other schools, and whether legal barriers exist. The minister called it a creative experiment to be evaluated in six months, said school boards decide community links, and explained the statutory rules on letting classrooms under article 108 WPO.
An evaluation will take place in half a year. I am curious about its outcomes.
Over een half jaar vindt er een evaluatie plaats. Ik ben benieuwd naar de uitkomsten daarvan.

m: Motie Uitslag c.s. over clientenperspectief bij zorgverzekeraars
Asks the government to agree with insurers and patient groups a plan to secure client participation at health insurers taking over AWBZ care.
calls on the government to consult with health insurers and patient organisations
roept de regering op in overleg met zorgverzekeraars en patiëntenorganisaties te treden
Asks the government to consult with the VNG and ministerial transition bureaus on cooperation for decentralisation and report to the House in spring 2012.
to inform the House in spring 2012 about how they have given it form and content
om de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2012 te informeren over de wijze waarop zij daaraan vorm en inhoud heeft gegeven
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over palliatieve sedatie
Asks the government to promote better communication about palliative sedation and knowledge exchange, and to ensure existing rules and guidelines are followed.
to promote that the applicable rules and guidelines are observed
te bevorderen dat de geldende regels en richtlijnen in acht worden genomen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Uitslag en Voordewind ter vervanging van nr. 53 over het herintroduceren van een experimenteerbepaling

Reinstates an experiment article letting municipalities raise the alcohol sales age to 18, requiring a joint AMvB, a report to both Chambers within three months after an experiment, and a four-week pre-submission of the draft AMvB to the Chambers.
The submission of a general administrative measure to be adopted under the second paragraph is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het tweede lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van de leden Bouwmeester en Uitslag ter vervanging van nr. 77 over de reikwijdte van de strafbaarstelling
Amendment narrowing the under-16 alcohol possession ban so that it does not apply in shops and bars selling alcohol, leaving liability with the seller and parents.
This amendment prevents a child under 16 from also being punishable in the supermarket and liquor store if it has alcoholic drink present or ready for consumption.
Met dit amendement wordt voorkomen dat een kind onder de 16 jaar ook in de supermarkt en slijterij strafbaar is indien het alcoholhoudende drank aanwezig of voor consumptie gereed heeft.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Bouwmeester en Uitslag ter vervanging van nr. 47 over de reikwijdte van de strafbaarstelling
Limits the alcohol possession offence for under-16s so it does not apply in supermarkets and liquor stores, leaving responsibility with retailers.
This amendment prevents a child from also being punishable in the supermarket or liquor store if alcohol under 16 is in its possession.
Met dit amendement wordt voorkomen dat een kind ook in de supermarkt of slijterij strafbaar is indien alcohol onder de 16 voorhanden is.
Amendement van de leden Bouwmeester en Uitslag ter vervanging van nr. 48 over de verkoop van zwak-alcoholhoudende streekproducten
Amends the alcohol-sales provision so tourist VVV shops may keep selling low-alcohol regional products to tourists.
