By dropping the first part, the ban on sales, an unintended effect of the legislative change, is prevented.
Door het eerste onderdeel te laten vervallen wordt het verbod op de verkoop, een onbedoeld effect van de wetswijziging, voorkomen.
Amendement van het lid Uitslag over het herintroduceren van een experimenteerbepaling

Reinstates an experiment article letting municipalities raise the alcohol age from 16 to 18 by AMvB, requiring a ministerial evaluation report to both chambers within three months after the experiment ends.
the Minister and the Minister of the Interior jointly send, within three months after an experiment ends, a report on its effectiveness and effects

Onze Minister en Onze Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tezamen zenden uiterlijk drie maanden na de beëindiging van een experiment een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten ervan
Asks the government to talk before the Voorjaarsnota about continuity of LFB support within the current budget framework.
requests the government to engage in discussion before the Voorjaarsnota on the embedding and continuity of the LFB.
verzoekt de regering vóór de Voorjaarsnota het gesprek aan te gaan over de inbedding en continuïteit van de LFB
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Uitslag ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het behouden van de privaatrechtelijke arbeidsovereenkomst voor het personeel van het CAK
Amendment keeping CAK staff on private-law employment contracts instead of civil-servant status, exempting them from the framework act for autonomous administrative bodies.
the staff of the legal person referred to in the first paragraph are employed under a private-law employment contract
worden de personeelsleden van de in het eerste lid bedoelde rechtspersoon in dienst genomen op arbeidsovereenkomst naar burgerlijk recht
Amendement van het lid Uitslag over het behouden van de privaatrechtelijek arbeidsovereekomst voor het personeel van het CAK
Amendment keeping CAK staff under private-law employment contracts instead of civil servant status, affecting administrative costs.
Staff of the legal entity are employed under a civil-law employment contract.
Het personeel van de in het eerste lid bedoelde rechtspersoon wordt in dienst genomen op arbeidsovereenkomst naar burgerlijk recht.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Uitslag ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het, mits het tuchtcollege daartoe besluit, in het register opnemen van waarschuwingen, geldboetes en berispingen
Amends the BIG register rules so the disciplinary tribunal may publish warnings, fines and reprimands for public-interest reasons.
If reasons derived from the general interest so require, the college may, when imposing a measure, decide to record the measure in the register.

Indien redenen aan het algemeen belang ontleend dit vorderen, kan het college bij het opleggen van een maatregel als bedoeld in het eerste lid onder a tot en met c, besluiten tot aantekening van de maatregel, met de gronden waarop hij rust, in het register.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Uitslag ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het, mits het tuchtcollege daartoe besluit, in het register opnemen van waarschuwingen, geldboetes en berispingen
Amendment letting the disciplinary tribunal publish sanctions without career consequences in the public interest for up to two years and extending the register and notification rules.
Through this amendment the disciplinary judge gets the option to decide that rulings without career-limiting effects are still made public.
Via deze wetswijziging krijgt de tuchtrechter de mogelijkheid te besluiten dat uitspraken die op zich geen beroepsbeperkende gevolgen hebben, toch openbaar worden gemaakt
Motie Kuiken en Uitslag over uitschrijven uit het register
Asks the government to close a loophole allowing medical professionals to deregister from the BIG register to avoid disciplinary proceedings and the blacklist.
requests the government to close this loophole in the law
verzoekt de regering deze maas in de wet te dichten
Amendement van het lid Uitslag over het in het register opnemen van waarschuwingen, geldboetes en berispingen

Amendment lets the disciplinary tribunal publish reprimands, fines and warnings for registered professionals in the register when the public interest requires, for up to two years, and adds the minister as a recipient of disciplinary rulings.
Through this amendment the disciplinary judge gains the option to decide that rulings without career-restricting consequences are still made public when the general interest requires it.

Via deze wetswijziging krijgt de tuchtrechter de mogelijkheid te besluiten dat uitspraken die op zich geen beroepsbeperkende gevolgen hebben, toch openbaar worden gemaakt, indien het algemeen belang dat vergt.
Motie-Uitslag c.s. over voorlichting over rood staan aan jongeren
Motion asking the government to consult Nibud and banks on better information for young people about overdrafts and on preventing unwise overdrafts.
requests the government, in consultation with Nibud and the banks, to achieve better and more transparent information about overdrafts for young people from eighteen
verzoekt de regering in overleg met het Nibud en de banken te komen tot een betere en transparantere voorlichting over rood staan voor jongeren vanaf achttien jaar
Motie-Voordewind en Uitslag over preventie als onderdeel van het jeugdgezondheidszorgbeleid
Asks the government to explain in its cabinet response to the Youth Act evaluation how prevention is an essential part of youth health care.
explicitly address how prevention is an essential part of youth health care
expliciet in te gaan op de wijze waarop preventie een wezenlijk onderdeel is van de jeugdgezondheidszorg
Motie Langkamp c.s. over de implementatie van de doorbraakmethode bij alle jeugd-ggz-instellingen
Asks the government with GGZ Nederland and insurers to present a plan for implementing the breakthrough method in all youth mental health institutions.
requests the government together with GGZ Nederland and health insurers to come up with a detailed plan
verzoekt de regering samen met GGZ Nederland en de zorgverzekeraars te komen met een nader uitgewerkt plan
Motie Uitslag en Bouwmeester over delen van de wachtlijstinformatie van de verschillende sectoren
Asks the government to agree with sectors that waiting-list information for youth care be shared annually across organisations in each region.
requests the government to agree with the sectors that waiting-list information from the different sectors in a region is shared with each other annually
verzoekt de regering met de sectoren af te spreken dat de wachtlijstinformatie van de verschillende sectoren in een regio jaarlijks met elkaar gedeeld wordt
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitslag en Çörüz over het bericht ‘In de zorg is fraude oké’

MPs Uitslag and Çörüz asked the government about a report that two care agencies allegedly defrauded 1 million euro, whether the Public Prosecution Service deprioritises care fraud, and how fraud detection and pgb fraud will be strengthened. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution of the reported cases, denied that care fraud lacks priority, listed the many detection bodies and the 2011 fraud figures, and promised a proposal on the extra pgb anti-fraud funding this autumn.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether criminal prosecution is indicated in this case.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of in dit geval strafrechtelijk optreden geïndiceerd is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Biskop en Uitslag over de werkinstructie indicatiestelling voor jeugd -GGZ 2012

Two CDA MPs asked why the 2012 youth mental health (jeugd-GGZ) assessment guideline was changed so that AWBZ care is only possible with full school exemption, and whether children living at home lose the combination of school and care. The state secretary answered that the guideline was corrected to 'full' exemption to match the CIZ indicator, that children can still receive personal care, nursing and individual support during school hours, and that exact numbers affected are not registered.
No, neither the CIZ nor youth care records which children use AWBZ or youth care during school hours, and in what way.
Nee, noch het CIZ, noch jeugdzorg registreren welke kinderen op welke wijze gebruikmaken van AWBZ- of jeugdzorg tijdens dagdelen onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Uitslag over het bericht ‘Bijna helft cafés nog niet rookvrij’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that nearly half of cafés were still not smoke-free, whether fines were ineffective, and whether enforcement could be intensified. The minister acknowledged compliance is insufficient, said additional measures such as more enforcement or higher fines are needed, but declined to decide now due to the cabinet's caretaker status.
As I indicated in the letter to Parliament of 18 June, I consider the current compliance level insufficient and believe additional measures are necessary to improve compliance.
Zoals ik in de Kamerbrief van 18 juni jl. heb aangegeven, vind ik het huidige naleefniveau onvoldoende en vind ik dat er aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om de naleving te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Uitslag over het bericht ‘Verbod dumpprijs bier levert 100 miljoen op’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a report that banning below-cost beer prices would raise 100 million euros, asking about the share of alcohol sold at such prices, whether cheap drink appeals to young and heavy drinkers, the Groot-Brittannië-style minimum pricing, and a total approach. The minister said she did not know the share, that price policy is one part of a broader approach, and that local mayors receive new powers under the Drank- en Horecawet to curb price promotions, preferring local tailoring over national minimum prices.
I prefer this form of local customisation over a national system of minimum prices.
Deze vorm van lokaal maatwerk prefereer ik boven een landelijk systeem met minimumprijzen.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verplicht logo alcohol en zwangerschap op fles» (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about a mandatory warning logo on alcohol bottles for pregnancy, including how many pregnant women keep drinking and whether the logo could be introduced. The minister answered that prevalence data are outdated, that prevention exists through websites, midwives and GP's, that she will explore introducing the logo through industry self-regulation and will report back.
I intend to explore whether it is possible to introduce the logo through self-regulation.
Ik ben voornemens te inventariseren of het mogelijk is het logo via zelfregulering in te voeren.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag (CDA) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Fokuswonen en het scheiden van wonen en zorg (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

MPs Uitslag and Voortman asked the state secretary about the status of a motion on separating housing and care, the letters from Fokuswonen on ADL cluster housing, and whether corporations should account for separating housing and care. The state secretary said cooperation with civil society has run since 2004, that the coupling of housing and ADL assistance serves to reserve adapted homes and secure 24-hour care, and that corporations already consider separating housing and care.
The minister of BZK recently announced that the cabinet wants to continue the action plans in the coming years.
De minister van BZK heeft recentelijk aangekondigd dat het kabinet de komende jaren een vervolg wil geven aan de actieplannen.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Jeugd koopt nog steeds makkelijk alcohol» (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

CDA MP Uitslag asked the health minister about a report that minors still easily buy alcohol, whether ID checks guarantee no sales, and how partners such as the supermarket and hospitality sectors are being pushed to enforce age limits. The minister pointed to the working group on alcohol and youth, the planned Drank- en Horecawet amendments (including closing supermarket alcohol departments after three violations in 12 months), and stressed parental responsibility.
In the proposal to amend the Drank- en Horecawet, for example, a provision has been included under which it will soon be prohibited for young people under 16 to have alcohol on them.
In het voorstel tot wijziging van de Drank- en Horecawet is bijvoorbeeld een bepaling opgenomen op grond waarvan het straks verboden is dat jongeren onder de 16 alcohol aanwezig hebben.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Kinderen krijgen eerste drank vooral thuis» (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

A CDA MP asks the health minister about reports that children get their first alcohol mainly at home, including 10-year-olds admitted to hospital drunk, and asks about parental responsibility and existing programmes. The minister agrees the situation is worrying, says sellers' associations have pledged more effort, promises a letter in early 2012 and a follow-up study on age-limit compliance, but gives no firm measures on parents.
Early 2012 I will, in consultation with the Minister of Security and Justice, send a letter to the House of Representatives on this subject.
Begin 2012 zal ik in overleg met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie een brief aan de Tweede Kamer sturen over dit onderwerp.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «ZZP’ers genegeerd door zorgkantoren» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary for health whether self-employed care workers (ZZP'ers) should be able to deliver AWBZ care in kind from 1 January 2012, and how many extramural AWBZ capacity places are needed to absorb the personal budget (pgb) change. The state secretary replied that zorgkantoren are not obliged to contract, that the legal obstacle has been removed, that extra funds and criteria are being prepared for contracting self-employed providers in the May 2012 round, and that EUR 100 million is available for the group losing pgb access.
I share your view that self-employed care providers should also be able to deliver AWBZ home care in kind, but this was not legally possible.
Ik deel uw mening dat ook zelfstandige zorgverleners AWBZ-thuiszorg via zorg in natura zouden moeten kunnen leveren, maar dit was wettelijk niet mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat 9% van de coffeeshops zich binnen een straal van 350 meter van ee

CDA MPs asked why 9% of coffeeshops reportedly sit within 350 metres of a school, given the coalition agreement's national 350-metre rule, and what the government will do. The minister disputes the 9% figure, says the rule will be implemented via OM policy criteria from 1 January 2014, and promises a letter to parliament on implementation.
I will send your House a letter in the short term on the state of affairs and the concrete implementation of the various measures the cabinet is preparing.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn een brief sturen over de stand van zaken en concretisering van de invoering van de diverse maatregelen die het kabinet in voorbereiding heeft.
Vragen van de leden Cörüz en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Utrecht zet plan voor legale wietteelt toch door» (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

CDA MPs Cörüz and Uitslag asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he was aware of reports that Utrecht was pressing ahead with a legal cannabis cultivation plan despite his stated opposition, and what concrete action he would take. The state secretary confirmed awareness, restated his opposition, said he had already informed the Utrecht mayor and chief prosecutor, and assumed the local tripartite would act in line with his position without committing to a specific step.
I also earlier informed the mayor of Utrecht and the chief public prosecutor of this position, as announced during the oral question hour of 15 March.
Ook stelde ik eerder, zoals aangekondigd tijdens het mondeling vragenuur van 15 maart jl., de burgemeester van Utrecht en de hoofdofficier van justitie van dit standpunt op de hoogte.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitspraken van de bestuursvoorzitter van de ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Uitslag asked the health minister whether the government can require a hospital to keep a maternity department open, and whether a hospital concentrating obstetric care breaches earlier parliamentary motions. The minister answered that the WTZi allows binding hospital admission conditions and, as a last resort, enforcement, but that no closure decision has been taken and the government will not impose keeping the department open where the 45-minute access norm is not at risk.
However, I will not impose on a hospital the obligation to keep a department open if the 45-minute access norm for acute care in the region is not at risk.
Ik zal een ziekenhuis echter niet opleggen om een afdeling open te houden als de bereikbaarheidsnorm voor acute zorg van 45 minuten voor de regio niet in het gedrang komt.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Jeugdzorg brengt afspraken niet in de praktijk» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a newspaper report that youth care providers do not implement agreements, which provinces check compliance, how provinces differ, and how municipalities will be equipped and supervised after decentralisation. The state secretary answers that providers bear primary responsibility, the Inspectorate can issue recommendations and escalate to provinces and then the national government, and that Rijk, VNG and IPO will agree arrangements and inform parliament later.
Responsibility for monitoring compliance with agreements between the inspectorate and youth care providers does not primarily lie with the provinces.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de controle op de naleving van gemaakte afspraken tussen de inspectie en jeugdzorgaanbieders ligt niet primair bij provincies.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over ondervoeding bij ouderen in verzorgingshuizen (in

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries about malnutrition among elderly care-home residents, a Maastricht study on fresh versus ready meals, and whether HACCP hygiene rules hinder home-style meals. The government said it did not know the study, saw nothing wrong nutritionally with ready meals, and that HACCP rules do not forbid home-style touches, with the code due for revision in 2014.
This study is not known to me. I would like to receive that report from you so that I can take note of it.
Dit onderzoek is mij niet bekend. Ik ontvang graag van u dat rapport zodat ik daar kennis van kan nemen.
Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de partijdrug GHB (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Uitslag and Çörüz asked the health and justice ministers about GHB, its links to school dropout and youth care, addiction treatment waiting lists, and whether it should be rescheduled. Minister Schippers answered that no causal link to dropout or youth care is known, acknowledged detox waiting lists in some regions with a protocol project underway, and committed to a new risk assessment of GHB by 1 July 2011 that could lead to rescheduling.
I have asked the CAM to complete this risk assessment by 1 July 2011.
Ik heb het CAM gevraagd deze risicobeoordeling voor 1 juli 2011 af te ronden.
Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de omstreden neuroloog J.S. (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

CDA MPs asked the minister how a neurologist removed from the Dutch BIG register could still work abroad via an agency, whether EU rules allow this, how loopholes can be closed, and what the inspectorate did. The minister answered that EU law leaves recognition of restrictions to the receiving state, that the register removal was voluntary so no disciplinary measure applied, and that the minister will raise a European list of restricted health professionals in Brussels.

I am certainly planning to raise again, on behalf of the Netherlands, at the upcoming visit to Brussels on 23 March 2011, whether a European list of health care professionals subject to a professional restriction measure can be created.

Ik ben zeker van plan om tijdens het aanstaande bezoek in Brussel op 23 maart 2011 wederom namens Nederland aan de orde te stellen of er een Europese lijst kan komen van beroepsbeoefenaren in de gezondheidszorg, aan wie een beroepsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over online alcoholhulp (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the health minister whether online alcohol help is effective for boys, why it is not effective for girls, and whether the minister will include the findings in the alcohol prevention policy paper and encourage insurers to offer online help. The minister confirms the study, suggests the boy-girl gap relates to heavier drinking among boys, plans to improve and re-evaluate the website, and says a structural solution for insurer reimbursement is being sought.
Following the study results, this website will be improved.
Naar aanleiding van de resultaten van het onderzoek zal deze website worden verbeterd.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag, Omtzigt en Smilde (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voornemens tot overheveling van de kraamafdeling van het ziekenhuis in Almelo naar Hengelo (ingezonde

CDA MPs asked the health minister about ZGT's plan to move the obstetric ward from Almelo to Hengelo, covering access, safety, capacity, home-birth rates, and the insurers' view. The minister answered that no final decision has been taken, that concentration is possible for quality reasons, that Hengelo's current capacity is insufficient, and that the IGZ can intervene if care quality is at risk.
Through the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) I am authorised and willing to intervene if the quality of care is at stake.
Via de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) ben ik bevoegd en bereid in te grijpen als de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zelfstandigen zonder persone

MPs Omtzigt and Uitslag asked the health, finance and VWS ministers whether the government still intends to allow self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) to be contracted, what concrete steps were taken, what the administrative and inspection consequences are, whether the 2012 promise will be kept, how four care-worker cases should be classified, and whether consultation with the sector will occur. The government answered that the aim remains, that preparatory activities are underway with a target of 1 January 2012 at the earliest, that employment classification is a matter for law and jurisprudence rather than politics, and that the Besluit zorgaanspraken AWBZ amendment will report on implementation.
It is not for politics to assess the facts and circumstances of an employment relationship.
Het is niet aan de politiek om de feiten en omstandigheden van een arbeidsrelatie te beoordelen.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over «onafhankelijke» vergelijkingssites voor zorgverzekeringen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister whether comparison site Independer gives preferential treatment to insurers paying commission, whether it discloses its funders, and how reliable information on health insurance comparison sites can be promoted, including via the NZa. The minister replied that Independer's conduct is supervised by the AFM, that the term 'independent' is not defined in law but will be reconsidered, that the NZa oversees insurers' information and has rated comparison sites since 2007, and that the market should otherwise be left to decide.
No, I leave this to the market.
Nee, dit laat ik over aan de markt.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een zwarte lijst van rookhoreca (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that smoking persists in about half of cafés and discos, the inspection capacity and fines issued, and why no bar has been prosecuted, requesting a directive for automatic criminal proceedings after repeated fines. The minister says enforcement will be intensified through administrative fines, reports the inspection figures, and declines criminal prosecution as too resource-intensive.
The nVWA will intensively enforce the smoking ban in hospitality where the smoking ban continues to apply.
De nVWA zal het rookverbod in de horeca waar het rookverbod blijft gelden intensief handhaven.
Vragen van de leden Venrooy-van Ark (VVD), Agema (PVV) en Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het pgb (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

MPs from VVD, PVV and CDA asked the state secretary about confusion over personal budgets (pgb) for care packages and whether the 2010 budget guarantee applies to people staying at home versus moving to a housing initiative. The state secretary answered that the motion will be implemented, the new tariff calculation is paused for existing budget holders until the spring memorandum, and the CVZ will be asked to clarify the distinction in the subsidy regulation.
The motion means for existing budget holders with a residence indication that the new tariff calculation method does not apply to them for the time being.
De motie betekent voor bestaande budgethouders met een verblijfsindicatie dat de nieuwe berekeningswijze van de pgb-tarieven vooralsnog niet op hen van toepassing is.
Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een boete voor Pinkpop (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MPs Van Hijum and Uitslag asked the minister why the Pinkpop festival received a 48,000 euro fine for using two foreign students as volunteers without a work permit, and whether the rules or inspection practice should change. The minister confirmed three fines of 16,000 euro each tied to illegal employment, explained that volunteer status requires a UWV declaration unavailable to profit-making organisations, and said the volunteer rules will be replaced by a work-permit requirement.
I intend to replace the volunteer declaration with a work permit.
Ik ben voornemens om de vrijwilligersverklaring te vervangen door een tewerkstellingsvergunning.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over medicatieveiligheid, agressie van patiënten en werkdruk van verpleegkundigen (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about medication safety, aggression against nurses and nursing workload, citing a consumer survey. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to ongoing IGZ research on night and weekend care, reports a fund for training and sector initiatives, but commits to no change in oversight or rules.
As soon as the research results are available, I will inform you.
Zo gauw de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn informeer ik u.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het in rekening brengen van kosten door zorginstellingen voor diensten die onder de Algemene Wet Bij

MPs Koppejan and Uitslag (CDA) asked the state secretary about care institutions charging for services covered by the AWBZ, citing a Zeeland study in which one institution charged EUR 39 for an extra shower. The state secretary said there were no large-scale unlawful charges, that unlawful co-payments for insured care are not permitted, that transparency duties apply, and that she would report on enforcement early the following year.
The study shows there is no question of serious or large-scale unlawful practices in Zeeland.
Het onderzoek laat zien dat er in Zeeland geen sprake is van forse of grootschalige onrechtmatigheden.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Oost-Europese concurrentie in de thuiszorg (ingezonden 5 oktober 2

CDA MPs asked whether Bulgarian and Romanian home-care workers are being employed through posted-worker constructions, whether this circumvents work permit rules and amounts to bogus self-employment, and how the Arbeidsinspectie controls this. The minister explained the notification route for cross-border service providers, said the Arbeidsinspectie checks for illegal employment and bogus self-employment, and announced a 2011 inspection project in the care sector.
In these cases it is being examined whether there is illegal employment through the use of bogus self-employed workers or through making labour available without the required work permit.

In deze zaken wordt onderzocht of er sprake is van illegale tewerkstelling door de inzet van schijnzelfstandigen of door het ter beschikking stellen van arbeid zonder de benodigde tewerkstellingsvergunning.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de AWBZ thuiszorg in het buitenland (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

MP Uitslag (CDA) asked the state secretary how AWBZ home care is delivered abroad, how quality is guaranteed, whether it is possible inside and outside the EU, whether abroad care should be limited given AWBZ cost growth, and what the annual spending is. The state secretary answered that AWBZ care abroad requires a licensed or national-system provider, that a bill to restrict it outside the EU/EEA is pending, and gave spending figures for 2007-2009.
The starting point of the bill is that AWBZ care must be obtained in the Netherlands, and not abroad.
Uitgangspunt van het wetsvoorstel is dat de AWBZ-zorg in Nederland verkregen moet worden, en niet in het buitenland.

Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de internationale streektaalconferentie «streektaal in de zorg» te Enschede (ingezonden 6 oktober 2010).

An MP asked about the status of applying Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages to Low Saxon and the outcome of ministerial review of that request. The minister stated Part III applies only to Frisian in Fryslân, and that review by line ministries is ongoing with the applicants to be informed once it concludes.
Once the outcome of the review is known, the applicants will be informed of their request.
Zodra de uitkomst van de toetsing bekend is, zullen de aanvragers over hun verzoek worden geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de toename van het aantal zwerfjongeren (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Youth and Family about reports that the number of street youths is rising due to the crisis, the gap between the Stichting Zwerfjongeren Nederland estimate and the Court of Audit figure, whether a single definition of street youths exists, and what the Handreiking has achieved. The ministers answered that signals are taken seriously, that a unified definition has been adopted by letter of 24 June 2010, that the handreiking was distributed but its effects were not studied, and referred to the progress report on shelter policy.

What is your reaction to the report that the Stichting Zwerfjongeren Nederland (SZN) assumes two to three times as many youths without a fixed residence as the Court of Audit, which at the end of 2008 assumed 6,000?

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about a report that the Council of State considers abolishing priority for status holders in social housing unconstitutional, and how housing for status holders will be ensured during the transition, including temporary housing and monitoring. The minister answered that the priority ban is part of a package of asylum measures, that a phased introduction and expanded housing options (SFT regulation, transition locations, co-living) are planned, that monitoring runs monthly, and that the questions were answered as far as possible.

The cabinet expects that the inflow-restricting measures, combined with the proposed phasing and the expansion of housing options and participation of status holders in society, will lead to a normalised position of permit holders relative to other housing seekers on the housing market.

Het kabinet verwacht dat de instroombeperkende maatregelen, in combinatie met de voorgestelde fasering en de inzet op het uitbreiden van huisvestingsopties en het laten meedoen van statushouders in de samenleving, zullen leiden tot een genormaliseerde positie van vergunninghouders ten opzichte van andere woningzoekenden op de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het item Ondanks woningnood blijft snel bouwen lastig in de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 2 augustus 2025

An MP asked the housing minister about the Valkenhorst housing project in Katwijk, delayed for about 20 years, including preparation times, nature protection, industrial building, the Council of State's handling of appeals, and what the state can do to speed it up. The minister answered all ten questions on substance, describing acceleration measures, the Wet Versterking regie volkshuisvesting, prioritised Council of State handling, and state-municipal preparations, without withholding information.
As a result, the Council of State has handled around 140 housing plans with priority since last year.
De Raad heeft daardoor sinds vorig jaar zo’n 140 woningbouwplannen met voorrang behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Peter de Groot over militair-civiele samenwerking op Lelystad Airport

MPs Ellian and Peter de Groot asked about military-civil cooperation at Lelystad Airport, including whether passenger flights are needed for F-35 stationing, the timing of decisions, permits and regional support. The government answered that a decision on commercial flights and fighter jet stationing is expected later this year, that preparations continue in parallel, and that it recognises regional support would fall away without passenger flights, while committing to further work and a letter.
The cabinet aims to take a definitive decision by the end of this year on fighter aircraft capacity and the opening of Lelystad Airport to commercial traffic.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om eind dit jaar een definitief besluit te nemen over jachtvliegtuigcapaciteit en de openstelling van Lelystad Airport voor handelsverkeer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Uitbreiding hoogspanningsnet jaren vertraagd in Gelderland, Utrecht en Flevopolder’

An MP asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reported multi-year delays to the high-voltage grid expansion in Gelderland, Utrecht and Flevopolder, including the Utrecht-Noord station, and what will be done to speed it up. The minister acknowledges the delay, attributes it to planning, land acquisition and technical problems, and points to a project approach, a shared action programme and a forthcoming update, but commits to no concrete new binding step beyond these existing measures.
In particular, the construction of the high-voltage station in Utrecht Noord is taking longer than planned.
Met name de bouw van het hoogspanningsstation in Utrecht Noord duurt langer dan gepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Brandweer ziet lastig te blussen branden door ontploffende zonnepanelen toenemen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that firefighters face hard-to-extinguish fires from exploding solar panels, and about installation quality, oversight, and training. The minister answered that the risk is small, relying on TNO/NIPV research, existing municipal and sector oversight, and a planned handbook on hazardous deposition, while declining to tighten oversight or create new protocols.

The limited number of incidents involving solar panels relative to the total number of installations in the Netherlands, and the initiatives by the sector, give me no reason to improve oversight of the quality of solar power installations.

Het beperkt aantal incidenten met zonnepanelen in verhouding tot het totale aantal installaties in Nederland en de initiatieven door de sector geeft voor mij geen aanleiding om het toezicht op de kwaliteit van zonnestroominstallaties te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Peter de Groot over probleemgevallen met certificeringen bij de ILT

MPs Buijsse and Peter de Groot asked the minister about inspection and certification delays for inland shipping after the accreditation suspension of the NBKB, including temporary certificates, the independence of new inspection bodies and capacity risks. The minister answered that the ILT outsources certification to accredited bodies, issued 690 temporary certificates, is working with new providers toward agreements once they meet independence requirements, and is working to expand inspection capacity.
The ILT is in close contact with both the inland shipping sector and the recognised classification societies and inspection bodies to keep a finger on the pulse and to intervene if necessary.
De ILT staat in nauw contact met zowel de binnenvaartsector als de erkende klassenbureaus en keuringsinstanties om vinger aan de pols te houden en in te grijpen als dit nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Duizenden Amsterdammers wacht erfpacht-strop: ’Van tientje naar 216 euro per maand’

An MP asked the housing minister whether she knows of a Telegraaf report on steep erfpacht (ground lease) increases in Amsterdam, whether she can accept the burden, whether she will talk to the municipality and the homeowners' foundation, and what remedies exist. The minister declined to judge the amounts or the municipality's conduct, pointed to the municipality's responsibility and existing dispute procedures, and mentioned a handbook for municipalities and a hardship scheme in Amsterdam.
As regards erfpacht, I have no legal basis on which to intervene in the ground rent agreed between the leaseholder and the ground lessor, including the procedure for setting a new rent.

Voor wat betreft erfpacht heb ik geen wettelijke basis waarop ik een ingreep in de tussen erfpachter en erfverpachter overeengekomen erfpachtcanon, inclusief de procedure om tot een nieuwe canon te komen, kan baseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Helft van het aantal asielopvangplekken in 2026 bezet door statushouders'

MPs Rajkowski and De Groot (VVD) asked about projected statushouder occupancy of asylum reception places, rising family reunification, and housing for status holders after the taakstelling is abolished. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the government is pursuing stricter family reunification rules, expects a two-status system to reduce reunification, and will bring forward measures and temporary housing plans with local authorities, without giving a firm timeline for permanent solutions.
The cabinet has included in its Coalition Agreement and Government Programme that family reunification will be further restricted.
Het kabinet heeft in haar Hoofdlijnenakkoord en in het Regeerprogramma opgenomen dat nareis verder wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het artikel 'Verzoek NAM om gas te winnen in Warffum afgewezen'

An MP asks the minister about SodM's decision not to tolerate gas extraction at Warffum after 31 December 2024, the criteria for postponing enforcement, the basis for weighing public unrest, and differences for residents if extraction were tolerated. The minister answers that SodM is responsible, describes the timeline for the definitive licence decision (earliest March 2025), and notes SodM's 2022 criteria while stating the decision lies with SodM.
The authority to make this decision lies entirely with SodM. I have no role in this and I respect the decision.
De bevoegdheid om deze beslissing te nemen ligt geheel bij SodM. Ik heb hierin geen rol en respecteer de beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Boos personeel, duurdere tickets en langere rijen: reiziger dreigt klos te worden van ingreep Schiphol bij beveiliging’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Schiphol's plan to reorganise security and ground-handling contracts, including reducing ground handlers from six to three, and its effects on passengers, prices, staff and foreign ownership. The minister answered that Schiphol is responsible for tendering, that the Marechaussee supervises security, that prices are not expected to rise, and that the ground-handling reduction aims to improve efficiency and working conditions, while answering several questions by pointing to Schiphol's assessments.
Schiphol is legally obliged to have security work carried out by security companies that meet strict requirements.
Schiphol is wettelijk verplicht beveiligingswerkzaamheden uit te laten voeren door beveiligingsbedrijven die aan strikte eisen voldoen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Extra krimp Schiphol dreigt na nieuwe berekeningen PVV-minister Madlener’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Schiphol flight cap may fall to about 466,000 movements, and how fleet renewal, tariffs, retaliation risks and EU notification were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet chose a phased -15% noise target giving about 478,000 movements from November 2025, that no extra shrinkage occurs, and that the EU Commission has been informed, though some questions are answered only in part or deferred.
The cabinet chooses to fill in the noise target in the first phase at -15%.
Het kabinet kiest daarbij voor een invulling van het geluidsdoel in de eerste fase naar –15%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Bezwaren van buurtbewoners en milieuclubs zorgen voor flinke rem op woningbouw’

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about reports that residents' and environmental objections are slowing housing construction, the number of completions, builder bankruptcies, investment in rental housing, and whether objection-related lawsuits could be restricted or penalised. The minister answers that delays should be minimised, outlines the bill on faster appeals to the Council of State and STOER regulatory review, and rejects penalising objectors because legal protection is a core element of the constitutional state.

Legal protection is after all an essential part of the democratic constitutional state, whereby an interested party can, if desired, have the government's weighing of interests reviewed by an independent judge.

Rechtsbescherming is immers een wezenlijk onderdeel van de democratische rechtsstaat, waarbij een belanghebbende de door de overheid gemaakte belangenafweging desgewenst door een onafhankelijke rechter kan laten toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Peter de Groot over de verdwijnende parkeerplaatsen in binnensteden

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether municipal removal of parking spaces in city centres such as Nijmegen harms car-dependent residents, whether a national overview of car-restrictive municipal measures exists, and whether national parking norms for new housing will be examined. The minister replied that parking and public space decisions are municipal responsibilities, that the ministry has no overview or oversight of parking norms, and that talks with municipalities on parking tariffs will be held.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Peter de Groot en Van Eijk (allen VVD) over het artikel 'Enorme ozb-verhoging Amsterdam ’Middenklasse maximaal uitgekleed”

VVD MPs asked the government about a steep property tax (OZB) increase proposed by Amsterdam, its effect on household costs, parking charges and erfpacht, and whether the government would engage Amsterdam to cap OZB rises. The minister declined to comment on Amsterdam's local tax decision as a matter for the municipal council, provided cost data, and committed to talks with municipalities on capping OZB increases.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, service levels and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ’Nieuwe huurregels kunnen studenten hun woning kosten’

An MP asks the Minister of Housing whether the Wet betaalbare huur is causing students sharing rented homes to lose their housing, and requests figures and remedies. The minister says there is no data on how many students were affected, that non-renewal may stem from interest rates, taxation or other rules rather than the Act, and that tenants with open-ended contracts are protected and can contact municipal reporting points.
No figures are available on the number of students whose expiring temporary contract was not renewed since the Wet betaalbare huur took effect on 1 July 2024.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal studenten waarvan een aflopend tijdelijk contract niet verlengd is sinds het ingaan van de Wet betaalbare huur per 1 juli 2024.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Peter de Groot en Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Brug Uitwellingerga niet meer bediend voor de scheepvaart»

MPs Peter de Groot and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Uitwellingerga bridge no longer being operated for shipping, its maintenance history, expected duration, economic effects and compensation. The minister answered all eleven questions on substance, stating the closure duration is not yet known, that the bridge deteriorated faster than expected, and that a general hardship compensation scheme applies while no separate scheme was opened.
Before the start of the sailing season (April 2025), Rijkswaterstaat will provide more clarity.
Voor de start van het vaarseizoen (april 2025) zal Rijkswaterstaat meer duidelijkheid te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht «Griekse vliegvakantie eindigt voor Nederlanders in nachtmerrie: «Paniek, huilen, flauwvallen en reanimatie»

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she views a reported incident in which Dutch passengers were held for a long time in a Greek aircraft cabin after a technical defect, and whether airlines should be obliged to provide acceptable cabin conditions, replacement aircraft, a maximum waiting time, or European rules. The minister acknowledged the situation was unpleasant, said no specific Dutch or EU rule sets a maximum time aboard, and promised talks with airlines and airports and raising the point at a future EU Transport Council.
Several regular conversations are taking place from the ministry with airlines and umbrella organisations.
Er lopen vanuit het ministerie verschillende reguliere gesprekken met luchtvaartmaatschappijen en koepelorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht Nieuwe water-eisen veroorzaken schok: ‘De bouw van zo’n half miljoen woningen staat op losse schroeven’

An MP asks the minister whether the national spatial framework map for climate-adaptive building (water and soil guiding housing sites), which shows many yellow or orange areas, will slow housing construction, cut plan capacity, raise costs and regulatory burden, and whether an impact study or a pause is needed. The minister rejects the claim that the framework blocks housing, states it has no legal status, gives approximate capacity figures, declines a separate impact study for now, and promises to keep the House informed of its further elaboration and possible legal anchoring.
For now I do not intend to commission a separate impact study.
Vooralsnog ben ik niet voornemens een aparte impactstudie te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Michon- Derkzen over het gebruik van drones door state operators

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Peter de Groot asked why Dutch state operators such as police and fire services may not fly drones beyond visual line of sight, whether EASA rules allow it, and how other countries and commercial operators are treated. The minister answered that state operations are under national rules for certain activities, that BVLOS flights are assessed on risk by the ILT, that a police pilot at Twente Airport is underway, and that a decision on the applicable rules for state operations is expected in Q3 2024.
A decision on the applicable rules for state operations in the Netherlands is expected to be taken in the third quarter of 2024.
Naar verwachting kan in het derde kwartaal van 2024 een besluit worden genomen over de toepasselijke regelgeving voor staatsoperaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot  over het bericht 'Pandeigenaren zijn vernielingen door krakers zat: ‘Met een moker heb ik de deur ingebeukt’'

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Interior ministers about squatting, including whether the 2022 anti-squatting law works, how many squats have been evacuated, whether squatting equals theft, and whether online calls to squat amount to incitement. The minister answered that the law's effectiveness will be assessed in an evaluation due in 2025, that existing criminal tools suffice for now, and that prosecution and courts decide on incitement.
Legislation works as a norm and provides a basis for action.
Wetgeving werkt normerend en biedt een grondslag om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Brekelmans en Erkens over het artikel ‘Russische schepen die bijtanken bij Vlissingen’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a NRC report that Russian-linked shadow fleet ships refuel and anchor at Everingen near Vlissingen, raising sanctions evasion, safety and enforcement concerns. The minister answered that anchorage fees are not charged, ship numbers have not risen sharply, no Russian-flagged ships anchored there, the ILT is still assessing accident risk, and enforcement and EU coordination are being strengthened, while rejecting a ban on anchoring and ruling out a mayoral enforcement role.
It is undesirable that ships can circumvent the European sanctions rules and may also pose a danger to people and the environment.
Het is onwenselijk dat schepen de Europese sanctieregels kunnen omzeilen en daarbij ook mogelijk een gevaar zijn voor mens en milieu.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over de ministeriële regeling tot aanwijzing van evacués uit het Midden-Oosten met een Nederlandse verblijfsstatus wier huisvesting bijzondere zorg van rijkswe

Two VVD MPs asked why a ministerial regulation was needed to house non-self-sufficient evacuees from the Middle East with Dutch status, how many are affected, and whether it will burden municipal housing quotas and social rental waiting lists. The minister answered that the rule covers a very small group of evacuees who cannot arrange housing themselves, that it is applied case by case, and that municipalities can count these cases toward their statushouder quota; he also agreed to answer urgently and to refrain from irreversible steps until parliament can debate it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Peter de Groot over de berichtgeving over vertraging op de A28 richting Utrecht vanwege slecht wegdek

MPs Veltman and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why road surface damage on the A28 near Nijkerk led to a sudden lane closure, how often the section was inspected, and what Rijkswaterstaat will do to reduce delays. The minister answered that inspections were weekly, the lane closure followed a deterioration after frost, and the section has been repaired and reopened, but gave only limited measures beyond advising peak-hour avoidance.
The affected road section has been repaired again and fully reopened to traffic.
Het betreffende wegvak is weer gerepareerd en volledig opengesteld voor het verkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Verhuurders zien het massaal niet meer zitten en zetten hun huis te koop’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the falling share of rental homes and landlords selling up, and the planned middle-segment rent regulation, are problematic for first-time buyers and movers. The minister answers that selling is not in itself a problem, that Kadaster data show no selling wave, and that the Wet Betaalbare Huur and new-build commitments keep investment attractive and middle-segment supply growing.
I will send the Affordable Rent bill to your House shortly, so that it can enter into force on 1 July 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur zal ik op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen, zodat de inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2024 kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Erkens, Bontenbal en Geurts over het bericht ‘Verduurzaming van koopwoningen komt bij gedeeld huizenbezit slecht van de grond’

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the minister why energy-efficiency upgrades in shared-ownership apartment buildings stall when homeowners' associations (VvE) do not approve them, and what could be done. The minister answered all eleven questions, citing a VvE acceleration agenda with lower decision thresholds, support tools, subsidies, and possible future legislation, while rejecting a rule giving VvEs unconditional competence over sustainability.
I do not intend to prepare legislation to that effect.
Ik ben niet voornemens wetgeving met die strekking te gaan voorbereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over ‘Gelderse woondeals dreigen te mislukken: niet door stikstof, maar door ambtenarentekort’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that Gelderland's housing deals risk failing due to a shortage of municipal civil servants, and about federal capacity support (flexpool funds) and the reduction of planning complexity. The Minister answered that the province estimates a shortage of 100 to 204 FTE, that the ministry supports housing projects through various teams and funds, and that a plan of action on faster procedures is underway, while stating that a commitment on the shortfall had been made to regional provinces without concrete new structural funding.
When drafting the housing deals, the housing construction target was used as the starting point.
Bij het opstellen van de woondeals is de volkshuisvestelijke bouwopgave als uitgangspunt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Zaltbommel zet alle nieuwe bouwplannen een jaar lang in de ijskast'

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Minister for Housing about reports that the municipality of Zaltbommel would freeze new building plans for a year because of the Environment and Planning Act, given the housing shortage. The minister replied that Zaltbommel still processes permit applications, only pausing new zoning plans, that a temporary stop of permit applications is legally impossible, and that he is working with the VNG and regional implementation supporters to prevent further delays.
For municipal councils there is room to temporarily refrain from adopting new zoning plans.
Voor gemeenteraden bestaat er wel ruimte om tijdelijk af te zien van het vaststellen van nieuwe bestemmingsplannen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over van het bericht ‘Woningcorporatiebazen privé actief als vastgoedbelegger, sector scherpt integriteitscode aan’

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that housing corporation executives also own private rental property, whether this constitutes a systemic integrity problem, whether the sector's integrity code is adequate, and whether the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) failed to detect it. The minister answered that the corporations' supervisory boards and the Aw are responsible for follow-up, that the sector's governance code is being tightened to a 'no, unless' principle, and that the Aw sees no reason yet for additional measures.
In the first instance it is up to the corporations themselves, and in particular their Supervisory Boards (RvC), to further investigate the cases raised in the Nieuwsuur research.

Het is in eerste instantie aan de corporaties zelf, en in het bijzonder de Raden van Commissarissen (RvC) om de casussen die in het onderzoek van Nieuwsuur naar voren zijn gebracht verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouwprojecten geschrapt, bedrijven zoeken manieren om door te bouwen’

An MP from the VVD asked the housing minister about reports that building projects were being cancelled, the expected drop in housing construction, the Startbouwimpuls subsidy, and how to secure locations and flexible housing in the face of local resistance. The minister answered in detail, pointing to regional housing deals, planning and versnellingstafels, the Startbouwimpuls scheme, and the upcoming Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting, while noting that overruling municipalities would be a lengthy legal process.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Martin botst met woonstichting om oneerlijke compensatie energiekosten: het is ons geld’

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked the minister why a housing corporation planned to credit the energy compensation for shared connections only in June 2024, and what tools exist to make landlords apply and pass on the subsidy. The minister answered that crediting must follow the existing payment periodicity and cost-allocation key, that landlords must apply and tenants can use the Huurcommissie or courts, and that a Kadaster application will show applications per connection.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Statushouders niet tevreden met flexwoning: weigeren contract te tekenen'

MPs De Groot and Brekelmans asked about refugees in Rijswijk refusing flex housing contracts, how many are in reception, and what measures the government will take. The minister says refusal is unacceptable, that under 3% of refusals led to eviction, that no ultimatum can be set since municipalities decide, and that a handreiking for municipalities is being prepared.
The cabinet is not in a position to set such an ultimatum in situations such as in Rijswijk.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om een dergelijk ultimatum te stellen in situaties zoals in Rijswijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Almere krijgt laatste kans om zelf woningen aan te wijzen voor statushouders'

An MP asked the Minister for Housing why Almere missed its quotas for housing status holders, whether the central government will help, and whether flexible housing can speed up placements. The minister explains the pressures on Almere's social housing stock, notes provincial supervision of quota compliance, lists support instruments and says he is already in contact with Almere and Flevoland on flexible housing.
The central government in principle has no role in individual conversations with municipalities.
Het Rijk heeft in principe geen rol in individuele gesprekken met gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over het bericht dat in de wijk van de toekomst plek is voor 10.000 mensen, 21.500 fietsen en 0 auto’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Housing ministers about a report on the car-free Merwede neighbourhood in Utrecht, including emergency access, affordable housing share, completion timing and use of national housing-impulse funds. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for local mobility, that the neighbourhood is not fully car-free (underground parking and car hubs are planned), that emergency access is ensured through consultation, that 55% of homes are affordable, and that construction timelines are monitored under funding agreements.
The choice of transport mode is made by the residents themselves. The municipality is responsible for local mobility policy.
De keuze voor de vervoerwijze maken de bewoners zelf. De gemeente is daarbij verantwoordelijk voor het lokale mobiliteitsbeleid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Woningbouw loopt vast: kopers én bouwers haken af’

An MP asks the housing minister about reports that housing construction is stalling, covering 2023 output forecasts, the effect of middle-segment rent regulation, institutional investors, inner-city versus outer-city building, and the role of housing corporations and regional housing deals. The minister gives substantive answers on most points, mostly describing policy plans and promising further information in the second quarter of 2023.
On the forecasts for 2023 and beyond, I will inform the House mid-year.
Over de prognoses over 2023 en verder, informeer ik uw Kamer medio dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Stijging erfpacht wekt wrevel: 'Waarom geen plafond, net als bij huren?'

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about media reports that Amsterdam's inflation-linked ground-lease (erfpacht) increases are steep, and whether national rules can cap them as with rents. The minister replied that erfpacht is a private-law instrument governed by contracts, that he has no legal basis to intervene, that the municipal executive (college) holds that power and can be questioned by the council, and that he will issue a guidance document on modern erfpacht conditions.
For erfpacht, unlike rental agreements, I have no legal basis on which to intervene in the inflation correction in the agreed erfpacht canon.
Voor wat betreft erfpacht heb ik, in tegenstelling tot bij huurovereenkomsten, geen wettelijke basis waarop ik een ingreep in de inflatiecorrectie in de overeengekomen erfpachtcanon kan baseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Peter de Groot over de serie 'Kraken doe je zo' van NPO 3

MPs Van Strien and Peter de Groot asked whether the NPO 3 series 'Kraken doe je zo', which explains how to squat, should be removed and investigated under the Mediawet, and asked about squatting enforcement and evictions. The government answered that it does not judge individual programme content, that the Commissariaat voor de Media supervises the Mediawet, that the courts decide on criminal matters, and that existing criminal and municipal tools suffice, while promising a later data update on squatter numbers.
It is not for the cabinet to judge the content of individual programmes or statements made in them.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma's of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Veel minder huurwoningen, verhuursite ziet verkoopgolf onder beleggers'

An MP from the VVD asked the housing minister about reports that landlords are selling rental homes, and whether this undermines the planned rent regulation for mid-range rentals. The minister answered that the data are not yet conclusive, that municipal tools and the Wet goed verhuurderschap are aimed at excesses rather than at investors, that sales may partly reflect the regulation, and that he will monitor the effects and send a study on the stacking of measures in the first quarter.
I expect to be able to send the study to your House in the first quarter.
Ik verwacht het onderzoek het eerste kwartaal naar uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Veluws vakantiepark wil woonwijk worden, maar dat mag niet: ‘Onbegrijpelijk’’

An MP asks the housing minister whether the government will push municipalities to allow a Veluwe holiday park, whose residents want it converted into a residential area, and asks how the motion on national steering of such transformations is being implemented. The minister answers that municipalities weigh transformation themselves, that an inventory of transformation potential is being done via provinces with a report promised by end of Q1, and that the expert team supports transformations only once a decision has been made.
I am following up on your motion by means of an inventory of the transformation potential of holiday parks.
Ik geef opvolging aan uw motie door middel van een inventarisatie naar het transformatiepotentieel van vakantieparken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Strolenberg over het eisen van foto’s van de binnenkant van huizen voor de vaststelling van de WOZ

Two VVD MPs asked whether municipalities may demand photos of the interior of homes for WOZ property valuation and whether this should stop. The minister answered that photos are an optional alternative to inspection visits, that the Waarderingskamer supervises municipalities' conduct and privacy safeguards apply, and that the practice will not be banned.
Moreover, my impression is that there is no question of demanding photos, but of offering an option of self-made photos.
Overigens is mijn indruk dat er geen sprake is van het eisen van foto’s, maar van het aanbieden van een optie van zelfgemaakte foto’s.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Paul over het bericht ‘Helft van scholen aan nieuwbouw of renovatie toe, extra geld onzeker’

MPs Peter de Groot and Paul (VVD) asked the ministers for Housing and for Primary and Secondary Education about a report that nearly half of Dutch schools need renovation or replacement and that extra funding is uncertain. Minister Wiersma answered that a national picture is still being compiled, that responsibilities are split across municipalities, school boards and the central government, and promised a funding task force reply and further information in Q1 2023.
In the first quarter of 2023 I will inform you of the outcomes of the research.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2023 zal ik u informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Bouw van duizenden woningen op pauzeknop door stijgende bouwkosten’

An MP asks the housing minister about reports that thousands of homes are being paused due to rising construction costs, and about the causes of delays, including long procedures, nitrogen issues and the mix of homes built. The minister acknowledges long project lead times and economic uncertainty, promises a plan to shorten procedures and a Plan van Aanpak, but declines to estimate how many projects will be affected.
I will send you a plan early next year to structurally shorten the lead time of housing projects.
Ik stuur u begin volgend jaar een plan om de doorlooptijd van woningbouwprojecten structureel te verkorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Minhas over het bericht 'Zonder ingrijpen valt nieuwbouw terug naar 45.000 woningen per jaar' in de Cobouw van 31 oktober 2022

Two VVD MPs asked the housing minister about a report that housebuilding could fall to 45,000 homes per year, and about delays in approved projects, subsidies, binnenstedelijk building, VINEX-style regional planning and the spatial planning instrument. The minister acknowledged the risks, pointed to the Programma Woningbouw, planned a plan of action on speeding up building, promised to revisit the Woningbouwimpuls subsidy rules in spring, and gave partial, policy-restating answers on figures and planning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Lening duurder bij kant-en-klare woning, starters dupe’

An MP asked the housing minister whether buyers of factory-built homes are excluded from the NHG mortgage guarantee, why certificates are hard to obtain, how factory construction will be scaled up, and about the status of a universal label and standard permit. The minister replied that factory-built homes can get NHG and the SVn starter loan via a certificate, acknowledged startups may struggle with solvency requirements, and pointed to forthcoming action plans and the postponed Wkb.
Factory-built homes can indeed be financed in combination with NHG and the SVn starter loan.
Fabrieksmatig gebouwde woningen kunnen wel degelijk gefinancierd worden in combinatie met NHG en de starterslening van SVn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Straatje erbij in elk dorp oplossing woningcrisis'

An MP from the VVD asked the housing minister whether he endorses the EIB's suggestion that building small extensions at the edges of every village could yield 300,000 homes, and about related plan capacity, flex-housing locations and the ladder for sustainable urbanisation. The minister answered that the proposal supports his policy, that plan capacity figures are not broken down to edge-of-municipality locations, that the ladder is under evaluation with results expected in Q1 2023, and that the questions were answered one by one.
Therefore, based on the provincial agreements, it is not possible to calculate the number of homes at the edges of municipalities.
Daarom is op basis van de provinciale afspraken geen doorrekening te maken van het aantal woningen aan randen van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Banken blokkeren meeverhuizen lage hypotheekrente'

MPs Heinen and Peter de Groot asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks block portability of low mortgage rates when homeowners move, causing higher monthly costs. The government answered that the portability rule and a 5% test rate for shorter fixed periods explain the situation, that rate-averaging is optional for lenders, and that it sees no need to mandate it, relying on consumer advice and a competitive market.
I consider it important that consumers who do not need or want the flexible conditions of a mortgage can still take out a suitable mortgage (with a correspondingly lower price).
Ik vind het belangrijk dat consumenten die de flexibele voorwaarden van een hypotheek niet nodig hebben of willen, toch een passende hypotheek (met bijbehorende lagere prijs) kunnen afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Investeringen in huurhuizen ingestort: 'Woningbouw stil door plannen Minister''

An MP asks the housing minister about a report that investment in rental housing construction collapsed, and whether planned rent regulation and uncertainty will deter private investors from building mid-rent homes. The minister answers that no hard data exists on investment amounts, that uncertainty is hurting the market, and that the contours of mid-rent regulation will be published in autumn with consultations and studies in the meantime.
No hard public data is available on how much is invested in rental housing.
Over hoeveel investeringen worden gedaan in huurwoningen zijn geen harde publieke gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Aanbod nieuwbouwwoningen terug bij niveau kredietcrisis’

An MP asks the housing minister why new-build homes offered and sold have stagnated, why permits fell, and what measures will speed up construction and match supply to housing demand. The minister attributes the slowdown to high build costs, long lead times, interest rises, nitrogen uncertainty and capacity shortages, and lists measures such as regional housing deals, funding tranches and a taskforce.
Yes, because of rising construction costs it has become harder to realise housing projects with sufficient affordable homes.
Ja, door de gestegen bouwkosten is het vooral moeilijker geworden om woningbouwprojecten met voldoende betaalbare woningen te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouwbranche trekt aan de bel: Gemeenten grootste horde bij aanpak wooncrisis'

An MP asked the housing minister about municipal bottlenecks in meeting the 100,000 homes-per-year target, including slow permit handling, capacity shortages and standardisation options. The minister outlined support instruments (flexpool, expert team, financing) and promised further letters on speeding up procedures, while stating that no Woningbouwimpuls money was spent on extra permit staff.
I expect to be able to inform your House further on this in the autumn.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hier in het najaar nader over te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Bouw flexhuizen schiet niet op, zegt Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving’

An MP asked the housing minister how the slow construction of flexible homes, flagged by the PBL, squares with new funding, and what would give them a better image and clearer rules. The minister acknowledges the PBL's points, raises the flexible-home targets, and promises a guarantee scheme and a national quality framework, though many details are left for later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Utrechtse sociale huurwoningen zes weken lang met voorrang naar statushouders’

An MP asked the housing minister whether Utrecht's six-week priority allocation of social rental homes to status holders, and its effect on other waiting groups and the 30 percent social housing target, is acceptable. The minister defended the temporary measure as a response to the national call to house status holders quickly, said it was limited to six weeks with alternatives kept for urgent cases, and pointed to flex housing and the regional programming as the way to increase supply.
The national government asked municipalities to quickly house status holders and to give priority to their legal task in this regard.
Het Rijk heeft gemeenten verzocht om versneld statushouders te huisvesten en hun wettelijke taak hierin met voorrang op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Streven versnelling extra woningen uit zicht: huizenbouw loopt juist terug’

An MP asked the housing minister how a report of falling building permits fits the goal of building more homes, whether the drop is structural, and what steps will be taken. The minister said the permit figures are only one imperfect indicator, that it is too early to call a decline, that permit trends vary by municipality, and that a national Versnellingstafel will be set up to spot and address bottlenecks.
It is too early to conclude that home construction is declining.
Het is te vroeg om te kunnen constateren dat de huizenbouw terugloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Verstrekkend stikstofvonnis zet bouwvergunningen voor meer dan 30 duizend woningen op losse schroeven’

Two VVD MPs asked the housing and nitrogen ministers how a court ruling blocking nitrogen permits for about 30,000 homes affects housing permits, who is responsible for mitigation measures, and how natuurinclusief building could help. The minister answered that finalized permits remain in force, that nitrogen space from the speed-reduction measure is no longer allocated, that responsibility for national mitigation lies with the Rijk while initiators handle project-level measures, and that a binding nature-inclusive construction scheme is too early to develop.
No, permits that have become irrevocable remain in force.
Nee, onherroepelijk geworden vergunningen blijven in stand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouwend Nederland: trage betalingen Rijk kosten bouwsector miljarden'

MPs Rahimi and De Groot asked the Minister about reports that the central government pays construction SMEs only after about 75 days, far beyond the legal 30-day term, and what this means for project delays and supplier exits. The Minister answered that the 75 days includes time before invoices are submitted, that over 95% of central government invoices are paid within 30 days, and that no link to project delays or supplier withdrawal has been found, while promising to inventory payment bottlenecks and inform the House before summer.

That is why I have committed to inventorying, with the relevant ministers of Finance, Interior and Kingdom Relations, and Infrastructure and Water Management, where problems arise in the process regarding late payment and how we can speed this up.

Daarom heb ik toegezegd om met de betrokken bewindspersonen van Financiën, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Infrastructuur en Waterstaat te inventariseren waar in het proces problemen ontstaan met betrekking tot late betaling en hoe we dat kunnen versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Kabinet overweegt met dwang bouwlocaties aan te wijzen’

An MP asked whether the minister will use coercive designation of building locations if local and provincial authorities stall housing construction, and about criteria, infrastructure, affordability and transformation. The minister answered that local and provincial authorities are primarily responsible, that coercive designation would only be considered after failed negotiation, and set out existing plans on housing targets, accessibility funding and flexible housing.
Should a deadlock arise over an important building location, it may sometimes be necessary to make a decision.
Mocht het zijn dat er een impasse ontstaat over een belangrijke bouwlocatie dan kan het soms nodig zijn om een knoop door te hakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Gekkenhuis op markt voor zonnepanelen en warmtepompen’

MPs Erkens and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about a news report on a surge in demand and long waiting times for solar panels and heat pumps, covering possible government actions, installer shortages, suitability of heat pumps and insulation of rented homes. Minister Jetten answered that the demand increase reflects higher energy prices, that supply and installer capacity issues are largely for the market and labour policy, and that the government is pursuing a programmatic insulation approach with housing associations and landlords.
The shortage is a consequence of a global market disruption caused by strong fluctuations in demand and in the transport chain.
