Het tekort is een gevolg van een wereldwijde verstoring van de markt, veroorzaakt door sterke schommelingen in de vraag en in de transportketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort, Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over de uitzending van EenVandaag over mogelijke tekorten in industriezand en grind

VVD MPs asked the government whether extraction permits for sand and gravel are expiring, whether shortages will arise, and how supply will meet the infrastructure and housing ambitions. The minister answered that a monitoring system and a national demand forecast are being developed, that circularity measures are underway, and that talks with provinces and the sector are ongoing.
At present, the need for sand and gravel is being mapped in cooperation with knowledge institutes and industry organisations. The House will be informed of the results before the end of the year.

Op dit moment wordt – in samenwerking met kennisinstituten en brancheorganisaties – de behoefte aan zand en grind in beeld gebracht. De Kamer zal voor het eind van het jaar over het resultaat worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Vewin: drinkwater voor 900.000 nieuwe woningen niet zeker’

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot asked the ministers about reports that drinking water supply for 900,000 new homes to 2030 is uncertain, and about the state of water sources, coordination with the housing sector, and planned measures. The minister answers that supply is secured for at least 10 years through supply plans supervised by the ILT, and points to ongoing studies, strategic reserves, a 800 million euro Deltaplan and a planned water-saving exploration, but gives no concrete figures on new sources.
RIVM is working on a supplementary report on the availability of sources, to be completed by mid-2022.
RIVM werkt aan een aanvullend rapport over de beschikbaarheid van bronnen, dat medio 2022 zal worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Van der Woude over het bericht ‘student zoekt studentenwoning, internationale investeerders net zo goed’

MPs De Groot and Van der Woude asked about rising competition for student housing from international students and investors, and about the link to the housing shortage, sizes of rooms, and loneliness. The minister acknowledged a link but cited multiple causes, described existing monitoring, linked shared-room regulation to the housing points system, and promised a report and an additional monitoring module.
I consider it important to get a better picture of this from the perspective of student housing.
Ik vind het belangrijk om dit vanuit studentenhuisvesting beter in beeld te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Warmtepomp of zonnepanelen verplicht bij grote verbouwing door nieuwe EU-regels' van 10 februari jl.

An MP asked why EU rules require renewable energy measures such as heat pumps or solar panels during major renovations of owner-occupied homes, whether Belgium omits this rule, and how cost and affordability are safeguarded. The minister answered that EU directive REDII must be implemented, explained the differing Belgian implementation and the Commission's infringement procedure, noted the economic-feasibility exemption with a ten-year payback criterion, and said a programme on support for homeowners will follow.
As a member state of the European Union, the Netherlands is obliged to ensure compliance with European law.
Nederland is als lidstaat van de Europese Unie verplicht de nakoming van het Europees recht te verzekeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Aanpak woningnood op drijfzand: planning 1,2 miljoen huizen is wensdenken'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Housing about reports that housing plan capacity is unreliable, including inconsistent counting across provinces, the treatment of demolitions, overprogramming of 30%, and the need for task forces and better data. The Minister acknowledges monitoring problems, promises unified definitions and a more accurate demolition estimate in June, and points to ongoing programme and expert support for municipalities.
I have now made agreements with the other governments on the use of unambiguous definitions for, among other things, hard and soft plan capacity and plan type.
Ik heb inmiddels met de medeoverheden afspraken gemaakt over het gebruik van eenduidige definities voor o.a. harde en zachte plancapaciteit en plantype
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Peter de Groot en Minhas over woningbouw binnen bestaand stedelijk gebied en de gevolgen voor sportvoorzieningen

MPs from the VVD asked the housing and health ministers whether housing construction in dense cities is squeezing sports facilities, and how municipalities plan space for sport. The minister answered that data on squeezed sports space is unavailable, that no standard norms exist, that he will not mandate a sports paragraph in spatial plans, and that the government will compile examples of multifunctional sports facilities.
A specific obligation regarding including a sports paragraph does not seem desirable given municipalities' own responsibility in this, and in my view is also not necessary.
Een specifieke verplichting m.b.t. het opnemen van een sportparagraaf lijkt niet wenselijk gezien de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten in deze, en is m.i. ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouw van zeker tienduizend huizen bedreigd door geldtekort'

An MP asked the housing minister whether a funding shortfall threatens the Transformation Facility managed by SVN, which could stall the construction or conversion of 10,000 to 12,000 homes, and what options exist to keep it funded. The minister answered that repayments are on schedule and that demand is higher than expected, that the Rijk has allocated 58 million euros of which 43 million is committed, and that a broader plan for the coming years is being explored.
As part of the housing construction programme, I will explore what is needed to keep the Transformation Facility running well in the coming years.
Ik ga in het kader van het woningbouwprogramma verkennen wat nodig is om de Transformatiefaciliteit ook de komende jaren goed te laten draaien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de uitspraak 201908401/1/R1 van de Raad van State over het verstrekken van omgevingsvergunningen door de gemeente Zutphen aan IJsselwind bv en het waterschap

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the Council of State ruling that annulled the zoning plan and permits for the IJsselwind wind park and the consequences of the related Delfzijl Zuid ruling for general wind turbine rules, municipal and provincial powers, and RES planning. The minister answered that local authorities may set their own environmental norms pending a new plan-MER, that wind projects may be delayed but the 2030 target is expected to be met, and that regional dialogue will address legitimacy and cross-border effects.
The State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management has set in motion the process for carrying out a plan environmental impact assessment for the general environmental rules.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW heeft het proces om een plan-milieueffectrapportage uit te voeren voor de algemene milieuregels in gang gezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Peter de Groot en Leijten over de invloed van de windlobby op de rapporten van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) over de gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

MPs Erkens, Peter de Groot and Leijten asked whether RIVM omitted the wind-lobby influence on its reports on health effects of wind turbines, and how independent future research can be ensured. The minister said the RIVM's authority is not in question, that funding source alone should not exclude studies, and that RIVM is exploring additional health research and a study on setback distances.
I do not think it is for me or the cabinet to respond to this discussion, which belongs in the scientific domain.
Ik vind het niet aan mij of het kabinet om te reageren op deze discussie, die in het wetenschappelijk domein thuishoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Zorgen en boosheid na plotseling afblazen contractondertekening voor verbreden A2, Rijkswaterstaat meldt miljoenentekort’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sudden cancellation of contract signing for widening the A2 near Vonderen-Kerensheide due to a cost shortfall, and about its timing, size, effect on planning and the nitrogen issue. The minister acknowledged the late and poorly handled communication, apologised, but withheld the exact size of the shortfall pending validation and said the planning remains on track with a tender in spring 2022.
The outcome of the validation and the follow-up will be communicated to you through the regular channels under the MIRT.
Over de uitkomst van de validatie en het vervolg wordt u via de reguliere kanalen volgens het MIRT geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de haalbaarheidsstudie ‘klimaatneutrale paden TSN IJmuiden’ van Roland Berger

Two VVD MPs asked the cabinet about the Roland Berger feasibility study on climate-neutral routes for Tata Steel IJmuiden, including state financial support, the size of the subsidy need, infrastructure, permit acceleration and inter-government coordination. The minister said the study is an important next step, that financial needs and support options are not yet known and depend on Tata Steel's own business case, that no funds are yet reserved, and that a new cabinet would decide, while permit speed-up and coordination are being explored without an interdepartmental taskforce.
That also cannot be expected at this stage of the process.
Dat kan in deze fase van het proces ook nog niet verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over cumulatie van uitstoot en overlast in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked about cumulative emissions and nuisance in cross-border South Limburg, including the planned Lixhe biomass plant in Belgium, and whether Dutch municipalities and the province can be stakeholders in the Belgian permit process. The State Secretary answered that Dutch bodies were not yet formally recognised as stakeholders, that the matter is for the bordering authorities to resolve, and that the government will raise concerns diplomatically and with Dutch local authorities.

I believe the province of Limburg and the Dutch municipalities concerned should be able to formally raise these objections in the procedure and that they should be weighed in assessing the application.

Ik vind dat de provincie Limburg en de betrokken Nederlandse gemeenten deze bezwaren formeel moeten kunnen inbrengen in de procedure en dat deze ook meegewogen moeten worden bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over de berichten 'Brug over Prinses Margrietkanaal in Kootstertille onveilig: bussen en vrachtverkeer moeten omrijden' en 'Wijkertunnel (A9) op slot voor vrachtverkeer'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sudden weight restriction on the Kootstertille bridge and the closure of the Wijkertunnel to freight, including why the bridge was deemed unsafe earlier than expected and why traffic was closed without a set end date. The minister answered that inspections required a load restriction for safety, that the tunnel closure followed defective ventilators with no available replacement parts, and that the bridge replacement was postponed due to budget shortfalls.
To minimise the risk of fire in the tunnel and the associated safety risks, it was decided to temporarily prohibit lorries and coaches from the Wijkertunnel.
Om brand in de tunnel en daarmee veiligheidsrisico's tot een minimum te beperken is besloten om tijdelijk geen vrachtwagens en touringcars toe te staan in de Wijkertunnel.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht 'Nederlands initiatief in Glasgow: nieuwe vrachtauto's uitstootvrij in 2040'

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked the State Secretary about a news report on the Glasgow zero-emission truck initiative, questioning why a 2040 target was not previously shared, its consistency with the Klimaatakkoord, competitiveness and leakage, and the instruments needed. The State Secretary answered that the MoU is not a new target but supports existing 2050 mobility goals, listed signatories, and described subsidies, charging infrastructure and toll-revenue funding under consideration.
The Global MoU does not involve legally binding agreements that countries must comply with.
Het Global MoU betreft geen juridisch bindende afspraken waaraan landen moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Rudmer Heerema en Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: riolen en bruggen kwetsbaar voor hackers’ in het Financieel Dagblad op 14 oktober 2021

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that sewer, bridge and lock control systems are vulnerable to hackers, including a case of a good-faith hacker taking over a city sewer system and delayed patching, and what the government has done on patching, procurement, threat sharing and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister acknowledges the vulnerabilities, reports no successful attacks or Wbni notifications at Rijkswaterstaat or ProRail in the past two years, and describes existing programmes, regulation and ongoing cooperation, while stating no specific case could be confirmed.
Inquiries show no further information is available about a case of a good-faith hacker who was able to take over the sewer system of a large municipality.
Uit navraag blijkt geen nadere informatie beschikbaar over een casus van een goedwillende hacker die het rioleringssysteem van een grote gemeente kon overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over de brief ‘Beperkingen op de Haringvlietbrug voor het wegverkeer en de scheepvaart’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Haringvlietbridge restrictions had been tested for safety and lifespan, what monitoring applies, what alternatives and market involvement were considered, and whether budget shortfalls for maintenance are a factor. The minister answered that speed was cut to 50 km/h to reduce vibrations, weekly inspections will monitor the bridge, no solution yet exists for the clamps, and the wider maintenance budget shortfall will likely cause similar situations at other bridges.
The monitoring will take place through weekly inspections of the bridge.
De monitoring zal door wekelijkse inspecties van de brug plaatsvinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Geurts over het NOS bericht ‘Intern onderzoek Rijkswaterstaat: files sluiting Haringvlietbrug veel langer dan gedacht’ en de bijbehorende kamerbrieven ‘Extra reistijd Har

MPs De Groot and Geurts asked why the Haringvlietbrug closure causes longer delays than expected, what measures will reduce them, and why the two-lane variant and the bridge repair are not faster. The minister explains that the delay estimate was revised upward, that traffic management and enforcement were arranged quickly, and that the bridge replacement is already accelerated, while acknowledging no quick fix for the clamps exists yet.
Rijkswaterstaat aims to involve the region and stakeholders in a timely manner, depending on the nature of the works, the nuisance and urgency.
Rijkswaterstaat zet erop in om de regio en belanghebbenden al naar gelang de aard van de werkzaamheden, de hinder en urgentie steeds en tijdig te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Gemeenten slaan alarm om volledige afsluiting A12: Ernstige gevolgen voor verkeer'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Rijkswaterstaat chose a nine-day full closure of the A12 motorway, its traffic effects, consultation with municipalities, and compensation for businesses. The minister answered in detail on the rationale, consultation with the region and stakeholders, alternatives considered, and commitments to inform parliament, while stating that the 'Staat van de Infrastructuur' will show planned works per region.
For this reason, the State of the Infrastructure, which the House will receive in December, will make clearer which large-scale works are planned per region.
Daarom zal bij de Staat van de Infrastructuur, die uw Kamer in december a.s. zal ontvangen, beter inzichtelijk worden gemaakt welke grootschalige werkzaamheden per regio gepland staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Verdachte chauffeur dodelijk ongeval Waalhaven reed eerder motoragent en fietsster aan’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Groot asked about reports that the suspect driver in a fatal Waalhaven crash had earlier struck a police motorcycle officer and a cyclist, and about prosecution, traffic-law classification, recidivism and police motorcycle safety. The Minister said the criminal investigation is ongoing and gave limited details, noting one earlier conviction, one case dismissed, and that police motorcycle training and evaluation are in place.
As there is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter in particular.
Aangezien er sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan ik over deze kwestie in het bijzonder geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Automobilist betaalt te veel bij laadpaal'

Peter de Groot (VVD) asked whether fast chargers deliver less energy than paid for due to conversion losses, whether this erodes trust in electric charging, and what solutions exist. The State Secretary answered that consumers pay only for energy actually delivered, losses under 1% are moderate, price transparency is already regulated and largely in order, and EV charging is cheaper than fuel, pointing to existing Klimaatakkoord and Nationale Agenda Laadinfrastructuur measures.
The losses of on average less than 1% between charging point and car cited by the operators can be considered small and are difficult to quantify given the multitude of systems in use.

De door de exploitanten genoemde verliezen van gemiddeld genomen minder dan 1% tussen laadpunt en auto zijn gering te noemen en laten zich moeilijk kwantificeren door de veelheid aan systemen die in gebruik zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Alarm Bouwend Nederland: Belgische gatenweg dreigt'

MPs Peter de Groot and Michon-Derkzen asked the minister about reports of a looming infrastructure maintenance shortfall, bridge and lock disruptions, and municipal budget cuts. The minister disputed the amounts cited, explained budget shifts and maintenance plans, described the status of closures and storms-related outages, and pointed to the next cabinet for longer-term funding decisions.
I do not recognise the amounts mentioned.
De genoemde bedragen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het rapport ‘Energy Transition Monitor - Critical Metals' van ABN AMRO

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked about an ABN AMRO report warning that electrifying road transport alone will not solve critical-metal dependence, and about the government's plans on scarcity, circularity, hydrogen and biofuels. The state secretary answered that the government supports a mix of electric, hydrogen and biofuel paths, relies on recycling, the European Critical Raw Materials Action Plan and ERMA, and will use an efficiency-based allocation approach rather than a formal allocation framework.
I am aware that there may be scarcity of sustainable fuels. That is why efforts are directed at using the various fuels as efficiently as possible.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat er schaarste kan zijn aan duurzame brandstoffen. Daarom wordt er ingezet op een zo efficiënt mogelijke inzet van de verschillende brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht dat er meer fietsers zijn omgekomen in het coronajaar

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why cyclist fatalities rose in 2020 despite less traffic, and what measures will address e-bike and older-cyclist risks. The minister answered that no single explanation exists yet, pointed to SWOV analyses due at year's end, and described road-safety funding, protocols and older-cyclist programmes, promising to involve local authorities in a new national road-safety action plan.
A single unambiguous explanation cannot yet be given.
Een eenduidige verklaring is nu nog niet te geven.

m: Motie van het lid Popken over het openhouden van de Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne
Asks the government to keep the Van Braam Houckgeest barracks open for the Marine Corps instead of moving it to Vlissingen.
requests the government to keep the Van Braam Houckgeest barracks open for housing the Marine Corps
verzoekt de regering, de Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne open te houden ten behoeve van de huisvesting van het Korps Mariniers
Motie van het lid Popken c.s. over de grenzen sluiten voor asielzoekers en immigranten uit islamitische landen
Asks the government to close the Dutch borders to asylum seekers and all immigrants from Islamic countries.
requests the government to close the Dutch borders to asylum seekers and all immigrants from Islamic countries
verzoekt de regering, de Nederlandse grenzen te sluiten voor asielzoekers en alle immigranten uit islamitische landen
Motie van het lid Popken over de landmacht vaker inzetten tegen drugsbendes
Asks the government to deploy the army more often against drug gangs in the Netherlands and to inform the Chamber about it.
requests the government to deploy the army more often, where and when possible, against drug gangs in the Netherlands and to inform the Chamber about it
verzoekt de regering, de landmacht vaker in te zetten – waar en wanneer mogelijk – tegen drugsbendes in Nederland en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s. over een blijk van waardering voor het Defensiepersoneel
Asks the government, if no collective labour agreement for defence staff is reached this year, to bring a supplementary proposal before the new year showing appreciation for defence personnel.
requests the government, if a working conditions agreement is not reached this year, to come with an additional proposal before the new year
verzoekt de regering, indien het dit jaar niet tot een arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord komt, nog voor de jaarwisseling met een aanvullend voorstel te komen
Motie van het lid Popken over cyber en space duidelijk specificeren in Defensiebegroting
Asks the government to specify cyber and space activities, objectives and funding clearly in the defence budget from next year.
from next year to clearly specify and elaborate cyber and space in the Defence budget
vanaf volgend jaar in de Defensiebegroting cyber en space duidelijk te specificeren en uit te werken
Motie van de leden Agema en Popken over de Regeling faciliteiten Turkse dienstplicht defensie-ambtenaren
Asks the government to immediately end the scheme giving defence staff with Turkish nationality financial facilities to buy out Turkish military service.
requests the government to immediately end the Regulation on facilities for Turkish military service of defence officials
verzoekt de regering, per direct een einde te maken aan de Regeling faciliteiten Turkse dienstplicht defensie-ambtenaren
Motie van de leden Agema en Popken over sluiten van de grenzen voor alle asielzoekers én alle migranten uit islamitische landen
Asks the government to close the borders to all asylum seekers and all migrants from Islamic countries and deploy the military police to guard them.
requests the government to close the borders to all asylum seekers and all migrants from Islamic countries
verzoekt de regering, de grenzen te sluiten voor alle asielzoekers én alle migranten uit islamitische landen
Motie van de leden Agema en Popken over ontslaan van Defensiepersoneel met een dubbele nationaliteit
Asks the government to dismiss Defence personnel holding dual nationality and stop hiring new dual nationals, citing divided loyalty and infiltration risk.
requests the government to dismiss Defence personnel with dual nationality and no longer appoint new Defence personnel with dual nationality
verzoekt de regering, Defensiepersoneel met een dubbele nationaliteit te ontslaan en geen nieuw Defensiepersoneel meer aan te stellen met een dubbele nationaliteit
Motie van het lid Karabulut c.s. over voldoende middelen voor de externe onderzoekscommissie
Asks the government to give the external investigation commission on sexual intimidation in the armed forces enough resources and powers to examine practice within operational units.
requests the government to give the commission doing this independent external investigation sufficient resources and means to also examine practice within the operational units
verzoekt de regering de commissie die dit onafhankelijk en extern onderzoek gaat doen, voldoende middelen en mogelijkheden te geven om ook de praktijk mede bij de operationele eenheden te onderzoeken
Motie van het lid Popken c.s. over psychologische hulp voor de slachtoffers van de incidenten in Schaarsbergen
Asks the government to offer psychological help and personal support to victims of the Schaarsbergen incidents for as long as they need it.
requests the government to offer the victims of the Schaarsbergen incidents psychological help and personal guidance
verzoekt de regering, de slachtoffers van de incidenten in Schaarsbergen psychologische hulp en persoonlijke begeleiding aan te bieden
Motie van het lid Popken over volledige dekking van het AOW-gat voor het Defensiepersoneel
Asks the government to fully compensate the AOW gap for defence personnel and civilians at 100%, funded from the state budget rather than the labour conditions budget.
requests the government to come up with a solution to fully compensate the AOW gap at 100%
verzoekt de regering ... met een oplossing te komen om het AOW-gat volledig voor de volle 100% te compenseren
Motie van het lid Popken over een regeling voor functioneel leeftijdsontslag voor DBBO-defensiepersoneel
Asks the government to extend the same functional age-dismissal arrangement to DBBO defence personnel as applies to other defence staff.
requests the government to ensure that the same arrangement on functional age dismissal applies to DBBO defence personnel
verzoekt de regering, ervoor zorg te dragen dat voor DBBO-Defensie personeel eenzelfde regeling omtrent het functioneel leeftijdsontslag zal gelden
Motie van de leden De Graaf en Popken over screening van alle personen die toegang hebben tot TBB 1 tot en met 4
Motion asking the government to screen all persons with access to defence sites TBB 1 to 4 and all civil servants with security roles, using the MIVD if needed.
requests the government to ensure screening of all persons who have access to TBB 1 through 4
verzoekt de regering, zorg te dragen voor screening van alle personen die toegang hebben tot TBB 1 tot en met 4
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Markuszower over een inspectie door het marineschip Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

MPs De Roon, Popken and Markuszower asked whether the frigate De Ruyter carried out a ship inspection over a possible sanctions violation, which vessel and flag were involved, what evidence existed, and with whom findings were shared. The government confirmed the inspection, said details could not be disclosed because a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and shared findings only with that service, and declined to give operational details of the ship's operations.
As you know, as Minister of Justice and Security I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Zoals bij u bekend doe ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over de waarnemingen van De Zr. Ms. De Ruyter van het incident in de Golf van Oman

MPs De Roon and Popken asked what the Dutch frigate De Ruyter observed of the reported Iranian seizure of the chemical tanker SC Taipei, whether Iran was involved and whether Iran's provocations should be condemned. The Defence Minister declined to share observations for operational reasons, said no cargo was seized as far as the government knows, and stated the government's commitment to de-escalation through the EMASoH mission.
No statements can be made about the observations of Zr. Ms. De Ruyter for operational reasons.
Over de waarnemingen van De Zr. Ms. De Ruyter kunnen om operationele redenen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de ICT vernieuwing bij Defensie compleet mislukt is

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Defence why the Kamer has not yet been informed about the GrIT ICT renewal, what the consequences of delay or cancellation are, whether underlying documents will be published, and how many misconduct incidents must occur before order is restored. The State Secretary replies that a closed technical briefing took place on 12 March, that financial details are withheld for commercial confidentiality during an ongoing tender, that the government rejects the characterisation of the situation, and that a reorganisation is underway.
I am not disclosing any financial details, because of the confidentiality of this information.
Ik breng hierbij geen financiële gegevens naar buiten, vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de JSF wederom teleurstelt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that the F-35's gun has accuracy flaws, including the financial and safety consequences and whether costs could be recovered from the manufacturer, and asked for a full list of defects and costs. The State Secretary confirmed the GAO-reported gun deficiency, said mitigation measures reduce the safety risk to acceptable levels, and refused to publish the full list of defects because it is classified.
An overview as requested cannot be made public.
Een overzicht zoals gevraagd kan niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Defensie 1800 mariniers wil huisvesten in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether the reported plan to house 1800 marines in Apeldoorn is accurate, requested all underlying documents, and asked that the Doorn barracks be kept open. The State Secretary answered that the matter is set out in a letter to the House of 14 February, without giving substance in this answer.
I refer you for this to my letter 'proposed decisions regarding the relocation of the Marine Corps and compensation Zeeland' which was sent to your House on 14 February.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn brief «voorgenomen besluiten inzake verhuizing Korps Mariniers en compensatie Zeeland» die op 14 februari aan uw Kamer is verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over een bijna-kamikazeactie met een helikopter

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister and State Secretary about a reported near-collision of a military helicopter with a riding stable during an exercise, and whether Defence would apologise and respond to complaints. The State Secretary denied any near-accident, said the flights were within the permit, that the stable owner was contacted by phone, and that no apology was due, while promising to examine incidents.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat militairen kampen met een kledingtekort

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence whether he was aware of reports that soldiers face a clothing shortage, whether the union's claims are accurate, why Parliament learns of problems via the media, and why the government spends on other projects. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, described ongoing clothing projects and supply measures, said a complete list of shortages cannot be given because stocks fluctuate, and pointed to existing reporting channels while refusing to provide a full overview of all problems.
Because stocks fluctuate, the articles that are not sufficiently in stock change, and no exhaustive overview can be provided.
Omdat de voorraden fluctueren, wisselen de artikelen die niet afdoende voorradig zijn en kan geen limitatief overzicht worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over niet-Nederlanders in de krijgsmacht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether Marechaussee job postings via Randstad omit the Dutch nationality requirement required by the AMAR, and how often article 11 AMAR exceptions to that requirement have been used. The State Secretary answered that the postings concern civilian border guard jobs governed by the BARD, not the AMAR, and that seven non-Dutch interpreters were appointed under article 11 in 2004-2007.

A search in the personnel system on appointment article 11 AMAR shows that in the past seven persons with a non-Dutch nationality were temporarily appointed as military personnel on the basis of this article.

Uit een zoekslag in het personeelssysteem op het aanstellingsartikel 11 AMAR blijkt dat er in het verleden zeven personen met een niet-Nederlandse nationaliteit tijdelijk als militair zijn aangesteld op basis van dit artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over jarenlange sabotage van auto’s van militairen

An MP from PVV asked the Defence minister about reported long-running sabotage of military personnel's cars (loosened wheel bolts), whether earlier incidents were made public, what damage and costs resulted, and whether soldiers were compensated. The minister said the Military Police is investigating on behalf of the Public Prosecution Service, gave limited details on incidents and no findings, and noted a nationwide alert was issued.
I cannot make statements about the content of this investigation; that is up to the Public Prosecution Service.
Over de inhoud van dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraken doen, dat is aan het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat het JSF-project opnieuw honderden miljoenen duurder uitvalt

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the F-35 programme's further cost overruns, linked to unhedged currency risk and alleged poor procurement, were acceptable, and whether the investments should be reversed. The State Secretary answered that the currency reserve is exhausted, unit prices in dollars are falling, the additional F-35s are a NATO priority, and the cost-benefit analysis was validated by the Court of Audit, without committing to reversing the investment.
The cabinet is examining how the Defence budget can be further made resilient against currency fluctuations.
Het kabinet onderzoekt op welke manier de schokbestendigheid van de Defensiebegroting tegen valutaschommelingen verder kan worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Helder over piraterij in de Golf van Mexico

MPs De Roon, Popken and Helder asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Justice and Security about piracy in the Gulf of Mexico, including the reported rise in attacks, any signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, monitoring and cooperation, and whether armed private guards could be allowed on Dutch ships. The government answered that it cannot confirm the attack figures, has received no signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, relies on cooperation with the US and Mexico, and noted that armed guards may become possible under the new Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij in designated High Risk Areas, which the Gulf is not currently.
To date we have not yet received any signals that ships sailing under the Dutch flag were targeted by pirates in the Gulf of Mexico.
Tot op heden hebben wij nog geen signalen ontvangen dat schepen varende onder de Nederlandse vlag doelwit waren van piraten in de Golf van Mexico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de omvorming van onze krijgsmacht tot een vreemdelingenlegioen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary of Defence whether the Coalition for Security's call to open the armed forces to non-EU nationals, which it calls a foreign legion, is credible and whether it should be dismissed. The State Secretary answers that opening to non-Dutch nationals is a political choice, that a feasibility study on opening to EU citizens is underway, and that the government will instead pursue unused domestic recruitment potential, not the coalition's proposal.
I will not adopt the CvV's suggestion to open Defence to citizens from outside the EU.
Ik zal de suggestie van de CvV om Defensie voor burgers van buiten de EU open te stellen niet overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over onderzeeboten van Nederlandse makelij

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence whether he knows that unions and VNO-NCW favour Dutch-built submarines, and whether he will stop the procurement process and choose the Saab-Damen design to boost Dutch industry. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the reports and said the submarine replacement project follows the agreed Defence Materiel Process, with a B-letter to the House later this year, and declined to pre-empt that decision.
As stated in the Defence project overview of 17 September, the House will receive the B-letter for this project later this year.
Zoals vermeld in het Defensieprojectenoverzicht van 17 september jl. zal de Kamer later dit jaar de B-brief ontvangen van dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat gemeente Utrechtse Heuvelrug de marinierskazerne wil omvormen tot een groen dorp

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the government would disregard the municipality of Utrechtse Heuvelrug's call to keep the marine barracks in Doorn open to the Mariniers and halt consultation on converting it into a green village, and whether municipalities fail military personnel and veterans. The State Secretary answered that Defence and the municipality keep each other informed, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is coordinating the site's future with local parties, and that development work in Doorn was suspended in consultation with the municipality and province, while denying that municipalities neglect veterans.
Of course we will continue to consult with each other.
Uiteraard blijven we in overleg met elkaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de burnpits doofpot

The PVV MP Popken asks the defence minister why a TNO study on burn pits was not made public, requests a full overview of military health risks, and asks whether officials should be punished and victims compensated. The minister says the study was a toxicology R&D programme whose results could not support health conclusions and that it would have been better to publish it, while medical secrecy limits a full overview, a health monitoring system is planned, and the link between burn pit emissions and health complaints is not yet clear enough to warrant compensation or accountability measures.

It is not possible to give an exhaustive overview of all reported and known health problems and health risks among military personnel, because much of this information falls under medical confidentiality.

Het is niet mogelijk om een limitatief overzicht te geven van alle gemelde en bekendstaande gezondheidsproblemen en gezondheidsrisico's bij militairen omdat veel van deze informatie valt onder het medisch geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het feit dat Defensie liever investeert in een zonneauto dan in veilige Defensie-gebouwen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Defence why the ministry invests in a solar car while barracks are fire-unsafe, and questions costs, documents, and whether this breaches transparency and duty of care. The State Secretary answers that fire-safety works and fire watches are budgeted and reported, that the car cost EUR 144,000 and is available to all staff for learning, and that the ministry denies neglecting duty of care while acknowledging backlog maintenance.
During a tender procedure, no commercially confidential information is given to the media.
Ten tijde van een aanbesteding wordt er geen commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie aan de media gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over “het bericht dat militairen twijfelen of zij een ijsje moeten meenemen voor een collega met een Arabisch klinkende achternaam tijdens de Ramadan”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence about Defence's support for the Multicultural Network Defence (MND), its advisory role, whether diversity is placed above quality, and why veterans' initiatives receive less attention. The State Secretary answered that support is part of broader support for diversity networks, that MND advice is informal and cannot be listed exhaustively, that quality is the leading principle, and that veteran care is handled through the Veteraneninstituut and related channels.
Such advice is not formalised and it is also not my intention to formalise it in the future.
Dergelijke adviezen zijn niet geformaliseerd en het is ook niet mijn voornemen om dit in de toekomst te formaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat mariniers te maken hebben met slechte maaltijden en een ziekmakende keuken

MP Popken (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that marines face poor meals and an unhygienic barracks kitchen, including why parliament learned of it via the media, the number of kitchens with hygiene problems and related illnesses, and calls for pay rises and cancelling a relocation. The State Secretary answered that the poor maintenance was raised in earlier letters and debates, listed reporting channels and measures for food safety, withheld diagnoses under medical confidentiality, attributed the backlog to past budget choices, announced kitchen renovation, and rejected the claim of breaching duty of care.
For sick reports in the registration system of the Defence Health Care Organisation, the diagnosis falls under medical confidentiality.
Bij ziekmeldingen in het registratiesysteem van de Defensie Gezondheidszorg Organisatie behoort de diagnose tot het medisch geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het Europees Defensiefonds

An MP asks the Defence Minister why the Chamber learned from the media that TNO lobbied for European defence funds, whether the Chamber will be given withheld information, and whether non-EU countries can participate in the European Defence Fund, plus challenges the fund's design. The minister answers that the Chamber was regularly informed via BNC-fiches and debates, will review sharing withheld information under Article 68 of the Constitution, and explains that the fund is open to consortia in the EU and EEA associated states subject to safeguards, while endorsing the Commission's analysis.
You will be informed about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat een konvooi met Nederlands legermaterieel is aangevallen in Mali.

An MP asked the Defence Minister about an attack on a convoy carrying Dutch military equipment in Mali, the deteriorating security situation, duty of care for personnel, and whether the MINUSMA mission should be halted. The minister expressed regret for Malian deaths, defended MINUSMA's relevance and mandate adjustment, and stated the redeployment is complete with remaining equipment returning in Q2 2020.
I deeply regret that six Malians (four soldiers and two drivers) died in the attack on the convoy carrying Dutch equipment on 21 August 2019.
Ik betreur ten zeerste dat zes Malinezen (vier militairen en twee chauffeurs) zijn omgekomen bij de aanslag op het konvooi met Nederlands materieel op 21 augustus 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het falend munitiebeleid

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence why ordering ammunition takes years, whether the Dutch ammunition industry was abandoned in favour of foreign suppliers, and whether European procurement rules could be bypassed for Dutch industry. The State Secretary attributed delivery times to supplier lead times, care and spreading of orders, denied that the Dutch industry was deliberately sidelined, and said procurement choices follow best product at best price with industry consultation through NIDV.
There are good and explainable reasons for the lead times of ammunition projects, such as supplier delivery times, care, and considerations of spreading orders.
Er zijn goede en verklaarbare redenen voor de doorlooptijd van munitieprojecten zoals levertijden van leveranciers, zorgvuldigheid en overwegingen van spreiding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over vervangende onderzeeboten

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence whether Dutch jobs and defence personnel safety should weigh heavily in buying replacement submarines, whether past foreign procurement was neglected, and whether Saab-Damen should be chosen. The State Secretary answered that Dutch industry involvement is a goal within best-product, best-price procurement, that the Defence Industry Strategy sets out capabilities, that the B-letter will announce the procurement strategy later, and agreed to answer the questions separately.

As reported in the letter of 24 April (Kamerstuk 34 225, no. 23), the House will be informed in the B-letter about decisions for the continuation of this replacement project, including the procurement strategy.

Zoals gemeld in de brief van 24 april jl. (Kamerstuk 34 225, nr. 23 ) zal de Kamer in de B-brief worden geïnformeerd over besluiten voor het vervolg van dit vervangingsproject, waaronder de verwervingsstrategie.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Popken over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris meer openheid wil bij Defensie

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Defence why she only now sees the importance of openness, whether earlier promises were empty, and whether she will fully answer earlier questions on misconduct and European defence cooperation spending, and commit to deploying the military for border control, compensating victims, punishing offenders and ending diversity policies. The State Secretary replies that openness is essential for learning from mistakes, that earlier questions were answered and she sees no reason to change those answers, and that the other points were addressed in earlier letters.
I see no reason to amend the answers.
Ik zie geen reden om de antwoorden aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en Fritsma over het bericht dat bij een Duits-Nederlandse grenscontrole 27 overtredingen van de Vreemdelingenwet zijn geconstateerd

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of 27 Immigration Act violations found at a joint German-Dutch border check, including nationalities, criminal records, Islamic background, detentions and deportations, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers and Islamic-country migrants. The government answered that 10 Dutch-side cases involved persons without residence permits (nationalities listed, no criminal records found, religion not registered), rejected categorical border closure as unrealistic, and noted the Marechaussee already performs border surveillance.
Based on information and registers available to the Marechaussee, no criminal records were found for the 10 persons named.
Op basis van bij de KMar beschikbare informatie en registers zijn bij de 10 genoemde personen geen criminele antecedenten gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederland acht of negen extra F-35 straaljagers gaat kopen

An MP from the PVV asked the defence ministry why the Chamber learned of plans to buy 8 or 9 extra F-35 jets through the media, about the costs, the US/NATO talks, and whether information would be shared. The government answered that the Chamber will be informed in advance of any change in F-35 numbers, including a confidential cost annex, and that the intention was already shared, but it did not disclose the actual number or costs now.
When the extra numbers of F-35 aircraft are actually determined, your Chamber will be informed in advance, in line with the recently amended guidance note on the major F-35 acquisition project.

Bij de daadwerkelijke invulling van de extra aantallen F-35 vliegtuigen zal uw Kamer daarover vooraf worden geïnformeerd, conform de (recent gewijzigde) uitgangspuntennotitie groot project Verwerving F-35
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat “Defensie blijft teleurstellen op het gebied van veiligheid”

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Defence why Defence handles safety matters slowly, why it cannot give a limitative overview of health problems linked to military duties, and why it has not answered earlier questions fully. The State Secretary answers that a case-by-case assessment applies, that medical-secret data cannot be released, that investigations are launched when a causal link is plausible, and that a pay and conditions agreement was reached on 2 July 2019.
Health problems reported to a doctor fall under medical confidentiality and are therefore not available.
Gezondheidsproblemen die aan een arts worden gemeld, vallen onder het medisch geheim en zijn daarmee niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Defensie een miljoenenclaim boven het hoofd hangt

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that Defence faces a multi-million claim from Full Circle Compliance, why Parliament learned of it through the media, and for a full overview of legal disputes and case documents. The State Secretary declined to discuss the dispute, citing that it is before the courts, and gave only general statements on the number and types of disputes.
The case is currently before the courts, so I make no statements about this dispute and do not provide access to the documents you requested.
De zaak is momenteel onder de rechter waardoor ik geen uitspraken over dit geschil doe en geen inzage geef in de door u gevraagde stukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de verhuizing van de mariniers opnieuw is uitgesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the postponed relocation of the marines would finally be cancelled after reports of a large outflow of personnel. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the report and explained that the contract award for preparatory works was suspended again, pending a consultation with the works council and at the Chamber's earlier request to avoid irreversible steps before a debate.
I have decided to again suspend the contract award for the preparatory construction works for the new barracks
heb ik besloten om de gunning van de bouw voorbereidende werkzaamheden ten behoeve van de nieuwe kazerne opnieuw op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten korting hebben gekregen op de F-35-toestellen

The PVV MP Popken asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Netherlands is entitled to a discount on the F-35 jets, given that the US reportedly obtained one, and asked about the costs incurred. The State Secretary answered that unit prices are negotiated by the US Joint Program Office for all partners, that the formal prices for the Dutch LOT 12-14 aircraft are still pending and will be communicated later, and that the cost overview will be provided in the annual progress report on Prinsjesdag.
The formalisation between the JPO and the American industry regarding the unit prices of the F-35 fighter aircraft in LOT 12, 13 and 14 ... is however still ongoing.
De formalisering tussen het JPO en de Amerikaanse industrie over de stuksprijzen van de F-35 jachtvliegtuigen in LOT 12, 13 en 14 ... is echter nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Broshuis een miljoenenorder in de wacht sleept van de Amerikaanse Defensie

MP Popken asked the State Secretary of Defence why Parliament learned via the media of a large US Defence order won by Broshuis, and whether the government supported it, and questioned Dutch procurement policy and ties to the defence industry. The State Secretary answered that Defence informs Parliament only through the agreed Defence Materiel Process, that Broshuis won the order without direct government support, and that procurement follows best-product-best-price with the Defence Industry Strategy applied.
That does not alter the fact that Defence only informs the House about materiel projects according to the Defence Materiel Process as agreed with the House.
Dat laat onverlet dat Defensie de Kamer alleen informeert over materieelprojecten volgens het Defensie Materieelproces zoals met de Kamer overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat achttien nieuwe marechausseevoertuigen onveilig zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that eighteen new armoured military police vehicles were unsafe and subject to a driving ban, and whether Dutch defence industry should have been involved. The State Secretary confirmed the driving ban over steering, fuel and braking problems, said the armouring added by a French supplier caused the defects, paused six extra vehicles, and denied any improper procurement motive.
Problems have been identified with, among other things, the steering system, the fuel system and the braking system.
Er zijn problemen vastgesteld met onder meer de stuurinrichting, het brandstofsysteem en het remsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over  het  schenden van de beantwoordingstermijn van schriftelijke vragen

Popken (PVV) asks the State Secretary for Defence why her written questions on eighteen new military police vehicles reported unsafe were not answered within the deadline, why no reason for delay was given, and whether she will answer promptly. The State Secretary replies that the deadline is known, Defence always aims for swift answers, the answer took longer than planned, and the answers were sent that day.
The answer deadline is known and Defence always strives for as swift an answer as possible.
De beantwoordingstermijn is bekend en Defensie streeft te allen tijde naar een zo snel mogelijke beantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het opschorten van de trainingsmissie in Irak

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister why Parliament learned of the suspension of the Iraq training mission through the media, what the threat is, and whether the mission should be ended to protect personnel. The minister answered that personnel were informed directly, operational security prevents giving details of the threat, training has resumed under conditions, and the government will keep monitoring the situation and take precautionary measures where needed.
Due to operational security, I cannot provide further details on the grounds on which the American commander of the anti-ISIS coalition decided to temporarily raise the threat level.

In verband met de operationele veiligheid kan ik geen nadere details verstrekken over de gronden op basis waarvan de Amerikaanse commandant van de anti-ISIS coalitie besloot het dreigingsniveau tijdelijk te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over “het bericht dat Defensie wederom teleurstelt bij het CAO-overleg”

MP Popken asked whether the Defence State Secretary knows that Defence keeps its CAO proposal secret while unions want it published, why it is kept secret, and whether it will give the House and personnel more openness. The State Secretary answered that both sides agreed not to communicate externally during negotiations under the Besluit Georganiseerd Overleg Defensie, but that staff were informed of Defence's position on 14 May.
In line with the Defence Organised Consultation Decree (art. 26), it was agreed at the start of negotiations not to communicate externally about the negotiating position.
In lijn met het Besluit Georganiseerd Overleg Defensie (art.26) is bij de start van de onderhandelingen afgesproken niet extern te communiceren over de inzet van de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederland de JSF met serieuze gebreken koopt en deze informatie achterhoudt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether US reports show 102 critical deficiencies in the F-35, fifteen endangering personnel safety, only four of eight reliability targets met, and why the Chamber was not informed, and whether purchase will be stopped. The State Secretary answered that fifteen Category 1 deficiencies remain, mitigation measures are in place, the annual report is a tailored version of foreign reports, and the purchase continues as committed.
The annual report on the F-35 acquisition project is therefore not an exact copy or bundling of foreign reports.
De jaarrapportage over het project Verwerving F-35 is daarom geen exacte kopie of bundeling van buitenlandse rapporten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat een fataal ongeluk met een Apache veroorzaakt werd door een verbogen onderdeel

An MP asked whether an internal report on the fatal Apache crash in Mali gave a different cause than the one sent to parliament, whether shortage of equipment, funding and training contributed, and why the incident was not communicated openly. The government answered that the Commission of Inquiry found a bent and then fractured probe as the technical cause, rejected any link to shortages, and explained that the full report is confidential under export-control and personal-data rules, while the summary was shared with parliament.
The report is confidential because it contains, among other things, technical data falling under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control rules.

Het rapport heeft een vertrouwelijk karakter, omdat het rapport onder andere technische gegevens bevat die vallen onder de International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) regelgeving voor exportcontrole.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat cyberoorlog zich ook op zee afspeelt

The PVV MP Popken asked the Defence Minister about reports of cyberwarfare at sea, including whether NATO had noted rising GPS and electromagnetic interference and whether the Dutch navy had been affected, and about navy ship cybersecurity and the EU's role at sea. The minister confirmed the navy faces jamming and spoofing that is reported to MIVD or NATO, but declined to give details on the nature of these activities or the state of navy cybersecurity, citing confidentiality and security reasons.

As regards the precise nature of these activities, I cannot, like NATO, provide detailed information, for reasons of confidentiality and because it would give insight into the armed forces' capabilities.

Over de precieze aard van deze activiteiten kan ik, net als de NAVO, geen gedetailleerde mededelingen doen, omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid en het inzicht dat dat zou geven in de capaciteiten van de krijgsmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat in de nieuwe verf dubbel zo veel Chroom-6 zit

MP Popken (PVV) asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that new paint for military aircraft contains twice as much chromium-6, and whether Defence is acting wrongly by not moving faster to chromium-6-free systems. The State Secretary answered that the higher percentage reflects a change in solids content, not added chromium-6, that a roadmap for further reduction is due by 1 March 2019, and that safe working with chromium-6 is ensured.

A concrete and feasible plan for further reducing the use of chromium-6 in aviation systems and aviation-related ground equipment will be ready by 1 March 2019, after which decisions on its implementation can be taken.

Een concreet en uitvoerbaar plan met betrekking tot initiatieven voor verdere reductie van gebruik van chroom-6 in luchtvaartsystemen en in luchtvaart gerelateerde gronduitrusting is uiterlijk 1 maart 2019 gereed, waarna besluiten over de realisatie ervan kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat twee derde van de mariniers uitstroomt als de verhuizing naar Vlissingen door gaat

MP Popken asked the State Secretary of Defence whether two-thirds of marines would leave if the relocation to Vlissingen proceeds, and about its direct and indirect consequences, vacancies, economic impact and whether Defence should halt the move. The State Secretary answered that the survey measured intention to leave (68% of respondents who answered), not actual outflow, listed the operational consequences of a two-thirds drop, reported 566 vacant posts, declined to speculate on vacancy filling and said Defence has no data on regional economic effects, while opening dialogue with the works council and pausing the PPS tender.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de bescherming van het personeel tegen Chroom-6 onvoldoende is

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that protection of defence personnel against chromium-6 was insufficient, including the spray-cabin situation, gas-mask filter buses, the internal safety staff documents and the meaning of apologies. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging past failings, describing measures and replacement plans, and making the internal documents available via a link, though the reply largely restates existing policy and continuing investigation.
For this I offered, on behalf of Defence, my apologies when the RIVM research results were announced.
Daarvoor heb ik bij de bekendmaking van de onderzoeksresultaten van het RIVM namens Defensie mijn excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat het materiaal van de commando's niet voldoet

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that commando equipment (helmets and jackets) fails to meet requirements, including a 2016 memo, how it was handled, and whether it reflects Defence's poor state. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, said the complaint was handled through the commander's line and resolved with DMO and KCT staff, admitted material readiness is not fully in order, and pointed to planned measures and investment.
As already reported, including in the operational readiness report, the (material) readiness of units, including KCT units, is not fully in order.
Zoals reeds gemeld in o.a. de inzetbaarheidsrapportage is de (materiële) gereedheid van eenheden, waaronder eenheden van het KCT, niet volledig op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de verhuizing van de marinierskazerne op losse schroeven staat

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that the relocation of the marine corps barracks was uncertain, including rising irregular outflow of marines, the effects of halting a Raiding Squadron, the basis for the 1 October date and costs of postponed construction work, and why marines should trust the defence staff. The State Secretary answered that outflow is being monitored and retention measures are being taken, that the squadron stop reduces operational capacity until 2021, that postponed work costs are borne by Defence, and that a process facilitator has been appointed to resume consultation with the works council.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederlandse producenten misgrijpen bij grote defensie-orders

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that Dutch producers risk losing large defence contracts, including the Vector vehicle's performance, why the procurement is at risk, why Dutch industry is not better protected, and whether Article 346 TFEU is interpreted generously. The State Secretary acknowledged the reports, said the Vector delivery was delayed but expected to deliver from 2019, declined to comment on the ongoing tender, and stated the Defence Industry Strategy would follow and that the national security exception is interpreted generously.
As this tender is still ongoing, I cannot provide any information on it.
Aangezien deze aanbesteding nog loopt, kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederland de militaire banden met Iran aanhaalt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence whether the Netherlands is strengthening military ties with Iran, whether Iran threatens the West and Israel, and what the Defence department plans. The government confirmed that a defence attaché will be posted in Tehran to monitor military developments, while stating its concern about Iran's regional role and missile programme and its support for an EU dialogue with Iran.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to place the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Mariniers Vlissingen niet zien zitten en massaal weglopen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that marines are leaving the corps rather than accept a move from Doorn to Vlissingen, and how large the departures must become before operations are endangered. The State Secretary answered that operational commitments can still be met, that the corps must be refilled, and listed retention measures such as adjusted allowances and retention premiums.
However, the Marine Corps remains able to meet its current operational commitment.
Maar het Korps Mariniers blijft in staat aan zijn huidige inzetverplichting te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Defensie gevechtsonderdelen opheft wegens personeelstekort

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that military units were being disbanded due to staff shortages, and about rising unplanned departures from the Marines and Commando Corps. The government answered that no units were disbanded for staff shortages, that some units are being temporarily merged or left unfilled, and that retention measures are underway.
In recent years, no Defence units have been disbanded due to staff shortages.
In de afgelopen jaren zijn er geen eenheden van Defensie opgeheven vanwege personeelstekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de brief inzake de bevindingen van het intern onderzoek van de misbruikzaak uit 1982

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the internal investigation findings on a 1982 sexual abuse case, asking whether perpetrators should be dismissed even when the offence is time-barred and whether the privacy of the accused is protected while the victim had to go public. The State Secretary called the conduct unacceptable, said criminal and disciplinary measures are blocked by the passage of time, and pointed to a commission reviewing the reporting system.
This abuse case is criminally time-barred. The passage of time also prevents taking administrative or disciplinary measures.
Deze misbruikzaak is strafrechtelijk gezien verjaard. Het tijdsverloop in deze zaak staat ook het nemen van bestuursrechtelijke of tuchtrechtelijke maatregelen in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat kleine vliegvelden vrij spel zijn voor criminelen

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether small airports are open to criminals, how much border-control capacity the Marechaussee lacks, what legislation must change to require digital advance passenger notifications, and whether the borders should close immediately. The Minister said the Marechaussee handles border checks only at designated border posts while police and customs cover smaller airports, that capacity is being expanded, that EU rules leave the timing of general declarations open and national rules could tighten them, and that the government does not favour immediate border closure.
To carry out the control task it is desirable that the information be supplied digitally a prescribed number of hours before entry into the Schengen area.
Ter uitvoering van de controletaak is het gewenst dat de informatie een voorgeschreven aantal uur voor binnenkomst in het Schengenland digitaal wordt aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de korte training tijdens de Uruzganmissie fataal werd

An MP asks the Defence Minister about reports that a short pre-deployment training preceded fatal friendly-fire incidents in Uruzgan in 2008, whether inadequate training was to blame, and whether Defence routinely sets too high an ambition level. The Minister answers that the unit was ready, that the internal investigation found training limitations and tactical procedure lapses, and that the incident resulted from a combination of circumstances rather than a single cause or a systemic overambition.
Defence's investigation shows that the unit was ready for the mission.
Het onderzoek van Defensie laat zien dat de eenheid klaar was voor de missie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de misstanden op de kazerne in Schaarsbergen omvangrijker waren dan bekend was

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence why abuses at the Schaarsbergen barracks lasted so long, whether they will be included in the independent inquiry, whether reporting procedures for vandalism will be reviewed, and why the Chamber was not fully informed about an internal 2015 risk analysis. The State Secretary answers that an independent commission is investigating, that the reporting procedure will be reviewed, and that the risk analysis is a confidential preventive instrument, referring to a separate letter.
It is precisely the confidentiality of this instrument that increases the chance that matters can be prevented and resolved.
Juist de vertrouwelijkheid van dit instrument verhoogt de kans dat zaken kunnen worden voorkomen en opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat er te weinig geld is voor alle 37 JSF-toestellen

MP Popken (PVV) asked whether the government will abandon the F-35 program after reports that the 37 planned jets are underfunded due to the dollar exchange rate, and why the Rekenkamer's earlier warnings were not acted on. The Secretary of State says the 37 jets will be bought as planned, that currency risk was reported to parliament in recent progress reports, that about 1.5 billion euro had been spent by end 2016, and that the F-35 is the best replacement for the F-16.
Defence recognised the risk of currency fluctuations from the start of the F-35 acquisition project.
Defensie heeft het risico van valutaschommelingen vanaf het begin van het project Verwerving F-35 onderkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat militairen vernederd zijn tijdens ontgroening op de KMA in Breda

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that military recruits were humiliated during hazing at the KMA in Breda, and whether a culture discouraging reporting of misconduct exists. The State Secretary said the facts are still being investigated and will be reported later, announced an independent commission on a socially safe environment within Defence, and stated that hazing is prohibited while initiation rituals are permitted under Defence-wide guidelines.
At this moment this is being investigated. The House will be informed about this matter later.
Op dit moment wordt dit uitgezocht. De Kamer wordt later over deze zaak geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat geprobeerd wordt de smartphones van NAVO-troepen te hacken

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence about reports that smartphones of NATO troops were being hacked, including whether Dutch soldiers were affected during Baltic exercises and what measures the armed forces take. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to give details on Dutch incidents or past exercises for operational security, described general cyber defence measures, and said cyber defence is a structural NATO priority.
For reasons of operational security, I cannot make any statements about this.
Om redenen van operationele veiligheid kan ik hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken, Wilders en Graus over het bericht dat de marechaussee onervaren en ongewapenden burgers gaat inzetten op Schiphol

PVV MPs asked whether deploying inexperienced, unarmed reservists at Schiphol border control, as reported, endangers security given the terror threat, and whether more money will be invested in border control. The ministers confirmed the report, said about 200 fully trained ex-marechaussee reservists exist and a single trainee reservist is in a pilot (unarmed, always paired with an armed colleague, to be evaluated), and pointed to €7.5m extra for 2017 and €20m structurally from 2018 for border control.
The starting point is that no compromises are made on security.
Voorop staat dat er geen concessies worden gedaan aan de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over toegangspassen tot de Koningin Maximakazerne die zijn gevonden in een auto die eerst eigendom van Defensie was

MP Popken asked the Minister of Defence how access passes and parking cards for the Koningin Maximakazerne were found in a former military police car, how often sold vehicles were not fully cleared, and whether the sale of defence equipment will be evaluated. The minister replied that no passes giving access to a defence site were left behind, that the parking vignettes were no longer in use, that the case was a human error without security consequences, and that personnel will be reminded of the procedure.
I do not consider this necessary, as the procedure is adequate and this concerns a human error without (potential) consequences for (state) security.
Ik acht dit niet nodig, aangezien de procedure toereikend is en het om een menselijke fout gaat zonder (potentiële) gevolgen voor de (staats)veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) evenveel geheugen heeft als een Iphone

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether reports that the F-35 has less data storage than an iPhone are true, and whether the Netherlands should stop the programme. The minister answered that the reports concern the UK's F-35B variant, that data storage can be adapted, that the F-35 is still in development testing, and that the Netherlands will continue acquiring the F-35A.
The F-35 will meet the requirements set by the Netherlands and will form an important weapons system of the armed forces in the coming decades.
De F-35 zal voldoen aan de door Nederland gestelde eisen en zal in de komende decennia een belangrijk wapensysteem van de krijgsmacht vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en De Graaf over het bericht dat België radicalen op zee gaat opsporen

MPs Popken and De Graaf asked whether the Netherlands applies maritime border and port controls comparable to Belgium's new hunt for radicalised crew on suspicious ships, and whether Dutch controls should be stepped up. The ministers answered that Dutch sea and port controls are comparable, describing the roles of the Kustwacht, ILT, Douane and Marechaussee, and pointed to extra funding for the Marechaussee.
The organisation of sea and port control in the Netherlands and Belgium is comparable.
De inrichting van de controle van de zee en havens in Nederland en België is vergelijkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over een schip dat in de nabijheid van marineschepen is geëxplodeerd voor de kust van Somalië

MPs De Roon and Popken asked the ministers whether a ship exploding near naval vessels off Somalia was a navy ship, whether EU navies were involved, and which navies were present, and whether the cause would be investigated before a Dutch ship deployed there. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that the ship was very likely not a naval vessel, that an Italian frigate found nothing on investigation, and that the incident gave no reason for further inquiry.
Neither the initial incident report nor the subsequent actions of EUNAVFOR Atalanta give reason to carry out further investigation.
Zowel de initiële incidentmelding als de daaropvolgende acties van EUNAVFOR Atalanta geven geen aanleiding om verder onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en Maeijer over het bericht dat Europese legers structureel gaan samenwerken

MPs Popken and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Defence Minister about reports that European armies will cooperate structurally, including Poland's concerns about duplication with NATO, EU defence fund spending, and EU Battlegroup costs and deployments. The minister answered that Netherlands supports stronger EU defence within a complementary NATO framework, outlined its EU Battlegroup contributions for 2018, and rejected any transfer of sovereignty.
Your House will receive a BNC fiche on the European Defence Fund setting out the Dutch position.
Uw Kamer ontvangt een BNC-fiche over het Europees Defensiefonds met daarin het Nederlandse standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat officieren waarschuwen dat onze Luchtmacht er slecht voor staat

An MP asked the Defence Minister about officers warning that the air force is in poor shape after 20 years of missions, and whether the four-year recovery period is too long and whether defence should focus on homeland defence. The minister acknowledged the F-16 fleet's readiness limits, said recovery takes eighteen months with possible redeployment from 2018, defended the F-35 transition and the postponement of the MALE UAV, and argued the armed forces must be able to operate beyond the EU's borders.
Recovering the readiness of the F-16s takes eighteen months.
Het herstel van de gereedheid van de F-16's neemt achttien maanden in beslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht 'Man koopt auto van Defensie en vindt nepbom'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence whether a fake explosive left in a former Defence vehicle sold at auction was a serious lapse, whether other sold vehicles might contain explosives, and how future sales could be prevented from leaving such items behind. The Minister confirmed the object resembles a fake explosive, said the Royal Marechaussee is investigating how it got there, and explained that surplus vehicles are transferred to Domeinen Roerende Zaken for public sale after Defence removes non-standard defence items, without addressing whether other vehicles are affected.
The Royal Marechaussee is investigating how and when the object was placed in the car.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee onderzoekt hoe en wanneer het voorwerp in de auto is geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over tientallen meldingen bij Defensie van bedreiging van militairen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about dozens of reported threats against military personnel and how many involved Islamic or terrorist motives, plus whether dual nationals should be barred from the armed forces.
