The minister reported 79 incidents in 2013 to date (20 with police reports), with only five linked to an Islamic background, all involving civilians and no sign of terrorism, and referred back to earlier answers on dual nationality.
In the period in question, a total of 79 incidents were registered with Defence, in twenty of which a report was also filed with the Royal Military Police.
In de betreffende periode zijn er in totaal 79 incidenten geregistreerd bij Defensie, waarbij in twintig gevallen ook aangifte is gedaan bij de Koninklijke Marechaussee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de marinierstraining in het Himalayagebergte

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that a Marine Corps Himalayan climbing training cost nearly 1 million euros, asking about its added value, when Defence was informed, and how to address anger among marines. The minister confirmed costs of about 923,000 euros (about 600,000 in extra costs), justified the training as valuable experience for extreme-environment operations, and said that 2016 cuts had been considered but the training was kept because of prior commitments.
Where necessary, choices made in the readiness plan will be explained in more detail to the personnel.
Waar nodig zullen gemaakte keuzes in het gereedstellingsplan uitvoeriger worden uitgelegd aan het personeel.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat 10 procent van de gevangenen ongewenst vreemdeling is

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister why foreign offenders without residence status can enter the Netherlands but are hard to deport after crimes, whether free-roaming offenders exist, the cost per detainee, the origin and asylum background of these prisoners, and whether borders should close to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The government answered that VRIS offenders are prioritised for return, that some tbs-passants and self-reporters are not detained and their status is not registered, that costs are estimated at 125-130 million euro per year, that origin and asylum background are not recorded, and that closing borders to groups is not a realistic solution.
It is not registered whether detainees come from an Islamic country.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd of gedetineerden uit een islamitisch land komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat een Hamas-fan die betrokken was bij de terreuraanval van 7 oktober opduikt bij een pro-Palestijnse sit-in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked why a man who filmed the 7 October 2023 attack and praised Hamas could enter the Netherlands and attend a pro-Palestinian sit-in, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers from Islamic countries. The government said it will legislate against glorifying terrorism, will not comment on individual cases, gave no exact figures on Hamas supporters, and refused to close borders by origin, citing non-discrimination law.
The cabinet makes no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over Palestina

An MP from the SP asked the government about medical evacuations from Gaza, reconstruction conference, UNRWA funding, ceasefire violations, humanitarian access, F-35 parts exports, arms exports to Israel, sanctions on the ICC, and related questions. The minister and state secretary answered most questions substantively, while declining to commit to specific new evacuations, UNRWA funding, or a fixed timetable for the conference, and pointing to planned reviews and letters.

The cabinet has, in line with the Ceder and Dobbe motions, formally protested to the Israeli government about the NGO registration legislation and will continue to work for unhindered, full and safe access for professional, mandated aid organisations to the Palestinian territories.

5 Antwoord 12 Het kabinet heeft, conform motie Ceder 6 en motie Dobbe 7 , formeel protest aangetekend bij de Israëlische regering ten aanzien van de NGO-registratiewetgeving en zal zich blijven inspannen voor de ongehinderde, volledige en veilige toegang voor professionele, gemandateerde hulporganisaties tot de Palestijnse gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de Franse rechter van het Internationaal Strafhof, Nicolas Guillou, op de Amerikaanse sanctielijst staat

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about US sanctions on ICC judges, including Judge Nicolas Guillou, and their effect on the court's functioning, banking, ICT and diplomacy. The minister answered that the Netherlands as host state is in regular contact with the ICC, that the court continues most work, and that diplomatic contacts with the US continue, while withholding details of confidential talks.
Due to confidentiality, the content of these conversations cannot be discussed in detail.
Wegens de vertrouwelijkheid kan er niet in detail worden getreden over de inhoud van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Heera Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland moet zich uitspreken tegen grote militaire actie in Cariben

MPs Ceder and Heera Dijk asked the government how it responds to the US military operation 'Southern Spear' against alleged drug boats in the Caribbean, whether it will call for independent investigation, whether US use of Curaçao facilities played a role, and whether it will inform the House. The government says the Kingdom is not involved in the US national operation, stresses adherence to international law without judging the US self-defence claim, notes only unarmed surveillance flights are covered by the 2000 facilities treaty, and leaves independent investigation primarily to the US while referring to diplomatic channels.
The Kingdom is not involved in the national US deployment in international waters and international airspace.
Het Koninkrijk is niet betrokken bij de nationale inzet vanuit de VS in de internationale wateren en het internationale luchtruim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Eurobarometer

A Freedom Party MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Eurobarometer systematically overstates positive views of the EU due to sample bias and question framing, whether the Rijksoverheid should stop using it as a source, and how the government views the contact between the authors and the commissioning and fieldwork bodies. The minister replies that the government values quality polling, that the methodology is documented, that it is not for the cabinet to judge how the survey is conducted, and that official sources are verified independently, without committing to any action.
It is further not for the cabinet to pronounce on the implementation of this opinion research.
Het is verder niet aan het kabinet om zich uit te spreken over de uitvoering van dit opinieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boswijk over de verstorende rol van Hongarije in het beleid van de Europese Unie

Two MPs from VVD and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary's alleged misuse of EU funds, its Russian energy imports, its blocking of Ukraine's accession and its China partnership. The minister condemned Hungary's rule-of-law record, described frozen EU funds and existing safeguards, and said the Commission should act quickly, while noting that the qualified majority needed for sanctions under Article 7 is not yet in sight.

The Netherlands, in line with motions by Klaver et al., Van Campen et al., Paternotte and Van Campen, and Dassen, urges the Commission to use all available EU instruments developed and strengthened in recent years, also at the urging of the House.

Nederland spoort, in lijn met motie Klaver c.s., motie Van Campen c.s., motie Paternotte en Van Campen en motie Dassen 2 , de Commissie aan om gebruik te maken van al het beschikbare EU-instrumentarium dat afgelopen jaren is ontwikkeld en versterkt, ook op aansporen van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Nederland is een ontbossingsland’

MP Teunissen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands contributes to global deforestation via finance, ports and consumption, including Rabobank's ranking and the adequacy of EU deforestation rules. The minister answered that companies and financial institutions must follow OECD and UN standards, that existing EU sustainability rules apply but are being simplified, and that the EUDR enforcement details remain uncertain pending final EU text.

How a financial institution gives effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and what choices it makes regarding investments or engaging with companies, is the responsibility of the institutions themselves.

Hoe een financiële instelling invulling geeft aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen, en welke keuzes zij maakt ten aanzien van investeringen of het aangaan van gesprekken met bedrijven, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over het bericht 'Nederland koopt opvang migranten af voor 33 miljoen euro'

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that the Netherlands would pay 33 million euros to offload reception of 1,650 migrants, why the EU solidarity figures were kept confidential, whether asylum seekers can re-apply after relocation, and whether the Netherlands should seek exemption or refuse the pact. The minister answered that the solidarity pool was agreed at 21,000 relocations (420 million euros), the Dutch share is 5.2% (about 21.9 million), the proposal was confidential by law until Council agreement, and that the Dublin rules and the pact's border measures remain binding, with no Dutch exemption sought.
The document has been shared confidentially with your House.
Het stuk is vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van het lid Dassen over het verschijnen van de Amerikaanse National Security Strategy

An MP from Volt asks the Foreign Minister fifteen questions about the US National Security Strategy, especially its passages on Europe, civilizational erasure, migration, support for patriotic European parties, Russia, NATO enlargement, the EU and US military presence. The minister postpones the answers, saying they will be included in a cabinet appraisal of the strategy to be sent to parliament in January 2026.
For that reason I will include the answers to the parliamentary questions in the cabinet appraisal, which I intend to send to your House in January 2026 ahead of the debate on it.
Om die reden zal ik de beantwoording van de Kamervragen betrekken bij de kabinetsappreciatie, die ik voornemens ben in januari 2026 voorafgaand aan het debat hierover aan uw Kamer toe te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Wat hebben Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven op een beurs in Rusland te zoeken?’1

Members of D66 asked the government about Dutch agricultural firms exhibiting at a fair in Krasnodar and continuing to operate in Russia, including whether agricultural machinery exports strengthen Russia and whether export bans and company conduct should be addressed. The minister answered that the government balances sanctions against food security, pursues a ban on specific high-tech agricultural machinery exports, notes that Dutch-linked export figures cannot be solely attributed to machinery, and will inform parliament further on a motion.
The cabinet continues to work towards banning exports of specific high-grade agricultural machinery to Russia.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen voor het verbieden van de export van specifieke, hoogwaardige landbouwmachines naar Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Kabinet trekt toch 700 miljoen euro extra uit voor Oekraïne'

MP Vermeer asked whether using 700 million euros of underspending to fund extra Ukraine aid breaches budget rules, how this fits the cabinet's earlier position, and for overviews of Dutch and EU aid, refugee costs and oversight of aid spending. The government answered that underspending may be redirected, that it is a first step on the Chamber's motion, and provided aid tables, EU instrument details and an account of the procurement and audit controls in place.
The cabinet will then consider at the beginning of the new year how further follow-up to the motion can be given.
Het kabinet beziet vervolgens in het begin van het nieuwe jaar hoe verdere opvolging aan de motie gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Dobbe, Piri en Hirsch over berichten in de uitzending Pauw & De Wit op NPO1 van 6 oktober 2025 over het Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports on mistreatment of Dutch participants in the Global Sumud Flotilla intercepted by Israel, and whether the Netherlands would support an independent investigation, file an ICC complaint, or seek legal justification for the interception. The minister answered that the government raised detention conditions with Israel, requested Israel's legal basis for the interception (still awaited), declined to take further steps such as an ICC complaint, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued diplomatic pressure.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities for a justification of the legal basis for Israel's actions following the interception of the ships.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen naar aanleiding van de onderschepping van de schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de publicatie 'Understanding Anti-Christian Hate Crimes and Addressing the Security Needs of Christian Communities'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the government how it responds to the OSCE/ODIHR publication on anti-Christian hate crimes, including monitoring, under-registration, and international advocacy. The government welcomed the report, said discrimination against Christians is a small share of complaints so no specific policy exists yet, and pointed to planned public communication on anti-discrimination reporting and ongoing diplomatic advocacy.
Because of the small number of reports, there is currently no specific policy to combat discrimination against Christians.
Vanwege het geringe aantal meldingen is er op dit moment geen specifiek beleid om discriminatie van christenen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de situatie in Soedan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the role of gold in the Sudan conflict, Dutch pressure on the UAE over arms and gold trade, Dutch positions at the Foreign Affairs Council, food-security funding via the Dutch Relief Alliance, and pressure on the SAF and RSF to allow humanitarian access. The government answered by describing EU conflict-minerals rules, arms export assessments, Dutch advocacy for ceasefire and sanctions, a EUR 10 million contribution to the UN Sudan Humanitarian Fund, and diplomatic calls on warring parties to allow aid, without committing to new national measures against the UAE.
The cabinet will take a position on this at the moment any possible negotiation result is submitted to the Council for decision.
Het kabinet zal daarover een positie innemen op het moment dat een eventueel onderhandelingsresultaat ter besluitvorming wordt voorgelegd aan de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de herbeoordeling van F-35-export Israël

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether the re-assessment of F-35 parts exports to Israel applied the EU Common Position criteria, why the Israel exclusion under AV009 is maintained, why a six-month re-review was set, and whether F-35 parts transferred via the Netherlands to other partners must also be withheld from Israel. The government answered that the EU criteria were applied, that the detailed assessment is not shared beyond standard reporting because it contains sensitive information, that a re-review within six months was chosen given the evolving situation, and that the Supreme Court order does not cover onward transfers to other F-35 partners.
In addition, the re-assessment contains sensitive information that could be harmful to the Netherlands' bilateral relations.
Daarnaast omvat de herbeoordeling gevoelige informatie die schadelijk kan zijn voor bilaterale relaties van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse klimaatfinanciering aan ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked whether Dutch climate finance to developing countries includes projects not primarily aimed at climate, how the climate share is set, how much is grants versus loans, and whether Dutch contributions are additional and comparatively low. The Secretary of State confirmed that broad programmes are counted using OECD Rio markers and estimates, reported 2024 totals of EUR 1.07 billion mostly grants, rejected the claim that the Netherlands lags other donors, and pointed to an online climate dashboard instead of a separate overview.
I am happy to refer you to the online climate dashboard.
Ik verwijs u graag naar het online klimaatdashboard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de nasleep van de moord op een Nederlandse vrouw in India

An MP asked the ministers whether the government could inform the victims' relatives about the progress of the Indian case over a Dutch woman's murder, whether extradition or passport measures could be used, and whether the relatives could be invited to a meeting. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual consular cases for privacy reasons, offers consular support and casework, explains the limited extradition and passport-withdrawal options, and does not commit to new concrete steps.
On individual consular cases, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make any statements out of respect for the privacy of those involved.
Over individuele consulaire zaken doet het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken geen mededelingen omwille van de privacy van betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over overlastgevers in Ter Apel

Deputy Podt (D66) asks about the number of places in the Ter Apel procedure availability location, the enforcement of the area ban with the local tri-partite consultation in Westerwolde, the transfer of overlast-causing Dublin claimants and minors, and perspective-oriented care for juvenile offenders. Minister Keijzer answers that the pilot can expand beyond five places, that the ministry will supply extra boa's to Westerwolde, that Dublin claimants are being transferred but capacity is limited, and that Nidos and COA are working to expand intensive-care locations, with evaluation results promised in Q1 2026.
The functioning of the procedural availability pilot will be evaluated with the chain in the coming period.
De werking van de pilot procesbeschikbaarheidsaanpak wordt de komende tijd met de keten geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Kerkleiders pleiten voor vrijlating Chinese voorgangers. ‘Zion Kerk groeit in de vervolging’'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the detention of Zion Church pastors in China and what steps it will take to raise the case with Chinese authorities. The minister called the reports worrying, said Dutch diplomatic channels raise religious freedom concerns in general but that the Zion Church case has not yet been raised specifically, and promised continued monitoring with partners.
The Netherlands will, together with our partners, closely follow the case and raise it with the Chinese authorities in contacts.
Nederland zal de zaak, samen met onze partners, nauwgezet blijven volgen en deze in contacten met de Chinese autoriteiten aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de ontwikkelingen omtrent opschorten van asielaanvragen, de inbreukprocedure en de belemmeringen van ngo’s in Griekenland

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about Greece's suspension of asylum applications, an EU infringement procedure on reception rules, NGO restrictions, and whether the Netherlands would press Greece and the Commission. The minister answered that enforcement is primarily for the Commission, that the ECHR interim measures say nothing about Greek law's legality, that Dutch bilateral support does not contribute to detention, and that the Commission's rule-of-law dialogue is the forum for NGO issues, with no concrete new commitments beyond informing parliament when warranted.
So far it is only known that the Commission sent a letter of formal notice to Greece on 26 January 2023.
Vooralsnog is enkel bekend dat de Commissie op 26 januari 2023 een aanmaningsbrief aan Griekenland heeft gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Duitse politie dumpt tientallen migranten aan de Nederlandse grens

MP Van der Plas asked whether German police abandon migrants without valid papers at the Dutch border without formal handover, and whether the Minister will raise this with Germany and tighten controls. The Minister replied that 690 persons were formally transferred from Germany between December 2024 and September 2025 under bilateral agreements, that warm and cold handovers both count as formal, and that the practice was discussed with border regional authorities.
In the period from 9 December 2024 to 8 September 2025, a total of 690 foreign nationals were transferred from Germany to the Netherlands.
In de periode van 9 december 2024 tot en met 8 september 2025 zijn in totaal 690 vreemdelingen door Duitsland aan Nederland overgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Duitse grenscontroles

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about German police handing people over the border at night, including whether this is lawful and how affected residents and municipalities are supported. The minister says handovers follow bilateral agreements, gives 690 transfers for a nine-month period, notes that some cases are cold handovers, says Dutch and German border authorities are in contact, and states that the legal question is pending in Germany.
The Royal Netherlands Marechaussee does not record whether persons refused by Germany are transferred by a 'warm handover' or a 'cold handover'.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) registreert niet of door Duitsland geweigerde personen worden overgedragen middels een «warme overdracht» of een «koude overdracht».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceulemans en Boomsma over het over de Nederlandse grens zetten van onderschepte personen bij grenscontroles door de Duitse autoriteiten

JA21 MPs Ceulemans and Boomsma asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about people intercepted at German border checks and pushed back to the Netherlands, including whether 'cold' transfers occur, how their status is verified, incidents in border municipalities, and measures to address them. The minister confirmed bilateral transfer arrangements apply to both warm and cold transfers, that the KMar does not record the type of transfer, that contact with Bundespolizei occurs, and that the KMar has raised transfer practices, including onward travel facilitation, with the German side.
The Royal Netherlands Marechaussee (KMar) does not record whether people refused by Germany are transferred by a 'warm' or a 'cold' transfer.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) registreert niet of door Duitsland geweigerde personen worden overgedragen middels een «warme» overdracht of een «koude» overdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over geweld en intimidatie jegens christelijke asielzoekers in azc in Goes

An SGP MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration how the government responds to reports of intimidation and violence against Christian asylum seekers at the Goes reception centre, what measures are taken, how victims can be encouraged to report, whether a convenant like the LGBTI one is possible, and whether asylum applications can be refused for intimidation. The Minister says such discrimination is unacceptable, that COA handles incidents seriously and imposes sanctions, that victims are encouraged to report, that COA does not separate residents by religion, and that refusal criteria follow the qualification directive so the review will not cover that.
COA does not recognise structural, organised incidents against Christian asylum seekers at the Goes location.
Het COA herkent op de locatie in Goes geen structurele, georganiseerde incidenten jegens christelijke asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en Piri over de toenemende spanningen tussen de Verenigde Staten en Venezuela

MPs Tseggai and Piri asked the government about Caribbean concerns over US strikes on alleged drug boats near Venezuela, whether the Kingdom would curb intelligence sharing or the Curaçao CSL cooperation, and how local authorities and residents are informed. The government answered that there is no acute threat to the Kingdom, that the US operation is national and outside Kingdom waters, that the Kingdom is not involved, that CSL flights are limited to unarmed surveillance under treaty, and that Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire communicate with their own populations while the Foreign Minister keeps them informed.
The Kingdom is not involved in the current military operation of the United States.
Het Koninkrijk is niet betrokken bij de huidige militaire operatie van de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kabinet stuurt vrouwen terug naar Taliban in Afghanistan’

SP MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked how the government opposes Taliban violations of women's rights, whether IND rejects and returns Afghan women using vague criteria, and how the ECJ ruling on gender-based persecution is implemented. The government answers that it raises women's rights in EU and UN fora and in the joint CEDAW state-responsibility case, but that individual asylum cases, including the rejection criteria, are assessed individually and it will not discuss specific cases.
Legally, an individual assessment of every asylum application remains possible.
Juridisch gezien blijft een individuele beoordeling van elke asielaanvraag mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht 'Het kabinet wil twee Afghaanse vrouwen terugsturen ondanks vrouwonvriendelijk bewind van de Taliban'

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Asylum and Migration and Foreign Affairs ministers about a report that the cabinet wants to return two Afghan women despite Taliban oppression, citing a UN human rights warning and a court ruling against the IND. The minister answered that the IND assesses each case individually under the Vreemdelingencirculaire, that Afghan women facing discriminatory measures generally receive asylum permits, that Nederland co-initiated a Women's Convention liability claim against Afghanistan, and that no change to country policy is planned, while declining to comment on the individual case.
As your House is aware, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over de situatie van orthodoxe christenen in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an attack on Orthodox Christians in Woldiya, Ethiopia, requesting condemnation, pressure for an independent investigation, and raising religious minority protection in bilateral contacts. The minister could not verify the date or location cited, condemned attacks on Orthodox Christians, noted a religious council was asked to investigate, and said Nederland raises protection of vulnerable groups in contacts and EU/UN fora.
The cabinet cannot verify this information.
Het kabinet kan deze informatie niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over moorden op en ontvoeringen van leden van de Ethiopisch Orthodoxe Kerk in de Ethiopische regio Arsi

Christian Union MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about killings and abductions of Ethiopian Orthodox Church members in Arsi, Oromia, including the 190 killed since 2021 claim, the August 2024 attack, and who is responsible. The minister confirmed awareness, said a religious dimension is likely alongside ethnic and conflict factors, that perpetrators remain unidentified, and that the Netherlands urges the Ethiopian government to protect vulnerable groups in dialogue and EU/UN settings.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine who the perpetrators were.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk vast te stellen wie de daders waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over de moordpartijen op orthodoxe christenen in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about killings of Orthodox Christians in Oromia, Ethiopia, their likely perpetrators (including the OLA), and Dutch steps to monitor, pressure and sanction. The minister confirmed a probable religious dimension but said perpetrators could not be identified, pointed to the Ethiopian interreligious council's inquiry, and largely referred to existing diplomatic channels and sanction criteria without committing to new concrete action.
Listing on the EU Global Human Rights Sanctions list must meet the principles of legal soundness, evidentiary standards and EU unity.
Voor plaatsing op de EU Mensenrechtensanctielijst moet worden voldaan aan de uitgangspunten van juridische soliditeit, bewijsstandaarden en EU-eenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht 'Kabinet stuurt vrouwen terug naar Taliban in Afghanistan'

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the government accepts that Taliban rules against women amount to persecution and how deportations of Afghan women fit with Netherlands' legal action against Afghanistan under CEDAW. The minister answered that individual assessment continues, that the Taliban rules can ground asylum under current policy, that forced return is currently not possible, and that the government will not comment further on the ongoing legal proceedings and will publish a new country report soon.
On this process [and questions related to this international legal procedure] the cabinet, in the interest of the liability claim, cannot make further statements.
Over dit proces [en vragen gerelateerd aan deze internationaal-juridische procedure] kan het kabinet, in het belang van de aansprakelijkstelling, geen verdere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over plannen van de Europese Commissie voor een eigen inlichtingendienst

An MP asked whether the European Commission's reported plan for its own intelligence unit would transfer national security powers to Brussels and undermine member-state control. The minister said no Commission proposal has been shared yet, that intelligence sharing with the EU's SIAC is voluntary, that the Netherlands supports closer EU intelligence cooperation via SIAC, and that a future proposal would be assessed and reported to parliament.
If a proposal from the European Commission is published, your House will, as usual, be informed of it through a cabinet response.
Indien er een voorstel vanuit de Europese Commissie gepubliceerd wordt, zal uw Kamer zoals gebruikelijk hierover geïnformeerd worden door middel van een kabinetsreactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de situatie in Soedan

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether the Netherlands, as a party to the Genocide Convention, must act to prevent genocide in Sudan, what preventive steps it takes, how it deals with UAE support to the RSF (arms export licences, trade deal, gold imports, sanctions), and whether it will implement parliamentary motions. The government answers that genocide requires a high evidentiary bar, describes diplomatic, humanitarian and EU-level efforts, states that arms licences to the UAE are assessed case by case with no diversion risk found, and says the EU trade negotiations continue under a mandate that considers compliance with international law, without committing to suspend them.
The cabinet assesses all licence applications for the export of military goods case by case and carefully under the EU Common Position on arms export control.
Het kabinet toetst alle vergunningaanvragen voor de uitvoer van militaire goederen per geval en zorgvuldig conform het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexportcontrole
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Eerdmans over het voorstel van Eurocommissaris Brunner voor het verspreiden van asielzoekers over Europa

MPs Boomsma and Eerdmans asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether the Netherlands received the Commission's relocation proposal, whether they could see the figures, whether Bulgaria and others get reductions, whether the Netherlands qualifies, what data was supplied, and how the Eerdmans motion was implemented. The minister confirmed receipt, offered the document for confidential inspection, said several states including Bulgaria qualify for reductions, said the Netherlands is flagged at risk of migration pressure, that no extra data was supplied, and that a financial solidarity contribution will be committed to.
The document was made available to your House for confidential inspection on 26 November.
Het stuk is op 26 november aan uw Kamer aangeboden ter vertrouwelijk inzage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over de stand van zaken van de uitvoering van de SP motie om te stoppen met de commerciële noodopvang

Two MPs from the SP ask the minister about progress in ending commercial emergency asylum shelter, as required by two adopted motions, including how many places and parties remain and how costs are developing. The minister says COA is expanding regular shelter places and the number of hotel and boat places rose to about 21,000 by 1 November 2025, costs are not expected to fall this year, and the government is pursuing measures to reduce inflow and speed outflow.
The number of regular COA shelter places is rising steadily, from an expected approximately 40,000 on 1 November 2025 to approximately 51,000 by 1 January 2027.
Het aantal reguliere opvangplekken van het COA stijgt gestaag, naar huidige verwachting van circa 40.000 op 1 november 2025 naar circa 51.000 op 1 januari 2027.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de beslisnota bij Terugkeerondersteuning Syrië

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how the raised departure premium of EUR 5,000 per adult for Syrians was determined, whether those who take it should be barred from future asylum or residence, and how re-entry could be detected through biometrics and border checks, and whether the support should extend to other migrant groups. The Minister answered that the amount follows the Ukraine precedent, that participants sign a declaration withdrawing pending or granted residence procedures, that re-entry would be refused under Schengen rules with the prior choice weighed in any new asylum assessment, and that identity is already recorded via DTenV systems.
Someone who departs with support signs a declaration by which any pending residence procedures, or an already granted residence permit, are withdrawn.
Iemand die met ondersteuning vertrekt tekent een verklaring waarmee eventuele aanhangige verblijfsmatige procedures, dan wel een reeds afgegeven verblijfsvergunning, worden/wordt ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de hongersnood in de Sudanese steden Al-Fasher en Kadugli

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views reports of famine, mass killings and ethnic cleansing in Al-Fasher and Kadugli in Sudan, whether genocide is possible, and what diplomatic, legal and humanitarian steps Netherlands will take including pressure on the UAE and sanctions on RSF leaders. The minister answered that independent fact-finding is needed, that genocide requires a high evidentiary bar, that the Netherlands supports the UN fact-finding mission and ICC work, and referred to a further letter to parliament.
Genocide is an extremely serious qualification, and therefore the cabinet is generally reluctant to qualify situations as genocide.
Genocide is een uiterst serieuze kwalificatie en daarom is het kabinet in de regel terughoudend om situaties als genocide te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de situatie in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the situation in Sudan, El Fasher, RSF genocide designation, sanctions, arms exports via the UAE, fact-finding, journalist support and humanitarian aid. The government answered that it shares concern, applies a high bar for genocide qualification, pursues sanctions and engagement with the UAE, supports the fact-finding mission and humanitarian aid, and reviews export licences case by case.
The cabinet assesses all export licence applications for military goods case by case and carefully under the EU Common Position on arms export control.
Het kabinet toetst alle vergunningaanvragen voor de uitvoer van militaire goederen per geval en zorgvuldig conform het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexportcontrole
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat Minister Yeşilgöz in 2022 KPMG inschakelde en interne juristen omzeilde in de aanpak van de crisis rond Ter Apel

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that a previous minister hired KPMG and bypassed internal legal advisers during the 2022 Ter Apel crisis, including whether the legal department was excluded from the 26 August 2022 letter and why appeals were pursued. The minister answered that DWJZ was not involved in drafting that letter due to the speed of the process but had regular contact, that the KPMG report and a traffic-light document were supplied, costs were 70,952.90 euro, and that the Chamber was not misinformed.
Due to the speed of the process, DWJZ was not involved in drafting the letter of 26 August 2022.
In de snelheid van het proces is DWJZ niet betrokken geweest bij het opstellen van de brief van 26 augustus 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat ING de Russische staat met honderden miljoenen financierde

An SP MP asked the government whether it would act against ING for reportedly financing the Russian state with hundreds of millions, and how sanctions enforcement and Parliament's oversight of it could be improved. The government answered that the purchases dated from 2014-2022 under looser rules, that enforcement is for independent authorities, that it will not comment on individual cases, and that it will send the Chamber general updates and submit the Wis sanctions bill after Raad van State advice.
For reasons of commercial confidentiality, the government will not address the investments of individual companies.
Het kabinet gaat omwille van bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet in op de investeringen van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over aanvallen van Hamas op Palestijnen in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported Hamas executions and attacks on Palestinians in Gaza after the ceasefire, including claims about ambulances, clan appeals and protection of minorities. The minister said the government could not verify specific incidents, condemned misuse of civilian means, and pointed to the peace plan, Hamas disarmament and humanitarian and EU support as the way to protect civilians.
The cabinet cannot independently verify this specific incident.
Het kabinet kan dit specifieke incident niet eigenstandig verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de 'politiehandleiding complotdenken'

An MP from FVD asks the Minister of Justice and Security about an internal police handbook on conspiracy thinking, questioning whether it wrongly criminalises critical citizens and whether conspiracy beliefs about elites or institutions are treated as radicalisation. The Minister confirms the handbook exists, says it was an internal aid not meant for publication, acknowledges some passages could cause confusion and will be adjusted, and largely refers to AIVD and NCTV reports without answering the substantive questions.
Moreover, the police have indicated that they acknowledge that some parts of the handbook could cause confusion without the proper context. They will therefore adjust the handbook on some points.

Overigens heeft de politie laten weten dat zij erkennen dat sommige onderdelen in de handreiking zonder de juiste context voor verwarring kunnen zorgen. Zij zullen de handreiking daarom op sommige punten aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de jaarlijkse medische kostenpost na terugkeer

Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how much the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek spends on medical treatment before and after return, and the annual medical cost under article 64 of the Vreemdelingenwet. The government answered that DTenV does not separately record medical costs and cannot give an amount, and that costs under article 64 for COA residents were about 4.1 to 7.1 million euro per year from 2020 to 2024, with other costs often covered by the OVV scheme without tracking the article 64 link.
The DTenV systems do not record medical care costs separately.
In de systemen van de DTenV worden de kosten voor medische zorg niet apart bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Werf over de beveiliging van de Israëlische delegatie door een voormalig legerofficier met illegale wapens

MPs Paternotte and Van der Werf asked about an armed private security guard, a former Israeli army officer, who was caught at Schiphol with illegal pistols while guarding an Israeli delegation, and about checks, prior notification, and possible training of Dutch police by him. The minister answered that armed guards require prior government permission, that no request was received for this visit, that individual cases are not discussed publicly, that police and army used the guard's company for training in the past, and that no other similar incidents are known.
I never make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de Israëlische aanval op de Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about reported drone attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla, the treatment of Dutch participants, and whether to condemn Israel, press for EU/UN action, or seek sanctions. The Foreign Minister says the government abhors violence against peaceful activists, cannot confirm Dutch citizens were aboard the attacked ships, has asked Israel for a legal justification and is awaiting it, and has pressed for safe passage and humanitarian access without committing to sanctions or a formal condemnation.
The cabinet rejects any form of violence against peaceful activists.
Het kabinet keurt elke vorm van geweld tegen vreedzame actievoerders af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de drone-aanvallen op de Gaza Sumud Flotilla

The MP Piri asks whether the government will condemn drone attacks on the Gaza Sumud Flotilla, call Israel to account, and support the flotilla's Dutch citizens and humanitarian access. The minister says the government lacks independent information on the attacks, has repeatedly urged Israel not to use force and to protect Dutch passengers, and gives no direct answer on whether the blockade is illegal.
The cabinet has no independent information on the precise nature and circumstances of the reported attacks.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de precieze aard en toedracht van de gerapporteerde aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Opvarenden Global Sumud Flotilla melden nachtelijke aanvallen van Israël, Italië stuurt fregat'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the government has independent information on reported Israeli attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla, whether it condemns them, whether it considers the Gaza blockade illegal, what contact it has had with Dutch participants, and how it protects them. The minister answers that the government lacks independent information, declines to condemn or confirm the attacks, reports diplomatic contacts and requests to Israel and Spain and Italy, and says sanctions are not on the table.
The cabinet has no independent information about the precise nature and circumstances of the reported attacks.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de precieze aard en toedracht van de gerapporteerde aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Global Sumud Flotilla

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns the Israeli interception and attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters, and whether it will pursue sanctions and raise the matter in the EU and UN. The minister replied that insufficient facts were known for a definitive judgment, that the ministry asked Israel to substantiate its legal basis, and that sanctions were not currently on the table.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities to substantiate the legal basis for Israel's actions.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het illegale 'Israëlische' enteren van de Global Sumud Flotilla

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla, whether the government condemns it, whether it violates international law, how Dutch participants will be freed, and whether sanctions will be imposed. The minister confirmed awareness of the interception, said the ministry requested Israel's legal justification, called for scaled-up humanitarian access, and said sanctions are not currently under consideration while awaiting that justification.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities for a justification of the legal basis for Israel's actions following the interception of the ships.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen naar aanleiding van de onderschepping van de schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het massaal doden van straathonden in Marokko voor het WK- voetbal

An MP asked the government whether it knows that stray dogs in Morocco are being mass-killed ahead of the 2030 World Cup, whether it will raise this with Morocco, and whether it will press against a draft law criminalising feeding strays. The government replied that the matter is an internal Moroccan affair, that it supports a combined approach to stray dogs rather than mass killing, and that it will not raise the issue bilaterally or at EU level beyond noting Morocco's new national legislation.
This concerns an internal Moroccan matter.
Het betreft hier een interne Marokkaanse aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat in Niger christenen tijdens een doopceremonie gedood zijn

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 22 Christians, including 15 at a baptism ceremony, in western Niger, and about the security situation, international withdrawal, and Dutch support. The minister acknowledged the attacks, described rising jihadist violence, outlined Dutch programmes against extremism, and declined to send a new letter to parliament on the Sahel in the short term.

Although it will of course comply with a formal request, the Cabinet considers the situation on the ground and the Dutch engagement not to have changed enough at present that the House should be informed again in the short term.

Hoewel het uiteraard zal voldoen aan een formeel verzoek, acht het Kabinet de situatie ter plekke en de Nederlandse inzet momenteel niet dermate veranderd dat de Kamer hierover op korte termijn opnieuw geïnformeerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de ratificatie van het VN-oceaanverdrag (BBNJ-overeenkomst)

MP Teunissen asked whether the Netherlands' delayed ratification of the UN high seas (BBNJ) treaty undermines its credibility on ocean protection, and whether it will avoid supporting harmful activities meanwhile. The government answered that domestic implementing legislation is still being prepared, that ratification documents may reach parliament only in late 2026, and that it will attend the first COP while not facilitating harmful activities under international law.
Due to the time limits for the various phases of these procedures, the expectation is that the approval documents can be submitted to the House of Representatives at the earliest by the end of 2026.
Vanwege de termijnen die voor de verschillende fasen in deze procedures staan, is de verwachting dat de goedkeuringsstukken op zijn vroegst eind 2026 aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de antiregeringsprotesten in Georgië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about mass protests and arrests in Georgia, whether the Netherlands should protect European democracy against Russian influence, whether it should use all unilateral and multilateral tools against Georgia, and whether it could impose independent sanctions under the Sanctiewet 1977. The minister answered that Georgian cooperation programmes were suspended, the OSCE Vienna Mechanism was initiated, EU funds were halted and visa measures applied, but that the Sanctiewet 1977 does not allow independent Dutch sanctions and the joint ministerial statement is insufficiently concrete to serve as a basis.
Under the Sanctiewet 1977 the Netherlands cannot impose independent sanctions; sanctions are implemented only when they follow from international obligations.
Op grond van de Sanctiewet 1977 kan Nederland geen zelfstandige sancties opleggen, maar worden sancties uitgevoerd die voortvloeien uit internationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over christenvervolging in Afrika

MP Stoffer asks the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christian villages in Nigeria, the government's bilateral and EU diplomacy, and the role of the Special Envoy for Religion and Belief. The government acknowledges the religious dimension of the violence, says it raises freedom of religion with Nigeria and in the EU, but gives mostly general answers without firm new commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this shortly.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hier binnenkort over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het datalek bij het Openbaar Ministerie

The MP asks what recovery steps have been taken after the hack of the Public Prosecution Service (OM), how their effectiveness is verified, and whether there are signs that sensitive data such as shelter addresses, witness data and HR files were accessed or misused. The Minister says steps followed the security frameworks, the first technical and forensic investigation found no signs of data manipulation or extraction so far, criminal investigation continues, and an independent investigation commission will be set up, while not giving details on the ongoing criminal probe.
I cannot make any statements about the ongoing criminal investigation.
Over het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op het vragen van lid Piri over het artikel ‘Wat de wonden vertellen’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Volkskrant investigation alleging Israeli forces deliberately shot and wounded Palestinian children with fragmentation weapons, and about humanitarian access, accountability for war crimes, and medical evacuations from Gaza. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reporting, stressed international humanitarian law and accountability efforts, noted engagement with Israel on access, and agreed to evacuate some seriously injured children to the Netherlands.
The cabinet has no independent information that can verify or refute the Volkskrant investigation.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie die het onderzoek van de Volkskrant kan verifiëren dan wel ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de laatste stand van zaken aangaande de Nederlandse inzet op de humanitaire crisis in Soedan

The MP Teunissen asked the government about steps taken on documentation of humanitarian law violations in Sudan, humanitarian access, peace process support and periodic reporting to parliament. The minister answered that Nederland supports the Fact Finding Mission's mandate, pushes for humanitarian access and EU diplomacy, and commits to inform parliament periodically, including a forthcoming letter on El Fasher.
On major developments regarding the humanitarian situation in Sudan and humanitarian aid and diplomatic efforts, the cabinet will inform the House.
Bij grote ontwikkelingen rondom de humanitaire situatie in Soedan en humanitaire hulp en diplomatieke inspanningen zal het kabinet uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de beschietingen van humanitaire reddingsschepen door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about Libyan coast guard shootings at humanitarian rescue ships (Ocean Viking and Sea-Watch 5), Dutch involvement, EU funding of the Libyan coast guard, and Dutch steps on accountability, rules of engagement and NGO criminalisation. The minister answered that the government has no independent information, condemned the violence, urged Libyan authorities to investigate through the embassy and EU delegation, and said it would inform parliament on request.
The cabinet does not have independent information about this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over beschietingen door de Libische kustwacht op NGO schepen in de Middellandse Zee

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns the shootings of NGO ships Sea-Watch 5 and Ocean Viking by the Libyan coast guard, whether EU funding facilitates such acts, and what protective and corrective measures it will take. The government said it lacks verified information that the Libyan coast guard was responsible or that Dutch nationals were aboard, condemned violence against aid workers, relied on EU monitoring and conditions for support, and committed only to calling on Libyan authorities to investigate.
The cabinet does not have verified and confirmed information that the shootings were carried out by the Libyan coast guard.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde en bevestigde informatie dat de beschietingen werden gepleegd door de Libische kustwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the NCTV uses or has access to Palantir, which ketenpartners receive signals from the police's Palantir analysis environment, which datasets and algorithms are involved, and whether those algorithms are published in the Algoritmeregister. The minister answered that the NCTV neither uses nor has access to Palantir, that only signals at case level (not information products or datasets) are shared with partners such as municipalities or the Openbaar Ministerie under the Wpg, and that the basic Palantir algorithms are not AI systems and therefore not registered.
No datasets are shared with those chain partners.
Er worden geen datasets gedeeld met die ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri en Nordkamp over Nederlandse onderdelen in Russische drones en raketten

MPs Timmermans, Piri and Nordkamp asked whether the government knew Dutch components were used in Russian drones and missiles, what concrete action was taken, whether the parts are covered by sanctions, and which Dutch firms are involved. The State Secretary answered that sanctions evasion is a priority, that the parts are already sanctioned, that enforcement rests with Customs and the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government cannot give insight into concrete actions against individual companies.
The cabinet cannot give insight into concrete actions that may be taken with individual companies.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in concrete acties die mogelijk worden gedaan bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de humanitaire situatie van de Druzen in Syrië

An MP asked the government about reported mass violence against Druze communities in Suwayda, Syria, including sieges, alleged sexual violence and possible ethnic cleansing, and asked what the Netherlands would do about international law, investigations and humanitarian aid. The minister condemned the violence, pointed to the UN Commission of Inquiry and a Syrian national commission, reported 46 aid convoys reaching Suwayda, and said the Netherlands will keep pressing for independent investigation and unhindered access.
The Netherlands continues to press for the publication of the outcomes of this investigation.
Nederland blijft aandringen op het belang van openbaarmaking van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Ministerie ‘trekt steun in’ voor wereldwijd klimaatcentrum in Rotterdam’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch government is ending funding for the Global Centre on Adaptation in Rotterdam, and about the consequences of a possible departure. The state secretary replied that the project funding simply runs to its contracted end date of 31 May 2026, that the foundation is independent and may reapply, and that the government will not withdraw support or change its climate adaptation commitments.
The current project funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs runs in line with the signed contract and ends on 31 May 2026.
Het huidige project dat door het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken wordt gefinancierd loopt in lijn met het gesloten contract op 31 mei 2026 af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de gevolgen van de storing bij het Openbaar Ministerie voor de aanvraag van een Verklaring omtrent Gedrag (VOG)

Sneller (D66) asked the Minister of Justice about the consequences of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) outage for VOG certificate applications and for JDS data, including whether applicants must reapply and who bears the costs. The State Secretary replied that the systems and data flows have been restored and the backlog cleared, that VOG decisions remain valid, and that a free reapplication or refund process is not feasible in the short term.
It is correct that the disruption at the OM meant that information from the OM dated after 17 July was missing from the JDS.
Het klopt dat de verstoring bij het OM ertoe heeft geleid dat informatie van het OM van na 17 juli jl. ontbrak in het JDS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, Sneller en Koops over het bericht dat justitiepersoneel bekneld raakt door de doorgeslagen verzuimaanpak van Detentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that a harsh sick-leave policy at Detentiecentrum Rotterdam pressures staff, blocks access to occupational doctors and may breach good employer rules. The State Secretary denied the policy is structural or that absenteeism there is significantly above the DJI average, acknowledged an incidental misapplication, and declined a separate investigation while noting ongoing verzuim monitoring.
However, this does not concern a structural practice or standing policy.
Het gaat hier echter niet om een structurele werkwijze of staand beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over de kwestie van de Armeense genocide

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked why the government still refers to 'the question' of the Armenian genocide despite a motion asking it to use the term genocide, and whether fear of Turkish reaction drives the stance. The minister replied that the government keeps the legal Genocide Convention definition, sees positive but precarious developments in the Armenia-Azerbaijan and Armenia-Turkey normalisation, and does not comment on other countries' motives.
As stated in the letter of last April, the cabinet maintains 'the question of the Armenian genocide'.
Zoals in de brief van afgelopen april vermeld staat, houdt het kabinet vast aan «de kwestie van de Armeense genocide».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'High Court rules state not giving Palestinian prisoners enough food'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a High Court ruling that the state is not giving Palestinian prisoners enough food, and Ben Gvir's refusal to accept it, and sought to know about prisoner deaths, legal rights, and whether Israel should be pressed and monitored. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised detention conditions bilaterally and multilaterally, cites UN figures of at least 75 deaths in detention, backs ICRC access, and will inform parliament if there is cause.
The cabinet raises these concerns in bilateral contacts with the Israeli authorities.
Het kabinet brengt deze zorgen op in bilaterale contacten met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Van Vroonhoven en Eerdmans over de toepassing van het Europese solidariteitsmechanisme

MPs Van Hijum, Van Vroonhoven and Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the EU solidarity mechanism under the Migration Pact, including Dutch stance, the 2026 solidarity pool, whether the Netherlands could be designated under migration pressure, and Dublin transfer figures. The minister answered that the Netherlands intends to contribute financially rather than through relocations, that its share is roughly 5-6%, that Dublin transfers depend on a plan of action, and that the Commission's decisions will be published, with the Council's pool proposal kept confidential.
The European Commission's proposal for a Council decision on the solidarity pool is confidential under Article 12(6) of the AMMR and other relevant EU legislation.
Het voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een raadsbesluit over de solidariteitspool is op grond van artikel 12 lid 6 van de AMMR en andere relevante uniewetgeving vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht 'Als trans persoon gevlucht voor Trumps beleid, maar is dat genoeg voor asiel? ‘Het is niet veilig voor haar’'

An MP from Volt asks the Asylum and Migration Minister and colleagues whether transgender US asylum claims can succeed given the Trump administration's policies, whether the 2024 US country report should be revised, and whether transgender people should be designated a risk group. The government answers that US developments do not currently justify presuming a well-founded fear of persecution for transgender Americans, that each claim is judged individually on recent sources, that no general country report is planned, and that discretionary residence permits will be reviewed after a Council of State ruling.
By letter of 27 August I informed your House about the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Bij brief van 27 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over nieuwe berichten over aanvallen op christenen in West- en Centraal-Afrika

ChristenUnie MPs Ceder and Bikker asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in West and Central Africa, whether perpetrators are mainly Islamist groups, whether the government will press Nigeria on specific demands, and on the status of EU and parliamentary motions. The minister condemned the violence, said it affects both Christians and Muslims with different dynamics per country, reaffirmed religious freedom as a priority, and said no date is known for an EU special envoy and the motion follow-up will be reported later.
The cabinet will inform your House about this shortly.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hier binnenkort over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de berichten dat op sommige plaatsen in Nederland de aanpak van (ondermijnende) criminaliteit doorgeslagen lijkt

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about reports that the aggressive local approach to undermining crime in Zaanstad and Breda, including home visits and forced entry into garages, bypasses residents' protections, with no information given and damage left unrepaired. The minister replies that home visits must follow statutory safeguards, that residents can object, go to court, contact the ombudsman or claim damages, and that municipalities are responsible for their own approach.
If the conduct of the authorities leads to a dispute with a citizen, that citizen can turn to the court.
Wanneer het handelen van de betrokken overheden leidt tot een geschil met een burger dan kan deze zich wenden tot de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse politie presenteert uitvinding tegen discriminatie: ‘de paal bepaalt’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Amsterdam police's random selection pole, a tool meant to prevent ethnic profiling in stop-and-search actions, and whether it would undermine police expertise and effectiveness and be rolled out nationally without parliamentary consent. The minister answered that the pole is a supporting tool for random checks, that the basis of professional checking remains the police guidance, that it does not affect investigation, that it has so far been used only by the Amsterdam unit, and that local authorities set the conditions, without committing to a parliamentary approval or abolition.
It is up to the mayor, in consultation with the public prosecution service and the police, to set the conditions for random checks and frisk actions.
Het is aan de burgemeester in samenspraak met het OM en de politie om de voorwaarden te bepalen van aselectieve controle- en fouilleeracties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht “Syrische christen onder druk in azc”

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of discrimination and intimidation against Syrian Christian asylum seekers in reception centres, and what measures would be taken, including whether perpetrators could lose asylum status and how to make the Gave reporting point more accessible. The minister answered that COA monitors the situation and has house rules, sanctions and intensive supervision, that victims decide on reporting to police, that asylum refusal for serious convictions is already possible, and that the situation in Syria is monitored without currently warranting a change in risk profile.
To date, this monitoring does not show that Christian asylum seekers are being discriminated against.
Tot op heden blijkt uit deze monitoring niet dat christelijke asielzoekers gediscrimineerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van der Burg over de aankondiging van Netanyahu dat migratiestromen uit Gaza zullen ontstaan

MPs Rajkowski and Van der Burg asked the government whether Netanyahu's announcement of Palestinian departures from Gaza would cause migration flows to the EU, how screening would catch Hamas members among asylum seekers, and how the Netherlands would press Israel and support the region. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes forced displacement, screens asylum seekers for war-crime indicators, works on regional reception and EU migration measures, and continues diplomatic pressure for a ceasefire.
For Dutch policy it is beyond question: Gaza belongs to the Palestinians.
Voor het Nederlands beleid staat buiten kijf: Gaza is van de Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over het artikel “Syrische Druzen werden buitengerechtelijk geëxecuteerd’’

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports of extrajudicial executions of Druze in Suwayda, whether the interim Syrian government is responsible, whether sanctions lifting undermines motion Ceder, and how Syria's investigations and accountability efforts are being supported. The minister answered that the government awaits the findings of the Syrian and UN inquiries, supports international accountability mechanisms, and will act with sanctions if the interim government does not deliver.
It is important to establish what exactly happened in Suweida and who was responsible for this violence.
Belangrijk is dat wordt vastgesteld wat er precies is voorgevallen in Suweida en wie verantwoordelijk is geweest voor dit geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Aanpak illegale goksites faalt: Kansspelautoriteit zet deurwaarders in'

An MP asks whether the Gambling Authority's call for stronger tools against illegal gambling sites is justified, and why bailiffs must now collect fines that illegal operators ignore. The Secretary of State says the government is extending the Authority's powers, including blocking websites and holding intermediaries liable, while noting Malta's contested law is under EU infringement proceedings.
I endorse the Gambling Authority's wish for additional instruments to block or take offline websites of illegal operators.
Ik onderschrijf de wens van de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) voor een aanvullend instrumentarium waarmee websites van illegale aanbieders kunnen worden geblokkeerd of offline kunnen worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het niet naleven van sancties tegen Rusland door Nederlandse internetproviders

Dobbe (SP) asked whether the government knew Dutch internet providers were not complying with EU sanctions against Russian propaganda media, and what it would do about low compliance and the lack of parliamentary insight into enforcement. The minister answered that non-compliance was known, that the matter is for the Public Prosecution Service, that the government is in ongoing talks with the European Commission on clarifying the ban, that it does not discuss individual cases for privacy and investigation reasons, and that over 50 criminal investigations have been started.
The cabinet does not address individual cases for reasons of privacy, the interest of (criminal) investigation, and because establishing possible violations is ultimately a matter for the court.

Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele gevallen om redenen van privacy, in het belang van (strafrechtelijk) onderzoek en omdat het vaststellen van mogelijke overtredingen uiteindelijk aan de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het instrument van erkennen van een staat

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about conditions attached to recognition of Palestine by France, Canada, the UK, Australia and Belgium, and about the general criteria and practice for recognising states. The minister answered that recognition is a sovereign act, outlined the Montevideo criteria and EU practice in 1991, and said the Netherlands has not recognised Palestine yet, as recognition should form part of a two-state political process and requires reforms by the Palestinian Authority.

Recognition requires careful consideration, looking not only at what it could mean for a possible lasting solution but also at what we expect from the Palestinian Authority regarding necessary reforms.

Erkenning vraagt om een zorgvuldige afweging, waarbij niet alleen gekeken moet worden wat dit kan betekenen voor een eventuele duurzame oplossing, maar ook wat we verwachten van de Palestijnse Autoriteit met betrekking tot noodzakelijke hervormingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bezoek van de Indonesische president aan Nederland en mensenrechtenschendingen in West-Papoea

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would meet the Indonesian president during his visit, whether the Netherlands bears a duty of care toward West Papua, and how Indonesia is pressed on human rights abuses there. The minister denied a meeting with the Prime Minister, described the human rights situation as worrying, and listed bilateral, EU and multilateral channels, while declining to say whether the King would raise the issue because such talks are confidential.
The Royal Couple received the president at Huis ten Bosch Palace; it is customary that conversations the Royal Couple holds at the Palace are confidential.
Het Koninklijk Paar heeft de president ontvangen op Paleis Huis ten Bosch; het is een goed gebruik dat de gesprekken die het Koninklijk Paar op het Paleis voert vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het aankomend verbod op gezichtsbedekking tijdens demonstraties

An MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about the planned ban on face coverings at demonstrations, including its compatibility with ECHR Articles 10 and 11, the Hague court ruling, police workload and the effect on protesters fearing foreign repression. The minister confirms work on a statutory ban, says it is in principle legally possible and that a consultation bill is planned this year, while leaving the design, exemptions and police concerns open.
The cabinet shares the concerns of MP Lahlah about the safety of demonstrators who face a security risk when they demonstrate recognisably.
Het deelt daarbij de zorgen van het lid Lahlah over de veiligheid van demonstranten die een veiligheidsrisico lopen wanneer zij herkenbaar demonstreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State dat Nederland verplicht is kinderen te horen in de asielprocedures

Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration how the government will respond to a Council of State ruling that unaccompanied children aged 12 to 15 must be given a real chance to be heard in asylum and Dublin procedures, and whether children under 12 and the information given to children will change. The minister agrees children must be able to express their views, says the IND practice will be adjusted to inform children of their right to be heard and to require individual justification for refusals, and says new policy for under-12s is still being developed, so no further statement can yet be made.

Hearings therefore took place with their parents or legal guardian on their behalf, unless the accompanied minor or their parent or legal guardian requested that the minor be heard directly or the IND had good reasons for it.

Het gehoor vond dus plaats met hun ouders of wettelijke vertegenwoordiger mede voor hen, tenzij de begeleide minderjarige of zijn ouder of wettelijke vertegenwoordiger verzochten om de minderjarige rechtstreeks te horen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Verdachte aangehouden voor ernstig zedenmisdrijf op Amsterdamse Weesperzijde

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the rule of law applies to asylum seekers, whether consequences such as withheld allowances or asylum withdrawal always follow offences, how repeat offending is prevented, whether an amendment on unwelcome declarations should be used, whether experts should be consulted, and how unpaid public transport fines are charged to asylum seekers. The minister replied that criminal law applies equally, that lik-op-stuk policy and asylum withdrawal on public order grounds are applied, that existing measures suffice for now, and that fine collection is the responsibility of carriers, with ongoing talks with COA and other parties.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Ceder, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over dat Nederland moet meewerken aan overbrengen ambassadebewakers

Six MPs asked the ministers whether the Dutch state must help transport 42 Afghan embassy guards after a summary-judgment ruling that the state acted unlawfully by not evacuating them. The minister contests the ruling, says the guards were not state employees, has appealed on an urgent basis, and says the appeal court suspended enforcement pending its decision, so no further transport steps are being taken.
On 12 September the appeal court suspended the State's obligation to immediately implement the judgment until it has ruled on the appeal.
Het gerechtshof heeft op 12 september jl. de verplichting voor de Staat geschorst om per direct uitvoering te geven aan het vonnis totdat het hof in het hoger beroep over deze zaak heeft geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ceder over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over het overplaatsen van de heer Singh

MP Ceder asked the Foreign and Justice ministers why the government had not yet sent the transfer request for Mr Singh after the court ruling, and how it had handled the earlier motion and WOTS procedure. The state secretary answered that the request was sent within the court's deadline, that the state will carry out the ruling, and that transfer under the WOTS policy was not the appropriate route due to insufficient ties to the Netherlands.
The request for transfer of sentence was sent to the American authorities within the time limit set by the Court of Appeal.
Het verzoek tot strafoverdracht is uitgestuurd naar de Amerikaanse autoriteiten binnen de door het Gerechtshof gestelde termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht 'Verdachte die biddende moslim doodstak in Zuid-Frankrijk, meldt zich op Italiaans politiebureau'

MP El Abassi (DENK) asked the Justice Minister about the fatal stabbing of a Muslim worshipper in a French mosque, the alleged Islamophobic climate fostered by politicians, and whether Dutch authorities take Muslim concerns about safety and discrimination seriously. The government denies that Dutch ministers foster an Islamophobic climate, acknowledges Muslim discrimination, describes ongoing dialogue and existing guidance, but declines to commit to structural mosque security measures or a dedicated anti-Muslim-hatred campaign.
The cabinet does not register the number of signals received.
Het kabinet registreert niet het aantal binnengekomen signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Nispen over het (demissionaire) kabinetsstandpunt inzake het initiatiefwetsvoorstel Centraal Aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR)

MPs Van der Lee and Van Nispen asked the government about its position on the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR), including the KPMG report, the UBO register's 25% threshold, and notary and Chamber of Commerce feasibility. The acting government declined to pre-empt parliamentary handling, said it would give its appraisal when the bill is debated, and stated the UBO register and CAHR are complementary.
The cabinet does not anticipate the parliamentary handling of the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR).
Het kabinet loopt niet vooruit op de behandeling van het initiatiefwetsvoorstel voor een centraal aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR) door uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de uitspraken van minister van Justitie en Veiligheid over de afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the Justice minister to explain remarks about Dutch dependence on US tech giants, whether this requires reducing that dependence quickly, and what the government's digital autonomy position is.
