The government answers that the European cloud market is concentrated, that a sovereign government cloud and a revised cloud policy are being explored, and that the Justice ministry will contribute to the revised cloud policy and digital sovereignty vision.
Reducing dependencies is currently being considered in the revision of the government-wide cloud policy.
Het afbouwen van afhankelijkheden nemen wij momenteel mee in de herziening van het Rijksbreed cloudbeleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Six Dijkstra over het (structureel) gebruik van het controversiële Amerikaanse softwaresysteem Parlantir

MPs Van Vroonhoven and Six Dijkstra asked about the use of Palantir software by Dutch public bodies, including police, data handling, procurement, EU/NATO indirect use and oversight. The government answered that only the police use Palantir in the analysis environment 'de Raffinaderij' on police data, that the six safety regions' 2021 pilot ended, and that procurement and contract details are confidential or were covered earlier, while promising little concrete new action beyond referring to earlier answers.
The financial details regarding the contract concerned are confidential and cannot be made public.
De financiële details met betrekking tot het betrokken contract zijn vertrouwelijk en kunnen niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf ver het bericht ‘Steeds meer fouten in processen-verbaal, jaarlijks tienduizenden overtreders vrijuit’

MPs Sneller and Van der Werf asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that rising errors in police reports on offences (processen-verbaal) let tens of thousands of offenders go unpunished each year. The Minister said about 32% of reports on offences were rejected in 2024, with roughly 18% never approved, and outlined measures to reduce errors but gave no concrete figures on lost fines.
I cannot give an amount here because, as I indicated in my answer to question 3, we do not know what the prosecution decision would have been had these reports been approved.

Ik kan hier geen bedrag noemen omdat we, zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heb aangegeven, niet weten hoe de vervolgbeslissing van het OM zou zijn uitgevallen als deze processen-verbaal wel waren goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over de recente cyberaanvallen middels kwetsbaarheden in Sharepoint en Netscaler

MPs asked the government about the impact of recent cyberattacks exploiting SharePoint and Citrix Netscaler vulnerabilities, including the compromise of Public Prosecution Service systems, attribution policy and information sharing by the NCSC. The minister answered that the impact on government and society was limited, that compromises at some national organisations are under investigation, and that attribution decisions are taken by the cabinet after weighing many factors, while the Cybersecurity Act is expected to improve information sharing.
What the exact consequences of the compromise are is the subject of ongoing investigation.
Wat de exacte consequenties van de compromittatie zijn, is onderwerp van lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de explosieve stijging van fraude met visa en phishing

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the sharp rise in visa fraud and phishing, including reported case numbers, the role of travel portals, prevention campaigns and the Anti-Phishing Shield pilot. The Minister answered that no reliable police figures exist for visa fraud or phishing, outlined public awareness campaigns, the online fraud integrated approach, and a six-month APS pilot with KPN.
There are currently no reliable figures available on the number of police reports concerning visa fraud.
Er zijn op dit moment geen betrouwbare cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal aangiften over visumverstrekking bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat meerdere moorden op gewone Nederlanders zijn besteld via het dark web

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that at least seven murders of ordinary Dutch citizens were ordered via dark web platforms, asking about police knowledge, victim protection, investigative capacity and international cooperation. The minister gave mostly evasive answers, declining to discuss individual cases, protection measures and investigative methods, while pointing to digital recruitment plans and Europol's dark web programme.

To prevent investigation and prosecution of criminal offences in ongoing inquiries from being frustrated, neither the police nor the public prosecution service provide insight into the investigative strategies and methods used.

Om te voorkomen dat opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten in lopende onderzoeken mogelijk wordt gefrustreerd, wordt door politie en het openbaar ministerie geen inzicht gegeven in gehanteerde onderzoeksstrategieën en methodieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over vernielingen bij de As-Soennah moskee in Assen

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about two window-smashing incidents at the As-Soennah mosque in Assen, whether they were treated as possibly anti-Islam, why a first complaint was closed quickly, and what protection is planned. The Minister expressed concern and said police and prosecutors pursue discrimination offences actively, but declined to comment on the individual case and left mosque security largely to local authorities.
It is not for me to make statements in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen in individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de artikelen 'Kantoor CIDI in Den Haag beklad: ’De waanzin dendert door’, 'Gebouw CIDI beklad met ketchup en bloem, gebeurde tijdens Gazadebat' en 'Zijn deze kunstenaars al

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the defacing of the CIDI office in The Hague and a CIDI board member's home, including whether suspects have been arrested and what protection measures exist for staff. The minister declined to comment on the individual investigation, said responsibility for security lies mainly with employers and local authorities, and rejected new laws or a dedicated prosecution policy, while pointing to existing funds, taskforce work and recent criminal-law changes.
I understand that this is a serious situation, but as usual I cannot comment on individual cases.
Ik begrijp dat dit een ingrijpende situatie is, maar zoals gebruikelijk kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘We hebben geen zin meer in politiek’

MP Boswijk asked the Justice Minister about the Jewish Police Network withdrawing from police network consultations because members feel pressured to account for Middle East events. The minister respects the decision, says the police leadership handles it, and states that Jews in the Netherlands are not responsible for Israeli politics.
Like the Chief of Police, I respect this choice made by the employees.
Ik respecteer net als de Korpschef deze keuze van de medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rolverdeling tussen de ministeries betreffende het onderwijs aan kinderen in de asielopvang

An MP from the SP asked the Ministers of Education and of Asylum and Migration how responsibility for education for children in asylum reception is divided between the ministries, whether the Education Minister can intervene, and how the 3-month access deadline and the school admission timelines are met. The state secretary answered that OCW sets the legal framework, municipalities hold the duty to provide places, COA handles placement and coordination, and the ministries consult regularly, while admitting that the three-month target is not always met and that the Education Minister has no specific powers beyond emergency temporary newcomer facilities, which have been used 16 times.
Due to the persistent shortage of reception places, it is not always possible to place children in locations where educational facilities are available.
Door het aanhoudende tekort aan opvangplekken lukt het niet altijd om kinderen te plaatsen in locaties waar onderwijsvoorzieningen beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over hoe het demissionaire kabinet omgaat met de keuze voor mailcommunicatie in eigen beheer

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the caretaker cabinet how it handles the choice to keep government email and data in-house rather than in Microsoft's cloud, including the Exchange support deadline of 14 October 2025 and US sanctions risks. The State Secretary answered that departments decide on cloud use themselves, most ministries and agencies keep mail on-premise, the Belastingdienst is considering a Microsoft365 migration, and the government will sharpen its cloud and digital sovereignty policy without committing to a binding halt.
Departments are themselves responsible for deciding which considerations they make regarding cloud use.
Departementen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen welke afwegingen zij maken rondom cloudgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat het Joods Politienetwerk tijdelijk uit het netwerkoverleg van de politie is gestapt

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Jewish Police Network temporarily leaving the police network consultation because members were repeatedly pressed about Gaza, and about whether Jews are held responsible for Israeli government actions and how police neutrality and protection of the Jewish community are ensured. The minister respects the members' decision, calls it regrettable, says he has no signals that police as a whole contribute to Jewish insecurity, and will investigate any signals of compromised neutrality, while referring to the antisemitism strategy and a debate on 23 September.
Should persons within the organisation be guilty of this, I assume the Chief of Police will address it firmly.
Mochten personen binnen de organisatie zich hier wel schuldig aan maken, dan ga ik er vanuit dat de Korpschef dit stevig aanpakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de uitspraak van de rechter dat digitale platforms geen openbare plaats zijn in de zin van de APV

Sneller (D66) asked the government to respond to a Council of State ruling that digital platforms are not a public place under municipal bylaws, and asked whether the earlier cabinet position was wrong, why no national vision exists, and what alternatives exist for online incitement. Minister Van Oosten answers that the ruling concerns only the Utrecht bylaw, denies the earlier position was wrong, lists existing tools and a pending consultation bill on data gathering, and commits to keep discussing with practitioners, while rejecting expanding the ATKM's mandate for now.
Naturally, I am looking concretely at options to further strengthen the room for action.
Uiteraard kijk ik concreet naar mogelijkheden om het handelingsperspectief verder te verstevigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht 'Pijnlijk: Terwijl homoacceptatie vrijwel overal groeit, daalt die in ‘gaycapital’ Amsterdam

An MP asked the Justice Minister and Education State Secretary about falling acceptance of homosexuality among youth in Amsterdam, the gap for youth with migrant backgrounds, prosecution and sentencing for discrimination, and whether the government would act on Amsterdam neighbourhoods and prosecution guidelines. The government said the research is ongoing, Amsterdam is responsible for local action, prosecution guidelines and sentencing policy are already adequate, and the questions could not be answered in time.
There is no overview available of prosecution demands and sentences in cases involving discrimination and/or violence where sexual orientation plays a role.
Er is geen overzicht voorhanden van strafeisen en vonnissen waarbij sprake is van discriminatie en/of geweld waar geaardheid een rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de verkoop van het gasdrukwapen ‘Sentinel’ en de hiaten in de wet

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the legal sale of the 'Sentinel' gas-pressure weapon that may resemble a firearm, and about gaps in the Weapons and Ammunition Act. The minister acknowledged the legal ambiguity ('sprekende gelijkenis'), said the act will be modernised with an advisory review pending, and gave no monitoring data on sales or incidents.
The police have no insight into the scale, since the sale is then legal.
De politie heeft geen inzicht in de omvang, aangezien de verkoop dan legaal is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de migratietop die op 18 juli 2025 door Duitsland in Beieren is georganiseerd

An MP from JA21 asked why the Netherlands sent no delegation to Germany's July 2025 migration summit in Bavaria, whether it received an invitation, what steps were taken on a motion about the ECHR letter and on treaty changes, and how it stays aligned with European partners. The minister replied that the Netherlands was not invited like several other EU states, pointed to existing EU initiatives and to later reports, and promised further information on the treaty review before the recess.
The Netherlands, like some other neighbouring countries and EU member states, did not receive an invitation to this meeting and therefore sent no delegation.
Nederland ontving net als enkele andere buurlanden en EU-lidstaten geen uitnodiging voor deze bijeenkomst en stuurde daarom geen afvaardiging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat een Joods echtpaar met jonge kinderen in de omgeving van Arnhem is afgeperst door een crimineel die eerder optrad als kroongetuige in moordza

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that a Jewish family near Arnhem was extorted by a former crown witness, demanding action against the perpetrators, passport revocation and the minister's contact with the victims. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the antisemitism strategy, said passport revocation is limited by statute, and said assessing crown witness credibility is for the courts.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in individuele zaken te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Nederland mag van rechter geen mannelijke asielzoekers terugsturen naar België: 'Enorm frustrerend''

An MP asks the government about a court ruling that bars the Netherlands from returning single male asylum seekers to Belgium under Dublin, and what this means for migration control, the reception shortage and plans to restore transfers. The minister acknowledges the ruling undermines the Dublin system, reports about 170 affected men, and says talks with Belgium aim to resume transfers, with further steps on reception restrictions.
On that basis, the cabinet will consider whether the transfer of Dublin claimants can be resumed as soon as possible.
Het kabinet zal op basis daarvan bezien of de overdracht van Dublinclaimanten weer zo spoedig mogelijk hervat kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de AI-explosie van kinderporno

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported surge in child sexual abuse material linked to AI and encrypted apps, covering escalation risks, enforcement capacity, EU cooperation, prosecution rates, company responsibility and public awareness campaigns. The minister answers that enforcement capacity has been expanded but remains insufficient, outlines prevention and cooperation efforts, and declines to launch public campaigns on fake imagery due to backfire risks.
It is not recorded per report what the underlying reason is for prosecuting or not, so it is difficult to give exact figures on the actual imposition of sentences.

Er wordt niet bijgehouden per melding wat de achterliggende reden is om wel of niet tot vervolging over te gaan en daarom is het lastig om exacte cijfers te geven over het concreet opleggen van straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het onderhandelaarsresultaat voor de nieuwe politie-cao

SGP MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked whether the new police collective agreement, which makes three Christian holidays exchangeable for individual leave, undermines commonly recognised public holidays and why parliament was not consulted. The government answered that the holidays remain in the Algemene termijnenwet, that collective bargaining is an employer-union matter, and that the Barp amendment will be prepared via the ministerial process with later publication, but it did not commit to advance parliamentary involvement.
Your House will receive the answers to these questions well before this publication.
Uw Kamer ontvangt ruim voor deze publicatie de beantwoording op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht dat Douwe Bob een kortgeding aanspant tegen VVD-leider Dilan Yeşilgöz om Jodenhaat-tweet

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a lawsuit by singer Douwe Bob against VVD leader Dilan Yesilgoz over an antisemitism accusation, asking whether it constitutes defamation and whether the OM should be urged to act. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution is for the OM and courts, noted defamation is a complaint offence, and described existing legal safeguards and reporting channels.
As Minister, I do not comment on individual cases.
Als Minister spreek ik mij niet uit over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derzkzen over het bericht ‘TikTok-kalifaat lokt piepjonge kinderen in val’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about online jihadist propaganda such as TikTok content reaching minors, whether it is illegal, how the DSA and the ATKM can act, and how schools and coordination can respond. The Minister answers that terrorist content can be removed under the TOI regulation but 'legal yet harmful' content is hard to address given free speech, notes ongoing WODC research, and points to existing prevention, teacher training and coordination efforts.
I share the concerns about this type of content and the impact it can have, particularly on minors.
Ik deel de zorgen rond dit type content en de impact die dit met name kan hebben op minderjarigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de meer dan 2500 ontvangen meldingen van discriminatie na online bericht van Wilders

An MP asked the Justice Minister about over 2,500 discrimination reports after a Wilders post and whether the expression is racist, whether the OM is acting, and what risks and steps follow. The minister declined to qualify the post, said prosecution and free-speech assessment rest with the OM and courts, would not comment on the OM case, and only generally acknowledged the risks and referred to inclusion efforts.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to assess whether a punishable expression is involved and, if so, whether prosecution is instituted.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om te beoordelen of er sprake is van een strafbare uiting en, zo ja, of vervolging wordt ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Piri over asielaanvragen van lhbtqia+-personen uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Westerveld and Piri asked whether asylum applications from LGBTQIA+ people from the United States have risen, whether the government will engage the US on this, whether US safety for LGBTQIA+ people is reassessed, and whether enough dedicated reception places exist. The Minister said such motives are not registered, applications rose modestly to 35 by July 2025, US safety does not in general justify asylum, and COA places LGBTQIA+ residents together in units when requested but has no fixed quota.
Asylum motives, such as sexual orientation or gender, are not systematically registered and therefore cannot be reproduced at an aggregated level.
Asielmotieven, zoals seksuele geaardheid of gender, worden niet systematisch geregistreerd en zijn dus niet op geaggregeerd niveau te reproduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Bikker over recente incidenten rond Joodse Nederlanders

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about recent incidents against Jewish Dutch people and institutions, the resulting intimidation, whether the government will cover community security costs, and what is being done against antisemitism on social media. The minister confirms the concern, calls on victims to file reports, points to the Strategy Combating Antisemitism 2024–2030 and a 1.3 million euro Security Fund now open for applications, and refers to an online discrimination action plan.
I have no national overview of all the security costs borne by the Jewish community.
Ik heb geen landelijk overzicht van alle beveiligingskosten die door de Joodse gemeenschap gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de AIVD

An FVD MP asked the Interior Minister about the AIVD's website claim that spreading a 'malicious elite' narrative creates a factually incorrect worldview, and about the AIVD's historian and the 'anti-institutional extremism' framing. The minister confirmed the statements, declined to ask the AIVD to research when the elite became benign, said citizens criticising the rule of law are not targeted, and gave evasive answers on how the AIVD would detect a shift back to a malicious elite.
The AIVD explicitly does not target citizens who voice criticism of how the democratic rule of law functions.
De AIVD richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op burgers die kritiek uiten op het functioneren van de democratische rechtstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the government about dependence on US tech giants for public cloud services, including whether ministries, DJI, IND and CJIB will reconsider migrations and whether data could be exposed under US law. The state secretary answers that existing cloud policy requires weighing risks, that migrations are being reconsidered under a temporary cloud policy line, and that dependence on US providers will largely persist for now while the cloud policy is revised.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful considerations regarding cloud migrations are of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op de leden Boon en Wilders over het voornemen van de HZ Omer Moskee in Epe om vanaf 20 juni 2025 wekelijks een islamitische gebedsoproep te laten horen

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the government would act against a mosque in Epe broadcasting a weekly Islamic call to prayer and whether it would ban such calls nationally. The Interior Minister answered that the freedom of religion protects calls to prayer, that local authorities set noise rules under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that the government is examining whether the rules need changing, with a report to parliament to follow.
The cabinet is examining whether the existing regulations need to be adjusted.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of de bestaande regelgeving aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Klaver over de schending van het Poolse luchtruim door Russische drones

MPs Timmermans and Klaver asked whether the government would convene an extra EU Council, form a leaders' group with Poland, push for a sanctions package banning Russian energy imports, accelerate REPowerEU, pressure blocking member states on frozen Russian assets, and explain remaining Russian oil and gas imports via Dutch ports and port-access powers. The government answered that NATO and EU channels are primary, that a separate leaders' group is not appropriate, that negotiations are ongoing, that Dutch oil imports from Russia have ceased and LNG imports are limited, and that port refusal rests on EU sanctions law and with ports and municipalities rather than the national government.
The cabinet regrettably cannot go further into detail on the Dutch position in ongoing negotiations.
Het kabinet kan helaas niet verder in detail ingaan op de Nederlandse positie in lopende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het rapport van het WODC over huwelijksdwang, achterlating en vrouwelijke genitale verminking

MP Dobbe asked the government about the WODC report 'Over Grenzen' on preventive protection orders for forced marriage, abandonment and FGM, including whether it will adopt the report's recommendations, criminalise glorification of FGM, and exempt reconstructive surgery from the deductible. The State Secretary says the report will be answered in a policy response later this year, that glorification and incitement of FGM are already partly punishable with an implementing bill pending, and that a research extension exempting reconstructive surgery from the deductible is underway until 2027.
In this policy response all conclusions and recommendations will be addressed in more detail.
In deze beleidsreactie zal op alle conclusies en aanbevelingen nader worden ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over het bericht van RTV Noord waaruit blijkt dat tientallen raadsleden van Groninger gemeenten hebben te maken met agressie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that dozens of Groningen councillors face aggression and intimidation, and whether reporting and protection for councillors are adequate. The minister acknowledged the problem, said it mirrors national monitor data, and outlined measures such as encouraging employer-role support for reporting, a security scan for councillors, and a weerbaarheidspakket for council clerks.
Political office holders must be able to do their work undisturbed.
Politieke ambtsdragers moeten ongestoord hun werk kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over COA-locaties

The MP asks for a complete list of current and planned COA reception locations with resident numbers and opening years, the number of legal proceedings against asylum centres per year since 2020, and the legal costs of those proceedings. The minister points to the COA map and an attached list (no future resident numbers), gives annual procedure counts rising to 50 in 2024 with a caveat about changed registration, and states that legal costs are not recorded by case type, while noting that municipal agreements are not published.

Finally, I want to emphasise that COA is an independent administrative body (ZBO), and that the national government does not make public the administrative agreements concluded by ZBOs and municipalities.
Tenslotte wil ik benadrukken dat het COA een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO) is, en dat het Rijk bestuursovereenkomsten die gesloten worden door ZBO's en gemeenten niet openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de zaak Salimzade/staat

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration why the state appealed again after the court annulled the IND's decisions three times in the case of Iranian twin girls seeking a residence permit with their aunt, a Dutch citizen, and questions the IND's reasoning, including the claim that the children would burden schools. The Minister declines to discuss the individual case, which is pending before the Council of State, and explains in general terms how the IND weighs article 8 ECHR family life against state interests, giving great weight to the child's best interest, and that the state appeals only when it disagrees with the ruling or sees a wider interest.
I cannot go into individual cases, certainly not cases that are currently being handled by the Council of State.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, zeker niet op zaken die op dit moment nog in behandeling zijn bij de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Brandweer en veiligheidsregio's slaan alarm over bezuiniging op rampenbestrijding: 'Onbegrijpelijk in deze tijden''

The CDA MP Boswijk asked whether a 10 percent cut to the Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR) for safety regions is responsible given geopolitical risks, and what its consequences would be for regional crisis capacity. The Minister answered that the cut follows from the coalition agreement, referred to a May 2025 letter with per-region impact figures, and said regional financial decisions will only become clear in autumn 2025, while committing to additional resilience funding without fully resolving the financing question.
The decision to cut specific grants by 10%, including the Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR), follows from the coalition agreement.
Het besluit om 10% te bezuinigen op specifieke uitkeringen, waaronder de Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR), vloeit voort uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de terroristische brandstichting bij kippenslachterij Plukon en het openlijk dreigen met nieuwe aanslagen

An MP from BBB asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about an arson attack on the Plukon poultry slaughterhouse, the ALF's implied threat of more attacks, and whether the group should be designated terrorist, plus questions on firefighter risks, prosecution and prevention. The government condemned the violence, said police and the prosecution are investigating and it cannot anticipate outcomes, explained the NCTV's terrorism definition and that the threat picture does not currently show a demonstrable violent threat from animal rights activism, and promised to invite sector organisations for talks.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) are currently investigating the incident.
De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doen op dit moment onderzoek naar het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘student encampment for Palestine’ op de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked about Samidoun's role in a June 2025 student encampment at the University of Amsterdam, whether such organisations should be banned, how the planned terrorism-glorification offence applies to campus protests, and whether universities have guidelines and suspension powers. The minister answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that banning organisations is for the courts on a prosecutor's request, that the new offences will depend on circumstances, that universities have a joint protest guideline and can suspend students under the WHW, and that a further letter on organisation bans will follow in autumn 2025.

As you will understand, individual cases cannot be discussed, nor the specific involvement of organisations in demonstrations, because this would encroach on the powers of the local triangle, namely the mayor, the police and the Public Prosecution Service.

Zoals u begrijpt kan er niet op individuele casuïstiek in worden gegaan, zo ook niet waar het gaat over de specifieke betrokkenheid van organisaties bij demonstraties, omdat hiermee in de bevoegdheid van de lokale driehoek, te weten de burgemeester, de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie, wordt getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe cijfers van het Landelijk Alcohol en Drugs Informatie Systeem (LADIS)

MPs asked the government about the rising number of people seeking treatment for gambling addiction (many young, mostly online), the lack of a ban on online gambling advertising, the minimum gambling age, drug addiction trends including cannabis and new substances, and the cost of cannabis-related addiction care. The minister acknowledged the trends as worrying, pointed to planned gambling law revision with consultation in 2026 and a planned raise of the minimum age to 21, and listed prevention measures while declining to ban gambling outright and giving no cost breakdown for cannabis treatment.
The aim is to put the relevant bill out for consultation in 2026.
Het streven is om het betreffende wetsvoorstel in 2026 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de veiligheidssituatie van christenen in Syrië

The MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the ministers about the safety of Christians in Syria, the return policy, and whether minority groups should get a risk profile. The government answered that it shares concern, that individual assessment remains the basis for asylum decisions, that no group-wide risk profile for Christians is justified by the current country report, and it described sanctions relief, support against IS, and an unchanged school curriculum for now.
However, an application by a Syrian Christian will always be assessed individually on the merits of the case, measured against the situation in the country of origin.
Een aanvraag van een Syrische christen zal echter altijd individueel beoordeeld worden aan de hand van de merites van de zaak, afgezet tegen de situatie in het herkomstgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het politieoptreden tijdens de Extinction Rebellion-demonstratie bij de A12 in Den Haag tijdens de NAVO top

Teunissen (PvdD) asks the Justice Minister about reported police use of batons and broken arms at an XR demonstration on the A12 during the NATO summit, and about proportionality, the right to peaceful protest, chilling effects and identity checks. The Minister defers to local authority and ongoing investigation, states that existing rules guarantee demonstration rights and sees no need for additional measures, and only commits to 'lessons learned' review via the triangle.
At present the incident on the A12 and the way the police acted are being investigated.
Op dit moment wordt het voorval op de A12 en de wijze waarop de politie heeft opgetreden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over dat het antisemitische punkduo Bob Vylan in september en oktober optreedt in Amsterdam en Tilburg

An MP asks whether Bob Vylan, a punk duo accused of antisemitic chanting at Glastonbury, should be barred from performing at Paradiso and 013 and from entering the Netherlands. The Minister says entry can be refused under Schengen rules for threats to public order, that municipalities decide on performances, and that a pre-emptive ban requires concrete serious disorder risks; he does not commit to cancelling the shows.
The local government is responsible for maintaining public order and makes its own assessment in this.
Het lokaal bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de openbare orde en maakt daarin een eigen afweging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de berichten 'Joodse studenten voelen zich onveilig en buitengesloten op UvA en VU: "De universiteit adviseerde me niet meer te komen"' en 'Antisemitisme drijft leerli

Christian Union MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the education minister how the government responds to reports that Jewish students feel unsafe at Dutch universities and that antisemitism drives pupils to Jewish schools, and what measures exist. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures (Strategy Against Antisemitism, guidance, planned security duty, monitoring plans) and said further steps would be considered after a task force reports in early 2026, while declining to register religion or monitor the handbook's use.
Institutions do not register religion for privacy reasons.
Instellingen registreren religie wegens privacy redenen niet.
Antwoord op de leden Dassen en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Baudet ontkent contact met Rusland, maar FVD-Kamerlid Ralf Dekker videobelt met Poetins partij Verenigd Rusland’

Dassen (Volt) and Paternotte (D66) asked the government whether contacts between Forum voor Democratie MPs and sanctioned Russian politicians from Putin's party pose security risks, whether such contacts will be condemned, and whether financial ties and election interference can be ruled out. The government answered that MPs are free to maintain contacts, that Russian influence and the risk of covert interference are recognised, that AIVD awareness briefings and warnings exist, that absolute certainty about sanctions compliance cannot be given (investigation would follow signals), and that election-security measures and EU cooperation are in place.
MPs, like everyone else, are free to maintain contact with anyone.
Kamerleden, net als iedereen, vrij zijn om met eenieder contact te onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over de schriftelijke vragen van 18 april 2025 (2025Z07899) over Mohammed B

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice why their April 2025 written questions about Mohammed B., released and present at a sit-in, were answered only after 102 days, and urged his prosecution and immediate serving of his suspended sentence. The minister said answers were delayed by coordination with chain partners, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that the cabinet plans to criminalise support for terrorist organisations, and that antisemitism is addressed through a broader strategy.
The answering of the parliamentary questions was delayed because coordination with various (chain) partners was necessary.
De beantwoording van de Kamervragen is vertraagd doordat er afstemming nodig was met verschillende (keten)partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pepijn van Houwelingen over ‘NAVO-doelstellingen, de resilience requirements’

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister which of NATO's seven resilience requirements covers pandemic preparedness. The minister answered that pandemic preparedness is not itself a NATO objective, but that measures for it contribute to civil resilience against military and hybrid threats, and referred to two earlier letters to parliament.
Pandemic preparedness in itself is not a NATO objective.
Pandemische paraatheid is op zichzelf geen doelstelling van de NAVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO ‘resilience objectives'

The MP asked whether the seven ministers responsible for policy areas covered by NATO's secret 'Resilience Objectives' knew of them, when and how they were informed, and whether the Schoof cabinet's coalition negotiators knew. The Minister replied that the objectives are known to the relevant ministers, that departments themselves elaborate them and inform new ministers through their own ministry, that it is not for the cabinet to comment on negotiators' knowledge, and that the objectives are referenced in the Vilnius communiqué and the coalition programme.
It is not for the cabinet to make statements about the (knowledge position of the) negotiators of the coalition agreement.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uitspraken te doen over de (kennispositie van de) onderhandelaars van het hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Plas over het bericht dat een oud-AIVD’er waarschuwt dat brandstichtingen door dierenextremisten “weer terug dreigen te komen”

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports of animal-rights extremist occupations of slaughterhouses in Apeldoorn and warnings of renewed arson, asking about arrests, threat assessments, prosecution, sanctions listing, and protection of food-chain firms. The government answered that the investigation is ongoing, declined to share intelligence or assess specific groups, reported that 42 people were arrested for trespass but not detained, and promised to invite sector organisations for talks.
At this moment the police, under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service, are investigating these incidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Op dit moment doet de politie onder gezag van het OM onderzoek naar deze incidenten. Wij kunnen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zakenmannen verkopen voor tientallen miljarden aan Israëlische wapenindustrie’

MP Van Baarle asked ministers about reports that Dutch businessmen supply electronic components via SASMOS to Israeli arms firms, raising prosecution, export control, and complicity questions. The government mostly declined to comment on individual companies, stated that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and reaffirmed Dutch export control and the 2025 measures on Israel.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether conduct that may be criminal and over which the Netherlands has jurisdiction is involved.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van gedragingen die mogelijk strafbaar handelen opleveren en waarover Nederland rechtsmacht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Six Dijkstra over het datalek van medische en persoonlijke gegevens bij het laboratorium van Clinical Diagnostics in Rijswijk

MPs Hertzberger and Six-Dijkstra asked how a hack at the Clinical Diagnostics laboratory exposed medical data of about half a million Dutch citizens, when the government was informed, why the breach was not disclosed sooner, and what minimum data security standards apply. The state secretary answered that independent investigations by BVO NL, the AP and the IGJ are underway, gave a timeline of notifications, stated that the cooperation with the laboratory was suspended, and largely deferred the detailed questions on data minimisation, certification and other laboratories to those ongoing investigations.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) has launched an independent investigation into the exact scope and cause of this hack.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar de exacte omvang en de oorzaak van deze hack.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de misstanden in de penitentiaire inrichtingen en de beloofde verbeteringen ten aanzien van de veiligheid van gedetineerde vrouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about abuse of detained women by prison staff, the handling of complaints and whistleblowers, medical care, and media contacts following the documentary series 'Dubbel Gestraft'. The Minister acknowledged the abuses, listed measures taken by DJI and the Inspectorate, and declined to launch a new large-scale investigation for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat Mohammed B. weer op vrije voeten is en aanwezig was bij een sit-in

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a convicted man allegedly at a station sit-in wearing a Hamas-referencing emblem, why he keeps receiving short sentences, and why his nationality or residence status has not been revoked. The minister confirmed the emblem references Hamas, said criminalising support for terrorist organisations is planned, deferred sentencing to the courts, and explained in general terms the legal limits on revoking nationality and residence.
It is primarily the task of the Public Prosecution Service to investigate criminal offences and prosecute suspects.
Het is primair de taak van het Openbaar Ministerie om strafbare feiten te onderzoeken en verdachten te vervolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Van Zanten over het artikel Visumvrij reizen 85 miljoen Turken stap dichterbij

BBB MPs asked whether the European Commission is seriously considering visa-free travel for all Turkish citizens despite Turkey's non-fulfilment of benchmarks, and what this means for migration control and sovereignty. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is not on the table because six of 72 criteria remain open, that the Schengen cascade model change only extends visa validity for frequent travellers, and that the government firmly maintains full fulfilment of the benchmarks.
See the answer to question 2. There is no question of visa-free travel.
Zie het antwoord op vraag 2. Er is geen sprake van visumvrij reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het kwalificeren van zelfuitgevoerde grenscontroles bij Ter Apel als demonstratie oor de minister- president

An MP asked why the Prime Minister called self-run border checks by citizens at Ter Apel a form of demonstration, given that such checks are legally reserved for authorities and risk vigilantism. The Minister of Justice answered that demonstrating is free within legal limits, that carrying out border checks is reserved for authorities like the Marechaussee, and that there is no room for vigilantism, while leaving the local mayor responsible for handling demonstrations.
Carrying out border checks is legally reserved for authorities such as the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee and is bound by strict national and European rules.
Het uitvoeren van grenscontroles is wettelijk voorbehouden aan autoriteiten zoals de Koninklijke Marechaussee en is aan strenge nationale en Europese regels gebonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de berichten ‘Ov-beelden al gewist, onderzoeken naar Maccabi-supporters gestaakt’ en ‘Politie worstelde met 'wezenlijk andere vorm van geweld' tijdens Maccabi-rellen’

The CDA MP Boswijk asked the Justice Minister about reports that transit footage of the Maccabi riots was erased and that investigations into supporters were dropped, and about the police and Public Prosecution Service response. The Minister says the prosecution sent complaints to police on 14 November 2024, that the GVB camera footage had already been overwritten during a camera replacement the prosecution was not told about, that no relevant footage or open-source leads were found, and that camera retention is a matter for the independent GVB, so no minimum retention period is proposed.
The GVB is an independent company for which the national government is not the concession grantor.
Het GVB is een zelfstandig bedrijf ten aanzien waarvan de Rijksoverheid geen concessieverlener is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over dat visumvrij reizen voor Turken wordt versoepeld

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether visa rules for Turkish citizens were being loosened and whether this could bring millions of Turks to the Netherlands. Minister Brekelmans answered that the change only adjusts the Schengen cascade model for repeat, bona fide travellers, that visa conditions are unchanged, and that visa liberalisation for Turkey is not on the table because Turkey still has to meet six outstanding conditions.
It concerns an adjustment of the existing Schengen cascade model for Turkish travellers who have previously used their visa correctly.
Het gaat om een aanpassing van het bestaande Schengen cascademodel voor Turkse reizigers die eerder op de juiste manier gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun visum
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Diederik van Dijk over ‘De geëscaleerde demonstratie bij een bijeenkomst van Christenen voor Israël’

MPs Bikker and Van Dijk asked how the government views an escalated pro-Palestinian demonstration at a Christenen voor Israël gathering in Barneveld, including intimidation of attendees, the role of the mayor and police, and whether freedom of assembly is safeguarded. The government answered that the gathering went ahead, that intimidation is unacceptable, and that the mayor is responsible for facilitating and intervening, while referring to a WODC study on how demonstration rights relate to other fundamental rights due in summer 2025 and a government response in autumn.
It is the responsibility of local authorities, in particular the mayor, to facilitate demonstrations as much as possible and to intervene where necessary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag, in het bijzonder de burgemeester, om demonstraties zoveel mogelijk te faciliteren en waar nodig in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the use of Palantir software within the ministry's bodies, the secrecy surrounding its acquisition and the reasons for not tendering it. The minister answered that only the police use Palantir, within the 'Raffinaderij' analysis environment for serious organised crime and attack prevention, that the acquisition was exempted from tendering under art. 2.23(1)(e) Aanbestedingswet for security reasons, and that the questions were answered as quickly as possible.

The reasons for the covert acquisition were: a. The themes for which the 'Raffinaderij' analysis environment and thus Palantir is deployed are very sensitive and carry a high risk of harm to operations.
De redenen voor het heimelijk verwerven waren: a. De thema's waarop de analyseomgeving «de Raffinaderij» en daarmee Palantir wordt ingezet zijn zeer gevoelig en kennen een hoog afbreukrisico
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het toezicht en vergunningverlening onder de Wet Wapens en Munitie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about oversight and licensing under the Weapons and Ammunition Act, including regional differences in licences for air-pistol and airsoft rental, the proposed reform for airsoft providers, the status and oversight of airsoft associations, and the validity period of hunting licences. The minister answered that licences are issued locally with possible interpretation differences that will be levelled, that airsoft associations are checked on board reliability and fraud reports, and that the topics will be addressed in the planned modernisation of the Act without firm commitments on timing.
Once these differences are noticed, efforts will be made to level them out.
Zodra deze verschillen opgemerkt worden, zal ingezet worden op het nivelleren hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over huisbezoeken aan demonstranten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police home visits to demonstrators, citing the Inspectorate's view that such visits can be intimidating and counterproductive. The minister defended the practice as proportionate information-gathering, pointed to a tightened internal police framework and a pending WODC study, and declined to provide figures on how often unannounced visits occur, while committing to register future contacts.
I have previously indicated that these figures are not available and that it is not possible to provide the requested overview.
Eerder heb ik aangegeven dat deze cijfers niet beschikbaar zijn en dat het niet mogelijk is om dit gevraagde overzicht te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Eindhoven alarm slaat over het antisemitisch geweld in Eindhoven

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security how the Eindhoven mayor's alarm about antisemitic violence should be addressed, what the current state of the antisemitism strategy is, how antisemitic offences are followed up, and what measures will help mayors. The Minister says the government stays engaged, points to prosecution policy and statistics, lists existing measures and offers to consult municipalities, while stressing local authorities decide on local measures.
Concrete local measures are the responsibility of local authorities, but I am always willing to engage with municipalities on tackling antisemitism.
Concrete lokale maatregelen liggen bij het lokaal gezag, maar ik ben altijd bereid in gesprek te gaan met gemeenten over de aanpak van antisemitisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Eigenrichting zoals bij de grens bij Ter Apel mag niet op begrip kunnen rekenen van politici’

An Volt MP asked the Justice Minister whether citizens carrying out their own border checks near Ter Apel break the law, whether authorities are failing to act, and what concrete steps will counter this vigilantism. The Minister said prosecution is for the OM and courts to judge, that border control is reserved for competent authorities such as the Marechaussee, that demonstrating is allowed within legal limits, and that police and Marechaussee are monitoring the situation with German counterparts.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have occurred.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over burgers die de grens menen te moeten bewaken

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Minister of Justice and Security about citizens who conducted self-appointed border checks at Ter Apel and Sellingen, and whether these were lawful and what authorities did. The minister answered with a factual account of the incidents, said prosecution and courts decide on criminal conduct, stressed that border checks are reserved to the Royal Marechaussee, and noted ongoing police and cross-border contact with German authorities.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether there are criminal offences.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over burgers die de grens menen te moeten bewaken

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice Minister how to view racist remarks in a WhatsApp group of citizens conducting border checks for asylum seekers, and whether prosecution will follow. The minister said citizens must not take the law into their own hands, that border checks belong to legally authorised authorities, that the remarks are objectionable, and that whether offences occurred is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts to decide.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have occurred.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over het artikel ‘Opnieuw grenscontroles door groep burgers, dit keer bij  Groningse Sellingen’

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether citizen groups stopping cars at the border and intimidating people is acceptable, what the government thinks of the chat messages with racist and violent content, and whether the government's initial response was too lax. The minister answered that border controls are reserved to authorities such as the Marechaussee, that taking the law into one's own hands is not allowed, that one suspect has been arrested, and that prosecution decisions rest with the prosecutor and judge.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have been committed.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Ondernemingsstrafrecht zonder klassenjustitie’

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether out-of-court OM transactions with large companies and banks amount to class justice, since they avoid prosecution and admission of guilt, and whether OM penal orders should replace them. The minister denied that transactions are a buy-off practice, explained the criteria, review committee and publication of high transactions, and agreed penal orders are preferred where suitable.
The First Supplementary Act to the new Code of Criminal Procedure proposes replacing review of high transactions by the independent committee with judicial review.
In de Eerste aanvullingswet bij het nieuwe Wetboek van Strafvordering wordt voorgesteld de toetsing van hoge transacties door de onafhankelijke commissie te vervangen door rechterlijke toetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'UvA verhaalt schade bezettingen mei 2024 niet op demonstranten'

MPs Martens-America and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked why the University of Amsterdam did not recover about 1.5 million euros of damage from the May 2024 occupations from the protesters, and what legal and practical obstacles exist to recovering such damage from rioters. The Minister answers that identifying perpetrators in chaotic group situations is often practically impossible, that group liability has conditions, that most damage was covered by insurance, and that institutions decide themselves whether to claim as injured parties, without providing case counts.
Furthermore, as Minister I do not collect data on whether group liability is applicable in riots in higher education.
Voorts verzamel ik als Minister geen gegevens over het wel of niet toepasbaar zijn van groepsaansprakelijkheid bij rellen in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Michon-Derkzen over de brief van de minister van Justitie en Veiligheid ‘Informatiebeveiliging OM’

MPs Buijsse and Michon-Derkzen asked about the Public Prosecution Service's disconnection of its internal systems from the internet after a Citrix vulnerability was exploited, including data theft, backups, court delays, patching and NCSC warnings. The Minister answered that disconnection was unavoidable, no evidence of data manipulation or theft has been found so far, backups are secured, a phased reconnection is underway, and that the investigation into patch timing and audit practice is ongoing.
Disconnecting the Public Prosecution Service from the internet is indeed a serious measure.
Het loskoppelen van het OM van het internet is inderdaad een zware maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de hackaanval op het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about the hack of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) digital environment, including data stolen, staff and witness safety, Citrix vulnerability, and restoration timing. The minister answered that no evidence yet shows data was manipulated or taken, that the OM is returning online in phases with enhanced monitoring, and that the NCSC has urged all Citrix users to investigate, while withholding details of the ongoing criminal investigation.
I cannot provide you with any information about the ongoing criminal investigation while that investigation continues.
Over het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik u gedurende dat onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel hoe de jacht op ‘verdachte’ inwoners in de armste wijken ontspoort

An MP asked the ministers about an investigative article on an integrated intervention team in Zaandam that allegedly targeted residents of poor neighbourhoods with harsh, discriminatory-sounding tactics, and whether officials felt pressured and unable to report concerns. The government answered that the municipality of Zaanstad is investigating the team's conduct and communication, that discrimination is unacceptable, and that fundamental rights must be safeguarded, but largely defended the area-based approach and left the detailed review to the municipality.
When asked, the municipality of Zaanstad indicated it would further examine the signals from the FTM publication regarding communication and internal working methods for accuracy and background.
Desgevraagd heeft de gemeente Zaanstad aangegeven de signalen uit de publicatie van FTM ten aanzien van de communicatie en de interne werkwijze nader te onderzoeken op juistheid en achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over de detentie van mensenrechtenverdediger Inés Estela Pérez Arregoces

MPs asked why Colombian human rights defender Inés Estela Pérez Arregoces was held over 20 hours at Schiphol and then removed, and how this fits with protection of human rights defenders, interpreter and legal assistance rights, and privacy. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing privacy, described the general Schengen Border Code framework and appeal options, and said he saw no reason for policy changes.
I cannot, also in connection with privacy considerations, go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Ik kan, ook in verband met privacyoverwegingen, niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden van dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitvoering van de motie over kinderen in de asielopvang

An SP MP asked the minister how the motion on housing children in suitable asylum locations is being implemented, including reports of unsuitable sites, consultation with municipalities, and what will be done before the summer holidays. The minister endorses the motion's aim but says that due to a structural shortage of places it cannot yet be implemented in the short term, points to a COA inventory of child-suitable locations and planned measures, and gives partial commitments.
I fully endorse the objective of this motion and it remains my aim that children are housed in suitable locations.
Ik onderschrijf de doelstelling van deze motie geheel en het blijft mijn inzet dat kinderen worden opgevangen in geschikte locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht ‘Hoe wij bij een CvI-lezing werden belaagd en geïntimideerd door demonstranten’

MPs Van Dijk and Flach asked the government about reports of intimidation of attendees at a lecture by a Dutch organisation, and whether protest rights permit criminal conduct without enforcement. The Minister condemned the intimidation, said demonstration rights do not cover criminal acts, and pointed to local authority and prosecutors for enforcement while a WODC study on conflicting fundamental rights is pending, with no commitment to amend the Public Demonstrations Act yet.
I am not anticipating changes to legislation ahead of the results of the WODC study.
Ik loop niet vooruit op het wijzigen van wetgeving voorafgaand aan de resultaten van het WODC-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Orkaan van haat treft Christenen voor Israël na video Tim Hofman: ‘Maar aantijgingen volstrekt onjuist’'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether religious gatherings should be free from disruption, how banned demonstrations at a Christians for Israel event can be prevented, and how the government judges the protest, the police and local authorities' role, and the participants' safety. The minister agreed in principle that religious gatherings should proceed unhindered, described the mayor's power to ban demonstrations, but said assessing local handling is not for him and pointed to a forthcoming study on the legal framework.
It is the responsibility of local authorities, in particular the mayor, to facilitate demonstrations as much as possible and to intervene where necessary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag, in het bijzonder de burgemeester om demonstraties zoveel mogelijk te faciliteren en waar nodig in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach en Diederik van Dijk over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 22 april in Lelystad

MPs Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach and Van Dijk asked whether a counter-demonstration at a Christians for Israel lecture in Lelystad, which forced attendees to stay inside for about three quarters of an hour, was announced or permitted, what support municipalities get, and how safety will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the municipality was informed only shortly before, that the mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations, and that a research study on the legal framework is expected at the end of summer.
In the Netherlands the mayor is responsible for facilitating the right to demonstrate.
In Nederland is de burgemeester verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van het demonstratierecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Remco S. loopt nog altijd vrij rond in India na de moord op José

Two MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that a suspect in the murder of a Dutch woman remains free in India, and about extradition, diplomatic contact, victim information and compensation. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that India has primary jurisdiction and extradition depends on facts and procedures, said Nederland's influence over foreign procedures is very limited, and noted victims of crimes abroad are not eligible for Schadefonds compensation, though the law may be revised.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts, I cannot provide information.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Voortrekker Nederland blijkt fors achter te lopen met voorbereidingen Migratiepact’ en het daarin benoemde rapport van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Minister about press reports and a European Commission progress report suggesting the Netherlands lags in implementing the EU Migration Pact, and about reception capacity and the Asylum Emergency Measures and two-status bills. The government replied that the Netherlands is on schedule for June 2026, acknowledges reception-capacity concerns, pledges to reduce emergency reception locations, and says the implementation timeline continues, with periodic updates to parliament.
The Netherlands is on schedule to implement the Pact by June 2026.
Nederland ligt op schema om het Pact per juni 2026 te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het rapport ‘State of play on the implementation of the Pact on Migration and Asylum’ van de Europese Commissie

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a European Commission report on implementing the EU Migration and Asylum Pact, including Dutch reception capacity gaps, the delayed emergency plan, implementation delays, and the tension with the Commission's critical tone. The minister replied that the Netherlands is on schedule for June 2026, acknowledges reception capacity as a known concern, says an emergency plan has now been submitted, and promises ongoing monitoring and periodic updates to parliament.
The cabinet therefore appreciates the Commission's progress reports and that these reports respond to the Netherlands' request that concrete examples from member states be named.

Het kabinet waardeert daarom de voortgangsrapportages van de Europese Commissie en dat deze rapportages gehoor geven aan het verzoek van Nederland dat concrete voorbeelden van lidstaten worden benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 17 april in Zaltbommel

MPs Eerdmans and Bikker asked whether the government would guarantee safety at a Zaltbommel event after a counter-demonstration intimidated attendees, and why organisers were not warned in advance. The Minister answered that the demonstration was not announced, that safety is a matter for the mayor and police, and that a WODC study on the demonstration right will report later this year.
It is a local matter and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council for it.
Het is een lokale aangelegenheid en de burgemeester legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Abassi over het bericht dat een topambtenaar kinderpornografisch materiaal verspreidde onder werktijd

The MP asks how a former senior civil servant at the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management could distribute child sexual abuse material during working hours undetected, and what oversight, screening and integrity measures apply. The minister answers that no warning signals existed, the employee was dismissed, some ICT and integrity measures are in place, but no systemic changes or independent inquiry are planned.
As soon as such signals did emerge, action was taken immediately.
Zodra deze signalen er wel kwamen is meteen opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Medische misstanden in Nederlandse gevangenissen. Ik kwam lopend binnen, en verliet de gevangenis in een rolstoel’

MPs Sneller and Van der Werf asked the Justice Minister about reports of medical failures in Dutch prisons, including delayed care, wrong medication, and reliance on untrained guards for medical matters. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems in principle, said the number of cases is unknown, and outlined existing procedures, on-call doctors, and planned reviews of women's detention, while disputing that cost considerations drive care decisions.
I take all signals, as described in the Misstandenboek, very seriously.
Ik neem alle signalen, zoals beschreven in het Misstandenboek, zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de beveiliging van Joodse en Amerikaanse locaties

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch Jewish and American locations should receive extra security after France tightened protection amid the Iran-Israel conflict, and what measures were taken. The government answered that threat level is substantial, that measures are taken as needed based on current threat information, but declined to disclose specific measures for individual institutions for security reasons.
For security reasons, I never make public statements about measures taken to protect individual institutions or persons.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over maatregelen die worden getroffen ten behoeve van de veiligheid van individuele instellingen of personen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Mutluer over het lekken van persoonsgegevens door ambtenaren aan criminelen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about civil servants leaking personal data such as addresses and licence plates to criminals, including a recent Amsterdam case, and asked for figures on prosecutions by municipality, the state's support for municipal integrity, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's role, and a joint vulnerability assessment with the VNG. The government answered that the police and judiciary do not register the employer of suspects so the figures cannot be given, pointed to existing municipal integrity measures and national support programmes, described the Data Protection Authority's supervisory role, and announced a new national anti-corruption approach with concrete actions planned for 2025.

The systems of the police, the Rijksrecherche and the judiciary do not record from which function a suspect breached the duty of confidentiality, or whether information was leaked to criminals or other persons.

De systemen van politie, Rijksrecherche en de Rechtspraak registreren niet vanuit welke functie door een verdachte de geheimhoudingsplicht is geschonden, en of informatie aan criminelen of andere personen is gelekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Piri over kritische demonstranten die bij een bezoek aan de Chinese vicepremier buiten het zicht werden geposteerd

MPs Lahlah and Piri asked about protesters being kept out of sight during the visit of the Chinese vice-premier, camera use, transnational repression and a planned ban on face coverings at demonstrations. The minister replies that the Hague municipality found no restriction tied to content, that demonstrations were not limited by the Chinese delegation, that camera use is for public order under the Municipalities Act, and that a WODC study on the right to demonstrate is pending.
Restriction of the right to demonstrate, or consideration of it in the context of this visit, has not been an issue.
Beperking van het demonstratierecht of overweging daartoe in het kader van het onderhavige bezoek is niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het politiegeweld tijdens de ontruiming van het universiteitsgebouw in Utrecht bij een pro-Palestina demonstratie

An MP asked whether police used violence during the eviction of a university building in Utrecht at a pro-Palestinian demonstration, whether excessive force was used, and how complaints can be made and investigated. The Minister declined to comment on the individual incident, citing ongoing investigation, but described the general rules on use of force, the review of force by the hulpofficier van justitie, complaint and criminal complaint procedures, and the right to demonstrate.
An investigation into the incident in Utrecht and the way the police acted is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt onderzoek gedaan naar het voorval in Utrecht en de wijze waarop de politie heeft opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het tegengaan van buitenlandse beïnvloeding bij de verkiezingen

CDA MPs asked the ministers how Dutch elections can be protected against foreign online disinformation campaigns, including the risks, existing measures, the DSA, Sweden's psychological defence agency and a public awareness campaign. The minister answered that the government is taking coordinated measures, is preparing new powers and legal bases for later elections, and will commission studies, but noted that the new powers will not be introduced before the 2025 elections.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Europese Raad over vreemdelingen- en asielbeleid op 12 en 13 juni

An FVD MP asked why the Minister of Asylum and Migration skipped the EU Justice and Home Affairs Council on migration in Luxembourg on 13 June 2025 in favour of attending the Bilderberg meeting, and asked for the dates and purpose of his attendance. The minister answered that the state secretary represented the Netherlands at the Council, that Bilderberg offers informal high-level dialogue on geopolitical issues, and that the questions were answered separately and within the usual three-week term.
The State Secretary for Legal Protection represented the Netherlands at the JBZ Council.
De Staatssecretaris Rechtsbescherming was namens Nederland aanwezig tijdens de JBZ-Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Schrikbarende toename van online oplichting’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that online fraud victims reached 2.4 million, why young people are targeted more, what concrete measures exist, whether victims feel helped, how banks and platforms cooperate, the PNBF refund scheme, priority and capacity, and the role of NCSC and DTC. The minister acknowledges the rise, describes the integrated approach with public and private partners, prevention campaigns, the digital reporting desk and EUR 52.6 million investment, but gives no data on PNBF use and says effects are hard to measure.
It is therefore not possible to obtain an overview of the number of requests under the PNBF scheme.
Het is daardoor niet mogelijk om een overzicht te verkrijgen van het aantal verzoeken in het kader van de PNBF-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de nationale crisisstructuur

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the National Crisis Structure is active, for each activation since 2016 the reason, period and decision-makers, whether the Chamber was informed, whether ICCb and MCCb minutes exist, and whether NCC, NKC and LOCC are operational. The minister answered that the structure is not active, listed six activations with dates and reasons, confirmed the Chamber was informed by letter each time, said minutes are confidential and only decision lists are published, and confirmed the staff bodies are standing organisations.
Minutes and decision lists of the MCCb are not made public.
Verslagen en besluitenlijsten van de MCCb worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke consequenties van strafbaarstelling illegaliteit

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the Raad van State should be asked for urgent advice on whether humanitarian aid could fall under the criminalisation of illegal stay in article 108a, and whether that article should not enter into force until parliament has deliberated. The minister agreed to ask the Raad van State for advice after the bill's adoption and to deliberate with parliament before the article takes effect, while noting he cannot pre-empt how prosecutors and courts will interpret it.

As soon as the bill is adopted by the House of Representatives, I will ask the Raad van State to advise on whether there is a considerable chance that individual acts of humanity or humanitarian aid also fall under this article.

Ik zal zodra het wetsvoorstel in de Tweede Kamer is aangenomen de Raad van State vragen te adviseren over de vraag of een aanmerkelijke kans bestaat dat ook individuele gedragingen uit menselijkheid of humanitaire hulp onder dit artikel vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boomsma over strafbaarstelling illegaliteit

MP Boomsma asked about the consequences of the Vondeling amendment criminalising unlawful residence and assistance to unlawfully resident foreigners, including implementation consequences and humanitarian aid. The Minister answered that the amendment will be executed, that enforcement capacity is limited so priority will go to foreigners causing nuisance or crime and those not cooperating with return, and that aid by churches or the Salvation Army is unlikely to be prosecuted soon.
Should choices need to be made due to limited capacity, the cabinet will ask the partner organisations to prioritise enforcement in practice.
Mocht het zo zijn dat er keuzes gemaakt moeten worden vanwege beperkte capaciteit, zal het kabinet de betrokken ketenpartners vragen om in de praktijk prioriteit te geven aan de handhaving
Antwoord op van de leden Van Nispen en Mutluer over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het politieonderwijs en de structurele tekorten in de opsporing
