MPs Van Nispen and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about police training capacity at the Politieacademie, shortages in investigation roles, and the use of field academies and external providers. The minister confirmed the shortages, outlined new direct-entry routes and training numbers, and said quality is safeguarded by central certification while a structural route is being developed, without committing to the requested early letter on external providers.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het chilling effect van acties van de politie n.a.v. onder meer de bevindingen van de podcast 'RADIO BOOS' van 30 januari 20251 inzake aangiftes tegen de politie

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether citizens can really file complaints against police officers, given reports of a chilling effect, and asks about the independence of police investigation units, protest rights, and police home visits to demonstrators. The Minister answers that citizens can file complaints and criminal reports, that the internal VIK units and the Rijksrecherche investigate independently under prosecutorial authority, and that home visits are lawful when necessary and proportionate.
I see no reason to assume that the accessibility and independence of criminal complaint procedures against police officers need to be improved.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat de toegankelijkheid en onafhankelijkheid van aangifteprocedures tegen politiefunctionarissen moet worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de politiebegroting

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police budget: the outcome of the police task force review, the size and causes of the 2026–2029 deficit, how it will be closed, and how much extra money the police has received. The minister answered that the residual shortfall is tens of millions in 2026 rising to about 300 million structurally from 2030, caused by personnel costs, IT and digitalisation, and housing, that the korpschef must take control measures in 2026 sparing operational capacity, and that multi-year solutions will be prepared for the 2027 budget with the local authorities involved.
The korpschef and I are in discussion with the local authorities about the police's financial shortfall.
De korpschef en ik zijn in gesprek met de gezagen over het financiële tekort bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Burg over ‘anti-emancipatoire beïnvloeding’

MPs Becker and Van der Burg asked about foreign lobby and funding aimed at influencing Dutch public and political debate on anti-emancipatory themes, including US, Russian and Islamic-linked funding, and what the government will do. The government answered that lobbying is legitimate but that incitement and discrimination are not, pointed to the Nationale Extremismestrategie, said it has no legal basis to map funding flows from most countries, noted the pending Wtmo law as a possible tool, and said it is willing to raise the issue in the EU.
The ministries have no legal basis for processing personal data in addressing problematic conduct and unwanted foreign financing.
De ministeries hebben geen juridische grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens in het kader van de aanpak van problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verder aan het licht gekomen misstanden in sektes door Undercover

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about abuses in the De Lichtfamilie sect revealed by an undercover documentary, including shunning, extortion, and claims that cancer patients are responsible for their illness, and about the status of a sect hotline and a motion on protecting people from sects. Struycken answered that the abuses are unacceptable and can be prosecuted by the OM, that the IGJ and Wkkgz/Wet BIG can act against harmful alternative care, and that a hotline pilot at Fier started in 2024 with a 2.5-year budget of €926,907, with further information promised in a letter before the summer recess.
The details of the Fier help desk will be communicated to the House in the letter on insecurity and coercive control in (closed) groups due before the summer recess.
Over de nadere vormgeving van het hulppunt bij Fier wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd in de Kamerbrief onveiligheid en dwingende controle in (gesloten) groeperingen die voor het zomerreces uitgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de overdracht van persoonsgegevens van Europese burgers aan Israël

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU adequacy decision for Israel and the transfer of European citizens' personal data there, citing concerns over surveillance and human rights. The state secretary answered that the Commission's adequacy decision remains in force after a 2024 review, that the Commission can suspend or revoke it, and that controllers must inform data subjects and complaints go to the Dutch data protection authority.
Keeping track of whether, and if so which types of personal data Dutch companies or organisations pass on to Israeli parties is not a task of the cabinet, if that is even feasible.
Het bijhouden of, en zo ja welke, soorten persoonsgegevens Nederlandse bedrijven of organisaties doorgeven aan Israëlische partijen, is – zo dat al doenlijk is – geen taak van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Van Nispen over het ondermijnen van de forensische geneeskunde door de recente aanbesteding van medische arrestantenzorg

MPs Lahlah and Van Nispen asked whether awarding all ten medical custody-care lots to one GP organisation undermines forensic medicine, and about risks to staffing, quality and the rule of law. The Minister declined to judge the provisional award, stated that custody care is distinct from forensic examination, pointed to quality and separation requirements and to the ongoing Versterking Forensische Geneeskunde programme, and noted a court procedure that may delay the final award.
The award is not yet final, as a court procedure is ongoing.
De gunning is nog niet definitief, aangezien er een procedure loopt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Mutluer over de aanhoudende problematiek van vuurwapenbezit op Curaçao

MPs White and Mutluer asked about rising firearm possession on Curaçao and the other Caribbean islands, including enforcement capacity, youth prevention, coastal smuggling and online sales. The minister answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own law enforcement, acknowledged capacity shortfalls and said Netherlands cooperates through the Justitieel Vierpartijenoverleg and related programmes.
Curaçao, as an autonomous country within the Kingdom, has its own responsibility for law enforcement and for policy to combat illegal firearms and their possession.
Curaçao heeft als autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk een eigen verantwoordelijkheid voor de rechtshandhaving en voor het beleid om illegale vuurwapens en het bezit hiervan tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen het lid El Abassi over gewelddadige intimidatie en binnendringen van een woning in Arnhem vanwege een opgehangen Palestijnse vlag

The MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported violent intrusion into a home over a displayed Palestinian flag, whether it is being investigated as ideologically motivated intimidation, what steps police took, and what measures exist to protect citizens. The Minister said no investigation had started because residents had not filed a complaint, that a complaint appointment is now planned, that no specific measures exist for ideologically motivated offences, and declined to give further detail on an ongoing criminal matter.
As is customary, I will not comment further on matters that are the subject of criminal investigation.
Zoals gebruikelijk laat ik mij verder niet uit over zaken die onderwerp van strafrechtelijke onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Medewerkers ambassade Israël gedood in VS, verdachte schreeuwde over Palestina’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the safety of Israeli diplomatic staff and Jewish institutions in the Netherlands after a shooting in Washington D.C., and about antisemitism. The minister answered that individual security cases are not discussed publicly, that protective measures are taken based on threat assessments, and pointed to the existing antisemitism strategy 2024-2030 without committing to new concrete measures.
For security reasons, I never publicly discuss the safety of individual cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen spreek ik in het openbaar nooit over de veiligheid van individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de aanval van een wolf op een hardloopster

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about a wolf attack on a jogger in the Hoge Veluwe park, the slow DNA testing, and the roles and liability of mayors and provinces in dealing with problem wolves. The government confirmed the wolf identification, explained the legal powers of mayors and provinces, said it is working to strengthen the mayor's role and to codify the problem-wolf definition by general administrative order, and declined to answer liability questions beyond general principles.
I am currently looking into what is possible to strengthen the role of the mayor.
Ik bezie op dit moment wat er mogelijk is, om de rol van de burgemeester te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Michon-Derkzen over de omstreden en nog altijd actieve sekte Pater Pio

MPs Van Nispen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice Minister about the Pater Pio sect in Twente, including reports of deaths linked to refusal of medical care, child corporal punishment and exorcisms, and why complaints have not stopped the group. The minister says the IGJ can intervene if harm results, that prosecutors have found insufficient evidence or grounds in past complaints, and that a Fier victim helpline launches in summer 2025 with police cooperation still being worked out.
The Fier help point will go live in summer 2025.
Het hulppunt bij Fier zal in de zomer van 2025 live gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Leerlingen pesten elkaar met nepnaaktbeelden, middelbare scholen willen verbod op uitkleedapps'

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked about reports that pupils circulate AI-generated fake nude images of classmates and schools want a ban on nudify apps. The government says bullying is unacceptable, points to existing criminal law, school safety duties, support for School & Veiligheid and Helpwanted, and rejects a general ban as easily circumvented, while promising a cabinet response to the 'Online seksueel geweld' report after the summer.
A more general ban on offering the nudify apps does not, however, seem appropriate at this time.
Een algemener verbod op het aanbieden van de uitkleedapps ligt op dit moment echter niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP from JA21 asked ministers across many departments how much money, which diversity, gender and inclusion policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and consultants their implementing agencies use. The government answered that spending is mostly embedded in general HR policy, lists the agencies' trainings and monitoring tools, and provided the requested figures per organisation where available.
There is a large number of implementing and sui generis organisations.
Er is sprake van een groot aantal uitvoerings- en sui generis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over de aangekondigde acties van XR in winkelgebieden met het verspreiden van butaanzuur

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about Extinction Rebellion's announced actions spreading butanoic acid in shopping areas, including casualties, whether it counts as terrorism or incitement, preventive search powers, prohibitions, and compensation for shop owners. The minister answered that butyric acid was used in Naaldwijk and Nijmegen with several people affected, condemned its use, left terrorism and incitement judgments to the prosecutor and courts, noted municipalities can designate security risk areas, and explained existing confiscation and damage-recovery routes.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether a (terrorist) offence exists in a given case.
Het is verder aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er in bepaald geval sprake is van een (terroristisch) misdrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het voornemen van Extinction Rebellion om winkels te bestoken met boterzuur

An MP from FVD asked ministers about Extinction Rebellion's announced plan to disrupt shops with butyric acid, the scope of past XR damage, municipal shifting of costs onto businesses, investigation of XR's structure and funding, equal treatment of demonstrations, and the AIVD/NCTV focus on right-wing versus left-wing extremism. The government called the butyric acid plan unacceptable, declined to compile an overview or damage figures, said municipal mayors decide on demonstration measures, refused to investigate XR, denied unequal treatment, and said the AIVD monitors left-wing extremism but XR's actions are currently seen as activism.
Such an overview cannot be generated.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Brandweer ziet lastig te blussen branden door ontploffende zonnepanelen toenemen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that firefighters face hard-to-extinguish fires from exploding solar panels, and about installation quality, oversight, and training. The minister answered that the risk is small, relying on TNO/NIPV research, existing municipal and sector oversight, and a planned handbook on hazardous deposition, while declining to tighten oversight or create new protocols.

The limited number of incidents involving solar panels relative to the total number of installations in the Netherlands, and the initiatives by the sector, give me no reason to improve oversight of the quality of solar power installations.

Het beperkt aantal incidenten met zonnepanelen in verhouding tot het totale aantal installaties in Nederland en de initiatieven door de sector geeft voor mij geen aanleiding om het toezicht op de kwaliteit van zonnestroominstallaties te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de weigering van een stichting om openheid van zaken te geven over de financiële afwikkeling van de stichting en het vermogen dat mede bestaat uit giften van derden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers how a dissolved foundation (Stichting Kanjer Wens) can refuse to disclose how its assets, including donations, were wound up, and whether transparency rules should be tightened. The government answered that existing rules (Civil Code liquidation and turboliquidatie registration at the Chamber of Commerce, tax reporting for former ANBIs, and donor inspection rights through courts) provide adequate transparency, and it saw no need to change the law at this stage.

On the obligation to register information at the Chamber of Commerce during the winding-up of a foundation, reference is made to the answer to question 3, so that they can check what happened to the assets.

Voor wat betreft de verplichting tot registratie van informatie in het handelsregister bij financiële afwikkeling en/of vereffening van een stichting wordt verwezen naar het antwoord op vraag 3 en kunnen zij nagaan wat er met het vermogen is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Universiteit Maastricht verbiedt lezing van Joodse student; pro-Palestijnse activiteiten gaan wel door'

An MP from JA21 asked the Education minister whether a university's cancellation of a lecture by a Jewish student, while pro-Palestinian events went ahead, undermines academic freedom and safety for Jewish students. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for weighing safety and debate, that the university is being very restrictive about political events on Gaza/Israel pending an external investigation, and that a broader safety and anti-antisemitism programme is under way.
It is the responsibility of the institutions to weigh whether or not to let an event go ahead.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen om af te wegen of zij een bijeenkomst wel of niet door laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koops over het bericht ‘Daders lopen mogelijk vrij rond door fout met naam in 867 zaken’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that 867 criminal cases may contain wrong identity records, including 141 serious cases, and whether convicted persons were wrongly punished. The state secretary answered that an analysis is ongoing, one innocent person was wrongly flagged, and an action plan and evaluation will follow.
This is being investigated. The first analysis of the 141 more serious cases showed that 1 innocent citizen was wrongly flagged due to identity mix-up.
Dit wordt onderzocht. Uit de eerste analyse van de 141 zwaardere zaken is gebleken dat er 1 onschuldige burger gesignaleerd stond door persoonsverwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht ‘Plotseling flinke stijging gewapende overvallen, daders veelal piepjong’

MP Emiel van Dijk asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported 46 percent rise in robberies in 2025 compared with 2024, the youth background of perpetrators, sentencing and seponering figures, victim compensation, and measures taken against juvenile robbers. The minister acknowledged the rise as worrying, cited the Taskforce Overvallen and prevention programmes, said data on suspects' origin and court outcomes are not available, and described compensation rules while noting the government will pursue the tougher juvenile sentencing proposals in a separate letter.
On the question of whether this happens sufficiently in practice, I regrettably cannot make statements, as the figures are not known to us.
Op de vraag of dit voldoende in de praktijk gebeurt kan ik helaas geen uitspraken doen, de cijfers hierover zijn bij ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Campen en Van der Plas over het binnendringen van stallen

MPs Van Campen and Van der Plas asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers how a court ruling allowing a demonstration exception to unlawful entry (art. 138 Sr) affects prosecution of activists occupying livestock barns, and whether laws should change. The minister declined to comment on the ruling, said the law already covers entry without forced entry, and pointed to a WODC study due in summer 2025 that may inform possible legal changes.
I understand the discomfort the ruling will cause for some. At the same time, it is an independent judicial ruling that we must respect, and as Minister I will not comment on its substance.

Ik heb begrip voor het ongemak dat het vonnis bij sommigen zal opleveren. Tegelijkertijd is er wel sprake van een rechterlijk en onafhankelijk vonnis dat we hebben te respecteren en dat ik als Minister ook niet inhoudelijk zal becommentariëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de nasleep van de moord op een Nederlandse vrouw in India

An SP MP asked the Foreign Affairs minister why a victim's family was never informed about the investigation into the 2012 murder of a Dutch woman in India, what the status of the case is, and what the government can do given the suspect remains free. The minister answered that consular help is given on request, that the ministry will not comment on individual cases for privacy reasons, that Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign legal process, and that without a request from a Dutch citizen it has no power to act toward a lawyer or local authorities.
On individual consular matters, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make statements out of consideration for the privacy of those involved.
Over individuele consulaire zaken doet het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken geen mededelingen omwille van de privacy van betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over geweld tegen klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked whether the government condemns a provincial councillor who drove into a peaceful Extinction Rebellion demonstrator and whether it will act against calls for violence against demonstrators. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, noting a police report had been filed and the OM is investigating, and said responsibility for demonstration safety lies with local government while any suggestion of violence against demonstrators is unacceptable.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to make statements about individual and ongoing cases.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, om uitspraken te doen over individuele en lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Burgemeester weigert Eritrese bijeenkomst in Rijswijk uit vrees voor rellen'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked ministers about the Rijswijk mayor refusing an Eritrean gathering over fear of riots, and about measures, prosecutions, residence permit revocations, and damages following the February 2024 Hague riots. The government answered that local authorities bear primary responsibility, supported by national knowledge and advice networks; that 34 convictions and one acquittal have occurred with damages largely awarded but not yet final; and that it declined to give case-level or IND figures on several points.
Responsibility for taking measures to prevent and deal with unrest lies primarily with local authorities; the national government supports them with knowledge and advice.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het nemen van maatregelen voor het voorkomen en omgaan met onrust ligt in de eerste plaats bij het lokaal gezag; het rijk ondersteunt met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Eritrese bijeenkomst afgeblazen, probleem niet opgelost’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a Rijswijk mayor refused an Eritrean gathering over riot fears, asking how municipalities can be strengthened, which national body coordinates support, and whether the Eritrean regime's diaspora control threatens national security. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing powers and the Ondersteuningsnetwerk maatschappelijke onrust, and said NCTV found no concrete signs that the Eritrean government was driving the violence, while committing to continued monitoring.
To examine how experiences have gone so far, how the room for action can be deployed as effectively as possible and where it can still be strengthened, a consultation structure has been started.

Om te kijken hoe de ervaringen tot dusver zijn geweest, hoe het handelingsperspectief zo effectief mogelijk ingezet kan worden en waar dat mogelijk nog versterkt kan worden, is een overlegstructuur gestart
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Six Dijkstra en Boswijk over berichten op de sociale media, die uit Nederland komen en oproepen tot haat, geweld en moord in Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Six Dijkstra and Boswijk asked whether police and the public prosecution service have adequate oversight of, and capacity to prosecute, social media calls from the Netherlands for hatred and violence against groups in Syria, and asked for case figures. The minister said the systems cannot show how often such posts occur or how many cases are investigated, asserted priority and capacity for prosecuting hate speech, and did not answer within the requested two weeks.

From the systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) it unfortunately cannot be retrieved how often such statements and calls occur and how many reports, complaints or criminal investigations are carried out regarding such calls.

Uit de systemen van de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kan helaas niet worden gehaald hoe vaak dergelijke uitingen en oproepen zich voordoen en hoeveel meldingen, aangiften of strafrechtelijke onderzoeken er worden gedaan naar dergelijke oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht ‘Stekende tbs’er Malek F. al eerder met onbegeleid verlof: ’Wij wisten dat hij opnieuw zou toeslaan en hebben hiervoor gewaarschuwd’

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security why the advisory commission approved leave for a tbs patient who stabbed a man in April 2025, despite victims' warnings, and whether the leave regime should be scrapped. The government declined to discuss the individual case, said some premises in the article were incorrect, described the careful leave-assessment procedure and victim-interest considerations, and refused to abolish tbs leave.
Although I in principle do not make statements about individual cases, I wish to inform you in general that various assumptions in the article are not based on facts.
Hoewel ik in principe geen uitspraken doe over individuele casussen, hecht ik eraan u in algemeenheid erover te informeren dat verschillende aannamen in het artikel niet op feiten berust zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Groene boa’s willen gemakkelijker wapens krijgen: ‘Zonder zijn we vleugellam’’

Mp Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about green enforcement officers (boa's) facing violence, PTSD, slow police response times and slow weapon-permit procedures. The minister said a broader review of the boa system will be sent to parliament around summer 2025, that weapon issuance requires careful assessment, and that the PTSD initiative response will follow before summer 2025.
Around summer 2025 the in-depth review of the boa system will be sent to your House.
Rond de zomer van 2025 zal de diepgaande beschouwing op het boa-bestel aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het screenen van wetenschappers en studenten door hogeronderwijsinstellingen omwille van de nationale veiligheid en wie dit moet bekostigen

An MP asked several ministers whether universities should bear the costs of the proposed screening of researchers and students for national security reasons, and whether this is a shared national responsibility. The minister answered that knowledge security is a cabinet-wide shared responsibility, that funding is partly shifted from Justice and Security to OCW, and that the screening law is a national policy choice, while stating that the government will not provide further legal grounding beyond the existing funding framework.
Yes, universities and colleges are responsible for keeping security in order and mitigating these risks.
Ja, hogescholen en universiteiten dragen verantwoordelijkheid voor het op orde hebben van beveiliging en het mitigeren van deze risico’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Dobbe over de eerdere beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in religieuze context

MPs Becker and Dobbe asked about the effectiveness of border indicators, awareness campaigns, training and follow-up on female genital mutilation risks at Schiphol, and the status of related programmes and research. The government answered that indicators and training are in place, the Marechaussee sees no need for evaluation or stronger controls, campaigns ran with reach figures but no formal evaluation, and a comparative study on preventive protection orders is expected before summer 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over huisbezoeken aan demonstranten

An MP asked the Justice Minister about unannounced police home visits to people considering demonstrating, and whether these chill protest rights and comply with legal rules. The minister answered that such visits are routine policing, legally grounded in the Police Act and subject to proportionality and entry rules, and declined to provide a regional count of visits, and will not restrict them.
Merely a person's presence at demonstrations is not a reason for a home visit.
Alleen iemands aanwezigheid bij demonstraties is geen reden voor een huisbezoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over onaangekondigde huisbezoeken bij demonstranten door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about unannounced police home visits to anti-genocide demonstrators, the Amnesty report on unlawful ID checks and surveillance, and whether guidelines, investigations and changes would follow. The minister said police home visits rest on Article 3 Politiewet with safeguards, that a new bill on information gathering is in preparation, and that some internal guidance and an inspection report exist, but gave no commitment to a new investigation or new binding rules.
It is not for me as Minister to comment on individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in te gaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Hoe christelijke donateurs in Nederland radicale Israëlische kolonisten steunen'

An MP asks the government about reports that Dutch Christian and Zionist foundations fund Israeli settlers building on the occupied West Bank, asking about legality, oversight, sanctions, tax status and prosecution. The government acknowledges the occupation is unlawful, says private relations are not prohibited but undesirable, states it does not monitor such financial flows, and declines to comment on individuals, prosecutions or tax status.

The cabinet does not conduct general supervision of financial flows abroad and therefore does not have information on where and for what purpose money from foundations such as Christenen voor Israël actually goes.

Het kabinet houdt geen algemeen toezicht op financieringsstromen richting het buitenland en beschikt daarom ook niet over informatie waar en met welke bedoeling geld van stichtingen zoals Christenen voor Israël exact naar toe gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over geheime en onwettige detentieplaatsen in Nederland

MP Van Nispen asked the minister how an advocate was held at a secret, unlawful detention location, who ordered it, why no supervisor was informed, how many such placements occurred, and whether transparency will be guaranteed in future. The state secretary admitted the Inspectorate should have been informed, said new agreements and a supervisory commission are being set up, but withheld operational details citing security and did not give numbers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Kathmann over huisbezoeken aan demonstranten en de gegevensverwerking van demonstranten

MPs Lahlah and Kathmann asked the Justice and Security minister about police home visits to demonstrators, the legal basis and limits for police data collection and retention on protesters, complaint outcomes, and remedies, including Amnesty's call for stronger oversight. The minister answered that police contact with citizens is standard practice and that the Ombudsman study and WODC research will be followed by policy responses, while data oversight rests with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and the police chief, and that the answers were late.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to comment on the recommendations made to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, because the exercise of supervision is independent.

Het is daarbij niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om mij uit te laten over de aanbevelingen die zijn gedaan richting de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, omdat de uitoefening van het toezicht onafhankelijk geschiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over ‘haatpredikers op de TU Eindhoven’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about planned talks at TU Eindhoven by speakers alleged to praise Hamas and support IS, and about powers to bar extremist speakers. The minister said the university had banned the lecture, that extremist speakers are a matter for event organisers and local mayors, and that the national security measures cannot be applied to non-foreign speakers.
Where it concerns extremist speakers, it is primarily up to the organisers of an event to ensure they are not given a platform.
Daar waar het gaat om extremistische sprekers is het in eerste instantie aan organisatoren van een evenement om te zorgen dat zij geen podium worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mutluer over buitenlandse beïnvloeding op het emancipatiebeleid

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Education, Culture and Science and the Minister of Justice and Security about foreign influence by extreme conservative lobby groups on emancipation policy, including disinformation, funding flows, and threats to LGBTQ+ and migrant rights. The government answered that lobbying is lawful but that incitement and intimidation fall outside democratic limits, pointed to the pending Wtmo and an anti-SLAPP directive, and said it lacks a legal basis for the requested investigations into funding.
The ministries do not have a legal basis to carry out these kinds of investigations.
De ministeries beschikken niet over een juridische grondslag om dit soort onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de onrust op Nederlandse universiteiten nadat een pro-Israelische spreker een lezing heeft gehouden

Eerdmans (JA21) asks the Ministers of Education and of Justice about disruption at Radboud and Maastricht universities during a lecture by a pro-Israeli speaker, including risk assessments, security measures, handling of disruptors, and protection of Jewish and Israeli students. Minister Bruins answers that the institutions bear primary responsibility for risk assessment and security, that the ministry has been in contact with them, that the minister has no central data on sanctions or students who stay away, and that the minister will inform parliament before the summer recess on follow-up discussions with the sector.
Assessing the risks of lectures and taking security measures, and involving the competent parties where necessary, is the responsibility of the institution in consultation with the local triangle.

Het beoordelen van de risico's van lezingen en het nemen van veiligheidsmaatregelen en het daarbij waar nodig inschakelen van daartoe bevoegde partijen, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling in samenspraak met de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het versterken van meldpunt 144 tegen dierenmishandeling

An MP asked the government how it is strengthening animal-abuse reporting line 144 after its tasks were scaled back, including the €2 million budget, the 24/7 availability motion and the business case. The minister confirmed the police are drafting an implementation plan with options such as outsourcing the line, and promised to inform parliament before Prinsjesdag.
I aim to inform you further about this implementation plan before Prinsjesdag.
Ik streef ernaar om u vóór Prinsjesdag nader te informeren over dit uitvoeringsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heite en Olger van Dijk over de bezuiniging op rampenbestrijding en de conclusies van het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘De derde hoofdtaak van de krijgsmacht’

MPs Heite and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers of Defence and Justice and Security about the Court of Audit report on the armed forces' third main task (disaster relief), the cuts, coordination with civil services, and civilian resilience. The ministers answered that Defence met all 447 civil assistance requests, that the Court's concerns mainly concern wartime capacity, that civil-military coordination will be strengthened, and that a resilience campaign is planned, but gave no firm guarantees on future capacity shortfalls.
Defence stated in its administrative response that it will adopt the recommendations made by the Court of Audit.
Defensie heeft in haar bestuurlijke reactie gemeld de door de Algemene Rekenkamer gedane aanbevelingen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht “Lokale wielrenners balen van afgelast NK wielrennen”

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether sports events, including the NK wielrennen, are being cancelled due to police capacity shortages linked to the NATO summit, and about police deployment data and protocols for small events. The minister answered that local authorities decide on event permits, no national figures are kept, and no protocol is planned, while pointing to burgermotorverkeersregelaars as an alternative.
There is no overview of the number of sports events that cannot proceed due to a lack of police capacity.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal sportevenementen dat niet kan doorgaan wegens een gebrek aan politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Six Dijkstra over de stroomstoring in Spanje en Portugal

Two MPs asked the government about the April 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal, including the risk of a similar outage in the Netherlands, the protection of the grid, emergency plans, and public preparedness for long outages. The government answered that such a blackout is unlikely in the Netherlands, described existing grid safeguards, crisis plans and the coming Cbw/Wwke rules, and said citizens should be prepared for 72 hours of self-reliance.

In mid-2025 a multi-year public campaign (national government, other authorities, businesses and social organisations) starts to further increase societal resilience to long-term failure of daily services.

Medio 2025 start een meerjarige publiekscampagne (rijksoverheid, andere overheden, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties) om de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid bij langdurige uitval van dagelijkse voorzieningen (ongeacht de aard van de dreiging) verder te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de onafhankelijkheid van de beoordeling van politiegeweld in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police use-of-force investigations are independent, and whether Dutch assessment of force meets ECHR case law on absolute or strict necessity. The minister rejected the criticism, arguing that Dutch rules (proportionality, subsidiarity, prosecutorial oversight and independent investigators such as the Rijksrecherche) satisfy the ECHR.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de oproep van een Nederlands/Syrisch influencer tot 'uitroeien' van Alawieten

Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about an influencer's call to 'exterminate' Alawites after killings in Syria, and whether similar calls had occurred in the Netherlands and whether measures were taken against sectarian spillover. The government answered that it cannot retrieve counts of reports or investigations from police and prosecution systems, stated it takes community tensions seriously via SZW monitoring and the NCTV, and said no signals currently show violent incidents against specific persons.
From the systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service it cannot be retrieved how many reports, complaints or criminal investigations are carried out regarding such calls.
Uit de systemen van politie en Openbaar Ministerie kan niet worden gehaald hoeveel meldingen, aangiften of strafrechtelijke onderzoeken er worden gedaan naar dergelijke oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de mogelijke uitlevering van een Amerikaanse vrouw

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands received a US extradition request for a woman suspected of murder, who had reportedly stayed in an asylum centre, and whether extradition would be refused if the death penalty could apply. The minister declined to comment on the individual case but explained that Dutch extradition law and treaties require a death-penalty guarantee before extradition, and that the Netherlands would refuse if the US could not give one.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brandbrief die Amsterdamse kerken aan de burgemeester van Amsterdam stuurden in verband met het gebrek aan fysieke ruimte om hun diensten en activiteiten plaats te laten vinde

MP Ceder asked whether the government recognises the shortage of physical space for church services in Amsterdam, whether Article 6 of the Constitution guarantees such space, and whether the government will press municipalities, including Amsterdam and Rotterdam, to reserve space for religious communities. The minister answered that space allocation is a municipal matter, that Article 6 imposes no obligation to guarantee physical space, that the state can only intervene if freedom of religion is rendered illusory, and that existing guidance is sufficient, with no concrete new action committed.
Article 6 of the Constitution, however, does not impose on the government an obligation of result to make sufficient physical space available for holding religious services.
Artikel 6 van de Grondwet legt de overheid echter geen resultaatsverplichting op om voldoende fysieke ruimte beschikbaar te maken voor het houden van erediensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Emiel van Dijk over Ayoub Y. die in 2020 de 18-jarige Rik van de Rakt doodstak.

PVV MPs asked why Ayoub M., who stabbed 18-year-old Rik van de Rakt while holding a temporary residence permit, was not stripped of his permit, why he may soon qualify for tbs leave, and whether he will be deported. The ministers said they do not discuss individual cases, described the tbs leave assessment procedure in general terms, and pointed to their general policy letter on revoking asylum permits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de blijvende ICT-problemen bij het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about recurring ICT failures at the Public Prosecution Service (OM), including the latest outage and what has been done and invested to fix it. The minister acknowledged the outages and the outdated systems, listed past and planned investments, and said the upgrade proceeds step by step under supervision of the College of Procurators-General, without new commitments.
The OM is doing its utmost to improve its ICT.
Het OM spant zich tot het uiterste in om de ICT te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie en het ministerie van SZW en VWS iftars organiseren

Two SGP MPs asked whether police and ministries hold iftar gatherings during Ramadan, questioning their neutrality given a reported in-uniform prayer, their costs, and why Islamic holidays dominate. The government answered that police and ministries organise gatherings for diversity and inclusion, that costs are absorbed in existing budgets, that in-uniform prayer is undesirable while attending iftars is acceptable, and that no nationwide policy governs which days are marked.
A call to prayer in uniform does not seem to me to fit with a police force that projects neutrality.
Een oproep tot gebed in uniform vind ik niet passen bij een politie die neutraliteit uitstraalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Burgemeester bezorgd over uitkomst onderzoek illegale prostitutie en mensenhandel: ‘Misstanden aangetroffen”

An MP asked the ministers about reports of serious abuses found in illegal prostitution during a Hague inspection, and about the scale of victims of exploitation, shelter capacity and protection of migrant sex workers. The government answered that the abuses are serious, that cooperation with municipalities is being supported through the Action Plan, and that it is preparing further steps such as a vision letter, a review of the motion on talks with countries of origin, and a study on decoupling victim status from prosecution.
The abuses found as described in the report are serious.
De aangetroffen misstanden zoals benoemd in het bericht zijn ernstig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het aan de Tweede Kamer doen toekomen van bij de overheid berustende documenten

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a 'known Dutch citizens' file, several internal ministry and NCTV documents, and communications about a prosecutor's handling of a case were not being shared with parliament. The Minister refused disclosure of most documents, citing criminal investigations, privacy, state interests and internal decision-making, while promising no concrete new action beyond pointing to existing publications.

Disclosure of data that play a role in the investigation and prosecution of criminal offences could frustrate that investigation and prosecution, and I therefore do not consider it suitable to share with your House.

Openbaarmaking van gegevens die een rol spelen in de opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten kan die opsporing en vervolging frustreren en acht ik om die reden niet geschikt om met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het doen van aangifte tegen een politieagent

An MP asked the Justice Minister why people wanting to file a criminal complaint (aangifte) against a police officer are routed to the complaints procedure, and whether this is consistent with the duty to record complaints. The minister acknowledged the chatbot wrongly routed people to complaints, said this will be fixed, stated that aangifte against police must be possible and is normally handled by the VIK units, and noted that the police do not register separately how many aangiften against officers are filed.
I have learned from the police that this will be improved, so that in future a person will first be pointed to the option to file a criminal complaint.
Van de politie heb ik vernomen dat dit wordt verbeterd, zodat in de toekomst iemand eerst op de aangiftemogelijkheid gewezen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘XR kondigt aanvallen met boterzuur aan, gemeente Eindhoven laat het begaan; geeft ondernemers tips over ventilatie en EHBO’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government will act against Extinction Rebellion's announced use of butyric acid in Eindhoven, whether it qualifies as terrorism or a criminal organisation, and why local authorities are not intervening. The minister condemned the tactic, said the mayor decides on protest conditions, and said prosecution and banning a group are matters for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts.
It is not for the cabinet but for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether a specific case constitutes a terrorist offence or a criminal organisation.
Het is niet aan het kabinet maar aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er in bepaald geval sprake is van een terroristisch misdrijf of een criminele organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht ‘XR kondigt aanvallen met boterzuur aan, gemeente Eindhoven laat het begaan; geeft ondernemers tips over ventilatie en EHBO’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why Eindhoven and Gouda do not intervene preventively against Extinction Rebellion butyric acid actions, and demanded the government ensure shopkeepers' and citizens' safety. The Minister replied that permitting demonstrations and preventive measures is a matter for the mayor within the local triangle, that butyric acid use is unacceptable, and that he supports mayors imposing conditions on such demonstrations.
It is a local matter and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council for it.
Het is een lokale aangelegenheid en de burgemeester legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over de rol van sociale media bij openbare ordeverstoringen

MP Emiel van Dijk (PVV) asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a citizens' dialogue on online-incited public order disturbances was organised, how it differs from the Citizens' Climate Assembly, its costs, staffing, participant selection and expert selection. The Minister answered that the dialogue implements the coalition's aim to involve citizens in policy, is smaller and cheaper than the climate assembly (estimated €350,000), selects participants by lottery from 100,000 invitations, and will inform the House in summer.
In the summer the House will be informed both about the outcome of the citizens' dialogue and about the (expected) outcome of various other ongoing and completed initiatives.
In de zomer zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over zowel de opbrengst van de burgerdialoog als de (verwachte) opbrengst van verschillende andere lopende en afgeronde initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Emiel van Dijk en Heutink over het bericht ‘OM vervolgt niemand na aangifte om mishandeling NS-conducteur’

MPs Van Dijk and Heutink asked why no one was prosecuted after a reported assault on an NS conductor, whether minor offences could be pursued, and what measures are being taken to curb violence on public transport. The State Secretary answered that the prosecutor found insufficient evidence, outlined existing measures (travel bans, bodycams, camera coverage, planned access to the driving-licence register for OV-boa's), and said NS is evaluating a broader rollout of bodycams.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on a decision by the Public Prosecution Service in a specific investigation.
Het past mij niet om een oordeel te vellen over een beslissing van het OM in een specifiek onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Michon-Derkzen en Koops over de omgang met een informant van de politie

MPs asked the Justice Minister about a police informant who was detained and could not defend himself after being prosecuted, and whether compensation or legal gaps should be addressed. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, citing the need to protect informant identities, and said existing rules adequately cover informants, so no legal gap is seen.
As Minister, I do not comment on individual cases or on matters concerning whether persons work or have worked as informants for the police and judicial authorities.
Als Minister ga ik niet in op individuele zaken en op zaken die zien op de vraag of personen als informant voor politie en justitie werken of in het verleden hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Nieuw boek Joran van der Sloot op plek 30 in bestseller 60'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the government knows about outstanding compensation owed by Joran van der Sloot to victims and relatives, whether his book earnings should go to them, and whether the state should help recover it. The minister said the government has no oversight of these foreign convictions, cannot intervene in another country's jurisdiction, and has no role in enforcing foreign judgments.
Criminal cases, convictions and the enforcement of decisions abroad take place under the laws and regulations of the country concerned.
Strafzaken, veroordelingen en de tenuitvoerlegging van beslissingen in het buitenland vinden plaats volgens de wet- en regelgeving van het betreffende land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Westerveld over het beboeten van dakloze mensen

MPs Beckerman and Westerveld asked why municipalities still fine homeless people for sleeping rough, begging and camping, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary agrees fines worsen homelessness, says municipalities set these rules under their own powers, and says talks with the VNG about alternatives are ongoing.
Municipal councils have, however, under Article 147 of the Municipalities Act, the power to adopt bylaws that they consider necessary in the interest of the municipality.
Gemeenteraden hebben echter op grond van artikel 147 Gemeentewet de bevoegdheid om verordeningen vast te stellen, die zij in het belang van de gemeente nodig achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wijnen-Nas en Zanten over de column ‘Afgeslacht om die achterlijke reden: Eer’

MPs Van Zanten and Wijnen-Nas asked the government about a Telegraaf column on honour killings and what it would do about the attitudes behind them and whether citizenship could be revoked for honour-motivated crimes. The state secretary condemned the worldview, described prevention and repression measures, and said revoking Dutch nationality is only possible within European Convention limits, with the government studying whether other serious crimes could be added.
Revoking Dutch nationality is only possible for persons who hold another nationality besides Dutch.
Intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit is alleen mogelijk bij personen die naast de Nederlandse nog een andere nationaliteit hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Klikken over uitkeringsfraude? Dat kan in steeds meer gemeenten, maar ook kritiek neemt toe'

MPs Van Kent and Van Nispen (SP) asked whether municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for welfare benefits should be curbed, given reports of harm to citizens and social trust. The State Secretary defended municipal discretion over hotlines, said they yield useful signals and that investigations include hearing rights, and rejected a ban while answering several questions only in general terms.
So I will not introduce a ban on the hotlines.
Ik ga dus geen verbod invoeren op de meldpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Nieuwe trend bij online pesten: ‘Het is ongelooflijk triest gedrag’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether consistent online bullying harms victims' mental health, whether bullying will be included in the planned criminalisation of psychological violence, and whether schools can refer bullies to Halt. The government agreed bullying is harmful, said existing criminal law covers some forms, said consultations on the psychological violence bill are ongoing with details due before summer 2025, and explained Halt referral is possible via police/prosecution or municipal preventive interventions.
Your House will be informed before summer 2025 about the outlines of this bill.
Uw Kamer wordt voor de zomer 2025 geïnformeerd over de contouren van dit wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van der Wal over het bericht ‘Politie en defensie worstelen met 'soevereine' collega's die overheid niet erkennen’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van der Wal asked how many police and defence staff hold sovereign-movement views, whether such staff can be disciplined or removed, and what the government is doing against anti-institutional thinking among employees. The ministers answer that signals are taken seriously, that disciplinary and security-clearance measures exist, that reporting channels are available, and that responsibility is shared across ministries, while declining to give detailed numbers for reasons of confidentiality.
The MIVD, given its statutory duty of secrecy, does not discuss its sources, current knowledge level and/or its modus operandi.
De MIVD gaat gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding, niet in op haar bronnen, het actuele kennisniveau en/of de modus operandi van de dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Fundamentele koerswijziging OM: Dieven en oplichters zo min mogelijk voor de strafrechter’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's shift to handling theft and fraud cases below six years' imprisonment via penal orders rather than court, and whether the policy conflicts with the community-service ban and legislative intent. The minister defended the expanded use of penal orders as a way to shorten case times, said the OM's policy stays within legal limits, and noted monitoring, a WODC study and a Procurator-General follow-up study are underway.
The OM has informed me that, partly in light of the questions raised, ample time is being taken for careful monitoring of the current expansion and preparation of possible future expansions.

Het OM heeft mij geïnformeerd dat, mede gelet op de ontstane vragen, ruim de tijd wordt genomen voor een zorgvuldige monitoring van de huidige uitbreiding en voorbereiding van mogelijke toekomstige uitbreidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de fundamentele koerswijziging van het Openbaar Ministerie om veel meer strafzaken zelf af te gaan doen met OM-strafbeschikkingen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's decision to issue far more OM penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) for property crimes, including whether this bypasses judicial review, weakens rights and victim protection, and was properly communicated. The minister answered that the OM acts within its statutory powers, that the change aims to shorten case durations and relieve courts, that safeguards and legal aid remain in place, and that a Kamer debate and WODC research are planned.
The OM functions independently and autonomously with regard to sentencing in criminal cases.
Het OM functioneert ten aanzien van de strafoplegging in strafzaken zelfstandig en onafhankelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koops, Omtzigt en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Gewijzigd beleid van het Openbaar Ministerie rondom strafbeschikkingen, waardoor bijvoorbeeld veelplegers en asielzoekers standaard een str

Three MPs asked the Justice and Asylum ministers about the Public Prosecution Service's expanded use of penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen), which could mean repeat offenders and asylum seekers receive fines or community service instead of prison and no longer go before a judge. The minister answers that the OM acts independently, that the expansion aims to shorten case times and cover offences up to six years, that cases can still be referred to court, and that the data requested is not registered or is forthcoming later.
The OM will clarify the passage in the instruction at the next amendment or following instruction on this point.
Het OM zal de passage in de instructie bij een eerstvolgende wijziging of volgende instructie op dit punt verhelderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over een nieuw uitgesproken fatwa

MP Wilders asked the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government would act against a new fatwa by a convicted Pakistani cleric calling for his killing and whether it would press Pakistan to cooperate with enforcement of a prior Dutch sentence. The government condemned the fatwa, said it had conveyed its view to Pakistani authorities, and stated that Dutch authorities depend on other states' cooperation for cases abroad, while not announcing new concrete action.

As reported in the answers to earlier parliamentary questions from MP Wilders, the cabinet is making maximum efforts to get the Pakistani authorities to cooperate with the requests concerning the persons convicted in the Netherlands.

Zoals gemeld in de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen van het lid Wilders, spant het kabinet zich maximaal in om de Pakistaanse autoriteiten te laten meewerken aan de verzoeken met betrekking tot de in Nederland veroordeelde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Pijpelink over het bericht dat criminele ronselaars hun slag slaan op scholen

MPs Mutluer and Pijpelink asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports that criminal recruiters increasingly target pupils at schools, and what the government knows, trains, and does about it. The minister answers that no figures on school recruitment are recorded, points to a study requested from the Centre for Child and Human Trafficking, existing school safety duties, a planned notification duty for serious incidents, and the Preventie met Gezag programme, and says he will consult the VNG on youth workers at schools.
There are no figures available on the number of young people approached by criminals.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat wordt benaderd door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht dat er wolven in Nederland verdwijnen en dat experts aanwijzingen voor stroperij zien

An MP asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about reports that a quarter of registered wolves in the Netherlands have vanished without explanation and that experts see signs of poaching, asking about preventive measures, police action, and protection of ecologists. The government answered that poaching is condemned and handled by police and provinces, that BIJ12 has not found an unusual pattern and reports no concrete poaching complaints, and that no special measures are planned.
I have no indications to share these concerns.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen om deze zorgen te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Zanten en Stoffer over het bericht van De Nieuwe Ster ’Hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op UWC’

MPs Van Zanten and Stoffer asked about reports of swastikas, antisemitic remarks by a guest speaker, and a student email at UWC Maastricht, and whether the school and the Inspectorate are protecting pupils. The State Secretary answered that the school has registered incidents, tightened its guest-speaker and email protocols and safety policy, and that the Inspectorate sees no reason for further steps while staying alert, offering support via a school-safety foundation.
The inspectorate is of the view that the board and the school are taking the situation very seriously.
De inspectie is van oordeel dat het bestuur en de school de situatie zeer serieus oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over politie inzet tijdens NAVO Top in Den Haag tussen 24-26 juni

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Justice and Security how public order elsewhere in the Netherlands would be guaranteed during the NATO summit, and about event cancellations, sponsor contract losses and liability. The minister answered that police and Defence will support each other, that local authorities decide on events based on available police capacity, and that local parties will consult on solutions.
I trust that they will jointly reach a solution that does justice to all interests as far as possible.
Ik vertrouw erop dat zij in gezamenlijkheid tot een oplossing komen waarin zo veel mogelijk aan alle belangen recht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitlevering van drie veroordeelde Pakistanen

An MP asked whether three Pakistani nationals convicted in the Netherlands for serious offences against him had been extradited, what concrete steps had been taken with Pakistan, and insisted on nothing less than extradition. The government answered that Pakistan has been formally asked to extradite, that the matter is raised repeatedly at all levels, but it declined to give details of diplomatic contacts and said the response is up to Pakistan.
As to which specific efforts have been made, given the confidential nature of diplomatic communications with foreign authorities, we will make no further statements.
Over welke inspanningen precies zijn gepleegd, doen wij gezien de vertrouwelijke aard van het diplomatieke verkeer met buitenlandse autoriteiten, geen verdere uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Shit, kan ik nog terug?' Chemiestudent Marieke werd twee keer geronseld voor drugslab'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports of chemistry students being recruited by drug criminals, including signals known to universities and police, protection measures, criminal liability and prevention campaigns. The government answered that recruitment of people with specific skills occurs but its frequency is unknown, pointed to existing prevention programmes, anonymous reporting channels and the criminal law provision, and declined to set up a dedicated information point for students.
How often this exactly occurs is not known.
Hoe vaak dit precies is, is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over het onbetrouwbare algoritme dat jongeren als crimineel bestempelt

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the Preselect Recidive algorithm that flags young suspects as future criminals, including its purpose, validation, transparency, privacy assessment, error rates and whether affected youths can object. The State Secretary answered that the tool only informs a human decision at the ZSM consultation, promised to register it in the Algorithm Register in 2025, to inform youths and parents, and to redevelop the tool with a new report in the second half of 2025.
When the Preselect Recidive is applied there is therefore always a decision by people, not by an algorithm, which also uses other information about the young person.
Er is bij de toepassing van de Preselect Recidive dus altijd sprake van een besluit door mensen, niet door een algoritme, waarbij ook andere informatie over de jongere wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht ‘Klap in het gezicht van winkelier Mia: dief gaat na greep uit kluis vrijuit, want al eerder gestraft’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why a repeat thief who stole 4,200 euro from a shop safe was not prosecuted because he had already been sentenced for another offence, and asked about OM statistics and recovery of damages. The Minister declined to judge individual prosecution decisions, which rest with the Public Prosecution Service, gave only a general explanation under Article 63 of the Criminal Code, said he has no statistics, and pointed to existing routes for victims to recover damages.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to give a judgment on (prosecution decisions in) individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om een oordeel te geven over (vervolgingsbeslissingen in) individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de bedreiging van deurwaarders, ambtenaren en andere overheidsfunctionarissen door soevereinen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about threats against bailiffs, civil servants and other officials by self-declared sovereigns, and what measures are taken to protect them. The minister answers that such threats are unacceptable, that a 2024 survey found 31% of cases of aggression involved self-declared sovereigns, that protection measures and a resilience coordinator exist, but that no specific classification of sovereign-related threats exists and no dedicated new measures are announced beyond existing programmes and further research.
This survey does not specifically examine threats and intimidation by sovereigns.
In dit onderzoek wordt niet specifiek gekeken naar bedreigingen en intimidatie door soevereinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Agent kan voortaan ook eed zweren op Allah of andere god’

An MP asks why the police oath was modernised to allow religious formulas (such as invoking Allah) without prior parliamentary consultation, questioning consistency with other public employers and the BZK minister's earlier statements on religion. The minister replies that the change is a labour-terms matter agreed with police unions within mandate, that BZK is not responsible for police, and describes the rationale, the Defence-inspired wording, and a work instruction for religious formulas.
The change to the oath and pledge is a change in terms of employment between the police employer and the police unions within the cabinet's mandate.
De wijziging van de eed en belofte betreft een rechtspositionele wijziging tussen werkgever van politie en de politievakbonden binnen mandaat van het kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het antwoord op vragen over over het antwoord op vragen over het bericht ‘inzake het Rapport dat de beveiliging staatsgeheimen NCTV en politie niet op orde is’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the ADR report finding that NCTV and police secret-information security was not in order, including possible misuse by an analyst-interpreter, unchecked clearances, and weak monitoring. The minister answered that no other cases are known, that the ADR did not investigate individuals, that many remedial measures have been taken, and that several questions are withheld because the criminal investigation or classified detail prevents disclosure.
Information relating to the suspicion of collecting or disseminating state-secret or confidential information is part of the criminal investigation.
Informatie die verband houdt met de verdenking van het verzamelen dan wel verspreiden van staatsgeheime/vertrouwelijke informatie is onderdeel van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Helder over storingen in C2000 en eOCS-systemen

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Helder asked about outages in the C2000 radio network and eOCS system, including their risk during the NATO summit, back-up options for solo officers, long-term prevention and procurement flexibility. The Minister said fallback arrangements, a second-opinion investigation and four improvement action lines are in place, but gave no firm commitment to push-to-talk changes before the summit.
I will inform the House, through the collective letters on fire services, crisis management and control rooms, about the outcomes of the investigations and experiments.
Ik zal uw Kamer middels de verzamelbrieven brandweerzorg, crisisbeheersing en meldkamers informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en experimenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het opzetten van een kaasfabriek in Marokko met Nederlandse subsidies voor deradicalisering

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen asked about alleged misuse of Dutch deradicalisation and integration subsidies by Rotterdam foundations, including funding a cheese factory in Morocco, and about the status of prosecution, recovery claims, and radicalisation oversight. The minister answered that the OM prosecuted fraud by the foundations via penal orders, that information sharing with Rotterdam was limited to what the OM judged appropriate, that recovery is limited by a five-year term, and described current prevention policy and evaluation tools.
The OM is currently in discussion with the municipality to determine which information can be shared.
Momenteel is het OM met de gemeente in gesprek om te bezien welke informatie wel kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de sektarische Twee aan Twee-beweging die ook in Nederland slachtoffers maakt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the Twee aan Twee movement, a closed group alleged to involve abuse and isolation of members, including in the Netherlands. The State Secretary said no police, prosecution or child protection cases were known, saw no need for independent research now, and pointed to a new Fier help and knowledge point for victims of coercive groups.
I currently see no need for independent research into this specific group.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak voor onafhankelijk onderzoek naar deze specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Ruim 700 aanhoudingen bij demonstratie Extinction Rebellion op A12'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about mass arrests at an Extinction Rebellion blockade of the A12, whether prosecutions have followed, what preventive measures will stop the next blockade, and how many people faced delayed ambulances. The minister said prosecution decisions await the public prosecutor, that preventive measures are a local matter for the mayor, that a ban on face coverings at demonstrations is being explored, and that ambulance delays were due to several factors.
The public prosecutor is currently investigating possible offences committed during the demonstration and will then assess whether prosecution is appropriate.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doet op dit moment onderzoek naar mogelijke misdrijven die tijdens de demonstratie zijn gepleegd en zal daarna afwegen of vervolging opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Agent stopt met social media om beleid politie: ‘Echt heel jammer’’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police social media rules, which tightened account requirements, should be relaxed so neighbourhood officers can keep their accounts and show their work. The Minister confirmed the 2024 update to account requirements, said police accounts must be recognisable, and declined to revise the policy, noting it supports the police leadership's approach.
I support this social media policy of the police leadership.
Ik ondersteun dit social mediabeleid van de korpsleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over bezoeken van De Eritrese ambassadeur voor de Europese Unie en de Benelux-landen aan Nederlandse steden

SP MPs asked whether local authorities were consulted about visits by Eritrea's ambassador to Amersfoort and Amsterdam, whether the visits constitute foreign interference, and whether the ambassador will be addressed. The government said municipalities were not informed in advance, that unlawful conduct would prompt firm action, and that Eritrean diplomats were previously expelled for coerced diaspora tax collection.
Municipalities Amersfoort and Amsterdam indicated that they were not informed in advance of the meetings and therefore they were not discussed within the local security triangle.

Gemeente Amersfoort en gemeente Amsterdam hebben aangegeven dat zij niet op voorhand op de hoogte waren van de bijeenkomsten en dat hier dus ook niet binnen de lokale veiligheidsdriehoek over is gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de oproep van het Openbaar Ministerie om de wetgeving tegen corruptie te verbeteren

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why prosecutors say Dutch law makes bribery of officials hard to prove, including the requirement of a direct quid pro quo, and whether Dutch law lags other EU states on trading in influence. The minister replied that the bribery offences are sufficiently broad, no direct link to a counter-performance is required, proof is hard in practice, Dutch law lacks a separate trading-in-influence offence, and legislative changes will be considered after the EU anti-corruption directive negotiations conclude.
So at present I do not have the picture that the current legislation offers insufficient possibilities to prosecute officials for corruption.
Ik heb dus op dit moment niet het beeld dat de huidige wetgeving onvoldoende mogelijkheden biedt om ambtenaren te vervolgen voor corruptie.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Michon- Derkzen, Becker en Rajkowski over de komst van omstreden predikers naar de Ramadan Expo in de Jaarbeurs

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Asylum ministers how to keep three controversial preachers with past antisemitic, homophobic and extremist statements from speaking at the Ramadan Expo in Utrecht, and what could be done about the organisers and the venue. The Minister said the three were barred via SIS signalling, that a court suspended this until a decision on objection, that the municipality holds the power over public order and any prohibition, and that prosecution remains possible if speech is criminal.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended these decisions until six weeks after the decision on the objection, with the result that the alerts in the Schengen Information System were removed and the persons can travel to the Netherlands.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter deze besluiten geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar, met als gevolg dat de signaleringen in het Schengeninformatiesysteem verwijderd zijn en personen Nederland in kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel Van Dijk, Van der Velde en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ongehoord Nederland zoekt man of vrouw, ’geen X’, OM doet onderzoek naar discriminatie’

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers why the Public Prosecution Service is investigating a broadcaster's job ad requiring 'man or woman, not X' while other cases get less attention, and whether the government recognizes only two biological sexes.
