The minister replied that prosecutors act on their own authority, that there is sexual diversity, that broadcasters set their own hiring within equal-treatment rules, and that no measures will be taken.
The Public Prosecution Service initiates criminal investigations on its own authority and on the basis of known principles.
Het Openbaar Ministerie stelt op eigen gezag en op basis van kenbare uitgangspunten strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State naar de media zijn gelekt

An MP asked the Asylum and Migration Minister whether leaks of Raad van State advisory opinions to the media were unusual, whether only the ministry received the opinions, and whether the leak would be reported to the police. The minister said the leaked content was unusual and undesirable but declined to qualify it as criminal, said no criminal complaint would be filed for lack of grounds, and noted the opinions were later published by the Raad van State on schedule.
I consider it undesirable when statements are made about Raad van State advisory opinions before they are made public by the Raad van State.
Ik vind het onwenselijk wanneer mededelingen worden gedaan over adviezen van de Raad van State, voordat deze openbaar zijn gemaakt door de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel 'Kinderrechten en de toetsende taak van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming'

An MP asks the Minister and State Secretaries whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, a government advisory body, should be stripped of its review role over non-extension of child protection measures in favour of an independent children's judge, citing ECHR Article 6 and a Dutch Juristenblad article. The State Secretary answers that the RvdK's review is lawful and independent, that the judge decides on extensions, that children are heard where possible, and that the current arrangement is not to be changed.
In case of doubt about the existence of grounds for extension, this can be submitted, with the final decision reserved for the judge.
Bij twijfel over het bestaan van gronden voor de verlenging, kan dit worden voorgelegd, waarbij het uiteindelijke besluit is voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ME’ers zijn uitputting nabij verboden demonstraties – echt bijna op

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police (ME) exhaustion after banned demonstrations in Amsterdam, aftercare for officers, whether demonstrations should have been allowed under an emergency ordinance, and the impact on police capacity for the 2025 NAVO summit. The minister answered that the ME was deployed repeatedly, that aftercare is provided, that local authorities are responsible for permitting decisions, and that police capacity will be sufficient for the summit, with mutual assistance between units if local shortages arise.
It is up to the authorities to set priorities on this.
Het is aan het gezag om hierop te prioriteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral en Rajkowski over het artikel ‘Mensensmokkel via zee goudmijn’

MPs Dral and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that criminal networks use the Netherlands as a hub for preparing people-smuggling crossings to the UK, including monitoring of networks, reporting by the maritime sector, social media recruitment and protection of unaccompanied minor Vietnamese girls. Minister Van Weel answered that preparatory acts occur in the Netherlands, that international cooperation (Europol OTF Wave, Calais Group) is ongoing, that reports are not centrally recorded so no comparative figures exist, and that current protection measures for unaccompanied minors are considered sufficient.
However, figures on these reports are not centrally recorded and therefore cannot be compared with previous years.
Cijfers over deze meldingen worden echter niet centraal bijgehouden, en zijn dus ook niet te vergelijken met voorgaande jaren.

Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Mutluer over het onderzoeksrapport Beveiligingsproces van staatsgeheime vertrouwelijke informatie bij NCTV en politie van de Audit Dienst Rijk, alsmede de kabinetsrea

MPs Six Dijkstra and Mutluer asked the government about the ADR report on security failures at the NCTV and police, including oversight, the BVA's role, and a leak. This follow-up letter answers question 5 by stating that a search found documents on the NCTV's security situation, that these are being assessed, and that some passages will be withheld for state and privacy reasons, with further documents to follow.
This has led to certain passages in the documents not being made public because they may harm the interests of the State.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid bepaalde passages uit de documenten niet openbaar te maken omdat deze de belangen van de Staat kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Zanten over Samidoun

An MP asked whether the government would ban a Samidoun teach-in at the University of Amsterdam, after Samidoun's Europe coordinator had earlier been barred, and what the status is of a motion to list Samidoun on the Dutch terrorist sanctions list. The minister replied that universities decide on events under academic freedom, that the UvA says the event was not officially registered and Samidoun is not welcome, and that no sufficient grounds currently exist for a court ban or sanctions listing, with a broader EU inventory and possible further measures to be reported in spring.

The conversation that has since taken place confirmed that the Public Prosecution Service currently has no information that could contribute to a request for a court ban or listing on the sanctions list.

Het gesprek dat inmiddels heeft plaatsgevonden heeft bevestigd dat het Openbaar Ministerie op dit moment geen informatie heeft die kan bijdragen aan een verzoek om verbodenverklaring bij de rechter of plaatsing op de sanctielijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Klap voor ministers: omstreden buitenlandse predikers mogen toch Nederland in van rechter’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked ministers how they would prevent three controversial foreign preachers from entering the Netherlands, whether landing rights could be revoked as in 2017, and what would be done if they had already landed. The ministers answered that a court had suspended the entry ban, so the preachers may enter if they meet entry conditions, that existing law offers no further grounds to refuse them, that landing rights cannot be revoked for migration reasons, and that local authorities are responsible for public order at the event.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended the decision to bar the three speakers from the Netherlands through an alert in the Schengen Information System, until six weeks after the decision on objection is announced.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter het besluit om de drie sprekers uit Nederland te weren door signalering in het Schengeninformatiesysteem, geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘De druppel die de emmer doet overlopen, naar een toekomstbestendige WETS-procedure voor overname van strafexecutie in Nederland de wetgever aan zet’

An MP asked the government about the lack of a direct hearing and limited legal remedies for convicted persons in the Dutch WETS recognition procedure for foreign prison sentences, and whether the procedure should be revised after the Arnhem-Leeuwarden appeal court was ruled inadmissible to refer questions to the European Court. The state secretary answered that convicted persons can submit written views, that civil courts remain available, and that a WODC study will examine the procedure's allocation of roles and legal protection.
Whether there is reason to revise the recognition procedure, as regards the legal protection of the convicted person, is the subject of the already announced study by the WODC.

Of er aanleiding bestaat om de erkenningsprocedure, wat betreft de rechtsbescherming van de veroordeelde, te herzien, is onderwerp van het reeds aangekondigde onderzoek van het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over het bericht dat krakers zich een bewoond appartement in Amsterdam hebben toegeëigend

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security why squatters who took over an occupied student flat in Amsterdam were not evicted and punished immediately, and whether this sets a precedent. The Minister replied that police capacity delayed intervention, that the investigating judge authorised eviction on 29 January and the flat was cleared that day, and that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service while damages may be claimed in civil proceedings.
I do not comment, as is customary, on any possible criminal prosecution in this case. That is a responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik uit mij, zoals te doen gebruikelijk, niet over een eventueel strafrechtelijk vervolg in deze zaak. Dat is een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Vandaag gestolen, morgen in Polen: ‘De hele polder wordt leeggeroofd'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about a news report on mass theft of farm machinery in rural areas, asking about its scale, registration, cross-border organised crime, funding for rural trust persons and ANPR cameras. The minister answered that theft shows no rising trend in police figures, outlined existing prevention and cross-border cooperation measures, and said budget for trust persons is secured through brancheorganisaties while police capacity is under strain.
The police have no insight into the amounts of the stolen vehicles.
De politie heeft geen inzicht in de bedragen van de gestolen voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak

MP Lahlah asks the Justice Minister and State Secretary about judicial independence after press reports of judges' concerns and academics warning of political influence over the judiciary, including whether the Minister should be removed from Raad voor de rechtspraak appointments and whether constitutional entrenchment is needed. The State Secretary replies that judicial independence is well guaranteed in law and surveys, that the government takes the concerns seriously, and that a letter to parliament on appointments, the Raad voor de rechtspraak and a constitutional court will follow in mid-2025.
I of course take the judges' concerns seriously. I intend to send parliament a letter in mid-2025 in which I will go into these constitutional starting points in more detail.
Ik neem de zorgen van de rechters uiteraard serieus. Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer medio 2025 een brief te sturen waarin ik nader in zal gaan op deze constitutionele uitgangspunten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de vrijspraak van dierenactivisten voor de stalbezetting in Boxtel

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the acquittal of animal activists for a pig-barn occupation in Boxtel, and the lack of firm sanctions, weakens protection of farmers and businesses, and whether a legal proposal treating stable occupations as trespass is needed. The minister answered that existing law (art. 138 and 461 Sr) already allows prosecution, that the OM decides on prosecution and the courts judge independently, and that no new legislation is needed; the answer also states the reply came late.
I cannot go into individual criminal cases, but in general I can say that the judge will assess each case on the basis of its specific circumstances.
Verder kan ik niet ingaan op individuele strafzaken maar kan ik in zijn algemeenheid wel zeggen dat de rechter elke zaak op basis van de specifieke omstandigheden van die zaak zal beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over de berichten 'Hypermoderne Tesla Cybertruck van rapper Kosso rijdt via omweg tóch op de Nederlandse weg' en 'Eerste legale Tesla Cybertruck in België rijdt rond: Ned

MPs Vedder and Boswijk asked whether Tesla Cybertrucks entering the Netherlands via loopholes (Albanian registration, Czech individual approval) pose road safety risks and what the government will do. The minister answered that the vehicle is registered abroad under the Vienna Convention, that the RDW has only a pending individual approval application for another Cybertruck, that enforcement tools exist but no new policy is planned, and that the government will push the European Commission to update individual approval rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW remain actively engaged in international forums where vehicle requirements affecting vehicle safety are further developed.

Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW blijven actief in gesprek in internationale gremia waar voertuigeisen, die van invloed zijn op de voertuigveiligheid, verder worden ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over “procesafspraken met grote criminelen”

An MP asks the Justice Minister about plea agreements with major international drug traffickers, whose sentences were reduced and who paid fines, and whether such deals are appropriate. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, defends plea agreements as efficient in complex cases, and says a statutory framework is being prepared with consultation advice still being processed.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Op individuele zaken kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de berichten dat criminelen op grote schaal actief zijn in de zorg

The SP's Dobbe asked the Ministers of VWS, OCW and Justice about reports that criminals operate on a large scale in healthcare, including fraudulent vocational certificates, unprosecuted DUO and KvK fraud reports, and whether the sector's underfunding enables abuse. The minister answered that the government is pursuing a broad integrated approach with concrete measures (stricter EVC handling, licensing extension, Wibz bill, DBA enforcement) while declining to address the underfunding claim directly and deferring follow-up info.
In line with the commitment made in earlier letters to your House, you will be informed shortly about follow-up actions by the relevant ministries to jointly curb the described abuses in healthcare.

Conform de in eerdergenoemde Kamerbrieven aan uw Kamer gedane toezegging, wordt u op korte termijn nader geïnformeerd over vervolgacties van onder andere de betrokken ministeries om gezamenlijk paal en perk te stellen aan de geschetste misstanden in de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over de artikelen 'Criminele zorgmedewerkers ronselen kwetsbare cliënten voor uithalen cocaïne' en ‘Drugshandelaren en plofkrakers 'op grote schaal' actief in de zorg, kw

An MP asked the Health and Justice ministers about reports that serious criminals are infiltrating the care sector, including recruiting vulnerable clients for drug runs, and what steps will prevent them and identify those already working there. The minister listed new rules (Wbsrz, expanded Wtza licensing, the forthcoming Wibz bill, Justis risk reports), said screening is the employers' responsibility, and declined to share a police signal document with parliament.
The signal document is therefore not suitable to share with the House.
Het signaaldocument is daarom niet geschikt om te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Van Nispen over het schenden van het verschoningsrecht door het OM

MPs Palmen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's breach of legal professional privilege in the Castor case, the settlement with Stibbe and an asset manager, the role of the landsadvocaat, and a disciplinary ruling on the landsadvocaat. The minister answered that the OM acknowledged a procedural error, that the Supreme Court filled a legal gap, that a new OM directive and a chain project are underway, and defended the landsadvocaat's good faith while answering most questions substantively.
The OM acknowledges that this constitutes a procedural irregularity.
Het OM erkent dat hier sprake is van een vormverzuim.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Mutluer over het onderzoeksrapport Beveiligingsproces van staatsgeheime vertrouwelijke informatie bij NCTV en politie van de Audit Dienst Rijk, alsmede de kabinetsreactie d

MPs Six Dijkstra and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the Audit Dienst Rijk report on classified information security at the NCTV and police, including management oversight, USB sticks possibly unaccounted for, and whistleblower protection. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, listed measures taken and promised further reviews, while declining to give some information (e.g. full documentation, an exact count of affected citizens) as ongoing investigation or unavailable.
Your House will be informed at a later point and in any case before the debate.
Uw Kamer wordt op een later moment en in ieder geval voor het debat nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Six Dijkstra over het bericht 'De Vonk nodigt omstreden pro-Palestijnse activist Khatib uit voor politiek evenement’

MPs Eerdmans and Six Dijkstra asked whether the government could stop Mohammed Khatib, invited by party De Vonk, from speaking in person or online in the Netherlands. The minister answered that Khatib is flagged for refusal at entry, that online speech can be prosecuted or removed, and that the government will explore broader tools while noting limits set by free speech case law.
I want to explore in the coming period whether there are possibilities within the framework of national security to broaden the scope for action.
Ik wil de komende tijd verkennen of er in het kader van nationale veiligheid mogelijkheden zijn om het handelingsperspectief te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Criminelen vroegen studiefinanciering aan op naam van Helmondse vrouw: rechter geeft minister veeg uit de pan’

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked how the ministry and DUO respond to a court finding that inadequate checks let student finance be fraudulently claimed in a victim's name, and about compensation, DigiD safeguards and legal access. The minister acknowledged a 2018 control gap that has been fixed, said the debt of the victim will be written off and DUO will try to recover from perpetrators, and committed to reviewing the court's ruling on advance payments without a legal basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij subsidieverlening

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Sneller asked about the use of the Bibob Act in subsidy grants by central government, including RVO's practice, data sharing with municipalities, and LBB advice requests. The minister answers that Bibob use is left to each state body and is risk-based, describes the RVO advisory group and ten LBB requests, and promises further evaluation and updates.
Because of the confidentiality duty in the Bibob Act, the LBB only shares figures on advice requests where they cannot be traced back to individual cases.
Het LBB deelt in verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht in de Wet Bibob alleen cijfers over adviesaanvragen als deze cijfers niet te herleiden zijn naar individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Bikker over het bericht ‘Deze zes mensen zien het vuilste van wat op internet rondgaat’ en ‘Politie waarschuwt honderdvijftig bezitters van kinderporno

MPs Van Dijk, Krul and Bikker asked why Dutch hosting providers are slow to remove child sexual abuse material, why police only warn downloaders rather than arrest them, and what legal tools exist. The minister acknowledges that only about 26% of Offlimits reports were handled within 24 hours in 2023, points to the new ATKM powers since July 2024, and explains that police prioritise producers and networks, using warning campaigns for downloaders.
In 74% of cases no or insufficient follow-up was given to a report, and the child pornography material remained visible for at least 24 hours.
In 74% van de gevallen werd geen of onvoldoende opvolging gegeven aan een melding en blijft het kinderpornografisch materiaal op zijn minst langer dan 24 uur zichtbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van Nispen over kluisverklaringen die mogelijk vernietigd worden

MPs Ellian and Van Nispen asked whether witness statements (kluisverklaringen) from a detained criminal, Goran K., should be destroyed when no cooperation deal with the Public Prosecution Service is reached, and how relevant information and imminent threats are handled. The Minister answers that statements are destroyed under statutory retention rules unless specific arrangements or serious interests justify earlier destruction, that information from non-agreed statements cannot be used for investigation, that threats are always acted upon, and declines to comment on the individual case.
It is not appropriate for me to go further into the substance of this individual case.
Het past mij niet om verder inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Ridouan Taghi krijgt schadevergoeding van Staat wegens onterechte beperkingen'

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Justice why the state pays damages to Ridouan Taghi for unlawful detention restrictions, whether the amounts were justified, how many other EBI prisoners received damages, and whether rights could be curtailed for such cases. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, stated in general terms that detainees can claim damages when a court finds restrictions unlawful, did not track EBI compensation figures, and refused to curtail fundamental rights.
Although I cannot go into individual case details, I can provide the following in general terms
Hoewel ik niet kan ingaan op individuele casuïstiek, kan ik u in zijn algemeenheid het volgende meegeven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State in de zaak Stichting Femmes For Freedom tegen de burgemeester van Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister how the Council of State ruling in the Femmes For Freedom case against The Hague mayor affects mayors' powers to act against preachers inciting violence against women and non-believers, and about possible legislation and EU/foreign comparisons. The minister agreed such incitement is unacceptable, said the Municipal Act gives no basis for preventive action against preachers, pointed to criminal prosecution by the OM, and promised consultation with VNG and to bills on criminalising glorification of terrorism, expected for internet consultation in spring 2025.
Neither the Municipal Act nor the Public Demonstrations Act provides a basis for preventively restricting the constitutional freedom of expression (due to the ban on censorship).
De Gemeentewet noch de Wet openbare manifestaties bieden de grondslag om preventief de grondwettelijke vrijheid van meningsuiting te beperken (vanwege het verbod op censuur).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het bericht ‘Grondrechten onder druk: demonstratierecht splijt politiek en samenleving’

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security how peaceful demonstrations are defined, how the balance between public order and the right to protest is kept, and how the criterion of public-order disruption is prevented from being applied against politically unwelcome protests. The minister answered that a sharper distinction between peaceful protest and disruptive action is being explored via a WODC study due in summer 2025, that the purpose or message of a demonstration should play no role, and that a broad dialogue will be held, while stating that the government will not tolerate deliberately disruptive or unlawful acts.
The purpose or message of an action may play no role in the assessment of a demonstration.
Het doel of de boodschap van een actie mogen geen rol spelen bij de beoordeling van een demonstratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en El Abassi over het niet naleven van de Wet politiegegevens

MPs Kathmann and El Abassi ask why the police have not complied with the Wet politiegegevens' deletion deadline for removed data, which the korpschef deliberately did not destroy from 2019 pending legal reform, and who oversees this. Minister Van Weel answers that the non-compliance is a deliberate, politically backed choice limited to article 14 data usable in cold cases, that the Raad van State has been asked for advice, and that a bill is planned for consultation in 2025.
There is no question of a tolerance decision. The korpschef decided, pending an amendment of the retention periods in the Wpg, not to proceed with destroying the relevant data.
Er is geen sprake van een gedoogbesluit. De korpschef heeft besloten in afwachting van een wijziging van de bewaartermijnen in de Wpg niet over te gaan tot vernietiging van de betreffende gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Belgische sekswerkers krijgen arbeidscontract en sociale zekerheden’

MP Podt asked the Justice Minister about Belgium's new rules giving sex workers employment contracts and social security, and whether the Netherlands should follow, including questions on worker numbers, social security gaps, bank accounts, employer integrity rules, rights and trafficking detection. The minister answered that a Belgian-style law is not currently warranted, that most Dutch sex workers are self-employed or under the opting-in scheme, and described ongoing work on opting-in oversight, bank account standards and integrity screening via local licensing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai  over arbeidscontracten voor sekswerkers

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a Belgian-style law giving sex workers employment contracts and social security would suit the Netherlands, and whether he would consult stakeholders on it. The minister answered that a Dutch law on the Belgian model is not currently warranted, that the opting-in scheme is the preferred route, and that he will discuss the matter with stakeholders and inform parliament in the autumn.
A Dutch law modelled on the Belgian law is therefore not currently a realistic option.
Een Nederlandse wet naar het voorbeeld van de Belgische wet ligt momenteel dan ook niet in de rede.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Six-Dijkstra en Kathmann over de rechterlijke toegang tot burgerinformatie van de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police refuse a court order to give a court-appointed forensic expert access to police data systems, and how citizens can access their police data. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, stated that court rulings should be followed and that police are in talks with the expert, and cited the Wpg access rules and existing audit findings.
In principle, court rulings must be followed.
Aan rechterlijke uitspraken dient in beginsel gevolg te worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Geweld, intimidatie en homofobie – hoe Feyenoord zijn meest gevreesde hooligans dichtbij houdt’

MPs Van den Hil and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that Feyenoord keeps its most feared hooligans close, including stadium-ban evasion and possession of stadium keys, and about how bans are enforced nationally. The State Secretary replied that the government leaves local enforcement to the mayor and the local OM-police triangle, offered help if requested, pointed to national programmes and bodies, and said the stadium-key claim was not confirmed while giving ban and enforcement statistics.
It is not appropriate for the national government to intervene here, but if the local authority wishes, I am willing to offer my help.
Het past niet dat de landelijke overheid hier in treedt, maar als het lokale gezag daar prijs op stelt, dan ben ik bereid mijn hulp aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mutluer en Helder over het afluistersysteem van de politie

MPs Van Nispen, Mutluer, Helder and Van der Werf asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the police wiretap system from Elbit was delayed and that an upgrade was bought as a backup, including questions about the supplier's staff access, human rights risks and AI use. The Minister denies that a new system was secretly bought, says the upgrade was a precaution, states that the new system will only be used once it meets requirements, and gives no firm guarantee on the first-half 2025 rollout.
Furthermore, it is good to note that because of the confidential tender, I cannot make statements about the supplier of the current wiretap system.
Verder is het goed om aan te geven dat vanwege de aanbesteding onder geheimhouding ik geen uitspraken kan doen over de leverancier van het huidige tapsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Westerveld over veilige opvang slachtoffers huiselijk geweld in de knel

MPs Mutluer and Westerveld asked about shortages of safe shelter places for domestic violence victims, who are being housed in hotels and holiday parks, and about the government's responsibility and funding. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible, that capacity data is still being developed, that extra funding has been provided but is not earmarked, and that the government will discuss the issue with municipalities and Valente but rules out returning to national financing for now.
Municipalities do not have to account to the national government for how they have precisely used the funds.
Gemeenten hoeven geen verantwoording te geven aan het Rijk over hoe zij de middelen precies hebben benut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over het bericht 'Evangelist op station Maastricht met machtsvertoon staande gehouden: 'Intimiderende en dreigende sfeer''

ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers whether police intervention against evangelists singing at a Maastricht station piano, and NS house rules restricting evangelising folders, are compatible with freedom of religion, and whether they will talk to NS about this. The government answered that police acted on a nuisance report under local responsibility, that no restrictions were imposed and the group left voluntarily, that house rules and WP2000 obligations justify NS enforcement, and that it sees no reason to talk to NS now.
The police's conduct was based on knowledge of the local situation and under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het optreden van de politie is op basis van de kennis van de lokale situatie en onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers about the handling of earlier written questions on the risk of female genital mutilation and incitement to it in a religious context, including OM prosecution, KMAR indicators, online monitoring, reporting channels and prevention campaigns. The government answered that the OM did not appeal, that prosecutions have not increased, that online monitoring is not actively done by the ministry, that reporting goes to police or Veilig Thuis, and that a campaign was evaluated as successful and extended, with a further advice-duty study completed and information promised for 2025.
The Ministry of Justice and Security does not actively monitor online activities relating to genital mutilation.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid monitort online activiteiten met betrekking tot genitale verminking echter niet actief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about enforcement and prevention of female genital mutilation (FGM), including whether the OM appealed a case, whether online calls for FGM are monitored, and whether reporting points and campaigns exist. The government answered that no appeal was lodged, enforcement is police and platform responsibility, reporting channels such as Veilig Thuis exist, and prevention campaigns and a parental declaration are in place, though no evaluation of some measures has been done.
The Ministry of Justice and Security does not actively monitor online activities related to genital mutilation.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid monitort online activiteiten met betrekking tot genitale verminking echter niet actief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Verbazing over ‘nep-beveiligers’ tijdens pro-Palestina demonstratie’

Two SGP MPs asked whether a pro-Palestine demonstration in Leiden, where persons acting as self-appointed security (Protest Alliance Watch) allegedly enforced their own rules on station travellers, violated the ban on private armed-style organisations and whether NS station staff were adequately trained. The minister answered that the right to demonstrate applies within the law, that local authorities and police, not the minister, judge such conduct, that police did not observe forced removals, that NS conductors (boa's) have limited powers and no specific training is needed, and that a joint escalation framework is being drafted in response to a motion.
The judgment on whether specific concrete conduct constitutes a criminal offence is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court.
Het oordeel of bepaald concreet handelen valt onder een strafrechtelijk delict is voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Verbazing over ‘nep-beveiligers’ tijdens pro-Palestina demonstratie’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the 'Protest Alliance Watch' stewarding group at pro-Palestinian demonstrations amounts to an illegal 'weerkorps', whether it should be investigated and banned, and whether police tolerate it. The minister declined to judge whether any offence occurred (a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts), said the group is not unusual and that local authorities decide on demonstrations, and offered no new investigation or ban.
Whether certain conduct constitutes a criminal offence, and whether it should be investigated further, is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge.

Het oordeel of bepaald handelen valt onder een strafrechtelijk delict en het oordeel of bepaald handelen nader onderzocht dient te worden is voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministier en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over vergunningverlening aan escortbureaus

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security why a Tilburg escort agency received a licence despite its founder's prior conviction for human trafficking, and whether foreign convictions can be weighed in Bibob screening. The minister agrees such convictions are in principle relevant, explains the Bibob framework and information-sharing options, says the municipality found nothing warranting refusal, and declines to comment on the specific case as licensing is local.
Granting licences to sex businesses is a local matter.
Het verlenen van vergunningen aan seksbedrijven betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de ongelijke behandeling van discriminatiemeldingen door de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP asks the Justice Minister why police referrals of antisemitism reports to the Public Prosecution Service are far higher than for other discrimination grounds, and demands equal treatment and fuller registration by ground. The minister rejects the premise as premature, citing non-comparable data, differing report/complaint definitions and a 2023 football-case surge, and declines a detailed breakdown, external investigation or policy review.
No, I am not willing to do this.
Nee, hiertoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘‘Duitse aanklager: Hamas heeft een wapendepot in Denemarken om klaar te zijn voor mogelijke aanslagen’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about a German report on Hamas weapons depots in Europe, possible Dutch links, screening of Hamas-linked organisations, and why Samidoun was not placed on the national terrorism sanctions list. The minister declined to comment on the individual case due to an ongoing German investigation, described existing screening and sanctions tools, and stated that the Public Prosecution Service is independent and had no grounds to open an investigation into Samidoun.
In the interest of this ongoing investigation, I cannot make statements about this individual case.
In het belang van dit lopende onderzoek, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elian en Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Te koop in Nederland: 7 Oktober, de game’ worden beantwoord zoals aangegeven

MPs Van Zanten and Ellian asked whether the game 'Fursan al-Aqsa' depicting the 7 October attack, sold on Steam in the Netherlands, violates criminal law and should be banned. The minister said criminal prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that the game was removed from Steam for EU member states after a French removal order, and that the national authority ATKM is monitoring the situation.
I have specifically brought this game to the attention of the Dutch ATKM to see whether it can be removed.
Ik heb deze game specifiek onder de aandacht gebracht van de Nederlandse ATKM om te bezien of deze verwijderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Te koop in Nederland: 7 Oktober, de game’

An MP asked the government about a game recreating the 7 October 2023 Hamas attack being sold in the Netherlands, and whether it should be banned. The minister condemned the game, said it was removed from Steam in EU member states after a French removal order, and promised to bring a law criminalising glorification of terrorism to consultation in spring 2025.
That is why the cabinet is also preparing legislation to make the glorification of terrorism a criminal offence with a high maximum sentence.
Daarom bereidt het kabinet ook wetgeving voor om het verheerlijken van terrorisme strafbaar te stellen met een hoog strafmaximum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Hamas’s extensive network in Europe exposed in a new series of reports’

An MP from the SGP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers how to respond to reports that Hamas-linked actors operate in Europe, including whether they should be placed on the national and EU terrorism sanctions lists and how disinformation and Hamas-linked networks should be monitored. Minister Van Weel answered that the matter was passed to competent authorities, explained the legal criteria for listing and the limits on acting, and said the government will pursue further EU measures and criminalise glorification of terrorism.
In the interest of how the intelligence services operate, no statements are made about this in public.
In het belang van de werkwijze van de inlichtingendiensten worden hierover in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over het rapport ‘Hamas in Europe’ en het bericht 'Buurlanden komt hij niet in, tóch mag omstreden kopstuk van pro-Palestinaclub spreken op universiteit in Nijmegen'

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government would investigate persons and organisations linked to Hamas in a report, and whether it would act against the Samidoun coordinator invited to speak at Radboud University. The government replied that the AIVD investigation continues, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, that the speaker has been flagged for entry refusal, and that talks with the Public Prosecution Service and AIVD on Samidoun-type organisations took place without indications for criminal suspicion.
Naturally, no public statement can be made about whether intelligence and security services are conducting investigations into persons or organisations.
Vanzelfsprekend kan in de openbaarheid geen uitspraak worden gedaan over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten naar personen of organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de mishandeling van een bejaarde vrouw in Den Haag

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the serious assault on an elderly woman in The Hague, police and housing corporation response, and anti-Muslim discrimination. The minister answers that the case is under prosecution, that police responded to two complaints, that privacy limits further detail, and that a national study on Muslim discrimination will report in early 2025.
Because of the privacy of both parties, I cannot go into the substance of this case further.
Vanwege de privacy van de beide partijen kan ik verder niet inhoudelijk op deze casus ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Criminelen ontdekken een nieuwe oplichtingstruc: phishing via QR-codes’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of phishing via QR codes, including how common it is, whether police and prosecutors face obstacles, and what prevention is planned. The minister answered that such cases are not separately registered, that the Fraudehelpdesk received about 20 related reports in 2024, and that prevention campaigns and awareness initiatives are ongoing.
The police do not keep separate records of the number of cases of phishing via QR codes.
De politie houdt geen aparte registraties bij van het aantal gevallen van phishing via QR-codes.
Antwoord op van het lid Grinwis over het artikel ‘‘Fuck de regels’: hoe spotgoedkope Chinese fatbikes Nederland worden binnengesmokkeld’

MP Grinwis asked the ministers of Infrastructure, Finance and Justice about reports that illegal Chinese fatbikes with throttles and excessive motors are smuggled into the Netherlands, how customs and the ILT control them, and what enforcement measures will follow, including on online sellers and the Ouxi V8 model. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that customs controls are risk-based without separate capacity or success figures for fatbikes, that the ILT and police can seize or fine non-compliant vehicles, and that a consumer awareness campaign is running.
It cannot be said how much capacity Customs deploys on fatbike controls.
Het is daardoor niet te zeggen hoeveel capaciteit de Douane inzet op de controles van fatbikes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Werf over de gevolgen voor veiligheid van de aangekondigde grenscontroles

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Migration, Defence and Justice how border controls would affect security, given KMar staff shortages, whether extra funding helps, and whether border municipalities were consulted. The government answered that controls run within existing KMar capacity, that funding is being worked out, that there was consultation with border regions, and that impacts on the economy will be kept to a minimum.
The internal border checks will be carried out on the basis of the KMar's existing capacity.
De uitvoering van de binnengrenscontroles zullen plaatsvinden op basis van de bestaande capaciteit van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat Viktor Orbán premier Netanyahu wil uitnodigen in Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether Hungary's announced invitation to Netanyahu and its stated intention to ignore ICC arrest warrants undermines the Court, and whether the Netherlands would raise this at the Assembly of States Parties. The Minister answered that the Rome Statute does not prohibit such invitations, that the government leaves Orbán's statements to him, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged all states parties to cooperate with the Court, without committing to a formal step against Hungary.
The authority of the ICC is firmly established and the obligations under the Rome Statute are clear.
Het gezag en de autoriteit van het ISH zijn stevig gevestigd en de verplichtingen onder het Statuut van Rome zijn helder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Minister begaat enorme flater: hij beweert dat moord op Utrechtse Sjaak in 1995 is opgelost, maar dat is niet zo’

MP El Abassi asked the Justice Minister to account for wrongly telling parliament that the 1995 murder of Sjaak Gerwig had been solved, and to apologise to the family. The minister admitted a slip of the tongue, said the case is unsolved, apologised to the relatives, and promised to be more accurate.
By mistake I said that both cases had been solved.
Per abuis heb ik genoemd dat beide zaken waren opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Israëlische ongewenste inmenging

An MP asked the government to share the NCTV investigation into alleged Israeli undue interference, to explain its scope and method, to investigate other Israeli interventions and incidents, and to say whether the ambassador was summoned. The government declined to share the findings publicly, citing security interests, said it would share further information through appropriate channels, and confirmed it raised the matter with the Israeli ambassador.
This information cannot be shared publicly because it could harm our security interests.
Deze informatie kan niet in het openbaar worden gedeeld omdat dit onze veiligheidsbelangen kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Oplichting door nepagenten stijgt explosief, dit jaar al 3500 incidenten'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the rising number of fake-police-agent scams targeting elderly victims, prevention measures, victim reluctance to report, and whether purchasing lookalike police uniforms online can be stopped. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, a podcast and police reporting efforts are ongoing, that wearing a lookalike uniform to mislead can be punished under article 196 of the Criminal Code, but that buying such a uniform for fraud is not punishable as preparation, and that takedown requests and customs action against online sellers are being pursued.
Wearing a counterfeit uniform at, for example, carnival is not punishable in itself, but the above means that anyone who behaves as a police officer in a strongly resembling uniform can be punished.

Het dragen van een namaak-uniform bij bijvoorbeeld carnaval is op zichzelf niet strafbaar, maar bovenstaande betekent wel dat wie zich in een sterk gelijkend uniform als politieagent gedraagt wél kan worden bestraft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over het verruimen van de mogelijkheden voor het vervolgen van medeplichtigen bij eergerelateerd geweld

MPs Becker and Ellian asked whether criminal law should be broadened to prosecute accomplices in honour-related violence, citing high figures and the collective nature of such crimes. The minister replied that existing offences and participation forms (co-perpetration, incitement, complicity) and the aggravating factor of premeditation already suffice, that the registration is inherently imperfect, and that no new classification, guideline or statutory article is currently deemed necessary.
Criminal law offers us, through various forms of participation, sufficient instruments to dissect group dynamics and do justice to the complexity of such cases in criminal-law terms.
Het strafrecht biedt ons met verschillende deelnemingsvormen voldoende instrumenten om de groepsdynamiek te ontleden en in strafrechtelijke zin recht te doen aan de complexiteit van dit soort zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over winkelverboden aan criminele overlastgevende asielzoekers

Two VVD MPs asked about shop bans against criminal nuisance-causing asylum seekers: how many were imposed since 2020, whether shopkeepers must serve them personally and translate them, and how reporting of theft and violations can be encouraged. The minister reported rising numbers of individual and collective shop bans, explained that shop bans must be served in person with no legal translation requirement but must be understandable to the suspect, and pointed to police and CCV measures and the existing toolbox.
There is no statutory provision requiring that a shop ban be issued in the native language of the person concerned.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke bepaling die verplicht tot het uitreiken van een winkelverbod in de (moeder)taal van de betrokkene/verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Kisteman over een  reportage over glazenwassers door het tv-programma Radar

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Kisteman asked about a Radar report on rogue window cleaners, including consumer rights, complaint channels, cash payment, sector knowledge, enforcement and whether the Zaanstad licensing approach should be copied. The minister answered that consumers may be required to pay in cash, that Zaanstad's licensing scheme is a municipal matter, that no further sector study is planned, and that no integrated national enforcement campaign is currently running.
The police have no overviews of the number of reports made over the past two years about window cleaners, because no sector-specific overviews are kept.
Bij politie zijn geen overzichten aanwezig van het aantal meldingen dat de afgelopen twee jaar is gedaan over glazenwassers, omdat geen sectorale overzichten worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vagen van het lid Teunissen over de oproep van Amnesty voor een verbod op gezichtsherkenning om mensen te identificeren tijdens demonstraties

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he assesses Amnesty International's findings on police use of facial recognition and biometric surveillance at protests, and what safeguards, transparency and independent oversight exist. The minister defers substantive answers to the upcoming police half-year report of December 2024, while pointing to existing police deployment frameworks and privacy-by-design and data protection impact assessment practices.
In the next police half-year report I will go into the recommendations of Amnesty International in more detail.
Ik ga in het eerstvolgende halfjaarbericht politie nader in op de aanbevelingen van Amnesty International.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Mutluer over gezichtsherkenning bij de politie

MPs Kathmann, Lahlah and Mutluer asked about police use of facial recognition and camera surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, citing an Amnesty report, and asked about oversight, data sources, retention and procurement. The Minister replied that police do not use real-time facial recognition at demonstrations, only retrospectively against suspects of crimes, that the Dutch DPA has adequate expertise to supervise, and that a national legal framework and an AI-regulation-based transparency register are being explored and will follow.
Only when criminal offences have been committed can the police subsequently use facial recognition technology to identify suspects.
Enkel wanneer sprake is van strafbare feiten kan door de politie achteraf gezichtsherkenningstechnologie worden ingezet om verdachten te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending van Het Misdaadbureau (NPO radio 1) van 25 oktober 2024 over de strafmaat op het wegmaken van een lijk

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Justice whether the maximum two-year prison sentence for concealing or removing a corpse is still adequate, given the greater role and suffering of victims' relatives, and whether it should be doubled to four years. The Minister answered that a bill is being prepared to criminalise physical desecration of corpses and necrophilia separately, that penalty maxima will be reviewed in that process, and that impact on relatives will be weighed, but did not commit to raising the maximum now.
In doing so, not only will it be examined how the existing criminal offences should be amended and supplemented, but attention will also be paid to the maximum penalties.
Daarbij zal niet alleen worden gekeken naar hoe de bestaande strafbaarstellingen moeten worden gewijzigd en aangevuld, maar zal ook aandacht zijn voor de strafmaxima
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de inzet van digitale surveillance bij demonstraties

The MP asks whether police digital surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, the legal basis for it, retention and sharing of data, and notification of participants comply with privacy and the right to demonstrate, following an Amnesty International report. The minister answers that camera use is occasional and based on risk assessments, that no identity registration occurs, that detailed per-demonstration information is not requested from municipalities, and that the broader Amnesty recommendations will be addressed in a later police progress letter.
I do not have an overview of demonstrations at which the police deployed cameras.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van demonstraties waarbij de politie camera's heeft ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de toenemende discriminatie tegen moslims

An MP asked ministers about rising discrimination against Muslims, citing an EU survey showing 55% of Dutch Muslims report discrimination, and about school discrimination, national anti-discrimination policy, and training measures. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a forthcoming national study on Muslim discrimination, outlined the division of responsibilities across ministries, and referred to existing programmes and a future action plan without committing to new binding measures.
On the basis of the findings of the study, it will be considered which specific additional measures can be taken to prevent discrimination against Muslims.
Op grond van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek wordt bezien welke specifieke maatregelen aanvullend getroffen kunnen worden om moslimdiscriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de invoering van interne grenscontroles in Nederland

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government about the reintroduction of internal border controls, including costs, justification under EU rules, personnel impact on the Royal Marechaussee, and whether controls will facilitate people smuggling. The minister answered that controls will be risk-based and non-systematic, that no significant extra costs are expected, that irregular migration and secondary flows justify the measure, and that controls are temporary and not expected to increase smuggling.
The cabinet is taking all possible measures to prevent further disruption of the migration system, because this could lead to distressing situations and a greater threat to public order.
Het kabinet neemt alle mogelijke maatregelen om verdere verstoring van het migratiesysteem te voorkomen, omdat dit kan leiden tot schrijnende situaties en een grotere dreiging voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Eerdmans over het bericht dat gemeenten nauwelijks van elkaar leren over nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Nispen and Eerdmans asked whether municipalities learn enough from each other about preventing New Year's Eve disorder, and what role the minister sees for herself. The minister replied that knowledge sharing already happens via VNG networks, regional consultations and the Strategic Consultation with mayors, that local preparation is a municipal responsibility, and offered no new concrete step.
Preparing for the New Year's celebration is a local responsibility and runs through the local triangle.
Het voorbereiden van de jaarwisseling is een lokale bevoegdheid en verloopt via de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het antwoord op vragen over de oproep van Extinction Rebellion om de A12 te bezetten op 6 juli 2024

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice Minister about Extinction Rebellion's road blockades (A10, A12, A15), police deployment, prosecutions, the scope of the right to demonstrate under Dutch and European law, and whether ANBI status should be revoked. The minister answered that police and prosecution data cannot be broken down per demonstration, that a study on the demonstration framework is under way, and that ANBI status is for the Tax Service to assess.
Research is being carried out into ways to strengthen the room for action within the framework of the above-mentioned case law.
Er wordt onderzoek uitgevoerd naar mogelijkheden om het handelingsperspectief te versterken binnen het kader van bovengenoemde jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Vooral bewoners zorginstellingen slachtoffer van mensenhandel, hulpverleners moeten makkelijker kunnen melden'

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about a report that vulnerable residents of care institutions and supported housing in Groningen are recruited for sexual and criminal exploitation, and whether national research, stronger protection measures and better cooperation are needed. The minister says the problem is serious but there is no evidence yet of a structural national problem, so no national study or new interventions are planned, pointing to existing measures, the Samen tegen Mensenhandel action plan and regional cooperation.
As the research shows, suspected victims of criminal and sexual exploitation often live in supported housing or reside in care institutions.
Zoals uit het onderzoek naar voren komt, wonen vermoedelijke slachtoffers van criminele en seksuele uitbuiting vaak in een begeleide woonvorm of zijn zij woonachtig in zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de inzet van jongeren als “geldezels”

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about young people used as money mules by online fraudsters: how many there are, detection rates, prosecution, restorative justice, debt aid, recidivism, VOG implications and prevention. The minister answers in detail with estimates, court figures and prevention programmes, while stating that precise figures are unknown and that no additional measures are needed for now.
Precise figures on this problem are not known.
Precieze cijfers over dit probleem zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Boomsma, Tseggai en Diederik van Dijk over de aanpak van klanten die betaalde seks hebben met minderjarige slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police and prosecution capacity for pursuing clients who buy sex from minors, after the OM Limburg reportedly declined to target them, and about sentencing, online age verification on sex-advertisement sites, and effective enforcement. The Minister denied any national policy of not pursuing clients, cited the higher statutory maxima and capacity investments, and committed to talks with police, the OM and advertising platforms, plus a policy response to the CKM report before the Christmas recess.
There is no decision that no capacity will be deployed in any case for the investigation of customers of human trafficking.
Er is geen besluit dat er sowieso geen capaciteit wordt ingezet voor de opsporing van klanten van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Overheid verzwijgt informatie over advocatenneef Taghi, AD stapt naar de rechter’

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether earlier information about lawyer Youssef T., nephew of Ridouan Taghi, was withheld, why access to the EBI was not refused sooner, and why AD had to go to court under the Open Government Act. The state secretary refers to earlier answers, says the denial of access was based on signs of misuse of his privileged position and lifted once the bar dean found no evidence, denies obstruction of journalists, and declines to discuss the pending court case.
Since this is an ongoing procedure, I cannot go into the substance of it.
Nu dit een lopende procedure betreft kan ik hier niet inhoudelijk op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Controversial ‘chat control’ back on EU agenda this week’

MPs Six Dijkstra and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about the EU 'chat control' proposal on scanning private messages, its timing in the Council, and its compatibility with Dutch constitutional privacy and telecommunications rights and EU/ECtHR case law. The Minister answered that the Netherlands will not support mandatory detection measures practically implementable only via client-side scanning, that the proposal is not yet ready, and that the answers to the questions were delayed beyond the deadline.

With the information now available, the cabinet will not support proposals on mandatory detection that in practice can only be carried out through client-side scanning, because of the consequences for digital resilience.

Met de informatie die nu voorhanden is, zal het kabinet geen voorstellen over verplichte detectie ondersteunen die in de praktijk uitsluitend kunnen worden uitgevoerd door middel van client-side scanning, vanwege de gevolgen voor de digitale weerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de jaarcijfers Mensenhandel 2023

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the 2023 human trafficking figures, including the rise in victims in home prostitution, falling suspect numbers, rising dismissals of cases, and low prosecution for labour exploitation. The minister answered that reporting bodies and investigative capacity are being strengthened, a sex-work bill and an amended trafficking offence are in progress, and the Action Plan will be monitored, but gave no new binding commitments beyond existing plans.
National policy is therefore aimed at increasing victims' willingness to report.
Het landelijk beleid is er dan ook op gericht om de meldingsbereidheid onder slachtoffers te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over de politiecapaciteit voor de begeleiding van wielerwedstrijden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk asked about the status of a motion on keeping cycling races going, the timing of an Antea Group study on volunteer motorcycle traffic controllers, and the effect of reduced police capacity around the 2025 NATO summit. The Staatssecretaris replied that the study is finished and will be shared soon with a letter on how its findings will be followed up, that local mayors decide on permits, and that police cannot guarantee escort for races from January to August 2025 except possibly a limited selection.
The Antea Group study will be shared with your House as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek van Antea Group wordt zo spoedig mogelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Bikker over de eerste veroordeling van een klant die willens en wetens heeft bijgedragen aan mensenhandel

MPs Boomsma and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about the first conviction of a client under article 273g Sr for knowingly contributing to trafficking, and about minors being offered via legal sex-advertising platforms. The minister confirmed the first conviction, reported 4 registered and 3 prosecuted suspects under 273g and 31 registered/22 prosecuted under 248b, and said the ministry will talk with platforms and the Fieldlab Tulpafslag organisations, but ruled out mandatory online age verification for now.
It is correct that the Action Plan of the Together Against Human Trafficking programme contains no measures targeting sex advertising platforms.
Het klopt dat in het Actieplan programma Samen tegen mensenhandel geen maatregelen zijn opgenomen die zien op seksadvertentieplatforms.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de eisen ten aanzien van de kleurenblindheid bij de politie

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether colour-vision requirements for police recruits can be relaxed given staffing needs, whether colour-blind candidates can be admitted, and whether aids are available. The minister defends the colour-vision requirement for executive police roles on grounds of accurate observation and safety, notes that assistive tools are not scientifically proven, and says the police are reviewing the recruitment standards without knowing yet whether colour requirements will change.
The police have started a review of the recruitment requirements.
De politie is gestart met een herijking van de aanstellingseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Bewoners in Amersfoort krijgen dreigbrieven na ophangen Palestijnse vlaggen: ‘Kom dan op de koffie’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about anonymous threatening letters sent to residents in Amersfoort who hung Palestinian flags, and whether the government would act against such intimidation. The minister said the police and Public Prosecution Service can investigate suspected crimes, condemned the intimidation, urged residents to report the letters to the police, and praised their response of inviting the senders for coffee.
In case of a suspicion of a criminal offence, the law gives the police the possibility to launch an investigation.
In geval van een vermoeden van een strafbaar feit, biedt de wet aan de politie de mogelijkheid om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het EU Internet Forum

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government contacts social media companies through the EU Internet Forum, what requests it sends them, for the correspondence over the past year, and for the list of violent right-wing extremism groups compiled by the Forum. The Minister answered that the Forum is a voluntary cooperation platform, that the government sends no requests to social media firms there, that no correspondence exists, and that the list is held on a secure Commission website, so documents must be requested from the Commission.
It is not for the cabinet to make public documents of the EUIF that also contain information from other member states.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om documenten van het EUIF openbaar te maken die ook informatie van andere lidstaten bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Michon–Derkzen over het bericht 'Drugscriminelen in hele land actief met hypotheekfraude'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that drug criminals are committing mortgage fraud nationwide, housing Bulgarian migrant workers. The government confirms police reports of roughly 8,000 affected homes, describes enforcement, information-sharing and planned reviews (including Belastingdienst income checks and Kamer van Koophandel measures), but declines to give municipalities a direct role in informing mortgage lenders.

The Minister of Justice and Security will, together with the State Secretary for Fiscal Affairs and the Tax Authority, further explore the effectiveness, efficiency and feasibility of this and then inform the House of the conclusion.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal samen met de Staatssecretaris van Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en uitvoerbaarheid hiervan nader verkennen en vervolgens uw Kamer informeren over de conclusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen en Six Dijkstra over het artikel inzake het plegen van hypotheekfraude door drugscriminelen

MPs Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen and Six Dijkstra asked about reports that criminal networks, including drug criminals, commit large-scale mortgage fraud and whether police and prosecutors can detect and prosecute it. The government answered that the problem is recognised but not systematically registered, that data-sharing options with banks and the Tax Authority are being explored, and that police knowledge of new modus operandi will be shared with lenders.
Mortgage fraud is not registered separately by the police or the Public Prosecution Service, because it consists of the offences of forgery, fraud and/or money laundering.
Tot slot wordt hypotheekfraude niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd bij de politie of het OM, omdat hypotheekfraude bestaat uit de delicten valsheid in geschrifte, oplichting en/of witwassen.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over het uitlezen van mobiele telefoons

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister how the CJEU ruling allowing phone searches for minor offences would affect Dutch practice, and what protocols, consent rules and data retention apply. The minister replied that the ruling's impact is still uncertain, that a codifying bill will be consulted on once clearer, and described current Dutch rules, biometric unlocking and data storage periods.
Before the end of the year, your House will receive the policy response to the evaluation reports.
Voor het einde van het jaar ontvangt uw Kamer de beleidsreactie op de evaluatierapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Psychiater Boudewijn Chabot introduceert eigen stikstofgasmethode voor mensen die humaan willen sterven'

An MP asked the government about a psychiatrist's film promoting nitrogen gas as a self-death method and media and cultural responsibility. The state secretary condemned the film as dangerous, said prosecution is for the OM and courts, and refused to ban it on free-expression grounds while pointing to existing media guidelines.
Taking measures to restrict in advance the publication of interviews and films about suicide is, however, not desirable in my view because it is disproportionate.
Het nemen van maatregelen door op voorhand de publicatie van interviews en films over zelfdoding te beperken, acht ik echter niet wenselijk omdat het disproportioneel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het landelijk kwaliteitskader in relatie tot Preventie met gezag

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the national quality framework for effective youth interventions was developed, whether it conflicts with local needs, and why some programmes may be stopped for lacking proven effectiveness. The minister answered that municipalities hold the regie, the framework is non-binding guidance under a learning approach with municipalities, and no programmes have been stopped on that basis, while committing to address the matter in the next progress report.
Municipalities have control over their own local PmG approach.
Gemeenten hebben de regie over hun eigen lokale aanpak PmG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over humanitaire consequenties detentie reddingsschip van Artsen zonder Grenzen Geo Barents door Italië

MP Koekkoek (Volt) asked the ministers about the humanitarian consequences of Italy's detention of the Geo Barents rescue ship and the Libyan coast guard's conduct. The government replied that Italy's detention is a domestic legal matter for Italian courts and the European Commission, that the EU supports the Libyan coast guard with monitoring and training, and that a complaint filed with the Commission in July 2023 is still pending.
This concerns an assessment by the Italian authorities based on Italian laws and regulations.
Het gaat hier om een afweging van de Italiaanse autoriteiten op basis van Italiaanse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Overheid gebruikte nationaliteit bij misdaadbestrijding en verzweeg dat’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the RIEC used nationality, including targeting Turkish Dutch people, in organised crime work, asking about oversight, data practices, profiling and whether similar analyses exist for other groups. The Minister acknowledged that the 2016 concept analysis used unacceptable, generalising wording that the organisations distance themselves from, described data-protection safeguards (access requests, objections, the upcoming Wgs), and said nationality is no longer processed and that a study into ethnic profiling is not considered opportune.
An individual citizen may at any time object in writing to the processing of their personal data in the RIEC partnership with the covenant partners.
Een individuele burger kan bij de convenantpartners te allen tijde schriftelijk bezwaar aantekenen tegen de verwerking van diens persoonsgegevens in het RIEC-samenwerkingsverband.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bamenga over het bericht dat een van de Regionale Informatie en Expertisecentra (RIEC) jarenlang persoonsgegevens over nationaliteit en land van herkomst verzamelde

MPs Van Nispen and Bamenga asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a RIEC recorded nationality and country of origin for years, including a 2016 draft analysis with discriminatory wording about Turkish Dutch people and neighbourhoods labelled as enforcement bottlenecks. The minister distanced the government from the wording, stated that nationality is not a signal for RIEC cases, that the practice was dropped in 2022, and declined to commission statistical research or ask the Data Protection Authority to investigate.

Are you willing to conduct statistical research into indications that people with a non-Dutch background or lower socio-economic class have been investigated by the RIEC far more often than people with a Dutch background or higher socio-economic class? If not, why not?

Bent u bereid statistisch onderzoek te doen naar aanwijzingen dat personen met een niet-Nederlandse achtergrond of een lagere sociaal-economische klasse veel vaker zijn onderzocht door het RIEC dan mensen met een Nederlandse achtergrond of een hogere sociaal-economische klasse? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek naar Klassenjustitie in Nederland

MPs asked whether the NOS/Investico and Groene Amsterdammer findings that lower-educated suspects with a migration background receive harsher treatment indicate class justice, and what the government will do. The minister answered that such unequal treatment is unacceptable, that the OM and judiciary are addressing it, and that two WODC studies due mid-2025 will determine any further measures.
On the basis of the outcome of these studies we will assess whether, and if so which, additional measures in the criminal justice chain should be taken to counter any unjustified unequal treatment.

Aan de hand van de uitkomst van deze onderzoeken zullen wij beoordelen of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende maatregelen in de strafrechtketen genomen dienen te worden om eventuele ongerechtvaardigde ongelijke behandeling tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de aanpak van witteboordencriminaliteit faalt en is verslechterd de afgelopen jaren

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the fight against white-collar crime is failing, including that more fraud suspects escape punishment and that prosecution priorities are too narrow. The minister disputes the data basis, says white-collar crime lacks a clear definition, points to ongoing priorities on corruption and money laundering, extra funding, and states that the strict enforcement of fraud and money-laundering offences is handled through the OM.
It is unclear on which data the conclusions of the Financieel Dagblad article are based.
Het is onduidelijk op welke gegevens de conclusies uit het artikel van het Financieel Dagblad zijn gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Paternotte over de aanbesteding van rechtsbijstand aan Nederlandse ter doodveroordeelden

MPs Ellian and Paternotte asked why the tender for legal aid to Dutch nationals facing the death penalty abroad was split into lots, why a English organisation could win, and whether a Dutch organisation should be required. Minister Veldkamp answered that the split aims at more expertise and redundancy, that local foreign lawyers are essential for death penalty cases, and that the Dutch-language support role lies with consular staff and Dutch-speaking subsidy partners.
