Specific knowledge, experience and a network relating to that local legal area and good communication channels in the detention country were the primary considerations in this tender.
Specifieke kennis, ervaring en een netwerk met betrekking tot dat lokale rechtsgebied en een goede communicatielijn in het betreffende detentieland, hebben voorop gestaan bij deze aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Werf over de aanval op Nederlandse apparaten door Chinese staatshackers

MPs Kathmann and Van der Werf asked the government about a Chinese state-linked hacking botnet that infected Dutch consumer devices, including its motives, consequences, affected parties and EU legislative remedies. The government answered that the botnet was untargeted, that no critical infrastructure or state secrets are known to have been affected, that NCSC and DTC issued general advice, and that the Cyber Resilience Act would strengthen device security.
As far as is known, the infected systems in the Netherlands were not part of the central government or vital infrastructure.
Voor zover bekend waren de in Nederland besmette systemen geen onderdeel van de Rijksoverheid of vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het voornemen om tien procent te bezuinigen op de crisisbeheersing en de brandweer

An SP MP asks the Justice and Security minister about a planned 10% cut to the disaster-control grant (BDuR) for safety regions and whether it is an unintended effect of the coalition agreement, and how it will affect regional crisis management and volunteer fire services. The government confirms the 10% cut and its effect on regional budgets, says the BDuR will remain a specific grant, and points to a feasibility study on volunteer firefighters and natural-fire funding.
The cabinet has since decided that the BDuR will continue to exist as a specific grant.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten dat de BDuR blijft voortbestaan als specifieke uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vroonhoven over antisemitische incidenten

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about the number of antisemitic incidents in 2022-2024, convictions for antisemitism, sentences, and whether such convictions lead to refusal or withdrawal of certificates of good conduct (VOG), including for taxi drivers. The minister provided incident and prosecution figures for 2022-2023, said 2024 figures will follow in 2025, declined to break down sentences without separate research, and explained VOG screening is case-by-case.
For 2024 there are no figures yet. These will be sent to the House in the course of 2025.
Voor 2024 zijn er nog geen cijfers. Deze worden in de loop van 2025 naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Wal en Michon-Derkzen over het artikel 'Rijksmuseum kan niet open: demonstranten Extinction Rebellion blokkeren ingang'

MPs Van der Wal and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security about the blockade of the Rijksmuseum entrance by Extinction Rebellion, including arrests, police capacity, damage claims and sponsor reactions. The government answered that demonstrations are governed locally by the mayor under the Wet openbare manifestaties, reported 33 arrests with one person identified and about 250 police hours, and said the museum decides on damage claims while a WODC study on demonstration law is due in summer 2025.
The mayor is responsible for public order and can set conditions for a demonstration under the Public Manifestations Act.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de openbare orde en kan voorwaarden stellen aan een demonstratie op basis van de Wet openbare manifestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Mutluer, Michon-Derkzen, Van Nispen en Aardema over het bericht ‘Politiehack van 62.000 medewerkers is gevaarlijk: naam agent is handelswaar’

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police data breach exposing contact details of about 62,000 officers, including timing of notification, risks to officers and families, and safeguards against similar leaks. The minister answered that work contact details and occasionally private contact details were exposed, that a pass-the-cookie attack by likely state actors was used, that notification was delayed in part, and that measures are being taken but investigations are ongoing and the wider lessons for government systems are limited.
In the interest of the ongoing investigations, I cannot say anything about that.
In het belang van de lopende onderzoeken kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Dral over het artikel ‘Duizenden jongeren zijn geldezel’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that thousands of young people are lured via social media to act as money mules for criminals, asking how this is criminalised, whether it falls under the modernised human trafficking article 273f, and what prevention is done. The minister answers that recruiting youths is punishable under several offences, cites recent convictions, explains that criminal exploitation under 273f depends on case circumstances, and describes prevention programmes in pilot municipalities plus school and parental outreach.
There are no figures on the number of suspects who approached young people to make their bank account available, because no separate registration is kept of this.

Er zijn geen cijfers bekend met betrekking tot het aantal verdachten dat jongeren heeft benaderd om hun bankrekening ter beschikking te stellen, omdat hiervan geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de tuchtrechtelijke veroordeling van de landsadvocaat

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the disciplinary reprimand of the State Advocate for keeping privileged emails, and whether the State should break with his firm. The minister answered that the emails should have been deleted once privilege was confirmed, acknowledged this should have happened, and said the matter will be discussed with the firm, while rejecting claims against the firm and refusing to reclaim fees.
I regret that these emails were not immediately removed from the file once it became clear that they concerned privileged information.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat deze e-mails niet direct uit het dossier zijn verwijderd, toen duidelijk werd dat het verschoningsgerechtigde informatie betrof.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Omtzigt en Palmen over het artikel ‘Landsadvocaat krijgt waarschuwing voor rol in fraudezaak’

MPs Omtzigt and Palmen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a disciplinary warning given to the state's chief lawyer (landsadvocaat) from Pels Rijcken over handling privileged emails in the fraud case, and about integrity safeguards in the state's contract with the firm. The Minister answered that the warning was the lightest sanction, that he did not believe the lawyer acted contrary to his duties, that the emails should have been removed promptly, and that the issue would be raised in administrative consultations with the firm.
I regret that these emails were not removed from the file directly when it became clear that they concerned information covered by legal privilege.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat deze e-mails niet direct uit het dossier zijn verwijderd toen duidelijk werd dat het verschoningsgerechtigde informatie betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Aanpak drugscriminelen Schiphol loopt vast op privacywetten: ‘Nadenken of criminelen wel zelfde rechten hebben’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that efforts to tackle drug criminals at Schiphol are stalled by privacy rules, including concerns from the Haarlemmermeer mayor about sharing information on organised crime and corruption. The minister answered that a Justice taskforce on data sharing is analysing information-sharing gaps with Schiphol partners, outlined existing reporting routes and information registers, and said no decision has yet been made on whether a dedicated AMvB for Schiphol is needed.
That is why the Justice Ministry's Data Sharing Taskforce, together with the Schiphol partners, is conducting a thorough analysis of these partners' information position.
Daarom maakt de Taskforce gegevensdeling van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid in samenwerking met de partners op Schiphol een grondige analyse van de informatiepositie van deze partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onveilige situatie voor meldingen van fraude en de barrière om meldingen te doen van misstanden

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security what has come of earlier commitments to better protect reporters of unusual transactions, notably gatekeepers such as notaries, who feel unsafe and report less, and whether anonymous reporting could be allowed. The minister replies that existing safeguards (restricted receipt by the FIU, company-name-only reporting, anonymisation by the prosecution service) are in place, that a further exploration of measures is ongoing with results due autumn 2024, and that anonymous reporting by gatekeepers is not possible because traceability of information is essential to the legal system.
It is not possible to anonymously report unusual transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit Netherlands.
Het is niet mogelijk om anoniem meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties te doen aan de Financial Intelligence Unit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht dat er voor het eerst iemand stierf in een zelfdodingsmachine

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a suicide capsule reportedly built in the Netherlands and used in Switzerland is lawful, whether its builder needs a patent or permit, whether it can be exported, and whether the government will act against its designer. The minister said the Swiss criminal investigation is ongoing and that the prosecutor (OM) decides on prosecution independently, declining to consult the OM, while stating that export and patenting face no obstacle and that suicide prevention policy continues.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to make this assessment independently and without political interference.
Het is aan het OM om deze beoordeling eigenstandig en zonder politieke inmenging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk, Helder en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Honderden agenten met PTSS krijgen geen passende WIA-uitwerking door gebrek aan kennis over ziekte bij UWV’

MPs from CDA, BBB and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether UWV medical assessors lack knowledge of PTSD, leaving police officers without proper WIA benefits, and proposed a specialist desk and training. The minister denied a knowledge gap, said PTSD is covered by general medical knowledge and assessor re-registration, and offered no new training or desk beyond existing optional courses.
I do not recognise that picture.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over handel en diefstal van diamanten naar aanleiding van de podcast ‘De Diamantroof’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about diamond theft and trade following the podcast 'De Diamantroof', including traceability systems, background checks, FIU involvement, cross-border cooperation and an international diamond database. The Minister replied that existing measures (heling rules, registration duties, Wwft obligations, Empact cooperation) are sufficient, saw no need for new measures or an international database, and committed to no concrete new steps.
I currently see no reason to come up with additional proposals to further limit the risks of trading in stolen diamonds.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om met extra voorstellen te komen om de risico's op het verhandelen van gestolen diamanten verder te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Aan Oekraïne geleverde NAVO-wapens in beslag genomen die in criminele circuit waren beland'

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice and Defence ministers how NATO weapons supplied to Ukraine could end up in Dutch criminal circles and what safeguards exist. The ministers answered that the risk of diversion is acknowledged and weighed against Ukraine support, citing the EU list of actions, a national Firearms Focal Point and export checks, and gave only general or partial answers on some questions.
The risk of diversion is not in proportion to Ukraine's urgent needs and the Dutch interest in continuing to support Ukraine with military goods.
Het risico op omleiding staat niet in verhouding tot de urgente behoeftes van Oekraïne en het Nederlandse belang Oekraïne met militaire goederen te blijven steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger Van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minister van Defensie: Nederlandse wetten ongeschikt voor ‘grijze zone’ tussen oorlog en vrede’

MPs Van Dijk and Six-Dijkstra asked the government about Russian vessels mapping North Sea infrastructure, military transport routes, conscription and reservists, a single cyber contact point, and cybersecurity governance. The government answered that it does not pre-announce responses, outlines Defence's North Sea tasks and the Action Plan, says military route specifics are confidential, notes a voluntary enquiry and more reservists, and describes the NLCS and the planned Cyberweerbaarheidsnetwerk.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’

Two MPs from the SGP asked whether the government will act against the planned lecture by Samidoun figure Mohammed Khatib at Radboud University, including through a national terror listing, a travel ban, or a ban on Samidoun. The ministers answered that entry has been refused and the university cancelled the lecture, that they will not intervene in academic debate, that Khatib has been flagged in E&S but the Twbmt cannot bar him from the country, and that they will talk with Germany and the Public Prosecution Service about Samidoun and support an EU listing.
With regard to the organisation Samidoun, other countries have established links with terrorist organisations.
Ten aanzien van de organisatie Samidoun geldt dat andere landen banden met terroristische organisaties hebben vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over politieagenten die Joodse objecten of evenementen niet meer willen beveiligen

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers refuse to protect Jewish sites and events, and how this squares with a neutral police force. The minister replied that police report no known cases, that such refusal is unacceptable, that the cabinet is preparing an antisemitism strategy and funding anti-discrimination programmes, but gave no specific new oversight commitment.
Like the chief of police, I have no understanding for police officers who would not want to guard Jewish objects.
Evenals de korpschef, heb ik geen begrip voor politiemedewerkers die geen Joodse objecten zouden willen bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over geld terugvorderen van fraudeurs door slachtoffers van online oplichting

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks the Justice Minister why victims of online fraud make little use of the PNBF procedure to recover money, and about data, awareness, police pilots and bank cooperation. The minister replies that PNBF is a private bank scheme without central registration, promises talks with the banks and Betaalvereniging on data and evaluation, and describes existing and ongoing prevention and cooperation initiatives.
For answering the question about an indication of how many requests have been made since 2021, no answer can be given within the requested response period.
Voor de beantwoording van de vraag om een indicatie hoeveel verzoeken er zijn gedaan sinds 2021 kan geen antwoord worden gegeven binnen de gevraagde beantwoordingstermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Michon-Derkzen over het uitrijden van mest met drugsafval door boeren in Baarle-Nassau

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen asked the ministers whether drug waste being spread with manure on Baarle-Nassau fields reflects a wider problem, what tools police and environmental services have, and how municipalities and farmers can be protected. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, the scale of drug-waste dumping is unknown, existing enforcement tools and the Veilig Buitengebied and farmer contact-person initiatives are described, and no cases of food-chain harm are known.
The investigation into the Baarle-Nassau case is still ongoing. It has not yet been established how the drug waste ended up on the field.
Het onderzoek in de casus Baarle-Nassau loopt nog. Er is nog niet vastgesteld hoe het drugsafval op de akker terecht is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Incassobureaus overtreden de wet: ‘Zorgelijk’’

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked about reports that debt collection agencies break the law, how many were inspected, and what the government will do for affected debtors and whether enforcement can start earlier. The government answered that the Inspectorate visited 11 agencies but cannot disclose violation details, that the inspectorate is independent and will keep a information-and-encouragement approach until 2025, and that the minister cannot direct enforcement.
It is up to the Inspectorate JenV to publish, if legally possible, how it shapes its supervision of debt collection agencies and which violations it finds.
Het is aan de Inspectie JenV om (indien juridisch mogelijk) te publiceren over hoe zij het toezicht op incassodienstverleners vormgeeft en welke overtredingen zij daarbij constateert.
Antwoord op vragen van Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Burgemeester Halsema overwoog activisten op UvA eigen universiteitsgebouw te geven'

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Education about reports that the Amsterdam mayor considered giving occupying activists a university building at the UvA, the damage costs, recovery of damages, student safety, student visas and protest policy. The government answered that the mayor and university boards are responsible for these matters, that damage recovery is for the institution, and that it will study the protest framework and reports by summer 2025.
It is therefore not for me to judge that.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM de criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan kan en er jaarlijks voor 10 miljard wordt gefraudeerd

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the Health and Justice ministers how they respond to reports that the Public Prosecution Service cannot handle healthcare crime and that around 10 billion euros is defrauded yearly, and what they will do about it. The minister answers that tackling care fraud is a priority, lists planned measures (new licensing grounds, data sharing, profit-distribution conditions, a review of open-house contracting, and stricter inspection of diplomas), and promises further letters and a bill in 2025.
I agree with the questioners that commercial interests of care providers or investors must never take precedence over the public interest in care and youth assistance.
Ik ben het eens met de vragenstellers dat commerciële belangen van zorgaanbieders of investeerders nooit vóór het maatschappelijk belang van zorg en jeugdhulp mogen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het OM kan criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan: ‘Er wordt jaarlijks voor 10 miljard gefraudeerd’

Diederik van Dijk (SGP) asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports that organised crime and fraud in healthcare cost around 10 billion euros a year and that prosecutors cannot cope, asking about cooperation, data sharing, inspection, fraud law and prioritisation. The minister answers that the Wbsrz (in force 1 January 2025) and a warning register will improve data sharing, that prosecution is already prioritised, and that she will not weaken the intent requirement or reverse the burden of proof but will review regulation with partners.
I am willing to enter into discussion with health insurers about how they check and reimburse claims for care provided in foreign clinics, and to inform your House about this in spring 2025.

Ik ben bereid het gesprek met zorgverzekeraars aan te gaan over de vraag op welke manier zij declaraties voor zorg – die geleverd is in buitenlandse klinieken – controleren en vergoeden, en uw Kamer daarover in het voorjaar van 2025 te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over een brand op een balkon waar een lhbti+ vlag hing

MPs Mutluer and Kostić asked the Justice and Education ministers about an arson fire in Breda that possibly targeted a rainbow flag, the aftercare for the victim, rising anti-LGBTI discrimination, the regenbooggemeenten programme, the timing of a new action plan, and the implementation of motions on police and intersectional discrimination. The minister condemned the incident while noting the investigation is ongoing, listed support measures, school programmes and planned research, and committed to a follow-up approach and action plan by spring 2025 while declining to comment on the victim's case for privacy reasons.
Because of the privacy and safety of the victim, I will not make further statements about this specific case.
Vanwege de privacy en de veiligheid van het slachtoffer doe ik geen verdere uitspraken over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie maakt einde aan blokkade sluizen IJmuiden door XR’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a blockade of the IJmuiden locks by Extinction Rebellion that halted shipping to Amsterdam, asking about the legal basis, police capacity, identification, damages, subsidies and whether the law should distinguish peaceful demonstrations from disorderly actions. The government answered that the mayor is responsible for assessing demonstrations, that the Wet openbare manifestaties is considered adequate, that a WODC study and Inspectorate review are underway, and it declined to commit to new legislation pending that research.
The mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations and therefore also for assessing whether a demonstration is peaceful.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van demonstraties en daarmee ook voor de beoordeling of er sprake is van een vreedzame demonstratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk  inzake het bericht ''Verdachten van mishandeling in zorgboerderij voorlopig op vrije voeten na blunder van justitie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why suspects convicted of abusing disabled residents at a care farm were released after the prosecution service missed the deadline to request continued detention, and how such errors will be prevented. The Minister acknowledged the error, explained it stemmed from faulty registration and a CJIB notification failure, said the OM and CJIB are taking measures, and stated the court rejected the late request so the matter is for the court and OM.
The OM and the CJIB are taking measures to prevent such a situation in the future, and where necessary the judiciary will be involved.
Het OM en het CJIB nemen maatregelen om een dergelijke situatie in de toekomst te voorkomen, waar nodig wordt de Rechtspraak hierbij betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Michon-Derkzen over online video’s in treinen voor pornoplatforms

MPs Veltman and Michon-Derkzen asked the government about online videos of people masturbating on trains that are posted on porn platforms, and about enforcement against offenders and platform responsibility. The Secretary of State answered that existing criminal provisions can address the offenders, that NS handles preventive measures and reports on-the-spot cases to police, that platforms are bound by the DSA's notice-and-action duties, and that no new action is planned beyond existing measures.
Therefore I see no need to consult further.
Ik zie daarom ook geen noodzaak om nader in overleg te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk, Helder en Michon-Derkzen over de voorgenomen sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from several parties ask the Minister of Justice and Security why the police plan to close the Wolvega station and replace it with a smaller police post, questioning the decision's basis, its effect on police presence, consultation with local government, and the link to coalition plans for more police presence in neighbourhoods. The Minister answers that station locations are a police responsibility, that the transformation follows a 2015 housing plan aimed at more mobile policing on the street, that no final location has been chosen, and that a new police post is planned by end 2025 with the municipality of Weststellingwerf.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, stay open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over groeiend aantal boeren dat wordt benaderd door onder meer drugscriminelen

Two MPs asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a reported rise in farmers approached by drug criminals offering use of barns, and what is being done. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the data does not show a rising trend, and described existing measures (advisors, Veilig Buitengebied, reporting lines) while declining to give police-level detail on how cases are handled.
This specific theme is also not registered as a separate category by the police.
Dit specifieke thema wordt ook niet als aparte categorie geregistreerd door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de hernieuwde fatwa van imam Jalali

Wilders asked whether the government knew of imam Jalali's renewed fatwa against him, whether it condemns the threats, what it has done to get the imam imprisoned, and what consequences non-cooperation by Pakistan would have. The minister said AIVD and NCTV information cannot be discussed publicly, condemned the threats, described diplomatic and legal-assistance efforts with Pakistan, and declined to pre-empt consequences for relations with Pakistan.

As is known to your House, no public statement can be made about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat casuistry and security measures for individuals.

Antwoord 2 Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan er over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigingscasuïstiek en beveiligingsmatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het DNA-spoor op het wapen waarmee Pim Fortuyn is vermoord

An MP asked whether the Public Prosecution Service will re-run a DNA trace from the Fortuyn murder weapon through international databases, and whether further investigation is possible for truth-finding. The Minister confirmed the OM decided against it because any match would only show possession before 2002 of an offence that has since prescribed, and said the Minister will not interfere in that prosecutorial decision.
The decision on whether to have further investigation carried out into the DNA trace in question rests with the OM.
De beslissing om al dan niet nader onderzoek naar het betreffende DNA-spoor te laten verrichten is aan het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Lahlah over het bericht 'CJIB wil bevoegdheid om te kunnen stoppen met het verhogen van verkeersboetes'

MPs Lahlah and El Abassi asked the Justice Minister about reports that the CJIB wants powers to stop raising traffic fine surcharges where these cause unreasonable hardship, and about the proportionality and fairness of fines and collection costs compared with commercial agencies. The minister acknowledges the CJIB's signal, points to planned measures (a free reminder before collection costs, and power to waive surcharges in cases of force majeure) and ongoing studies, but does not commit to a legislative change before summer 2025 and gives no firm answer on the fine levels.
First, that the CJIB can first send a free payment reminder before collection costs are charged.
Ten eerste dat het CJIB eerst een gratis betalingsherinnering kan sturen voordat aanmaningskosten in rekening worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked ministers about the enforcement of labour exploitation, including prosecution figures, UWV's failure to revoke work permits in the Cornwall case, information sharing between ministries, housing tied to employment, inspectorate capacity and the scope of the criminal definition. The minister answered with figures on prosecutions, the legal limits on revoking permits, the new trafficking bill and the expansion of inspection capacity, while saying some earlier recommendations were not adopted.
On 25 April, the bill on modernising and extending the criminalisation of human trafficking was therefore submitted to the House of Representatives.
Op 25 april jl. is daarom het wetsvoorstel modernisering en uitbreiding strafbaarstelling mensenhandel bij de Tweede Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over arbeidsuitbuiting.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, about labour exploitation of migrant workers, the information exchange between the ministry and UWV, and the enforcement record of the Labour Inspectorate. The government says it treats exploitation as a high priority, describes changes to the Wav and enforcement capacity, and announces a bill to modernise the criminal offence of human trafficking, expected to take effect around mid-2025.

Alongside the planned amendment, the strengthened action plan 'Together against human trafficking' is exploring whether criminal investigation of suspects can be decoupled from establishing victim status.

Naast de voorgenomen wetswijziging wordt daarom in het kader van het versterkte Actieplan «Samen tegen mensenhandel» verkend of het uitvoeren van strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar verdachten van mensenhandel losgekoppeld kan worden van het vaststellen van slachtofferschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Groeiende groep mensen kijkt naar seksueel misbruik van minderjarigen, ook jongeren ‘voor de kick’

An MP asked the Justice Minister and the Education State Secretary about reports that minors share child sexual abuse material casually, asking about encryption, prevention, awareness, support for investigators and trends. The government answered by pointing to its enforcement and prevention measures, the EU CSAM regulation and HLG work, education efforts, and existing psychological support, while noting that end-to-end encryption limits investigators' access to message content.

The cabinet is committed to effectively combating child sexual abuse imagery, but restrictions on fundamental rights will only take place when strictly necessary and proportionate, and surrounded by adequate safeguards.

Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in dat beeldmateriaal van seksueel kindermisbruik effectief kan worden bestreden, maar dat inperking van grondrechten alleen plaatsvindt wanneer dit strikt noodzakelijk en proportioneel is, en omkleed met passende waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai inzake de bescherming van sekswerkers

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Justice Minister about violence against sex workers, the Ugly Mugs report, and the government's position on six recommendations including decriminalisation. The minister acknowledged the signals, said police lack reliable data on victims who are sex workers, agreed that strict rules can create vulnerability, and said most recommendations match the existing 'Aanpak' and that progress will be reported in autumn.
In the autumn I will inform the House by letter about the progress of this.
In het najaar informeer ik uw Kamer middels een brief over de voortgang hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dral over het artikel ‘Kindsoldaten uit de polder’

MP Dral asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about a newspaper report on youths recruited into criminal exploitation, including prevention measures, police and conviction statistics, progress on an initiative note, municipal enforcement capacity, a planned tougher youth criminal law, and the 'patseraanpak'. The government said prevention is being funded and expanded, could not provide the requested police and court figures because they are not recorded, and promised further information on the youth sentencing and Halt pilot proposals later.
It is therefore not possible to provide the requested figures.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om de gevraagde cijfers aan te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het artikel 'Psychiaters eisen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar euthanasie van Milou (17)'

Paulusma (D66) asked about psychiatrists' demand for a criminal investigation into the euthanasia of a 17-year-old, after the regional review committee judged it careful. The government answered that criminal investigation is only warranted where the review committee finds a breach, that the Public Prosecution Service saw no reason to investigate, and that it supports ThaNet efforts to build expertise on euthanasia in psychiatric cases.
The Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to start a criminal investigation in this case.
Het OM ziet geen reden om in dit geval een strafrechtelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ernstig dierenleed bij de training en inzet van politiehonden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice Minister about a police dog shot during an arrest, the mistreatment of dogs at a Schiedam training school, and whether police dog use should be phased out. The minister said the shooting is under internal investigation and not discussed in detail, that no central figures on dog injuries are kept, that the training school involved was a different association and an investigation is ongoing, and that phasing out police dogs is not on the table but animal welfare is being improved.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual cases, nor about the final results of internal police investigations into a specific incident.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitlatingen te doen over individuele gevallen en evenmin over uiteindelijke resultaten van intern politieonderzoek naar een concreet incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de oproep van Extinction Rebellion om de A12 te bezetten op 6 juli 2024

MP Eerdmans asked the Justice Minister about Extinction Rebellion's road blockades (A12) and planned action on 6 July 2024, covering police capacity, preventive seizure and searches, prosecution for incitement, and whether the group's ANBI charity status should be revoked. The minister answered that police and the Public Prosecution Service are responsible for operational and prosecutorial decisions, outlined the legal limits on seizure and searches, and explained that ANBI status is assessed by the Tax Authority under strict secrecy, with revocation only for serious crimes; the answers came late.
It is not for me to decide on that. Any arrest of people is a matter for the police under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service.
Het is niet aan mij om zoiets te besluiten. Het eventueel aanhouden van mensen is aan de politie onder gezag van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op van het lid Abassi over het bericht ‘Omwonenden Stampersgat: “Parkeerruzie leidde tot doodschieten Hamza (25)”’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a fatal shooting in Stampersgat reportedly linked to a parking dispute, the shooter's public racist statements, whether police check weapon holders involved in neighbour disputes, and how discrimination motives are assessed. The minister answered that police check weapon licence holders regularly, that the criminal investigation is ongoing so the case cannot be discussed, that discrimination aspects are investigated per OM policy, and that criticism of religion is lawful while group insults and incitement are not.
I cannot go into this ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Ban op boa-hoofddoek voorlopig in ijskast gezet'

An MP asked the Justice Minister why legislation requiring neutral appearance for municipal enforcement officers (boa's), including a headscarf ban, has been delayed and is now tied to the new coalition agreement. The minister answered that the neutrality law is being prepared carefully, will be linked to the coalition agreement, that existing guidelines apply in the meantime, and that the Chamber will be informed as soon as possible about the timeline.
Your Chamber will be informed by me as soon as possible about the further course.
Uw Kamer wordt zo spoedig mogelijk door mij geïnformeerd over het verdere traject.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over het eindrapport van de Commissie Schneiders, de overdracht van het dossier aan de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en de opvolging v

MPs asked whether the Schneiders Commission should continue monitoring implementation of its 20 recommendations on the Landelijke Eenheid, given union and works council concerns that the transition is unfinished and that oversight passes to the Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid. The Minister replied that oversight rests with the police leadership through an internal monitoring process, with Schneiders staying on as adviser and the Inspectie checking quality of task performance, and that no extension of the commission is planned.
Oversight of and direction for implementing the recommendations is the responsibility of the police leadership and, by extension, the leadership of the national units.
Toezicht op en sturing geven aan de opvolging van de gedane aanbevelingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de korpsleiding en in het verlengde daarvan de leidingen van de landelijke eenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Mutluer over ‘het bericht omtrent de opheffing van commissie-Schneiders die de Landelijke Eenheid onderzocht en zou monitoren’

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether the Schneiders committee on the Landelijke Eenheid police unit was dissolved after delivering its final report, whether the report will be sent to parliament, and how the transition, culture change, leadership and staff participation are being secured. The minister answers that the report was delivered as agreed, that oversight now rests with the police leadership and the Inspectorate, that Schneiders stays on as an adviser, and that the transition is a multi-year process with funding kept in place.
Oversight of and direction for following up the recommendations is a responsibility of the police leadership and, by extension, the leadership of the Landelijke Eenheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk en Helder over de sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and BBB asked the Minister of Justice about the planned closure of the Wolvega police station, its consistency with the coalition's commitment to visible policing, the reasons for closure, and talks with the municipality. The Minister answered that a smaller police post will replace it, the police decide closures in consultation with local authorities, and talks with the municipality are ongoing.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, remain open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
